etacchrutvā sa dharmātmā dharmavyādho ruṣānvitaḥ |
mataṅgasya gṛhaṃ so'tha gatvā janapadairvṛtam || 8.17 ||
tasyāgatasya saṃbandhī mataṅgo jayatāṃ varaḥ |
āsanādyardhyapādyena pūjayitvedamabravīt |
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ te kiṃ karomyāgatakriyām || 8.18 ||
vyādha uvāca |
bhojanaṃ kiṃcidicchāmi bhoktuṃ caitanyavarjitam |
kautūhalena yenāhamāgato bhavato gṛham || 8.19 ||
mataṅga uvāca |
godhūmā vrīmayaścaiva saṃskṛtā mama veśmani |
bhujyatāṃ dharmavicchreṣṭha yathākāmaṃ tapodhana || 8.20 ||
vyādha uvāca |
paśyāmi kīdṛśāste hi godhūmā vrīhayo yavāḥ |
svarūpeṇa ca santyete yena vo vedmi sattama || 8.21 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
evamukte mataṅgena śūrpaṃ godhūmapūritam |
aparaṃ tatra vrīhīṇāṃ dharmavyādhāya darśitam || 8.22 ||
dṛṣṭvā vrīhīn sagodhūmān dharmavyādho varāsanāt |
utthāya gantumārebhe mataṅgena nivāritaḥ || 8.23 ||
kimarthaṃ gantumārabdhaṃ tvayā vada mahāmate |
abhuktenaiva saṃsiddhaṃ madgṛhe cānnamuttamam |
pācayitvā svayaṃ caiva kasmāt tvaṃ nādya bhuñjase || 8.24 ||
vyādha uvāca |
sahastraśaḥ koṭiśaśca jīvān haṃsi dine dine |
athedṛśasya pāpasya ko'nnaṃ bhuñjati satpumān || 8.25 ||
acaitanyaṃ yadi gṛhe vidyate'nnaṃ susaṃskṛtam |
idānīmatra saṃdṛṣṭā ete tu jalajantavaḥ || 8.26 ||
(uptāḥ sahastratāṃ yānti pratisaṃvatsaraṃ mune |) || 8.26 (1)||
ahamekaṃ kuṭumbārthe hanmyaraṇye paśuṃ dine |
taṃ cet pitṛbhyaḥ saṃskṛtya dattvā bhuñjāmi sānugaḥ || 8.27 ||
tvaṃ tu jīvān bahūn hatvā svakuṭumbena sānugaḥ |
bhuñjannetena satatamabhojyaṃ tanmataṃ mama || 8.28 ||
brahmaṇā tu purā sṛṣṭā oṣadhyaḥ sarvavīrudhaḥ |
yajñārthaṃ tattu bhūtānāṃ bhakṣyamityeva vai śrutiḥ || 8.29 ||
divyo bhautastathā paitro mānuṣo brāhma eva ca |
ete pañca mahāyajñā brahmaṇā nirmitāḥ purā || 8.30 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ hitārthāya itareṣāṃ ca tanmukham |
itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ kāritāḥ śubhāḥ || 8.31 ||
evaṃ yadi vibhāgaḥ syād varānnaṃ tad viśudhyati |
anyathā vrīhayo'pyete ekaike mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
mantavyā dātṛbhoktṛṇāṃ mahāmāṃsaṃ tu tat smṛtam || 8.32 ||
mayā te duhitā dattā putrārthe devarūpiṇī |
sā ca tvadbhāryayā proktā duhitā jantughātinaḥ || 8.33 ||
ato'rthamāgato'haṃ te gṛhaṃ prati samīkṣitum |
ācāraṃ devapūjāṃ ca atithīnāṃ ca tarpaṇam || 8.34 ||
eteṣāmekamapyatra kurvannapi na dṛśyate |
tad gṛhaṃ gantumicchāmi pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhakāmyayā || 8.35 ||
svagṛhe naiva bhuñjāmi pitṝṇāṃ kāryamityuta |
ahaṃ vyādho jīvaghātī na tu tvaṃ lokahiṃsakaḥ || 8.36 ||
matsutā jīvaghātasya yadoḍhā tvatsutena ca |
tanmahattvaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ prāyaścitaṃ tapodhana || 8.37 ||
evamuktvā sa cotthāya śaptvā nārīṃ tadā dhare |
mā snuṣābhiḥ samaṃ śvaśrvā viśvāso bhavatu kvacit || 8.38 ||
mā ca snuṣā kadācit syād yā śvaśrūṃ jīvatīmiṣet |
evamuktvā gato vyādhaḥ svagṛhaṃ prati bhāmini || 8.39 ||
tato devān pitṝn bhaktayā pūjayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
putraṃ cārjunakaṃ sthāpya svasantāne mahātapāḥ || 8.40 ||
dharmavyādho jagāmāśu tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam |
puruṣottamākhyaṃ ca paraṃ tatra gatvā samāhitaḥ |
tapaścacāra niyataḥ paṭhan stotramidaṃ dhare || 8.41 ||
namāmi viṣṇuṃ tridaśārināśanaṃ
viśālavakṣasthalasaṃśritaśriyam |
suśāsanaṃ nītimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ
trivikramaṃ mandaradhāriṇaṃ sadā || 8.42 ||
dāmodaraṃ rañjitabhūtalaṃ dhiyā
yaśoṃśuśubhraṃ bhramarāṅgasaprabham |
dharādharaṃ narakaripuṃ puruṣṭutaṃ
namāmi viṣṇuṃ śaraṇaṃ janārdanam || 8.43 ||
(naraṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ harimīśvaraṃ prabhuṃ
tridhāmanāmānamanantavarcasam |
susaṃskṛtāsyaṃ śaraṇaṃ narottamaṃ
vrajāmi devaṃ satataṃ tamacyutam || 8.43 (1))
tridhā sthitaṃ tigmarathāṅgapāṇinaṃ
nayasthitaṃ tṛptamanuttamairguṇaiḥ |
niḥśreyasākhyaṃ kṣapitetaraṃ guruṃ
namāmi viṣṇuṃ puruṣottamaṃ tvaham || 8.44 ||
(hatau purāṇau madhukaiṭabhāvubhau
bibhartti ca kṣmāṃ śirasā sadā hi saḥ |
yathā stuto me prasabhaṃ sanātano
dadhātu viṣṇuḥ sukhamūrjitaṃ mama || 8.44 (1))
mahāvarāho haviṣāmbubhojano
janārdano me hitakṛccitīmukhaḥ |
kṣitīdharo māmudadhikṣayo mahān
sa pātu viṣṇuḥ śaraṇārthinaṃ tu mām || 8.45 ||
māyātataṃ yena jagattrayaṃ kṛtaṃ
yathāgninaikena tataṃ carācaram |
carācarasya svayameva sarvataḥ
sa me'stu viṣṇuḥ śaraṇaṃ jagatpatiḥ || 8.46 ||
bhave bhave yaśca sasarjja kaṃ tato
jagat prasūtaṃ sacarācaraṃ tvidam |
tataśca rudrātmavati pralīyate'nvato harirviṣṇuharastathocyate || 8.47 ||
khātmendupṛthvīpavanāgnibhāskarā jalaṃ ca yasya prabhavanti mūrttayaḥ |
sa sarvadā me bhagavān sanātano
dadātu śaṃ viṣṇuracintyarūpadhṛk || 8.48 ||
itīrite tasya sanātanaḥ svayaṃ
puro babhūvādbhutarūpadarśanaḥ |
dharaṇyuvāca |
ādau kṛtayuge nātha kiṃ kṛtaṃ viśvamūrttinā |
nārāyaṇena tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 9.1 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
pūrvaṃ nārāyaṇastveko nāsīt kiñciddhareḥ param |
saika eva ratiṃ lebhe naiva svacchandakarmakṛt || 9.2 ||
tasya dvitīyamicchantaścintā buddhyātmikā babhau |
asāvityeva saṃjñāyā kṣaṇaṃ bhāskarasannibhā || 9.3 ||
tasyā api dvidhā bhūtā cintā'bhūda brahmavādinī |
umeti saṃjñayā yattatsadā martye vyavasthitā || 9.4 ||
omityekākṣarībhūtā sasarjemāṃ mahīṃ tadā |
bhūḥ sasarja bhuvaṃ so'pi svaḥ sasarja tato mahaḥ || 9.5 ||
tataśca jana ityeva tapaścātmā pralīyate |
etadotaṃ tathā protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva || 9.6 ||
jagat praṇavato bhūtaṃ śūnyametat sthitaṃ tadā |
yeyaṃ mūrtirbhagavataḥ śaṃkaraḥ sa svayaṃ hariḥ || 9.7 ||
śūnyām̐llokānimān dṛṣṭvā sisṛkṣurmūrttimuttamām |
kṣobhayitvā manodhāma tatrākāraḥ svamātrataḥ || 9.8 ||
sthitastasmin yadā kṣubdhe brahmāṇḍamabhavattadā |
tasmiṃstu śakalībhūte bhūrlokaṃ ca vyavasthitam || 9.9 ||
aparaṃ bhuvanaṃ prāyānmadhye bhāskarasannibham |
purāṇapuruṣo vyāpya padmakośe vyavasthitaḥ || 9.10 ||
sa hi nārāyaṇo devaḥ prājāpatyena tejasā |
akārādyaṃ svaraṃ nābhyāṃ halaṃ ca visasarja ha || 9.11 ||
amūrttasṛṣṭau śāstrāṇi udagāyat tadā diśaḥ |
suṣṭvā punarameyātmā cintayāmāsa dhāraṇam || 9.12 ||
tasya cintayato netrāt tejaḥ samabhavanmahat |
dakṣiṇaṃ vahnisaṅkāśaṃ vāmaṃ tuhinasannibham || 9.13 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā candrasūryau tu kalpitau parameṣṭhinā |
tataḥ prāṇaḥ samuttasthau vāyuśca parameṣṭhinaḥ || 9.14 ||
sa eva vāyurbhagavān yo'dyāpi hṛdigo vibhuḥ |
tasmād vahniḥ samuttasthau tasmādagnerjalaṃ mahat || 9.15 ||
ya evāgniḥ sa vai tejo brāhmaṃ paramakāraṇam |
bāhubhyāmapyasau tejaḥ kṣātraṃ tejaḥ sasarja ha || 9.16 ||
ūrubhyāmapi vaiśyāṃśca padbhyāṃ śūdrāṃstathā vibhuḥ |
tatastu sasṛje yakṣān rākṣasāṃśca tathā vibhuḥ || 9.17 ||
caturvidhaistu bhūrlokaṃ bhuvarlokaṃ viyaccaraiḥ |
bhūtaiḥ svarmārgagairanyaiḥ svarlokaṃ samapūrayat || 9.18 ||
maharlokaṃ tathā taistairbhūtaiśca sanakādibhiḥ |
janolokaṃ tataścaiva vairājaiḥ samapūrayat || 9.19 ||
tapolokaṃ tato devastaponiṣṭhairapūrayat |
apunarmārakairdevaiḥ satyalokamapūrayat || 9.20 ||
sṛṣṭiṃ sṛṣṭvā tathā devo bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ |
kalpasaṃjñaṃ svakaṃ ghastraṃ jāgarti parameśvaraḥ || 9.21 ||
tasmin jagati bhūrloko bhuvarlokaśca jāyate |
svarlokaśca trayo'pyete jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 9.22 ||
supte tu deve kalpānte tāvatī rātririṣyate |
trai lokyametat suptaṃ syāt tathopaplavatāṃ gatam || 9.23 ||
tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmutthitaḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ |
cintayāmāsa tān vedān mātaraṃ ca caturṣvapi |
cintayānaḥ sa deveśastān vedān nādhyagacchata || 9.24 ||
lokamārgasthitiṃ karttuṃ nidrājñānena mohitaḥ |
cintayāmāsa deveśo nātra vedā vyavasthitāḥ || 9.25 ||
tataḥ svamūrtau toyākhye līnān dṛṣṭvā sureśvaraḥ |
jighṛkṣuścintayāmāsa matsyo bhūtvāviśajjalam || 9.26 ||
evaṃ dhyātvā mahāmatsyastatkṣaṇāt samajāyata |
viveśa ca jalaṃ devaḥ samantāt kṣobhayanniva || 9.27 ||
tasmin praviṣṭe sahasā jalaṃ tu
mahāmahīdhṛgvapuṣi prakāśam |
mātsyaṃ gate devavare mahodadhiṃ
hariṃ stavaistuṣṭuvuruddhṛtakṣitim || 9.28 ||
namo'stu vedāntaragāpratarkya
namo'stu nārāyaṇa matsyarūpa |
namo'stu te susvara viśvamūrtte
namo'stu vidyādvayarūpadhārin || 9.29 ||
namo'stu candrārkamarutsvarūpa
jalāntaviśvasthita cārunetra |
namo'stu viṣṇoḥ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ
prapāhi no matsyatanuṃ vihāya || 9.30 ||
tvayā tataṃ viśvamanantamūrtte pṛthaggate kiñcidihāsti deva |
bhavān na cāsya vyatiriktamūrttistvatto vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ || 9.31 ||
khātmenduvahniśca manaśca rūpaṃ
purāṇamūrttestava cābjanetra |
kṣamasva śaṃbho yadi bhaktihīnaṃ
tvayā jagadbhāsati devadeva || 9.32 ||
viruddhametat tava devarūpaṃ
subhīṣaṇaṃ susvanamadritulyam |
purāṇa deveśa jagannivāsa
śamaṃ prayāhyacyuta tīvrabhāno || 9.33 ||
vayaṃ hi sarve śaraṇaṃ prapannā
bhayācca te rūpamidaṃ prapaśya |
loke samastaṃ bhavatā vinā tu
na vidyate dehagataṃ purāṇam || 9.34 ||
evaṃ stutastadā devo jalasthān jagṛhe ca saḥ |
vedān sopaniṣacchāstrānantaḥsthaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ || 9.35 ||
yāvatsvamūrtirbhagavāṃstāvadeva jagat tvidam |
kūṭasthe tallayaṃ yāti vikṛtisthe vivarddhate || 9.36 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
evaṃ sṛṣṭvā jagatsarvaṃ bhagavān lokabhāvanaḥ |
virarāma tataḥ sṛṣṭirvyavarddhata dhare tadā || 1 ||
vṛddhāyāmatha sṛṣṭau tu sarve devāḥ purātanam |
nārāyaṇākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ yajanto vividhairmakhaiḥ || 2 ||
dvīpeṣu caiva sarveṣu varṣeṣu ca makhairharim |
devāḥ satrairmahadbhiste yajantaḥ śraddhayā'nvitāḥ |
toṣayāmāsuratyarthaṃ svaṃ pūjyaṃ kartumīpsavaḥ || 3 ||
evaṃ toṣayatāṃ teṣāṃ bahuvarṣasahastrikam |
kāle devastadā tuṣṭaḥ pratyakṣatvaṃ jagāma ha || 4 ||
anekabāhūdaravaktranetro
mahāgireḥ śrṛṅgamivollikhaṃstadā |
uvāca kiṃ kāryamatho sureśo
brūtāṃ varaṃ devavarā varaṃ vaḥ || 5 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
jayasva govinda mahānubhāva
tvayā vayaṃ nātha vareṇa devāḥ |
manuṣyaloke'pi bhavantamādyaṃ
vihāya nāsmānbhavate ha kaścit || 6 ||
rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā
viśve'śvinau marutaścoṣmapāśca |
sarve bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ sma
kuruṣva pūjyāniha viśvamūrte || 7 ||
evamuktastadā taistu mahāyogeśvaro hariḥ |
karomi sarvān vaḥ pūjyānityuktvā'ntaradhīyata || 8 ||
devā api nijaukāṃsi gatavantaḥ sanātanam |
stuvantaḥ parameśo'pi trividhaṃ bhāvamāsthitaḥ || 9 ||
evaṃ tridhā jagaddhātā bhūtvā devān maheśvaraḥ |
ārādhya sāttvikaṃ rājaṃ tāmasaṃ ca tridhā sthitam || 10 ||
sāttvikena paṭhed vedān yajed yajñena devatāḥ |
ātmano'vayavo bhūtvā rājasenāpi keśavaḥ || 11 ||
sa kālarūpiṇaṃ raudraṃ prakṛtyā śūlapāṇinam |
ātmano rājasīṃ mūrtiṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ |
tāmasenāpi bhāvena asureṣu vyavasthitaḥ || 12 ||
evaṃ tridhā jagaddhātā bhūtvā devān maheśvaraḥ |
ārādhayāmāsa tato loko'pi trividho'bhavat || 13 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānanāmnā gṛhya vyavasthitaḥ |
sa ca nārāyaṇo devaḥ kṛte yugavare prabhuḥ || 14 ||
tretāyāṃ rudrarūpastu dvāpare yajñamūrtimān |
kalau nārāyaṇo devo bahurūpo vyajāyata || 15 ||
tasyādikṛttato viṣṇoścaritaṃ bhūritejasaḥ |
śrṛṇuṣva sarvaṃ suśroṇi gadato mama bhāmini || 16 ||
āsīt kṛtayuge rājā supratīko mahābalaḥ |
tasya bhāryādvayaṃ cāsīdaviśiṣṭaṃ manoramam || 17 ||
vidyutprabhā kāntimatī tayorete tu nāmanī |
tayoḥ putraṃ samaṃ rājā na lebhe yatnavānapi || 18 ||
yadā tadā muniśreṣṭhamātreyaṃ vītakalmaṣam |
toṣayāmāsa vidhinā citrakūṭe nagottame || 19 ||
saka ṛṣistoṣitastena dīrghakālaṃ varārthinā |
varaṃ diditsayā yāvadabravīdatrijo muniḥ || 20 ||
tāvadindro'pi kariṇā gataḥ pārśvena tasya ha |
devasainyaiḥ parivṛtastūṣṇīmeva mahābalaḥ || 21 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā'ntargataprītimaprītiṃ prītavān muniḥ |
cukopa devarājāya śāpamugraṃ sasarja ha || 22 ||
yasmāt tvayā mamāvajñā kṛtā mūḍha divaspate |
tatastvaṃ cālito rājyādanyaloke vasiṣyasi || 23 ||
evamuktvā'pi kopena sureśaṃ taṃ ca bhūpatim |
uvāca rājan putraste bhavitā dṛḍhavikramaḥ || 24 ||
indrarūpopamaḥ śrīmānudyacchastraḥ pratāpavān |
vidyāprabhāvakarmmajñaḥ krūrakarmā bhaviṣyati |
durjayo'tibalī rājā evamuktvā gato muniḥ || 25 ||
so'pi rājā supratīko bhāryāyāṃ garbhamāvahat |
vidyutprabhāyāṃ dharmajñaḥ sā'pi kāle tvasūyata || 26 ||
tasyāḥ putraḥ samabhavad durjayākhyo mahābalaḥ |
jātakarmādisaṃskāraṃ tasya cakre muniḥ svayam |
(durvāsā nāma tapaso tasya dehamakalmaṣaḥ || 27 ||)
tasya ceṣṭerbalenāsau muneḥ saumyo babhūva ha |
vedaśāstrārthavidyāyāṃ pārago dharmavān śuciḥ || 28 ||
yā dvitīyā'bhavat patnī tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ |
nāmnā kīrttimatī dhanyā tasyāḥ putro babhūva ha |
nāmnā sudyumna ityevaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ || 29 ||
atha kālena mahatā sa rājā rājasattamaḥ |
supratīkaḥ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā durjayaṃ yogyamantike || 30 ||
ātmano vṛddhabhāvaṃ ca vārāṇasyādhipo balī |
cintayāmāsa rājyārthaṃ durjayaṃ prati bhāmini || 31 ||
evaṃ saṃcintya dharmātmā tasya rājyaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ |
svayaṃ ca citrakūṭākhyaṃ parvataṃ sa jagāma ha || 32 ||
durjayo'pi mahadrājyaṃ hastyaśvarathavājibhiḥ |
saṃyojya cintayāmāsa rājyavṛddhiṃ prati prabhuḥ || 33 ||
evaṃ saṃcintya medhāvī hastyaśvarathapattibhiḥ |
sametāṃ vāhinīṃ kṛtvā uttarāṃ diśamāśritaḥ |
tasya cottarato deśāḥ sarve siddhā mahātmanaḥ || 34 ||
bhāratākhyamidaṃ varṣaṃ sādhayitvā sudurjayaḥ |
tataḥ kiṃpuruṣaṃ nāma varṣaṃ tenāpi sādhitam || 35 ||
tataḥ parataraṃ cānyaddharivarṣaṃ jigāya saḥ |
ramyaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ cāpi kurubhadrāśvameva ca |
ilāvṛtaṃ merumadhyametat sarvaṃ jigāya saḥ || 36 ||
jitvā jambvākhyametaddhi dvīpaṃ yāvadasau nṛpaḥ |
jagāma devarājānaṃ jetuṃ sarvasurānvitam || 37 ||
meruparvatamāruhya devagandharvadānavān |
guhyakān kiṃ narān daityāṃstato brahmasuto muniḥ |
nārado durjayajayaṃ devarājāya śaṃsata || 38 ||
tata indrastvarāyukto lokapālaiḥ samanvitaḥ |
jagāma durjayaṃ hantuṃ so'cireṇāstranirjjitam |
vihāya parvataṃ meruṃ martyalokamihāgataḥ || 39 ||
pūrvadeśe ca devendro lokapālaiḥ samaṃ prabhuḥ |
sthitavāṃstasya sumahaccaritaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 40 ||
durjayaśca surāñjitvā yāvat pratinivarttate |
gandhamādanapṛṣṭhe tu skandhāvāraniveśanam |
kṛtvā'vasthitasaṃbhāramāgataṃ tāpasau tu tam || 41 ||
tāvagatāvathābrūtāṃ rājan durjjaya lokapāḥ |
nivāritāstvayā sarvaṃ lokapālairvinā jagat |
na pravarttata tasmān nau dehi tatpadamuttamam || 42 ||
evamukte tatastau tu durjjayaḥ prāha dharmavit |
kau bhavantāviti tatastāvūcaturariṃdamau |
vidyutsuvidyunnāmānāvasurāviti mānada || 43 ||
tvayā samprati cecchāmo dharmyaṃ satsu susaṃskṛtau |
lokapālamataṃ sarvamāvāṃ kurma sudurjaya || 44 ||
evamukte durjjayena tau svarge sanniveśitau |
laukapālau kṛtau sadyastato'ntardhānaṃ jagmatuḥ || 45 ||
tayorapi mahatkarma caritaṃ ca dharādhare |
bhaviṣyati mahārājo durjayo mandaropari || 46 ||
dhanadasya vanaṃ divyaṃ dṛṣṭvā nandanasannibham |
mudā babhrāma ramye'smin sa yāvadrājasattamaḥ || 47 ||
tāvatsuvarṇavṛkṣādhaḥ kanyādvayamapaśyata |
atīvarūpasaṃpannamatīvādbhutadarśanam || 48 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu vismayāviṣṭaḥ ka ime śubhalocane |
evaṃ saṃcintya yāvat sa kṣaṇamekaṃ vyavasthitaḥ |
tasmin vane tāvadubhau tāpasau so'valokayat || 49 ||
tau dṛṣṭvā sahasā rājā yayau prītyā parāṃ mudam |
avatīrya dvipāt tūrṇaṃ namaścakre tayoḥ svayam || 50 ||
upaviṣṭaḥ sa tābhyāṃ tu kauśye datte varāsane |
pṛṣṭaḥ kastvaṃ kutaścāsi kasya vā kimiha sthitaḥ || 51 ||
tau prahasyābravīd rājā supratīketi viśrutaḥ |
tasya putraḥ samutpanno durjayo nāma nāmataḥ || 52 ||
pṛthivyāṃ sarvarājāno jigīṣanniha sattamau |
āgato'smi dhruvaṃ caiva smarttavyo'haṃ tapodhanau |
bhavantau kau samākhyātaṃ mamānugrahakāṅkṣayā || 53 ||
tāpasāvūcatuḥ |
āvāṃ hetṛprahetrākhyau manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ sutau |
āvāṃ devavināśāya gatau svo meruparvatam || 54 ||
tatrāvayormahāsainyaṃ gajāśvarathasaṃkulam |
jigāya sarvadevānāṃ śataśo'tha sahastraśaḥ || 55 ||
te ca devā mahatsainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ nipātitam |
asurairujjhitaprāṇaṃ tataste śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 56 ||
kṣīrābdhau yatra deveśo hariḥ śete svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
tatra vijñāpayāmāsuḥ sarve praṇatipūrvakam || 57 ||
devadeva hare sarvaṃ sainyaṃ tvasurasattamaiḥ |
parājitaṃ paritrāhi bhītaṃ vihvallocanam || 58 ||
tvayā devāsure yuddhe pūrvaṃ trātāḥ sma keśava |
sahastrabāhoḥ krūrasya samare kālaneminaḥ || 59 ||
idānīmapi deveśa asurau devakaṇṭakau |
hetṛprahetṛnāmānau bahusainyaparicchadau |
tau hatvā trāhi naḥ sarvān devadeva jagatpate || 60 ||
evamuktastato devo viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
ahaṃ yāsyāmi tau hantumityuvāca jagatpatiḥ || 61 ||
evamuktāstato devā meruparvatasannidhau |
pratasthuste'tha manasā cintayanto janārdanam || 62 ||
taiḥ saṃcintitamātrastu devaścakragadādharaḥ |
āvayoḥ sainyamāviśya eka eva mahābalaḥ || 63 ||
ekadhā daśadhātmānaṃ śatadhā ca sahastradhā |
lakṣadhā koṭidhā kṛtvā svabhūtyā ca jagatpatiḥ || 64 ||
evaṃ sthite devavare asmatsainye mahābalaḥ |
yaḥ kaścidasuro rājannāvayorbalamāśritaḥ |
sa hataḥ patito bhūmau dṛśyate gatacetanaḥ || 65 ||
evaṃ tat sahasā sainyaṃ māyayā viśvamūrtinā |
nihataṃ sāśvakalilaṃ pattidvipasamākulam || 66 ||
caturaṅgaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ hatvā devo rathāṅgadhṛk |
āvāṃ śoṣāvatho dṛṣṭvā gato'ntarddhānamīśvaraḥ || 67 ||
āvayorīdṛśaṃ karma dṛṣṭaṃ devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ |
tatastameva śaraṇaṃ gatāvārādhanāya vai || 68 ||
tvaṃ cāsmanmitratanayaḥ supratīkātmajo nṛpa |
ime ca āvayoḥ kanye gṛhāṇa manujeśvara |
hetṛkanyā sukeśī tu miśrakeśī prahetṛṇaḥ || 69 ||
durjayastvevamuktastu hetṛṇā te ubhe śubhe |
kanye jagrāha dharmeṇa bhāryārthaṃ manujeśvaraḥ || 70 ||
te labdhvā sahasā rājā mudā paramayā yutaḥ |
ājagāma svakaṃ rāṣṭraṃ nijasainyasamāvṛtaḥ || 71 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā tasya putradvayaṃ babhau |
sukeśyāḥ suprabhaḥ putro miśrakeśyāḥ sudarśanaḥ || 72 ||
sa rājā durjayaḥ śrīmām̐llabdhvā putradvayaṃ śubham |
svayaṃ kālāntare śrīmāñjagāmāraṇyamantike || 73 ||
tatrastho vanajātīrhi badhayan vai bhayaṃkarāḥ |
dadarśāraṇyamāśritya muniṃ sthitamakalmaṣam || 74 ||
tapasyantaṃ mahābhāgaṃ nāmnā gauramukhaṃ śubham |
ṛṣivṛndasya goptāraṃ trātāraṃ pāpinaḥ svayam || 75 ||
tasyāśrame vimalajalāvilemarutsugandhivṛkṣapravare dvijanmanaḥ |
rarāja jīmūta ivāmbarānmahīmupāgataḥ pravaravimānavad gṛhaḥ || 76 ||
jvalanamakhāgnipratibhāṣitāmbaraḥ
suśuddhasaṃvāsitaveśakuṭṭakaḥ |
śiṣyaiḥ samuccāritasāmanādakaḥ
surūpayoṣidṛṣikanyakākulaḥ |
itīdṛśo'syāvasātho varāśrame
supuṣpitāśeṣataruprasūnaḥ || 77 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
tatastamīdṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā gauramukhāśramam |
durjjayaścintayāmāsa ramyamāśramamaṇḍalam || 1 ||
praviśāmyatra paśyāmi ṛṣīn paramadhārmikān |
cintayitvā tadā rājā praviveśa tamāśramam || 2 ||
tasya praviṣṭasya tato rājñaḥ paramaharṣitaḥ |
cakāra pūjāṃ dharmātmā tadā gauramukho muniḥ || 3 ||
svāgatādikriyāḥ kṛtvā kathānte taṃ mahāmuniḥ |
svaśaktyā'haṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sānugasya ca bhojanam || 4 ||
kariṣyāmi pramucyantāṃ sādhu vāhā iti dvijaḥ |
evamuktvā sthitastūṣṇīṃ sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ || 5 ||
rājā'pi tasthau tadbhaktyā svasahāyaiḥ samanvitaḥ |
akṣauhiṇyo balasyāsya pañcamātrāstadā sthitāḥ |
ayaṃ ca tāpasaḥ kiṃ me dāsyate bhojanaṃ tviha || 6 ||
nimantrya durjayaṃ viprastadā gauramukho nṛpam |
cintayāmāsa kiṃ cāsya mayā deyaṃ tu bhojanam || 7 ||
evaṃ cintayatastasya maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ |
sthito manasi deveśo harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ saṃsmṛtya manasā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tadā |
toṣayāmāsa gaṅgāyāṃ praviśya munisattamaḥ || 9 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
kathaṃ gauramukho viṣṇuṃ toṣayāmāsa bhūdhara |
etanme kautukaṃ śrotuṃ samyagicchā pravarttate || 10 ||
namo'stu viṣṇave nityaṃ namaste pītavāsase |
namaste cādyarūpāya namaste jalarūpiṇe || 11 ||
namaste sarvasaṃsthāya namaste jalaśāyine |
namaste kṣitirūpāya namaste tejasātmane || 12 ||
namaste vāyurūpāya namaste vyomarūpiṇe |
tvaṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhustvamasi hṛcchayaḥ || 13 ||
tvamoṅkāro vaṣaṭkāraḥ sarvatraiva ca saṃsthitaḥ |
tvamādiḥ sarvadevānāṃ tava cādirna vidyate || 14 ||
tvaṃ bhūstvaṃ ca bhuvo deva tvaṃ janastvaṃ mahaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tvaṃ tapastvaṃ ca satyaṃ ca tvayi deva carācaram || 15 ||
tvatto bhūtamidaṃ viśvaṃ tvadudbhūtā ṛgādayaḥ |
tvattaḥ śāstrāṇi jātāni tvatto yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 16 ||
tvatto vṛkṣā vīrudhaśca tvattaḥ sarvā vanauṣadhīḥ |
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarpāstvatta eva janārdana || 17 ||
mamāpi devadeveśa rājā durjayasaṃjñitaḥ |
āgato'bhyāgatastasya ātithyaṃ karttumutsahe || 18 ||
tasya me nirdhanasyādya devadeva jagatpate |
bhaktinamrasya deveśa kuruṣvānnādyasaṃcayam || 19 ||
yaṃ yaṃ spṛśāmi hastena yaṃ yaṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā |
vṛkṣaṃ vā tṛṇakandaṃ vā tattadannaṃ caturvidham || 20 ||
tathā tvanyatamaṃ vā'pi yad dhyātaṃ manasā mayā |
tat sarvaṃ siddhyatāṃ mahyaṃ namaste parameśvara || 21 ||
iti stutyā tu deveśastutoṣa jagatāṃ patiḥ |
munestasya svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 22 ||
uvāca suprasannātmā brūhi vipra varaṃ param |
evaṃ śrutvā'kṣiṇī yāvadunmīlayati vai muniḥ || 23 ||
tadā śaṅkhagadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ |
garuḍastho'pi tejasvī dvādaśādityasaprabhaḥ || 24 ||
divi sūryasahastrasya bhavedyugapadutthitā |
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ || 25 ||
tatraikasthaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktamanekadhā |
dadarśa sa munirdevi vismayotphullalocanaḥ || 26 ||
jagāma śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalirathābravīt |
yadi me varado devo bhūyād bhaktasya keśava || 27 ||
idānīmeṣa nṛpatiryathā sabalavāhanaḥ |
mamāśrame kṛtāhāraḥ śvaḥ prayātā svakaṃ gṛham || 28 ||
ityuktastasya deveśo varadaḥ saṃbabhūva ha |
cittasiddhiṃ dadau tasmai maṇiṃ ca sumahāprabham || 29 ||
taṃ dattvā'ntardadhe devaḥ sa ca gauramukho muniḥ |
jagāma cāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ nānā ṛṣiniṣevitam || 30 ||
tatra gatvā sa viprendraścintayamāsa vai muniḥ |
himavacchikharākāraṃ mahābhramiva connatam |
śaśāṅkaraśmisaṅkāśaṃ gṛhaṃ vai śatabhūmikam || 31 ||
tādṛśānāṃ sahastrāṇi lakṣakoṭyaśca sarvaśaḥ |
gṛhāṇi nirmame vipro viṣṇorlabdhavarastadā || 32 ||
prākārāṇi tatopānte tallagnodyānakāni ca |
kokilākulaghuṣṭāni nānādvijavarāṇi ca |
campakāśokapunnāganāgakeśaravanti ca || 33 ||
nānājātyastathā vṛkṣā gṛhodyāneṣu sarvaśaḥ |
hastināṃ hastiśālāśca turagāṇāṃ ca mandurāḥ || 34 ||
cakāra saṃcayān vipro nānābhakṣyāṇi sarvaśaḥ |
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ tathā lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathā |
cakārānnādyanicayaṃ hemapātryaśca sarvataḥ || 35 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā sa viprastu rājānaṃ bhūritejasam |
uvāca sarvasainyāni praviśantu gṛhāniti || 36 ||
evamuktastato rājā tadgṛhaṃ parvatopamam |
praviveśāntareṣvanye bhṛtyā viviśurāśu vai || 37 ||
tatasteṣu praviṣṭeṣu tadā gauramukho muniḥ |
pragṛhya taṃ maṇiṃ divyaṃ rājānaṃ cedamabravīt || 38 ||
majjanābhyavahārārthaṃ pathi śramakṛte tathā |
vilāsinīstathā dāsān preṣayiṣyāmi te nṛpa || 39 ||
evamuktvā sa viprendrastaṃ maṇiṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śubham |
ekānte sthāpayāmāsa rājñastasya prapaścataḥ || 40 ||
tasmin sthāpitamātre tu maṇau śuddhasamaprabhe |
niśceruryoṣitastatra divyarūpāḥ sahastraśaḥ || 41 ||
sukumārāṅgarāgādyāḥ sukumāravarāṅaganāḥ |
sukapolāḥ sucārvyaṅgyaḥ sukeśāntāḥ sulocanāḥ |
kāścitsauvarṇapātrīśca gṛhītvā saṃpratasthire || 42 ||
evaṃ yoṣidgaṇāstatra narāḥ karmakarāstathā |
nirjagmustasya nṛpateḥ sarve bhṛtyā nṛpasya ha |
kevalaṃ bhojanaṃ pūrvaṃ paridhānaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 43 ||
tāḥ striyaḥ sarvabhṛtyānāṃ rājamārgeṇa majjanam |
daduste ca narāśvānāṃ hastināṃ ca tvarānvitāḥ || 44 ||
nānāvidhāni tūryāṇi tatrāvādyanta sarvaśaḥ |
majjane nṛpatestatra nanṛtuścānyayoṣitaḥ |
aparāśca jagustatra śakrasyeva pramajjataḥ || 45 ||
evaṃ divyopacāreṇa snātvā rājā mahāmanāḥ |
cintayāmāsa rājendro vismayāviṣṭacetanaḥ |
kimidaṃ munisāmarthyaṃ tapaso vā'tha vā maṇeḥ || 46 ||
evaṃ snātvā śubhe vastre paridhāyottame tathā |
vividhānnaṃ tu vidhinā bubhuje sa nṛpottamaḥ || 47 ||
yathā ca nṛpateḥ pūjā kṛtā tena maharṣiṇā |
tadvad bhṛtyajanasyāpi cakāra munisattamaḥ || 48 ||
yāvat sa rājā bubhuje sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ |
tāvadastagiriṃ bhānurjagāmāruṇasaprabhaḥ || 49 ||
tatastu rātriḥ samapadyatā'dhunā
śaracchaśāṅkojjvalaṛkṣamaṇḍitā |
karoti rāgaṃ sa ca rohiṇīdhavaḥ
susaṅgataṃ saumyaguṇeṣu tāpi ca || 50 ||
bhṛgūdvahaḥ kṛṣṇatarāṃśubhānunā
sahodyato daityaguruḥ surādhipaḥ |
athāntarātpakṣagato na rājate
svabhāvayogena matistu dehinām || 51 ||
suraktatāṃ bhūmisutaśca muñcate rāhuḥ sitī candramasoṃśubhiḥ sitaiḥ |
muktaḥ svabhāvo jagataḥ surāsurairanusvabhāvo balavān sukṛnnṛpaḥ || 52 ||
siteśvarākhyāpitaraśmimaṇḍale sūryatvasiddhāntakaṣeva nirmale |
karoti keturna pare mahattamastadā kuśīleṣu gatiśca nirmalā || 53 ||
budhoccabuddhirjagato vibhāvayan
rarāja rājño tanayaḥ svakarmabhiḥ |
bhṛtecchakaḥ kakṣavivāhitaściraṃ
bhavediyaṃ sādhuṣu sammitirdhruvam || 54 ||
karoti ketuḥ kapilaṃ viyacciraṃ
rājñaḥ surāṇāṃ pathi saṃsthitaṃ bhṛśam |
na durjanaḥ sajjanasaṃsadi kvacit
karoti śuddhaṃ nijakarmakauśalam || 55 ||
śaśāṅkaraśmipravibhāsitā api
prakāśamīyurniratāḥ pade pade |
kulaṃbhavāḥ saṃbhavadharmapattayo
mahāṃśuyogānmahatāṃ samunnatim || 56 ||
tridoṣasaktānnikṛto'sya sarvaśaḥ
sutena rājño varuṇasya sūryajaḥ |
virājate kauśikasanniveśitā
na vedakarma kvacidanyathā bhavet || 57 ||
dvandvaḥ sametān mama yaḥ śiśuḥ purā
harirya ārādhitavān nṛpāsanam |
lakṣmyāpi buddhyā suciraṃ prakāśate
dhruveṇa viṣṇusmaraṇena durlabham || 58 ||
itīdṛśī rātrirabhūdṛṣeḥ śubhe
varāśrame durjayabhūpateḥ śubhā |
sabhṛtyasāmantavarāśvadantinaḥ
subhaktavastrābharaṇādipūjayā || 59 ||
itīdṛśāyāṃ vararatnacitritāḥ
supaṭṭasaṃvītavarāstṛtāstadā |
gṛheṣu paryaṅkavarāḥ samāśritāḥ
surūpayoṣitkṛtabhaṅgabhāsurāḥ || 60 ||
sa tatra rājā visasarja bhūbhṛtaḥ
svayaṃ sabhṛtyānapi sarvato gṛhān |
gateṣu suṣvāpa varastriyā vṛtaḥ
sureśavatsvargagataḥ pratāpavān || 61 ||
evaṃ sumanasastasya sabhṛtyasya mahātmanaḥ |
ṛṣestasya prabhāvena hṛṣṭāstu suṣupustadā || 62 ||
tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ sa rājā tāḥ striyaḥ punaḥ |
antarddhānaṃ gatāstatra dṛṣṭvā tāni gṛhāṇi ca || 63 ||
adṛśyāni mahārhāṇi varāsanajalāni ca |
rājā sa vismayāviṣṭaścintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ || 64 ||
kathamevaṃ maṇirmahyaṃ bhavatīti punaḥ punaḥ |
cintayannadhigamyātha sa rājā durjayastadā || 65 ||
cintāmaṇimimaṃ cāsya harāmīti vicintya saḥ |
prayāṇaṃ nodayāmāsa sa rājāśramabāhyataḥ |
āśramasya bahirgatvā nātidūre savāhanaḥ || 66 ||
tato virocanākhyaṃ vai preṣayāmāsa mantriṇam |
ṛṣergauramukhasyāpi maṇeryācanakarmaṇi || 67 ||
ṛṣiṃ taṃ ca samāgatya maṇiṃ yācitumudyataḥ |
ratnānāṃ bhājanaṃ rājā maṇiṃ tasmai pradīyatām || 68 ||
amātyenaivamuktastu kruddho gauramukho'bravīt |
pratigṛhṇāti viprastu rājā caiva dadāti ca |
tvaṃ ca rājā punarbhūtvā yācase dīnavat katham || 69 ||
evaṃ brūhi durācāraṃ rājānaṃ durjayaṃ svayam |
gaccha drutaṃ durācāra mā tvāṃ loko'tyagāditi || 70 ||
(evamuktvā muniḥ prāgāt kuśedhmāharaṇāya vai |
cintayan manasā taṃ ca maṇiṃ śatruvināśanam ) || 71 ||
evamuktastadā dūto jagāma ca nṛpāntikam |
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ brāhmaṇena ca || 72 ||
tataḥ krodhaparītātmā śrutvā brāhmaṇabhāṣitam |
durjayaḥ prāha nīlākhyaṃ sāmantaṃ gaccha māciram |
brāhmaṇasya maṇiṃ gṛhya tūrṇamehi yadṛcchayā || 73 ||
evamuktastadā nīlo bahusenāparicchadaḥ |
jagāma sa ca viprasya vanyamāśramamaṇḍalam || 74 ||
tatrāgnihotraśālāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ maṇimāhitam |
uttīrya syandanānnīlaḥ so'varohata bhūtale || 75 ||
avatīrṇe tatastasmin nīle paramadāruṇe |
krūrabuddhyā maṇestasmānnirjagmuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || 76 ||
sarathāḥ sadhvajāḥ sāśvāḥ sabāṇāḥ sāsicarmiṇaḥ |
sadhanuṣkāḥ satūṇīrā yodhāḥ paramadurjayāḥ |
niścerustaṃ maṇiṃ bhitvā asaṃkhyeyā mahābalāḥ || 77 ||
tatra sajjā mahāśūrā daśa pañca ca saṃkhyayā |
nāmabhistān mahābhāge kathayāmi śrṛṇuṣva tān || 78 ||
suprabho dīptatejāśca suraśmiḥ śubhadarśanaḥ |
sukāntiḥ sundaraḥ sundaḥ pradyumnaḥ sumanāḥ śubhaḥ || 79 ||
suśīlaḥ sukhadaḥ śambhuḥ sudāntaḥ soma eva ca |
ete pañcadaśa proktā nāyakā maṇitotthitāḥ || 80 ||
tato virocanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bahusainyapariṣkṛtam |
yodhayāmāsuravyagrā vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ || 81 ||
dhanūṃṣi teṣāṃ kanakaprabhāṇi
śarān sujāmbūnadapuṅkhanaddhān |
patanti khaṅgāni vibhīṣaṇāni
bhuśuṇḍiśūlāḥ paramapradhānāḥ || 82 ||
ratho rathaṃ saṃparivārya tasthau
gajo gajasyāpi hayo harasya |
padātiratyugraparākramaśca
padātimeva prasasāra cāgryam || 83 ||
dvandvanyanekāni tathaiva yuddhe
dravanti śūrāḥ paribhartsayantaḥ |
vibhīṣaṇaṃ nirgatacāpamārgaṃ
babhūva bāhuprabhavaṃ sughoram || 84 ||
tathā pravṛtte tumule'tha yuddhe
hataḥ sa rājñaḥ sacivo visaṃjñaḥ |
sahānugaḥ sarvabalairupeto
jagāma vaivasvatamandirāya || 85 ||
tasmin hate durjayarājamantriṇi
upāyayau svena balena rājā |
sa durjayaḥ sāśvaratho'titīvraḥ
pratāpavāṃstairmaṇijairyuyodha || 86 ||
tatastasmiṃstadā rājño mahatkadanamābabhau |
tato hetuprahetṛbhyāṃ śrutvā jāmātaraṃ raṇe || 87 ||
yudhyamānaṃ mahābāhuṃ tatastvāyayatuścamūḥ |
tasmin bale tu daityā ye tān śrṛṇuṣva dhareritān || 88 ||
praghaso vighasaścaiva saṅghaso'śanisaprabhaḥ |
vidyutprabhaḥ sughoṣaśca unmattākṣo bhayaṃkaraḥ || 89 ||
agnidanto'gnitejāśca bāhuśakraḥ pratardanaḥ |
virādho bhīmakarmā ca vipracittistathaiva ca || 90 ||
ete pañcadaśa śreṣṭhā asurāḥ paramāyudhāḥ |
akṣauhiṇīparīvāra ekaiko'tra pṛthakpṛthak || 91 ||
mahāmāyāstu samare durjjayasya mahātmanaḥ |
yuyudhurmaṇijaiḥ sārddhaṃ mahāsainyaparicchadāḥ || 92 ||
(suprabhaḥ praghasaṃ tvājau tāḍayāmāsa pañcabhiḥ |
śarairāśīviṣākāraiḥ prataptaiḥ patagairiva || ) || 93 ||
taptatejāstribhirbāṇairvighasaṃ saṃpravidhyata |
saṃghasaṃ daśabhirbāṇaiḥ suraśmiḥ pratyavidhyata || 94 ||
aśaniprabhaṃ raṇe'vidhyat pañcabhiḥ śubhadarśanaḥ |
vidyutprabhaṃ sukāntistu sughoṣaṃ sundarastathā || 95 ||
unmattākṣaṃ tathāvidhyat sundaḥ pañcabhirāśugaiḥ |
cakartta ca dhanustasya śitena nataparvaṇā || 96 ||
sumanā agnidaṃṣṭraṃ tu suśubhaścāgnitejasam |
suśīlo vāyuśakraṃ tu sumukhaśca pratardanam || 97 ||
(virādhena tathā śambhuḥ sukīrtirbhīmakarmmaṇā |
vipracittistathā somaṃ etad yuddhaṃ mahānabhūt ||) || 98 ||
parasparaṃ suyuddhena yodhayitvā'stralāghavāt |
yathāsaṃkhyena te daityāḥ punarmaṇibhavairhatāḥ || 99 ||
yāvat saṃgrāmaghoro vai mahāṃsteṣāṃ vyavarddhata |
tāvat samitkuśādīni kṛtvā gauramukho muniḥ || 100 ||
āgato mahadāścaryaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ bhīmadarśanam |
bahusainyaparīvāraṃ sthitaṃ taṃ cāpi durjjayam || 101 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa munirdvāri cintāparama eva hi |
upaviśyādhigamyātha maṇeḥ kāraṇameva ha ||  102 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā maṇikṛtaṃ raudraṃ gāḍhaṃ ca saṃyugam |
cintayāmāsa deveśaṃ hariṃ gauramukho muniḥ || 103 ||
sa devaḥ puratastasya pītavāsāḥ khagāsanaḥ |
kimatra te mayā kāryamiti vāṇīmudīrayat || 104 ||
sa ṛṣiḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā uvāca puruṣottamam |
jahīmaṃ durjjayaṃ pāpaṃ sasainyaṃ parivāriṇam || 105 ||
evamuktastadā tena cakraṃ jvalanasannibham |
(mumoca durjayabale kālacakraṃ sudarśanam) || 106 ||
tena cakreṇa tatsainyamāsuraṃ daurjayaṃ kṣaṇāt |
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa bhasmavad bahudhā kṛtam || 107 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tato devo muniṃ gauramukhaṃ tadā |
uvāca nimiṣeṇedaṃ nihataṃ dānavaṃ balam || 108 ||
araṇye'smiṃstatastvevaṃ naimiṣāraṇyasaṃjñitam |
bhaviṣyati yathārthaṃ vai brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 109 ||
ahaṃ ca yajñapuruṣa etasmin vanagocare |
nāmnā yājyā sadā ceme daśa pañca ca nāyakāḥ |
kṛte yuge bhaviṣyanti rājāno maṇijā mune || 110 ||
evamuktvā tato devo gato'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ |
dvijo'pi svāśrame tasthau mudā paramayā yutaḥ || 111 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
tataḥ putraṃ rathāṅgāgnidagdhaṃ śrutvā nṛpottamaḥ |
supratīkaḥ pratītātmā cintayāmāsa pārthivaḥ |
tasya cintayatastvevaṃ tadā buddhirajāyata || 1 ||
citrakūṭe girau viṣṇuḥ sadā rāmeti kīrtyate |
tato'haṃ rāmasaṃjñena nāmnā staumi jagatpatim || 2 ||
supratīka uvāca |
namāmi rāmaṃ naranāthamacyutaṃ
kaviṃ purāṇaṃ tridaśārināśanam |
śivasvarūpaṃ prabhavaṃ maheśvaraṃ
sadā prapannārtiharaṃ dhṛtaśriyam || 3 ||
bhavān sadā deva samastatejasāṃ
karoṣi tejāṃsi samastarūpadhṛk |
kṣitau bhavān pañcaguṇastathā jale
catuḥprakārastrividho'tha tejasi |
dvidhā'tha vāyau viyati pratiṣṭhito
bhavān hare śabdavapuḥ pumānasi || 4 ||
bhavān śaśī sūryahutāśano'si
tvayi pralīnaṃ jagadetaducyate |
bhavatpratiṣṭhaṃ ramate jagat yataḥ
stuto'si rāmeti jagat pratiṣṭhitam || 5 ||
bhavārṇave duḥkhatarormisaṃkule
tathākṣamānagrahaṇe'tibhīṣaṇe |
na majjati tvatsmaraṇaplavo naraḥ
smṛto'si rāmeti tathā tapovane || 6 ||
vedeṣu naṣṭeṣu bhavāṃstathā hare
karoṣi mātsyaṃ vapurātmanaḥ sadā |
yugakṣaye rañjitasarvadiṅmukho
bhavāṃstathāgnirbahurūpadhṛg vibho || 7 ||
kaurmaṃ tathā te vapurāsthitaḥ sadā yuge yuge mādhava toyamanthane |
na cānyadastīti bhavatsamaṃ kvacijjanārdanād yaḥ svayaṃ bhūtamuttamam || 8 ||
tvayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ mahātman
svakākhilān veda diśaśca sarvāḥ |
kathaṃ tvamādyaṃ paramaṃ tu dhāma
vihāya cānyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 9 ||
bhavānekaḥ pūrvamāsīt tataśca tvatto mahī salilaṃ vahniruccaiḥ |
vāyustathā khaṃ ca mano'pi buddhiścetoguṇāstatprabhavaṃ ca sarvam || 10 ||
tvayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ samastaṃ
sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me |
samastaviśveśvara viśvamūrte
sahastrabāho jaya deva deva |
namo'stu rāmāya mahānubhāva || 11 ||
iti stuto devavaraḥ prasannaḥ
tadā rājñaḥ supratīkasya mūrtim |
saṃdarśayāmāsa tato'bhyuvāca
varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti ca supratīkam || 12 ||
evaṃ śrutvā vacanaṃ tasya rājā
sasaṃbhramaṃ devadevaṃ praṇamya |
uvāca deveśvara me prayaccha
layaṃ yadāste paramaṃ vapuste || 13 ||
itīrite rājavaraḥ kṣaṇena
layaṃ tathā'gādasuraghnamūrtau |
sthitastasminnātmabhūto vimuktaḥ
sa bhūmipaḥ karmakāṇḍairanekaiḥ || 14 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
itīritaṃ te tu mayā purāṇaṃ svāyambhuve cādikṛtaikadeśam |
śakyaṃ na cāsyairbahubhiḥ sahastrairapīha kenāpi mukhena vaktum || 15 ||
uddeśataḥ saṃsmṛtamātrametanmayā bhadre kathitaṃ te purāṇam |
samudratoyāt parimāṇasṛṣṭiḥ kvacit kvacid vṛttamatho hyanardhyam || 16 ||
svayambhuvā kathitaṃ brahmaṇā'pi
nārāyaṇenāpi kuto bhave'nyaḥ |
aśakyamasmābhiritīritaṃ te
tanmūrttitvāt smaraṇenedamādyam || 17 ||
samudre bālukāsaṃkhyā vidyate rajasaḥ kṣitau |
na tu sṛṣṭeḥ punaḥ saṃkhyā krīḍataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 18 ||
eṣa nārāyaṇasyāṃśo mayā proktaḥ śucismite |
kṛte vṛttānta eṣaśca kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 19 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
etat tanmahadāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā gauramukho muniḥ |
te cāpi maṇijāḥ prāptāḥ kiṃ phalaṃ tu varaṃ guroḥ || 1 ||
ko'sau gauramukhaḥ śrīmān muniḥ paramadhārmmikaḥ |
kiṃ cakāra hareḥ karmma dṛṣṭvā'sau munipuṃgavaḥ || 2 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
nimiṣeṇa kṛtaṃ karma dṛṣṭvā bhagavato muniḥ |
ārirādhayiṣurdevaṃ tameva prayayau vanam |
prabhāsaṃ nāma somasya tīrthaṃ paramadurlabham || 3 ||
tatra daityāntakṛd devaḥ procyate tīrthacintakaiḥ |
ārādhayāmāsa hariṃ daityasūdanasaṃjñitam || 4 ||
tasyārādhayato devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
ājagāma mahāyogī mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || 5 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā'bhyāgataṃ dūrādarghapādyena so muniḥ |
arcayāmāsa taṃ bhaktyā mudā paramayā yutaḥ || 6 ||
kauśyāṃ vṛṣyāṃ tadāsīnaṃ papracchedaṃ munistadā |
śādhiṃ māṃ muniśārdūla kiṃ karomi mahāvrata || 7 ||
evamuktaḥ sa viprendro mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ |
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā muniṃ gauramukhaṃ tadā || 8 ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
etadeva mahatkṛtyaṃ yatsatāṃ saṃgamo bhavet |
yattu sāndehikaṃ kāryaṃ tatpṛcchasva mahāmune || 9 ||
gauramukha uvāca |
ete hi pitaro nāma procyante vedavādibhiḥ |
sarvavarṇaṣu sāmānyā utāhosvit pṛthak pṛthak || 10 ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
sarveṣāmeva devānāmādyo nārāyaṇo guruḥ |
tasmād brahmā samutpannaḥ so'pi saptāsṛjanmunīn || 11 ||
māṃ yajasveti tenoktāstadā te parameṣṭhinā |
ātmanātmānamevāgre ayajanta iti śrutiḥ || 12 ||
teṣāṃ vai brahmajātānāṃ mahāvaikārikarmaṇām |
aśapad vyabhicāro hi mahāneṣa kṛto yataḥ |
prabhraṣṭajñāninaḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha na saṃśayaḥ || 13 ||
evaṃ śaptāstataste vai brahmaṇātmasamudbhavāḥ |
sadyo vaṃśakarān putrānutpādya tridivaṃ yayuḥ || 14 ||
tatasteṣu prayāteṣu tridivaṃ brahmavādiṣu |
tatputrāḥ śrāddhadānena tarpayāmāsurañjasā || 15 ||
te ca vaimānikāḥ sarve brahmaṇaḥ sapta mānasāḥ |
tat piṇḍadānaṃ mantroktaṃ prapaśyanto vyavasthitāḥ || 16 ||
gauramukha uvāca |
ye ca te pitaro brahman yaṃ ca kālaṃ samāsate |
kiṃ yato vai pitṛgaṇāstasmiṃlloke vyavasthitāḥ || 17 ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
pravarttante varāḥ kecid devānāṃ somavarddhanāḥ |
te marīcyādayaḥ sapta svarge te pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 18 ||
catvāro mūrttimanto vai trayastvanye hyamūrttayaḥ |
teṣāṃ lokanisargaṃ ca kīrttayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu || 19 ||
prabhāvaṃ ca mahardhi ca vistareṇa nibodha me |
dharmamūrtidharāsteṣāṃ trayo'nye paramā gaṇāḥ |
teṣāṃ nāmāni lokāṃśca kīrtayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu || 20 ||
lokāḥ saṃtānakā nāma yatra tiṣṭhanti bhāsvarāḥ |
amūrttayaḥ pitṛgaṇāste vai putrāḥ prajāpateḥ || 21 ||
virājasya prajāśreṣṭhā vairājā iti te smṛtāḥ ||
devānāṃ pitaraste hi tān yajantīha devatāḥ || 22 ||
ete vai lokavibhraṣṭā lokān prāpya sanātanān |
punaryugaśatānteṣu jāyante brahmavādinaḥ || 23 ||
te prāpya tāṃ smṛtiṃ bhūyaḥ sādhya yogamanuttamam |
cintya yogagatiṃ śuddhāṃ punarāvṛttidurlabhām || 24 ||
ete sma pitaraḥ śrāddhe yogināṃ yogavarddhanāḥ |
āpyāyitāstu te pūrvaṃ yogaṃ yogabale ratau || 25 ||
tasmācchrāddhāni deyāni yogināṃ yogisattama |
eṣa vai prathamaḥ sargaḥ somapānāmanuttamaḥ || 26 ||
ete ta ekatanavo vartante dbijasattamāḥ |
bhūrlokavāsināṃ yājyāḥ svargalokanivāsinaḥ ||
brahmaputrā marīcyādyāsteṣāṃ yājyā mahadgatāḥ || 27 ||
kalpavāsikasaṃjñānāṃ teṣāmapi jane gatāḥ |
sanakādyāstatasteṣāṃ vairājāstapasi sthitāḥ |
teṣāṃ satyagatā muktā ityeṣā pitṛsaṃtatiḥ || 28 ||
agniṣvātteti mārīcyā vairājā barhisaṃjñitāḥ |
sukāleyāpi pitaro vasiṣṭhasya prajāpateḥ |
te'pi yājyāstribhirvarṇairna śūdreṇa pṛthakkṛtam || 29 ||
varṇatrayābhyanujñātaḥ śūdraḥ sarvān pitṛn yajet |
na tu tasya pṛthak santi pitaraḥ śūdrajātayaḥ || 30 ||
muktaścetanako brahman nanu vipreṣu dṛśyate |
viśeṣaśāstradṛṣṭyā tu purāṇānāṃ ca darśanāt || 31 ||
evaṃ ṛṣistutaiḥ śāstraṃ jñātvā yājyakasaṃbhavān |
svayaṃ sṛṣṭyāṃ smṛtirlabdhā putrāṇāṃ brahmaṇā tataḥ |
paraṃ nirvāṇamāpannāste'pi jñānena eva ca || 32 ||
vasvādīnāṃ kaśyapādyā varṇānāṃ vasavādayaḥ |
aviśeṣeṇa vijñeyā gandharvādyā api dhruvam || 33 ||
eṣa te paitṛkaḥ sarga uddeśena mahāmune |
kathito nānta evāsya varṣakoṭyā hi dṛśyate || 34 ||
śrāddhasya kālān vakṣyāmi tān śrṛṇuṣva dvijottama |
śrāddhārhamāgataṃ dravyaṃ viśiṣṭamathavā dvijam || 35 ||
śrāddhaṃ kurvīta vijñāya vyatīpāte'yane tathā |
viṣuve caiva saṃprāpte grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ |
samasteṣveva viprendra rāśiṣvarke'tigacchati || 36 ||
nakṣatragrahapīḍāsu duṣṭasvapnāvalokane |
icchāśrāddhāni kurvīta navasasyāgame tathā || 37 ||
amāvāsyā yadā ārdrāviśākhāsvātiyogino |
śrāddhaiḥ pitṛgaṇastṛptiṃ tadāpnotyaṣṭavārṣikīm || 38 ||
amāvasyā yadā puṣye raudre'tharkṣe punarvasau |
dvādaśābdaṃ tathā tṛptiṃ prayānti pitaro'rccitāḥ || 39 ||
vāsavājaikapādarkṣe pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimicchatām |
vāruṇe cāpyamāvāsyā devānāmapi durlabhā || 40 ||
navasvarkṣeṣvamāvāsyā yadā teṣu dvijottama |
tadā śrāddhāni deyāni akṣayyaphalamicchatām |
api koṭisahastreṇa puṇyasyānto na vidyate || 41 ||
athāparaṃ pitaraḥ śrāddhakālaṃ
rahasyamasmat pravadanti puṇyam |
vaiśākhamāsasya tu yā tṛtīyā
navamyasau kārttikaśuklapakṣe || 42 ||
nabhasyamāsasya tamistrapakṣe
trayodaśī pañcadaśī ca māghe |
upaplave candramaso raveśca
tathāṣṭakāsvapyayanadvaye ca || 43 ||
pānīyamapyatra tilairvimiśraṃ
dadyātpitṛbhyaḥ prayato manuṣyaḥ |
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena samāḥsahastraṃ
rahasyametat pitaro vadanti || 44 ||
māghāsite pañcadaśī kadācidupaiti yogaṃ yadi vāruṇena |
ṛkṣeṇa kālaḥ paramaḥ pitṝṇāṃ na tvalpapuṇyairdvija labhyate'sau || 45 ||
kāle dhaniṣṭhā yadi nāma tasmin
bhavettu viprendra sadā pitṛbhyaḥ |
dattaṃ jalānnaṃ pradadāti tṛptiṃ
varṣāyutaṃ tatkulajairmanuṣyaiḥ || 46 ||
tatraiva ced bhādrapadāstu pūrvāḥ
kāle tadā yaiḥ kriyate pitṛbhyaḥ |
śrāddhaṃ parā tṛptimupetya tena
yugaṃ samagraṃ pitaraḥ svapanti ||
śrāddhaṃ tu yatpakṣamudāharanti
tatpaitṛkaṃ munigaṇāḥ pravadanti tuṣṭim || 47 ||
gaṅgāsarayūmathavā vipāśāṃ
sarasvatīṃ naimiṣagomatīṃ vā |
tato'vagāhyārcanamādareṇa
kṛtvā pitṝṇāmahitāni hanti || 48 ||
gāyanti caitat pitaraḥ kadā tu
varṣāmaghātṛptimavāpya bhūyaḥ |
māghāsitānte śubhatīrthatoyairyāsyāma tṛptiṃ tanayādidattaiḥ || 49 ||
cittaṃ ca vittaṃ ca nṛṇāṃ viśuddhaṃ śastaśca kālaḥ kathito vidhiśca |
pātraṃ yathoktaṃ paramā ca bhaktirnṛṇāṃ prayacchantyabhivāñchitāni || 50 ||
pitṛgītāstathaivātra ślokāstān śrṛṇu sattama |
śrutvā tathaiva bhavitā bhāvyaṃ tatra vidhātmanā || 51 ||
api dhanyaḥ kule jāyādasmākaṃ matimān naraḥ |
akurvan vittaśāṭhyaṃ yaḥ piṇḍān yo nirvapiṣyati || 52 ||
ratnavastramahāyānaṃ sarvaṃ bhogādikaṃ vasu |
vibhave sati viprebhyo asmānuddiśya dāsyati || 53 ||
annena vā yathāśaktyā kāle'smin bhaktinamradhīḥ |
bhojayiṣyati viprāgryāṃstanmātravibhavo naraḥ || 54 ||
asamartho'nnadānasya vanyaśākaṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
pradāsyatidvijāgryebhyaḥ svalpāṃ yo vāpi dakṣiṇām || 55 ||
tatrāpyasāmarthyayutaḥ karāgrāgrasthitāṃstilān |
praṇamya dvijamukhyāya kasmaicid dvija dāsyati || 56 ||
tilaiḥ saptāṣṭabhirvāpi samavetāṃ jalāñjalim |
bhaktinamraḥ samuddiśyāpyasmākaṃ saṃpradāsyati || 57 ||
yataḥ kutaścit saṃprāpya gobhyo vāpi gavāhnikam |
abhāve prīṇayatyasmān bhaktyā yuktaḥ pradāsyati || 58 ||
sarvābhāve vanaṃ gatvā kakṣāmūlapradarśakaḥ |
sūryādilokapālānāmidamuccaiḥ paṭhiṣyati || 59 ||
na me'sti vittaṃ na dhanaṃ na cānyacchrāddhasya yogyaṃ svapitṝn nato'smi |
tṛpyantu bhaktyā pitaro mayaitau bhujau tatau vartmani mārutasya || 60 ||
ityetat pitṛbhirgītaṃ bhāvābhāvaprayojanam |
kṛtaṃ tena bhavecchrāddhaṃ ya evaṃ kurute dvija || 61 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
etanme kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaputreṇa dhīmatā |
sanakānujena viprarṣe brāhmaṇān śrṛṇu sāṃpratam || 1 ||
triṇāciketastrimadhustrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit |
vedavit śrotriyo yogī tathā vai jyoṣṭhasāmagaḥ || 2 ||
ṛtvijaṃ bhāgineyaṃ ca dauhitraṃ śvasuraṃ tathā |
jāmātaraṃ mātulaṃ ca taponiṣṭhaṃ ca brāhmaṇam || 3 ||
pañcāgnyabhirataṃ caiva śiṣyaṃ saṃbandhinaṃ tathā |
mātāpitṛrataṃ caiva etāñchrāddhe niyojayet || 4 ||
mitradhruk kunakhī caiva śyāvadantastathā dvijaḥ |
kanyādūṣayitā vahnivedojjhaḥ somavikrayī || 5 ||
abhiśaptastathā stenaḥ piśuno grāmayājakaḥ |
bhṛtakādhyāpakaścaiva bhṛtakādhyāpitaśca yaḥ || 6 ||
parapūrvāpatiścaiva mātāpitrostathojjhakaḥ |
vṛṣalīsūtipoṣyaśca vṛṣalīpatireva ca |
tathā devalakaścāpi śrāddhe nārhanti ketanam || 7 ||
prathame'hni budhaḥ kuryād viprāgryāṇāṃ nimantraṇam |
ānimantrya dvijān gehamāgatān bhojayed yatīn || 8 ||
pādaśaucādinā gehamāgatān bhojayed dvijān |
pavitrapāṇirācāntānāsaneṣūpaveśayet || 9 ||
pitṝṇāmayujo yugmān devānāmapi yojayet |
devānāmekamekaṃ vā pitṝṇāṃ ca niyojayet || 10 ||
tathā mātāmahaśrāddhaṃ vaiśvadevasamanvitam |
kurvīta bhaktisaṃpannasaktantraṃ vā vaiśvadevikam || 11 ||
prāṅmukhaṃ bhojabhed vipraṃ devānāmubhayātmakam |
pitṛpaitāmahānāṃ ca bhojayeccāpyudaṅmukhān || 12 ||
pṛthak tayoḥ kecidāhuḥ śrāddhasya karaṇaṃ dvija |
ekatraikena pākena vadantyanye maharṣayaḥ || 13 ||
viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśān dattvā saṃpūjyārghavidhānataḥ |
kuryādāvāhanaṃ prājño devānāṃ tadanujñayā || 14 ||
yavāmbunā ca devānāṃ dadyādarghyaṃ vidhānavit |
sugandhadhūpadīpāṃśca dattvā tebhyo yathāvidhi |
pitṝṇāmapasakavyena sarvamevopakalpayet || 15 ||
anujñāṃ ca tataḥ prāpya dattvā darbhān dvidhākṛtān |
mantrapūrvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu kuryādāvāhanaṃ budhaḥ |
tilāmbunā cāpasavyaṃ dadyādardhyādikaṃ budhaḥ || 16 ||
kāle tatrātithiṃ prāptamannakāmaṃ dvijādhvagam |
brāhmaṇairabhyanujñātaḥ kāmaṃ tamapi pūjayet || 17 ||
yogino vividhai rūpairnarāṇāmupakāriṇaḥ |
bhramanti pṛthivīmetāmavijñātasvarūpiṇaḥ || 18 ||
tasmādabhyarcayet prāptaṃ śrāddhakāle'tithiṃ budhaḥ |
śrāddhakriyāphalaṃ hanti dvijendrāpūjito'tithiḥ || 19 ||
juhuyād vyañjanaṃ kṣārairvarjyamannaṃ tato'nale |
anujñāto dbijaistaistu triḥ kṛtvā puruṣarṣabha || 20 ||
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti prathamāhutiḥ |
somāya vai pitṛmate dātavyā tadanantaram || 21 ||
vaivasvatāya caivānyā tṛtīyā dīyatāhutiḥ |
hutāvaśiṣṭamalpālpaṃ viprapātreṣu nirvapet || 22 ||
tato'nnaṃ mṛṣṭamatyarthamabhīṣṭamabhisaṃskṛtam |
dattvā juṣadhvamicchāto vācyametadaniṣṭhuram || 23 ||
bhoktavyaṃ taiśca taccittairmaunibhiḥ sumukhaiḥ sukham |
akrudhyatā atvaratā deyaṃ tenāpi bhaktitaḥ || 24 ||
rakṣoghnamantrapaṭhanaṃ bhūmerāstaraṇaṃ tilaiḥ |
kṛtvā'dhyeyāśca pitarasta eva dvijasattamāḥ || 25 ||
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ |
mama tṛptiṃ prayāntvadya homāpyāyitamūrttayaḥ || 26 ||
pitāpitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ |
mama tṛptiṃ prayāntvadya vipradeheṣu saṃsthitāḥ || 27 ||
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ |
tṛptiṃ prayāntu piṇḍeṣu mayā datteṣu bhūtale || 28 ||
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ |
tṛptiṃ prayāntu me bhaktyā yanmayaitadudāhṛtam || 29 ||
mātāmahastṛptimupaitu tasya
tathā pitā tasya pitā tato'nyaḥ |
viśve'tha devāḥ paramāṃ prayāntu
tṛptiṃ praṇaśyantu ca yātudhānāḥ || 30 ||
yajñeśvaro havyasamastakavyabhoktā'vyayātmā harirīśvaro'tra |
tatsannidhānādapayāntu sadyo rakṣāṃsyaśeṣāṇyasurāśca sarve || 31 ||
tṛpteṣveteṣu vipreṣu kiredannaṃ mahītale |
dadyādācamanārthāya tebhyo vāri sakṛtsakṛt || 32 ||
sutṛptaistairanujñātaḥ sarveṇānnena bhūtale |
salilena tataḥ piṇḍān samāgṛhya samāhitaḥ || 33 ||
pitṛtīrthena salilaṃ tathaiva salilāñjalim |
mātāmahebhyastenaiva piṇḍāṃstīrthena nirvapet|
dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu puṣpadhūpādipūjitām || 34 ||
svapitre prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyāducchiṣṭasannidhau |
pitāmahāya caivānyaṃ tatpitre ca tathā'param || 35 ||
darbhamūle lepabhujaḥ prīṇayellepagharṣaṇāt |
piṇḍe mātāmahe tadvad gandhamālyādisaṃyutaiḥ || 36 ||
pūjayitvā dvijāgryāṇāṃ dadyādācamanaṃ budhaḥ |
paitrebhyaḥ prathamaṃ bhaktyā tanmanasko dvijeśvara || 37 ||
susvadhetyāśiṣā yuktāṃ dadyācchaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
dattvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo vācayed vaiśvadevikān |
prīyantāmiti ye viśve devāstena itīrayet || 38 ||
tatheti cokte tairvipraiḥ prārthanīyāstathāśiṣaḥ |
paścād visarjayed devān pūrvaṃ paitrānmahāmate || 39 ||
mātāmahānāmapyevaṃ saha devaiḥ kramaḥ smṛtaḥ |
bhojane ca svaśaktyā ca dāne tadvad visarjjane |
āpādaśaucanāt pūrvaṃ kuryādeva dvijanmasu || 40 ||
jānantaṃ prathamaṃ pitryaṃ tathā mātāmaheṣu ca |
visarjayet prītivacaḥ saṃmānyābhyarthitāṃstataḥ |
nivarttetābhyanujñāta ādvārāntamanuvrajet || 41 ||
tatastu vaiśvadevākhyāṃ kuryānnityakriyāṃ tataḥ |
bhuñjīyācca samaṃ pūjya bhṛtyabandhubhirātmanā || 42 ||
evaṃ śrāddhaṃ budhaḥ kuryāt pitryaṃ mātāmahaṃ tathā |
śrāddhairāpyāyitā dadyuḥ sarvān kāmān pitāmahāḥ || 43 ||
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutapastilāḥ |
rajatasya tathā dānaṃ tathā saṃdarśanādikam || 44 ||
varjyastu kurvatā śrāddhaṃ krodho'dhvagamamaṃ tvarā |
bhokturapyatra viprendra trayametanna saṃśayaḥ || 45 ||
viśvedevāḥ sapitarastathā mātāmahā dvija |
kulaṃ cāpyāyate puṃsāṃ sarvaṃ śrāddhaṃ prakurvatām || 46 ||
somādhāraḥ pitṛgaṇo yogādhāraśca candramāḥ |
śrāddhaṃ yoginiyuktaṃ tu tasmad viprendra śasyate || 47 ||
sahastrasyāpi viprāṇāṃ yogī cet purataḥ sthitaḥ |
sarvān bhoktṝṃstārayati yajamānaṃ tathā dvija || 48 ||
mahyaṃ sanatkumāreṇa pūrvakalpe dvijottama |
kathitaṃ vāyunā cāpi devānāṃ śaṃbhunā tathā || 49 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ śaktiputreṇa tathā maitreyasaṃjñite |
bhaviṣyati kramād yāvan mayā te kathitaṃ dvija || 50 ||
iyaṃ sarvapurāṇeṣu sāmānyā paitṛkī kriyā |
etat kramāt karmakāṇḍaṃ jñātvā mucyeta bandhanāt || 51 ||
etadāśritya nirvāṇaṃ ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ |
prāptā gauramukhedānīṃ tvamapyevaṃ paro bhava || 52 ||
iti te kathitaṃ bhaktyā pṛcchato dvijasattama |
pitṝn yaṣṭvā hariṃ dhyāyed yastasya kimataḥ param |
na tasmāt parataḥ pitryaṃ tantramastīti niścayaḥ || 53 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
evaṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyānmahāmuniḥ |
tadā gauramukho deva kimūrdhvaṃ kṛtavān vibho || 1 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
etacchrutvā tadā dhātri pitṛtantraṃ mahāmuniḥ |
saṃsmārito janmaśataṃ mārkaṇḍeyena dhīmatā || 2 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
bhagavan gauramukhaḥ ko'sau anyajanmani kaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kathaṃ ca smṛtavān smṛtvā kiṃ cakāra ca sattamaḥ || 3 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
bhṛgurāsīt svayaṃ sākṣādanyasmin brahma janmani |
tadanvayātmajastveṣa mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ || 4 ||
putraistu bodhitā yūyaṃ sugatiṃ prāpsyatheti yat |
prāguktaṃ brahmaṇā tena mārkaṇḍeyena bodhitaḥ || 5 ||
sasmāra sarvajanmāni smṛtvā caiva tu yatkṛtam |
tacchṛṇuṣva varārohe kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 6 ||
evaṃ śrāddhavidhānena dvādaśābdaṃ tataḥ pitṝn |
iṣṭvā paścāddhareḥ stotraṃ sa munistūpacakrame || 7 ||
prabhāsaṃ nāma yattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam |
tatra daityāntakaṃ devaṃ stotuṃ gauramukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 8 ||
gauramukha uvāca |
stoṣye mahendraṃ ripudarpahaṃ śivaṃ
nārāyaṇaṃ brahmavidāṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
ādityacandrāśviyugasthamādyaṃ
purātanaṃ daityaharaṃ sadā harim || 9 ||
cakāra mātsyaṃ vapurātmano yaḥ purākṛtaṃ vedavināśakāle |
mahāmahīdhṛgvapuragrapucchachaṭāhavārcciḥ suraśatruhādyaḥ || 10 ||
tathābdhimanthānakṛte girīndraṃ dadhāra yaḥ kaurmmavapuḥ purāṇam |
hitecchayā yaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ prapātu māṃ daityaharaḥ sureśaḥ || 11 ||
mahāvarāhaḥ satataṃ pṛthivyās
talāttalaṃ prāviśad yo mahātmā |
yajñāṅgasaṃjñaḥ surasiddhavandyaḥ
sa pātu māṃ daityaharaḥ purāṇaḥ || 12 ||
nṛsiṃharūpī ca bhavatyajastraṃ
yuge yuge yogivarograbhīmaḥ |
karālavaktraḥ kanakāgravarcā
ratnāśayo'smānasurāntako'vyāt || 13 ||
balermakhadhvaṃsakṛte mahātmā
svāṃ gūḍhatāṃ yogavapuḥsvarūpaḥ |
sa daṇḍakāṣṭhā'jinalakṣaṇaḥ punaḥ
kṣitiṃ ca padā krāntavān yaḥ sa pātu || 14 ||
triḥsaptakṛtvo jagatīṃ jigāya
jitvā dadau kaśyapāya pracaṇḍaḥ |
sa jāmadagnyo'bhijanasya goptā
hiraṇyagarbho'surahā prapātu || 15 ||
catuḥprakāraṃ ca vapurya ādyaṃ hairaṇyagarbhapratimānalakṣyam |
rāmādirūpairbahurūpabhedaścakāra so'smānasurāntako'vyāt || 16 ||
cāṇūrakaṃsāsuradarpabhīterbhītāmarāṇāmabhayāya devaḥ |
yuge yuge vāsudevo babhūva kalpe bhavatyadbhutarūpakārī |
yuge yuge kalkināmnā mahātmā varṇasthitiṃ karttumanekamūrttiḥ || 17 ||
sanātano brahmamayaḥ purāṇo
na yasya rūpaṃ surasiddhadaityāḥ |
paśyanti vijñānagatiṃ vihāya
athopyanekāni samarcvayanti |
matsyādirūpāṇi carāṇi so'vyāt || 18 ||
namo namaste puruṣottamāya
punaśca bhūyo'pi namo namaste |
namaḥ purastādatha pṛṣṭhataste
nayasva māṃ muktipadaṃ namaste || 19 ||
evaṃ namasyatastasya maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ |
pratyakṣatāṃ gato devaḥ svayaṃ cakragadādharaḥ || 20 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya vijñānaṃ nistaraṅgaṃ svadehataḥ |
uttasthau so'pi taṃ labdhvā tasmin brahmaṇi śāśvate |
layaṃ jagāma devātmā tvapunarbhavasaṃjñite || 21 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
tadā durvāsasā śapto devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ |
vasiṣyasi tvaṃ marttyeṣu supratīkasutena tu || 1 ||
utsādito divo mūḍhetyevamuktastu bhūdhara |
indro marttyamupāgamya sarvadevasamanvitaḥ || 2 ||
kiṃ cakāra ca tasmiṃstu durjaye ca nipātite |
parameṣṭhinā bhagavatā tena yogaviduttamau || 3 ||
svarge vidyutsuvidyucca tau ca kiṃ cakratustadā |
etanme saṃśayaṃ deva kathayasva prasādataḥ || 4 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
dūrjayena jito dhātri devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ |
bhārate hi tadā varṣe vārāṇasyāṃ tu pūrvataḥ |
āśritya saṃsthito devaiḥ saha yakṣamahoragaiḥ || 5 ||
vidyutsuvidyucca tadā yogamāsthāya śobhane |
dīrghatāpajvaraṃ vāyukarmayogena saṃśritau ||
lokapālāyitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ cakraturyogamāyayā || 6 ||
taṃ durjayaṃ mṛtaṃ śrutvā samudrāntaḥsthitaṃ tadā |
ānīya caturaṅgaṃ tu devān prati vijagmatuḥ || 7 ||
āgatya tau tadā daityau mahatsainyena parvatam |
himavantaṃ samāśritya saṃsthitau tu babhūvatuḥ || 8 ||
devā api mahatsainyaṃ saṃhatya kṛtadaṃśitāḥ |
mantrayāñcakruravyagrā aindraṃ padamabhīpsavaḥ || 9 ||
abravīt tatra devānāṃ gururāṅgiraso muniḥ |
gomedhena yajaghvaṃ vai prathamena tadantaram || 10 ||
yaṣṭavyaṃ kratubhiḥ sarvairekasthitirathāmarāḥ |
upadeśo mayā dattaḥ kriyatāṃ śīghrameṣa vai || 11 ||
evamuktāstadā devā gāḥ paśūṃścānukalpya te |
mumucuścaraṇārthāya rakṣārthaṃ saramāṃ daduḥ || 12 ||
tāśca gāvo devaśunyā rakṣyamāṇā dharādhare |
tatra jagmustadā gāvaścarantyo yatra te'surāḥ || 13 ||
te ca gāvastu tā dṛṣṭvā śukramūcuḥ purohitam |
paśvarthaṃ devagā brahmaṃścāryante rakṣamāṇayā |
devaśūnyā saramayā vada kiṃ kriyate'dhunā || 14 ||
evamuktastadā śukraḥ pratyuvācāsurāṃstadā |
etā gā hriyatāṃ śīghramasurā mā vilambatha || 15 ||
evamuktāstadā daityā jahrustā gā yadṛcchayā |
hṛtāsu tāsu saramā mārgamanveṣaṇe ratā || 16 ||
apaśyat sā diteḥ putrairnītā gāvo dharādhare |
daityairapi śunī dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭamārgā viśeṣataḥ || 17 ||
dṛṣṭvā te tāṃ ca sāmnaiva sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ |
āsāṃ gavāṃ tu dugdhvaiva kṣīraṃ tvaṃ sarame śubhe || 18 ||
pibasvaivamiti proktā tasyai tad dadurañjasā |
dattvā tu kṣīrapānaṃ tu tasyai te daityanāyakāḥ || 19 ||
mā bhadre devarājāya gāścemā vinivedaya |
evamuktvā tato daityā mumucustāṃ śunīṃ vane || 20 ||
tairmuktā sā surāṃstūrṇaṃ jagāma khalu vepatī |
namaścakre ca devendraṃ saramā surasattamam || 21 ||
tasyāśca maruto devā devendreṇa nirūpitāḥ |
gūḍhaṃ gacchata rakṣārthaṃ devaśunyā mahābalāḥ || 22 ||
ityuktāstena sūkṣmeṇa vapuṣā jagmurañjasā |
te'pyāgamya surendrāya namaśrakrurdharādhare || 23 ||
tāṃ devarājaḥ papraccha kva gāvaḥ sarame'bhavan |

gāvaḥ kva ceti marutaḥ provācedaṃ śunī katham || 25 ||
evamuktāstu maruto devendreṇa dharādhare |
kathayāmāsuravyagrāḥ karmma tat saramākṛtam || 26 ||
tata indraḥ samutthāya padā saṃtāḍayacchunīm |
krodhena mahatāviṣṭo devendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ || 27 ||

evamuktvā padā tena tāḍitā saramā dhare || 28 ||
tasyendrapādaghātena kṣīraṃ vaktrāt prasustruve |
stravatā tena payasā sā śunī yatra gā bhavan |
jagāma tatra devendraḥ sahasainyastadā dhare || 29 ||
gatvā cāpaśyad devendrastā gā daityairupāhṛtāḥ |
pālanāṃ cakrurye daityā balino bhṛśam |
te sainyairnihatāḥ sadyastatyajurgāḥ svamūrttibhiḥ || 30 ||
sāmantaiśca surendro'tha vṛtaḥ paramaharṣitaiḥ |
tāśca labdhvā mahendrastu mudā paramayā yutaḥ || 31 ||
cakāra yajñān vividhān sahastrānapi sa prabhuḥ |
kriyamāṇaistato yajñairvavṛdhendrasya tad balam || 32 ||
varddhitena balenendro devasainyamuvāca ha |
sannahyantāṃ surāḥ śīghraṃ daityānāṃ vadhakarmaṇi || 33 ||
evamuktāstato devāḥ sannaddhāstatkṣaṇe'bhavan |
asurāṇāmabhāvāya jagmurdevāḥ savāsavāḥ || 34 ||

jitāśca devairasurā hataśeṣā dharādhare |
mamajjuḥ sāgarajale bhayatrastā vicetasaḥ || 35 ||

|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchātre ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
ye te maṇau tadā deva utpannā narapuṃgavāḥ |
teṣāṃ varo bhagavatā dattastretāyuge kila || 1 ||
rājāno bhavitāro vai kathaṃ teṣāṃ samudbhavaḥ |
kiṃ ca cakrurhi te karma pṛthaṅ nāmāni śaṃsa me || 2 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
suprabho maṇijo yastu rājā nāmnā mahāmanāḥ |
tasyotpattiṃ varārohe śrṛṇu tvaṃ bhūtadhāriṇi || 3 ||
āsīd rājā mahābāhurādau kṛtayuge purā |
śrutakīrtiriti khyātastrailokye balavattaraḥ || 4 ||
tasya putratvamāpede suprabho maṇijo dhare |
prajāpāleti vai nāmnā śrutakīrtirmahābalaḥ || 5 ||
saikasmiṃścid dine prāyād vipinaṃ śvāpadākum |
tatrāpaśyadṛṣerdhanyaṃ mahadāśramamaṇḍalam || 6 ||
tasmin mahātapā nāma ṛṣiḥ paradhārmikaḥ |
tapastepe nirāhāro japan brahma sanātanam || 7 ||
tatrāsau pārthivaḥ śrīmān praveśāya matiṃ tadā |
cakāra cāviśad rājā prajāpālo mahātapāḥ || 8 ||
tasmin varāśramapade vanavṛkṣajātyā
dharāprasūtorjitamārgajuṣṭāḥ |
latāgṛhā induraviprakāśino
nāyāsitajñāḥ kulabhṛṅgarājāḥ || 9 ||
suraktapadmodarakomalāgranakhāṅgulībhiḥ prasṛtaiḥ surāṇām |
varāṅganābhiḥ padapaṅktimuccaiviṃhāya bhūmiṃ tvapi vṛtraśatroḥ || 10 ||
kvacit samīpe tamatīva hṛṣṭairnānādvijaiḥ ṣaṭcṛraṇaiśca mattaiḥ |
vāsadbhiruccairvividhapramāṇāḥ śākhāḥ supuṣpāḥ samayogayuktāḥ || 11 ||
kadambanīpārjjunaśīlaśālalatāgṛhasthairmadhurasvareṇa |

makhāgnidhūmairuditāgnihomaistataḥ samantāt gṛhamedhibhirdvijaiḥ |
siṃhairivādharmmakarī vidāritaḥ sa tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrairvaramattakesaraiḥ || 13 ||
evaṃ sa rājā vividhānupāyān
varāśrame prekṣamāṇo viveśa |
tasmid praviṣṭe tu sa tīvratejā
mahātapāḥ puṇyakṛtāṃ pradhānaḥ |
dṛṣṭo yathā bhānuranantabhānuḥ
kauśyāsane brahmavidāṃ pradhānaḥ || 14 ||
dṛṣṭvā sa rājā vijayī mṛgāṇāṃ
matiṃ visasmāra muneḥ prasaṅgāt |
cakāra dharmaṃ prati mānasaṃ so
anuttamaṃ prāpya nṛpo muniṃ saḥ || 15 ||
sa munistaṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā prajāpālamakalmaṣam |
abhyāgatakriyāṃ cakre āsanasvāgatādibhiḥ || 16 ||
tataḥ kṛtāsano rājā praṇamya ṛṣipuṅgavam |
papraccha vasudhe praśnamimaṃ paramadurlabham || 17 ||
bhagavan duḥkhasaṃsāramagnaiḥ pumbhistitīrṣubhiḥ |
yatkāryaṃ tanmamācakṣva praṇate śaṃsitavrata || 18 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
saṃsārārṇavamajjamānamanujaiḥ potaḥ sthiro'tidhruvaḥ
kāryaḥ pūjanadānahomavividhairyajñaiḥ samaṃ dhyāyanaiḥ |
kīlaiḥ kīlitamokṣabhiḥ surabhaṭairūrdhvaṃ mahārajjubhiḥ
prāṇādyairadhunā kuruṣva nṛpate potaṃ trilokeśvaram || 19 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ narakaharaṃ sureśaṃ
bhaktyā namaskurvati yo nṛpeśa |
sa vītaśokaḥ paramaṃ viśokaṃ
prāpnoti viṣṇoḥ padamavyayaṃ tat || 20 ||
nṛpa uvāca |
bhagavan sarvadharmajña kathaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ |
pūjyate mokṣamicchadbhiḥ puruṣairvada tattvataḥ || 21 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
śrṛṇu rājan mahāprājña yathā viṣṇuḥ prasīdati |
puruṣāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ sarvayogīśvaro hariḥ || 22 ||
sarve devāḥ sapitaro brahmādyāścāṇḍamadhyagāḥ |
viṣṇoḥ sakāśādutpannā itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ || 23 ||
agnistathāśvinau gaurī gajavaktrabhujaṃgamāḥ |
kārtikeyastathādityo mātaro durgayā saha || 24 ||
diśo dhanapatirviṣṇuryamo rudraḥ śaśī tathā |
pitaraśceti saṃbhūtāḥ prādhānyena jagatpateḥ || 25 ||
hiraṇyagarbhasya tanau sarvaṃ eva samudbhavāḥ |
pṛthakpṛthak tato garvaṃ vahamānāḥ samantataḥ || 26 ||
ahaṃ yogyastvahaṃ yājya iti teṣāṃ svano mahān |
śrūyate devasamitau sāgarakṣubdhasannibhaḥ || 27 ||
teṣāṃ vivadamānānāṃ vahnirutthāya pārthiva |
uvāca māṃ yajasveti dhyāyadhvaṃ māmiti bruvan || 28 ||
prājāpatyamidaṃ nūnaṃ śarīraṃ madvinākṛtam |
vināśamupapadyeta yato nāhaṃ mahānaham || 29 ||
evamuktvā śarīraṃ tu tyaktvā vahnirviniryayau |
nirgate'pi tatastasmiṃstaccharīraṃ na śīryate || 30 ||
tato'śvinau mūrtimantau prāṇāpānau śarīragau |
āvāṃ pradhānāvityevamūcaturyājyasattamau || 31 ||
evamuktvā śarīraṃ tu vihāya kvacidāsthitau |
tayorapi kṣayaṃ kṛtvā kṣetrī tatpuramāsthitaḥ || 32 ||
tato vāgabrabīd gaurī prādhānyaṃ mayi saṃsthitam |
sā'pyevamuktvā kṣetrāt tu niścakrāma bahiḥ śubhā || 33 ||
tayā vināpi tatkṣetraṃ vāgūnaṃ vyavatiṣṭhata |
tato gaṇapatirvākyamākāśākhyo'bravīt tadā || 34 ||
na mayā rahitaṃ kiñciccharīraṃ sthāyi dūrataḥ |
kālāntaretyevamuktvā so'pi niṣkramya dehataḥ || 35 ||
pṛthagbhūtastathāpyetaccharīraṃ nāpyanīnaśat |
vinākāśākhyatattvena tathāpi na viśīryate || 36 ||
suṣiraistu vihīnaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā kṣetraṃ vyavasthitam |
śarīradhātavaḥ sarve te brūyurvākyameva hi || 37 ||
asmābhirvyatiriktasya na śarīrasya dhāraṇam |
bhavatītyevamuktvā te jahuḥ sarve śarīriṇaḥ || 38 ||
tairvyapetamapi kṣetraṃ puruṣeṇa prapālyate |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvabravīt skandaḥ so'haṃkāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 39 ||
mayā vinā śarīrasya saṃbhūtirapi neṣyate |
evamuktvā śarīrāt tu so'bhyapetaḥ pṛthak sthitaḥ || 40 ||
tenākṣatena tatkṣetraṃ vinā muktavadāsthitam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kupito bhānuḥ sa ādityaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 41 ||
mayā vinā kathaṃ kṣetramimaṃ kṣaṇamapīṣyate |
evamuktvā prayātaḥ sa taccharīraṃ na śīryate || 42 ||
tataḥ kāmādirutthāya gaṇo mātṛvisaṃjñitaḥ |
na mayā vyatiriktasya śarīrasya vyavasthitiḥ |
evamuktvā sa yātastu śarīraṃ tanna śīryate || 43 ||
tato māyā'bravītkopāt sā ca durgā prakīrtitā |
na mayā'sya vinā bhūtirityuktvā'ntardadhe punaḥ || 44 ||
tato diśaḥ samuttasthurūcuścedaṃ vaco mahat |
nāsmābhī rahitaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ |
catastra āgatāḥ kāṣṭhā apayātāḥ kṣaṇāt tadā || 45 ||
tato dhanapatirvāyurmayyapete kva saṃbhavaḥ |
śarīrasyeti sopyevamuktvā mūrdhānago'bhavat || 46 ||
tato viṣṇurmano brūyānnāyaṃ deho mayā vinā |
kṣaṇamapyutsahet sthātumityuktvā'ntardadhe punaḥ || 47 ||
tato dharmo'bravīt sarvamidaṃ pālitavānaham |
idānīmapyupagate kathametadbhaviṣyati || 48 ||
evamuktvā gato dharmastaccharīraṃ na śīryate |
tatobravīnmahādevaḥ avyakto bhūtanāyakaḥ || 49 ||
mahatsaṃjño mayā hīnaṃ śarīraṃ no bhaved yathā |
evamuktvā gataḥ śambhustaccharīraṃ na śīryate || 50 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pitaraścocustanmātrā yāvadasmabhiḥ |
pragatairebhiretacca śarīraṃ śīryate dhruvam |
evamuktvā tu te dehaṃ tyaktvā'ntarddhānamāgatāḥ || 51 ||
agniḥ prāṇo apānaśca ākāśaṃ sarvadhātavaḥ |
kṣetraṃ tadvadahaṃkāro bhānuḥ kāmādayo mayā |
kāṣṭhā vāyurviṣṇurdharma śambhustathendriyārthakāḥ || 52 ||
etairmuktaṃ tu tatkṣetraṃ tat tathaiva vyavasthitam |
somena pālyamānaṃ tu puruṣeṇendurūpiṇā || 53 ||
evaṃ vyavasthite some ṣoḍaśātmanyathākṣare |
prāgvat tatra guṇopetaṃ kṣetramutthāya babhrama || 54 ||
prāgavasthaṃ śarīraṃ tu dṛṣṭvā sarvajñapālitam |
tāḥ kṣetradevatāḥ sarvā vailakṣaṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ || 55 ||
tamevaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvāstaṃ devaṃ parameśvaram |
svasthānamīyiṣuḥ sarvāstadā nṛpatisattama || 56 ||
tvamagnistvaṃ tathā prāṇastvamapānaḥ sarasvatī |
tvamākāśaṃ dhanādhyakṣastvaṃ śarīrasya dhātavaḥ || 57 ||
ahaṃkāro bhavān deva tvamādityo'ṣṭako gaṇaḥ |
tvaṃ māyā pṛthivī durgā tvaṃ diśastvaṃ marutpatiḥ || 58 ||
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ tathā dharmastvaṃ jiṣṇustvaṃ parājitaḥ |
akṣarārthasvarūpeṇa parameśvarasaṃjñitaḥ || 59 ||
asmābhirapayātaistu kathametadbhaviṣyati |
evamatra śarīraṃ tu tyaktamasmābhireva ca || 60 ||
tat paraṃ bhavatā deva tadavasthaṃ prapālyate |
sthānabhaṅgo na naḥ kāryaḥ svayaṃ sṛṣṭvā prajāpate || 61 ||
evaṃ stutastato devasteṣāṃ toṣaṃ paraṃ yayau |
uvāca caitān krīḍārthaṃ bhavantotpāditā mayā || 62 ||
kṛtakṛtyasya me kiṃ nu bhavadbhirviprayojanam |
tathāpi dadmi vo rūpe dve dve pratyekaśo'dhunā || 63 ||
bhūtakāryeṣvamūrtena devaloke tu mūrtinā |
tiṣṭhadhvamapi kālānte layaṃ tvāviśata drutam || 64 ||
śarīrāṇi punarnaivaṃ karttavyo'hamiti kvacit |
mūrttīnāṃ ca tathā tubhyaṃ dadmi nāmāni vo'dhunā || 65 ||
agnervaiśvānaro nāma prāṇāpānau tathāśvinau |
bhaviṣyati tathā gaurī himaśailasutā tathā || 66 ||
pṛthivyādigaṇastveṣa gajavaktro bhaviṣyati |
śarīradhātavaśceme nānābhūtāni eva tu |
ahaṃkārastathā skandaḥ kārttikeyo bhaviṣyati || 67 ||
bhānuścādityarūpo'sau mūrttāmūrtta ca cakṣuṣī |
kāmādyo'yaṃ gaṇo bhūyo mātṛrūpo bhaviṣyati || 68 ||
śarīramāyā durgaiṣā kāraṇānte bhaviṣyati |
daśa kanyā bhaviṣyanti kāṣṭhāstvetāstu vāruṇāḥ || 69 ||
ayaṃ vāyurdhaneśastu kāraṇānte bhaviṣyati |
ayaṃ mano viṣṇunāmā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 70 ||
dharmo'pi yamanāmā ca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
mahattattvaṃ ca bhagavān mahādevo bhaviṣyati || 71 ||
indriyārthāśca pitaro bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ |
ayaṃ somaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā yāmitraṃ sarvadāmarāḥ || 72 ||
evaṃ vedāntapuruṣaḥ prokto nārāyaṇātmakaḥ |
svasthāne devatāḥ sarvā devastu virarāma ha || 73 ||
evaṃ prabhāvo devo'sau vedavedyo janārdanaḥ |
kathito nṛpate tubhyaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 74 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
kathamagneḥ samutpattiraśvinorvā mahāmune |
gauryā gaṇapatervā'pi nāgānāṃ vā guhasya ca || 1 ||
ādityacandramātṝṇāṃ durgāyā vā diśāṃ tathā |
dhanadasya ca viṣṇorvā dharmasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || 2 ||
śambhorvāpi pitṝṇāṃ ca tathā candramaso mune |
śarīradevatā hyetāḥ kathaṃ mūrttitvamāgatāḥ || 3 ||
kiṃ ca tāsāṃ mune bhojyaṃ kā vā saṃjñā tithiśca kā |
yasyāṃ yaṣṭāstvamī puṃsāṃ phalaṃ yacchantyanāmayam |
etanme sarahasyaṃ tu mune tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 4 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
yogasādhyaḥ svarūpeṇa ātmā nārāyaṇātmakaḥ |
sarvajñaḥ krīḍatastasya bhogecchā cātmanātmani |
kṣobhite'bhūnmahābhūte etacchabdaṃ tadadbhutam || 5 ||
tamapyaprītimattoyaṃ vikāraṃ samarocayat |
vikurvatastasya tadā mahānagniḥ samutthitaḥ |
koṭijvālāparīvāraḥ śabdavān dahanātmakaḥ || 6 ||
asāvapyatitejasvī vikāraṃ samarocayat |
vikurvato babhau vahnervāyuḥ paramadāruṇaḥ |
tasmādapi vikārasthādākāśaṃ samapadyata || 7 ||
tacchabdalakṣaṇaṃ vyoma sa ca vāyuḥ pratāpavān |
tacca tejo'mbhasā yuktaṃ śliṣṭamanyonyatastadā || 8 ||
tejasā śoṣitaṃ toyaṃ vāyunā ugragāminā |
bādhitena tathā vyomnā mārge datte tu tatkṣaṇāt || 9 ||
piṇḍībhūtaṃ tathā sarvaṃ kāṭhinyaṃ samapadyata |
seyaṃ pṛthvī mahābhāga teṣāṃ vṛddhatarā'bhavat || 10 ||
caturṇāṃ yogakāṭhinyādekaikaguṇavṛddhitaḥ |
pṛthvī pañcaguṇā jñeyā te'pyetasyāṃ vyavasthitāḥ || 11 ||
sa ca kāṭhinyakaṃ kurvan brahmāṇḍaṃ samapadyata |
tasmin nārāyaṇo devaścaturmūrtiścaturbhujaḥ || 12 ||
prājāpatyena rūpeṇa sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ |
cintayan nādhigaccheta sṛṣṭiṃ lokapitāmahaḥ || 13 ||
tato'sya sumahān kopo jajñe paramadāruṇaḥ |
tasmāt kopāt sahastrārciruttasthau dahanātmakaḥ || 14 ||
sa taṃ didhakṣurbrahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇoktastadā nṛpa |
havyaṃ kavyaṃ vahasveti tato'sau havyavāhanaḥ || 15 ||
brahmāṇaṃ kṣudhitaḥ prāyāt kiṃ karomi prasādhi mām |
sa brahmā pratyuvācātha tridhā tṛptimavāpsyasi || 16 ||
dattāsu dakṣiṇāsvādau tṛptirbhūtvā yato'marān |
nayase dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ dakṣiṇāgnistato'bhavat || 17 ||
ā samantāddhutaṃ kiṃcid yat triloke vibhāvaso |
tad vahasva surārthāya tatastvaṃ havyavāhanaḥ || 18 ||
gṛhaṃ śarīramityuktaṃ tatpatistvaṃ yato'dhunā |
ato vai gārhapatyastvaṃ bhava sarvagato vibho || 19 ||
viśvān narān huto yena nayase sadgatiṃ prabho |
ato vaiśvānaro nāma tava vākyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 20 ||
draviṇaṃ balamityuktaṃ dhanaṃ ca draviṇaṃ yataḥ |
dadāti tad bhavāneva draviṇodāstato'bhavat || 21 ||
tanuṃ pāsyatanuṃ pāsi yena tvaṃ sarvadā vibho |
tatastanūnapānnāma tava vatsa bhaviṣyati || 22 ||
bhavān jātāni vai veda ajātāni ca yena vai |
ataste nāma bhavatu jātavedā iti prabho || 23 ||
nārāḥ sāmānyataḥ puṃso viśeṣeṇa dvijātayaḥ |
te śaṃsanti yatastvāṃ tu nārāśaṃsastato bhava || 24 ||
agas tirobhavennityaṃ niḥśabdo niścayātmakaḥ |
agastvaṃ sarvagatvācca tenāgnistvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 25 ||
dhmā prapūraṇaśabdo ya idhmā nāma prakīrtyate |
pūritasyāgatiryena tenedhmastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 26 ||
yājyānyetāni nāmāni tava putra mahāmakhe |
yajantastvāṃ narāḥ kāmaistarpayiṣyantyasaṃśayam || 27 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
viṣṇorvibhūtimāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ te prasaṅgataḥ |
tithīnāṃ śrṛṇu māhātmyaṃ kathyamānaṃ mayā nṛpa || 1 ||
itthaṃbhūto mahānagnirbrahmakrodhodbhavo mahān |
uvāca devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tithirme dīyatāṃ vibho |
yasyāmahaṃ samastasya jagataḥ khyātimāpnuyām || 2 ||
brahmovāca |
devānāmatha yakṣāṇāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca sattama |
ādau pratipadā yena tvamutpanno'si pāvaka || 3 ||
tvatpadāt pratipadaṃ cānyā saṃbhaviṣyanti devatāḥ |
ataste pratipannāma tithireṣā bhaviṣyati || 4 ||
tasyāṃ tithau haviṣyeṇa prājāpatyena mūrtinā |
hoṣyanti teṣāṃ prītāḥ syuḥ pitaraḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 5 ||
caturvidhāni bhūtāni manuṣyāḥ paśavo'surāḥ |
devāḥ sarve sagandharvāḥ prītāḥ syustarpite tvayi || 6 ||
yaścopavāsaṃ kurvīta tvadbhaktaḥ pratipaddine |
kṣīrāśano vā vartteta śrṛṇu tasya phalaṃ mahat || 7 ||
caturyugāni ṣaṭtriṃśat svarloke'sau mahīyate |
tejasvī rūpasaṃpanno dravyavān jāyate naraḥ || 8 ||
iha janmanyasau rājā pretya svarge mahīyate |
tūṣṇīṃ babhūva sopyagnirbrahmadattāśrayaṃ yayau || 9 ||
ya idaṃ śrṛṇuyānnityaṃ prātarutthāya mānavaḥ |
agnerjanma sa pāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 10 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
evamagneḥ samutpattirjātā brahman mahātmanaḥ |
prāṇāpānau kathaṃ devāvaśvinau saṃbabhūvatuḥ || 1 ||
marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ putraḥ svayaṃ brahmā dvisaptabhiḥ |
rūpairvyavasthitasteṣāṃ marīciḥ śreṣṭhatāmagāt || 2 ||
tasya putro mahātejāḥ kaśyapo nāma vai muniḥ |
svayaṃ prajāpatiḥ śrīmān devatānāṃ pitā'bhavat || 3 ||
tasya putrā babhūvurhi ādityā dvādaśa prabho |
adityapatyāni te sarve ādityāstena kīrtitāḥ || 4 ||
teṣāṃ madhye mahātejā mārttaṇḍo lokaviśrutaḥ |
nārāyaṇātmakaṃ tejo dvādaśaṃ saṃprakīrtitam || 5 ||
ye te māsāsta ādityāḥ svayaṃ saṃvatsaro hariḥ |
evaṃ te dvādaśādityā mārttaṇḍaśca pradhānavān || 6 ||
tasya tvaṣṭā dadau kanyāṃ saṃjñāṃ nāma mahāprabhām |
tasyāpatyadvayaṃ jajñe yamaśca yamunā tathā || 7 ||
tasya tejo'pyasahatī babhūvāśvī manojavā |
svāṃ chāyāṃ tatra saṃsthāpya sā jagamottarān kurūn || 8 ||
tadrūpāṃ tāṃ savarṇāṃ tu bheje mārttaṇḍabhāskaraḥ |
tasyā api dvayaṃ jajñe śaniṃ tapatimeva ca || 9 ||
yadā tvasadṛśaṃ bheje putrān prati narottama |
saṃjñāṃ provāca bhagavān krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ |
asamatvaṃ na karttavyaṃ sveṣvapatyeṣu bhāmini || 10 ||

tadā yamaḥ svapitaraṃ provāca bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ || 11 ||
neyaṃ mātā bhavet tāta asmākaṃ śatruvat sadā |
sapatnīva vṛthācārā svesvapatyeṣu vatsalā || 12 ||
evaṃ yamavacaḥ śrutvā sā chāyā krodhamūrcchitā |
śaśāpa pretarājastvaṃ bhaviṣyasyacirādiva || 13 ||
evaṃ śrutvā'tha mārttaṇḍastadā putrahitaiṣayā |
uvāca madhyavartī tvaṃ bhavitā dharmapāpayoḥ |
lokapālaśca bhavitā tvaṃ putra divi śobhase || 14 ||
śaniṃ śaśāpa mārttaṇḍaśchāyākopapradharṣitaḥ |
tvaṃ krūradṛṣṭirbhavitā mātṛdoṣeṇa putraka || 15 ||
evamuktvā samutthāya yogaṃ bhānurdidṛkṣayā |
tāmapaśyattvasau sāśvī uttareṣu kuruṣvatha || 16 ||
tato'śvarūpaṃ kṛtvā sa gatvā tatrottarān kurūn |
prājāpatyena mārgeṇa yuyojātmānamātmanā || 17 ||
tasyāṃ tvāṣṭryāmaśvarūpyāṃ mārttaṇḍastīvratejasaḥ |
bījaṃ nirvāpayāmāsa tajjvalantaṃ dvidhā'patat || 18 ||

varadānena ca punarmūrttimantau babhūvatuḥ || 19 ||
tau tvāṣṭryāmaśvarūpiṇyāṃ jātau yena narottamau |
tatastāvaśvinau devau kīrttyete ravinandanau || 20 ||
prajāpatiḥ svayaṃ bhānustvāṣṭrī śaktiḥ parāparā |
tasyāḥ prāgvaccharīrasthāvamūrttau mūrtimāśritau || 21 ||
tatastāvaśvinau devau mārttaṇḍamupatasthatuḥ |
ūcatuḥ svaruciṃ tāvat kiṃ karttavyamathāvayoḥ || 22 ||
mārttaṇḍa uvāca |
putrau prajāpatiṃ devaṃ bhaktyārādhayatāṃ varam |
nārāyaṇaṃ sa vo dātā varaṃ nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati || 23 ||
evaṃ tāvaśvinau proktau mārttaṇḍena mahātmanā |
tepatustīvratapasau tapaḥ paramaduścaram |
brahmapāramayaṃ stotraṃ japantau tu samāhitau || 24 ||
tayoḥ kālena mahatā brahmā nārāyaṇātmakaḥ |
tutoṣa paramaprītyā varaṃ caitaṃ dadau tayoḥ || 25 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
aśvibhyāmīritaṃ stotraṃ brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ |
śrotumicchāmyahaṃ brahmaṃstvatprasādānmahāmune || 26 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
śrṛṇu rājan yathā stotramaśvibhyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kṛtam |
īdṛśaṃ ca phalaṃ prāptaṃ tayoḥ stotrasya cānagha || 27 ||
oṃnamaste niṣkriya niṣprapañca nirāśraya nirapekṣa nirālamba
nirguṇa nirāloka nirādhāra nirjaya nirākāra |
brahman mahābrahman brāhmaṇapriya puruṣa mahāpuruṣottama |
deva mahādevottama sthāṇo sthitasthāpaka |
bhūta mahābhūta bhūtādhipati yakṣa mahāyakṣa yakṣādhipate |
guhya mahāguhyādhipate saumya mahāsaumya saumyādhipate |
pakṣi mahāpakṣipate daitya mahādaityādhipate |
rudra mahārudrādhipate viṣṇu mahāviṣṇupate |
parameśvara nārāyaṇa prajāpataye namaḥ |
evaṃ stutastadā tābhyāmaśvibhyāṃ sa prajāpatiḥ |
tutoṣa paramaprītyā vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 28 ||
varaṃ varayatāṃ śīghraṃ devaiḥ paramadurlabham |
yena me varadānena caratastridivaṃ sukham || 29 ||
aśvināvūcatuḥ |
āvayoryajñabhāgaṃ tu dehi deva prajāpate |
somapatvaṃ ca devānāṃ sāmānyatvaṃ ca śāśvatam || 30 ||
brahmovāca |
rūpaṃ kāntiranaupamyaṃ bhiṣaktvaṃ sarvavastuṣu |
somapatvaṃ ca lokeṣu sarvametad bhaviṣyati || 31 ||
etat sarvaṃ dvitīyāyāmaśvibhyāṃ brahmaṇā purā |
dattaṃ yasmādatasteṣāṃ tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ || 32 ||
etasyāṃ rūpakāmastu puṣpāhāro bhavennaraḥ |
saṃvatsaraṃ śucirnityaṃ susvarūpī bhavennaraḥ |
aśvibhyāṃ ye guṇāḥ proktāste tasyāpi bhavanti ca || 33 ||
ya idaṃ śrṛṇuyānnityamaśvibhyāṃ janma cottamam |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ putravān jāyate naraḥ || 34 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
pūrvaṃ prajāpatirdevaḥ sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ |
cintayāmāsa dharmātmā yadā tā nādhyagacchata || 2 ||
tadā'sya kopāt saṃjajñe sa ca rudraḥ pratāpavān |
rodanāt tasya rudratvaṃ saṃjātaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 3 ||
tasya brahmā śubhāṃ kanyāṃ bhāryārthaṃ mūrttisaṃbhavām |
gaurī nāmnā svayaṃ devī bhāratī tāṃ dadau pitā || 4 ||
rudrāyāmitadehāya svayaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ |
sa tāṃ labdhvā varārohāṃ mudā paramayā yutaḥ || 5 ||
sargakāleṣu taṃ brahmā tapasā pratyuvāca ha |
rudra prajāḥ sṛjasveti paunaḥpunyena coditaḥ |
asamartho'hamiti jale nimajjata mahābalaḥ || 6 ||
taporthitvaṃ tapohīnaḥ straṣṭuṃ śaknoti na prajāḥ |
evaṃ cintya jale magnastato rudraḥ pratāpavān || 7 ||
tasmin nimagne deveśe tāṃ brahmā kanyakāṃ punaḥ |
antaḥśarīragāṃ kṛtvā gaurīṃ paramaśobhanām || 8 ||
punaḥ sisṛkṣurbhagavānasṛjat sapta mānasān |
dakṣaṃ ca teṣāmārabhya prajāḥ samyag vyavarddhitāḥ || 9 ||
tatra dākṣāyaṇīputrāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ |
vasavo'ṣṭau ca rudrāśca ādityā marutastathā || 10 ||
sā'pi dakṣāya suśroṇī gaurī dattātha brahmaṇā |
duhitṛtve purā yā hi rudreṇoḍhā mahātmanā || 11 ||
sā ca dākṣāyaṇī devī punarbhūtā nṛpottama |
tato dakṣaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā dauhitrān svān sa vṛddhikṛt |
dṛṣṭvā yajñamathārebhe prīṇanāya prajāpatiḥ || 12 ||
tatra brahmasutāḥ sarve marīcyādaya eva ca |
cakrurārttvijyakaṃ karmma sve sve mārge vyavasthitāḥ || 13 ||

atristu yajñakarmastha āgnīdhrastvaṅgirā bhavat || 14 ||
hotā pulastyastvabhavadudgātā pulaho'bhavat |
kratau kratustu prastotā tadā yajñe mahātapāḥ || 15 ||
pratihartā pracetāstu tasmin kratuvare babhau |
subrahmaṇyo vasiṣṭhastu sanakādyāḥ sabhāsadaḥ |
tatra yājyaḥ svayaṃ brahmā sa ca ijyastu pūjyate || 16 ||
pūjyā dakṣasya dauhitrā rudrādityāṅgirādayaḥ |
pratyakṣapitaraste hi taiḥ prītaiḥ prīyate jagat || 17 ||
tatra bhāgārthino devā ādityā vasavastathā |
viśvedevāḥ sapitaro gandharvādyā marudgaṇāḥ || 18 ||
jagṛhuryajñabhāgān svān yāvat te haviṣorpitān |
tāvatkālaṃ jalāt sadya uttasthau brahmaṇaḥ punaḥ || 19 ||
rudraḥ kopodbhavo yastu pūrvaṃ magno mahājale |
sa sahastrārkasaṃkāśo niścakrāma jalāt tataḥ || 20 ||
sarvajñānamayo devaḥ sarvadevamayo'malaḥ |
pratyakṣadarśī sarvasya jagatastapasā babhau || 21 ||
tasmiṃstu kāle pañcānāṃ jātaḥ sargo narottama |
divyānāṃ pṛthivīsthānāṃ caturṇāmarajātinām || 22 ||
raudrasargasya saṃbhūtistadā sadyo'pi jāyate |
idānīṃ rudrasargaṃ tvaṃ śrṛṇu pārthivasattama || 23 ||
daśavarṣasahastrāṇi tapaścīrtvā mahajjale |
pratibuddho yadā rudrastadā corvoṃ sakānanām |
dṛṣṭvā sasyavatīṃ ramyāṃ manuṣyapaśusaṃkulām || 24 ||
śuśrāva ca tadā śabdānṛtvijāṃ dakṣasadmani |
āśrame yajñināṃ coccairyogasthairiti kīrttitam || 25 ||
tataḥ śrutvā mahātejāḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
cukopa subhṛśaṃ devo vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 26 ||
ahaṃ pūrvaṃ tu kavinā sṛṣṭaḥ sarvātmanā vibhuḥ |
prajāḥ sṛjasveti tadā vākyametat tathoktavān || 27 ||
idānīṃ kena tatkarma kṛtaṃ sṛṣṭyādivarṇanam |
evamuktvā bhṛśaṃ kopānnanāda parameśvaraḥ || 28 ||
tasya nānadato jvālāḥ śrotrebhyo niryayustadā |
tatra bhūtāni vetālā ucchruṣmāḥ pretapūtanāḥ || 29 ||
kūṣmāṇḍā yātudhānāśca sarve prajvalitānanāḥ |
uttasthuḥ koṭiśastatra nānāpraharaṇāvṛtāḥ || 30 ||
te dṛṣṭvā bhūtasaṃghātā vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ |
sasarja vedavidyāṅgaṃ rathaṃ paramaśobhanam || 31 ||
tasminnṛgādayastvaśvāstritattvaṃ ca triveṇukam |
tripūjakaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ dharmākṣaṃ mārutadhvanim || 32 ||
ahorātre patāke dve dharmādharme tu daṇḍake |
śakaṭaṃ sarvavidyāśca svayaṃ brahmādisārathiḥ || 33 ||
gāyatrī ca dhanustasya oṅkāro guṇa eva ca |
svarāḥ sapta śarāstasya devadevasya suvrata || 34 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā sa sāmagrīṃ devadevaḥ pratāpavān |
jagāma dakṣayajñāya kopād rudraḥ pratāpavān || 35 ||
gacchatastasya devasya ambarāṅgirasaṃ nayat |
ṛtvijāṃ mantranicayo naṣṭo rudrāgame tadā || 36 ||
viparītamidaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā sarve ca ṛtvijaḥ |
ūcuḥ saṃnahyatāṃ devā mahad vo bhayamāgatam || 37 ||
kaścidāyāti balavānasuro brahmanirmitaḥ |
yajñabhāgārthametasmin kratau paramadurlabham || 38 ||
evamuktāstato devā ūcurmātāmahaṃ tadā |
dakṣa tāta kimatrāsmatkāryaṃ brūhi vivakṣitam || 39 ||
dakṣa uvāca |
gṛhyantāṃ drutamastrāṇi saṃgrāmo'tra vidhīyatām |
evamukte tadā devairvividhāyudhadhāribhiḥ |
rudrasyānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ pravartitam || 40 ||
tatra vetālabhūtāni kūṣmāṇḍā grahapūtanāḥ |
yuyudhurlokapālaiśca nānāśastradharāṇi ca || 41 ||
devā raudrāṇi bhūtāni nirasanto yamālayam |
cikṣipuḥ sāyakān ghorānasīṃśca saparaśvadhān || 42 ||
bhūtānyapi mṛdhe dhorāṇyulmukairasthibhiḥ śaraiḥ |
jagmurdevān mṛdhe roṣād rudrasya purato balāt || 43 ||
tatastasmin mahāraudre saṃgrāme bhīmarūpiṇi |
rudro bhagasya netre tu bibhedaikeṣuṇā mṛdhe || 44 ||
rudrasya śarapātena naṣṭanetraṃ bhagaṃ tadā |
dṛṣṭvā'sya krodhāt tejasvī pūṣā rudramayodhayat || 45 ||

dṛṣṭvā rudro'sya dantāṃstu cakarṣaṃ paravīrahā || 46 ||
tasya dantāṃstadā dṛṣṭvā pūṣṇo rudreṇa pātitān |
dudruvuḥ vasavo dikṣu rudrāstvekādaśa drutam || 47 ||

ādityāvarajo vākyamuvāca svabalaṃ tadā || 48 ||

vyavasāyaṃ kulaṃ bhūtiṃ kathaṃ na smaryate drutam || 49 ||
parameṣṭhiguṇairyukto laghuvadbhītitaḥ purā |
namaskaṃ kurute moghaṃ pṛthivyāṃ padmajaḥ svayam || 50 ||

śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ || 51 ||

rudraḥ pāśupatāstreṇa vivyādha harimojasā |
harirnārāyaṇāstreṇa rudraṃ vivyādha kopavān || 52 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ pāśupatamubhe'stre vyomni roṣite |
yuyudhāte bhṛśaṃ divyaṃ parasparajighāṃsayā |
divyaṃ varṣasahastraṃ tu tayoryuddhamabhūt tadā || 53 ||

ekaṃ pradhmāpayacchaṅkhamanyaḍumarukaṃ śubham || 54 ||

ekaṃ kaustubhadīptāṅgamanyaṃ bhūtivibhūṣitam || 55 ||
ekaṃ gadāṃ bhrāmayati dvitīyaṃ daṇḍameva ca |
ekaṃ śobhati kaṇṭhasthairmaṇibhistvasthibhiḥ param |
ekaṃ pītāmbaraṃ tatra dvitīyaṃ sarpamekhalam || 56 ||
evaṃ tau sparddhināvastrau raudranārāyaṇātmakau |
anyo'nyātiśayopetau tadālokya pitāmahaḥ || 57 ||

evaṃ te brahmaṇā coktau śāntabhāvaṃ prajagmatuḥ || 58 ||

dakṣasya khyātimām̐llokaḥ saṃtatyā'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || 60 ||
evamuktvā hariharau tadā lokapitāmahaḥ |

stutiṃ ca devāḥ kuruta rudrasya parameṣṭhi naḥ || 62 ||
bhaganetraharaṃ devaṃ pūṣṇo dantavināśanam |
stutiṃ kurutamā śīghraṃ gītairetaistu nāmabhiḥ |
yenāyaṃ vaḥ prasannātmā varadatvaṃ bhajeta ha || 63 ||
evamuktāstu te devāḥ stotraṃ śaṃbhormahātmanaḥ |
cakruḥ paramayā bhaktyā namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuve || 64 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
namo viṣamanetrāya namaste tryambakāya ca |
namaḥ sahastranetrāya namaste śūlapāṇaye || 65 ||
namaḥ khaṭvāṅgahastāya namo daṇḍabhṛte kare |
tvaṃ deva hutabhugjvālākoṭibhānusamaprabhaḥ || 66 ||
adarśane'nayad deva mūḍhavijñānato'dhunā |
kṛtamasmābhireveśa tadatra kṣamyatāṃ prabho || 67 ||
namastrinetrārttiharāya śaṃbho
triśūlapāṇe vikṛtāsyarūpa |
samastadeveśvara śuddhabhāva
prasīda rudrācyuta sarvabhāva || 68 ||
pūṣṇo'sya dantāntaka bhīmarūpa
pralambabhogīndralulantakaṇṭha |
viśāladehācyuta nīlakaṇṭha
prasīda viśveśvara viśvamūrtte || 69 ||
bhagākṣisaṃsphoṭanadakṣakarmā
gṛhāṇa bhāgaṃ makhataḥ pradhānam |
prasīda deveśvara nīlakaṇṭha
prapāhi naḥ sarvaguṇopapanna || 70 ||
sitāṅgarāgāpratipannamūrtte
kapāladhāriṃstripuraghna deva |
prapāhi naḥ sarvabhayeṣu caiva
umāpate puṣkaranālajanma || 71 ||
paśyāma te dehagatān sureśa
sargādayo vedavarānananta |
sāṅgān savidyān sapadakramāṃśca
sarvān nilīnāṃstvayi devadeva || 72 ||
bhava śarva mahādeva pinākin rudra te hara |
natāḥ sma sarve viśveśa trāhi naḥ parameśvara || 73 ||
itthaṃ stutastadā devairdevadevo maheśvaraḥ |
tutoṣa sarvadevānāṃ vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 74 ||
rudra uvāca |
bhagasya netraṃ bhavatu pūṣṇo dantāstathā makhaḥ |
dakṣasyācchidratāṃ yātu yajñaścāpyaditeḥ sutāḥ |
paśubhāvaṃ tathā cāpi apaneṣyāmi vo surāḥ || 75 ||
maddarśanena yo jātaḥ paśubhāvo divaukasām |
sa mayā'pahṛtaḥ sadyaḥ patitvaṃ vo bhaviṣyati || 76 ||
ahaṃ ca sarvavidyānāṃ patirādyaḥ sanātanaḥ |
ahaṃ vai patibhāvena paśumadhye vyavasthitaḥ || 77 ||
ataḥ paśupatirnāma mama loke bhaviṣyati |
ye māṃ yajanti teṣāṃ syād dīkṣā pāśupatī bhavet || 78 ||
evamukte'tha rudreṇa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
uvāca rudraṃ sasnehaṃ smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 79 ||
dhruvaṃ pāśupatirdeva tvaṃ loke khyātimesyati |
ayaṃ ca devastvannāmnā loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati |
ārādhyaśca samastānāṃ devādīnāṃ gamiṣyasi || 80 ||

gaurīṃ prayaccha rudrāya pūrvamevopapāditām || 81 ||
evamuktvā tadā dakṣastāṃ kanyāṃ brahmasannidhau |
dadau rudrāya mahate gaurīṃ paramaśobhanām || 82 ||

dakṣasya ca priyaṃ kurvan bahumānapuraḥsaram || 83 ||
gṛhītāyāṃ tu kanyāyāṃ dākṣāyaṇyāṃ pitāmahaḥ |
dadau rudrasya nilayaṃ kailāsaṃ surasannidhau || 84 ||

devāścāpi yathāsthānaṃ svaṃ svaṃ jagmurmudānvitāḥ |
brahmā'pi dakṣasahitaḥ prājāpatyaṃ puraṃ yayau || 85 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
tasmin nivasatastasya rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ |
cukopa gaurī devasya piturvairamanusmaran || 1 ||
cintayāmāsa dakṣasya anenāpakṛtaṃ purā |
yajño vidhvaṃsito yasmāt tasmāccānyāṃ tanūmaham || 2 ||
ārādhya tapasā tasya gṛhe bhūtvā vrajāmyaham |
kathaṃ gacchāmi pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ kṣapitabāndhavam || 3 ||
bhavapatnī ca duhitā evaṃ saṃcintya sundarī |
jagāma tapase śailaṃ himavantaṃ mahāgirim || 4 ||
tatra kālena mahatā kṣapayantī kalevaram |
svaśarīrāgninā dagdhā tataḥ śailasutā'bhavat || 5 ||
umā nāmeti mahatī kṛṣṇā cetyabhidhānataḥ |
labdhvā tu śobhanāṃ mūrtiṃ himavantagṛhe śubhā || 6 ||
punastapaścakārograṃ devaṃ smṛtvā trilocanam |
asāveva patirmahyamityuktvā tapasi sthitā || 7 ||
kurvantyā tat tapaścograṃ himavante mahāgirau |
kālena mahatā devastapasārādhitastayā || 8 ||
ājagāmāśramaṃ tasyā vipro bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ |
vṛddhaḥ śithilasarvāṅgaḥ skhalaṃścaiva pade pade || 9 ||
