bubhukṣito'smi me dehi bhadre bhojyaṃ dvijasya tu || 10 ||
evamuktā tadā kanyā umā śailasutā śubhā |
uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ bhojyaṃ dadmi vipra phalādikam |
kuru snānaṃ drutaṃ vipra bhuñjasvānnaṃ yadṛcchayā || 11 ||
evamuktastadā viprastasya pārśve mahānadīm |
gaṅgāṃ jagāma snānārthī snānaṃ karttumavātarat || 12 ||
snānaṃ tu kurvatā tena rudreṇa dvijarūpiṇā |
bhūtvā māyāmayaṃ bhīmaṃ makaraṃ bhayadarśanam |
grāhitastu tadā viprastena duṣṭena madgunā || 13 ||
dṛṣṭvā dhṛtamathātmānaṃ makareṇa balīyasā |
vṛddhamātmānamanyaṃ tāṃ darśayan vākyamabravīt || 14 ||
abrahmaṇyaṃ gataṃ kanye dhāvasvānaya māṃ ruṣaḥ |
yāvannāyāti vikṛtiṃ tāvanmāṃ trātumarhasi || 15 ||
evamuktā tadā kanyā cintayāmāsa pārvatī |
pitṛbhāvena śailendraṃ bhartṛbhāvena śaṃkaram |
spṛśāmi tapasā pūtā kathaṃ vipraṃ spṛśāmyaham || 16 ||
yadyenaṃ nāpakarṣāmi makareṇa jale dhṛtam |
tadānīṃ brahmavadhyā me bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ || 17 ||
anyavyatikrame dharmamapanetuṃ ca śakyate |
brahmavadhyā punarnaivamevamuktavā gatā tvaram || 18 ||
sā gatvā tvaritaṃ bhīrurgṛhītvā pāṇinā dvijam |
cakarṣāntarjalāt tāvat svayaṃ bhūtapatirharaḥ || 19 ||
yamārādhya tapaścarttumārabdhaṃ śailaputrāyā |
sa eva bhagavān rudrastasyāḥ pāṇau vilambata || 20 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā lajjitā devī pūrvatyāgamanusmaran |
na kiṃciduttaraṃ subhrūrvadati sma sulajjitā || 21 ||
tūṣṇīṃbhūtāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā gaurīṃ rudro hasanniva |
pāṇau gṛhītvā māṃ bhadre kathaṃ tyaktumihārhasi || 22 ||
matpāṇigrahaṇaṃ bhadre vṛthā yadi kariṣyasi |
tadānīṃ brahmaṇaḥ putryāmāhārārthaṃ bravīmyaham || 23 ||
na bhavet parihāso'yamuktā devī parāparā |
lajjamānā tadā vākyaṃ vadati smitapūrvakam || 24 ||
devadeva trilokeśa tvadartho'yaṃ samudyamaḥ |
prāgjanmārādhito bharttā bhavān devo maheśvaraḥ || 25 ||
idānīṃ me bhavān devaḥ patirnānyo bhaviṣyati |
kintu svāmī pitā mahyaṃ śailendro me vrajāmi tam |
anujñāpya vidhānena tataḥ pāṇiṃ gṛhīṣyasi || 26 ||
evamuktvā tadā devī pitaraṃ prati bhāminī |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā himavantamuvāca ha || 27 ||
ato'nyajanmabharttā me rudro dakṣamakhāntakaḥ |
idānīṃ tapasā saiva dhyāto'bhūd gatibhāvanaḥ || 28 ||
sa ca viśvapatirbhūtvā brāhmaṇo me tapovanam |
āgatya bhojanārthāya yācayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ |
mayā snātuṃ vrajasveti codito jāhnavīṃ gataḥ || 29 ||
tatrāsau vṛddhakāyena dvijarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ |
makareṇa dhṛtastūrṇaṃ abrahahmaṇyamuvāca ha || 30 ||
brahmahatyābhayāt tāta mayā pāṇau dhṛtastataḥ |
dhṛtamātraḥ svakaṃ dehaṃ darśayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ || 31 ||
tato māmabravīd devaḥ pāṇigrahaṇamāgatām |
bhavatī devi mā kiṃcid vicāraya tapodhane || 32 ||
evamuktā tvahaṃ tena śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā |
tadanujñāpya deveśaṃ bhavantaṃ praṣṭumāgatā |
idānīṃ yat kṣamaṃ kāryaṃ tacchīghraṃ saṃvidhīyatām || 33 ||
evaṃ śrutvā tadā vākyaṃ śailarājo mudā yutaḥ |
uvāca duhitāṃ dhanyāṃ tasmin kāle varānanām || 34 ||
putri dhanyo'smyahaṃ loke yasya rudraḥ svayaṃ haraḥ |
jāmātā bhavitā devi tvayā'patyavatāmaham |
sthāpito mūrdhni devānāmapi putri tvayā hyaham || 35 ||
sthīyatāṃ kṣaṇamekaṃ tu yāvadāgamanaṃ mama |
evamuktvā gato rājā śailānāṃ brahmaṇo'ntikam || 36 ||
tatra dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ sarvadevapitāmaham |
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā brahmāṇaṃ śailarāṭ tataḥ || 37 ||
devomā duhitā mahyaṃ tāṃ rudrāya dadāmyaham |
tvayā deva anujñātastatkaromi praśādhi mām || 38 ||
tato brahmā prītamanā yāhi rudrāya tāṃ śubhām |
prayacchovāca devānāṃ tadā lokapitāmahaḥ || 39 ||
evamuktaḥ śailarājaḥ svaveśmāgamya satvaram |
devānṛṣīn siddhasaṃghān cāmantrayata satvaram || 40 ||
tumburuṃ nāradaṃ caiva hāhāhūhūṃ tathaiva ca |
sa gatvā kinnarāṃścaiva asurān rākṣasānapi || 41 ||
parvatāḥ saritaḥ śailā vṛkṣā oṣadhayastathā |
āgatā mūrttimanto vai parvatāḥ saṅgamopalāḥ |
himavadduhiturdraṣṭuṃ vivāhaṃ śaṃkareṇa ha || 42 ||
tatra vediḥ kṣitiścāsīt kalaśāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ |
sūryo dīpastathā somaḥ sarito vavahurjalam || 43 ||
evaṃ vivāhasāmagrīṃ kṛtvā śailavarādhipaḥ |
preṣayāmāsa rudrāya samīpaṃ mandaraṃ girim || 44 ||
sa tadā mandaroktastu śaṃkaro drutamāyayau |
vidhinā somayā pāṇiṃ jagrāha parameśvaraḥ || 45 ||
tatrotsave parvatanāradau dvau
jaguśca siddhā nanṛturvanaspatīḥ |
puṣpāṇyanekāni vicikṣipuḥ śubhāḥ
nanarturuccaiḥ surayoṣito bhṛśam || 46 ||
tasmin vivāhe salilapravāhe
caturmukho lokaparaḥ svasaṃsthaḥ |
uvāca kanyāṃ bhava putri loke
nārī prabharttā tava cānyapuṃsām |
ityevamuktvā sa umāṃ sarudrāṃ
pitāmahaḥ svaṃ puramājagāma || 47 ||
jāmātaraṃ parvatarāṭ supūjya
visarjayāmāsa vibhuṃ sa somam |
devāṃśca daityān vividhānṛṣīṃśca saṃpūjya sarvān vividhaistu vastubhiḥ |
vibhūṣaṇairvastravarānnadānairvisarjayāmāsa tadādrimukhyān ||48 ||
sa vītaśoko virajo viśuddhaḥ
śubhānanāṃ devavarāya dattvā |
umāṃ mahātmā himavānadrirājaḥ
paitāmahe loka ivādhvare bhāt || 49 ||
itīriteyaṃ tava rājasattama prasūtireṣā na viduryāṃ surāsurāḥ |
svayaṃbhudakṣādirājaḥ trijanmabhirgaurīvivāho'pi mayā sukīrtitaḥ || 50 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
evaṃ sā gaurināmnā tu kāraṇānmūrttimāgatā |
saṃbabhūva yathā proktaṃ prajāpālāya pṛcchate |
ṛṣiṇā mahatā pūrvaṃ tapasā bhāvitātmanā || 51 ||
gauryā utpattireṣā vai kathitā paramarṣiṇā |
vivāhaśca yathā vṛttastatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ tava || 52 ||
etatsarvaṃ tu gauryā vai saṃpannaṃ tu tṛtīyayā |
tasyāṃ tithau tṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ varjayennaraḥ |
yaścopoṣyati nārī vā sā saubhāgyaṃ tu vindati || 53 ||
durbhagā yā tu nārī syāt puruṣaścātidurbhagaḥ |
etacchrutvā tṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ tu vivarjayet || 54 ||
sarvakāmānavāpnoti saubhāgyaṃ dravyasampadam |
ārogyaṃ ca sadā loke kāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ ca vindati || 55 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
kathaṃ gaṇapaterjanma mūrtimantaṃ ca sattama |
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi dhṛtikaṣṭaṃ vyavasthitam || 1 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
pūrvaṃ devagaṇāḥ sarve ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ |
kāryārambhaṃ tathā cakruḥ sidhyante ca na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||
sanmārgavartiṣu yathā siddhyante vighnataḥ kriyāḥ |
asatkāriṣu sarveṣu tadvadevamavighnataḥ || 3 ||
tato devāḥ sapitaraścintayāmāsurojasā |
asatkāryeṣu vighnārthaṃ sarva evābhyamantrayan || 4 ||
tatasteṣāṃ tadā mantraṃ kurvatastridivaukasām |
babhūva buddhirgamane rudraṃ prati mahāmatim || 5 ||
te tatra rudramāgamya kailāsanilayaṃ gurum |
ūcuḥ savinayaṃ sarve praṇipātapuraḥsaram || 6 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
devadeva mahādeva śūlapāṇe trilocana |
vighnārthamaviśiṣṭānāmutpādayitumarhasi || 7 ||
evamuktarastadā devairbhavaḥ paramayā mudā |
umāṃ nirīkṣayāmāsa cakṣuṣā'nimiṣeṇa ha || 8 ||
devānāṃ sannidhau tasya paśyatomāṃ mahātmanaḥ |
cintā'bhūd vyomni mūrtibhyo dṛśyate kena hetunā || 9 ||
pṛthivyā vidyate mūrttirapāṃ mūrttistathaiva ca |
tejasaḥ śvasanasyāpi mūrttireṣā tu dṛśyate |
ākāśaṃ ca kathaṃ neti matvā devo jahāsa ca || 10 ||
jñānaśaktimumāṃ dṛṣṭvā yad dṛṣṭaṃ vyomni śaṃbhunā |
yaccoktaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ śarīraṃ tu śarīriṇām || 11 ||
yaccāpi hasitaṃ tena devena parameṣṭhinā |
etatkāryacatuṣkeṇa pṛthivyādicaturṣvapi || 12 ||
mūrttimānatitejasvī hasataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
pradīptāsyo mahādīptaḥ kumāro bhāsayan diśaḥ |
parameṣṭhiguṇairyuktaḥ sākṣād rudra ivāparaḥ || 13 ||
utpannamātro devānāṃ yoṣitaḥ sapramohayan |
kāntyā dīptyā tathā mūrtyā rūpeṇa ca mahātmavān || 14 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ rūpaṃ kumārasya mahātmanaḥ |
umā'nimeṣanetrābhyāṃ tamapaśyata bhāminī || 15 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kupito devaḥ strībhāvaṃ cañcalaṃ tathā |
matvā kumārarūpaṃ tu śobhanaṃ mohanaṃ dṛśām |
tataḥ śaśāpa taṃ devaḥ strīśaṅkāṃ parameśvaraḥ || 16 ||
kumāra gajavaktrastvaṃ pralambajaṭharastathā |
bhaviṣyasi tathā sarpairupavītagatirdhruvam |
evaṃ śaśāpa taṃ devastīvrakopasamanvitaḥ || 17 ||
arddhakoṭyā ca romāṇāmātmano'ṅge trilocanaḥ |
kūpakāsvedasalilapūrṇaśūladharastathā |
dhunvan śarīramutthāya tato devo ruṣānvitaḥ || 18 ||
yathā yathā'sau sa śarīramādyaṃ dhunoti devastriśikhāstrapāṇiḥ |
tathā tathā cāṅgaruhāścakāsurjalaṃ kṣitau saṃnyapataṃstathānyāḥ || 19 ||
vināyakānekavidhā gajāsyāstamālanīlāñjanasaṃnikāśāḥ |
uttasthuruccairvividhāstrahastāstatastu devā manasākulena || 20 ||
kimetadityadbhutakarmakārī
hyekaḥ karotyapratimaṃ mahacca |
kāryaṃ surāṇāṃ kṛtametadiṣṭaṃ
bhavedathaitaṃ paritaṃ kutastat || 21 ||
divaukasāṃ cintayatāṃ tathā tu vināyakaiḥ kṣmā kṣubhitā babhūva |
caturmukhaścāpratimo vimānamāruhya khe vākyamidaṃ jagāda || 22 ||
dhanyāḥ stha devāḥ suranāyakena
trilocanenādbhutarūpiṇā ca |
anugṛhītāḥ parameśvareṇa
suradviṣāṃ vighnakṛtāṃ natau ca || 23 ||
ityevamuktvā prapitāmahastānuvāca devastriśikhāstrapāṇim |
yaste vibho vaktrasamudbhavaḥ prabhurvināyakānāṃ bhavatu tvime'nugāḥ || 24 ||
bhavāṃstathā'syātmavareṇa cāmbare
tvayā caturṣvastu śarīracārī |
ākāśametad bahudhā vyavasthitaṃ
tvayā vareṇyaḥ kṛta eva nānyaḥ || 25 ||
prabhurbhava tvaṃ pratimāstrapāṇinā
imāni cāstrāṇi varāṃśca dehi |
ityevamuktvā'dhigate pitāmahe
trilocanaścātmabhavaṃ jagāda || 26 ||
vināyako vighnakaro gajāsyo
gaṇeśanāmā ca bhavasya putraḥ |
ete ca sarve tava yāntu bhṛtyā
vināyakāḥ krūradṛśaḥ pracaṇḍāḥ |
ucchuṣmadānādivivṛddhadehāḥ
kāryeṣu siddhiṃ pratipādayantaḥ || 27 ||
bhavāṃśca deveṣu tathā makheṣu
kāryeṣu cānyeṣu mahānubhāvāt |
agreṣu pūjāṃ labhate'nyathā ca
vināśayiṣyasyatha kāryasiddhim || 28 ||
ityevamuktvā parameśvareṇa
suraiḥ samaṃ kāñcanakumbhasaṃsthaiḥ |
jalaistathāsāvabhiṣiktagātro
rarāja rājendra vināyakānām || 29 ||
dṛṣṭavā'bhiṣicyamānaṃ tu devāstaṃ gaṇanāyakam |
tuṣṭuvuḥ prayatāḥ sarve triśūlāstrasya sannidhau || 30 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
namaste gajavaktrāya namaste gaṇanāyaka |
vināyaka namaste'stu namaste caṇḍavikrama || 31 ||
namo'stu te vighnakartre namaste sarpamekhala |
namaste rudravaktrottha pralambajaṭharāśrita || 32 ||
sarvadevanamaskārādavighnaṃ kuru sarvadā |
evaṃ stutastadā devairmahātmā gaṇanāyakaḥ |
abhiṣiktaśca rudrasya somasyāpatyatāṃ gataḥ || 33 ||
etaccaturthyāṃ saṃpannaṃ gaṇādhyakṣasya pārthiva |
yatastato'yaṃ mahatī tithīnāṃ paramā tithiḥ || 34 ||
etasyāṃ yastilān bhuktvā bhaktyā gaṇapatiṃ nṛpa |
ārādhayati tasyāśu tuṣyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 35 ||
yaścaitat paṭhate stotraṃ yaścaitacchṛṇuyāt sadā |
na tasya vighnā jāyante na pāpaṃ sarvathā nṛpa || 36 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
kathaṃ te gātrasaṃsparśānmūrttimanto mahābalāḥ |
nāgā babhūvurdeveśa kāraṇaṃ te mahīdhara || 1 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
śrutvā gaṇapaterjanma prajāpālo narādhipaḥ |
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā taṃ muniṃ saṃśitavratam || 2 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
bhagavaṃstārkṣaviṣayāḥ kathaṃ mūrttimupāgatāḥ |
nāgā babhūvuḥ kuṭilā etadākhyātumarhasi || 3 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
sṛjatā brahmaṇā sṛṣṭiṃ marīciḥ sūtikāraṇam |
prathamaṃ manasā dhyātastasya putrastu kaśyapaḥ || 4 ||
tasya dākṣāyaṇī bhāryā kadrūrnāma śucismitā |
mārīco janayāmāsa tasyāṃ putrān mahābalān || 5 ||
anantaṃ vāsukiṃ caiva kambalaṃ ca mahābalam |
karkoṭakaṃ ca rājendra padmaṃ cānyaṃ sarīsṛpam || 6 ||
mahāpadmaṃ tathā śaṅkhaṃ kulikaṃ cāparājitam |
ete kaśyapadāyādāḥ pradhānāḥ parikīrttitāḥ || 7 ||
eteṣāṃ tu prasūtyā tu idamāpūritaṃ jagat |
kuṭilā hīnakarmāṇastīkṣṇāsyotthaviṣolbaṇāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā saṃdaśya manujān kuryurbhasma kṣaṇād dhruvam || 8 ||
śabdagāmī yathā sparśaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ narādhipa |
ahanyahani jāyeta kṣayaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ || 9 ||
ātmanastu kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā prajāḥ sarvāḥ samantataḥ |
jagmuḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ paraṃ tu parameśvaram || 10 ||
imamevārthamuddiśya prajāḥ sarvā mahīpate |
ūcuḥ kamalajaṃ viṣṇuṃ purāṇaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam || 11 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
devadeveśa lokānāṃ prasūti parameśvara |
trāhi nastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ bhujaṃgānāṃ mahātmanām || 12 ||
ahanyahani ye deva paśyeyururagā dṛśā |
manuṣyapaśurūpaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ bhasmasād bhavet || 13 ||
tvayā sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā deva nīyate sā bhujaṃgāmaiḥ |
etajjñātvā tu durvṛttaṃ tatkuruṣva mahāmate || 14 ||
brahmovāca |
ahaṃ rakṣāṃ vidhāsyāmi bhavatīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
vrajadhvaṃ svāni dhiṣṇyāni prajā mābhūt sasādhvasā || 15 ||
evamuktvā prajāstena brahmaṇā'vyaktamūrttinā |
ājagmuḥ paramaprītyā natvā caiva svayaṃbhuve || 16 ||
āgatāsu prajāsvādyastānāhūya bhujaṃgamān |
śaśāpa paramakruddho vāsukipramukhāṃstadā || 17 ||
brahmovāca |
yato matprabhavān nityaṃ kṣayaṃ nayata mānuṣān |
bhavāntare athānyasmin mātuḥ śāpāt sudāruṇāt |
bhavitā'tikṣayaṃ ghoraṃ nūnaṃ svāyaṃbhuve'ntare || 18 ||
evamuktāstu vepanto brahmāṇaṃ bhujagottamāḥ |
nipatya pādayostasya idamūcurvacastadā || 19 ||
nāgā ūcuḥ |
bhagavan kuṭilā jātirasmākaṃ bhavatā kṛtā |
viṣolbaṇatvaṃ krūratvaṃ dṛkśastratvaṃ ca nastvayā |
saṃpāditaṃ tvayā deva idānīṃ śamayācyuta || 20 ||
brahmovāca |
yadi nāma mayā sṛṣṭā bhavantaḥ kuṭilāśayāḥ |
tataḥ kiṃ manujān nityaṃ bhakṣayadhvaṃ gatavyathāḥ || 21 ||
nāgā ūcuḥ |
maryādāṃ kuru deveśa sthānaṃ caiva pṛthak pṛthak |
manuṣyāṇāṃ tathā'smākaṃ samayaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak |
nāgānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā devo vacanamabravīt || 22 ||
ahaṃ karomi vo nāgāḥ samayaṃ manujaiḥ saha |
tadekamanasaḥ sarve śrṛṇudhvaṃ mama śāsanam || 23 ||
pātālaṃ vitalaṃ caiva harmyākhyaṃ ca tṛtīyakam |
dattaṃ caiva sadā ramyaṃ gṛhaṃ tatra gamiṣyatha || 24 ||
tatra bhogān bahuvidhān bhuñjānā mama śāsanāt |
tiṣṭhadhvaṃ saptamaṃ yāvad rātryantaṃ tu punaḥ punaḥ || 25 ||
tato vaivasvatasyādau kāśyapeyā bhaviṣyatha |
dāyādāḥ sarvadevānāṃ suparṇasya ca dhīmataḥ || 26 ||
tadā prasūtirvaḥ sarvā bhokṣyate citrabhānunā |
bhavatāṃ naiva doṣo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 27 ||
ye vai krūrā bhogino durvinītāsteṣāmanto bhavitā nānyathaitat |
kālaprāptaṃ bhakṣayadhvaṃ daśadhvaṃ tathā'pakāre ca kṛte manuṣyam || 28 ||
mantrauṣadhairgāruḍamaṇḍalaiśca baddhairdṛṣṭairmānavā ye caranti |
teṣāṃ bhītairvarttitavyaṃ na cānyaccintyaṃ kāryaṃ cānyathā vo vināśaḥ || 29 ||
itīrite brahmaṇā te bhujaṅgā
jagmuḥ sthānaṃ kṣmātalākhyaṃ hi sarve |
tasthurbhogān bhuñjamānāḥ samagrān
rasātale līlayā saṃsthitāste || 30 ||
evaṃ śāpaṃ tu te labdhvā prasādaṃ ca caturmukhāt |
tasthuḥ pātālanilaye muditenāntarātmanā || 31 ||
etat sarvaṃ ca pañcamyāṃ teṣāṃ jātaṃ mahātmanām |
atastviyaṃ tithirdhanyā sarvapāpaharā śubhā || 32 ||
etasyāṃ saṃyato yastu amlaṃ tu parivarjayet |
kṣīreṇa snāpayennāgāṃstasya yāsyanti mitratām || 33 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre caturviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
ahaṃkārāt kathaṃ jajñe kārttikeyo dvijottama |
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi pṛcchato vai mahāmune || 1 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
sarveṣāmeva tattvānāṃ yaḥ paraḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tasmādavyaktamutpannaṃ tattvādi trividhaṃ tu tat || 2 ||
puruṣāvyaktayormadhye mahattvaṃ samapadyata |
sa cāhaṃkāra ityukto yo mahān samudāhṛtaḥ || 3 ||
puruṣo viṣṇurityuktaḥ śivo vā nāmataḥ smṛtaḥ |
avyaktaṃ tu umā devī śrīrvā padmanibhekṣaṇā || 4 ||
tatsaṃyogādahaṃkāraḥ sa ca senāpatirguhaḥ |
tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śrṛṇu rājan mahāmate || 5 ||
ādyo nārāyaṇo devastasmād brahmā tato'bhavat |
ataḥ svayaṃbhuvaścānye marīcyādyārkasaṃbhavāḥ || 6 ||
teṣvārabhya surā daityā gandharvā mānuṣāḥ khagāḥ |
paśavaḥ sarvabhūtāni sṛṣṭireṣā prakīrtitā || 7 ||
sṛṣṭyāṃ vistāritāyāṃ tu devadaityā mahābalāḥ |
sāpatnyaṃ bhāvamāsthāya yuyudhurvijigīṣavaḥ || 8 ||
daityānāṃ balinaḥ santi nāyakā yuddhadurmadāḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipuḥ pūrvaṃ hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ |
vipracittirvicittiśca bhīmākṣaḥ krauñca eva ca || 9 ||
ete'tibalinaḥ śūrā devasainyaṃ mahāmṛdhe |
anārataṃ sitairbāṇairjayante'nudinaṃ mṛdhe || 10 ||
teṣāṃ parājayaṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ tu bṛhaspatiḥ |
uvāca hīnaṃ vaḥ sainyaṃ nāyakena vinā surāḥ || 11 ||
ekenendreṇa divyaṃ tu sainyaṃ pātuṃ na śakyate |
ataḥ senāpatiṃ kiñcidanveṣayata māciram || 12 ||
evamuktāstato devā jagmurlokapitāmaham |
senāpatiṃ ca no dehi vākyamūcuḥ sasaṃbhramam || 13 ||
tato dadhyau caturvaktraḥ kimeṣāṃ kriyate mayā |
brahmā'tha cintayāmāsa rudraṃ prati manogatam || 14 ||
tato devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ |
brahmāṇaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā jagmuḥ kailāsaparvatam || 15 ||
tatra dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ śivaṃ paśupatiṃ vibhum |
tuṣṭavurvividhaistotraiḥ śakrādyāstridivaukasaḥ || 16 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
namāma sarve śaraṇārthino vayaṃ
maheśvaraṃ tryambakabhūtabhāvanam |
umāpate viśvapate marutpate
jagatpate śaṃkara pāhi naḥ svayam || 17 ||
jaṭākalāpāgraśaśāṅkadīdhitiprakāśitāśeṣajagattrayāmala |
triśūlapāṇe puruṣottamācyuta prapāhi daityācca jagattrayodare || 18 ||
tvamādidevaḥ puruṣottamo harirbhavo maheśastripurāntako vibhuḥ |
bhagākṣihā daityaripuḥ purātano vṛṣadhvajaḥ pāhi surottamottama || 19 ||
girīśajānātha giripriyāpriya
prabho samastāmaralokapūjita |
gaṇeśa bhūteśa śivākṣayāvyaya
prapāhi no daityavarāntakācyuta || 20 ||
pṛthvyāditattveṣu bhavān pratiṣṭhito
dhvanisvarūpo gagane viśeṣataḥ |
vāyau dvidhā tejasi ca tridhā jale
catuḥ kṣitau pañcaguṇaḥ prapāhi naḥ || 21 ||
agnisvarūpo'si tarau tathopale
sattvasvarūpo'si tathā jaleṣvapi |
tejaḥsvarūpo bhagavān maheśvaraḥ
prapāhi no daityagaṇārditān hara || 22 ||
nāsīdyadā'kāṇḍamidaṃ trilocana
prabhākarendradraviṇādhipāḥ kutaḥ |
tadā bhavāneva viruddhalocana
pramāṇabādhādivivarjitaḥ sthitaḥ || 23 ||
kapālamālin śaśikhaṇḍaśekhara
śmaśānavāsin sitabhasmaguṇṭhita |
phaṇīndrasaṃvītatano'ntakāpaha
prapāhi no dakṣadhiyā sureśvara || 24 ||
bhavān pumān śaktiriyaṃ gireḥ sutā
sarvāṅgarūpā bhagavaṃstathā tvayi |
triśūlarūpeṇa jagattrayaṃ kare
sthitaṃ trinetreṣu makhāgnayastrayaḥ || 25 ||
jaṭāsvarūpeṇa samastasāgarāḥ
kulācalāḥ sindhuvahāśca sarvaśaḥ |
śaśī paraṃ jñānamidaṃ tava sthitaṃ
na deva paśyanti kudṛṣṭayo janāḥ || 26 ||
nārāyaṇastvaṃ jagatāṃ samudbhavastathā bhavaḥ saiva caturmukho bhavān |
sattvādibhedena tathāgnibhedato yugādibhedena ca saṃsthitastridhā || 27 ||
bhavantamete suranāyakāḥ prabho
bhavārthino'nyasya vadanti toṣayan |
yatastato no bhava bhūtibhūṣaṇa
prapāhi viśveśvara rudra te namaḥ || 28 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
evaṃ stutastadā devo rudraḥ paśupatiḥ suraiḥ |
uvāca devānavyagraḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ brūta mā ciram || 29 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
senāpatiṃ no deveśa dehi daityavadhāya vai |
devānāṃ brahmamukhyānāmetadeva hitaṃ bhavet || 30 ||
rudra uvāca |
dadāmi senānāthaṃ vo devā bhavata vijvarāḥ |
bhaviṣyamasti paurāṇaṃ yogādīnāmacintayan || 31 ||
evamuktvā haro devān visṛjya svāṅgasaṃsthitām |
śaktiṃ saṃkṣobhayāmāsa putrahetoḥ paraṃtapa || 32 ||
tasya kṣobhayataḥ śaktiṃ jvalanārkasamaprabhaḥ |
kumāraḥ sahajāṃ śaktiṃ bibhrajjñānaikaśālinīm || 33 ||
utpattistasya rājendra bahurūpā vyavasthitā |
manvantareṣvanekeṣu devasenāpatiḥ kila || 34 ||
yo'sau śarīrago devaḥ ahaṃkāreti kīrttitaḥ |
prayojanavaśād devaḥ saiva senāpatirvibho || 35 ||
tasmin jāte svayaṃ brahmā sarvadaivaiḥ samanvitaḥ |
pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ śivaṃ paśupatiṃ tadā || 36 ||
sarvaiśca devai ṛṣibhiśca siddhaiḥ
senāpatirvaradānena tena |
āpyāyitaḥ so'pi surānuvāca
sakhāyārthaṃ kraḍane kāryameva || 37 ||
śrutvā vacastasy mahānubhāvo
mahādevo vākyamidaṃ jagāda |
dadāmi te krīḍanakaṃ tu kukkuṭaṃ
tathānugau śākhaviśākhasaṃjñau |
kumāra bhūtagrahanāyako bhavān
bhavasva deveśvara senayāpatiḥ || 38 ||
evamuktvā tato devaḥ sarve devāśca pārthiva |
tuṣṭuvurvāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ skandaṃ senāpatiṃ tadā || 39 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
bhavasva devasenānīrmaheśvarasuta prabho |
ṣaṇmukha skanda viśveśa kukkuṭadhvaja pāvake || 40 ||
kampitāre kumāreśa skanda bālagrahānuga |
jitāre krauñcavidhvaṃsa kṛttikāsuta mātṛja || 41 ||
bhūtagrahapatiśreṣṭha pāvaki priyadarśana |
mahābhūtapateḥ putra trilocana namo'stu te || 42 ||
evaṃ stutastadā devairvavardha bhavanandanaḥ |
dvādaśādityasaṃkāśo babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ |
trailokyamapi tattejastāpayāmāsa pārthiva || 43 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
kathaṃ taṃ kṛtrikāputramuktavantaḥ suraṃ gurum |
kathaṃ ca pāvakirasau kathaṃ vā mātṛnandanaḥ || 44 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
ādimanvantare deva utpattiryā mayoditā |
parokṣadarśibhirdevairevameva stutaḥ prabhuḥ || 45 ||
kṛttikā pāvakastvanyamātaro girijā tathā |
dvijīyajanmani guhasyaite utpattihetavaḥ || 46 ||
evametat tavākhyātaṃ pṛcchataḥ pārthivottama |
ātmavidyā'mṛtaṃ guhyamahaṃkārasya saṃbhavaḥ || 47 ||
svayaṃ skando mahādevaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ |
tasya ṣaṣṭhīṃ tithiṃ prādādabhiṣeke pitāmahaḥ || 48 ||
etāṃ phalāśano yastu kṣayenniyatamānasaḥ |
aputro'pi labhet putrānadhano'pi dhanaṃ labhet |
yaṃ yamiccheta manasā taṃ taṃ labhati mānavaḥ || 49 ||
yaścaitat paṭhati stotraṃ kārtikeyasya mānavaḥ |
tasya gehe kumārāṇāṃ kṣemārogyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 50 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
śarīrasya kathaṃ mūrtigrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣo dvija |
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi praṇatasya dvijottama || 1 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
yo'sāvātmā jñānaśaktireka eva sanātanaḥ |
sa dvitīyaṃ yadā caicchat tadā svātmasthito jvalat || 2 ||
yaḥ sūrya iti bhāsvāṃstu anyonyena mahātmanaḥ |
lolībhūtāni tejāṃsi bhāsayanti jagattrayam || 3 ||
tasmin sarve surāḥ siddhā gaṇāḥ sarve maharṣibhiḥ |
samaṃ sūtā iti vibho tasmāt sūryo bhavan stutaḥ || 4 ||
lolībhūtasya tasyāśu tejaso'bhūccharīrakam |
pṛthaktvena raviḥ so'tha kīrttyate vedavādibhiḥ || 5 ||
bhāsayan sarvalokāṃstu yato'sāvutthito divi |
ato'sau bhāskaraḥ proktaḥ prakarṣācca prabhākaraḥ || 6 ||
divā divasa ityuktastatkāritvād divākaraḥ |
sarvasya jagatastvādirādityastena ucyate || 7 ||
etasya dvādaśādityāḥ saṃbhūtāstejasā pṛthak |
pradhāna eva sarveṣāṃ sarvadā sa vibudhyate || 8 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagato vyāptiṃ kurvāṇaṃ parameśvaram |
tasyaivāntaḥ sthitā devā viniṣkramya stutiṃ jaguḥ || 9 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
bhavān prasūtirjagataḥ purāṇaḥ
kṣayāmalaiva pradahan jaganti |
samutthito nātha śamaṃ prayāhi
mā devalokān pluṣa karmasākṣin || 10 ||
tvayā tataṃ sarvata eva tejaḥ
pratāpinā sūrya yajuḥpravṛtte |
tigmaṃ rathāṅgaṃ tava devakalpaṃ
kālākhyamadhvāntakaraṃ vadanti || 11 ||
prabhākarasaktvaṃ ravirādideva
ātmā samastasya carācarasya |
pitāmahasaktvaṃ varuṇo yamaśca
bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca vadanti siddhāḥ || 12 ||
dhvāntaṃ praṇu tvaṃ suralokapūjya
prayāhi śāntiṃ pitaro vadanti |
vedāntavedyo'si makheṣu deva
tvaṃ hūyase viṣṇurasi prasahya |
iti stutastaiḥ suranātha bhaktyā
prapāhi śaṃbho na iti prasahya || 13 ||
evamuktastadā devaiḥ saumyāṃ mūrttimathākarot |
prakāśatvaṃ jagāmāśu devatānāṃ mahāprabhaḥ || 14 ||
etatsarvaṃ surāṇāṃ tu dahanaṃ śāmitaṃ purā |
saptamyāṃ khalu sūryeṇa mūrttitvaṃ kṛtavān bhuvi || 15 ||
etāṃ yaḥ puruṣo bhaktyā upāste sūryamarcayet |
bhāskareṇa ca tasyāsau phalamiṣṭaṃ prayacchati || 16 ||
etat te kathitaṃ rājan sūryākhyānaṃ purātanam |
ādimanvantare vṛttaṃ mātaraḥ śrṛṇu sāṃpratam || 17 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
pūrvamāsīnmahādaityo balavānandhako bhuvi |
sa devān vaśamāninye brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ || 1 ||
tenātmavān surāḥ sarve tyājitā meruparvatam |
brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurandhakasya bhayārditāḥ || 2 ||
tānāgatāṃstadā brahmā uvāca surasattamān |
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ vo devā brūta kimāsyate || 3 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
andhakenārditāḥ sarve vayaṃ devā jagatpate |
trāhi sarvāṃścaturvaktra pitāmaha namo'stu te || 4 ||
brahmovāca |
andhakānnaiva śakto'haṃ trātuṃ vai surasattamāḥ |
bhavaṃ śarvaṃ mahādevaṃ vrajāma śaraṇārthinaḥ || 5 ||
kintu pūrvaṃ mayā datto varastasya surottamāḥ |
avadhyastvaṃ hi bhavitā na śarīraṃ spṛśenmahīm || 6 ||
tasyaivaṃ balinastveko hantā rudraḥ paraṃtapaḥ |
tatra gacchāmahe sarve kailāsanilayaṃ prabhum || 7 ||
evamuktvā yayau brahmā sadevo bhavasannidhau |
tasya saṃdarśanād rudraḥ pratyutthānādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
kṛtvābhyuvāca deveśo brahmāṇaṃ bhuvaneśvaram || 8 ||
śaṃbhuruvāca |
kiṃ kāryaṃ devatāḥ sarvā āgatā mama sannidhau |
yenāhaṃ tatkaromyāśu ājñā kāryā hi satvaram || 9 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
rakṣasva deva balinastvandhakād duṣṭacetasaḥ || 10 ||
yāvadevaṃ surā sarve śaṃsanti parameṣṭhinaḥ |
tāvat sainyena mahatā tatraivāndhaka āyayau || 11 ||
balena caturaṅgeṇa hantukāmo bhavaṃ mṛdhe |
tasya bhāryāṃ girisutāṃ hartumicchan sasādhanaḥ || 12 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā'yāntaṃ devaśakraprahāriṇam |
sannahya sahasā devā rudrasyānucarā bhavan || 13 ||
rudro'pi vāsukiṃ dhyātvā takṣakaṃ ca dhanaṃjayam |
valayaṃ kaṭiṃsūtraṃ ca cakāra parameśvaraḥ || 14 ||
nīlanāmā ca daityendro hastī bhūtvā bhavāntikam |
āgatastvaritaḥ śakrahastīvoddhatarūpavān || 15 ||
sa jñāto nandinā daityo vīrabhadrāya darśitaḥ |
vīrabhadro'pi siṃhena rūpeṇāhatya ca drutam || 16 ||
tasya kṛttiṃ vidāryāśu kariṇastvañjanaprabhām |
rudrāyārpitavān so'pi tamevāmbaramākarot |
tataḥ prabhṛti rudro'pi gajacarmapaṭo'bhavat || 17 ||
gajacarmmapaṭo bhūtvā bhujaṃgābharaṇojjvalaḥ |
ādāya triśikhaṃ bhīmaṃ sagaṇo'ndhakamanvayāt || 18 ||
tataḥ pravṛtte yuddhe ca devadānavayormahat |
indrādyā lokapālāstu skandaḥ senāpatistathā |
sarve devagaṇāścānye yuyudhuḥ samare tadā || 19 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradā yuddhaṃ yayau nārāyaṇaṃ prati |
śaśaṃsa ca mahad yuddhaṃ kailāse dānavaiḥ saha || 20 ||
tacchrutvā cakramādāya garuḍastho janārdanaḥ |
tameva deśamāgatya yuyudhe dānavaiḥ saha || 21 ||
āgatya ca tato devā hariṇāpyāyitā raṇe |
viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve palāyanaparā bhavan || 22 ||
tatra bhagneṣu deveṣu svayaṃ rudro'ndhakaṃ yayau |
tatra tena mahadyuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam || 23 ||
tatra devo'pyasau daityaṃ triśūlenāhanad bhṛśam |
tasyāhatasya yad raktamapatad bhūtale kila |
tatrāndhakā asaṃkhyātā babhūvurapare bhṛśam || 24 ||
tad dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ rudro śūle'ndhakaṃ mṛdhe |
gṛhītvā triśikhāgreṇa nanartta parameśvaraḥ || 25 ||
itare'pyandhakāḥ sarve cakreṇa parameṣṭhinā |
nārāyaṇena nihatāstatra ye'nye samutthitāḥ | 26 ||
asṛgdhārātuṣāraistu śūlaprotasya cāsakṛt |
anārataṃ samuttasthustato rudro ruṣānvitaḥ || 27 ||
tasya krodhena mahatā mukhājjvālā viniryayau |
tadrūpadhāriṇī devī yāṃ tāṃ yogeśvarīṃ viduḥ || 28 ||
svarūpadhāriṇī cānyā viṣṇunāpi vinirmitā |
brahmaṇā kārtikeyena indreṇa ca yamena ca |
varāheṇa ca devena viṣṇunā parameṣṭhinā || 29 ||
pātāloddharaṇaṃ rūpaṃ tasyā devyā vinirmame |
māheśvarī ca rājendra ityetā aṣṭamārataḥ || 30 ||
kāraṇaṃ tāni yatproktaṃ kṣetrajñenāvadhāraṇam |
śarīrād devatānāṃ tu tadidaṃ kīrtitaṃ mayā || 31 ||
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho mado moho'tha pañcamaḥ |
mātsaryaṃ ṣaṣṭhamityāhuḥ paiśunyaṃ saptamaṃ tathā |
asūyā cā'ṣṭamī jñeyā ityetā aṣṭamātaraḥ || 32 ||
kāmaṃ yogeśvarīṃ viddhi krodho māheśvarīṃ tathā |
lobhastu vaiṣṇavī proktā brahmāṇī mada eva ca || 33 ||
mohaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ kaumārī mātsaryaṃ cendrajaṃ viduḥ |
yamadaṇḍadharā devī paiśunyaṃ svayameva ca |
asūyā ca varāhākhyā ityetāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 34 ||
kāmādigaṇa eṣo'yaṃ śarīre parikīrtitaḥ |
jagrāha mūrttiṃ tu yathā tathā te kīrtitaṃ mayā || 35 ||
etābhirdevatābhiśca tasya rakte'tiśoṣite |
kṣayaṃ gatā''surī māyā sa ca siddho'ndhako'bhavat |
etat te sarvamākhyātamātmavidyā'mṛtaṃ mayā || 36 ||
ya etacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ mātṝṇāmudbhavaṃ śubham |
tasya tāḥ sarvato rakṣāṃ kurvantyanudinaṃ nṛpa || 37 ||

tasya tāḥ parituṣṭāstu kṣemārogyaṃ dadanti ca || 39 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
kathaṃ māyā samutpannā durgā kātyāyanī śubhā |
ādikṣetre sthitā sūkṣmā pṛthagmūrttā vyajāyata || 1 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
āsīd rājā purā rājan sindhudvīpaḥ pratāpavān |
varuṇāṃśo mahārāja so'raṇye tapasi sthitaḥ || 2 ||
putro me śakranāśāya bhavediti nāradhipaḥ |
evaṃ kṛtamatiḥ so'tha mahatā tapasā svakam |
kalevaraṃ sthito bhūtvā śoṣayāmāsa suvrata || 3 ||
prajāpāla uvāca |
kathaṃ tasya dvijaśreṣṭha śakreṇāpakṛtaṃ bhavet |
yenāsau tadvināśāya putramicchan vrate sthitaḥ || 4 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
so'nyajanmani putro'bhūt tvaṣṭurbalabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
avadhyaḥ sarvaśastreṣu apāṃ phenena nāśitaḥ || 5 ||
jalaphenena nihatastasmim̐llayamavāpnuyāt |

vetravatyudare jāto nāmnā vaitrāsuro'bhavat |
balavānatitejasvī prāgjyotiṣapatirbhavat || 12 ||

mahāyogena saṃyukto jigāyemāṃ vasuṃdharām || 13 ||
saptadvīpavatīṃ paścānmeruparvatamāruhat |
tatrendraṃ prathamaṃ jigye paścādagniṃ yamaṃ tataḥ |
nirṛtiṃ varuṇaṃ vāyuṃ dhanadaśceśvaraṃ tataḥ || 14 ||

yamo nirṛtimāgacchannirṛtirvaruṇaṃ yayau || 15 ||
indrādibhirupetastu varuṇo vāyumanvagāt |

iyāya gadayā so'pi dānavo baladarpitaḥ |
gadāmādāya dudrāva śivalokaṃ prati prabho || 17 ||
śivo'pyavadhyaṃ taṃ matvā devān guhya yayau purīm |
brahmaṇaḥ surasiddhādyairvanditāṃ puṇyakāribhiḥ || 18 ||
tatra brahmā jagatstraṣṭā viṣṇupādodbhave jale |
niyāmitākāśagato japatyantarjale śubhe |
kṣetrajñamāyāṃ gāyatrīṃ tato devā vicukruśuḥ || 19 ||
trāhi prajāpate sarvān devānṛṣivarānapi |
asurādbhayamāpannān trāhi trāhītyacodayan || 20 ||
evamuktastadā brahmā dṛṣṭvā devāṃstadāgatān |
cintayāmāsa devasya māyeyaṃ vitataṃ jagat |
nāsurā na surāścātra māyeyaṃ kīdṛśī matā || 21 ||
evaṃ cintayatastasya prādurāsīdayonijā |
śuklāmbaradharā kanyā strakkirīṭojjvalānanā |
aṣṭabhirbāhubhiryuktā divyapraharaṇodyatā || 22 ||
cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ gadāṃ pāśaṃ khaṅgaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ tathā dhanuḥ |
dhārayantī tathā cānyān baddhatūṇā jalād bahiḥ || 23 ||
niścakrāma mahādevī siṃhavāhanavegitā |
yuyudhe cāsurān sarvānekaiva bahudhā sthitā || 24 ||
divyaṃ varṣasahastraṃ tu divyairastrairmahābalam |
yuddhvā kālātyaye devyā hato vaitrāsuro raṇe |
tataḥ kilakilāśabdo devasainye'bhavanmahān || 25 ||
hate vaitrāsure bhīme tadā sarve divaukasaḥ |
praṇemurjaya yuddheti svayamīśaḥ stutiṃ jagau || 26 ||
maheśvara uvāca |
jayasva devi gāyatre mahāmāye mahāprabhe |
mahādevi mahābhāge mahāsattve mahotsave || 27 ||
divyagandhānuliptāṅgi divyastragdāmabhūṣite |
vedamātarnamastubhyaṃ tryakṣarasthe maheśvari || 28 ||
trilokasthe tritattvasthe trivahnisthe triśūlini |
trinetre bhīmavaktre ca bhīmanetre bhayānake |
kamalāsanaje devi sarasvati namo'stu te || 29 ||
namaḥ paṅkajapatrākṣi mahāmāye'mṛtastrave |
sarvage sarvabhūteśi svāhākāre svadhe'mbike || 30 ||
saṃpūrṇe pūrṇacandrābhe bhāsvarāṅge bhavodbhave |
mahāvidye mahāvedye mahādaityavināśini |
mahābuddhyudbhave devi vītaśoke kirātini || 31 ||
tvaṃ nītistvaṃ mahābhāge tvaṃ gīstvaṃ gaustvamakṣaram |
tvaṃ dhīstvaṃ śrīstvamoṅkārastattve cāpi paristhitā |
sarvasattvāhite devi namaste parameśvari || 32 ||
ityevaṃ saṃstutā devī bhavena parameṣṭhinā |
devairapi jayetyuccairityuktā parameśvarī || 33 ||
yāvadāste caturvaktrastāvadantarjalād bahiḥ |
niścakrāma tato devīṃ kṛtakṛtyāṃ dadarśa saḥ || 34 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devakāryaṃ ca siddhaṃ matvā pitāmahaḥ |
bhaviṣyaṃ kāryamuddiśya tato vacanamabravīt || 35 ||
brahmovāca |
iyaṃ devī varārohā yātu śailaṃ himodbhavam |
tatra yūyaṃ surāḥ sarve gatvā nandata māciram || 36 ||
navamyāṃ ca sadā pūjyā iyaṃ devī samādhinā |
varadā sarvalokānāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 37 ||
navamyāṃ yaśca piṣṭāśī bhaviṣyati hi mānavaḥ |
nārī vā tasya saṃpannaṃ bhaviṣyati manogatam || 38 ||
yaśca sāyaṃ tathā prātaridaṃ stotraṃ paṭhiṣyati |
tvayeritaṃ mahādeva tasya devyā samaṃ bhavān || 39 ||
varado deva sarvāsu āpatsvapyuddharasva tam |
evamuktvā bhavaṃ brahmā punardevīṃ sa cābravīt || 40 ||
tvayā devi mahatkāryaṃ kartavyaṃ cānyadasti naḥ |
bhaviṣyaṃ mahiṣākhyasya asurasya vināśanam || 41 ||
evamuktvā tato brahmā sarve devāśca pārthiva |
yathāgataṃ tato jagmurddevīṃ sthāpya hime girau |
saṃsthāpya nanditā yasmāt tasmānnandā'bhavat tu sā || 42 ||
yaścedaṃ śrṛṇuyājjanma devyā yaśca svayaṃ paṭhet |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati || 43 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
śrṛṇu rājannavahitaḥ prajāpāla kathāmimām |
yadā diśaḥ samutpannāḥ śrotrebhyaḥ pṛthivīpate || 1 ||
brahmaṇaḥ sṛjataḥ sṛṣṭimādisarge samutthite |
cintābhūnmahatī ko me prajāḥ sṛṣṭā dhariṣyati || 2 ||
evaṃ cintayatastasya avakāśaṃ prajāsviha |
prādurbabhūvuḥ śrotrebhyaḥ daśa kanyā mahāprabhāḥ || 3 ||
pūrvā ca dakṣiṇā caiva pratīcī cottarā tathā |
ūrdhvā'dharā ca ṣaṇmukhyāḥ kanyā hyāsaṃstadā nṛpa || 4 ||
anyāścatastrasteṣāṃ tu kanyāḥ paramaśobhanāḥ |
rūpasvinyo mahābhāgā gāmbhīryeṇa samanvitāḥ || 5 ||
tā ūcuḥ praṇayād devaṃ prajāpatimakalmaṣam |
avakāśaṃ tu no dehi devadeva prajāpate || 6 ||
yatra tiṣṭhāmahe sarvā bhartṛbhiḥ sahitāḥ sukham |
patayaśca mahābhāgā dehi no'vyaktasaṃbhava || 7 ||
brahmovāca |
brahmāṇḍametat suśroṇyaḥ śatakoṭipravistaram |
tasyānte svecchayā bhadrā uṣyatāṃ mā vilambata || 8 ||
bhartṝṃśca vaḥ prayacchāmi sṛṣṭvā rūpasvino'naghāḥ |
yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ deśo yasyā yo rocate'dhunā || 9 ||
evamuktāśca tāḥ sarvā yatheṣṭaṃ prayayustadā |
brahmāpi sasṛje tūrṇaṃ lokapālān mahābalān || 10 ||
sṛṣṭvā tu lokapālāṃstu tāḥ kanyāḥ punarāhvayat |
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 11 ||
ekāmindrāya sa prādādagnaye'nyāṃ yamāya ca |
nirṛtāya ca devāya varuṇāya mahātmane || 12 ||
vāyave dhanadeśāya īśānāya ca suvrata |
ūdrdhvāṃ svayamadhiṣṭhāya śeṣāyādho vyavasthitām || 13 ||
evaṃ dattvā punarbrahmā tithiṃ prādād diśāṃ punaḥ |
daśamīṃ bhartṛnāmnastu dadhyannaṃ bhojanaṃ prabhuḥ || 14 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tā devyaḥ sendrādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
daśamī ca tithistāsāmatīva dayitābhavat || 15 ||
tasyāṃ dadhyāśano yastu suvratī bhavate naraḥ |
tasya pāpakṣayaṃ tāstu kurvantyaharaharnṛpa || 16 ||
yaścaitacchṛṇuyājjanma diśāṃ niyatamānasaḥ |
sa pratiṣṭhāmavāpnoti brahmaloke na saṃśayaḥ || 17 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
śrṛṇu cānyāṃ vasupaterutpattiṃ pāpanāśinīm |
yathā vāyuḥ śarīrastho dhanadaḥ saṃbabhūva ha || 1 ||
ādyaṃ śarīraṃ yat tasmin vāyurantaḥ sthito'bhavat |
prayojanānmūrttimattvamādiṣṭaṃ kṣetradevatā || 2 ||
tatra mūrttasya vāyostu utpattiḥ kīrttyaye mayā |
tāṃ śrṛṇuṣva mahābhāga kathyamānāṃ mayānagha || 3 ||
brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭikāmasya mukhād vāyurviniryayau |
pracaṇḍaśarkarāvarṣī taṃ brahmā pratyaṣedhayat |
mūrtto bhavasva śāntaśca tatrokto mūrttimān bhavat || 4 ||
sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ yad vittaṃ phalameva ca |
tatsarvaṃ pāhi yenoktaṃ tasmād dhanapatirbhavat || 5 ||
tasya brahmā dadau tuṣṭastithimekādaśīṃ prabhuḥ |
tasyāmanagnipakvāśī yo bhavenniyataḥ śuciḥ || 6 ||
tasyāśu dhanado devastuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ prayacchati |
eṣā dhanapatermūrtiḥ sarvakilbiṣanāśinī || 7 ||
ya etāṃ śrṛṇuyād bhaktyā puruṣaḥ paṭhate'pi vā |
sarvakāmamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati || 8 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
manornāma manutvaṃ ca yadetat paṭhyate kila |
prayojanavaśād viṣṇurasāveva tu mūrttimān || 1 ||
yo'sau nārāyaṇo devaḥ parāt parataro nṛpa |
tasya cintā samutpannā sṛṣṭiṃ prati narottama || 2 ||
sṛṣṭā ceyaṃ mayā sṛṣṭiḥ pālanīyā mayaiva ha |
karmakāṇḍaṃ tvamūrttena kartuṃ naiveha śakyate |
tasmānmūrttiṃ sṛjāmyekāṃ yayā pālyamidaṃ jagat || 3 ||
evaṃ cintayatastasya satyābhidhyāyino nṛpa |
prāksṛṣṭijātaṃ rājan vai mūrttimat tatpuro babhau || 4 ||
purobhūte tatastasmin devo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
praviśantaṃ dadarśātha trailokyaṃ tasya dehataḥ || 5 ||
tataḥ sasmāra bhagavān varadānaṃ purātanam |
vāgādīnāṃ tatastuṣṭaḥ prādāt tasya punarvaram || 6 ||
sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā tvaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ |
trailokyaviśanācca tvaṃ bhava viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ || 7 ||
devānāṃ sarvadā kāryaṃ karttavyaṃ brahmaṇastathā |
sarvajñatvaṃ ca bhavatu tava deva na saṃśayaḥ || 8 ||
evamuktvā tato devaḥ prakṛtistho babhūva ha |
viṣṇurapyadhunā pūrvāṃ buddhiṃ sasmāra ca prabhuḥ || 9 ||
tadā saṃcintya bhagavān yoganidrāṃ mahātapāḥ |
tasyāṃ saṃsthāpya bhagavānindriyārthodbhavāḥ prajāḥ |
dhyātvā pareṇa rūpeṇa tataḥ suṣvāpa vai prabhuḥ || 10 ||
tasya suptasya jaṭharānmahatpadmaṃ viviḥsṛtam |
saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī sasamudrā sakānanā || 11 ||
tasya rūpasya vistāraṃ pātālaṃ nālasaṃsthitam |
karṇikāyāṃ tathā merustanmadhye brahmaṇo bhavaḥ || 12 ||
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ tasya śarīrasya tu saṃbhavam |
mumuce taccharīrastho vāyurvāyuṃ samaṃ sṛjat || 13 ||
avidyāvijayaṃ cemaṃ śaṅkharūpeṇa dhāraya |
ajñānacchedanārthāya khaṅgaṃ te'stu sadā kare || 14 ||
kālacakramimaṃ ghoraṃ cakraṃ tvaṃ dhārayācyuta |
adharmagajaghātārthaṃ gadāṃ dhāraya keśava || 15 ||
māleyaṃ bhūtamātā te kaṇṭhe tiṣṭhatu sarvadā |
śrīvatsakaustubhau cemau candrādityacchalena ha || 16 ||
mārutaste gatirvīra garutmān sa ca kīrttitaḥ |
trailokyagāminī devī lakṣmīste'stu sadāśraye |
dvādaśī ca tithiste'stu kāmarūpī ca jāyate || 17 ||
ghṛtāśano bhavedyastu dvādaśyāṃ tvalparāyaṇaḥ |
sa svargavāsī bhavatu pumān strī vā viśeṣataḥ || 18 ||
eṣa viṣṇustavākhyāto mūrtayo devadānavān |
hanti pāti śarīrāṇi sṛjatyanyāni cātmanaḥ || 19 ||
yuge yuge sarvago'yaṃ vedānte puruṣo hyasau |
na hīnabuddhyā vaktavyo manuṣyo'yaṃ kadācana || 20 ||
ya evaṃ śrṛṇuyāt sargaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pāpanāśanam |
sa kīrtimiha saṃprāpya svargaloke mahīyate || 21 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||
pūrvaṃ brahmā'vyayaḥ śuddhaḥ parādaparasaṃjñitaḥ |
sa sisṛkṣuḥ prajāstvādau pālanaṃ ca vicintayat || 2 ||
tasya cintayatastvaṅgād dakṣiṇācchvetakuṇḍalaḥ |
prādurbabhūva puruṣaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ || 3 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvovāca bhagavāṃścatuṣpādaṃ vṛṣākṛtim |
pālayemāḥ prajāḥ sādho tvaṃ jyeṣṭho jagato bhava || 4 ||
ityuktaḥ samavastho'sau catuḥpadbhyāṃ kṛte yuge |
tretāyāṃ sa samastṛbhyāṃ dve caiva dvāpare'bhavat |
kalāvekena pādena prajāḥ pālayate prabhuḥ || 5 ||
ṣaḍbhedo brāhmaṇānāṃ sa tridhā kṣatre vyavasthitaḥ |
dvidhā vaiśyekadhā śūdre sthitaḥ sarvagataḥ prabhuḥ |
rasātaleṣu sarveṣu dvīpavarṣe svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 6 ||
dravyaguṇakriyājāticatuḥpādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
saṃhitāpadakramaścaiva triśrṛṅgo'sau smṛto budhaiḥ || 7 ||
tathā ādyanta oṅkāra dviśirāḥ saptahastavān |
tribaddhabaddho viprāṇāṃ mukhyaḥ pālayate jagat || 8 ||
sa dharmaḥ pīḍitaḥ pūrvaṃ somenādbhutakarmaṇa |
tārāṃ jighṛkṣatā patnīṃ bhrāturāṅgirasasya ha || 9 ||
so'pāyād bhīṣitastena balinā krūrakarmaṇā |
araṇyaṃ gahanaṃ ghoramāviveśa tadā prabhuḥ || 10 ||
tasmin gate surāḥ sarve asurāṇāṃ tu patnayaḥ |
jighṛkṣantastadaukāṃsi babhramurdharmavañcitāḥ |
asurā api tadvacca suraveśmani babhramuḥ || 11 ||
nirmaryāde tathā jāte dharmanāśe ca pārthiva |
devāsurā yuyudhire somadoṣeṇa kopitāḥ |
strīhetośca mahābhāga vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ || 12 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā yudhyato devānasuraiḥ saha kopitān |
nāradaḥ prāha saṃgamya pitre brahmaṇi harṣitaḥ || 13 ||
sa haṃsayānamāruhya sarvalokapitāmahaḥ |
nivārayāmāsa tadā kasyārthe yuddhamabravīt || 14 ||
sarve śaśaṃsuḥ somaṃ tu sa tu buddhvā svakaṃ sutam |
pīḍanādapayātaṃ tu gahanaṃ vanamāśritam || 15 ||
tato brahmā yayau tatra devāsurayutastvaran |
dadarśa ca suraiḥ sārddhaṃ catuṣpādaṃ vṛṣākṛtim |
carantaṃ śaśisaṅkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā devānuvāca ha || 16 ||
brahmā uvāca |
ayaṃ me prathamaḥ putraḥ pīḍitaḥ śaśinā bhṛśam |
patnīṃ jighṛkṣatā bhrāturddharmasaṃjño mahāmuniḥ || 17 ||
idānīṃ toṣayadhvaṃ vai sarva eva surāsurāḥ |
yena sthitirvo bhavati samaṃ devāsurā iti || 18 ||
tataḥ sarve stutiṃ cakrustasya devasya harṣitāḥ |
viditvā brahmaṇo vākyāt saṃpūrṇaśaśisannibham || 19 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
namo'stu śaśisaṅkāśa namaste jagataḥ pate |
namo'stu devarūpāya svargamārgapradarśaka |
karmamārgasvarūpāya sarvagāya namo namaḥ || 20 ||
tvayeyaṃ pālyate pṛthvī trailokyaṃ ca tvayaiva hi |
janastapastathā satyaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ tu pālyate || 21 ||
na tvayā rahitaṃ kiṃcijjagatsthāvarajaṅgamam |
vidyate tvadvihīnaṃ tu sadyo naśyati vai jagat || 22 ||
tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ satāṃ sattvasvarūpavān |
rājasānāṃ rajastvaṃ ca tāmasānāṃ tama eva ca || 23 ||
catuṣpādo bhavān deva catuśśrṛṅgastrilocanaḥ |
saptahastastribandhaśca vṛṣarūpa namo'stu te || 24 ||
tvayā hīnā vayaṃ deva sarva unmārgavarttinaḥ |
tanmārgaṃ yaccha mūḍhānāṃ tvaṃ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ || 25 ||
evaṃ stutastadā devairvṛṣarūpī prajāpatiḥ |
tuṣṭaḥ prasannamanasā śāntacakṣurapaśyata || 26 ||
dṛṣṭamātrāstu te devāḥ svayaṃ dharmeṇa cakṣuṣā |
kṣaṇena gatasaṃmohāḥ samyaksaddharmasaṃhitāḥ || 27 ||
asurā api tadvacca tato brahmā uvāca tam |
adyaprabhṛti te dharma tithirastu trayodaśī || 28 ||
yastāmupoṣya puruṣo bhavantaṃ samupārjayet |
kṛtvā pāpasamāhāraṃ tasmānmuñcati mānavaḥ || 29 ||
yaccāraṇyamidaṃ dharmma tvayā vyāptaṃ ciraṃ prabho |
tato nāmnā bhaviṣye taddharmāraṇyamiti prabho || 30 ||
catustripād dvyekapācca prabho tvaṃ
kṛtādibhirllakṣyase yena lokaiḥ |
tathā tathā karmabhūmau nabhaśca
prāyoyuktaḥ svagṛhaṃ pāhi viśvam || 31 ||
ityuktamātraḥ prapitāmaho'dhunā
surāsurāṇāmatha paśyatāṃ nṛpa |
adṛśyatāmagamat svālayāṃśca
jagmuḥ surāḥ savṛṣā vītaśokāḥ || 32 ||
dharmotpattiṃ ya imāṃ śrāvayīta
tadā śrāddhe tarpayeta pitṝṃśca |
