sa svargagāmī tu surānupeyāt || 33 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
athāparāṃ rudrasaṃbhūtimādyāṃ
śrṛṇuṣva rājanniti so'bhyuvāca |
mahātapāḥ prītito dharmmadakṣaḥ
kṣamāstradhārī ṛṣirugratejāḥ || 1 ||
jātaḥ prajānāṃ patirugratejā | jñānaṃ paraṃ tattvabhāvaṃ viditvā |
sṛṣṭiṃ sisṛkṣuḥ kṣubhito'tikopādavṛddhikāle jagataḥ prakāmam || 2 ||
tapasyato'taḥ sthirakīrtiḥ purāṇo
rajastamodhvastagatirbabhūva |
varo vareṇyo varadaḥ pratāpī
kṛṣṇāruṇaḥ puruṣaḥ piṅganetraḥ || 3 ||
rudannukto brahmaṇā mā ruda tvaṃ
rudrastato'sāvabhavat purāṇaḥ |
nayasva sṛṣṭiṃ vitatasvarūpāṃ
bhavān samartho'si mahānubhāva || 4 ||
ityuktamātraḥ salile mamajja
magne sasarjātmabhavāya dakṣaḥ |
kasthe tadā devavare vitenuḥ
sṛṣṭiṃ tu te mānasā brahmajātāḥ || 5 ||
tasyāṃ tatāyāṃ tu surādhipe tu
paitāmahaṃ yajñavaraṃ prakāmam |
magnaḥ purā yatsalile sa rudraḥ
utsṛjya viśvaṃ tu surān sisṛkṣuḥ || 6 ||
sustrāva yajñaṃ surasiddhayakṣānupāgatān krodhavaśaṃ jagāma |
manyuṃ pradīptaṃ paribhāvya kena sṛṣṭaṃ jaganmāṃ vyatiricya mohāt || 7 ||
hā heti cokte jvalanārciṣastu
tatrābhavan kṣudrapiśācasaṅghā
vetālabhūtāni ca yogisaṅghāḥ || 8 ||
ghanaṃ yadā tairvitataṃ viyacca
bhūmiśca sarvāśca diśaśca lokāḥ |
tadā sa sarvajñatayā cakāra
dhanuścaturviṃśatihastamātram || 9 ||
guṇaṃ trivṛttaṃ ca cakāra roṣādādatta divye ca dhanurguṇaṃ ca |
tataśca pūṣṇo daśanānavidhyad bhagasya netre vṛṣaṇau kratośca || 10 ||
sa viddhabījo vyapayātkratuśca mārgaṃ vāyurdhāradhan yajñavāṭāt |
devāśca sarve paśupatimupeyurjagmuśca sarve praṇatiṃ bhavasya || 11 ||
āgamya tatraiva pitāmahastu
bhavaṃ pratītaḥ saṃpariṣvajya devān |
bhaktyopetān vīkṣayad devadevān
vijñānamantaḥ kuru vīrabāho || 12 ||
rudra uvāca |
sṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ bhavatā'haṃ na ceme
kasmānna bhāgaṃ parikalpayanti |
yajñodbhavaṃ tena ruṣā mayeme
hṛtajñānā vikṛtā devadeva || 13 ||
brahmā uvāca |
devāḥ śaṃbhuṃ stutibhirjñānahetor
yajadhvamuccairasurāśca sarve |
yena rudro bhagavāṃstoṣameti
sarvajñatā toṣamātrasya ca syāt || 14 ||
ityuktāstena te devāḥ stutiṃ cakrurmahātmanaḥ || 15 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
namo devātidevāya trinetrāya mahātmane |
raktapiṅgalanetrāya jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇe || 16 ||
bhūtavetālajuṣṭāya mahābhogopavītine |
bhīmāṭṭahāsavaktrāya kapardin sthāṇave namaḥ || 17 ||
pūṣṇo dantavināśāya bhaganetrahane namaḥ |
bhaviṣyavṛṣacihnāya mahābhūtapate namaḥ || 18 ||
bhaviṣyatripurāntāya tathāndhakavināśine |
kailāsavaravāsāya karikṛttinivāsine || 19 ||
vikarālodrdhvakeśāya bhairavāya namo namaḥ |
agnijvālākarālāya śaśimaulikṛte namaḥ || 20 ||
bhaviṣyakṛtakāpālivratāya parameṣṭhine |
tathā dāruvanadhvaṃsakāriṇe tigmaśūline || 21 ||
kṛtakaṅkaṇabhogīndra nīlakaṇṭha triśūline |
pracaṇḍadaṇḍahastāya vaḍavāgnimukhāya ca || 22 ||
vedāntavedyāya namo yajñamūrte namo namaḥ |
dakṣayajñavināśāya jagadbhayakarāya ca || 23 ||
viśveśvarāya devāya śivaśaṃbhubhavāya ca |
kapardine karālāya mahādevāya te namaḥ || 24 ||
evaṃ devaiḥ stutaḥ śaṃbhurugradhanvā sanātanaḥ |
uvāca devadevo'haṃ yatkaromi taducyatām || 25 ||
devā ūcuḥ |
vedaśāstrāṇi vijñānaṃ dehi no bhava māciram |
yajñaṃ sarahasyaṃ no yadi tuṣṭo'si naḥ prabho || 26 ||
mahādeva uvāca |
bhavantaḥ paśavaḥ sarve bhavantu sahitā iti |
ahaṃ patirvo bhavatāṃ tato mokṣamavāpsyatha |
tatheti devāstaṃ prāhustataḥ paśupatirbhavat || 27 ||
brahmā paśupatiṃ prāha prasannenāntarātmanā |
caturddaśī te deveśa tithirastu na saṃśayaḥ || 28 ||
tasyāṃ tithau bhavantaṃ ye yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ |
upoṣya paścādbhuñjīyādgodhūmānnena vai dvijān ||
tasya tvaṃ tuṣṭimāpanno naya sthānamanuttamam || 29 ||
evamaktastadā rudro brahmaṇā'vyaktajanmanā |
dantān netre phale prādādbhagapūṣṇoḥ kratorapi |
parijñānaṃ ca sakalaṃ sa prādācca sureṣvapi || 30 ||
evaṃ rudrasya saṃbhūtiḥ saṃbhūtā brahmaṇaḥ purā |
anenaiva prayogena devānāṃ patirucyate || 31 ||
yaścainaṃ śrṛṇuyānnityaṃ prātarutthāya mānavaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokamavāpnuyāt || 32 ||
|| iti śrīvarāharapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
pitṝṇāṃ saṃbhavaṃ rājan kathyamānaṃ nibodha me |
pūrvaṃ prajāpatirbrahmā sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ || 1 ||
ekāgramanasā sarvāstanmātrā manasā bahiḥ |
kṛtvā paramakaṃ brahma dhyāyan sargepsuruccakaiḥ || 2 ||
tasyātmani tadā yogaṃ gatasya parameṣṭhinaḥ |
tanmātrā niryayurdehād dhūmavarṇākṛtitviṣaḥ || 3 ||
pibāma iti bhāṣantaḥ surān soma iti sma ha |
ūrdhvaṃ jigamiṣanto vai viyatsaṃsthāstapasvinaḥ || 4 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā sahasā brahmā tiryaksaṃsthāna unmukhān |
bhavantaḥ pitaraḥ santu sarveṣāṃ gṛhamedhinām || 5 ||
ūrdhvavaktrāstu ye tatra te nāndīmukhasaṃjñitāḥ |
vṛddhiśrāddheṣu satata pūjyā śrutividhānataḥ || 6 ||
agniṃ puraskṛto yaistu te dvijā agnihotriṇaḥ |
nityairnaimittikaiḥ kāmyaiḥ pārvaṇaistarpayantu tān || 7 ||
bahiḥpravaraṇā ye ca kṣatriyāstarpayantu tān |
ājyaṃ pibanti ye cātra tānarcayantu viśaḥ sadā || 8 ||
brāhmaṇairabhyanujñātāḥ śūdrāḥ svapitṛnāmataḥ |
tānevārcayatāṃ samyagvidhimantrabahiṣkṛtāḥ || 9 ||
anāhitāgnayo ye ca brahmakṣatraviśo narāḥ |
svakālinaste'rcayantu lokāgnipurataḥ sadā || 10 ||
ityevaṃ pūjitā yūyamiṣṭān kāmān prayacchata |
āyuḥ kīrtiṃ dhanaṃ putrān vidyāmabhijanaṃ smṛtim || 11 ||
ityuktvā tu tadā brahmā teṣāṃ panthānamākarot |
dakṣiṇāyanasaṃjñaṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ || 12 ||
tūṣṇīṃ sasarja bhūtāni tamūcuḥ pitarastataḥ |
vṛttiṃ no dehi bhagavan yayā vindāmahe sukham || 13 ||
brahmā uvāca |
amāvāsyādinaṃ vo'stu tasyāṃ kuśatilodakaiḥ |
tarpitā mānuṣaistṛptiṃ parāṃ gacchatha nānyathā || 14 ||
tilā deyāstathaitasyāmupoṣya pitṛbhaktitaḥ |
paramaṃ tasya saṃtuṣṭā varaṃ yacchata mā ciram || 15 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putraḥ atrirnāma mahātapāḥ |
tasya putro'bhavatsomo dakṣajāmātṛtāṃ gataḥ || 1 ||
saptaviṃśati yāḥ kanyā dākṣāyaṇyaḥ prakīrttitāḥ |
somapatnyo'timantavyāstāsāṃ śreṣṭhā tu rohiṇi || 2 ||
tāmeva ramate somo netarā iti śuśrumaḥ |
itarāḥ procurāgatya dakṣasyāsamatāṃ śaśeḥ || 3 ||
dakṣo'pyasakṛdāgatya tamuvāca sa nākarot |
samatāṃ so'pi taṃ dakṣaḥ śaśāpāntarhito bhava || 4 ||
evaṃ śaptastu dakṣeṇa somo dehaṃ tyajedatha |
uvāca somo dakṣaṃ tu bhavānevaṃ bhaviṣyati |
anekajo vihāyemaṃ brahmadehaṃ sanātanam || 5 ||
evamuktvā kṣayaṃ soma agamad dakṣaśāpataḥ |
devā manuṣyāḥ paśavo naṣṭe some savīrudhaḥ || 6 ||
kṣīṇābhavaṃstadā sarvā oṣadhyaśca viśeṣataḥ |
kṣayaṃ gacchadbhiratyarthamoṣadhībhiḥ surarṣabhāḥ || 7 ||
mūleṣu vīrudhāṃ somaḥ sthita ityūcurāturāḥ |
teṣāṃ cintā'bhavat tīvrā viṣṇuṃ ca śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 8 ||
bhagavānāha tān sarvān brūta kiṃ kriyate mayā |
te cocurdeva dakṣeṇa śaptaḥ somo vināśitaḥ || 9 ||
tānuvāca tadā devo mathyatāṃ kalaśodadhiḥ |
oṣadhyaḥ sarvato devāḥ prakṣipyāśu susaṃyataiḥ || 10 ||
evamuktvā tato devān dadhyau rudraṃ hariḥ svayam |
brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā dadhyau vāsukiṃ netrakāraṇāt || 11 ||
te sarve tatra sahitā mamanthurvaruṇālayam |
tasmiṃstu mathite jātaḥ punaḥ somo mahīpate || 12 ||
yo'sau kṣetrajñasaṃjño vai dehe'smin puruṣaḥ paraḥ |
sa eva somo mantavyo dehināṃ jīvasaṃjñitaḥ |
parecchayā sa mūrttiṃ tu pṛthak saumyāṃ prapedivān || 13 ||
tameva devamanujāḥ ṣoḍaśemāśca devatāḥ |
upajīvanti vṛkṣāśca tathaivoṣadhayaḥ prabhum || 14 ||
rudrastameva sakalaṃ dadhāra śirasā tadā |
tadātmikā bhavantyāpo viśvamūrtirasau smṛtaḥ || 15 ||
tasya brahmā dadau prītaḥ paurṇamāsīṃ tithiṃ prabhuḥ |
tasyāmupoṣayed rājaṃstamarthaṃ pratipādayet || 16 ||
yavānnahāraśca bhavet tasya jñānaṃ prayacchati |
kāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ ca rājendra dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca kevalam || 17 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
mahātapā uvāca |
āditretāsu rājāno maṇijā ye prakīrttitāḥ |
kathayiṣyāmi tān rājan yatra jāto'pi pārthiva || 1 ||
yo'sau suprabhanāmāsīt sa tvaṃ rājan kṛte yuge |
jāto'si nāmnā vikhyātaḥ prajāpāleti śobhanaḥ || 2 ||
śeṣāstretāyuge rājan bhaviṣyanti mahābalāḥ |
yo dīptatejā maṇijaḥ sa śanteti prakīrtitaḥ || 3 ||
suraśmirbhavitā rājā śaśakarṇo mahābalaḥ |
śubhadarśanaḥ pāñcālo bhaviṣyati narādhipaḥ || 4 ||
suśāntiraṅgavaṃśe vai sundaro'pyaṅga ityuta |
sundaśca mucukundo'bhūtsudyumnastura eva ca || 5 ||
sumanāḥ somadattastu śubhaḥ saṃvaraṇo'bhavat |
suśīlo vasudānastu sukhado supatirbhavat || 6 ||
śambhuḥ senāpatirabhūt sukānto daśarathaḥ smṛtaḥ |
somo'bhūjjanako rājā ete tretāyuge nṛpa || 7 ||
sarve bhūmimimāṃ rājan bhuktvā te vasudhādhipāḥ |
iṣṭvā ca vividhairyajñairdivaṃ prāpsyantyasaṃśayam || 8 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
evaṃ śrutvā sa rājarṣirbrahmavidyā'mṛtaṃ prabhuḥ |
ākhyānaṃ paramaṃ prītastapaścartumiyād vanam || 9 ||
ṛṣiradhyātmayogena vihāyedaṃ kalevaram |
brahmabhūto'bhavaddhātri harau layamavāpa ca || 10 ||
vṛndāvanaṃ ca rājā'sau tapo'rthaṃ gatavān prabhuḥ |
tatra govindanāmānaṃ hariṃ stotumathārabhat || 11 ||
rājovāca |
namāmi devaṃ jagatāṃ ca mūrttiṃ
gopendramindrānujamaprameyam |
saṃsāracakrakramaṇaikadakṣaṃ
kṣitīdharaṃ devavaraṃ namāmi || 12 ||
bhavodadhau duḥkhaśatormmibhīme
jarāvartte kṛṣṇapātālamūle |
tadantameko dadhate sukhaṃ me
namo'stu te gopatiraprameya || 13 ||
vyādhyādiyuktaḥ puruṣairgrahaiśca
saṅghaṭṭamānaṃ punareva deva |
namo'stu te yuddharate mahātmā
janārdano gopatirugrabāhuḥ || 14 ||
tvamuttamaḥ sarvavidāṃ sureśa
tvayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ samastam |
gopendra māṃ pāhi mahānubhāva
bhavādbhītaṃ tigmarathāṅgapāṇe || 15 ||
paro'si deva pravaraḥ surāṇāṃ
puṃsaḥ svarūpo'si śaśiprakāśaḥ |
hutāśavaktrācyuta tīvrabhāva
gopendra māṃ pāhi bhave patantam || 16 ||
saṃsāracakrakramaṇānyanekānyāvirbhavantyacyuta dehināṃ yat |
tvanmāyayā mohitānāṃ sureśa kaste māyāṃ tarate dvandvadhāmā || 17 ||
agotramasparśamarūpagandhamanāmanirdeśamajaṃ vareṇyam |
gopendra tvāṃ yadyupāsanti dhīrāste muktibhājo bhavabandhamuktāḥ || 18 ||
śabdātigaṃ vyomarūpaṃ vimūrttiṃ vikarmmiṇāṃ śubhabhāvaṃ vareṇyam |
cakrābjapāṇiṃ tu tathopacārāduktaṃ purāṇe satataṃ namāmi || 19 ||
trivikramaṃ krāntajagattrayaṃ ca
caturmūrttiṃ viśvagatāṃ kṣitīśam |
śambhuṃ vibhuṃ bhūtapatiṃ sureśaṃ
namāmyahaṃ viṣṇumanantamūrttim || 20 ||
tvaṃ deva sarvāṇi carācarāṇi
sṛjasyatho saṃharase tvameva |
māṃ muktikāmaṃ naya deva śīghraṃ
yasmin gatā yogino nāpayānti || 21 ||
jayasva govinda mahānubhāva
jayasva viṣṇo jaya padmanābha |
jayasva sarvajña jayāprameya
jayasva viśveśvara viśvamūrtte || 22 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
evaṃ stutvā tadā rājā nidhāya svaṃ kalevaram |
paramātmani govinde layamāgācca śāśvate || 23 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
kathamārādhyase deva bhaktimadbhirnarairvibho |
strībhirvā sarvametanme śaṃsa tvaṃ bhūtabhāvana || 1 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
bhāvasādhyo'smyahaṃ devi na vittairna japairaham |
sādhyastathā'pi bhaktānāṃ kāyakleśaṃ vadāmi te || 2 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā maccitto yo naro bhavet |
tasya vratāni dhāsyāmi vividhāni nibodha me || 3 ||
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryamakalkatā |
etāni mānasānyāhurvratāni tu dharādhare || 4 ||
ekabhaktaṃ tathā naktamupavāsādikaṃ ca yat |
tatsarvaṃ kāyikaṃ puṃsāṃ vrataṃ bhavati nānyathā || 5 ||
maunaṃ cādhyayanaṃ caiva devastutyarthakīrtitat |
nivṛttiścāpi paiśunyād vācikaṃ vratamuttamam ||6 ||
atrāpi śrūyate cānyadṛṣirugratapāḥ purā |
brahmaputraḥ purā kalpe āruṇirnāma nāmataḥ || 7 ||
so'raṇyamagamat kiṃcit taporthī dvijasattamaḥ |
tapastepe tatastasminnupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 ||
devikāyāstaṭe ramye so'vasad brāhmaṇaḥ kila |
kadācidabhiṣekāya sa jagāma mahānadīm || 9 ||
tatra snātvā japan vipro dadarśāyāntamagrataḥ |
vyādhaṃ mahādhanuḥpāṇimugranetraṃ vibhīṣaṇam || 10 ||
taṃ dvijaṃ hantumāyāt sa valkalānāṃ jighṛkṣayā |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣubhito vipro brahmaghnasya bhayāditi |
dhyāyan nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tasthau tatraiva sa dvijaḥ || 11 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā'ntargatahariṃ vyādho bhīta ivāgrataḥ |
vihāya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ tato vacanamabravīt || 12 ||
vyādha uvāca |
hantumicchurahaṃ brahman bhavantaṃ prāgihāgataḥ |
idānīṃ darśanāt tubhyaṃ sā matiḥ kvāpi me gātā || 13 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahastrāṇi sastrīṇāmayutāni ca |
nihatāni mayā brahman nihatau ca kuṭambinau || 14 ||
narake'bhyadhikaṃ cittaṃ kadācidapi vidyate |
idānīṃ taptumicchāmi tapo'haṃ tvatsamīpataḥ |
upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 15 ||
evamukto'pyasau vipro nottaraṃ pratyapadyata |
brahmahā pāpakarmeti matvā brāhmaṇapuṃgavaḥ || 16 ||
anukto'pi sa dharmepsurvyādhastatraiva tasthivān |
snātvā nadyāṃ dvijaḥ so'pi vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ || 17 ||
kasyacit tvatha kālasya tāṃ nadīmagamat kila |
vyāghro bubhukṣitaḥ śāntaṃ taṃ vipraṃ hantumudyataḥ || 18 ||
antarjalagataṃ vipraṃ yāvad vyāghro jighṛkṣati |
tāvad vyādhena viddho'sau sadyaḥ prāṇairviyojitaḥ || 19 ||
tasmād vyāghraśarīrāt tu utthāya puruṣaḥ kila |
vipraścāntarjale magnaḥ śrutvā taṃ śabdamākulam |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti vākyamuccairuvāca ha || 20 ||
vyāghreṇāpi śruto mantraḥ prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhasthitaistataḥ |
śrutamātre jahau prāṇān puruṣaścābhavacchubhaḥ || 21 ||
so'bravīd yāmi taṃ deśaṃ yatra viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ |
tvatprasādād dvijaśreṣṭha muktapāpmā nirāmayaḥ || 22 ||
ityukto brāhmaṇaḥ prāha ko'si tvaṃ puruṣarṣabha |
so'bravīt tasya rājendraḥ pratāpī pūrvajanmani |
dīrghabāhuriti khyātaḥ sarvadharmaviśāradaḥ || 23 ||
ahaṃ jānāmi vedāṃśca ahaṃ vedmi śubhāśubham |
brāhmaṇe naiva me kāryaṃ kiṃ vastu brāhmaṇā iti || 24 ||
tasyaivaṃ vādino viprāḥ sarve krodhasamanvitāḥ |
ūcuḥ śāpaṃ durādharṣaḥ krūro vyāghro bhaviṣyasi || 25 ||
avamānāt tu viprāṇāṃ satyāntaṃ smaraṇaṃ tava |
mṛtyukālena saṃmūḍha keśavena bhaviṣyati || 26 ||
ityukto'haṃ purā taistu brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ |
tameva sarvaṃ saṃprāpto brahmaśāpaṃ supuṣkalam || 27 ||
tataste brāhmaṇā sarve praṇipatya mahāmune |
uktā'nugrahahetorvai ūcuste māmimaṃ purā || 28 ||
ṣaṣṭhānnakālikasyāgre yaste sthāsyati kaścana |
sa bhakṣyaste tu bhavitā kaṃcitkālaṃ narādhama || 29 ||
yadeṣughātaṃ labdhvā tu prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairbhavān |
śroṣyase dvijavaktrāt tu namo nārāyaṇeti hi |
tadā svargagatistubhyaṃ bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 30 ||
paravaktragatasyāpi viṣṇornāma śrutaṃ mayā |
labdhadveṣasya viprāṇāṃ pratyakṣaṃ tava sattama || 31 ||
yaḥ punarbrāhmaṇān pūjya svavaktreṇa namo harim |
vadan prāṇaṃ vimucyeta muktau'sau vītakilbiṣaḥ ||| 32 ||
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamutkṣipya bhujamucyate |
jaṅgamā brāhmaṇā devāḥ kūṭasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 33 ||
evamuktvā gataḥ svargaṃ sa rājā vītakalmaṣaḥ |
brāhmaṇo'pi sadāyuktastaṃ vyādhaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 34 ||
ṛṣiruvāca |
jighṛkṣormṛgarājasya yattvayā rakṣito hyaham |
tatputra tuṣṭaste dadmi varaṃ varaya suvrata || 35 ||
vyādha uvāca |
eṣa eva varo mahyaṃ yat tvaṃ māṃ bhāṣase dvija |
ataḥ paraṃ vareṇāhaṃ kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām || 36 ||
ṛṣiruvāca |
ahaṃ tvayā purā putra prārthito'smi tapo'rthinā |
bahupātakayuktena ghorarūpeṇa cānagha || 37 ||
idānīṃ tava pāpāni devikābhiṣaveṇa ca |
maddarśanena ca ciraṃ viṣṇunāmaśrutena ca |
naṣṭāni śuddhadeho'si sāṃprataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 38 ||
idānīṃ varamekaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa mama sannidhau |
tapaḥ kuruṣva sādho tvaṃ cirakālaṃ yadīcchasi || 39 ||
vyādha uvāca |
ya eṣa bhavatā prokto viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
sa kathaṃ prāpyate martyaireṣa eva varo mama || 40 ||
ṛṣiruvāca |
tamuddiśya vrataṃ kuryād yatkiṃcitpuruṣo'cyutam |
sa paraṃ tamavāpnoti bhaktayā yuktaḥ pumāniti || 41 ||
evaṃ jñātvā bhavān putra vratametat samācara |
na bhakṣayāmi sakaṭaṃ na vadāmyanṛtaṃ kvacit || 42 ||
etat te vratamādiṣṭaṃ mayā vyādhavara dhruvam |
tatraivaṃ tapasā yuktastiṣṭha tvaṃ yāvadicchasi || 43 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
evaṃ cintānvitaṃ matvā varado brāhmaṇo'bhavat |
mokṣārthinamatho buddhvā vañcayitvā gato muniḥ || 44 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
sa śubhaṃ śobhanaṃ mārgamāsthāya vyādhasattamaḥ |
tapastepe nirāhārastaṃ guruṃ manasā smaran || 1 ||
bhikṣākāle tu saṃprāpte śīrṇaparṇānyabhakṣayat |
sa kadācit kṣudhāviṣṭo vṛkṣamūlaṃ samāśritaḥ || 2 ||
bubhukṣitastaroḥ parṇamaicchad bhakṣitumantikāt |
ityevaṃ kurvato vyomni vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 3 ||
mā bhakṣayasva sakaṭamuccairevaṃ prabhāṣite |
tato'sau taṃ vihāyānyad vārkṣaṃ patitamagrahīt || 4 ||
tamapyevaṃ niṣiddhaṃ syādanyaṃ tathaivameva ca |
evaṃ sa sakaṭaṃ matvā vyādhaḥ kiñcinna bhakṣayat || 5 ||
nirāhārastapastepe smaran gurumatandritaḥ |
tasyātha bahunā kāle gate ṛṣivaro'bhyagāt || 6 ||
durvāsāḥ śaṃsitātmā vai kiñcitprāṇamapaśyata |
vyādhaṃ tapotthatejobhirjvalamānaṃ haviryathā || 7 ||
so'pi vyādhastu taṃ natvā śirasā'tha mahāmunim |
uvāca sa kṛtārtho'smi bhagavan darśanāt tava || 8 ||
idānīṃ śrāddhakālaṃ me prāptaṃ tvamavadhāraya |
śīrṇaparṇāni bhakṣayan vai tairevāhaṃ mahāmune |
bhavantaṃ prīṇayāmīti vyādhastaṃ vākyamabravīt || 9 ||
durvāsā api taṃ śuddhaṃ śuddhabhāvaṃ jitendriyam |
jijñāsustattapo vākyamidamuccairuvāca ha || 10 ||
yavagodhūmaśālīnāmannaṃ caiva susaṃskṛtam |
dīyatāṃ me kṣudhārtāya tvāmuddiśyāgatāya ca || 11 ||
ityuktena tvasau vyādhaścintāṃ paramikāṃ gataḥ |
kva saṃbhaviṣyate mahyamiti cintāparo'bhavat || 12 ||
tasya cintayataḥ pātramākāśāt patitaṃ śubham |
sauvarṇaṃ siddhisaṃyuktaṃ tajjagrāha kareṇa saḥ || 13 ||
tad gṛhītvā muniṃ prāha durvāsākhyaṃ sasādhvasaḥ |
atraiva sthīyatāṃ brahman yāvad bhikṣāṭanaṃ tvaham |
karomi tatprasādo'yaṃ kriyatāṃ brahmavittama || 14 ||
evamuktvā tato bhikṣāmaṭanaṃ vyādhasattamaḥ |
nātidūreṇa nagaraṃ dhanayoṣasamanvitam || 15 ||
tasya tatra prayātasya agrataḥ sarvaśobhanāḥ |
vṛkṣebhyo niryayuścānyā hemapātrāgrapāṇayaḥ |
vividhānnāni tasyāśu dattvā pātraṃ prapūritam || 16 ||
sa ca bhūtārthamātmānaṃ matvā punarathāśramam |
ājagāma tato'paśyat tamṛṣiṃ japatāṃ varam || 17 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sthāpya tāṃ bhikṣāṃ śucau deśe prasannadhīḥ |
praṇamya tamṛṣiṃ vākyamuvāca vyādhasattamaḥ || 18 ||
bhagavan kṣālanaṃ padbhyāṃ kriyatāmṛṣipuṃgava |
yadi tvahamanugrāhyastadevaṃ karttumarhasi || 19 ||
evamuktaḥ sa jijñāsustapovīryaṃ śubhaṃ muniḥ |
nadīṃ gantuṃ na śaknomi jalapātraṃ na cāsti me || 20 ||
kathaṃ prakṣālayāmyāśu vyādha pādau mahāmate |
ityetanmuninā vyādhaḥ śrutvā cintāparo'bhavat |
kiṃ karomi kathaṃ cāsya bhojanaṃ vai bhaviṣyati || 21 ||
evaṃ saṃcintya manasā guruṃ smṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
jagāma śaraṇaṃ tāṃ tu saritaṃ devikāṃ sudhīḥ || 22 ||
vyādha uvāca |
vyādho'smi pāpakarmā'smi brahmahā'smi saridvare |
tathāpi saṃsmṛtā devi pāhi māṃ śaraṇaṃ gatam || 23 ||
devatāṃ naiva jānāmi na mantraṃ na tathārcanam |
gurupādau paraṃ dhyātvā paśyāmi satataṃ śubhe || 24 ||
evaṃ vidhasya me devi dayāṃ kuru saridvare |
ṛṣeḥ kṣālārthasalilaṃ samīpaṃ kuru māciram || 25 ||
evamuktvā'tha vyādhena devikā pāpanāśinī |
ājagāma yatastasthau durvāsāḥ saṃśitavrataḥ || 26 ||
tasya pādau svayaṃ devī kṣālayantī saridvarā |
jagāma hrādinī bhūtvā vyādhāśramasamīpataḥ || 27 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ durvasā vismayaṃ yayau |
prakṣālya hastau pādau ca tadantaṃ śraddhayānvitam |
bubhuje paramaprītastathācamya vicakṣaṇaḥ || 28 ||
tamasthiśeṣaṃ vyādhaṃ tu kṣudhādurbalatāṃ gatam |
uvāca vedādhyayanaṃ sarve vedāḥ sasaṃgrahāḥ |
brahmavidyā purāṇāni pratyakṣāṇi bhavantu te || 29 ||
evaṃ prādād varaṃ tasya durvāsā nāma cākarot |
bhavān satyatapā nāma ṛṣirādyo bhaviṣyati || 30 ||
evaṃ dattavaro vyādhastamāha munisattamam |
vyādho bhūtvā kathaṃ brahman vedānadhyāpayāmyaham || 31 ||
ṛṣiruvāca |
prākśarīraṃ gataṃ te'dya nirāhārasya sattama |
tapomayaṃ śarīraṃ te pṛthagbhūtaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 32 ||
prāgvijñānaṃ gataṃ nāśamidānīṃ śuddhamakṣaram |
viddhi taṃ śuddhakāyo'si tathā'nyat te śarīrakam |
tena vedāḥ samaṃ śāstraiḥ pratibhāsyanti te mune || 33 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre aṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||
satyatapā uvāca |
bhagavan dve śarīre tu iti yatparikīrttitam |
tanme kathaya bhedaṃ vai ke te brahmavidāṃ vara || 1 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
na dve trīṇi śarīrāṇi vācyaṃ tadviparītakam |
vibhogāyatanaṃ caiva triśarīrāṇi prāṇinām || 2 ||
prāgavasthamadharmākhyaṃ parijñānavivarjitam |
aparaṃ savrataṃ taddhi jñeyamatyantadhārmikam || 3 ||
dharmādharmopabhogāya yat tṛtīyamatīndriyam |
tattribhedaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ brahmavidbhirvicakṣaṇaiḥ |
yātanā dharmabhogaśca bhuktiśceti tribhedakam || 4 ||
yastu bhāvaḥ purā hyāsīt prāṇino nighnataḥ sa vai |
tatpāpākhyaṃ śarīraṃ te pāpasaṃjñaṃ taducyate || 5 ||
idānīṃ śubhavṛttiṃ tu kurvatastapa ārjavam |
aparaṃ dharmarūpaṃ tu śarīraṃ te vyavasthitam |
tena vedapurāṇāni jñātumarhasyasaṃśayam || 6 ||
yadāṣṭākaṃ saṃparivarttate pumāṃstadā tryavasthaḥ parikīrtyate tu vai |
gatāṣṭavargastrigataḥ sadā śubhaḥ sthiro bhavedātmani niścayātmavān || 7 ||
yadā pañca punaḥ pañca pañca pañcāpi saṃtyajet |
ekamārgastadā brahma śāśvataṃ labhate naraḥ || 8 ||
satyatapā uvāca |
bhagavan yadi vijñānaṃ śarīraṃ nopajāyate |
tadā kena prakāreṇa paraṃ brahmopalabhyate || 9 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
karmakāṇḍaṃ jñānamūlaṃ jñānaṃ karmādikaṃ tathā |
etayorantaraṃ nāsti yathā'śmamṛdayormune || 10 ||
karmakāṇḍaṃ caturbhedaṃ brāhmaṇādiṣu kīrtitam |
tatra vedoktakarmāṇi trayaḥ kurvanti nityaśaḥ |
triśuśrūṣāmathaikastu eṣā vedoditā kriyā || 11 ||
etān dharmānavasthāya brahmaṇopāstiṃ rocate |
tasya muktirbhavennūnaṃ vedavādaratasya ca || 12 ||
satyatapā uvāca |
yadetat paramaṃ brahma tvayā proktaṃ mahāmune |
tasya rūpaṃ na jānanti yogino'pi mahātmanaḥ || 13 ||
anāmamasagotraṃ ca amūrttaṃ mūrttivarjitam |
kathaṃ sa jñāyate brahma saṃjñānāmavivarjitam |
tasya saṃjñāṃ kathaya me vedamārgavyavasthitām || 14 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
yadetat paramaṃ brahma vedavyāseṣu paṭhyate |
sa devaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ || 15 ||
sa yajñairvividhairiṣṭairdānairdattaiśca sattama |
prāpyate paramo devaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ || 16 ||
satyatapā uvāca |
bhagavan bahuvittena ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ |
prāpyate puṇyakṛdbhirhi kvacid yajñaḥ kathaṃcana |
tena prāptena bhagavān labhyate duḥkhato hariḥ || 17 ||
vittena ca vinā dānaṃ dātuṃ vipra na śakyate |
vidyamāne'pi na matiḥ kuṭumbāsaktacetasaḥ |
tasya mokṣaḥ kathaṃ brahman sarvathā durlabho hariḥ || 18 ||
alpāyāsena labhyeta yena devaḥ sanātanaḥ |
tanme sāmānyato brūhi sarvavarṇeṣu yad bhavet || 19 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
kathayāmi paraṃ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ devanirmitam |
dharaṇyā yatkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ majjantyā tu rasātale || 20 ||
pṛthivyāḥ pārthivo bhāvaḥ salile nātirecitaḥ |
tasmin salilamagne tu pṛthvī prāyād rasātalam || 21 ||
sā bhūtadhāriṇī devī rasātalagatā śubhā |
ārādhayāmāsa vibhuṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param |
upavāsavratairdevī niyamaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 22 ||
kālena mahatā tasyāḥ prasanno garuḍadhvajaḥ |
ujjahāra sthitau cemāṃ sthāpayāmāsa so'vyayaḥ || 23 ||
satyatapā uvāca |
ko'sau dharaṇyā saṃcīrṇa upavāso mahāmune |
kāni vratāni ca tathā etanme vaktumarhasi || 24 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
yadā mārgaśire māsi daśamyāṃ niyatātmavān |
kṛtvā devārcanaṃ dhīmānagnikāryaṃ yathāvidhi || 25 ||
śucivāsāḥ prasannātmā havyamannaṃ susaṃskṛtam |
bhuktvā pañcapadaṃ gatvā punaḥ śaucaṃ tu pādayoḥ || 26 ||
kṛtvā'ṣṭāṅgulamātraṃ tu kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhavam |
bhakṣayed dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu tata ācamya yatnataḥ || 27 ||
spṛṣṭvā dvārāṇi sarvāṇi ciraṃ dhyātvā janārdanam |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ kirīṭiṃ pītavāsasam || 28 ||
prasannavadanaṃ devaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam |
dhyātvā punarjalaṃ haste gṛhya bhānuṃ janārdanam || 29 ||
dhyātvā'rdhyaṃ dāpayet tasya karatoyena mānavaḥ |
evamuccārayed vācaṃ tasmin kāle mahāmune || 30 ||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvā'hamapare'hani |
bhokṣyāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta || 31 ||
evamuktvā tato rātrau devadevasya sannidhau |
japannārāyaṇāyeti svapet tatra vidhānataḥ || 32 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale nadīṃ gatvā samudragām |
itarāṃ vā taḍāgaṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān || 33 ||
ānīya mṛttikāṃ śuddhāṃ mantreṇānena mānavaḥ |
dhāraṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ tvatto bhūtānāṃ devi sarvadā |
tena satyena me pāpaṃ yāvanmocaya suvrate || 34 ||
brahmāṇḍodaratīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni deva te |
tenemāṃ mṛttikāṃ spṛṣṭvā mā labhāmi tvayoditām || 35 ||
tvayi sarve rasā nityāḥ sthitā varuṇa sarvadā |
tenemāṃ mṛttikāṃ plāvya pūtāṃ kuru mamāciram || 36 ||
evaṃ mṛdaṃ tathā toyaṃ prasādyātmānamālabhet |
triḥ kṛtvā śeṣamṛdayā kuṇḍamālikhya vai jale || 37 ||
tatastatra naraḥ samyak cakravartyupacārataḥ |
snātvā cāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā punardevagṛhaṃ vrajet || 38 ||
tatrārādhya mahāyogiṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
keśavāya namaḥ pādau kaṭiṃ dāmodarāya ca || 39 ||
ūruyugmaṃ nṛsiṃhāya uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe |
kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya vakṣaḥ śrīpataye tathā || 40 ||
trailokyavijayāyeti bāhū sarvātmane śiraḥ |
rathāṅgadhāriṇe cakraṃ śaṃkarāyeti vārijam || 41 ||
gambhīrāyeti ca gadāmambhojaṃ śāntimūrttaye |
evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 42 ||
punastasyāgrataḥ kumbhān caturaḥ sthāpayed budhaḥ |
jalapūrṇān samālyāṃśca sitacandanalepitān || 43 ||
cūtapallavasagrīvān sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitān |
sthagitān tāmrapātraiśca tilapūrṇaiḥ sakāñcanaiḥ || 44 ||
catvāraste samudrāstu kalaśāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
teṣāṃ madhye śubhaṃ pīṭhaṃ sthāpayed vastragarbhitam || 45 ||
tasmin sauvarṇaraupyaṃ vā tāmraṃ vā dāravaṃ tathā |
alābhe sarvapātrāṇāṃ pālāśaṃ pātramiṣyate || 46 ||
toyapūrṇaṃ tu tatkṛtvā tasmin pātre tato nyaset |
sauvarṇaṃ matsyrūpeṇa kṛtvā devaṃ janārdam |
vedavedāṅgasaṃyuktaṃ śrutismṛtivibhūṣitam || 47 ||
tatrānekavidhairbhakṣaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca śobhitam |
gandhadhūpaiśca vastraiśca arcayitvā yathāvidhi || 48 ||
rasātalagatā vedā yathā deva tvayāhṛtāḥ |
matsyarūpeṇa tadvanmāṃ bhavānuddhara keśava |
evamuccārya tasyāgre jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet || 49 ||
yathāvibhavasāreṇa prabhāte vimale tathā |
caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca caturo dāpayed ghaṭān || 50 ||
pūrvaṃ tu bahvṛce dadyācchandoge dakṣiṇaṃ tathā |
yajuḥśākhānvite dadyāt paścimaṃ ghaṭamuttamam |
uttaraṃ kāmato tadyādeṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 51 ||
ṛgvedaḥ prīyatāṃ pūrve sāmavedastu dakṣiṇe |
yajurvedaḥ paścimato atharvaścottareṇa tu || 52 ||
anena kramayogena prīyatāmiti vācayet |
matsyarūpaṃ ca sauvarṇamācāryāya nivedayet || 53 ||
gandhadhūpādivastraiśca saṃpūjya vidhivat kramāt |
yastvimaṃ sarahasyaṃ ca mantraṃ caivopapādayet |
vidhānaṃ tasya vai dattvā phalaṃ koṭiguṇottaram || 54 ||
pratipadya guruṃ yastu mohād vipratipadyate |
sa janmakoṭi narake pacyate puruṣādhamaḥ |
vidhānasya pradātā yo gururityucyate budhaiḥ || 55 ||
evaṃ dattvā vidhānena dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇumarcya ca |
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ kuryād yathāśaktyā sadakṣiṇam || 56 ||
tāmrapātraiśca satilaiḥ sthagitān kārayed ghaṭān |
tatra sajjalapātrasthaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine || 57 ||
devaṃ dadyānmahābhāgastato viprāṃśca bhojayet |
bhūriṇā paramānnena tataḥ paścāt svayaṃ naraḥ |
bhuñjīta sahito bālairvāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ || 58 ||
anena vidhinā yastu dharaṇīvratakṛnnaraḥ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ cāgryaṃ śrṛṇu buddhimatāṃ vara || 59 ||
yadi vaktrasahastrāṇi bhavanti mama suvrata |
āyuśca brahmaṇastulyaṃ bhaved yadi mahāvrata || 60 ||
tadānīmasya dharmasya phalaṃ kathayituṃ bhavet |
tathāpyuddeśato brahman kathayāmi śrṛṇuṣva tat || 61 ||
daśa sapta daśa dve ca aṣṭau catvāra eva ca |
lakṣāyutāni catvāri ekasthaṃ syāccaturyugam || 62 ||
tairekasaptatiyugaṃ bhavenmanvantaraṃ mune |
caturdaśāho brāhmastu tāvatī rātririṣyate || 63 ||
evaṃ triṃśaddino māsaste dvādaśa samā smṛtā |
teṣāṃ śataṃ brahmaṇastu āyurnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 64 ||
yaḥ sakṛd dvādaśīmetāmanena vidhinā kṣipet |
sa brahmalokamāpnoti tatkālaṃ caiva tiṣṭhati || 65 ||
tato brahmopasaṃhāre tallayaṃ tiṣṭhate ciram |
punaḥ sṛṣṭau bhaved devo vairājānāṃ mahātapāḥ || 66 ||
brahmahatyādipāpāni iha lokakṛtānyapi |
akāme kāmato vāpi tāni naśyanti tatkṣaṇāt || 67 ||
iha loke daridro yo bhraṣṭarājyo'tha vā nṛpaḥ |
upoṣya tāṃ vidhānena sa rājā jāyate dhruvam || 68 ||
vandhyā nārī bhaved yā tu anena vidhinā śubhā |
upoṣyati bhavet tasyāḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || 69 ||
agamyāgamanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ jānāti mānavaḥ |
sa imaṃ vidhimāsādya tasmāt pāpād vimucyate || 70 ||
brahmakriyāyā lopena bahuvarṣakṛtena ca |
upoṣyemāṃ sakṛd bhaktyā vedasaṃskāramāpnuyāt || 71 ||
kimatra bahunoktena na tadasti mahāmune |
aprāpyaṃ prāpyate naiva pāpaṃ vā yanna naśyati || 72 ||
anena vidhinā brahman svayameva hyupoṣitā |
dharaṇyā magnayā tāta nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 73 ||
adīkṣitāya no deyaṃ vidhānaṃ nāstikāya ca |
devabrahmadviṣe vā'pi na śrāvyaṃ tu kadācana |
gurubhaktāya dātavyaṃ sadyaḥ pāpapraṇāśanam || 74 ||
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ varastriyaḥ |
bhavanti vividhā yastu upoṣya vidhinā tataḥ || 75 ||
ya imaṃ śrāvayed bhaktyā dvādaśīkalpamuttamam |
śrṛṇoti vā sa pāpaistu sarvaireva pramucyate || 76 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ūnacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
tathaiva pauṣamāse tu amṛtaṃ mathitaṃ suraiḥ |
tatra kūrmo bhaved devaḥ svayameva janārdanaḥ || 1 ||
tasyeyaṃ tithiruddiṣṭā harervai kūrmarūpiṇaḥ |
puṣyamāsasya yā śuddhā dvādaśī śuklapakṣataḥ || 2 ||
tasyāṃ prāgeva saṃkalpya prāgvat snānnādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
nirvartyārādhayed rātryāmekādaśyāṃ janārdanam |
pṛthaṅmantrairmuniśreṣṭha devadevaṃ janārdanam || 3 ||
oṃkūrmāya pādau prathamaṃ prapūjya
nārāyaṇeti hareḥ kaṭiṃ ca |
saṃkarṣaṇāyetyudaraṃ viśoketyurobhavāyeti tathaiva kaṇṭham |
subāhavetyeva bhujau śiraśca namo viśālāya rathāṅgasāram || 4 ||
svanāmamantreṇa sugandhapuṣpairnānānivedyairvividhaiḥ phalaiśca |
abhyarcya devaṃ kalaśaṃ tadagre saṃsthāpya mālyaiḥ sitakaṇṭhadāma || 5 ||
taṃ ratnagarbhaṃ tu pureva kṛtvā
svaśaktito hemamayaṃ tu devam |
samandaraṃ kūrmarūpeṇa kṛtvā
saṃsthāpya tāmre ghṛtapūrṇapātre |
pūrṇaghaṭasyopari saṃniveśya
śvo brāhmaṇāyaivamevaṃ tu dadyāt || 6 ||
śvo brāhmaṇān bhojya sadakṣiṇāṃśca
yathāśaktyā prīṇayed devadevam |
nārāyaṇaṃ kūrmarūpeṇa paścād
tathā svayaṃ bhuñjīta sabhṛtyavargaḥ || 7 ||
evaṃ kṛte vipra samastapāpaṃ
vinaśyate nātra kuryād vicāram |
saṃsāracakraṃ tu vihāya śuddhaṃ
prāpnoti lokaṃ ca hareḥ purāṇam |
prayānti pāpāni vināśamāśu
śrīmāṃstathā jāyate satyadharmaḥ || 8 ||
anekajanmāntarasaṃcitāni
naśyanti pāpāni narasya bhaktyā |
prāguktarūpaṃ tu phalaṃ bhaveta
nārāyaṇastuṣṭimāyāti sadyaḥ || 9 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
evaṃ māghe site pakṣe dvādaśīṃ dharaṇībhṛtaḥ |
varāhasya śrṛṇuṣvādyāṃ mune paramadhārmika || 1 ||
prāguktena vidhānena saṃkalpasnānameva ca |
kṛtvā devaṃ samabhyarcya ekādaśyāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 2 ||
dhūpanaivedyagandhaiśca arcayitvā'cyutaṃ naraḥ |
paścāt tasyāgrataḥ kumbhaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ tu vinyaset || 3 ||
oṃ vārāhāyeti pādau tu mādhavāyeti vai kaṭim |
kṣetrajñāyeti jaṭharaṃ viśvarūpetyuro hareḥ || 4 ||
sarvajñāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ tu prajānāṃ pataye śiraḥ |
pradyumnāyeti ca bhujau divyāstrāya sudarśanam |
amṛtodbhavāya śaṅkhaṃ tu eṣa devārcane vidhiḥ || 5 ||
evamabhyarcya medhāvī tasmin kumbhe tu vinyaset |
sauvarṇaṃ raupyatāmraṃ vā pātraṃ vibhavaśaktitaḥ || 6 ||
sarvabījaistu saṃpūrṇaṃ sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
tatra śaktyā tu sauvarṇaṃ vārāhaṃ kārayed budhaḥ || 7 ||
daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddhṛtāṃ pṛthvīṃ saparvatavanadrumām |
mādhavaṃ madhuhantāraṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitam || 8 ||
sarvabījabhṛte pātre ratnagarbhaṃ ghaṭopari |
sthāpayet paramaṃ devaṃ jātarūpamayaṃ harim || 9 ||
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ tāmrapātraṃ tu vai mune |
sthāpyārccayed gandhapuṣpairnaivedyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 10 ||
puṣpamaṇḍalikāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet |
prādurbhāvān harestatra vācayed bhāvayed budhaḥ || 11 ||
evaṃ sanniyamasyāntaṃ prabhāte udite ravau |
śuciḥ snātvā hariṃ pūjya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 12 ||
vedavedāṅgaviduṣe sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate |
viṣṇubhaktāya viprarṣe viśeṣeṇa pradāpayet || 13 ||
devaṃ sakumbhaṃ taṃ dattvā hariṃ vārāharūpiṇam |
brāhmaṇāya bhaved yaddhi phalaṃ tanme niśāmaya || 14 ||
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ śrīḥ kāntistuṣṭireva ca |
daridro vittavān sadyaḥ aputro labhate sutam |
alakṣmīrnaśyate sadyo lakṣmīḥ saṃviśate kṣaṇāt || 15 ||
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ paraloke niśāmaya |
asminnarthe purāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam || 16 ||
iha loke'bhavad rājā vīradhanveti viśrutaḥ |
sa kadācid vanaṃ prāyān mṛgahetoḥ paraṃtapaḥ || 17 ||
vyāpādayan mṛgagaṇān tatrarṣivanamadhyagaḥ |
jaghāna mṛgarūpān so'jñānato brāhmaṇān nṛpaḥ || 18 ||
bhrātarastatra pañcāśanmṛgarūpeṇa saṃsthitāḥ |
saṃvartasya sutā brahman vedādhyayanatatparāḥ || 19 ||
satyatapā uvāca |
kāraṇaṃ kiṃ samāśritya te cakrurmṛgarūpatām |
etanme kautukaṃ brahman praṇatasya prasīda me || 20 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
te kadācid vanaṃ yātā dṛṣṭvā hariṇapotakān |
jātamātrān svamātrā tu vihīnān dṛśya sattama |
ekaikaṃ jagṛhuste hi te mṛtāḥ skandhasaṃsthitāḥ || 21 ||
tataste duḥkhitāḥ sarve yayuḥ pitaramantikam |
ūcuśca vacanaṃ cedaṃ mṛgahiṃsāmṛte mune || 22 ||
ṛṣiputrakā ūcuḥ |
jātamātrā mṛgāḥ pañca asmābhirnihatā mune |
akāmatastato'smākaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyatām || 23 ||
saṃvartta uvāca |
matpitā hiṃsakastvāsīdahaṃ tasmād viśeṣataḥ |
bhavantaḥ pāpakarmāṇaḥ saṃjātā mama putrakāḥ || 24 ||
idānīṃ mṛgacarmāṇi paridhāya yatavratāḥ |
caraghvaṃ pañcavarṣāṇi tataḥ śuddhā bhaviṣyatha || 25 ||
evamuktāstu te putrā mṛgacarmopavītinaḥ |
vanaṃ viviśuravyagrā japanto brahma śāśvatam || 26 ||
tathā varṣe vyatikrānte vīradhanvā mahīpatiḥ |
tatrājagāma yasmiṃste caranti mṛgarūpiṇaḥ || 27 ||
te cāpyekatarormūle mṛgacarmmopavītinaḥ |
japantaḥ saṃsthitāste hi rājñā dṛṣṭvā mṛgā iti |
matvā viddhāstu yugapanmṛtāste brahmavādinaḥ || 28 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā tu mṛtān rājā brāhmaṇān saṃśitavratān |
bhayena vepamānastu devarātāśramaṃ yayau |
tatrāpṛcchad brahmavadhyā mamāyātā mahāmune || 29 ||
āmūlya tad vadhaṃ vṛttaṃ kathayitvā narādhipaḥ |
bhṛśaṃ śokaparītātmā ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ || 30 ||
sa ṛṣirdevarātastu rudantaṃ nṛpasattamam |
uvāca mā bhairnṛpate apaneṣyāmi pātakam || 31 ||
pātāle sutalākhye ca yathā dhātrī nimajjatī |
uddhṛtā devadevena viṣṇunā kroḍamūrttinā || 32 ||
tadvad bhavantaṃ rājendra brahmavadhyāpariplutam |
uddhariṣyati devo'sau svayameva janārdanaḥ || 33 ||
evamuktastato rājā harṣito vākyamabravīt |
katareṇa prakāreṇa sa me devaḥ prasīdati |
prasanne cāśubhaṃ sarvaṃ yena naśyati sattama || 34 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
evamukto munistena devarāta imaṃ vratam |
ācakhyau so'pi taṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā bhogānsupuṣkalān || 35 ||
mutyukāle muniśreṣṭha sauvarṇena virājatā |
vimānenāgamat svargamindralokaṃ sa pārthivaḥ || 36 ||
tasyendrastvarghyamādāya pratyutthānena niryayau |
āyāntamindraṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tamūcurviṣṇukiṃkarāḥ |
na draṣṭavyo devarājastvaddhīnastapasā iti || 37 ||
evaṃ sarve lokapālā niryayustasya tejasā |
pratyākhyātāśca tairviṣṇukiṃkarairhīnakarmaṇaḥ |
evaṃ sa satyalokāntaṃ gato rājā mahāmune || 38 ||
apunarmārake loke dāhapralayavarjjite |
adyāpi tiṣṭhate devaiḥ stūyamāno mahānṛpaḥ |
prasanne yajñapuruṣe kiṃ citraṃ yena tadbhavet || 39 ||
iha janmani saubhāgyamāyurārogyasampadaḥ |
ekaikā vidhinopāstā dadātyamṛtamuttamam || 40 ||
kiṃ punarvarṣasaṃpūrṇe sa dadāti svakaṃ padam |
nārāyaṇaścaturmūrttiḥ parārdhyaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ || 41 ||
yathaivoddhṛtavān vedān matsyarūpeṇa keśavaḥ |
kṣīrāmbudhau mathyamāne mandaraṃ dhṛtavān prabhuḥ |
tadvacca kūrmarūpākhyā dvitīyā paśya vaiṣṇavī || 42 ||
yathā rasātalāt kṣmāṃ ca dhṛtavān puruṣottamaḥ |
varāharūpī tadvacca tṛtīyā paśya vaiṣṇavī || 43 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
tadvat phālgunamāse tu śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm |
upoṣya proktavidhinā harimārādhayet sudhīḥ || 1 ||
narasiṃhāya pādau tu govindāyetyurū tathā |
kaṭiṃ viśvabhuje pūjya aniruddhetyurastathā || 2 ||
kaṇṭhaṃ tu śitikaṇṭhāya piṅgakeśāya vai śiraḥ |
asuradhvaṃsanāyeti cakraṃ toyātmane tathā |
śaṅkhamityeva saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpaphalaistathā || 3 ||
tadagre ghaṭamādāya sitavastrayugānvitam |
tasyopari nṛsihaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ tāmrabhājane |
sauvarṇa śaktitaḥ kṛtvā dāruvaṃśamaye'pi vā || 4 ||
ratnagarbhaghaṭe sthāpya taṃ saṃpūjya ca mānavaḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 5 ||
evaṃ kṛte phalaṃ prāptaṃ yat purā pārthivena tu |
tasyāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vatsanāmnā mahāmune || 6 ||
āsīt kiṃpuruṣe varṣe rājā paramadhārmikaḥ |
bhārateti ca vikhyātastasya vatsaḥ suto'bhavat || 7 ||
sa śatrubhirjitaḥ saṃkhye hṛtakośo dvipādavān |
vanaṃ prāyāt sapatnīko vasiṣṭhasyāśrame'vasat || 8 ||
kālena gacchatā so'tha vasiṣṭhena maharṣiṇā |
kiṃ kāryamiti sa prokto vasasyasmin mahāśrame || 9 ||
rājovāca |
bhagavan hṛtakośo'haṃ hṛtarājyo viśeṣataḥ |
śatrubhirhatasaṃkalpo bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 10 ||
evamukto vasiṣṭhastu tasyemāṃ dvādaśīṃ mune |
vidhinā pratyuvācātha so'pi sarvaṃ tathā'karot || 11 ||
tasya vratānte bhagavān nārasiṃhastutoṣa ha |
cakraṃ prādācca śatrūṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakaraṃ param || 12 ||
tenāstreṇa svakaṃ rājyaṃ jitavān sa nṛpottamaḥ |
rājye sthitvā'śvamedhānāṃ sahastramakarod vibhuḥ |
ante ca viṣṇulokākhyaṃ padamāpa ca sattama || 13 ||
eṣā dhanyā pāpaharā dvādaśī bhavato mune |
kathitā yā prayatnena śrutvā kuru yathepsitam || 14 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
evameva mune māsi caitre saṃkalpya dvādaśīm |
upoṣyārādhayet paścāt devadevaṃ janārdanam || 1 ||
vāmanāyeti pādau tu viṣṇave kaṭimarcayet |
vāsudeveti jaṭharamuraḥ saṃpūrṇakāya ca || 2 ||
kaṇṭhaṃ viśvakṛte pūjya śiro vai vyomarūpiṇe |
bāhū viśvajite pūjya svanāmnā śaṃkhacakrakau || 3 ||
anena vidhinābhyarcya devadevaṃ sanātanam |
prāgvadevottaraṃ kumbhaṃ sayugmaṃ purato nyaset || 4 ||
prāguktapātre saṃsthāpya vāmanaṃ kāñcanaṃ budhaḥ |
yathāśaktyā kṛtaṃ hrasvaṃ sitayajñopavītinam || 5 ||
kuṇḍikāṃ sthāpayet pārśve chatrikāṃ pāduke tathā |
akṣamālāṃ ca saṃsthāpya vṛsikāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 6 ||
etairupaskarairyuktaṃ prabhāte sa dvijātaye |
dāpayet prīyatāṃ viṣṇurhrasvarūpītyudīrayet || 7 ||
māsanāmnā tu saṃyuktaṃ prādurbhāvavidhānakam |
prīyatāmiti sarvatra vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ || 8 ||
śrūyate ca purā rājā haryaśvaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
aputraḥ sa tapastepe putramicchaṃstapodhanam || 9 ||
tasyaiva kurvato vyuṣṭiṃ putrārthe munisattama |
ājagāma hariḥ pūrvaṃ dvijarūpaṃ samāśritaḥ || 10 ||
uvāca tapasā rājan kiṃ te vyavasitaṃ prabho |
putrārthamiti provāca taṃ vipraḥ pratyuvāca ha || 11 ||
idameva vidhānaṃ tu kuru rājannuvāca ha |
evamuktvā tu rājānaṃ kṣaṇādantarhitaḥ prabhuḥ || 12 ||
rājā'pi taṃ cakārāśu mantravantaṃ dvijātaye |
daridrāya tathā prādāt jyotirgārgāya dhīmate || 13 ||
yathāditeraputrāyāḥ svayaṃ putratvamāgataḥ |
bhagavaṃstena satyena mamāpyastu suto varaḥ || 14 ||
anena vidhinā datte tasya putro'bhavanmune |
kuvalāśva iti khyātaścakravartī mahābalaḥ || 15 ||
aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam |
bhraṣṭarājyo labhed rājyaṃ mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 16 ||
kīrttitvā suciraṃ tatra iha martyamupāgataḥ |
cakravartī bhaved dhīmān yayātiriva nāhuṣaḥ || 17 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre trayaścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||
durvāsa uvāca |
vaiśākhe'pyevamevaṃ tu saṃkalpya vidhinā naraḥ |
tadvat snānādikaṃ kṛtvā tato devālayaṃ vrajet || 1 ||
tatrārādhya hariṃ bhaktyā ebhirmantrairvicakṣaṇaḥ |
jāmadagnyāya pādau tu udaraṃ sarvadhāriṇe |
madhusūdanāyeti kaṭimuraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe || 2 ||
kṣatrāntakāya ca bhujau maṇikaṇṭhāya kaṇṭhakam |
svanāmnā śaṅkhacakrau tu śiro brahmāṇḍadhāriṇe || 3 ||
evamabhyarcya medhāvī prāgvat tasyāgrato ghaṭam |
vinyasya sthagitaṃ tadvad vastrayugmena veṣṭitam || 4 ||
vaiṇavena tu pātreṇa tasmin saṃsthāpayeddharim |
jāmadagnyeti vikhyātaṃ nāmnā kleśavināśanam || 5 ||
dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ haste tasya devasya kārayet |
sarvagandhaiśca saṃpūjya puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 6 ||
tatastasyāgrataḥ kuryājjāgaraṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ |
prabhāte vimale sūrye brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
evaṃ niyamayuktasya yatphalaṃ tannibodha me || 7 ||
āsīd rājā mahābhāgo vīraseno mahābalaḥ |
aputraḥ sa purā tīvraṃ tapastepe mahaujasā || 8 ||
caratastattapo ghoraṃ yājñavalkyo mahāmuniḥ |
ājagāma mahāyogī taṃ dṛṣṭvā nātidūrataḥ || 9 ||
tamāyāntamatho dṛṣṭvā ṛṣiṃ paramavarcasam |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā rājābhyutthānamākarot || 10 ||
sa pūjito muniḥ prāha kimarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ |
rājan kathaya dharmajña kiṃ te kāryaṃ vivakṣitam || 11 ||
rājovāca |
aputro'haṃ mahābhāga nāsti me putrasaṃtatiḥ |
tena me tapa āṃsthāya kṛṣyate svatanurdvija || 12 ||
yājñavalkya uvāca |
alaṃ te tapasā'nena mahākleśena pārthiva |
alpāyāsena te putro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 13 ||
rājovāca |
kathaṃ me bhavitā putro alpāyāsena vai dvija |
etanme kathaya prīto bhagavan praṇatasya ha || 14 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
evamukto munistena pārthivena yaśasvinā |
ācakhyau dvādaśīṃ cemāṃ vaiśākhe sitapakṣajām || 15 ||
sa hi rājā vidhānena putrakāmo viśeṣataḥ |
upoṣya labdhavān putraṃ nalaṃ paramadhārmikam |
yo'dyāpi kīrtyate loke puṇyaśloko narottamaḥ || 16 ||
prāsaṅgikaṃ phalaṃ hyetad gatasyāsya mahāmune |
suputro jāyate vittavidyāvān kāntiruttamā || 17 ||
iha janmani kiṃ citraṃ paraloke śrṛṇuṣva me |
kalpamekaṃ brahmaloke vasitvā'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || 18 ||
krīḍatyante punaḥ sṛṣṭau cakravartī bhaved dhruvam |
triṃśatyabdasahastrāṇi jīvate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 19 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhavagacchāstre catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
jyeṣṭhamāse'pyevamevaṃ saṃkalpya vidhinā naraḥ |
arcayet paramaṃ devaṃ puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 1 ||
namo rāmābhirāmāya pādau pūrvaṃ samarcayet |
trivikramāyeti kaṭiṃ dhṛtaviśvāya codaram || 2 ||
uraḥ saṃvatsarāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ saṃvarttakāya ca |
sarvāstradhāriṇe bāhū svanāmnā'bjarathāṅgakau || 3 ||
sahastraśirase'bhyarcya śirastasya mahātmanaḥ |
evamabhyarcya vidhivat prāguktaṃ kumbhaṃ vinyaset || 4 ||
prāgvad vastrayugacchannau sauvarṇau rāmalakṣmaṇau |
arcayitvā vidhānena prabhāte brāhmaṇāya tau |
dātavyau manasā kāmamīhatā puruṣeṇa tu || 5 ||
aputreṇa purā pṛṣṭo rājñā daśarathena ca |
putrakāmaparaḥ paścād vasiṣṭhaḥ paramārcitaḥ || 6 ||
idameva vidhānaṃ tu kathayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ |
prāgrahasyaṃ viditvā tu sa rājā kṛtavānidam || 7 ||
tasya putraḥ svayaṃ jajñe rāmanāmā suto balī |
caturddhā so'vyayo viṣṇuḥ parituṣṭo mahāmune |
etadaihikamākhyātaṃ pāratrikamataḥ śrṛṇu || 8 ||
tāvad bhogān bhuñjate svargasaṃstho
yāvadindrā daśa ca dvidvisaṃkhyā |
atītakāle punaretya marttyo
bhaveta rājā śatayajñayājī |
naśyanti pāpāni ca tasya puṃsaḥ
prāpnoti nirvāṇamalaṃ ca śāśvatam || 9 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
durvāsā uvāca |
āṣāḍhe'pyevamevaṃ tu saṃkalpya vidhinā naraḥ |
arcayet paramaṃ devaṃ gandhapuṣpairanekaśaḥ || 1 ||
vāsudevāya pādau tu kaṭiṃ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca |
pradyumnāyeti jaṭharaṃ aniruddhāya vai uraḥ || 2 ||
cakrapāṇayeti bhujau kaṇṭhaṃ bhūpataye tathā |
svanāmnā śaṅkhacakrau tu puruṣāyeti vai śiraḥ || 3 ||
evamabhyarcya medhāvī prāgvattasyāgrato ghaṭam |
vinyasya vastrasaṃyuktaṃ tasyopari tato nyaset |
kāñcanaṃ vāsudevaṃ tu caturvyūhaṃ sanātanam || 4 ||
tamabhyarcya vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |
prāgvat taṃ brāhmaṇe dadyād vedavādini suvrate |
evaṃ niyamayuktasya yatpuṇyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me || 5 ||
vasudevo'bhavad rājā yaduvaṃśavivarddhanaḥ |
devakī tasya bhāryā tu samānavratadhāriṇī || 6 ||
sā tvaputrā'bhavat sādhvī patidharmaparāyaṇā |
tasya kālena mahatā nārado'bhyagamad gṛham || 7 ||
vasudevenāsau bhaktyā pūjito vākyamabravīt |
vasudeva śruṇuṣva tvaṃ devakāryaṃ mamānagha |
śrutvaitāṃ ca kathāṃ śīghramāgato'smi tavāntikam || 8 ||
pṛthivī devasamitau mayā dṛṣṭā yadūttama |
gatvā ca jalpatī bhāraṃ na śaktā ūhituṃ surāḥ || 9 ||
saubhakaṃsajarāsandhāḥ punarnaraka eva ca |
kurupāñcālabhojāśca balino dānavāḥ surāḥ |
pīḍayanti sametā māṃ tān hanadhvaṃ surottamāḥ || 10 ||
evamuktāḥ pṛthivyā te devā nārāyaṇaṃ gatāḥ |
manasā sa ca deveśaḥ pratyakṣastat kṣaṇāt babhau || 11 ||
uvāca ca suraśreṣṭhaḥ svayaṃ kāryamidaṃ surāḥ |
sādhayāmi na sandeho martyaṃ gatvā manuṣyavat || 12 ||
kiṃtvāṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe yā nārī saha bharttṛṇā |
upoṣyati manuṣyeṣu tasyā garbhe bhavāmyaham || 13 ||
evamuktvā gato devaḥ svayaṃ cāhamihāgataḥ |
upadiṣṭaṃ tu bhavato aputrasya viśeṣataḥ |

|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
śrutvā durvāsaso vākyaṃ dharaṇīvratamuttamam |
yayau satyatapāḥ sadyo himavatpārśvamuttamam || 1 ||
puṣpabhadrā nadī yatra śilā citraśilā tathā |
vaṭo bhadravaṭo yatra tatra tasyāśramo babhau |
tatropari mahat tasya caritaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 2 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
bahukalpasahastrāṇi vratasyāsya sanātana |
mayā kṛtasya tapasastanmayā vismṛtaṃ prabho || 3 ||
idānīṃ tvatprasādena smaraṇaṃ prāktanaṃ mama |
jātaṃ jātismarā cāsmi viśokā parameśvara || 4 ||
yadi nāma paraṃ deva kautukaṃ hṛdi vartate |
agastyaḥ punarāgatya bhadrāśvasya niveśanam |
yaccakāra sa rājā ca tanmamācakṣva bhūdhara || 5 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
pratyāgatamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadrāśvaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ |
varāsanagataṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā pūjāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
apṛcchanmokṣadharmākhyaṃ praśnaṃ sakaladhāriṇi || 6 ||
bhadrāśva uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena chidyate bhavasaṃsṛtiḥ |
kiṃ vā kṛtvā na śocanti mūrttāmūrttopapattiṣu || 7 ||
agastya uvāca |
śrṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyāṃ dūrāsannavyavasthitām |
dṛśyādṛśyavibhāgotthāṃ samāhitamanā nṛpa || 8 ||
nāho na rātrirna diśo'diśaśca
na dyaurna devā na dinaṃ na sūryaḥ |
tasmin kāle paśupāleti rājā
sa pālayāmāsa paśūnanekān || 9 ||
tān pālayan sa kadācid didṛkṣuḥ
pūrvaṃ samudraṃ ca jagāma tūrṇam |
anantapārasya mahodadhestu
tīre vanaṃ tatra vasanti sarpāḥ || 10 ||
aṣṭau drumāḥ kāmavahā nadī ca
turyak codrdhvaṃ babhramustatra cānye |
pañca pradhānāḥ puruṣāstathaikāṃ
striyaṃ bibhrate tejasā dīpyamānām || 11 ||
sā'pi strī sve vakṣasi dhārayantī sahastrasūryapratimaṃ viśālam |
tasyādharastrirvikārastrivarṇastaṃ rājānaṃ paśya paribhramantam || 12 ||
tūṣṇīṃbhūtā mṛtakalpā ivāsan nṛpo'pyasau tadvanaṃ saṃviveśa |
tasmin praviṣṭe sarva ete viviśurbhayādaikyaṃ gatavantaḥ kṣaṇena || 13 ||

saṃveṣṭito dasyubhiścintayānaḥ |
kathaṃ caitena bhaviṣyanti yena
kathaṃ caite saṃsṛtāḥ saṃbhaveyuḥ || 14 ||
evaṃ rājñaścintayatastrivarṇaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ |
śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ trivarṇaṃ dhārayannaraḥ || 15 ||
sa saṃjñāṃ kṛtavān mahyamaparo'tha kva yāsyasi |
evaṃ tasya bruvāṇasya mahannāma vyajāyata || 16 ||
tenāpi rājā saṃvītaḥ sa budhyasveti cābravīt |
evamukte tataḥ strī tu taṃ rājānaṃ rurodha ha || 17 ||
māyātataṃ taṃ mā bhaiṣṭa tato'nyaḥ puruṣo nṛpam |
saṃveṣṭya sthitavān vīrastataḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ || 18 ||
tato'nye pañca puruṣā āgatya nṛpasattamam |
saṃviṣṭya saṃsthitāḥ sarve tato rājā virodhitaḥ || 19 ||
ruddhe rājani te sarve ekībhūtāstu dasyavaḥ |
mathituṃ śastramādāya līnā'nyo'nyaṃ tato bhayāt || 20 ||
tairlīnairnṛparterveśma babhau paramaśobhanam |
anyeṣāmapi pāpānāṃ koṭiḥ sāgrābhavannṛpa || 21 ||
gṛhe bhūsalilaṃ vahniḥ sukhaśītaśca mārutaḥ |
sāvakāśāni śubhrāṇi pañcaikonaguṇāni ca || 22 ||
ekaiva teṣāṃ suciraṃ saṃveṣṭyāsajyasaṃsthitā |
evaṃ sa paśupālo'sau kṛtavānañjasā nṛpa || 23 ||
tasya tallāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ca nṛpatermṛdhe |
trivarṇaḥ puruṣo rājannabravīd rājasattamam || 24 ||
tvatputro'smi mahārāja brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te |
asmābhirbandhumicchadbhirbhavantaṃ niścayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 25 ||
yadi nāma kṛtāḥ sarve vayaṃ deva parājitāḥ |
evameva śarīreṣu līnāstiṣṭhāma pārthiva || 26 ||
maryyeke tava putratvaṃ gate sarveṣu saṃbhavaḥ |
evamuktastato rājā taṃ naraṃ punarabravīt || 27 ||

yuṣmatsukhairnarairbhāvairnāhaṃ lipye kadācana || 28 ||
evamuktvā sa nṛpatistamātmajamathākarot |
tairvimuktaḥ svayaṃ teṣāṃ madhye sa virarāma ha || 29 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||
agastya uvāca |
sa trivarṇo nṛpotsṛṣṭaḥ svatantratvācca pārthiva |
ahaṃ nāmānamasṛjat putraṃ putrastrivarṇakam || 1 ||
tasyāpi cābhavat kanyā avabodhasvarūpiṇī |
sā tu vijñānadaṃ putraṃ manohvaṃ visasarja || 2 ||
tasyāpi sarvarūpāḥ syustanayāḥ pañcabhoginaḥ |
yathāsaṃkhyena putrāstu teṣāmakṣābhidhānakāḥ || 3 ||
ete pūrvaṃ dasyavaḥ syustato rājñā vaśīkṛtāḥ |
amūrttā iva te sarve cakrurāyatanaṃ śubham || 4 ||
navadbāraṃ puraṃ tasya tvekastambhaṃ catuṣpatham |
nadīsahastrasaṃkīrṇa jalakṛtya samāsthitam || 5 ||
tatpuraṃ te praviviśurekībhūtāstato nava |
puruṣo mūrttimān rājā paśupālo'bhavat kṣaṇāt || 6 ||
tatastatpurasaṃsthastu paśupālo mahānṛpaḥ |
saṃsūcya vācakāñchabdān vedān sasmāra tatpure || 7 ||
ātmasvarūpiṇo nityāstaduktāni vratāni ca |
niyamān kratavaścaiva sarvān rājā cakāra ha || 8 ||
sa kadācinnṛpaḥ khinnaḥ karmakāṇḍaṃ prarocayan |
sarvajño yoganidrāyāṃ sthitvā putraṃ sasarja ha || 9 ||
caturvaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ caturvedaṃ catuṣpatham |
tasmādārabhya nṛpatervaśe paśvādayaḥ sthitāḥ || 10 ||
tasmin samudre sa nṛpo vane tasmiṃstathaiva ca |
tṛṇādiṣu nṛpassaiva hastyādiṣu tathaiva ca |
samobhavat karmakāṇḍādanujñāya mahāmate || 11 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre dvāpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||
bhadrāśva uvāca |
matpraśnaviṣaye brahman katheyaṃ kathitā tvayā |
tasyā vibhūtirabhavat kasya kena kṛtena ha || 1 ||
agastya uvāca |
āgateyaṃ kathā citrā sarvasya viṣaye sthitā |
tvaddehe mama dehe ca sarvajantuṣu sā samā || 2 ||
tasyāṃ saṃbhūtimicchan yastasyopāyaṃ svayaṃ param |
paśupālāt samutpanno yaścatuṣpāccaturmukhaḥ || 3 ||

tasya putraḥ svaro nāma saptamūrtiṃrasau smṛtaḥ || 4 ||

ṛgarthānāṃ caturbhiste tadbhaktyārādhyatāṃ yayuḥ || 5 ||
caturṇāṃ prathamo yastu catuḥśrṛṅgasamāsthitaḥ |
vṛṣadvitīyastatproktamārgeṇaiva tṛtīyakaḥ |
caturthastatpraṇītastāṃ pūjya bhaktyā sutaṃ vrajet || 6 ||
saptamūrttestu caritaṃ śuśruṃvuḥ prathamaṃ nṛpa |
brahmacaryeṇa vartteta dvitīyo'sya sanātanaḥ || 7 ||

ahamasmi vadatyanyaścaturddhā ekadhā dvidhā |
bhedabhinnasahotpannāstasyāpatyāni jajñire || 9 ||

cintayāmāsa janakaṃ kathaṃ paśyāmyahaṃ nṛpa || 10 ||
madīyasya piturye hi guṇā āsan mahātmanaḥ |
na te samprati dṛśyante svarāpatyeṣu keṣucit || 11 ||
pituḥ putrasya yaḥ putraḥ sa pitāmahanāmavān |
evaṃ śrutiḥ sthitā ceyaṃ svarāpatyeṣu nānyathā || 12 ||

evaṃ nīte'pi kiṃ kāryamiti cintāparo'bhavat || 13 ||
tasya cintayataḥ śastraṃ pitṛkaṃ purato babhau |
tena śastreṇa taṃ roṣānmamantha svaramantike || 14 ||
tasmin mathitamātre tu śirastasyāpi durgraham |
nālikeraphalākāraṃ caturvaktro'nvapaśyata || 15 ||
taccāvṛtaṃ pradhānena daśadhā saṃvṛto babhau |
catuṣpādena śastreṇa ciccheda tilakāṇḍavat || 16 ||
prakāmaṃ tilasaṃcchinne tadamūlau na me babhau |
ahaṃ tvahaṃ vadan bhūtaṃ tamapyevamathācchinat || 17 ||
tasmin chinne tadasyāṃse hrasvamanyamavekṣata |
ahaṃ bhūtādi vaḥ pañca vadantaṃ bhūtimantikāt || 18 ||
tamapyevamatho chittvā pañcāśūnyamamīkṣata |
kṛtvāvakāśaṃ te sarve jalpanta idamantikāt || 19 ||
tamapyasaṅgaśastreṇa ciccheda tilakāṇḍavat |
tasmiṃcchinne daśāṃśena hrasvamanyamapaśyata || 20 ||
puruṣaṃ rūpaśastreṇa taṃ chittvā'nyamapaśyata |
tadvad hrasvaṃ sitaṃ saumyaṃ tamapyevaṃ tadā'karot || 21 ||
evaṃ kṛte śarīraṃ tu dadarśa sa punaḥ prabhuḥ |
svakīyamevākasyāntaḥ pitaraṃ nṛpasattama || 22 ||
trasareṇusamaṃ mūrtyā avyaktaṃ sarvajantuṣu |
samaṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ harṣaṃ ubhe visasvarārttavit || 23 ||
evaṃvidho'sau puruṣaḥ svaranāmā mahātapāḥ |
mūrttistasya pravṛttākhyaṃ nivṛttākhyaṃ śiro mahat || 24 ||
etasmādeva tasyāśu kathayā rājasattama |
saṃbhūtirabhavad rājan vivṛttestveṣa eva tu || 25 ||
eṣetihāsaḥ prathamaḥ sarvasya jagato bhṛśam |
ya imaṃ vetti tattvena sākṣāt karmaparo bhavet || 26 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre tripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||
bhadrāśva uvāca |
vijñānotpattikāmasya ka ārādhyo bhaved dvija |
kathaṃ cārādhyate'sau hi etadākhyāhi me dvija || 1 ||
agastya uvāca |
viṣṇureva sadārādhyaḥ sarvadevairapi prabhuḥ |
tasyopāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yenāsau varado bhavet || 2 ||

nārāyaṇaḥ paro devastaṃ praṇamya na sīdati || 3 ||

kathitaṃ tuṣṭidaṃ viṣṇorvrtamapsarasāṃ tathā || 4 ||

snānārthaṃ tatra cajāpaśyat sarvamapsarasāṃ gaṇam || 5 ||

devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ didṛkṣuṃ kalahapriyam |

apsarasa ūcuḥ |

nārada uvāca |

vasante śuklapakṣasya dvādaśī yā bhavecchubhā |

tasyopari tataḥ puṣpairmaṇḍapaṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
nṛtyavāditrageyaiśca jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet || 14 ||
manobhavāyeti śira anaṅgāyeti vai kaṭim |
kāmāya bāhumūle tu suśāstrāyeti codaram || 15 ||
manmathāyeti pādau tu harayeti ca sarvataḥ |
puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ mallikājātibhistathā || 16 ||
paścāccatura ādāya ikṣudaṇḍān suśobhanān |
caturdikṣu nyaset tasya devasya praṇato nṛpa || 17 ||

vedavedāṅgayuktāya saṃpūrṇāṅgāya dhīmate || 18 ||

avamānasya tasyāyaṃ vipāko vo bhaviṣyati || 20 ||

agastya uvāca |

|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre catuḥpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||
agastya uvāca |
śrṛṇu rājan mahābhāga vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam |
yena saṃprāpyate viṣṇuḥ śubhenaiva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 ||

sitavastrayugacchannāṃ sarvabījasamanvitām |

vastrayugmaṃ ca dātavyaṃ yathāvibhavaśaktitaḥ || 15 ||

evaṃ kṛte tathā kṛṣṇaśukladvādaśyameva ca || 16 ||

rājovāca |

rājovāca |
kṣarākṣaraṃ kṣīrasamudraśāyinaṃ
kṣitīdharaṃ mūrtimatāṃ paraṃ padam |
atīndriyaṃ viśvabhujāṃ puraḥ kṛtaṃ
nirākṛtaṃ staumi janārdanaṃ prabhum || 31 ||
tvamādidevaḥ paramārtharūpī
vibhuḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣottamaśca |
atīndriyo vedavidāṃ pradhānaḥ
prapāhi māṃ śaṅkhagadāstrapāṇe || 32 ||
kṛtaṃ tvayā deva surāsurāṇāṃ
saṃkīrtyate'sau ca anantamūrte |
sṛṣṭyarthametat tava deva viṣṇo
na ceṣṭitaṃ kūṭagatasya tatsyāt || 33 ||
tathaiva kūrmatvamṛgatvamuccaistvayā kṛtaṃ rūpamanekarūpa |
sarvajñabhāvādasakṛcca janma saṃkīrttyate te'cyuta naitadasti || 34 ||
nṛsiṃha namo vāmana jamadagnināma
daśāsyagotrāntaka vāsudeva |
namo'stu te buddha kalkin khageśa
śaṃbho namaste vibudhārināśana || 35 ||
namo'stu nārāyaṇa padmanābha
namo namaste puruṣottamāya |
namaḥ samastāmarasaṅghapūjya
namo'stu te sarvavidāṃ pradhāna || 36 ||
namaḥ karālāsya nṛsiṃhamūrtte
namo viśālādrisamāna kūrma |
namaḥ samudrapratimāna matsya
namāmi tvāṃ kroḍarūpinananta || 37 ||
sṛṣṭyarthametat tava deva ceṣṭitaṃ
na mukhyapakṣe tava mūrttitā vibho |
ajānatā dhyānamidaṃ prakāśitaṃ
naibhirvinā lakṣyase tvaṃ purāṇa || 38 ||
ādyo makhastvaṃ svayameva viṣṇo
makhāṅgabhūto'si havistvameva |
paśurbhavān ṛtvigijyaṃ tvameva
tvāṃ devasaṅghā munayo yajanti || 39 ||
yadetasmin jagadhruvaṃ calācalaṃ
surādikālānalasaṃsthamuttamam |
na tvaṃ vibhakto'si janārdaneśa
prayaccha siddhiṃ hṛdayepsitāṃ me || 40 ||
namaḥ kamalapatrākṣa mūrttāmūrtta namo hare |
śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapanno'smi saṃsārānmāṃ samuddhara || 41 ||
evaṃ stutastadā devastena rājñā mahātmanā |
viśālāmratalasthena tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ || 42 ||
kubjarūpī tato bhūtvā ājagāma hariḥ svayam |
tasminnāgatamātre tu sīpyāmraḥ kubjako'bhavat || 43 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ sa rājā saṃśitavrataḥ |
viśālasya kathaṃ kaubjyamiti cintāparobhavat || 44 ||
tasya cintayato buddhirbabhau taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati |
anenāgatamātreṇa kṛtametanna saṃśayaḥ || 45 ||
tasmādeṣaiva bhavitā bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
evamuktvā namaścakre tasya viprasya sa nṛpaḥ || 46 ||
anugrahāya bhagavan nūnaṃ tvaṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
āgato'si svarūpaṃ me darśayasvādhunā hare || 47 ||
evamuktastadā devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
babhau tatpurataḥ saumyo vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 48 ||
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva rājendra yatte manasi vartate |
mayi prasanne trailokya tilamātramidaṃ nṛpa || 49 ||
evamuktastato rājā harṣotphullitalocanaḥ |
mokṣaṃ prayaccha deveśetyuktvā novāca kiṃcana || 50 ||
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavān punarvākyamuvāca ha |
mayyāgate viśālo'yamāmraḥ kubjatvamāgataḥ |
yasmāt tasmāt tīrthamidaṃ kubjakāmraṃ bhaviṣyati || 51 ||
tiryagyonyādayo'pyasmin brāhmaṇāntā yadi svakam |
kalevaraṃ tyajiṣyanti teṣāṃ pañcaśatāni ca |
vimānāni bhaviṣyanti yogināṃ muktireva ca || 52 ||
evamuktvā nṛpaṃ devaḥ śaṅkhāgreṇa janārdanaḥ |
pasparśa spṛṣṭamātro'sau paraṃ nirvāṇamāptavān || 53 ||
tasmāttvamapi rājendra taṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja |
yena bhūyaḥ punaḥ śocyapadavīṃ no prayāsyasi || 54 ||
ya idaṃ śrṛṇuyānnityaṃ prātarutthāya mānavaḥ |
paṭhed yaścaritaṃ tābhyāṃ mokṣadharmārthado bhavet || 55 ||
śubhavratamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaśca kuryājjaneśvara |
sa sarvasampadaṃ ceha bhuktvete tallayaṃ vrajet || 56 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||
agastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhanyavratamanuttamam |
yena sadyo bhaved dhanya adhanyo'pi hi yo bhavet || 1 ||
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe pratipad yā tithirbhavet |
tasyāṃ naktaṃ prakurvīta viṣṇumagniṃ prapūjayet || 2 ||
vaiśvānarāya pādau tu agnayetyudaraṃ tathā |
havirbhuṃjāya ca uro draviṇodeti vai bhujo || 3 ||
saṃvarttāyeti ca śiro jvalanāyeti sarvataḥ |
abhyarcyaivaṃ vidhānena devadevaṃ janārdanam || 4 ||
tasyaiva purataḥ kuṇḍaṃ kārayitvā vighānataḥ |
homaṃ tatra prakurvīta ebhirmantrairvicakṣaṇaḥ || 5 ||
tataḥ saṃyāvakaṃ cānnaṃ bhuñjīyād ghṛtasaṃyutam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe'pyevameva cāturmāsyaṃ tu yāvataḥ || 6 ||
caitrādiṣu ca bhuñjīta pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ budhaḥ |
śrāvaṇādiṣu saktūṃśca tataścaitat samāpyate || 7 ||
samāpte tu vrate vahniṃ kāñcanaṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
raktavastrayugacchannaṃ raktapuṣpānulepanam || 8 ||
kuṅkumena tathā lipya brāhmaṇaṃ devadeva ca |
sarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ priyadarśanam || 9 ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena raktavastrayugena ca |
paścāt taṃ dāpayet tasya mantreṇānena buddhimān || 10 ||
dhanyo'smi dhanyakarmā'smi dhanyaceṣṭo'smi dhanyavān |
dhanyenānena cīrṇena vratena syāṃ sadā sukhī || 11 ||
evamuccārya taṃ vipre nyasya kośaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
sadyo dhanyatvamāpnoti yo'pi syād bhāgyavarjitaḥ || 12 ||
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca puṣkalam |
anena kṛtamātreṇa jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 13 ||
prāgjanmajanitaṃ pāpamagnirdahati tasya ha |
dagdhe pāpe vimuktātmā iha janmanyasau bhavet || 14 ||
yo'pīdaṃ śrṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaśca bhaktyā paṭhed dvijaḥ |
ubhau tāviha loke tu dhanyau sadyo bhaviṣyataḥ || 15 ||
śrūyate ca vrataṃ caitaccīrṇamāsīnmahātmanā |
dhanadena purā kalpe śūdrayonau sthitena tu || 16 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ṣaṭpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||
agastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāntivratamanuttamam |
yatkṛtvā tu purā somaḥ kāntimānabhavat punaḥ || 1 ||
yakṣmaṇā dakṣaśāpena purākrānto niśākaraḥ |
etaccīrtvā vrataṃ sadyaḥ kāntimānabhavat kila || 2 ||
dvitīyāyāṃ tu rājendra kārttikasya site dine |
naktaṃ kurvīta yatnena arcayan balakeśavam || 3 ||
baladevāya pādau tu keśavāya śiro'rcayet |
evamabhyarcya medhāvī vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpamuttamam || 4 ||
parasvarūpaṃ somākhyaṃ dvikalaṃ taddine hi yat |
tasyārghaṃ dāpayed dhīmān mantreṇa parameṣṭhinaḥ || 5 ||
namo'stvamṛtarūpāya sarvauṣadhinṛpāya ca |
yajñalokādhipataye somāya paramātmane || 6 ||
anenaiva ca mārgeṇa dattvārghyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
rātrau savipro bhuñjīta yavānnaṃ saghṛtaṃ naraḥ || 7 ||
phālgunādicatuṣke tu pāyasaṃ bhojayecchuciḥ |
śālihomaṃ tu kurvīta kārttike tu yavaistathā || 8 ||
āṣāḍhādicatuṣke tu tilahomaṃ tu kārayet |
tadvat tilānnaṃ bhuñjīta eṣa eva vidhikramaḥ || 9 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe śaśinaṃ kṛtarājatam |
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ sitapuṣpānulepanam |
evameva dvijaṃ pūjya tatastaṃ pratipādayet || 10 ||
kāntimānapi loke'smin sarvajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ |
tvatprasādāt somarūpin nārāyaṇa namo'stu te || 11 ||
anena kila mantreṇa dattvā viprāya vāgyataḥ |
dattamātre tatastasmin kāntimān jāyate naraḥ || 12 ||
ātreyeṇāpi somena kṛtametat purā nṛpa |
tasya vratānte saṃtuṣṭaḥ svayameva janārdanaḥ |
yakṣmāṇamapanīyāśu amṛtākhyāṃ kalāṃ dadau || 13 ||
tāṃ kalāṃ somarājā'sau tapasā labdhavāniti |
somatvaṃ cāgamat so'sya oṣadhīnāṃ patirbabhau || 14 ||
dvitīyāmaśvinau somabhujau kīrtyete taddine nṛpa |
tau śeṣaviṣṇū vikhyātau mukhyapakṣau na saṃśayaḥ || 15 ||
na viṣṇorvyatiriktaṃ syād daivataṃ nṛpasattama |
nāmabhedena sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 16 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saptapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||
agastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ mahārāja saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ vratam |
śrṛṇu yenāśu saubhāgyaṃ strīpuṃsāmupajāyate || 1 ||
phālgunasya tu māsasya tṛtīyā śuklapakṣataḥ |
upāsitavyā naktena śucinā satyavādinā || 2 ||
saśrīkaṃ ca hariṃ pūjya rudraṃ vā comayā saha |
yā śrīḥ sā girijā proktā yo hariḥ sa trilocanaḥ || 3 ||
evaṃ sarveṣu śāstreṣu purāṇeṣu ca paṭhyate |
etasmādanyathā yastu brūte śāstraṃ pṛthaktayā || 4 ||
rudro janānāṃ martyānāṃ kāvyaṃ śāstraṃ na tadbhavet |
viṣṇuṃ rudrakṛtaṃ brūyāt śrīrgaurī na tu pārthiva |
tannāstikānāṃ martyānāṃ kāvyaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 5 ||
evaṃ jñātvā salakṣmīkaṃ hariṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ |
mantreṇānena rājendra tatastaṃ parameśvaram || 6 ||
gambhīrāyeti pādau tu subhagāyeti vai kaṭim |
udaraṃ devadeveti trinetrāyeti vai mukham |
vācaspataye ca śiro rudrāyeti ca sarvataḥ || 7 ||
evamabhyarcya medhāvī viṣṇuṃ lakṣmyā samanvitam |
haraṃ vā gaurisaṃyuktaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || 8 ||
tatastasyāgrato homaṃ kārayenmadhusarpiṣā |
tilaiḥ saha mahārāja saubhāgyapatayeti ca || 9 ||
tatastvakṣāravirasaṃ nisnehaṃ dharaṇītale |
godhūmānnaṃ tu bhuñjīta kṛṣṇepyevaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
āṣāḍhādidvitīyāṃ tu pāraṇaṃ tatra bhojanam || 10 ||
yavānnaṃ tu tataḥ paścāt kārttikādiṣu pārthiva |
śyāmākaṃ tatra bhuñjīta trīn māsān niyataḥ śuciḥ || 11 ||
tato māghasite pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ narādhipa |
sauvarṇāṃ kārayed gaurīṃ rudraṃ caikatra buddhimān || 12 ||
salakṣmīkaṃ hariṃ cāpi yathāśaktyā prasannadhīḥ |
tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyāt pātrabhūte vicakṣaṇe || 13 ||
annena hīne vedānāṃ pārage sādhuvartini |
sadācāreti vā dadyādalpavitte viśeṣataḥ || 14 ||
ṣaḍbhiḥ pātrairupetaṃ tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
ekaṃ madhumayaṃ pātraṃ dvitīyaṃ ghṛtapūritam || 15 ||
tṛtīyaṃ tilatailasya caturthaṃ guḍasaṃyutam |
pañcamaṃ lavaṇaiḥ pūrṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ gokṣīrasaṃyutam || 16 ||
etāni dattvā pātrāṇi saptajanmāntaraṃ bhavet |
subhago darśanīyaśca nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā || 17 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre aṣṭapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||
agastya uvāca |
athāvighnakaraṃ rājan kathayāmi śrṛṇuṣva me |
yena samyak kṛtenāpi na vighnamupajāyate || 1 ||
caturthyāṃ phālgune māsi grahītavyaṃ vrataṃ tvidam |
naktāhāreṇa rājendra tilānnaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam |
tadevāgnau tu hotavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca tad bhavet || 2 ||
cāturmāsyaṃ vrataṃ caitat kṛtvā vai pañca me tathā |
sauvarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ tu kṛtvā viprāya dāpayet || 3 ||
pāyasaiḥ pañcabhiḥ pātrairupetaṃ tu tilaistathā |
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caitat sarvavighnairvimucyate || 4 ||
hayamedhasya vighne tu saṃjāte sagaraḥ purā |
etadeva caritvā tu hayamedhaṃ samāptavān || 5 ||
tathā rudreṇa devena tripuraṃ nighnatā purā |
etadeva kṛtaṃ tasmāt tripuraṃ tena pātitam |
mayā samudraṃ pibatā etadeva kṛtaṃ vratam || 6 ||
anyairapi mahīpālairetadeva kṛtaṃ purā |
tapo'rthibhirjñānakṛtairnirvighnārthe paraṃtapa || 7 ||
śūrāya dhīrāya gajānanāya
lambodarāyaikadaṃṣṭrāya caiva |
evaṃ pūjyastaddine tat punaśca
homaṃ kuryād vighnavināśahetoḥ || 8 ||
anena kṛtamātreṇa sarvavighnairvimucyate |
vināyakasya kṛpayā kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet || 9 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre navapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
agastya uvāca |
śāntivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi tava rājan śrṛṇuṣva tat |
yena cīrṇena śāntiḥ syāt sarvadā gṛhamedhinām || 1 ||
pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārttike māsi suvrata |
ārabhed varṣamekaṃ tu bhuñjīyādamlavarjitam || 2 ||
naktaṃ devaṃ tu saṃpūjya hariṃ śeṣopari sthitam |
anantāyeti pādau tu vāsukāyeti vai kaṭim || 3 ||
takṣakāyeti jaṭharamuraḥ karkoṭakāya ca |
padmāya kaṇṭhaṃ saṃpūjya mahāpadmāya doryugam || 4 ||
śaṅkhapālāya vaktraṃ tu kuṭilāyeti vai śiraḥ |
evaṃ viṣṇugataṃ pūjya pṛthaktvena ca pūjayet || 5 ||
kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kuryāt tānuddiśya hareḥ punaḥ |
tadagre homayet kṣīraṃ tilaiḥ saha vicakṣaṇaḥ || 6 ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam |
nāgaṃ tu kāñcanaṃ kuryād brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 7 ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vratametannarādhipaḥ |
tasya śāntirbhavennityaṃ nāgānāṃ na bhayaṃ tathā || 8 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
agastya uvāca |
kāmavrataṃ mahārāja śrṛṇu me gadato'dhunā |
yena kāmāḥ samṛddhyante manasā cintitā api || 1 ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano yastu varṣamekaṃ vrataṃ caret |
pauṣamāsasite pakṣe caturthyāṃ kṛtabhojanaḥ || 2 ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu pārayed dhīmān prathamaṃ tu phalaṃ nṛpa |
tato bhuñjīta yatnena vāgyataḥ śuddhamodanam || 3 ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ saha rājendra athavā kevalaiḥ phalaiḥ |
tamekaṃ divasaṃ sthitvā saptamyāṃ pārayennṛpa || 4 ||
agnikāryaṃ tu kurvīta guharūpeṇa keśavam |
pūjayitvābhidhānena varṣamekaṃ vrataṃ caret || 5 ||
ṣaḍvaktra kārttika guha senānī kṛttikāsuta |
kumāra skanda ityevaṃ pūjyo viṣṇuḥ svanāmabhiḥ || 6 ||
samāptau tu vratasyāsya kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam |
ṣaṇmukhaṃ sarvasauvarṇaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 7 ||
sarve kāmāḥ samṛddhyantāṃ mama deva kumāraka |
tvatprasādādimaṃ bhaktyā gṛhyatāṃ vipra māciram || 8 ||
anena dattvā mantreṇa brāhmaṇāya sayugmakam |
tataḥ kāmāḥ samṛddhyante sarve vai iha janmani || 9 ||
aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam |
bhraṣṭarājyo labhed rājyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 10 ||
etad vrataṃ purā cīrṇaṃ nalena nṛpasattama |
ṛtuparṇasya viṣaye vasatā vratacaryayā || 11 ||
tathā rājyacyutairanyairbahubhirnṛpasattamaiḥ |
paurāṇikaṃ vrataṃ caiva siddhyarthaṃ nṛpasattama || 12 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||
agastya uvāca |
athāparaṃ mahārāja vratamārogyasaṃjñitam |
kathayāmi paraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 1 ||
tasyaiva māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
pūjayed bhāskaraṃ devaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ sanātanam || 2 ||
āditya bhāskara rave bhāno sūrya divākara |
prabhākareti saṃpūjya evaṃ saṃpūjyate raviḥ || 3 ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva kṛtāhāraḥ saptamyāṃ bhānumarcayet |
aṣṭamyāṃ caiva bhuñjīta eṣa eva vidhikramaḥ || 4 ||
anena vatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ vidhinā yo'rcayed ravim |
tasyārogyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyamiha janmami jāyate |
paratra ca śubhaṃ sthānaṃ yad gatvā na nivartate || 5 ||
sārvabhaumaḥ purā rājā anaraṇyo mahābalaḥ |
tenāyamarcito devo vratenānena pārthiva |
tasya tuṣṭo varaṃ devaḥ prādādārogyamuttamam || 6 ||
bhadrāśva uvāca |
kimasau rogavān rājā yenārogyamavāptavān |
sārvabhaumasya ca kathaṃ brahman rogasya saṃbhavaḥ || 7 ||
agastya uvāca |
sa rājā sārvabhaumo'bhūd yaśasvī ca surūpavān |
sa kadācinnṛpaśreṣṭho nṛpaśreṣṭha mahābalaḥ ||8 ||
gatavān mānasaṃ divyaṃ saro devagaṇānvitam |
tatrāpaśyad bṛhad padmaṃ saromadhyagataṃ sitam || 9 ||
tatra cāṅguṣṭhamātraṃ tu sthitaṃ puruṣasattamam |
raktavāsobhirāchannaṃ dvibhujaṃ tigmatejasam || 10 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sārathiṃ prāha padmametat samānaya |
idaṃ tu śirasā bibhrat sarvalokasya sannidhau |
ślāghanīyo bhaviṣyāmi tasmādāhara māciram || 11 ||
evamuktastadā tena sārathiḥ praviveśa ha |
grahītumupacakrāma taṃ padmaṃ nṛpasattama || 12 ||
spṛṣṭamātre tataḥ padme huṅkāraḥ samajāyata |
tena śabdena sa trastaḥ papāta ca mamāra ca || 13 ||
rājā ca tatkṣaṇāt tena śabdena samapadyata |
kuṣṭhī vigatavarṇaśca balavīryavivarjitaḥ || 14 ||
tathāgatamathātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa puruṣarṣabhaḥ |
tasthau tatraiva śokārttaḥ kimetaditi cintayan || 15 ||
tasya cintayato dhīmānājagāma mahātapāḥ |
vasiṣṭho brahmaputro'tha taṃ sa papraccha pārthivam || 16 ||

tāpasa uvāca |

bhadrāśva uvāca |

tretāyāṃ yajñarūpeṇa pañcarātraistu dvāpare || 25 ||

agastya uvāca |

saṃkhyāṃ cāpi samudrāṇāṃ dvīpānāṃ caiva vistaram || 1 ||
yāvanti caiva varṣāṇi teṣu nadyaśca yāḥ smṛtāḥ |
mahābhūtapramāṇaṃ ca gatiṃ candrārkayoḥ pṛthak || 2 ||
dvīpabhedasahastrāṇi saptasvantargatāni ca |
na śakyante krameṇeha vaktuṃ yairvitataṃ jagat || 3 ||
saptadvīpān pravakṣyāmi candrādityagrahaiḥ saha |
yeṣāṃ manuṣyāstarkeṇa pramāṇāni pracakṣate || 4 ||
acintyāḥ khalu ye bhāvā na tāṃstarkeṇa sādhayet |
prakṛtibhyaḥ paraṃ yacca tadacintyaṃ vibhāvyate || 5 ||
nava varṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi jambūdvīpaṃ yathātatham |
vistarānmaṇḍalāccaiva yojanaistannibodhata || 6 ||
śatamekaṃ sahastrāṇāṃ yojanānāṃ samantataḥ |
nānājanapadākīrṇaṃ yojanairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 7 ||
siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ parvatairupaśobhitam |
sarvadhātuvivṛddhaiśca śilājālasamudbhavaiḥ |
parvataprabhavābhiśca nadībhiḥ sarvataścitam || 8 ||
jambūdvīpaḥ pṛthuḥ śrīmān sarvataḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ |
navabhiścāvṛtaḥ śrīmān bhuvanairbhūtabhāvanaḥ || 9 ||
lavaṇena samudreṇa sarvataḥ parivāritaḥ |
jambūdvīpasya vistārāt samena tu samantataḥ || 10 ||
tasya prāgāyatā dīrghā ṣaḍete varṣaparvatāḥ |
ubhayatrāvagāḍhāśca samudrau pūrvapaścimau || 11 ||
himaprāyaśca himavān hemakūṭaśca hemavān |
sarvatra susukhaścāpi niṣadhaḥ parvato mahān || 12 ||
caturvarṇaḥsa sauvarṇo meruścolbamayo giriḥ |
vṛttākṛtipramāṇaśca caturastraḥ samucchitaḥ || 13 ||
nānāvarṇastu pārśveṣu prajāpatiguṇānvitaḥ |
nābhimaṇḍalasaṃbhūto brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 14 ||
pūrvataḥ śvetavarṇastu brahmaṇyaṃ tena tasya tat |
pītaśca dakṣiṇenāsau tena vaiśyatvamiṣyate || 15 ||
bhṛṅgapatranibhaścāsau paścimena yato'tha saḥ |
tenāsya śūdratā proktā merornāmārthakarmaṇaḥ || 16 ||
pārśvamuttaratastasya raktavarṇaṃ vibhāvyate|
tenāsya kṣatrabhāvaḥ syāditi varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 17 ||
vṛttaḥ svabhāvataḥ prokto varṇataḥ parimāṇataḥ |
nīlaśca vaidūryamayaḥ śvetaśuklo hiraṇmayaḥ |
mayūrabarhivarṇastu śātakaumbhaśca śrṛṅgavān || 18 ||
ete parvatarājānaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitāḥ |
teṣāmantaraviṣkambho navasāhastra ucyate || 19 ||
madhye tvilāvṛtaṃ nāma mahāmeroḥ sa saṃbhavaḥ |
navaiva tu sahastrāṇi vistīrṇaḥ sarvataśca saḥ || 20 ||
madhyaṃ tasya mahāmerurvidhūma iva pāvakaḥ |
vedyarddhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ meroruttarārddhaṃ tathottaram || 21 ||
varṣāṇi yāni ṣaḍatra teṣāṃ te varṣaparvatāḥ |
yojanāgraṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ tad vidhīyate || 22 ||
dve dve varṣe sahastrāṇāṃ yojanānāṃ samucchrayaḥ |
jambūdvīpasya vistārasteṣāmāyāma ucyate || 23 ||
yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi śatau dvau cāyatau girī |
nīlaśca niṣadhaścaiva tābhyāṃ hīnāśca ye pare |
śvetaśca hemakūṭaśca himavāñchṛṅgavāṃśca yaḥ || 24 ||
jambūdvīpapramāṇena niṣadhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
tasmād dvādaśabhāgena hemakūṭaḥ prahīyate |
himavān viṃśabhāgena hemakūṭāt prahīyate || 25 ||
aṣṭāśītisahastrāṇi hemakūṭo mahāgiriḥ |
aśītirhimavān śaila āyataḥ pūrvapaścime || 26 ||
dvīpasya maṇḍalībhāvād hrāsavṛddhī prakīrtyate |
varṣāṇāṃ parvatānāṃ ca yathā ceme tathottaram || 27 ||
teṣāṃ madhye janapadāstāni varṣāṇi caiva tat |
prapātaviṣamaistaistu parvatairāvṛtāni tu || 28 ||
saṃtatāni nadībhedairagamyāni parasparam |
vasanti teṣu sattvāni nānājātīni sarvaśaḥ || 29 ||
etaddhaimavataṃ varṣaṃ bhāratī yatra santatiḥ |
hemakūṭaṃ paraṃ yatra nāmnā kiṃpuruṣottamaḥ || 30 ||
hemakūṭāt tu niṣadhaṃ harivarṣaṃ taducyate |
harivarṣāt paraṃ caiva merupārśva ilāvṛtam || 31 ||
ilāvṛtāt paraṃ nīlaṃ ramyakaṃ nāma viśrutam |
ramyakācca paraṃ śvetaṃ viśrutaṃ taddhiraṇmayam |
hiraṇmayāt paraṃ caiva śrṛṅgavantaṃ kuru smṛtam || 32 ||
dhanuḥsaṃsthe tu dve varṣe vijñeye dakṣiṇottare |
dvīpāni khalu catvāri caturastramilāvṛtam || 33 ||
arvāk ca niṣadhasyātha vedyardhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ smṛtam |
paraṃ śrṛṅgavato yacca vedyardhaṃ hi taduttaram || 34 ||
vedyarddhe dakṣiṇe trīṇi varṣāṇi trīṇi cottare |
tayormadhye tu vijñeyo yatra merustvilāvṛtaḥ || 35 ||
dakṣiṇena tu nīlasya niṣadhasyottareṇa ca |
udagāyato mahāśailo mālyavānnāma parvataḥ || 36 ||
yojanānāṃ sahastre dve viṣkambhocchraya eva ca |
āyāmataścatustriṃśat sahastrāṇi prakīrtitaḥ || 37 ||
tasya pratīcyāṃ vijñeyaḥ parvato gandhamādanaḥ |
āyāmocchrayavistārāt tulyo mālyavatā tu saḥ || 38 ||
parimaṇḍalastayormadhye meruḥ kanakaparvataḥ |
caturvarṇaḥ sasauvarṇaścaturastraḥ samucchritaḥ || 39 ||
avyaktā dhātavaḥ sarve samutpannā jalādayaḥ |
avyaktāt pṛthivīpadmaṃ merustasya ca karṇikā || 40 ||
catuṣpatraṃ samutpannaṃ vyaktaṃ pañcaguṇaṃ mahat |
tataḥ sarvāḥ samudbhūtā vitatā hi pravṛttayaḥ || 41 ||
anekakalpajīvadbhiḥ puruṣaiḥ puṇyakāribhiḥ |
kṛtātmabhirmahātmabhiḥ prāpyate puruṣottamaḥ || 42 ||
mahāyogī mahādevo jagaddhyeyo janārdanaḥ |
sarvalokagato'nanto vyāpako mūrttiravyayaḥ || 43 ||
na tasya prākṛtā mūrtirmāṃsamedo'sthisaṃbhavā |
yogitvācceśvaratvācca sattvarūpadharo vibhuḥ || 44 ||
tannimittaṃ samutpannaṃ loke padmaṃ sanātanam |
kalpaśeṣasya tasyādau kālasya gatirīdṛśī || 45 ||
tasmin padme samutpanno devadevaścaturmukhaḥ |
prajāpatipatirdeva īśāno jagataḥ prabhuḥ || 46 ||
tasya bījanisargaṃ hi puṣkarasya yathārthavat |
kṛtsnaṃ prajānisargeṇa vistareṇaiva varṇyate || 47 ||
tadambu vaiṣṇavaḥ kāyo yato ratnavibhūṣitaḥ |
padmākārā samutpannā pṛthivī savanadrumā || 48 ||
tat tasya lokapadmasya vistaraṃ siddhabhāṣitam |
varṇyamānaṃ vibhāgena kramaśaḥ śrṛṇuta dvijāḥ || 49 ||
mahāvarṣāṇi khyātāni catvāryatra ca saṃsthitāḥ |
tatra parvatasaṃsthāno merurnāma mahābalaḥ || 50 ||
nānāvarṇaḥ sa pārśveṣu pūrvataḥ śveta ucyate |
pītaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ tasya bhṛṅgavarṇaṃ tu paścimam || 51 ||
uttaraṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu tasya pārśvaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
merustu śobhate śuklo rājavaṃśe tu dhiṣṭhitaḥ || 52 ||
taruṇādityasaṃkāśo vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ |
yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi caturāśītirucchritaḥ || 53 ||
praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastādvistṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu |
śarāvasaṃsthitatvācca dvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtaḥ || 54 ||
vistārastriguṇaścāsya pariṇāhaḥ samantataḥ |
maṇḍalena pramāṇena vyasyamānaṃ tadiṣyate || 55 ||
navatiśca sahastrāṇi yojanānāṃ samantataḥ |
tataḥ ṣaṭkādhikānāṃ ca vyasyamānaṃ prakīrttitam |
caturastreṇa mānena pariṇāhaḥ samantataḥ || 56 ||
sa parvato mahādivyo divyauṣadhisamanvitaḥ |
savanairāvṛtaḥ sarvo jātarūpamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 57 ||
tatra devagaṇāḥ sarve gandharvoragarākṣasāḥ |
śailarāje pramodante tathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 58 ||
sa tu meruḥ parivṛto bhavanairbhūtabhāvanaiḥ |
catvāro yasya deśāstu nānāpārśveṣu dhiṣṭhitāḥ || 59 ||
bhadrāśvo bhārataścaiva ketumālaśca paścime |
uttare kuravaścaiva kṛtapuṇyapratiśrayāḥ || 60 ||
karṇikā tasya padmasya samantāt parimaṇḍalā |
yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ || 61 ||
tasya kesarajālāni navaṣaṭ ca prakīrttitāḥ |
caturaśītirutsedho vivarāntaragocarāḥ || 62 ||
triṃśaccāpi sahastrāṇi yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ |
tasya kesarajālāni vikīrṇāni samantataḥ || 63 ||
śatasāhastramāyāmamaśītiḥ pṛthulāni ca |
catvāri tatra parṇāni yojanānāṃ caturdaśa || 64 ||
tatra yā sā mayā tubhyaṃ karṇiketyabhiviśrutā |
tāṃ varṇyamānāmekāgryāt samāsena nibodhata |
maṇiparṇaśataiścitrāṃ nānāvarṇaprabhāsitām || 65 ||
anekaparṇanicayaṃ sauvarṇamaruṇaprabham |
kāntaṃ sahastraparvāṇaṃ sahastrodarakandaram |
sahastraśatapatraṃ ca vṛttamekaṃ nagottamam || 66 ||
maṇiratnārpitaśvabhrairmaṇibhiścitravedikam |
suvarṇamaṇicitrāṅgairmaṇicarcitatoraṇaiḥ || 67 ||
tatra brahmasabhā ramyā brahmarṣijanasaṃkulā |
nāmnā manovratī nāma sarvalokeṣu viśrutā || 68 ||
tatreśānasya devasya sahastrādityavarcasaḥ |
mahāvimānasaṃsthasya mahimā varttate sadā || 69 ||
tatra sarve devagaṇāścaturvaktraṃ svayaṃ prabhum |
iṣṭvā pūjyanamaskārairarcanīyamupasthitāḥ || 70 ||
yaistadā dihasaṃkalpairbrahmacaryaṃ mahātmabhiḥ |
cīrṇaṃ cārumanobhiśca sadācārapathi sthitaiḥ || 71 ||
samyagiṣṭvā ca bhuktvā ca pitṛdevārcane ratāḥ |
gṛhāśramaparāstatra vinītā atithipriyāḥ || 72 ||
gṛhiṇaḥ śuklakarmasthā viraktāḥ kāraṇātmakāḥ |
yamairniyamadānaiśca dṛḍhanirdagdhakilbiṣāḥ || 73 ||
teṣāṃ nivasanaṃ śuklabrahmalokamaninditam |
uparyupari sarvāsāṃ gatīnāṃ paramā gatiḥ |
caturdaśasahastrāṇi yojanānāṃ tu kīrttitam || 74 ||
tatorddharucire kṛṣṇe taruṇādityavarcasi |
mahāgirau tato ramye ratnadhātuvicitrite || 75 ||
naikaratnasamāvāse maṇitoraṇamandire |
meroḥ sarveṣu pārśveṣu samantāt parimaṇḍale || 76 ||
triṃśadyojanasāhastraṃ cakrapāṭo nagottamaḥ |
jārudhiścaiva śailendra ityete uttarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 77 ||
eteṣāṃ śailamukhyānāmuttareṣu yathākramaḥ |
sthalīrantaradroṇyaśca sarāṃsi ca nibodhata || 78 ||
daśayojanavistīrṇā cakrapāṭopanirgatā |
sā tūdrdhvavāhinī cāpi nadī bhūmau pratiṣṭhitā || 79 ||
sā puryāmamarāvatyāṃ kramamāṇendurā prabhau |
tayā tiraskṛtā vā'pi sūryendujyotiṣāṃ gaṇāḥ || 80 ||
udayāstamite sandhye ye sevante dvijottamāḥ |
tān tuṣyante dvijāḥ sarvānaṣṭāvapyacalottamān || 81 ||
paribhramajjyotiṣāṃ yā sā rudrendramatā śubhā || 82 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||
rudra uvāca |
tasyaiva meroḥ pūrve tu deśe paramavarcase |
cakravāṭaparikṣipte nānādhātuvirājite || 1 ||
tatra sarvāmarapuraṃ cakravāṭasamuddhatam |
durdharṣaṃ baladṛptānāṃ devadānavarakṣasām |
tatra jāmbūnadamayaḥ suprākāraḥ sutoraṇaḥ || 2 ||
tasyāpyuttarapūrve tu deśe paramavarcase |
alokajanasaṃpūrṇā vimānaśatasaṃkulā || 3 ||
mahāvāpisamāyuktā nityaṃ pramuditā śubhā |
śobhitā puṣpaśabalaiḥ patākādhvajamālinī || 4 ||
devairyakṣopsarobhiśca ṛṣibhiśca suśobhitā |
purandarapurī ramyā samṛddhā tvamarāvatī || 5 ||
tasyā madhye'marāvatyā vajravaidūryavedikā |
trailokyaguṇavikhyātā sudharmā nāma vai sabhā || 6 ||
tatrāste śrīpateḥ śrīmān sahastrākṣaḥ śacīpatiḥ |
siddhādibhiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvābhirdevayonibhiḥ || 7 ||
tatra caiva suvaṃśaḥ syād bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ |
sākṣāt tatra surādhyakṣaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ || 8 ||
tasyāśca dikṣu vistīrṇā tattadguṇasamanvitā |
tejovatī nāma purī hutāśasya mahātmanaḥ || 9 ||
tattadguṇavatī ramyā purī vaivasvatasya ca |
nāmnā saṃyamanī nāma purī trailokyaviśrutā || 10 ||
tathā caturthe digbhāge nairṛtādhipateḥ śubhā |
nāmnā kṛṣṇāvatī nāma virūpākṣasya dhīmataḥ || 11 ||
pañcame hyuttarapuṭe nāmnā śuddhavatī purī |
udakādhipateḥ khyātā varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 12 ||
tathā pañcottare devasvasyottarapuṭe purī |
vāyorgandhavatī nāma khyātā sarvaguṇottarā || 13 ||
tasyottarapuṭe ramyā guhyakādhipateḥ purī |
nāmnā mahodayā nāma śubhā vaidūryavedikā || 14 ||
tathāṣṭame'ntarapuṭe īśānasya mahātmanaḥ |
purī manoharā nāma bhūtairnānāvidhairyutā |
puṣpairdhanyaiśca vividhairvanairāśramasaṃsthitaiḥ || 15 ||
prārthyate devaloko'yaṃ sa svarga iti kīrtitaḥ || 16 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||
rudra uvāca |
yadetat karṇikāmūlaṃ merormadhyaṃ prakīrtitam |
tad yojanasahastrāṇi saṃkhyayā mānataḥ smṛtam || 1 ||
catvāriṃśat tathā cāṣṭau sahastrāṇi tu maṇḍalaiḥ |
śailarājasya tattatra merumūlamiti smṛtam || 2 ||
teṣāṃ girisahastrāṇāmanekānāṃ mahocchrayaḥ |
digaṣṭau ca punastasya maryādāparvatāḥ śubhāḥ || 3 ||
jaṭharo devakūṭaśca pūrvasyāṃ diśi parvatau |
pūrvapaścāyatāvetāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau |
maryādāparvatānetānaṣṭānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 4 ||
yo'sau merurdvijaśreṣṭhāḥ proktaḥ kanakaparvataḥ |
viṣkambhāṃstasya vakṣyāmi śrṛṇudhvaṃ gadatastu tān || 5 ||
mahāpādāstu catvāro meroratha caturdiśam |
yairna cacāla viṣṭabdhā saptadvīpavatī mahī || 6 ||
daśayojanasāhastraṃ vyāyāmasteṣu śaṅkyate |
tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca racitā haritālataṭairvṛtāḥ || 7 ||
manaḥśilādarībhiśca suvarṇamaṇicitritāḥ |'
anekasiddhabhavanaiḥ krīḍāsthānaiśca suprabhāḥ || 8 ||
pūrveṇa mandarastasya dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ |
vipulaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaścottare sthitaḥ || 9 ||
teṣāṃ śrṛṅgeṣu catvāro mahāvṛkṣāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
devadaityāpsarobhiśca sevitā guṇasaṃcayaiḥ || 10 ||
mandarasya gireḥ śrṛṅge kadambo nāma pādapaḥ |
pralambaśākhāśikharaḥ kadambaścaityapādapaḥ || 11 ||
mahākumbhapramāṇeśca puṣpairvikacakesaraiḥ |
mahāgandhabanojñaiśca śobhitaḥ sarvakālajaiḥ || 12 ||
samāsena parivṛto bhuvanairbhūtabhāvanaiḥ |
sahastramadhikaṃ so'tha gandhenāpūrayan diśaḥ || 13 ||
bhadrāśvo nāma vṛkṣo'yaṃ varṣādreḥ ketusaṃbhavaḥ |
kīrtimān rūpavāñchrīmān mahāpādapapādapaḥ |
yatra sākṣāddhṛṣīkeśaḥ siddhasaṅghairniṣevyate || 14 ||
tasya bhadrakadambasya tathāśvavadano hariḥ |
prāptavāṃścāmaraśreṣṭhaḥ sa hi sānuṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 15 ||
tena cālokitaṃ varṣaṃ sarvadvipadanāyakāḥ |
yasya nāmnā samākhyāto bhadrāśveti na saṃśayaḥ || 16 ||
dakṣiṇasyāpi śailasya śikhare devasevite |
jambūḥ sadyaḥ puṣpaphalā mahāśākhopaśobhitā || 17 ||
tasyā hyatipramāṇāni svādūni ca mṛdūni ca |
phalānyamṛtakalpāni patanti girimūrdhani || 18 ||
tasmād girivaraśreṣṭhāt phalaprasyandavāhinī |
divyā jāmbūnadī nāma pravṛttā madhuvāhinī || 19 ||
tatra jāmbūnadaṃ nāma suvarṇamanalaprabham |
devālaṅkāramatulamutpannaṃ pāpanāśanam || 20 ||
devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasaguhyakāḥ |
papustadamṛtaprakhyaṃ madhu jambūphalastravam || 21 ||
sā keturdakṣiṇe varṣe jambūrlokeṣu viśrutā |
yasyā nāmnā samākhyātā jambūdvīpeti mānavaiḥ || 22 ||
vipulasya ca śailasya dakṣiṇena mahātmanaḥ |
jātaḥ śrṛṅgeti sumahānaśvatthaśceti pādapaḥ || 23 ||
mahocchrāyo mahāskandho naikasattvaguṇālayaḥ |
kumbhapramāṇai ruciraiḥ phalaiḥ sarvarttukaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 24 ||
sa ketuḥ ketumālānāṃ devagandharvasevitaḥ |
ketumāleti vikhyāto nāmnā tatra prakīrtitaḥ |
tannibodhata viprendrā niruktaṃ nāmakarmaṇaḥ || 25 ||
kṣīrodamathane vṛtte mālā skandhe niveśitāḥ |
indreṇa caityaketostu ketumālastataḥ smṛtaḥ |
tena taccihnitaṃ varṣaṃ ketumāleti viśrutam || 26 ||
supārśvasyottare śrṛṅge vaṭo nāma mahādrumaḥ |
nyagrodho vipulaskandho yastriyojanamaṇḍalaḥ || 27 ||
mālyadāmakalāpaiśca vividhaistu samantataḥ |
śākhābhirlambamānābhiḥ śobhitaḥ siddhasevitaḥ || 28 ||
pralambakumbhasadṛśairhemavarṇaiḥ phalaiḥ sadā |
sa hyuttarakurūṇāṃ tu ketuvṛkṣaḥ prakāśate || 29 ||
sanatkumārāvarajā mānasā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ |
sapta tatra mahābhāgāḥ kuravo nāma viśrutāḥ || 30 ||
tatra sthiragatairjñānairvirajaskairmahātmabhiḥ |
akṣayaḥ kṣayaparyanto lokaḥ proktaḥ sanātanaḥ || 31 ||
