|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 77 ||
rudra uvāca |
tathā caturṇāṃ vakṣyāmi śailendrāṇāṃ yathākramam |
anuvidhyāni ramyāṇi vihaṅgaiḥ kūjitāni ca || 1 ||
anekapakṣiyuktātmaśrṛṅgāṇi subahūni ca |
devānāṃ divyanārībhiḥ samaṃ krīḍāmayāni ca || 2 ||
kinnarodgītaghuṣṭāni śītamandasugandhibhiḥ |
pavanaiḥ sevyamānāni ramaṇīyatarāṇi ca || 3 ||
caturddikṣu virājante nāmataḥ śrṛṇutānaghāḥ |
pūrve caitrarathaṃ nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanam |
prabhāveṇa sutoyāni navakhaṇḍayutāni ca || 4 ||

asitodaṃ paścime ca mahābhadraṃ tathottare |

mahānīlo'tha kumbhaśca subindurmadanastathā || 11 ||
veṇunaddhaḥ sumedāśca niṣadho devaparvataḥ |
ityete parvatavarāḥ puṇyāśca girayo'pare || 12 ||
pūrveṇa mandarāt siddhāḥ parvatāśca madāyutāḥ |
saraso mānasasyeha dakṣiṇena mahācalāḥ || 13 ||
ye kīrttitā mayā tubhyaṃ nāmatastān nibodhata |
śailastriśiraścaiva śiśiraścācalottamaḥ || 14 ||
kapiśca śatamakṣaśca turagaścaiva sānumān |
tāmrāhaśca viṣaścaiva tathā śvetodano giriḥ || 15 ||
samūlaścaiva saralo ratnaketuśca parvataḥ |
ekamūlo mahāśrṛṅgo gajamūlo'pi śāvakaḥ || 16 ||
pañcaśailaśca kailāso himavānacalottamaḥ |
uttarā ye mahāśailāstān vakṣyāmi nibodhata || 17 ||
kapilaḥ piṅgalo bhadraḥ sarasaśca mahācalaḥ |
kumudo madhumāṃścaiva garjano markaṭastathā || 18 ||
kṛṣṇaśca pāṇḍavaścaiva sahastraśirasastathā |
pāriyātraśca śailendraḥ śrṛṅgavānacalottamaḥ |
ityete parvatavarāḥ śrīmantaḥ paścime smṛtāḥ || 19 ||
mahābhadrasya sarasa uttareṇa dvijottamāḥ |
ye parvatāḥ sthitā viprāstān vakṣyāmi nibodhata || 20 ||
haṃsakūṭo mahāśailo vṛṣahaṃsaśca parvataḥ |
kapiñjalaśca śailendra indraśailaśca sānumān || 21 ||
nīlaḥ kanakaśrṛṅgaśca śataśrṛṅgaśca parvataḥ |
puṣkaro meghaśailo'tha virajāścācalottamaḥ |
jāruciścaiva śailendra ityete uttarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 22 ||
ityeteṣāṃ tu mukhyānāmuttareṣu yathākramam |
sthalīrantaradroṇyaśca sarāṃsi ca nibodhata || 23 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 78 ||
rudra uvāca |
sītāntasyācalendrasya kumudasyāntareṇa ca |
droṇyāṃ vihaṅgapuṣṭāyāṃ nānāsattvaniṣevitam || 1 ||
triyojanaśatāyāmaṃ śatayojanavistṛtam |
surasāmalapānīyaṃ ramyaṃ tatra surocanam || 2 ||
droṇamātrapramāṇaiśca puṇḍarīkaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
sahastraśatapatraiśca mahāpadmairalaṅkṛtam || 3 ||
devadānavagandharvairmahāsarpairadhiṣṭhitam |
puṇyaṃ tacchrīsaro nāma saprakāśamiheha ca || 4 ||
prasannasalilaiḥ pūrṇaṃ śaraṇyaṃ sarvadehinām |
tatra tvekaṃ mahāpadmaṃ madhye padmavanasya ca || 5 ||
koṭipatraprakalitaṃ taruṇādityavarcasam |
nityaṃ vyākośamadhuraṃ calatvādatimaṇḍalam || 6 ||
cārukesarajālāḍhyaṃ mattabhramaranāditam |
tasmin madhye bhagavatī sākṣāt śrīrnityameva hi |
lakṣmīstu taṃ tadāvāsaṃ mūrttimantaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 7 ||
sarasastasya tīre tu tasmin siddhaniṣevitam |
sadā puṣpaphalaṃ ramyaṃ tatra bilvavanaṃ mahat || 8 ||
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ dviyojanaśatāyatam |
arddhakrośoccaśikharairmahāvṛkṣaiḥ samantataḥ |
śākhāsahastrakalitairmahāskandhaiḥ samākulam || 9 ||
phalaiḥ sahastrasaṅkāśaiḥ haritaiḥ pāṇḍuraistathā |
amṛtasvādusadṛśairbherīmātraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ || 10 ||
śīryadbhiśca patadbhiśca kīrṇabhūmivanāntaram |
nāmnā tacchrīvanaṃ nāma sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || 11 ||
devādibhiḥ samākīrṇamaṣṭābhiḥ kakubhiḥ śubham |
bilvāśibhiśca munibhiḥ sevitaṃ puṇyakāribhiḥ |
tatra śrīḥ saṃsthitā nityaṃ siddhasaṅghaniṣevitā || 12 ||
ekaikasyācalendrasya maṇiśailasya cāntaram |
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ dviyojanaśatāyatam || 13 ||
vimalaṃ paṅkajavanaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam |
puṣpaṃ lakṣmyā dhṛtaṃ bhāti nityaṃ prajvalatīva ha || 14 ||
arddhakrośaṃ ca śikharairmahāskandhaiḥ samāvṛtam |
praphullaśākhāśikharaṃ piñjaraṃ bhāti tadvanam || 15 ||
dvibāhupariṇāhaistaistrihastāyāmavistṛtaiḥ |
manaḥśilācūrṇanibhaiḥ pāṇḍukesaraśālibhiḥ || 16 ||
puṣpairmanoharairvyāptaṃ vyākośairgandhaśobhibhiḥ |
virājati vanaṃ sarvaṃ mattabhramaranāditam || 17 ||
tadvanaṃ dānavairdaityairgandharvairyakṣarākṣasaiḥ |
kinnarairapsarobhiśca mahābhogaiśca sevitam || 18 ||
tatrāśramo bhagavataḥ kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ |
siddhasādhugaṇākīrṇaṃ nānāśramasamākulam || 19 ||
mahānīlasya madhye tu kumbhasya ca girestathā |
madhye sukhā nadī nāma tasyāstīre mahadvanam || 20 ||
pañcāśadyojanāyāmaṃ triṃśadyojanamaṇḍalam |
ramyaṃ tālavanaṃ śrīmat krośārddhocchritapādapam || 21 ||
mahābalairmahāsāraiḥ sthirairavicalaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
mahadañjanasaṃsthānaiḥ parivṛttairmahāphalaiḥ || 22 ||
mṛṣṭagandhaguṇopetairupetaṃ siddhasevitam |
airāvatasya kariṇastatraiva samudāhṛtam || 23 ||
airāvatasya rudrasya devaśailasya cāntare |
sahastrayojanāyāmā śatayojanavistṛtā || 24 ||
sarvā hyekaśilā bhūmirvṛkṣavīrudhavarjitā |
āplutā pādamātreṇa salilena samantataḥ || 25 ||
ityetābhyantaradroṇyo nānākārāḥ prakīrttitāḥ |
meroḥ pārśvena viprendrā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 26 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||
rudra uvāca |
atha dakṣiṇadigvyavasthitāḥ parvatadroṇyaḥ siddhācaritāḥ kīrtyante | śiśirapataṅgayormadhye śuklabhūmistriyā muktalatāgalitapādapam |
ikṣukṣepe ca śikhare pādapairupaśobhitam |
udumbaravanaṃ ramyaṃ pakṣisaṅghaniṣevitam || 1 ||
phalitaṃ tad vanaṃ bhāti mahākūrmopamaiḥ phalaiḥ ||
tad vanaṃ devayonyo'ṣṭau sevante sarvadaiva || 2 ||
varāhapurāṇa || 3 ||
tatra prasannasvādusalilā bahūdakā nadyo vahanti | tatrāśramo bhagavataḥ kardamasya prajāpateḥ | nānāmunijanākīrṇastacca śatayojanamekaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ vanaṃ ca |
tathā ca tāmrābhasya śailasya pataṅgasya cāntare śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ dviguṇāyataṃ bālārkasadṛśarājīvapuṇarīkaiḥ samantataḥ sahastrapatrairaviralairalaṃkṛtaṃ mahat saro'nekasiddhagandharvādhyuṣitam | tasya ca madhye mahāśikharaḥ śatayojanāyāmastriṃśadyojanavistīrṇo'nekadhāturatnabhūṣitastasya copari mahatī rathyā ratnaprākāratoraṇā |
tasyāṃ mahad vidyādharapuram | tatra pulomanāmā vidyādhararājaḥ śatasahastraparīvāraḥ |
tathā ca vikhākhācalendrasya śvetasya cāntare saraḥ |
tasya ca pūrvatīre mahadāmravanaṃ kanakasaṃkāśaiḥ phalairatisugandhibhirmahākumbhamātraiḥ sarvataścitam |
devagandharvādayaśca tatra nivasanti |
sumulasyācalendrasya vasudhārasya cāntare triṃśadyojanavistīrṇe pañcāśadyojanāyate | bilvasthalī nāma | tatra phalāni vidrumasaṃkāśāni taiśca patadbhiḥ sthalamṛttikā klinnā | tāṃ ca sthalīṃ suguhyakādayaḥ sevante bilvaphalāśinaḥ |
tathā ca vasudhāraratnadhārayorantare triṃśadyojanavistīrṇaṃ śatayojanamāyataṃ sugandhikiṃśukavanaṃ sadākusumaṃ yasya gandhena vāsyate yojanaśatam |
tatra siddhādhyuṣitaṃ jalopetaṃ ca |
tatra cādityasya devasya mahadāyatanam |
samāse māse ca bhagavānavatarati sūryaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
kālajanakaṃ devādayo namasyanti |
tathā ca pañcakūṭasya kailāsasya cāntare sahastrayojanāyāmaṃ vistīrṇaṃ śatayojanaṃ haṃsapāṇḍuraṃ kṣudrasattvairanādhṛṣyaṃ svargasopānamiva bhūmaṇḍalam |
atha paścimadigbhāge vyavasthitā giridroṇyaḥ kīrtyante | supārśvaśikhiśailayormadhye samantād yojanaśatamekaṃ bhaumaśilātalaṃ nityataptaṃ duḥsparśam |
tasya madhye triṃśadyojanavistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vahnisthānam | sa ca sarvakālamanindhano bhagavān lokakṣayakārī saṃvartako jvalate |
antare ca śailavarayoḥ kumudāñjanayoḥ śatayojanavistīrṇāmātuluṅgasthalī sarvasattvānāmagamyā | pītavarṇaiḥ phalairāvṛtā satī sā sthalī śobhate |
tatra ca śailayoḥ piñjaragaurayorantareṇa sarodroṇī hyanekaśatayojanāyatā mahadbhiśca ṣaṭpadodghuṣṭaiḥ kumudairupaśobhitā |
tatra ca bhagavato viṣṇoḥ parameśvarasyāyatanam |
tathā ca śuklapāṇḍurayorapi mahāgiryorantare triṃśadyojanavistīrṇo navatyāyata ekaḥ śiloddeśovṛkṣavivarjitaḥ | tatra niṣpaṅkā dīrghikā savṛkṣā ca sthalapadminī anekajātīyaiśca padmaiḥ śobhitā |
tasyāśca madhye pañcayojanapramāṇo mahānyagrodhavṛkṣaḥ | tasmiṃścandraśekharomāpatirnīlavāsāśca devo nivasati yakṣādibhirīḍyamānaḥ |
sahastraśikharasya gireḥ kumudasya cāntare pañcāśadyojanāyāmaṃ viṃśadyojanavistṛtamikṣukṣepoccaśikharamanekapakṣisevitam |
anekavṛkṣaphalairmadhurastravairupaśobhitam |
tatra cendrasya mahānāśramo divyābhiprāyanirmitaḥ |
tathā ca śaṅkhakūṭaṛṣabhayormadhye puruṣasthalīramyā'nekaguṇānekayojanāyatā bilvapramāṇaiḥ kaṅkolakaiḥ sugandhibhirupetā |
tatra puruṣakarasonmattā nāgādyāḥ prativasanti |
tathā kapiñjalanāgaśailayorantare dviśatayojanamāyāmavistīrṇā śatayojanasthalī nānāvanavibhūṣitā drākṣākharjūrakhaṇḍairupetā anekavṛkṣavallībhiranekaiśca sarobhirupetā sā sthalī |
tathā ca puṣkaramahāmeghayorantare ṣaṣṭiyojanavistīrṇā śatāyāmā pāṇitalaprakhyā mahatī sthalī vṛkṣavīrudhavivarjitā |tasyāśca pārśve catvāri mahāvanāni sarāṃsi cānekayojanānām |daśa pañca sapta tathāṣṭau triṃśad viṃśati yojanānāṃ sthalyo droṇyaśca | tatra kāścinmahāghorāḥ parvatakukṣayaḥ |
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre aśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||
rudra uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ parvateṣu devānāmavakāśā varṇyante | tatra yo'sau śāntākhyaḥ parvatastasyopari mahendrasya krīḍāsthānam |
tatra devarājasya pārijātakavṛkṣavanam |
tasya pūrvapārśve kuñjaro nāma giriḥ |
tasyopari dānavānāmaṣṭau purāṇi ca |
tathā vajrake parvatavare rākṣasānāmanekāni purāṇi |
te ca nāmnā nīlakāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ |
mahānīle'pi śailendrapurāṇi |
pañcadaśasahastrāṇi kinnarāṇāṃ khyātāni |
tatra devadattacandrādayo rājānaḥ |
pañcadaśakinnarāṇāṃ garvitāḥ |
tāni sauvarṇāni bilapraveśanāni ca purāṇi |
candrodaye ca parvatavare nāgānāmadhivāsaḥ | te ca bilapraveśāḥ bileṣu vainateyaviṣayāvarttino vyavasthitānurāge ca dānavendrā vyavasthitāḥ |
veṇumatyapi vidyādharapuratrayaṃ |
triṃśadyojanaśatavistīrṇamekaikaṃ tāvadāyatam |
ulūkaromaśamahāvetrādayaśca rājāno vidyādharāṇām |
ekaike ca śailarājani svayameva garuḍo vyavasthitaḥ |
kuñjare tu parvatavare nityaṃ paśupatiḥ sthitaḥ |
vṛṣabhāṅko mahādevaḥ śaṃkaro yogināṃ varaḥ anekagaṇabhūtakoṭisahastravāro bhagavān anādipuruṣo vyavasthitaḥ |
vasudhāre ca puṣpavatāṃ vasūnāṃ ca samāvāsaḥ |
vasudhāraratnadhārayormūrdhni aṣṭau sapta ca saṃkhyayā | purāṇi vasusaptarṣīṇāṃ ceti | ekaśrṛṅge ca parvatottame prajāpateḥ sthānaṃ caturvaktrasya brahmaṇaḥ| gajaparvate ca mahābhūtaparivṛtā svayameva bhagavatī tiṣṭhati |
vasudhāre ca parvatavare munisiddhavidyādharāṇāmāyatanam |
caturāśītyaparapuryo mahāprākāratoraṇāḥ |
tatra cānekaparvatā nāma gandharvā yuddhaśālino vasanti |
teṣāṃ cādhipatirdevo rājarājaikapiṅgalaḥ |
surarākṣasāḥ pañcakūṭedānavāḥ śataśrṛṅgeyakṣāṇāṃ puraśatam |
tāmrābhe takṣakasyapuraśatam | viśakhaparvate guhasyāyatanam |śvetodaye girivare mahāgandharvabhavanam |
harikūṭe harirdevaḥ | kumude kinnarāvāsaḥ | añjane mahoragāḥ |
sahastraśikhare ca daityānāmugrakarmiṇāmāvāsaḥ |
purāṇāṃ sahastramekaṃ hemamālinām mukuṭe pannaprapakṣe parvatavare catvāryāyatanāni tu| evaṃ meruparvateṣu devānāmadhivāsaḥ |
maryādāparvate devakūṭe puravinyāsaḥ kīrtyate |
tasyopari yojanaśataṃ garuḍasya jātaṃ kṣetram |
tasyaiva pārśvatastriṃśadyojanavistīrṇāścatvāriṃśadāyatāḥ saptagandharvanagarāḥ |
āgneyāśca nāmnā gandharvātibalinaḥ |
tatra cānyat triṃśadyojanamaṇḍalaṃ puram saiṃhikeyānām |
tatra ca devarṣicaritāni devakūṭe dṛśyante |
puraṃ ca kālakeyānāṃ tatraiva | tathā cāntarataṭe'nyesunānnāma tasyaiva dakṣiṇe triṃśadyojanavistṛtaṃ dviṣaṣṭiyojanāyāmaṃ puram kāmarūpiṇāṃ dṛptānāṃ madhyame ca tasya hemakūṭe mahādevasya nyagrodhaḥ |
athātaḥ kailāsavarṇako bhavati|
kailāsasya taṭe yojanaśatamāyāmavastṛtam bhuvanamālābhivyāptam | tasyāśca madhye sabhā |
tatra ca tatpuṣkaraṃ nāma vimānaṃ tiṣṭhati |
dhanadasya ca tadvimānamadhivāsaśca | tatra padmamahāpadmamakarakacchapakumudaśaṅkhanīlanandamahānidhayaḥ prativasanti | tatra candrādīnāṃ lokapālānāmāvāsaḥ |
tatra ca mandākinī nāma nadī |
tathā kanakamandā mandā ceti nāmabhiḥ saritaḥ |
tatrānyā api nadyaḥ santi | pūrvapārśve ca śatayojanamāyāmāstriṃśadyojanavistṛtā daśagandharvapuryaḥ tāsu ca sakubāhuharikeśacitrasenādayo rājānaḥ | tasyaiva ca paścimakūṭe aśītiyojanāyāmaṃ catvāriṃśadvistṛtamekaikaṃ yakṣanagaram |
teṣu ca mahāmālisunetra cakrādayo nāyakāḥ |
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe pārśve kuñjadarīṣu guhāsu samudrāḥ samudraṃ yāvatkinnarāṇāṃ puraśatam |
teṣu ca drumasugrīvādibhagadattapramukhaṃ rājaśatam |
tatra ca rudrasyomayā sārddhaṃ vivāhassaṃvṛttaḥ |
tapaśca kṛtavatī gaurī | kirātarūpiṇā ca rudreṇa sthitam | tatraiva tatra sthitena somena śaṃkareṇa jambūdvīpāvalokanaṃ kṛtam | tatra cānekakinnaragandharvopagītamumāvanaṃ nāmāpsarobhiranekapuṣpalatāvallībhirupetam |
yatra bhagavatā maheśvareṇārddhanārīnaravapuḥ prāptam |
tatra ca kārtikeyasya śaradvanam |
puṣpacitrakrauñcayormadhye kārtikeyābhiṣekaḥ kṛtaḥ tasya ca pūrvataṭe siddhamunigaṇāvāsaḥ kalāpagrāmo nāma |
tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyavasiṣṭhaparāśaranalaviśvāmitroddālakādīnāṃ maharṣīṇāmanekāni sahastrāṇyāśramāṇāṃ hi bhavati |
tathā ca paścimasyācalendrasya niṣadhasya bhāgaṃ śrṛṇuta |
tasya ca madhyamakūṭe viṣṇvāyatanaṃ mahādevasya |
tasyaivottarataṭe triṃśadyojanavistṛtaṃ mahatpuraṃ lambākhyātaṃ rākṣasānām |
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe pārśve bilapraveśanagaram |
prabhedakasya paścimena devadānavasiddhādīnāṃ purāṇi |
tasya girermūrdhni mahatī somaśilā tiṣṭhati |
tasyāṃ ca parvaṇi somaḥ svayamevāvatarati |
tasyaivottarapārśve trikūṭaṃ nāma |
tatra brahmā tiṣṭhati kvacit | tathā ca vahnyāyatanam | mūrttimān vahnirupāsyate devaiḥ |
uttare ca śrṛṅgākhye parvatavare devatānāmāyatanāni |
pūrve nārāyaṇasyāyatanam | madhye brahmaṇaḥ |
śaṃkarasya paścime | tatra ca yakṣādīnāṃ kecit purāṇi tasya cottaratīre jātuche mahāparvate triṃśadyojanamaṇḍalaṃ nandajalaṃ nāma saras tatra nando nāma nāgarājā vasati śataśīrṣapracaṇḍa iti ityete'ṣṭau devaparvatā vijñeyāḥ | tenānukrameṇa hemarajataratnavaidūryamānaḥ śilāhiṅgulādivarṇāḥ | iyaṃ ca pṛthvī lakṣakoṭiśatānekasaṃkhyātānāṃ pūrṇā teṣu ca siddhavidyādharāṇāṃ nilayāḥ te ca meroḥ pārśvataḥ kesaravalayālavālaṃ siddhaloketi kīrttyate |
iyaṃ pṛthvī padmākāreṇa vyavasthitā |
eṣa ca sarvapurāṇeṣu kramaḥ sāmānyataḥ pratipādyate |
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 ||
rudra uvāca |
atha nadīnāmavatāraṃ śrṛṇuta |
ākāśasamudro yaḥ kīrtyate sāmākhyas tasmādākāśagāminī nadī pravṛttā | sā cānavaratamindragajena kṣobhyate | sā ca caturaśītisahastrocchrāyā | sā meroḥ sudarśanaṃ karoti | sā ca merukūṭataṭāntebhyaḥ praskhalitā caturdhā saṃjātā | ṣaṣṭiṃ ca yojanasahastraṃ nirālambā patamānā pradakṣiṇamanusarantī caturddhā jagāma | sītā cālakanandā cakṣurbhadrā ceti nāmabhiḥ |
yathoddeśaṃ sā cānekaśatasahastraparvatānāṃ dārayantī gāṃ gateti gaṅgetyucyate atha gandhamādanapārśve'maragaṇḍikā varṇyate | ekatriṃśadyojanasahastrāṇi āyāmaḥ catuḥśatavistīrṇam| tatra ketumālāḥ sarve janapadāḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ puruṣā mahābalinaḥ | utpalavarṇāḥ striyaḥ śubhadarśanāḥ | tatra ca mahāvṛkṣāḥ panasāḥ santi | tatreśvaro brahmaputrastiṣṭhati | tatrodapānācca jarārogavivarjitā varṣāyutāyuṣaśca narāḥ | mālyavataḥ pūrvapārśve pūrvagaṇḍikā ekaśrṛṅgādyojanasahastrāṇi mānatastatra ca bhadrāśvā nāma janapadāḥ bhadrasālavanaṃ ca tatra vyavasthitam | kālāmravṛkṣāḥ puruṣāḥ śvetāḥ padmavarṇinaḥ striyaḥ kumudavarṇā daśavarṣasahastrāṇi teṣāmāyuḥ | tatra ca pañca kulaparvatāḥ | tadyathā śailavarṇaḥ mālākhyaḥ korajaśca triparṇaḥ nīlaśceti tadvinirgatāḥ| tadambhaḥsthitānāṃ deśānāṃ tānyeva nāmāni | te ca deśā etā nadīḥ pibanti| tadyathā sītā suvāhinī haṃsavatī kāsā mahācakrā candravatī kāverī surasā śākhāvatī indravatī aṅgāravāhinī haritoyā somāvartā śatahradā vanamālā vasumatī haṃsā suparṇā pañcagaṅgā dhanuṣmatī maṇivaprā subrahmabhāgā vilāsinī kṛṣṇatoyā puṇyodā nāgavatī śivā śevālinī maṇitaṭā kṣīrodā varuṇāvatī viṣṇupadī mahānadī hiraṇyaskandhavāhā surāvatī kāmodā patākāścetyetā mahānadyaḥ | etāśca gaṅgāsamāḥ kīrtitāḥ| ājanmāntaṃ pāpaṃ vināśayanti | kṣudranadyaśca koṭiśaḥ| tāśca nadīrye pibanti te daśavarṣasahastrāyuṣaḥ| rudromābhaktā iti|
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 82 ||
rudra uvāca |
nisarga eṣa bhadrāśvānāṃ kīrtitaḥ ketumālānāṃ vistareṇa kathitaṃ | naiṣadhasyācalenadrasya paścimena kulācalajanapadanadyaḥ kīrtyante | tathā ca viśākhakambalajayantakṛṣṇaharitāśokavarddhamānā ityeteṣāṃ saptakulaparvatānāṃ koṭiśaḥ prasūtiḥ |
tannivāsino janapadāstannāmāna eva draṣṭavyāḥ | tadyathā sauragrāmāttasāṃtapo kṛtasurāśravaṇa kambalamāheyācalakūṭavāsamūlatapakrauñcakṛṣṇāṅgamaṇipaṅkajacūḍamalasomīyasamudrāntaka kurakuñcasuvarṇaḥ taṭakakuha śvetāṅgakṛṣṇapāṭavidakapilakarṇikamahiṣakubjakaranāṭamahotkaṭaśukanāsagajabhūmakakurañjana manāhakiṃkisapārṇabhaumakacorakadhūmajanma aṅgārajatīvanajīvalaukilavācāṃ sahāṅgamadhureyaśukecakeyaśravaṇamatta kāsikagodāvāmakulapañjāvarjjahamodaśaalaka ete janapadāstatparvatotthā nadīḥ pibanti | tadyathā plakṣā mahākadambā mānasī śyāmā sumedhā bahulā vivarṇā puṅkhā mālā darbhavatī bhadrānadī śukanadī pallavā bhīmā prabhañjanā kāmbā kuśāvatī dakṣā kāsavatī tuṅgā puṇyodā candrāvatī sumūlāvatī kakudminī viśālā karaṇṭakā pīvarī mahāmāyā mahiṣī mānuṣī caṇḍā etā nadīḥ pradhānāḥ| śeṣāḥ kṣudranadyaḥ sahastraśaśceti |
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 ||
rudra uvāca |
uttarāṇāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
ācakṣate yathānyāyaṃ ye ca parvatavāsinaḥ |
tacchṛṇudhvaṃ mayā viprāḥ kīrttyamānaṃ samāhitāḥ || 1 ||
dakṣiṇena tu śvetasya nīlasya cottareṇa ca |
vāyavyāṃ ramyakaṃ nāma jāyante tatra mānavāḥ |
matipradhānā vimalā jarādaurgandhyavarjitāḥ || 2 ||
tatrāpi sumahān vṛkṣo nyagrodho rohitaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tatphalād rasapānāddhi daśavarṣasahastriṇaḥ |
āyuṣā sarvamanujā jāyante devarūpiṇaḥ || 3 ||
uttareṇa ca śvetasya triśrṛṅgasya ca dakṣiṇe |
varṣaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ nāma tatra hairaṇvatī nadī |
yakṣā vasanti tatraiva balinaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || 4 ||
ekādaśahastrāṇi samānāṃ tena jīvate |
śatānyanyāni jīvante varṣāṇāṃ daśa pañca ca || 5 ||
lakucāḥ kṣudrasā vṛkṣāstasmin deśe vyavasthitāḥ |
tatphalaprāśamānā hi tena jīvanti mānavāḥ || 6 ||
tathā triśrṛṅge ca maṇikāñcanasarvaratnaśikharānukrameṇa tasya cottaraśrṛṅgāddakṣiṇasamudrānte cottarakuravaḥ | vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca vṛkṣeṣveva jāyante kṣīravṛkṣāḥ kṣīrāsavāḥ santi| maṇibhūmiḥ suvarṇabālukā| tasmin svargacyutāśca puruṣā vasanti trayodaśavarṣasahastrāyuṣaḥ | tasyaiva dvīpasya paścimena caturyojanasahastramatikramya devalokāccandradvīpo bhavati yojanasahastraparimaṇḍalaḥ | tasya madhye candrakāntasūryakāntanāmānau girivarau| tayośca madhye candrāvatī nāma mahānadī anekavṛkṣaphalānekanadīsamākulā| etatkuruvarṣaṃ ca | tasyottarapārśve samudrormimālāḍhyaṃ pañcayojanasahastramatikramya devalokāt sūryadvīpo bhavati yojanasahastraparimaṇḍalaḥ| tasya madhye girivaraḥ śatayojanavistīrṇastāvaducchritaḥ| tasmātsūryāvarttanāmā nadī nirgatā| tatra ca sūryasyādhiṣṭhitam tatra sūryadaivatyāstadvarṇāśca prajā daśavarṣasahastrāyuṣaḥ| tasya ca dvīpasya paścimena caturyojanasahastramatikramya samudraṃ daśayojanasahastraṃ parimaṇḍalatvena dvīpo rudrākaro nāma | tatra ca bhadrāsanaṃ vāyoranekaratnaśobhitam| tatra vigrahavān vāyustiṣṭhati| tapanīyavarṇāśca prajāḥ pañcavarṣasahastrāyuṣaḥ || 7 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 84 ||
rudra uvāca |
iyaṃ bhūpadmavyavasthā kathitā| idānīṃ bhārataṃ navabhedaṃ śrṛṇuta| tadyathā| indraḥ kaseruḥ tāmravarṇo gabhastiḥ nāgadvīpaḥ saumyaḥ gandharvaḥ vāruṇaḥ bhātaraṃ ceti| sāgarasaṃvṛtamekaikaṃ yojanasahastrapramāṇam| tatra ca sapta kulaparvatā bhavanti| tadyathā| mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānnṛkṣaparvataḥ| vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca ityete kulaparvatāḥ| anye ca mandaraśāradardurakolāhalasuramainākavaidyutavārandhamapāṇḍuratuṅgaprasthakṛṣṇagirijayantaraivataṛṣyamūkagomantacitrakūṭaśrīcakorakūṭaśailakṛtasthala ityete kṣudraparvatāḥ| śeṣāḥ kṣudratarāḥ| teṣāmāryā mlecchā janapadā vasanti| pibanti caitāsu nadīṣu pānīyam| tadyathā gaṅgā sindhu sarasvatī śatadru vitastā vipāśā candrabhāgā sarayū yamunā irāvatī devikā kuhū gomatī dhūtapāpā bāhudā dṛṣadvatī kauśikī nisvarā gaṇḍakī cakṣuṣmatī lohitā ityetā himavatpādanirgatāḥ||
vedasmṛtirvedavatī sindhuparṇā sacandanā sadācārā rohipārā carmaṇvatī vidiśā vedatrayī ityetā pāriyātrodbhavāḥ śoṇā jyotīrathā narmadā surasā mandākinī daśārṇā citrakūṭā tamasā pippalā karatoyā piśācikā citrotpalā viśālā vañjulā bālukā vāhinī śuktimatī virajā paṅkinī rirī kuhū ityetā ṛkṣaprasūtāḥ| maṇijālā śubhā tāpī payoṣṇīṃ śīghrodā veṣṇā pāśā vaitaraṇī vedī pālī kumudvatī toyā durgā antyā girā etā vindhyapādodbhavāḥ| godāvarī bhīmarathī kṛṣṇā veṇā vañjulā tuṅgabhadrā suprayogā vāhyā kāverī ityetāḥ sahyapādodbhavāḥ| śatamālā tāmraparṇī puṣpāvatī utpalāvatī ityetā malayajāḥ|
triyāmā ṛṣikulyā ikṣulā trividā lāṅgūlinī vaṃśavarā mahendratanayāḥ| ṛṣikā lūmatī mandagāminī palāśinī ityetāḥ śuktimatprabhavāḥ| etāḥ prādhānyena kulaparvatanadyaḥ| śeṣāḥ kṣudranadyaḥ| eṣa jambūdvīpo yojanalakṣapramāṇataḥ| ataḥ paraṃ śākadvīpaṃ nibodhata| jambūdvīpasya vistārād dviguṇapariṇāhāllavaṇodakaśca jambūdvīpasamastena dviguṇāvṛtaḥ| tatra ca puṇyā janapadāścirānmriyante durbhikṣajarāvyādhirahitaśca deśo'yam| saptaiva kulaparvatāstāvat tiṣṭhanti tasya cobhayato lavaṇakṣīrodadhī vyavasthitau| tatra ca prāgāyataḥ śailendra udayo nāma parvataḥ| tasyāpareṇa jaladhāro nāma giriḥ| saiva candreti kīrttitaḥ| tasya ca jalamindro gṛhītvā varṣati| tasya pāre raivatako nāma giriḥ| saiva nārado varṇyate tasmiṃśca nāradaparvatādutpanno tasya cāpareṇa śyāmo nāma giriḥ| tasmiṃśca prajāḥ śyāmatvamāpannāḥ saiva dundubhirvarṇyate| tasmin siddhā iti kīrtitāḥ prajānekavidhāḥ krīḍantastasyāpare rajato nāma giriḥ saiva śākocyate| tasyāpareṇāmbikeyaḥ sa ca vibhrājaso bhaṇyate| sa eva kesarītyucyate| tataśca vāyuḥ pravarttate| girināmānyeva varṣāṇi tadyathā| udayasukumāro jaladhārakṣemakamahādrumeti pradhānāni dvitīyaparvatanāmabhirapi vaktavyāni| tasya ca madhye śākavṛkṣastatra ca saptamahānadyo dvināmnyaḥ| tadyathā sukumārī kumārī nandā veṇikā dhenuḥ ikṣumatī gabhasti ityetā nadyaḥ|
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 85 ||
atha tṛtīyaṃ kuśadvīpaṃ śrṛṇuta| kuśadvīpena kṣīrodaḥ parivṛtaḥ śākadvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena| tatrāpi sapta kulaparvatāḥ| sarve ca dvināmānaḥ| tad yathā --- kumudavidrumeti ca socyate| unnato hemaparvataḥ saiva| balāhako dyutimān saiva| tathā droṇaḥ saiva puṣpavān| kaṅkaśca parvataḥ saiva kuśeśayaḥ| tathā ṣaṣṭho mahiṣanāmā sa eva harirityucyate| tatrāgnirvasati| saptamastu kakudmān nāma saiva mandaraḥ kīrtyate| ityete parvatāḥ kuśadvīpe vyavasthitāḥ eteṣāṃ varṣabhedo bhavati dvināmasaṃjñaḥ| kumudasya śvetamudbhidaṃ tadeva kīrtyate| unnatasya lohitaṃ veṇumaṇḍalaṃ tadeva bhavati| balāhakasya jīmūtaṃ tadeva rathākāra iti|droṇasya haritaṃ tadeva balādhanaṃ bhavati| kaṅkasyāpi kakudmān nāma| vṛttimat tadeva mānasaṃ mahiṣasya prabhākaram| kakudmataḥ kapilaṃ tadeva saṃkhyātaṃ nāma| ityetāni varṣāṇi| tatra dvināmnyo nadyaḥ| pratapā praveśā saivocyate| dvitīyā śivā yaśodā sā ca bhavati| tṛtīyā pitrā nāma saiva kṛṣṇā bhaṇyate| caturthī hrādinī nāma saiva candrā nigadyate| vidyutā ca pañcamī śuklā saiva| varṇā ṣaṣṭhī saiva vibhāvarī| mahatī saptamī saiva dhṛtiḥ| etāḥ pradhānāḥ śeṣāḥ kṣudanadyaḥ| ityeṣa kuśadvīpasya saṃniveśaḥ| śākadvīpo dviguṇaḥ saṃniviṣṭaśca kathitaḥ| tasya ca madhye mahākuśastambaḥ| eṣa ca kuśadvīpo dadhimaṇḍodenāvṛtaḥ kṣīrodadviguṇena|
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 86 ||
rudra uvāca |
atha krauñcaṃ bhavati caturthaṃ kuśadvīpād dviguṇamānataḥ samudraḥ krauñcena dviguṇenāvṛtaḥ| tasmiṃśca saptaiva pradhānaparvatāḥ| prathamaḥ kauñco vidyullato raivato mānasaḥ saiva pāvakaḥ| tathaivāndhakāraḥ saivācchodakaḥ| devāvṛtto sa ca surāpo bhaṇyate| tato deviṣṭhaḥ sa eva kāñcanaśrṛṅgo bhavati| devanandātparo govindaḥ, dvivinda iti| tataḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ saiva toṣāśayaḥ| ete sapta ratnamayāḥ parvatāḥ krīñcadvīpe vyavasthitāḥ| sarve ca paraspareṇocchrayāḥ| tatra varṣāṇi tathā krauñcasya kuśalo deśaḥ saiva mādhavaḥ smṛtaḥ vāmanasya mano'nugaḥ saiva saṃvartakastatoṣṇavān somaprakāśaḥ| tataḥ pāvakaḥ saiva sudarśanaḥ| tathā cāndhakāraḥ saiva saṃmohaḥ| tato munideśaḥ sa ca prakāśaḥ| tato dundubhiḥ saivānartha ucyate| tatrāpi saptaiva nadyaḥ|| 1 ||
gaurī kumudvatī caiva sandhyā rātrirmanojavā khyātiśca puṇḍarīkā ca gaṅgā saptavidhāḥ smṛtāḥ|
gaurī saiva puṣpavahā kumudvatī tāmravatī rodhasaṃdhyā sukhāvahā ca manojavā ca kṣiprodā ca khyātiḥ saiva gobahulā puṇḍarīkā citravegā śeṣāḥ kṣudranadyaḥ|| krauñcadvīpo ghṛtodenāvṛtaḥ| ghṛtodā śālmaleneti|| 2 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 87 ||
rudra uvāca |
triṣu śiṣṭeṣu vakṣyāmi dvīpeṣu manujānyuta |
śālmalaṃ pañcamaṃ varṣaṃ pravakṣye tannibodhata |
krauñcadvīpasya vistārācchālmalo dviguṇo mataḥ || 1 ||
ghṛtasamudramāvṛtya vyavasthistadvistāro dviguṇastatra ca sapta parvatāḥ pradhānāstāvanti varṣāṇi tāvatyo nadyaḥ| tatra ca parvatāḥ| sumahān pītaḥśātakaumbhāt sārvaguṇasauvarṇarohitasumanasakuśala --- jāmbūnadavaidyutā ityete kulaparvatā varṣāṇi ceti| atha ṣaṣṭhaṃ gomedaṃ kathyate| śālmalaṃ yathā surodenāvṛtaṃ tadvat surodo'pi tadviguṇena gomedenāvṛtaḥ| tatra ca pradhānaparvatau dvāveva| ekasya tāvattāvasaraḥ| aparaśca kumuda iti| samudraścekṣurasastaddviguṇena puṣkareṇāvṛtaḥ| tatra ca puṣkarākhye mānaso nāma parvataḥ| tadapi dvidhā chinnaṃ varṣaṃ tatpramāṇena ca| svādodakenāvṛtam| tataśca kaṭāham| etat pṛthivyāḥ pramāṇam| brahmāṇḍasya ca sakaṭāhavistārapramāṇam| evaṃvidhānāmaṇḍānāṃ parisaṃkhyā na vidyate| etāni kalpe kalpe bhagavān nārāyaṇaḥ kroḍarūpī rasātalāntaḥpraviṣṭāni daṃṣṭraikainoddhṛtya sthitau sthāpayati|
eṣa vaḥ kathito mārgo bhūmerāyāmavistaraḥ | svasti vo'stu gamiṣyāmi kailāsaṃ nilayaṃ dvijāḥ || 2 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
evamuktvā gato rudraḥ kṣaṇādadṛśyamūrtimān |
te ca sarve gatā devā ṛṣayaśca yathāgatam || 3 ||
|| iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre aṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 88 ||
dharaṇyuvāca |
paramātmā śivaḥ puṇya iti kecid bhavaṃ viduḥ |
apare harimīśānamiti keciccaturmukham || 1 ||
eteṣāṃ katamo devaḥ paraḥ ko vā'thavā'paraḥ |
etaddeva mamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ vibho || 2 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca |
paro nārāyaṇo devastasmājjātaścaturmukhaḥ |
tasmād rudro'bhavad devi sa ca sarvajñatāṃ gataḥ || 3 ||
tasyāścaryāṇyanekāni vividhāni varānane |
śrṛṇu sarvāṇi cārvaṅgi kathyamānaṃ mayā'naghe || 4 ||
kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite |
vasatyanudinaṃ devaḥ śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥ || 5 ||
saikasmin divase devaḥ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtaḥ |
gaṇaiḥ parivṛto gauryā mahānāsīt pinākadhṛk || 6 ||
tatra siṃhamukhāḥ kecid gaṇā nardanti siṃhavat |
apare hastivaktrāśca hayavaktrāstathāpare || 7 ||
apare śiṃśumārāsyā apare sūkarānanāḥ |
apare'śvāmukhā raudrā kharāsyājānanāstathā |
chāgamatsyānanāḥ krūrā hyanantāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || 8 ||
kecid gāyanti nṛtyanti dhāvanti sphoṭayanti ca |
hasanti kilakilāyanti garjanti ca mahābalāḥ || 9 ||
kecilloṣṭāṃstu saṃgṛhya yuyudhurgaṇanāyakāḥ |
apare mallayuddhena yuyudhurbaladarpitāḥ |
evaṃ gaṇasahastreṇa vṛto devo maheśvaraḥ || 10 ||
yāvadāste svayaṃ devyā krīḍan devavaraḥ svayam |
tāvad brahmā svayaṃ devairupāyāt saha satvaraḥ || 11 ||
tamāgatamatho dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ |
uvāca paramo devo rudro brahmāṇamavyam || 12 ||
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ te brahman brūhi mamāciram |
kiṃ ca devāstvarāyuktā āgatā mama sannidhau || 13 ||
brahmovāca |
astyandhako mahādaityastena sarve divaukasaḥ |
arditā matsamīpaṃ tu buddhvā māṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ || 14 ||

gacchāma iti deveśa tatastvete samāgatāḥ || 15 ||

bhagavaṃstvatprasādena saṃsārārṇavatāraṇam ||
icchāmastvaihikīṃ lakṣmīṃ viśeṣeṇa tapodhana || 18 ||
evamabhyarcya medhāvī guruṃ viṣṇumivāgrataḥ ||
abhyarccitastaiḥ so'pyāśu daśamyāṃ kārttikasya tu ||19||
kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ samantrakam ||
bhakṣayitvā svapeyurhi devadevasya sannidhau ||20||
svapnāndṛṣṭvā guroragre śrāvayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
tataḥ śubhāśubhe tatra lakṣayetparamo guruḥ || 21 ||
ekādaśyāmupoṣyaivaṃ snātvā devālayaṃ vrajet ||
guruśca maṇḍalaṃ bhūmau kalpitāyāṃ tu varttayet ||22||
lakṣaṇairvividhairbhūmiṃ lakṣayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
ṣoḍaśāraṃ likheccakraṃ sarvatobhadrameva ca ||23||
athavā aṣṭapatraṃ ca likhitvā darśayedbudhaḥ||
netrabandhaṃ tu kurvīta sitavastreṇa yatnataḥ||24||
varṇānukramataḥ śiṣyānpuṣpahastānpraveśayet||
navanābhaṃ yadā kuryānmaṇḍalaṃ varṇakairbudhaḥ||25||
tadānīṃ pūrvato devamidrapūrvaṃ tu pūjayet ||
lokapālaiḥ samaṃ pūjya agniṃ sampūjayecchubhe||26||
svadikṣu tadvadyāmyāyāṃ nerṛtyāṃ nirṛtiṃ nyaset ||
varuṇaṃ vāruṇāyāṃ ca vāyuṃ vāyavyato nyaset||27||
dhanadaṃ cottare nyasya rudramīśānagocare|
pūjyaivaṃ tu vidhānena dikkṣetreṣu vyavasthitām||28||
padmamadhye tathā viṣṇumarccayetparameśvaram ||
pūrvapatre balaṃ pūjya pradyumnaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā ||29||
aniruddhaṃ tathā pūjya paścime cottare tathā ||
pūjayedvāsudevaṃ tu sarvapātakaśāntidam ||30||
aiśānyāṃ vinyasecchaṃkhamāgneyyāṃ cakrameva tu ||
yāmyāyāṃ tu gadāṃ pūjya vāyavyāṃ padmameva ca ||31||
aiśānyāṃ musalaṃ pūjya dakṣiṇe garuḍaṃ nyaset ||
vāmato vinyasellakṣmīṃ devadevasya buddhimān||32||
dhanuścaiva tu khaḍgaṃ tu devasya purato nyaset|
śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ caiva navamaṃ tatra kalpayet||33||
evaṃ pūjya yathānyāyaṃ devadevaṃ janārddanam||
daleṣu dikṣu vinyasya aṣṭau kumbhānvidhānataḥ ||34||
vaiṣṇavaṃ kalaśaṃ caiva navamaṃ tatra kalpayet ||
snāpayenmuktikāmaṃ tu vaiṣṇavena ghaṭena ha || 32 ||
śrīkāmaṃ snāpayettadvadaindreṇa tu ghaṭena ha ||
prājyapratāpakāmaṃ ca āgneyena tu snāpayet ||36||
mṛtyuñjayavidhānāya yāmyena snapanaṃ tathā ||
duṣṭapradhvaṃsanāyālaṃ nirṛtena vidhīyate ||37||
śāntaye vāruṇenāśu pāpanāśāya vāyave ||
dravyasampattikāmasya kaubereṇa vidhīyate || 38 ||
raudreṇa jñānahetośca lokapālapadāptaye ||
ekaikena naraḥ snātaḥ sarvapāpa vivarjitaḥ ||39||
bhavedavyāhataṃ jñānaṃ śrīmānvipro vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
kiṃ punarnavabhiḥ snāto naraḥ pātakavarjitaḥ||40||
jāyate viṣṇusadṛśaḥ sadyo rājāthavā bhavet ||
athavā dikṣu sarvāsu yathāsaṃkhyena lokapān ||
pūjayīta svaśāstroktavidhānena vidhānavit || 41 ||
evaṃ sampūjya devāṃśca lokapālān prasannadhīḥ ||
paścātpradakṣiṇān śiṣyān baddhanetrān praveśayet ||
āgneyī vāruṇī dagdhā vāyunā vidhinā tataḥ ||42||
saumenāpyāyitā paścācchrāvayetsamayānbudhaḥ||
anindyānbrāhmaṇānvedānviṣṇuṃ brahmāṇameva ca || 43 ||
rudramādityamagniṃ ca lokapālagrahāṃstataḥ ||
gurūṃśca vaiṣṇavāṃścāpi puruṣaḥ pūrvadīkṣitaḥ || 44 ||
evaṃ tu samayaṃ khyāpya paścāddhomaṃ tu kārayet ||
oṃ namo bhagavate sarvarūpiṇe huṃ phaṭ svāhā || 45 ||
ṣoḍaśākṣaramantreṇa homayejjvalitāgnaye ||
garbhādhānādikāścaiva kriyāḥ samavaghārayet ||46||
tribhirāhutibhiścāpi devadevasya sannidhau ||
homānte dīkṣitaḥ paścāddadyācca gurudakṣiṇām ||47||
hastyaśvakaṭakādīni hemagrāmādikaṃ nṛpaḥ||
dadyācca gurave prājño madhyame madhyamaṃ tathā ||48||
evaṃ kṛte tu yatpuṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ jāyate dhare ||
tatra śakyaṃ tu gaditumapi varṣaśatairapi||49||
dīkṣitātmā punarbhūtvā varāhaṃ śṛṇuyādyadi ||
tena vedapurāṇāni sarve mantrāḥ sasaṃgrahāḥ||50||
japtāḥ syuḥ puṣkare tīrthe prayāge sindhusaṅgame ||
devāgāre kurukṣetre vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||51||
grahaṇe viṣuve caiva yatphalaṃ japatāṃ bhavet ||
tatphalaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya dīkṣito yaḥ śṛṇoti ca ||52||
devā api tapaḥ kṛtvā dhyāyaṃti ca vadaṃti ca ||
kadā no bhārate varṣe janma syādbhūtadhāriṇi||53|||
dīkṣitāśca bhaviṣyāmo varāhaṃ śṛṇumaḥ katham||
varāhaṃ ṣoḍaśātmānaṃ tyaktvā dehaṃ kadā vayam||54||
yāsyāmaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yadgatvā na punarbhavet ||
evaṃ jalpanti vibudhā manasā cintayanti ca||55||
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam||
vasiṣṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ śvetasya ca mahātmanaḥ ||56 ||
svargavāse sthito hyāsīcchveto rājā mahāyaśāḥ||
āsīdilāvṛte varṣe śveto rājā bṛhattapāḥ|| 57||
sa mahīṃ sakalāndevi sapallavavanadrumām ||
dātumicchansa covāca vasiṣṭhaṃ tapasāṃ nidhim || 58 ||
bhagavandātumicchāmi brāhmaṇebhyo vasundharām||
dehyanujñāṃ sa covāca vasiṣṭho rājasattamam ||59||
annaṃ dehi sadā rājan sarvakālasukhāvaham ||
annena caiva dattena kiṃ na dattaṃ mahītale ||60||
sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannadānaṃ viśiṣyate ||
annādbhavaṃti bhūtāni annenaiva ca varddhate ||61||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena annadānaṃ dadasva bhoḥ ||
vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa rājā na tathākarot ||62||
ratnavastramalaṃkārān śrīmanti nagarāṇi ca ||
yatkiñcitkośajātaṃ sa dvijānāhūya taddadau ||63||
pradattaṃ brāhmaṇasyātha kuṃjarānajināni ca ||
sa kadācinnṛpaḥ pṛthvīṃ jitvā paramadharmavit || 64 ||
purohitamuvācedaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ japatāṃ varam ||
bhagavannaśvamedhānāṃ sahasraṃ kartumutsahe ||65||
suvarṇaraupyatāmrāṇi yāgaṃ kṛtvā dvijātiṣu ||
dattāni tena rājñā vai nānnaṃ dattaṃ tathā jalam||66||
vastu svalpamiti jñātvā prabhuḥ so'nnaṃ tu nādadat ||
evaṃ vibhavayuktasya tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ ||67 ||
kāladharmavaśāddevi mṛtyuḥ samabhavattadā ||
paraloke vartamānaḥ sa ca rājā mahāmanāḥ ||68||
kṣudhayā pīḍito hyāsīttṛṣayā ca viśeṣataḥ ||
ānināyāpsarobhāgaṃ gatvā śvetākhyaparvatam ||69||
tatra prāgjanmamūrttiśca purā dagdhā mahātmanaḥ ||
tatrāsthīni sa saṃgṛhya lihannāste sa pārthivaḥ || 70 ||
punarvimānamāruhya divamācakrame nṛpaḥ ||
atha kālena mahatā sa rājā saṃśitavrataḥ ||71||
tānyasthīni lihandṛṣṭo vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ||
uktaśca tena kiñca tvaṃ svāsthi bhuṃkṣe narādhipa || 72 ||
evamuktastadā rājā vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ||
uvāca vacanaṃ cedaṃ śveto rājā muniṃ tadā || 73 ||
bhagankṣudhitaścāsmi annapānaṃ purā mayā ||
na dattaṃ muniśārdūla tena māṃ bādhate kṣudhā || 74 ||
evamuktastato rājñā vasiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ ||
uvāca ca munirbhūyaḥ śvetaṃ vākyaṃ mahānṛpam || 79 ||
kiṃ te karomi rājeṃdra kṣudhitasya viśeṣataḥ ||
adattaṃ nopatiṣṭheta kasyacitkiñciduttamam || 76 ||
ratnahemapradānena bhogavān jāyate naraḥ ||
annapānapradānena sarvakāmaistu tarpitaḥ || 77 ||
tanna dattaṃ tvayā rājan stokaṃ matvā narādhipa ||
śveta uvāca ||
adattasya ca samprāptistanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 78 ||
śirasā bhaktiyuktena yācito'si mahāmune ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca ||
astyekaṃ kāraṇaṃ yena jāyate tanna saṃśayaḥ || 79 ||
tacchṛṇuṣva naravyāghra kathyamānaṃ mayā'nagha ||
āsīdrājā purākalpe vinītāścātiviśrutaḥ || 80 ||
sa sarvamedhamārebhe svayaṃ kratuvaraṃ nṛpaḥ ||
yajatānena viprebhyo dattā gāvo dvipā vasu || 81 ||
nānnaṃ tena tadā dattaṃ svalpaṃ matvā yathā tvayā ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā mṛto'sau jāhnavījale || 82 ||
kṛtvā puṇyaṃ vinātīśvaḥ sārvabhaumo nṛpottamaḥ ||
svargaṃ ca gatavānso'pi yathā rājan bhavān prabho || 83 ||
asāvapi kṣudhāviṣṭa evameva gato nṛpaḥ ||
martyaloke nadītīre gaṃgāyāṃ nīlapavartam || 84 ||
vimānenārkavarṇena bhāsvatā devavannṛpaḥ ||
dadarśa ca tadā rājā kṣudhitaḥ svaṃ kalevaram || 85 ||
purohitaṃ dadarśātha hotāraṃ jāhnavītaṭe ||
taddṛṣṭvā'sāvapi nṛpaḥ papraccha munisattamam || 86 ||
kṣudhāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ me sa hotā tamuvāca ha ||
tiladhenuṃ bhavānrājañjaladhenuṃ ca sattama ||87 ||
ghṛtadhenuṃ ca dhenuṃ ca rasadhenuṃ ca pārthiva ||
dehi śīghraṃ yena bhavānkṣudhayā varjjito bhaveḥ || 88 ||
tapate yāvadādityastapate vāpi candramāḥ ||
evamuktastato rājā taṃ punaḥ pṛṣṭavānidam ||89||
vinītāśva uvāca ||
kathaṃ sā dīyate brahmaṃstiladhenurjigīṣubhiḥ ||
bhuṅkte svargaṃ ca viprendra tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||90 ||
hotovāca ||
vidhānaṃ tiladhenośca tvaṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa ||
caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiścaiva prastha ekaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ||91 ||
sā tu ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kāryā caturbhir vatsako bhavet ||
nāsā gandhamayī tasyā jihvā guḍamayī śubhā || 95 ||
pucche prakalpanīyā sā ghaṇṭābharaṇābhūṣitā ||
īdṛśīṃ kalpayitvā tu svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ tu kārayet || 93||
kāṃsyadohāṃ raupyakhurāṃ pūrvadhenuvidhānataḥ ||
kṛtvā tāṃ brāhmaṇāyāśu dadyāccaiva narādhipa || 94 ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ dhenuvāso nanditāṃ kalpitāṃ śubhām ||
sūtreṇa sūtritāṃ kṛtvā sarvaratnasamanvitām || 99 ||
sarvauṣadhisamāyuktāṃ mantrapūtāṃ tu dāpayet ||
annaṃ me jāyatāmanyatpānaṃ sarvarasāstathā || 96||
sarvaṃ sampādayāsmākaṃ tiladheno dvijārpitā ||
gṛhṇāmi devi tvāṃ bhaktyā kuṭumbārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||97||
bhajasva kāmānmāṃ devi tiladheno namo'stu te ||
evaṃvidhāṃ tato dadyāttiladhenuṃ nṛpottama || 98 ||
sarvakāmasamāvāptiṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā kuryātkārayate'pi vā || 99 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati ||
gomaye maṇḍale kṛtvā gocarmma tadanantaram || 100 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne tiladhenudānamāhātmyaṃ nāma navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 99 ||
atha jaladhenudāna vidhiḥ ||
hotovāca ||
jaladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam ||
gocarmmamātraṃ bhūbhāgaṃ gomayenopalepayet || 1 ||
tatra madhye tu rājendra pūrṇaṃ kumbhaṃ ca vinyaset ||
jalapūrṇaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ || 2 ||
vāsitaṃ gandhatoyena tāṃ dhenuṃ parikalpayet ||
vatsaṃ tathāparaṃ kalpya jalena paripūritam || 3||
varddhanīkaṃ(varddhanakiṃ) mahārāja yantrapuṣpaiḥ samanvitam ||
dūrvāṃkurairupastīrya sragbhiścaiva vibhūṣitam || 4 ||
paṃcaratnāni niḥkṣipya tasmin kumbhe narādhipa ||
māṃsīmuśīraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca tathā śaileyabālukam || 5 ||
dhātrīphalaṃ sarṣapāśca sarvadhānyāni pārthiva ||
caturdikṣvapi pātrāṇi catvāryeva prakalpayet || 6 ||
ekaṃ ghṛtamayaṃ pātraṃ dvitīyaṃ dadhipūritam ||
tṛtīyaṃ madhunaścaiva caturthaṃ śarkarāvṛtam || 7 ||
suvarṇamukhacakṣūṃṣi śṛṃgaṃ kṛṣṇāṃgareṣu ca ||
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ muktāphalamayekṣaṇām ||8 ||
tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ darbharomasamanvitām ||
pucchaṃ sūtramayaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇābharaṇa ghaṇṭikām || 9 ||
kambale puṣpamālāṃ ca guḍāsyāṃ śuktidantikām ||
jihvāṃ śarkarayā kṛtvā navanītena ca stanān || 10 ||
ikṣupādāṃ tu rājendra gandhapuṣpopaśobhitām ||
kṛṣṇājinopari sthāpya vastreṇācchāditāṃ tu tām || 11 ||
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya viprāya vinivedayet ||
evaṃ dhenuṃ tadā dattvā brāhmaṇe vedapārage || 12||
sādhuviprāya rājendra śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ||
tapovṛddhāya pātrāya dātavyā ca kuṭumbine || 13 ||
yo dadāti naro rājan yaḥ paśyati śṛṇoti ca ||
pratigṛhṇāti yo vipraḥ sarve mucyanti pātakāt || 14 ||
brahmahā pitṛhā goghnaḥ surāpo gurutalpagaḥ ||
muktāḥ sarvapāpaistu gantāro viṣṇumaṃdire || 15 ||
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpaistu viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
yo'śvamedhena yajate samāptavaradakṣiṇaḥ || 16 ||
jaladhenuṃ ca yo dadyātsamametannarādhipa ||
jalāhārastvekadinaṃ tiṣṭhecca jaladhenudaḥ || 17 ||
grāhako'pi trirātraṃ vai tiṣṭhedevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
yatra kṣīravahā nadyo madhupāyasakardamāḥ ||18||
yatra cāpsarasāṃ gītaṃ tatra yānti jalapradāḥ ||
dātā ca dāpakaścaiva pratigrāhī ca yo dvijaḥ || 19 ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyuḥ ||
jaladhenuvidhānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyātkīrttayedapi || 20 ||

iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne jaladhenuvidhirnāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 100 || 
atha rasa dhenudānamāhātmyam ||
hotovāca ||
rasadhenuvidhānaṃ te kathayāmi samāsataḥ ||
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinakuśāstare || 1 ||
rasasya tu ghaṭaṃ rājan sampūrṇaṃ tvaikṣavasya tu ||
tadvatsaṅkalpayetprājñaścaturthāṃśena vatsakam || 2 ||
turīyāṃśena vatsaṃ tu tatpārśve sthāpayetsudhīḥ ||
ikṣudaṇḍamayāḥ pādā rajatasya khurairyutāḥ || 3 ||
evaṃ kāryā rasairdhenurikṣupādasamanvitā || 4 ||
suvarṇaśṛṃgābharaṇā vastrapucchā ghṛtastanī ||
puṣpakambalasaṃyuktā śarkarāmukhajihvakā || 5 ||
dantāḥ phalamayāstasyāḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ tāmramayaṃ śubham ||

saptavrīhisamāyuktāṃ caturdikṣu ca dīpitām ||

catvāri tilapātrāṇi caturdikṣu niveśayet ||
sarvalakṣaṇayuktāya śrotriyāya kuṭumbine || 8 ||

prārthanāpūrvakaṃ bhaktyā dvijāgryāya nivedayet || 12 ||

ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādatha bhaktitaḥ ||

hotovāca||
guḍadhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmārthasādhinīm ||
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinakuśāstṛte || 1 ||
tasyoparikṛtaṃ vastraṃ guḍamānīya puṣkalam ||
kṛtvā guḍamayīṃ dhenuṃ savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanīm || 2 ||
sauvarṇe mukhaśṛṅge ca dantāśca maṇimauktikaiḥ ||
grīvā ratnamayī tvasyā ghrāṇaṃ gandhamayaṃ tathā || 3 ||
śṛṅge tvagurukāṣṭhena pṛṣṭhaṃ tāmramayaṃ tathā ||
pucchaṃ kṣaumamayaṃ tasyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ||4||
ikṣupādāṃ ropyakhurāṃ kambalaṃ paṭṭasūtrakam ||
ācchādya paṭṭavastreṇa ghaṇṭācāmaraśobhitām ||5||
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ navanītastanīṃ budhaḥ ||
phalairnānāvidhaistasyā upaśobhāṃ prakalpayet || 6 ||
uttamā guḍadhenuḥ syātsadādhāracatuṣṭayam ||
bhāgārddhena tu taulyena caturthāṃśena vatsakam || 7 ||
madhyamā ca tadardhena bhāreṇaikena cādhamā ||
vittahīno yathāśakti śatairaṣṭābhireva ca ||8||
ata urdhvaṃ tu karttavyā gṛhavittānusārataḥ ||
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 9 ||
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kṛtvā ghṛtanaivedyadīpakān ||
evaṃ kṛtvā dvijendrāya āhitāgnerviśeṣataḥ || 10||
śrotriyāya pradātavyā sahasrakanakena tu ||
tadardhena mahārāja tasyāpyarddhena vā punaḥ ||11 ||
śatena vā śatārdhena yathāśakti nivedayet ||
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya mudrikākarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 12 ||
chatrikā pāduke dattvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet ||
guḍadheno mahāvīrye sarvasampatprade śubhe||13||
dānādasmācca bho devi bhakṣyabhojyaṃ prayaccha me||
yā śriyādīni mantrāṇi pūrvoktāni smaredbudhaḥ ||14||
prāṅmukho vāpi dātā ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ manasā yadvicintitam || 15 ||
mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāgo'rthe udāhṛtam ||
anṛtaṃ nāśamāyātu guḍadheno dvijārpitā || 16 ||
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim ||
yatra kṣīravahā nadyo ghṛtapāyasa kardamāḥ || 17 ||
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāstatra gacchanti dhenudāḥ ||
daśa pūrvāndaśa parānātmānaṃ caikaviṃśatim ||18 ||
viṣṇulokaṃ nayatyāśu guḍadhenoḥ prasādataḥ ||
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye ||
etadeva vidhānaṃ syādete copaskarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 19 ||
mantrāvāhanasaṃyogaḥ sadā parvaṇiparvaṇi ||
sarvadaiva pradātavyā pātraṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāmate || 20 ||
śraddhānvitena dātavyā bhuktimuktiphalapradā ||
sarvakāmapradā nityaṃ sarvapāpaharā smṛtā || 21 ||
guḍadhenoḥ prasādācca saubhāgyamakhilaṃ labhet ||
iha saubhāgyamatulamāyurārogyasampadaḥ || 22 ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnoti daurgatyaṃ tasya naśyati ||
daśadvādaśa sāhasrā daśa cāṣṭau ca janmani || 23 ||
na śokaduḥkhadaurgatyaṃ tasya saṃjāyate kvacit || 24 ||
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti ceha samyak matimapi caiva dadāti yojanānām ||
sa iha ca vibhavaiściraṃ vasitvā vasati ciraṃ divi devatādipūjyaḥ || 25 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne guḍadhenudānamāhātmyaṃ nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 102 ||
atha śarkarādhenudānamāhātmyam ||
hotovāca ||
tadvacca śarkarādhenuṃ śṛṇu rājanyathārthataḥ ||
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinakuśāstare || 1 ||
dhenuṃ śarkarayā rājankṛtvā bhāracatuṣṭayam ||
uttamā kathyate sadbhiścaturthāṃśena vatsakam || 2 ||
tadarddhaṃ madhyamā proktā kaniṣṭhā bhārakeṇa tu ||
tadvadvatsaṃ prakurvīta caturthāṃśena tattvataḥ || 3 ||
atha kuryādaṣṭaśatairūrdhvaṃ nṛpatisattama ||
svaśaktyā kārayeddhenuṃ tathātmānaṃ na pīḍayet ||4 ||
sarvabījāni saṃsthāpya caturdikṣu samantataḥ||
suvarṇasya mukhaṃ śṛṅge mauktikairnayane tathā || 5||
sauvarṇamukhaśṛṅgāṇi mauktike nayanāni ca ||
guḍena tu mukhaṃ kāryaṃ jihvā piṣṭamayī tathā || 6 ||
kambalaiḥ paṭṭasūtreṇa kaṇṭhābhūṣaiśca bhūṣitām ||
ikṣupādāṃ ropyakhurāṃ navanītastanīṃ tathā || 7 ||
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ sitacāmarabhūṣitām ||
paṃcaratnasamāyuktāṃ vastreṇācchāditāṃ tathā || 8 ||
gandhapuṣpairalaṃkṛtya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
śrotriyāya daridrāya sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate || 9 ||
vedavedāṃṅgaviduṣe sāgnikāya kuṭumbine ||
aduṣṭāya pradātavyaṃ na tu matsariṇe dvija || 10 ||
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye ||
eṣu puṇyeṣu kāleṣu yathāvibhavaśaktitaḥ || 11 ||
satpātraṃ ca dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvāgataṃ śrotriyaṃ gṛhe ||
āgatāya pradātavyā pucchadeśe vimṛśya ca || 12 ||
pūrvābhimukhamāsthāya athavā sa udaṅmukhaḥ ||
gāṃ pūrvābhimukhīṃ kṛtvā vatsamuttarato nyaset || 13 ||
dānakāle tu ye mantrāstānpaṭhitvā samarpayet ||
sampūjya vidhivadvipraṃ mudrikākarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 14||
svaśaktyā dakṣiṇā deyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ||
haste tu dakṣiṇāṃ datvā gandhapuṣpāḍhyacandanām || 15||
dhenuṃ samarpayettasya mukhaṃ ca na vilokayet||
ekāhaṃ śarkarāhāro brāhmaṇastridinaṃ vaset|| 16||
sarvapāpaharā dhenuḥ sarvakāmapradāyinī ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhastu jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 17||
dīyamānaṃ prapaśyanti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā paṭhate vāpi mānavaḥ|| 18||
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 19 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne śarkarādhenumāhātmyaṃ nāma tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||103||
atha madhudhenudānamāhātmyam||
hotovāca||
madhudhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśinīm ||
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinakuśottare||1||
dhenuṃ madhumayīṃ kṛtvā sampūrṇaghaṭaṣoḍaśām||
caturthena tathāṃśena vatsakaṃ parikalpayet||2||
sauvarṇaṃ tu mukhaṃ kṛtvā śṛṅgāṇyagurucaṃdanaiḥ||
pṛṣṭhaṃ tāmramayaṃ kṛtvā sāsrāṃ paṭamayīṃ tathā||3||
pādānikṣumayānkṛtvā sitakambalasaṃvṛtān||
mukhaṃ guḍamayaṃ kṛtvā jihvāṃ śarkarayā tathā||4||
oṣṭhau puṣpamayau tasyā dantāḥ phalamayāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
darbharomamayī devī khurairaupyaiśca bhūṣitā ||5||
praśastapatraśravaṇā pramāṇātparitastatā ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktā saptadhānyānvitā tathā||6||
catvāri tilapātrāṇi caturdikṣu prakalpayet||
chāditāṃ vastrayugmena kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣitām||7||
kāṃsyopadohinīṃ kṛtvā gandhapuṣpaistu pūjitām ||
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye ||8 ||
saṃkrāṃtyāmuparāge ca sarvakāle yadṛcchayā ||
dravyabrāhmaṇasampattiṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ pratipādayet ||9||
brāhmaṇāya daridrāya śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ||
āryāvartte samutpanne vedavedāṅgapārage ||10||
tādṛśāya pradātavyā madhu dhenurnarottame ||
pucchadeśe vimṛśyātha jalapūrṇāṃ sadakṣiṇām ||11 ||
dadyādviprāya dhenuṃ tāṃ mantrapūrvāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
pucchadeśopaviṣṭastu gandhadhūpādipūjitā ||
ācchādya vastrayugmena mudrikāvarṇamātrakaiḥ ||
svaśaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
jalapūrvaṃ tu karttavyaṃ paścādyānaṃ samarpayet ||
rasajñā sarvadevānāṃ sarvabhūtahite ratā|| 12||
prīyantāṃ pitaro devā madhudheno namo'stu te||
evamuccārya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet||13||
ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ devi kuṭumbārthe viśeṣataḥ ||
kāmaṃ kāmadughe kāmānmadhudheno namo'stu te || 14||
madhuvāteti mantreṇa dadyādāśucikena tu ||
dattvā dhenuṃ mahārāja chatrikopānahau tathā ||15||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā madhudhenuṃ narādhipa ||
dattvā dānaṃ pāyasena madhunā ca dinaṃ nayet||16||
brāhmaṇaśca trirātraṃ tu madhupāyasasaṃyutam ||
evaṃ kṛte tu yatpuṇyaṃ tannibodha narādhipa || 17 ||
yatra nadyo madhuvahā yatra pāyasakardamāḥ ||
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāstatra gacchanti dhenudāḥ ||18||
tatra bhogānatho bhuṅkte brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ punarmartyamupāgataḥ||19||
sa bhuktvā vipulānbhogānviṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati||
daśa pūrvāndaśa parānātmānaṃ caikatriṃśakam||20||
nayate viṣṇusāyujyaṃ madhudhenupradānataḥ ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvāpi mānavaḥ ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||21||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne madhudhenumāhātmyaṃ nāma caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||104||
atha kṣīradhenudānavidhiḥ ||
hotovāca ||
kṣīradhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ nibodha narādhipa ||
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe gomayena nṛpottama ||1 ||
gocarmamātramānena kuśānāstīrya sarvataḥ ||
tasyopari mahārāja nyasetkṛṣṇājinaṃ budhaḥ ||2||
tatra kṛtvā kuṇḍalikāṃ gomayena suvistṛtām ||
kṣīrakumbhaṃ tataḥ sthāpya caturthāṃśena vatsakam ||3||
suvarṇamukhaśṛṅgāṇi candanāgurukāṇi ca ||
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ tilapātropari nyaset ||4||
mukhaṃ guḍamayaṃ tasyā jihvāṃ śarkarayā tathā ||
phalapraśastadaśanāṃ muktāphalamayekṣaṇām ||5||
ikṣupādāṃ darbharomāṃ sitakambalasaṃvṛtām ||
tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ paṭṭasūtramayīṃ śubhām||6||
pucchaṃ ca nṛpaśārdūla navanītamayastanīm||
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ pañcaratnasamanvitām ||7||
catvāri tilapātrāṇi caturdikṣvapi vinyaset ||
saptadhānyayutaṃ pātre dikṣu dikṣu ca vinyaset ||8 ||
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ kṣīradhenuṃ prakalpayet ||
ācchādya vastrayugmena gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 9 ||
dhūpadīpādikaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
vastrādibhiralaṃkṛtya mudrikākarṇakuṇḍalaiḥ ||10 ||
pādukopānahau chatraṃ dattvā dānaṃ samarpayet ||
dadyādanena mantreṇa kṣīradhenuṃ prayatnataḥ ||11||

āśrayaḥ sarvabhūtānāmityādi narapuṅgava||12||
āpyāyasveti mantreṇa kṣīradhenuṃ prasādayet ||
pratigrāhī paṭhenmantrameṣa dānavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||13||
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti te yānti paramāṃ gatim ||
etāṃ hemasahasreṇa śatenātha svaśaktitaḥ||14||
datvā dhenuṃ mahārāja śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasraṃ tu indraloke mahīyate||15||
pitrādibhiśca sahito brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ vrajet ||
divyaṃ vimānamārūḍho divyasraganulepanaḥ ||16||
krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
dvādaśādityasaṃkāśe vimānavaramaṇḍite || 17 ||
gītavāditranirghoṣairapsarobhiśca sevite ||
tatroṣya viṣṇorbhavane viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt ||18|
yaṃ imaṃ śṛṇuyādrājanpaṭhedvā bhaktibhāvataḥ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||19 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvāpokhyāne kṣīradhenudānavidhirnāma pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||105||
atha dadhidhenudāna māhātmyam ||
hotovāca ||
dadhidhenormahārāja vidhānaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam ||
anulipte mahībhāge gomayena narādhipaḥ ||1 ||
gocarmamātraṃ tu punaḥ puṣpaprakaraśobhite ||
kuśairāstīrya vasudhāṃ kṛṣṇājinakuśottarīm || 2 ||
dadhikumbhaṃ tu saṃsthāpya saptadhānyacayopari ||
caturthāṃśena vatsaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ mukhamaṇḍitam ||3||
ācchādya vastrayugmena puṣpagandhaistu pūjitām ||
brāhmaṇāya kulīnāya sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate ||4||
kṣamādiguṇayuktāya dadyāttāṃ dadhidhenukām ||
pucchadeśopaviṣṭastu mudrikākarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||5 ||
pādukopānahau chatraṃ dattvā maṃtramimaṃ paṭhet ||
dadhikrāvṇeti maṃtreṇa dadyāddhenuṃ supūjitām || 6 ||
evaṃ dadhimayīṃ dhenuṃ dattvā rājarṣisattama ||
ekāhārī dinaṃ tiṣṭheddadhnā ca nṛpanandana ||7||
yajamāno vasedrājaṃstrirātraṃ ca dvijottamaḥ ||
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti te yānti paramaṃ padam || 8 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvāpi mānavaḥ ||
so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati || 9 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvāpokhyāne dadhidhenudānamāhātmyaṃnāma ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 106 ||
atha navanītadhenudānamāhātmyam ||
hotovāca ||
navanītamayīṃ dhenuṃ śṛṇu rājanprayatnataḥ ||
yāṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 ||
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ bhūmau gocarmamānataḥ ||
carma kṛṣṇamṛgasyeva tasyopari ca dhārayet || 2 ||
kumbhaṃ tu navanītasya prasthamātrasya dhārayet ||
vatsaṃ caturthabhāgasya tasyāmuttarato nyaset || 3 ||
kṛtvā vidhānena ca rājasiṃha suvarṇaśṛṅgī sumukhā ca kāryā ||
netre ca tasyā maṇimauktikaistu kṛtvā tathānyacca guḍena jihvām || 4 ||
oṣṭhau ca puṣpaiśca phalaiśca dantāḥ prakalpya sāsnāṃ ca sitaiśca sūtraiḥ ||
jihvāṃ tathā śarkarayā prakalpya phalāni dantāḥ kambalaṃ paṭṭasūtram || 5 || 
navanītastanīṃ rājannikṣupādāṃ prakalpayet ||
tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ raupyakhurāṃ darbharomakṛtacchavim || 6 ||

caturbhistilapātraiśca saṃvṛtāṃ sarvato diśi || 7 ||
ācchādya vastrayugmena gandhapuṣpairalaṃkṛtām ||

atha lavaṇadhenudānamāhātmyam ||
hotovāca ||
lavaṇadhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ nibodha nṛpottama ||
ṣoḍaśaprasthasaṃyuktāṃ dhenuṃ kṛtvā tu mānavaḥ || 1 ||
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinakuśottare ||

vatsaṃ caturbhī rājendra ikṣupādāṃśca kārayet ||
suvarṇamukhaśṛṅgāṇi khurā raupyamayāstathā || 3 ||
mukhaṃ guḍamayaṃ tasyā dantāḥ phalamayā nṛpa ||
jihvāṃ śarkarayā rājanghrāṇaṃ gandhamayaṃ tathā ||
netre ratnamaye kuryātkarṇau patramayau tathā ||
śrīkhaṇḍamayakoṣṭhau ca navanītamayāḥ stanāḥ || 4 ||
sūtrapucchāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ darbharomāṃ payasvinīm ||
kāṃsyopadohāṃ rājendra ghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣitām ||5||
sugandhapuṣpadhūpaiśca pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
ācchādya vastrayugmena brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 6 ||

vedavedāṅgaviduṣe śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ||
īdṛśāya pradātavyā tathā'matsariṇe nṛpa || 9 ||
iṣṭvā caivaṃ ca mantraṃ tu pucchadeśopaviśya ca ||

dattvā dhenuṃ tu lavaṇenaikāhaṃ caiva tiṣṭhati ||

sahasreṇa śatenātha svaśaktyā kanakena tu ||
dattvemāṃ svargamāpnoti yatra devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 16 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvāpi mānavaḥ ||
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ ca gacchati || 17 ||

atha kārpāsadhenudānamāhātmyam ||
hotovāca ||
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dhenuṃ kārpāsakīṃ nṛpa ||
yatpradānānnaro yāti aindralokamanuttam || 1 ||
viṣuve tvayane puṇye yugādigrahaṇe tathā ||
grahapīḍāsu cogrāsu duḥsvapne'riṣṭadarśane || 2 ||
nṛṇāṃ ca grahapīḍāsu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane ||
puṇyeṣvāyatane rājañchucideśe gavāṃ gaṇe || 3 ||
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ darbhānāstīrya vai tilān ||
tanmadhye sthāpayeddhenuṃ vastramālyānulepanām || 4 ||
dhūpadīpādinaivedyaiḥ pūjayecca vimatsaraḥ ||
uttamā ca caturbhārairarddhenaiva tu madhyamā || 5 ||
bhāreṇa cādhamā proktā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||
caturthāṃśena vatsaṃ tu kalpayitvā vidhānataḥ| 6 ||
karttavyā rukmaśṛṅgī tu rajatasya khurānvitā ||
nānāphalamayā dantā ratnagarbhasamanvitāḥ ||7||
ityevaṃ sarvasampūrṇā kṛtvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
āvāhayettāṃ kārpāsadhenuṃ mantrairdvijātaye || 8||
dadyāddhenuṃ carmapāṇiḥ prayataḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
pūrvoktastu vidhiḥ kāryo dānamantrapurasaraḥ || 9 ||
yayā devagaṇaḥ sarvastvayā hīno na varttate ||
tathā uddhara māṃ devi pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt || 10 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne kārpāsadhenudānamāhātmyaṃ nāma navādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||109||
atha dhānyadhenudānamāhātmyam ||
hotovāca||
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi dhānyadhenumanuttamām ||
yasyāḥ saṃkīrtanādeva sā tuṣyet pārvatī svayam ||1 ||
viṣuve cāyane vāpi kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||
yāṃ dattvā mucyate pāpācchaśāṃka iva rāhuṇā ||2||
(tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi dhānyadhenuvidhiṃ param)
daśadhenupradānena yatphalaṃ rājasattama||
tatsarvameva prāpnoti vrīhidhenupradānataḥ ||3||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prāgvatsaṃsthāpayedbudhaḥ ||
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ bhūmau tāṃ paripūjayet ||4||
uttamā tu bhaveddhenurdroṇaiścāpi catuṣṭayaiḥ ||
madhyamā ca tadardedhena vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet||5||
caturthāṃśena vatsaṃ tu kalpayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
caturthāṃśena dhenorvai vatsaṃ tu parikalpayet ||6||
kartavyau rukmaśṛṅgau tu rājatakhurasaṃyutau ||
gomedaiḥ kurvīta ghrāṇaṃ aguruṃ candanaṃ tathā|7||
muktāphalamayā daṃtā ghṛtakṣaudramayaṃ mukham||
praśastapatraśravaṇaṃ kāṃsyadohanakāritām||8||
ikṣupṛṣṭimayāḥ pādāḥ kṣaumyapucchasamanvitām ||
nānāphalasamopetāṃ ratnagarbhasamanvitām ||9||
pādukopānahacchatrabhājanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā||
aṅgaṃ tu pūrvavatkāryaṃ mukhaṃ kṣaudramayaṃ śubham||10||
pūrvavaccārccayitvā tāṃ kṛtvā dīpārccanādikam||
puṇyakālaṃ ca samprāpya snātaḥ śuklāṃbaro gṛhī||11||
triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛttya daṃḍavatpraṇamecca tām||
tvaṃ hi vipra mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāraga ||12||
mayā dattāṃ ca gṛhṇīṣva prasīda tvaṃ dvijottama||
prīyatāṃ mama deveśo bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ||13||
yā ca lakṣmīstu govinde svāhā yā ca vibhāvasau ||
śakre śacīti vikhyātā śive gaurī ca saṃsthitā || 14 ||
gāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ proktā jyotsnā candre raveḥ prabhā ||
buddhirbṛhaspateḥ khyātaṃ medhā muniṣu sattamā || 15 ||
tasmātsarvamayī devī dhānyarūpeṇa saṃsthitā ||
evamuccārya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 16 ||
dattvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ kṣamāpya dvijottamam ||
yāvacca pṛthivī sarvā vasuratnāni bhūpate || 17 ||
tāvatpuṇyaṃ samadhikaṃ vrīhidhenośca tatphalam ||
tasmānnarendra dātavyā bhuktimuktiphalapradā || 18 ||
ihaloke ca saubhāgyamāyurārogyavarddhanam ||
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā || 19 ||
stūyamāno'psarobhiśca sa yāti śivamandiram ||
yāvacca smarate janma tāvatsvarge mahīyate || 20 ||
tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭo jambūdvīpapatirbhavet ||
evaṃ hareṇa codgīrṇaṃ śrutvā vākyaṃ narottamaḥ || 21 ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudraloke mahīyate || 22 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne dhānyadhenudānamāhātmyaṃ nāma daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||
atha kapilādhenudānamāhātmyam ||
hotovāca ||
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi kapilāṃ dhenumuttamām ||
yatpradānānnaro yāti viṣṇulokamanuttamam || 1 ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena dadyāddhenuṃ savatsakām ||
sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktāṃ sarvaratnasamanvitām || 2 ||
kapilāyāḥ śiro grīvā sarvatīrthāni bhāmini ||
pitāmahaniyogācca nivasanti hi niścayaḥ || 3 ||
prātarutthāya yo martyaḥ kapilāgalamastakāt ||
cyutaṃ tu bhaktyā pānīyaṃ śirasā vandate śuciḥ || 4 ||
sa tena puṇyatoyena tatkṣaṇāddagdhakilbiṣaḥ ||
triṃśadvarṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ dahatyagnirivendhanam ||5||
kalyamutthāya yo martyaḥ kuryāttāsāṃ pradakṣiṇam ||
pradakṣiṇī kṛtā tena pṛthivī syādvasundhare||6||
pradakṣiṇena caikena śraddhāyuktena tatkṣaṇāt||
daśajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya naśyatyasaṃśayam ||7||
kapilāyāstu mūtreṇa snāyāccaiva śucivrataḥ|
sa gaṅgādiṣu tīrtheṣu snāto bhavati mānavaḥ ||8||
tena snānena caikena bhāvayuktena vai naraḥ ||
yāvajjīvakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 9 ||
gosahasraṃ ca yo dadyādekāṃ vā kapilāṃ naraḥ ||
samametatpurā prāha brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 10||
gavāmasthi tato'pyetanmṛtagandhena dūṣayet ||
yāvajjighrati taṃ gandhaṃ tāvatpuṇyaistu pūryate || 11 ||
gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tathā ca paripālanam ||
tulyaṃ gośatadānasya bhayarogādipālane ||12||
tṛṇādikāni yo dadyātkṣudhitena gavāhnikam ||
gomedhasya phalaṃ divyaṃ labhate mānavottamaḥ || 13 ||
vimānairvividhairdivyaiḥ kanyābhirabhito'rpitaiḥ ||
sevyamānaḥ sugandhairvai dīpyamāna ivāgnayaḥ||14||
suvarṇakapilā pūrvaṃ dvitīyā gaurapiṅgalā ||
tṛtīyā caiva raktākṣī caturthī guḍapiṃgalā||15||
paṃcamī bahuvarṇā syātṣaṣṭhī ca śvetapiṅgalā||
saptamī śvetapiṃgākṣī tvaṣṭamī kṛṣṇapiṃgalā ||16||
navamī pāṭalā jñeyā daśamī pucchapiṃgalā ||
ekādaśī khuraśvetā tvetāsāṃ sarvalakṣaṇāḥ || 17 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktā sarvālaṃkṛtasundarī ||
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā bhuktimuktipradāyinī || 18 ||
bhuktimuktipradā teṣāṃ viṣṇumārgapradāyinī || 19 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne kapilādānamāhātmyaṃ nāma ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||
athobhayatomukhīgodānahemakumbhadānapurāṇapraśaṃsāḥ ||
hotovāca ||
ataḥ paraṃ mahārāja śṛṇūbhayamukhīṃ tataḥ ||
vidhānaṃ tadvarārohe dharaṇyā kathitaṃ purā || 1||
tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi tava puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
yā tvayā kapilā proktā pūrvamutpāditā prabho||2||
homadhenuḥ sadā puṇyā sā jñeyā katilakṣaṇā ||
kiyatyaḥ kapilāḥ proktāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā ||3||
prasūyamānā dānena kiṃ puṇyaṃ syācca mādhava ||
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ vistareṇa jagadguro || 4 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇuṣva devi tattvena pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam ||
yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 5 ||
kapilā hyagnihotrārthe yajñārthe ca varānane ||
uddhṛtya sarvatejobhirbrahmaṇā nirmitā purā || 6 ||
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam ||
puṇyānāṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ kapilā ca vasundhare || 7 ||
tapasastapa evāgryaṃ vratānāṃ vratamuttamam ||
dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ nidhīnāṃ hyetadakṣayam || 8 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni guhyānyāyatanāni ca ||
pavitrāṇi ca puṇyāni sarvalokeṣu sundari || 9 ||
hotavyānyagnihotrāṇi sāyaṃ prātardvijātibhiḥ ||
kapilāyā ghṛteneha dadhnā kṣīreṇa vā punaḥ|| 10 ||
juhvate hyagnihotrāṇi mantraiśca vividhaiḥ sadā ||
pūjayannatithīṃścaiva parāṃ bhaktimupāgatāḥ || 11 ||
te yāntyādityavarṇaiśca vimānairdvijasattamāḥ ||
sūrya maṇḍalamadhyāttu brahmaṇā nirmitā purā ||12||
kapilā yā piṅgalākṣī sūryasaukhyapradāyinī ||
siddhibuddhipradā dhenuḥ kapilānantarūpiṇī || 13||
pūrvoktā yāstu kapilāḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ ||
sarvā hyetā mahābhāgāstārayanti na saṃśayaḥ || 14 ||
saṃgameṣu praśastāśca sarvapāpavināśanāḥ ||
agnipucchā agnimukhī agnilomānalaprabhā || 15 ||
tathāgnāyī tathā devī suvarṇākhyā pravartate ||
gṛhītvā kapilāṃ śūdrātkāmataḥ sadṛśaḥ pibet || 16 ||
patitaiḥ sa hi vijñeyaścāṇḍālasadṛśo'dhamaḥ ||
tasmānna pratigṛhṇīyācchrūdrādvipraḥ pratigraham || 17 ||
dūrātte pariharttavyāḥ śvabhistulyā ivādhvare ||
parvakāle hi sarve vai varjitāḥ pitṛdaivataiḥ || 18 ||
asambhāṣyāḥ pratigrāhyā śūdrāste pāpakarmaṇaḥ ||
pibanti yāvat kapilāṃ tāvatteṣāṃ pitāmahaḥ || 19 ||
bhūmermalaṃ samaśnanti jāyante viḍbhujaściram ||
tāsāṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vāpi navanītamathāpi vā || 20 ||
upajīvanti ye śūdrāsteṣāṃ gatimataḥ śṛṇu ||
kapilājīvinaḥ śūdrāḥ krūrā gacchanti rauravam || 21 ||
raurave tu mahāraudre varṣakoṭiśataṃ dhare ||
tato vimuktāḥ kālena śuno yoniṃ vrajanti hi || 22 ||
śuno yonyā vimuktāstu viṣṭhābhukkṛmayastataḥ ||
viṣṭhāsthāneṣu pāpiṣṭhaḥ sudurgandhiṣu nityaśaḥ || 23 ||
bhūyobhūyo jāyamānastathottāraṃ na vindati ||
brāhmaṇaścaiva yo vidvānkuryātteṣāṃ pratigraham || 24 ||
tataḥ prabhṛtyamedhyāntaḥ pitarastasya śerate ||
na taṃ vipraṃ tu sambhāṣenna caivaikāsanaṃ viśet || 25 ||
sa nityaṃ varjanīyo hi dūrāttu brāhmaṇairdhare ||
yastena saha sambhāṣettathā caikāsanaṃ vrajet ||26||
prājāpatyaṃ caretkṛcchraṃ tena śuṣyati sa dvijaḥ||
ekasya gopradānasya sahasrāṃśena pūryate ||27||
kimanyairbahubhirdānaiḥ koṭisaṃkhyānavistaraiḥ ||
śrotriyāya daridrāya suvṛttāyāhitāgnaye || 28 ||
āsannaprasavāṃ dhenuṃ dānārthaṃ pratipālayeta ||
kapilārddhaprasūtā vai dātavyā ca dvijanmane || 29 ||
jāyamānasya vatsasya mukhaṃ yonyāṃ pradṛśyate ||
tāvatsā pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muñcati || 30 ||
dhenvā yāvanti romāṇi savatsāyā vasundhare ||
tāvatyo varṣakoṭyastu brahmavādibhirarcitāḥ || 31 ||
vasanti brahmaloke vai ye nityaṃ kapilāpradāḥ ||
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ yaḥ kṛtvā raupyayuktakhurāṃ tathā || 32 ||
brāhmaṇasya kare dattvā suvarṇaṃ raupyameva ca ||
kapilāyāstadā pucchaṃ brāhmaṇasya kare nyaset || 33 ||
udakaṃ ca kare dattvā vācayecchuddhayā girā ||
sasamudravanā tena saśailavanakānanā || 34 ||
ratnapūrṇā bhaveddattā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
pṛthivīdānatulyena dānenaitena vai naraḥ || 35 ||
nandito yāti pitṛbhirviṣṇvākhyaṃ paramaṃ padam ||
brahmasvahārī goghno vā bhrūṇahā pāpadehakaḥ || 36 ||
mahāpātakayukto'pi vaṃcako brahmadūṣakaḥ ||
nindako brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tathā karmāvadūṣakaḥ || 37 ||
mahāpātakayukto'pi gavāṃ dānena śudhyati ||
yaścobhayamukhīṃ dadyātprabhūtakanakānvitām || 38 ||
taddinaṃ pāyasāhāraṃ payasā vāpi vā bhavet ||
suvarṇasya sahasreṇa tadarddhenāpi bhāmini ||39||
tasyāpyarddhaśatenātha paṃcāśacca tato'rddhakam ||
yathāśaktyā pradātavyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||40||
imāṃ gṛhṇobhayamukhīmubhayatra śamo'stu vai ||
dade vaṃśavivṛddhyarthaṃ sadā svastikarī bhava || 41 ||
pratigṛhṇāmi tvāṃ dheno kuṭumbārthe viśeṣataḥ ||
śubhaṃ bhavatu me nityaṃ devadhātri namo'stu te || 42 ||
me nityaṃ svasti bhavatu rudrāṅgeti namonamaḥ ||
oṃ dyostvā dadātu pṛthivī tvā prati gṛhṇatu || 43 ||
ka idaṃ kasmā adāditi japitvā vai vasundhare ||
visṛjya brāhmaṇaṃ devi tāṃ dhenuṃ tadgṛhaṃ nayet || 44 ||
evaṃ prasūyamānāṃ yo gāṃ dadāti vasundhare ||

śrīvarāha uvāca ||
