yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā nairantaryeṇa mānavaḥ ||
śrutvā tu pūjayedyastu śāstraṃ vārāhasaṃjñitam || 80 ||
śrutvā tu pūjayecchāstraṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ sanātanam ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā vastrairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ||81 ||
yathāśaktyā nṛpo grāmaiḥ pūjayedvatsakaṃ dhare ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt ||82||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śvetavinītāśvopākhyāne ubhayatomukhīgodāna hemakumbhadāna purāṇapraśaṃsanaṃnāma dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||112||
atha bhagavatstutiḥ ||
oṃ namo varāhāya namo brahmaputrāya sanatkumārāya namaḥ || 1 ||
namastasmai varāhāya līlayoddharate mahīm ||
suramadhyagato yasya meruḥ khaṇakhaṇāyate || 2 ||
daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddhṛtā gorudadhiparivṛtā parvatairnimnagābhirbhaktānāṃ bhītihānau suranarakadaśāsyāntakaḥ kroḍarūpī ||
viṣṇuḥ sarveśvaro'yaṃ yamiha hatamalā līlayā prāpnuvanti
tyaktātmāno na pāpe prabhu bhavatu muditārātipakṣakṣitīśam ||3 ||
yasminkāle kṣitiḥ pūrvakalpe vārāha mūrtinā ||
uddhṛtā ca yayā bhaktyā papraccha parameśvaram || 4 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
kalpe kalpe bhavāneva māṃ samuddharate bhavān ||
na bāhuśceṣṭate mūrtirmādṛśīṃ gāṃ ca keśava||5||
sa tena sāntvitāyāṃ vai pṛthivyāṃ yaḥ samāgataḥ ||
sanatkumārastatkṣetre dṛṣṭvā tāṃ saṃsthitāṃ mahīm ||6||
svasti vācyāha puṇyāgre pratyuvāca vasundharām ||
sanatkumāra uvāca ||
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā varddhase devi tvaṃ ca yasyāsi mādhavi || 7 ||
viṣṇunā dhāryamāṇā ca kiṃ tvayā dṛṣṭamadbhutam ||
etadācakṣva tattvena yatte harimukhācchrutam||8||
brahmaputravacaḥ śrutvā pṛthivī vākyamabravīt ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
yadguhyaṃ sa mayā pṛṣṭo yacca me samprabhāṣitam ||9||
śṛṇu tattvena viprendra guhyaṃ dharmaṃ mahaujasam ||
bhagavatproktadharmeṣu yadguhyaṃ kathayāmyaham|| 10 ||
tena me kathitaṃ hyetatsaṃsārāttu vimokṣaṇam ||
viṣṇubhaktena yatkāryaṃ yatkriyā paritiṣṭhatā || 11 ||
uvāca paramaṃ guhyaṃ dharmāṇāṃ vyāptaniścayam ||
ayaṃ dharmo mayā hyetacchrute dharme sanātane || 12||
tato mahīvacaḥ śrutvā brahmaputro mahātapāḥ ||
kokāmukhe mama kṣetraṃ japanto brahmavādinaḥ || 13||
tānsarvānānayāmāsa yatra devī vyavasthitā ||
sanatkumāraḥ pūtātmā pratyuvāca mahīṃ prati || 14||
sanatkumāra uvāca ||
yanmayā pūvarmuktāsi kathayasva varānane||
aprameyagatiṃ caiva dharmamācakṣva tattvataḥ || 15||
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā praṇamya ṛṣipuṃgavam ||
uvāca paramaprītā dhātrī madhurayā girā || 16 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve yattadviṣṇumukhācchrutam ||
bāḍhamityeva tāṃ devi svasti brūhīti so'bravīt || 17 ||
naṣṭacandrānile loke naṣṭabhāskaratārake ||
stambhitāśca diśaḥ sarvā na prājñāyata kiñcana || 18||
na vāti pavanastatra naiva cāgnirna vidyutaḥ ||
na kiṃcittatra vidyeta na tārā na ca rāśayaḥ || 19||
vedeṣu caiva naṣṭeṣu matsyo bhūtvā rasātalam ||
praviśya tānathotkṛṣya brahmaṇe dattavānasi||20 ||
anyaddevaḥ kūrmarūpastvaṃ samudrasya manthane ||
dhṛtavānasi kaurmeṇa mandaraṃ madhusūdana || 21 ||
punarvarāharūpeṇa māṃ gacchantīṃ rasātale ||
ujjahārekadaṃṣṭreṇa bhavāneva mahārṇavāt ||22||
anyaddhiraṇyakaśipurvaradānena darpitaḥ ||
asāvapi nṛsiṃheṇa vapurāsthāya nāśitaḥ || 23 ||
punarniḥkṣatrarūpeṇa tvayā'haṃ vikṛtā purā ||
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa tvayā dṛṣṭā sakṛtprabho || 24 ||
punaśca rāvaṇo rakṣaḥ kṣayitaṃ svena tejasā ||
baliśca baddho bhagavantvayā vāmanarūpiṇā ||25||
na ca jānāmyahaṃ deva tava kiṃcidviceṣṭitam ||
uddhṛtya māṃ kathaṃ deva sṛjase kiṃca kāraṇam ||26||
sṛṣṭvā kimādiśaḥ sarvāṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana ||
na vāti pavanastatra na caivāgnirjvalatyapi ||27||
aṃśavaścana vidyante na nakṣatrā na vā grahāḥ ||
na caivāṅgārakastatra na śukro na bṛhaspatiḥ||28||
śanaiścaro budho nātra na cendro dhanado yamaḥ ||
varuṇo'pi na vidyeta nānye keciddivaukasaḥ ||29||
varjayitvātra trīndevān brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān ||
pṛthivī bhārasantaptā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā || 30 ||
gatvā ca śaraṇaṃ devī dainyaṃ vadati mādhavī ||
prasīda mama devendra magnāhaṃ bhārapīḍitā ||31||
saparvatavanaiḥ sārddhaṃ māṃ tāraya pitāmaha ||
pṛthivyā vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ||32||
muhurtaṃ dhyānamāsthāya pṛthivīṃ tāmuvāca ha ||
nāhaṃ tārayituṃ śakto viṣamasthāṃ vasundhare ||33||
lokanāthaṃ suraśreṣṭhamādikarttāramañjasā ||
lokeśaṃ dhanvinaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yāhi māyākaraṇḍakam ||34||
sarveṣāmeva naḥ kāryaṃ yacca kiñcitpravarttate ||
sarvāṃstārayituṃ śaktaḥ ki punastvāṃ vasundhare || 35 ||
anantaśayane devaṃ śayānaṃ yogaśāyinam ||
tataḥ kamalapatrākṣī nānābharaṇabhūṣitā ||36 ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭā devī prasādayati mādhavam ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
ahaṃ bhārasamāyuktā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṅgatā ||37||
pratyākhyātā bhagavatā tenāpyuktamidaṃ vacaḥ ||
nāhaṃ tārayituṃ śaktaḥ suśroṇi vraja mādhavam ||38||
sa tvāṃ tārayituṃ śakto magnāsi yadi sāgare ||
prasīda mama deveśa lokanātha jagatprabho||39||
bhaktyā tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi prasīda mama mādhava||
tvamādityaśca candraśca tvaṃ yamo dhanadastu vai ||40||
vāsavo varuṇaścāsi hyagnirmāruta eva ca ||
akṣaraśca kṣaraścāsi tvaṃ diśo vidiśo bhavān || 41||
matsyaḥ kūrmmo varāhaśca narasiṃho'si vāmanaḥ ||
rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkī mahātmavān ||42 ||
evaṃ paśyasi yogena śrūyate tvaṃ mahāyaśāḥ ||
yugāyuga sahasrāṇi vyatītānyasi saṃsthitaḥ||43||
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpojyotiśca pañcamam||
śabdasparśasvarūpo'si raso gandho'si no bhavān||44||
sagrahāṇi ca ṛkṣāṇi kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrttakāḥ || 45 ||
sagrahā ye ca nakṣatrā kalā kālamuhūrttakāḥ ||
jyotiścakraṃ dhruvaścā'si sarveṣu dyotate bhavān || 46 ||
māsaḥ pakṣamahorātramṛtuḥ saṃvatsarāṇyapi || 47 ||
kalā kāṣṭhāpi ṣaṇmāsāḥ ṣaḍrasāścāpi saṃyamaḥ ||
saritaḥ sāgarāśca tvaṃ parvatāśca mahoragāḥ || 48 ||
tvaṃ merurmandaro vindhyo malayo darduro bhavān ||
himavānniṣadhaścāsi sacakro'si varāyudhaḥ||49||
dhanuṣāṃ ca pināko'si sāṃkhyayogo'si cottamaḥ ||
paramparo'si lokānāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ parāyaṇaḥ||50||
saṃkṣiptaścaiva vistāro goptā yajñaśca śaśvataḥ||
yajñānāṃ ca mahāyajño yūpānāmasi saṃsthitaḥ ||51||
vedānāṃ sāmavedo'si sāṅgopāṅgo mahāvrataḥ ||
garjanaṃ varṣaṇaṃ cāsi tvaṃ vedhā anṛtānṛte||52||
amṛtaṃ sṛjase viṣṇo yena lokānadhārayat ||
tvaṃ prītistvaṃ parā prītiḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣo bhavān || 53 ||
dheyādheyaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yacca kiṃcit pravarttate ||
saptānāmapi lokānāṃ tvaṃ nāthastvamasaṃgrahaḥ||54||
tvaṃ ca kālaśca mṛtyuśca tvaṃ bhūto bhūtabhāvanaḥ||
ādimadhyāntarūpo'si medhā buddhiḥ smṛtirbhavān ||55||
ādityastvaṃ yugāvarttāstvaṃ tapasvī mahātapāḥ ||
apramāṇaḥ prameyo'si ṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahānṛṣiḥ || 56 ||
anantaścāsi nāgānāṃ sarpāṇāmasi takṣakaḥ ||
udvahaḥ pravahaścāsi varuṇo vāruṇo bhavān || 57 ||
krīḍāvikṣepaṇaścāsi gṛheṣu gṛhadevatāḥ ||
sarvātmakaḥ sarvagato varddhano mana eva ca || 58 ||
sāṅgastvaṃ vidyutīnāṃ ca vaidyutānāṃ mahādyutiḥ ||
yuge manvantare cāpi vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca vanaspatiḥ || 59||
śraddhāsi tvaṃ ca deveśa doṣahantāsi mādhava ||
aṇḍajodbhijjasvedānāṃ jarāyūnāṃ ca mādhava || 60 ||
garuḍo'si mahātmānaṃ vahasi tvaṃ parāyaṇaḥ ||
dundubhirnemighoṣaiśca ākāśamamalo bhavān || 61 ||
jayaśca vijayaścāsi gṛheṣu gṛhadevatāḥ ||
sarvātmakaḥ sarvagataścetano mana eva ca || 62 ||
bhagastvaṃ viṣaliṅgaśca parastvaṃ paramātmakaḥ ||
sarvabhūtanamaskāryo namo deva namo namaḥ || 63 ||
māṃ tvaṃ magnāmasi trātuṃ lokanātha ihārhasi ||
ādikālātmakaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvalokātmako vibhuḥ || 64 ||
ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ keśavasya dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
vyādhito mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt || 65 ||
aputro labhate putraṃ daridro dhanamāpnuyāt ||
abhāryo labhate bhāryāmapatiḥ patimāpnuyāt || 66 ||
ubhe sandhye paṭhetstotraṃ mādhavasya mahātmanaḥ ||
sa gacchedviṣṇulokaṃ ca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 67 ||
evaṃ tu akṣarokto'pi bhavettu parikalpanā ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate || 68 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe viṣṇustavanaṃ nāma trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 113 ||
atha śrīvarāhāvatāraḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
saṃstūyamāno bhagavānmunibhirmantravādibhiḥ ||
tuṣṭo nārāyaṇo devaḥ keśavaḥ paramo vibhuḥ || 1 ||
tato dhyānaṃ samāsthāya divyaṃ yogyaṃ ca mādhavaḥ ||
madhuraṃ svaramāsthāya pratyuvāca vasundharām || 2 ||
tava devi priyārthāya bhaktyā yaṃ tvaṃ vyavasthitā ||
kārayiṣyāmi te sarvaṃ yatte hṛdi vyavasthitam || 3 ||
ahaṃ tvāṃ dhārayiṣyāmi saśailavanakānanām ||
sasāgarāṃ sasaritaṃ saptadvīpasamanvitām || 4 ||
evamāśvāsayitvā tu vasudhāṃ sa ca mādhavaḥ ||
rūpaṃ saṃkalpayāmāsa vārāhaṃ sumahaujasam || 5 ||
ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi cocchrāyo vistāreṇa punastrayaḥ ||
evaṃ navasahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ vidhāya ca || 6 ||
vāmayā daṃṣṭrayā gṛhya ujjahāra ca medinīm ||
saparvatavanākārāṃ saptadvīpāṃ sapattanām || 7 ||
nagā vilagnāḥ patitāḥ kecidvijñānasaṃśritāḥ ||
śobhante ca vicitrāṃgameghāḥ sandhyāgame yathā || 8 ||
candranirmalasaṅkāśā varāhamukhasaṃsthitāḥ ||
śobhante cakrapāṇeśca mṛṇālaṃ kardame yathā || 9||
evaṃ hi dhāryamāṇā sā pṛthivī sāgarānvitā ||
varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ hi vajradaṃṣṭreṇa sādhunā ||10 ||
tasyāmeva tu kālasya parimāṇaṃ yugeṣu ca ||
ekasaptatike kalpe kardamo'yaṃ prajāpatiḥ || 11 ||
tataḥ pṛthivyā devaśca bhagavānviṣṇuravyayaḥ||
anyonyābhimatāścaiva vārāhe kalpa uttame || 12||
sā gauḥ stuvati taṃ caiva purāṇaṃ paramavyayam ||
yogena parameṇaiva śaraṇaṃ caiva gacchati ||13||
ādhāraḥ kīdṛśo deva upayogaśca kīdṛśaḥ ||
kālekāle ca deveśa karmaṇaścāpi kīdṛśaḥ || 14 ||
kīdṛśā paścimā saṃdhyā kīdṛśī hyardhabāhyataḥ ||
śeṣāḥ samānāstvā deva ye tu karmāṇi kurvate || 15 ||
kinnu saṃsthāpane deva āvāhanavisarjane ||
aguruṃ gandhadhūpaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ gṛhyate katham || 16 ||
kathaṃ pādyaṃ ca gṛhṇāti snāpanālepanāni ca ||
kathaṃ dīpaśca dātavyaḥ kandamūlaphalāni ca || 17 ||
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ caiva kiṅkarmmāpi vidhīyate ||
kathaṃ pūjādi karttavyaṃ prāṇāstatra ca vai kati || 18 ||
paścimā pūrvasaṃdhyāyāṃ kiṃ puṇyaṃ cāpi tatra vai ||
śaradi kīdṛśaṃ karma śiśire karma kīdṛśam || 19 ||
vasante kīdṛśaṃ karma grīṣme kiṃ karma kārayet ||
prāvṛṭkāle ca kiṃ karma varṣānte kiñca kārayet || 20 ||
yāni tatropabhogyāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ||
karmaṇyāste akarmaṇyā ye ca śāstrabahiṣkṛtāḥ || 21 ||
kiṃ karmaṇā bhogavatā tāvadgacchati mādhavam ||
kathaṃ karma na cānneṣu atigacchati kīdṛśam || 22 ||
arccāyāḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ tu sthāpanaṃ cāpi kīdṛśam ||
parimāṇaṃ kathaṃ deva upavāsaśca kīdṛśaḥ || 23 ||
pītakaṃ śuklaraktaṃ vā kathaṃ gṛhṇāti vāsasām ||
teṣāṃ tu kāni vastrāṇi yairhitaṃ pratipadyate || 24||
keṣu dravyeṣu saṃyuktaṃ madhuparkaṃ pradīyate ||
ke tu karmaguṇāstasya madhuparkasya mādhava ||25||
keṣu lokeṣu gacchanti madhuparkasya bhakṣaṇāt ||
stave paramakāle'pi tava bhaktasya mādhava||26 ||
kimpramāṇaṃ tu dātavyaṃ madhuparkasamanvitam ||
kāni māṃsāni te deva phalaṃ śākasya kīdṛśaḥ ||27|
prāpaṇeṣvapi yujyeta karma śāstrasamāyutam ||
āhūtasya ca mantreṇa āgate dharmavatsala ||28||
kena mantravidhānena prāśanaṃ te pradīyate ||
vratasya copacāreṣu arccayitvā yathāvidhi||29||
kāni karmmāṇi kurvīta tava bhaktasya bhojanāt ||
yastu taṃ prāpaṇaṃ deva na ca doṣaprasādikam ||30||
ke 'tra bhuṃjanti taddeva sarvaśuddhikaraṃ param ||
ye tu ekāśino devamupasarpanti mādhavam||31||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva tava mārgānusāriṇām ||
vrataṃ kṛtvā yathoktena ye'bhigacchanti mādhavam ||32||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva tava bhaktiṃ prakurvatām ||
kṛcchrasāṃtapane kṛtvā ye'bhigacchanti mādhavam |33 |
kāṃ gatiṃ te prapadyante tava karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
vāyvāhāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ samadhigacchati || 34 ||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatiḥ kṛṣṇa tava bhaktau vyavasthitāḥ ||
akṣāralavaṇaṃ kṛtvā ye'bhigacchanti cācyutam ||35||
kāṃ gatiṃ te prapadyante tava karmānusāriṇaḥ ||
kṛtvā payovrataṃ caiva ye'bhigacchaṃti cācyutam || 36 ||
te kāṃ gatiṃ prapadyante narā ye vratakāriṇaḥ||
dattvā gavāhnikaṃ caiva ye prapadyanti mādhavam ||37||
kāṃ gatiṃ te prapadyante tava bhaktyā vyavasthitāḥ ||
uñchavṛttiṃ samāsthāya ye'bhigacchanti mādhavam ||38||
kāṃ gatiṃ te prapadyante narā bhikṣopajīvinaḥ||
gṛhasthadharmaṃ kṛtvā vai ye'bhigacchanti mādhavam ||39||
kāṃ gatiṃ te prapadyante tava karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
tava kṣetreṣu vaikuṇṭha ye tu prāṇānvimuñcate ||40||
kām̐llokāṃste prapadyante tava kṣetreṣu ye mṛtāḥ ||
kṛtvā paṃcātapaṃ caiva mādhavāya prayacchati ||41 ||
kāṃ gatiṃ vai parāyānti ye tu paṃcātape mṛtāḥ ||
kaṇṭaśayyāṃ samāsādya ye prapaśyanti cācyutam||42||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva kaṇṭaśayyāṃ samāśritāḥ||
ākāśaśayanaṃ kṛtvā ye prapadyanti cācyutam || 43||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatiḥ kṛṣṇa tava bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||
govraje śayanaṃ kṛtvā ye prapadyanti keśavam || 44 ||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirbrahmaṃstava bhaktipathe sthitāḥ ||
śākāhāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ye'bhigacchanti cācyutam || 45 ||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva kaṇabhakṣāstu ye narāḥ ||
paṃcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā ye'bhigacchanti mādhavam || 46 ||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva ye narā yāvakāśinaḥ ||
āhāraṃ gomayaṃ kṛtvā ye'bhigacchanti keśavam || 47 ||
nārāyaṇa gatisteṣāṃ kīdṛśo'tra vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
saktuṃ vai bhakṣayitvā tu ye prapadyanti cācyutam || 48 ||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva tava karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
śirasā dīpakaṃ kṛtvā ye'bhigacchanti keśavam || 49 ||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva śirasā dīpadhāraṇāt ||
ye hi nityaṃ payaḥ pītvā tava cintāvyavasthitāḥ || 50 ||
te gatiṃ kāṃ prapadyante tava ciṃtāparāyaṇāḥ ||
aśmāśanaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ye prapadyanti nityaśaḥ || 51 ||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva tava bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||
bhakṣayitvā tu dūrvāṃ ye prapadyante manīṣiṇaḥ || 52 ||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva svadharmaguṇacāriṇaḥ ||
jānubhyāṃ pratipadyante tava prītyā ca mādhava ||53||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||
uttānaśayanaṃ kṛtvā dhārayanti hi dīpikām || 54 ||
te yāṃti kāṃ gatiṃ deva kathyate yā ca śāśvatī ||
jānubhyāṃ dīpakaṃ kṛtvā keśavāya prapadyate||55||
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva kathyate caiva śāśvatī ||
avāṅmukhastu bhūtvā vai yaḥ prapadyejjanārddanam || 56 ||
bhagavan kā gatistasya avākśirasi śāyinaḥ ||
putradāragṛhaṃ caiva muktvā yo'nuprapadyate || 57 ||
kā gatistasya siddhā tu kathayasva surottama ||
bhāṣito'si mayā hyevaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham || 58 ||
gamanāgamanaṃ caiva tvatprasannena mādhava ||
tvaṃ jñātā tvaṃ pitā caiva sarvadharmaviniścayaḥ || 59 ||
atastvayaiva vaktavyo yogasāṅkhyaviniścayaḥ ||
tvāṃ bhajaṃśca gate jīve madhuparkasamanvitam || 60 ||
bhasmākuleṣu niḥkṣipya kathaṃ cāgnau prapadyate ||
kāṃ gatiṃ pratipadyante tvadbhaktā jalamāsthitāḥ || 61 ||
tvatkṣetrasaṃsthito vāpi tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||
smaraṇa putra te kṛṣṇa yaistu nāma prakīrtyate || 62 ||
namo nārāyaṇetyuktvā teṣāṃ vai kā gatirbhavet ||
udyateṣvapi śastreṣu hanyamānā raṇe narāḥ || 63 ||
nāmaprakīrtanātteṣāṃ kīdṛśī tu gatirbhavet ||
ahaṃ śiṣyā ca dāsī ca tava bhaktyā vyavasthitā || 64 ||
rahasyaṃ dharmasaṃyuktaṃ tanmamācakṣva mādhava ||
evaṃ tatparamaṃ guhyaṃ mama prītyā jagadguro || 65 ||
saṃcintya lokadharmārthaṃ tadbhavān vaktumarhati ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe pṛthivyāḥ praśno nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 114 ||
atha vividhadharmotpattiḥ ||
tato mahīvacaḥ śrutvā devo nārāyaṇo'bravīt ||
kathayiṣyāmi te devi karma svargasukhāvaham || 1 ||
yattvayā pṛcchyate devi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
sthitiṃ sattāṃ tu martyānāṃ bhaktyā ye ca vyavasthitāḥ ||2 ||
nāhaṃ dānasahasreṇa nāhaṃ yajñaśatairapi ||
tuṣyāmi na tu vittena ye narāḥ svalpacetasaḥ ||3||
ekacittaṃ samādhāya yo māṃ jānāti mādhavi ||
nityaṃ tuṣyāmi tasyāhaṃ puruṣaṃ bahudoṣakam || 4 ||
yacca pṛcchasi māṃ bhadre karma svargasukhāvaham ||
tacchṛṇuṣva varārohe gadato me śucismite || 5 ||
ye namasyati māṃ nityaṃ puruṣā bahucetasaḥ ||
arddharātre'ndhakāre ca madhyāhne vāparāhṇake || 6 ||
yasya cittaṃ na naśyeta mama bhaktivyavasthitam ||
dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ tu yaḥ kuryānmama tatparaḥ || 7 ||
te māmeva prapaśyanti mayi bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||
labdhaceto guṇajñaśca naro bhaktivyavasthitaḥ || 8 ||
icchayā'pi bhavedbhadre svarge vasati sundari ||
svalpakena na gamyante duṣprāpyo'haṃ varānane || 9 ||
yāni karmāṇi kurvantu māṃ prapaśyanti mādhavi ||
tāni te kathayiṣyāmi yena bhaktyā vyavasthitāḥ || 10 ||
dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ tu ye ca kurvanti te narāḥ ||
teṣāmeva prapaśyanti mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ||11 ||
kṛtvā caivopavāsaṃ pragṛhya caiva jalāñjalim ||
namo nārāyaṇetyuktvā ādityaṃ cāvalokayet||12||
yāvanto bindavaḥ kiṃcitpatantyevāñjalerjalāt ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate || 13||
atha caiva tu dvādaśyāṃ puruṣā dharmavādakāḥ||
vidhinā ca prayatnena ye māṃ kurvanti mānuṣāḥ ||14||
pāṇḍuraiścaiva puṣpaiśca mṛṣṭairdhūpaistu dhūpayet||
yo me dhārayate bhūmau tasyāpi śṛṇu yā gatiḥ||15||
dattvā śirasi puṣpāṇi imaṃ mantramudīrayet ||
hṛdi kṛtvā tu mantrāṃśca śuklāmbaradharo dhare ||16||
sumānyaḥ sumanā gṛhya prīyatāṃ bhagavānhariḥ || 17 ||
namo'stu viṣṇave vyaktāvyaktagandhigandhānsugandhānvā gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namo bhagavate viṣṇave ||
anena mantreṇa gandhaṃ dadyāt ||
śrutvā pratyāgatamādhārasavanaṃ pataye bhavaṃ praviṣṭaṃ me dhūpa dhūpanaṃ gṛhṇātu me bhagavānacyutaḥ ||
anena mantreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyāt || 18 ||
śrutvā caivaṃ ca śāstrāṇi yo māmeva tu kārayet ||
mama lokaṃ ca gaccheta jāyetaiva caturbhujaḥ || 19 ||
etatte kathitaṃ devi śreṣṭhaṃ caiva mama priyam ||
tava caivaṃ priyārthāya mantrapūjāṃ sukhāvaham ||20||
śyāmākaṃ svastikaṃ caiva godhūmaṃ mudgakaṃ tathā ||
śālayastu yavāścaiva tathā nīvārakāṅgukāḥ || 21 ||
etāni yastu bhuñjīta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ lāṅgalaṃ ca musalaṃ sa ca paśyati || 22 ||
brāhmaṇasya tu vakṣyāmi śṛṇu karma vasundhare ||
yāni karmāṇi kurvīta mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 23 ||
ṣaṭkarmanirato bhūtvā ahaṅkāravivarjjitaḥ ||
lābhālābhaṃ parityajya bhikṣāhāro jitendriyaḥ || 24 ||
mama karmasamāyuktaḥ paiśunyena vivarjitaḥ ||
śāstrānusārimadhyastho navṛddhaśiśucetanaḥ || 25 ||
etadvai brahmaṇaḥ karma ekacitto jitendriyaḥ ||
iṣṭāpūrtaṃ ca kurute sa māmeti vasundhare || 26 ||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ pravakṣyāmi mama karmasu tiṣṭhatām ||
yāni karmāṇi kurvīta kṣatriyo madhyasaṃsthitaḥ || 27 ||
dānaśūraśca karmajño yajñeṣu kuśalaḥ śuciḥ ||
mama karmasu medhāvī ahaṅkāravivarjitaḥ || 28 ||
alpabhāṣī guṇajñaśca nityaṃ bhāgavatapriyaḥ ||
guruvidyo'nasūyaśca nindyakarmavivarjitaḥ||29||
abhyutthānādikuśalaḥ paiśunyena vivarjitaḥ||
etairguṇaiḥ samāyukto yo māṃ vrajati kṣatriyaḥ || 30 ||
bhajate mama yo nityaṃ mama lokāya gacchati ||
vaiśyānāṃ tu pravakṣyāmi mama karmasu tiṣṭhatām || 31 ||
yāni karmāṇi kurute mama bhaktipathe sthitaḥ ||
etairguṇaiḥ svadharmeṇa lābhālābhavivarjitaḥ || 32 ||
ṛtukālābhigāmī ca śāntātmā mohavarjitaḥ ||
śucirdakṣo nirāhāro mama karmarataḥ sadā || 33 ||
gurusampūjako nityaṃ yukto bhaktānuvatsalaḥ ||
vaiśyo'pyevaṃ susaṃyukto yastu karmāṇi kārayet || 34 ||
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati || ||
atha śūdrasya vakṣyāmi karmāṇi śṛṇu mādhavi || 35 ||
karmāṇi yāni kṛtvā ha śūdro mahyaṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||
dampatī mama bhaktau yo mama karma parāyaṇau || 36 ||
ubhau bhāgavatau bhaktau madbhaktau karmaniṣṭhitau ||
deśakālau ca vānītau rajasā tamasojjhitau || 37 ||
nirahaṅkāraśuddhātmā ātitheyo vinītavān ||
śraddadhāno'tipūtātmā lobhamohavivarjitaḥ || 38 ||
namaskārapriyo nityaṃ mama cintāvyavasthitaḥ ||
śūdraḥ karmāṇi me devi ya evaṃ samamācaret || 39 ||
tyaktvā ṛṣisahasrāṇi śūdrameva bhajāmyaham ||
cāturvarṇyasya karmāṇi yattvayā paripṛcchitam || 40 ||
evaṃ karmaguṇāścaiva yena bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ ||
sarvavarṇāśca māṃ devi aparaṃ kṣatriye śṛṇu || 41 ||
yena tatprāpyate yogaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
tyaktvā lābhamalābhaṃ ca mohaṃ kāmaṃ ca varjayet || 42 ||
na śītaṃ ca na coṣṇe ca labdhā'labdhaṃ vicintayet ||
na tiktenāsti kaṭunā madhurāmlairna lāvaṇaiḥ || 43 ||
na kaṣāyaiḥ spṛhā yasya prāpnuyātsiddhimuttamām ||
bhāryā putrāḥ pitā mātā upabhogārthasaṃyutam || 44 ||
ya etān hi parityajya mama karmarataḥ sadā ||
dhṛtijñaḥ kuśalaścaiva śraddadhāno dhṛtavrataḥ || 45 ||
tatparo nityamudyuktaḥ anyakāryajugupsakaḥ ||
bāle vayasi kalpaśca alpabhogī kulānvitaḥ || 46 ||
kāruṇyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ pratyutthāyī mahākṣamaḥ ||
kāle maunakriyāṃ kuryādyāvattatkarma kārayet ||47||
trikālaṃ ca diśo bhāgaṃ sadā karmapathi sthitaḥ ||
upapannānabhuñjānaḥ karmāṇyabhojanāni ca || 48 ||
anuṣṭhānaparaścaiva mama pārśve manaścaraḥ ||
kāle mūtrapurīṣāṇi visṛjya snānavatsalaḥ || 49 ||
puṣpe gandhe ca dhūpe ca matkarmaṇi sadā rataḥ ||
kadācitkandamūlāni phalāni ca kadācana||50||
payasā yāvakenāpi kadācidvāyubhakṣaṇaḥ ||
kadācitṣaṣṭhakālena kvaciddṛṣṭamahāphalaḥ || 51 ||
kadācittu caturthena kadācitphalameva ca ||
kadāciddaśame bhuñjetpakṣe māse vasundhare || 52 ||
ya etatsapta janmāni mama karmāṇi kurvate ||
yoginastānprapaśyanti pūrvoktānkarmasu sthitān || 53 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe vividhakarmotpattau paṃcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 115 ||
atha sukhaduḥkhanirūpaṇam||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
mayā proktavidhānena yastu karmāṇi kārayet ||
tacchṛṇuṣva mahābhāge yo sāphalyamāpnuyāt || 1 ||
ekacittaḥ samāsthāya ahaṅkāravivarjjitaḥ ||
maccittasaṃhato nityaṃ kṣānto dāṃto jitendriyaḥ || 2 ||
phalamūlāni śākāni dvādaśyāṃ vā kadācana||
payovrataṃ ca tatkāle punareva nirāmiṣaḥ || 3 ||
ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamī hyamāvāsyā tūbhayatra caturdaśī ||
maithunaṃ nābhiseveta dvādvaśyāṃ ca tathā priye ||4||
evaṃ yogavidhānena karma kuryāddṛḍhavrataḥ ||
pūtātmā dharmasaṃyukto viṣṇulokaṃ tu gacchati || 5 ||
na glānirna jarā tasya na moho roga eva ca ||
bhujāṣṭādaśa jāyante dhanvī khaḍgī śarī gadī || 6 ||
teṣāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ pravakṣyāmi mama karmasamutthitām ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca || 7 ||
mamārcanavidhiṃ kṛtvā mama loke mahīyate ||
duḥkhamevaṃ pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 8 ||
ucitenopacāreṇa duḥkhamokṣavināśanam ||
ahaṅkārāvṛto nityaṃ naro mohena cāvṛtaḥ || 9 ||
yo māṃ naiva prapadyeta tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
sarvāśī sarvavikretā namaskāravivarjitaḥ || 10 ||
yo na māṃ pratipadyeta tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
prāptakāle vaiśvadeve dṛṣṭvā cātithimāgatam || 11 ||
adattvā tasya yo bhuṃkte tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
sarvānnāni tu siddhāni pākabhedaṃ karoti yaḥ || 12 ||
tasya devā na cāśnanti tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
asantuṣṭastu vaiṣamye paradārābhimarśakaḥ || 13 ||
paropatāpī mandātmā tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
akṛtvā puṣkalaṃ karma gṛhe saṃvasate naraḥ || 14||
mṛtyukālavaśaṃ prāptastato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
hastyaśvarathayānāni gamyamānāni paśyati || 15 ||
dhāvantyasyāgrataḥ pṛṣṭhe tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
aśnanti piśitaṃ kecitkecicchālisamanvitam || 16 ||
śuṣkānnaṃ kecidaśnanti tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
varavastrāvṛtāṃ śayyāṃ samāsevati bhūṣitām || 17 ||
kecittṛṇeṣu śerante tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
surūpo dṛśyate kaścitpuruṣaścātmakarmabhiḥ || 18 ||
kecidvirūpā dṛśyante tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
vidvān kṛtī guṇajñaśca sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ||19||
kecinmūkāśca dṛśyante tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
vidyamāne dhane kecitkṛpaṇā bhogavarjitāḥ ||20||
daridro jāyate dātā tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
dvibhāryaḥ puruṣo yastu tayorekāṃ praśaṃsati || 21 ||
ekā tu durbhagā tatra tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyastrayo varṇāḥ sumadhyame || 22 ||
pāpakarmaratā hyāsantato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
labdhvā tu mānuṣīṃ saṃjñāṃ paṃcabhūta samanvitām || 23 ||
māmeva na prapadyante tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre duḥkhakarmaviniścayam || 24 ||
sarvabhūtāhitaṃ pāpaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchitam ||
yacca māṃ pṛcchate bhadre śubhaṃ kīdṛśamucyate || 25 ||
tacchṛṇuṣvānavadyāṅgi mama karmaviniścayam ||
kṛtvā tu vipulaṃ karma madbhakteṣu nivedayet || 26 ||
yasya buddhirvijāyeta sa duḥkhāyopajāyate ||
māṃ pūjayitvā naivedyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ parikalpya ca || 27 ||
śeṣamannaṃ samaśnāti tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
trikālaṃ ye prapadyante mayoktena vasundhare || 28 ||
kṛtvā sāyāhnikaṃ karma tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
devatātithimarttyānāṃ tyaktvā cānnaṃ vasundhare || 29 ||
yaścātmā vai samaśnāti tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
praviṣṭastvatithiryasya nirāśo yanna gacchati || 30 ||
yena kenaciddattena tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
māsi māsyekadivasastvamāvāsyeti yocyate || 31 ||
pitaro yasya tṛpyanti tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
bhojaneṣu prapanneṣu yavānnaṃ yaḥ prayacchati || 32 ||
abhinnamukharāgeṇa tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
ubhayorapi bhāryāsu yasya buddhirna naśyati || 33 ||
samaṃ paśyati yo devi tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
ahiṃsanaṃ tu kurvīta viśuddhenāntarātmanā || 34||
ahiṃsoparataḥ śuddhaḥ sa sukhāyopajāyate ||
parabhāryāṃ surūpāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭirna cālyate || 35 ||
yasya cittaṃ na gacchettu tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
mauktikādīni ratnāni tathaiva kanakāni ca || 36 ||
loṣṭavatpaśyate yastu tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
mudite vāśvanāgendre ubhe sainye pathi sthite || 37 ||
yastu prāṇānpramucyeta tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim||
labdhena cāpyalabdhena kutsitaṃ karma garhayan || 38 ||
yastu jīvati saṃtuṣṭaḥ sa sukhāyopapadyate ||
bhartustu vai vrataṃ strīṇāmevameva vasundhare || 39 ||
yā toṣayati bharttāraṃ tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
vidyate vibhavenāpi puruṣo yastu paṇḍitaḥ || 40 ||
nigṛhītendriyaḥ paṃca tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
sahate cāvamānaṃ tu vyasane na tu durmanāḥ || 41 ||
yasyedaṃ viditaṃ sarvaṃ tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
akāmo vā sakāmo vā mama kṣetre vasuṃdhare || 42 ||
yastu prāṇānpramucyeta tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva yaḥ sadā pūjayennaraḥ || 43||
devateva sadā paśyettataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ||
ṛtukāle tu yo gacchenmāsemāse ca maithunam||44||
ananyamānaso bhūtvā tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim||
prayuktaḥ sarvadevānāṃ yo māmevaṃ prapūjayet ||45||
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||

sarvalokahitārthāya yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || 46 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe sukhaduḥkhanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||116||
atha dvātriṃśadaparādhāḥ||
śrīvarāha uvāca||
śṛṇu bhadre mahāścaryamāhāravidhiniścayam ||
āhāraṃ cāpyanāhāraṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 1 ||
bhuñjāno yāti cāśnāti mama yogāya mādhavi ||
aśubhaṃ karma kṛtvāpi puruṣo dharmamāśritaḥ || 2||
āhāraṃ caiva dharmajña upabhuñjīta nityaśaḥ ||
sarve cātraiva karmaṇyā vrīhayaḥ śālayastathā ||3||
akarmaṇyāni vakṣyāmi yena bhojyaṃti māṃ prati ||
tena vai bhuktamārgeṇa aparādho mahaujasaḥ || 4 ||
prathamaṃ cāparādhānnaṃ na roceta mama priye ||
bhuktvā tu parakīyānnaṃ tatparastannivarttanaḥ || 5||
dvitīyastvaparādho'yaṃ dharmavighnāya vai bhavet ||
gatvā maithunasaṃyāgaṃ yo nu māṃ spṛśate naraḥ ||6||
tṛtīyamaparādhaṃ tu kalpayāmi vasuṃdhare ||
dṛṣṭvā rajasvalāṃ nārīmasmākaṃ yaḥ prapadyate || 7 ||
caturthamaparādhaṃ tu dṛṣṭaṃ naiva kṣapāmyaham ||
spṛṣṭvā tu mṛtakaṃ caiva asaṃskārakṛtaṃ tu vai ||8||
paṃcamaṃ cāparādhaṃ ca na kṣamāmi vasuṃdhare ||
dṛṣṭvā tu mṛtakaṃ yastu nācamya spṛśate tu mām ||9 ||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ taṃ cāparādhaṃ vai na kṣamāmi vasuṃdhare ||
mamārcanasya kāle tu purīṣaṃ yastu gacchati || 10 ||
saptamaṃ cāparādhaṃ tu kalpayāmi vasuṃdhare ||
yastu nīlena vastreṇa prāvṛto māṃ prapadyate || 11 ||
aṣṭamaṃ cāparādhaṃ ca kalpayāmi vasundhare ||
mamaivārccanakāle tu yastvasamaṃ prabhāṣate ||12||
navamaṃ cāparādhaṃ taṃ na rocāmi vasundhare ||
avidhānaṃ tu yaḥ spṛśya māmeva pratipadyate || 13 ||
daśamaścāparādho'yaṃ mama cāpriyakārakaḥ ||
kruddhastu yāni karmāṇi kurute karmakārakaḥ || 14||
ekādaśāparādhaṃ tu kalpayāmi vasuṃdhare ||
akarmaṇyāni puṇyāni yastu māmupakalpayet || 15 ||
dvādaśaṃ cāparādhaṃ taṃ kalpayāmi vasuṃdhare ||
yastu raktena vastreṇa kausumbhenopagacchati || 16 ||
trayodaśaṃ cāparādhaṃ kalpayāmi vasundhare ||
andhakāre ca māṃ devi yaḥ spṛśeta kadācana ||17||
caturddaśāparādhaṃ tu kalpayāmi vasundhare ||
yastu kṛṣṇena vastreṇa mama karmāṇi kārayet || 18||
aparādhaṃ paṃcadaśaṃ kalpayāmi vasuṃdhare ||
adhautena tu vastreṇa yastu māmupakalpayet || 19 ||
ṣoḍaśaṃ tvaparādhānāṃ kalpayāmi varānane ||
svayamannaṃ tu yo hyayādajñānādapi mādhavi || 20 ||
aparādhaṃ saptadaśaṃ kalpayāmi vasundhare ||
yastu mātsyāni māṃsāni bhakṣayitvā prapadyate ||21 ||
aṣṭādaśāparādhaṃ ca kalpayāmi vasuṃdhare ||
jālapādaṃ bhakṣayitvā yastu māmupasarpati || 22 ||
ekonaviṃśāparādhaṃ kalpayāmi vasuṃdhare ||
yastu me dīpakaṃ spṛṣṭvā māmeva pratipadyate ||23||
viṃśakaṃ cāparādhaṃ taṃ kalpayāmi varānane ||
śmaśānaṃ yastu vai gatvā māmeva pratipadyate||24||
ekaviṃśāparādhaṃ taṃ kalpayāmi vasundhare ||
piṇyākaṃ bhakṣayitvā tu yo māmevābhigacchati || 25 ||
dvāviṃśaṃ cāparādhaṃ taṃ kalpayāmi priye sadā ||

śrīvarāha uvāca ||
yena garbhaṃ na gaccheta tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
kathayiṣyāmi te hyevaṃ sarvadharmaviniścayam || 1 ||
kṛtvāpi vipulaṃ karma ātmānaṃ na praśaṃsati ||
karoti bahukarmāṇi śuddhenaivāntarātmanā || 2 ||
kṛtvā tu mama karmāṇi samartho'nugrahe rataḥ ||
kāryākārye vijānāti sarvadharmeṣu niṣṭhitaḥ || 3||
śītoṣṇavātavarṣādikṣutpipāsāsahaśca yaḥ ||
yo daridro nirālasyaḥ satyavāganasūyakaḥ ||4||
svadāranirato nityaṃ paradāravivarjakaḥ ||
satyavādī viśuddhātmā nityaṃ ca bhagavatpriyaḥ || 5 ||
saṃvibhājya viśeṣajño nityaṃ brāhmaṇavatsalaḥ ||
priyabhāṣī dvijānāṃ ca mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 6 ||
kuyoniṃ tu na gaccheta mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||7 ||
yo viyoniṃ na gaccheta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
jīvahiṃsānivṛttastu sarvabhūtahitaḥ śuciḥ || 8 ||
sarvatra samatāyuktaḥ samaloṣṭhāśmakāṃcanaḥ ||
bālye sthito'pi vayasi kṣānto dāntaḥ śubhe rataḥ || 9 ||
nityaṃ naiva vijānāti pareṇāpakṛtaṃ kvacit ||
karttavyaṃ saṃsmaretsarvaṃ mama satyaṃ ca jalpati || 10 ||
vyalīkādvinivṛtto yastathyetikṛtaniścayaḥ ||
nityaṃ ca vṛttimānkaścitparokṣe'pi na cākṣipet ||11||
ṛtukāle'pi gacchedyaḥ apatyārthe svakāṃ striyam ||
īdṛśāstu narā bhadre mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ||12||
te viyoniṃ na gacchanti mama gacchanti sundari ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 13 ||
puruṣāṇāṃ prasannānāṃ yaśca dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
manunāpyanyathā dṛṣṭo hyanyathāṃgirasena ca || 14 ||
śukreṇa cānyathā dṛṣṭo gautamenāpi cānyathā ||
somena cānyathā dṛṣṭo rudreṇāpyanyathā punaḥ||15||
śaṅkhena cānyathā dṛṣṭo likhitenāpi cānyathā ||
kaśyapenānyathā dṛṣṭo dharmeṇāpyanyathā dhare |||16||
agninā vāyunā caiva dṛṣṭo dharmo'nyathā dhare ||
yamena cānyathā dṛṣṭa indreṇa varuṇena ca || 17 ||
kubereṇānyathā dṛṣṭaḥ śāṇḍilyenāpi cānyathā ||
pulastyenānyathā dṛṣṭa ādityenāpi cānyathā || 18 ||
pitṛbhiścānyathā dṛṣṭo hyanyathāpi svayambhuvā ||
ātmanātmani dharmeṇa ye narā niścitavratāḥ || 19 ||
svakaṃ pālayate dharmaṃ svamatenaiva bhāṣitam ||
paravādaṃ na kurvīta sarvadharmeṣu niścitam || 20||
na nindeddharmakāryāṇi ātmadharmapathe sthitaḥ ||
ebhirguṇaiḥ samāyukto mama karmāṇi kārayet || 21 ||
viyoniṃ sa na gaccheta mama lokāya gacchati ||
punaranyattu vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣveha mādhavi || 22 ||
taranti puruṣā yena garbhasaṃsārasāgaram ||
jitendriyā jitakrodhā lobhamohavivarjitāḥ || 23 ||
ātmopakārakā nityaṃ devātithigurupriyāḥ ||
hiṃsādīni na kurvanti madhumāṃsavivarjakāḥ || 24 ||
manasā brāhmaṇīṃ caiva yo gacchenna kadācana ||
viprāya kapilāṃ dadyādvṛdvaṃ sāntvena pālayet || 25 ||
sarveṣāṃ caiva putrāṇāṃ na viśeṣaṃ karoti yaḥ ||
saṃkruddhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yastu tatra prasādayet || 26 ||
yaḥ spṛśetkapilāṃ bhaktyā kumārīṃ na ca dūṣayet ||
agniṃ na ca krametpadbhyāṃ na ca putreṇa bhāṣayet || 27 ||
jalena mehayedyastu gurubhakto na jalpakaḥ ||
evaṃ dharmeṇa saṃyukto yo nu māṃ pratipadyate ||28||
sa ca garbhaṃ na gaccheta mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 29 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe janmābhāvo nāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 121 ||
atha kokāmukhamāhātmyam ||
varāha uvāca ||
guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
tiryagyonigatāścāpi yena mucyanti kilbiṣāt || 1 ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ maithunaṃ yo na gacchati ||
bhuktvā parasya cānnāni yaścaiva na vikutsati || 2 ||
bālye vayasyapi ca yo mama nityamanuvrataḥ ||
yena kenāpi saṃtuṣṭo yo mātāpitṛpūjakaḥ || 3 ||
āyāse jīvati na yaḥ pravibhāgī guṇānvitaḥ ||
dātā bhoktā ca kāryeṣu svatantro nityasaṃyataḥ || 4 ||
vikarma nābhikurvīta kaumāravratasaṃsthitaḥ ||
sarvabhūtadayāyuktaḥ sattvena ca samanvitaḥ || 5 ||
matyā ca niḥspṛho'tyantaṃ parārtheṣvaspṛhaḥ sadā ||
īdṛgbuddhiṃ samādāya mama lokāya gacchati ||
imaṃ guhyaṃ varārohe devairapi durāsadam || 6 ||
tacchṛṇuṣvānavadyāṅgi kathyamānaṃ mayā'naghe ||
jarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjasvedajāni kadācana || 7 ||
ye na hiṃsanti bhūtāni śuddhātmāno dayāparāḥ ||
yastu kokāmukhe devi dhruvaṃ prāṇānparityajet ||8||
manasā na calatyeva mama vallabhatāṃ vrajet ||
tato viṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvā sā mahī saṃśitavratā ||9||
varāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ pratyuvāca vasundharā || 10 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
ahaṃ śiṣyā ca dāsī ca bhaktā ca tvayi mādhava || 11 ||
evaṃ me paramaṃ guhyaṃ tvadbhaktyā vaktumarhasi ||
cakraṃ vārāṇasīṃ caiva aṭṭahāsaṃ ca naimiṣam || 12 ||
bhadrakarṇahradaṃ caiva hitvā kokāṃ praśaṃsasi ||
nagaraṃ ca dviraṇḍaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ maṇḍaleśvaram || 13 ||
kedāraṃ ca tato muktvā ki kokāṃ ca praśaṃsasi ||
devadāruvanaṃ muktvā tathā jāleśvaraṃ vibhum || 14 ||
durgaṃ mahābalaṃ muktvā kiṃ vai kokāṃ praśaṃsasi ||
gokarṇaṃ ca tato muktvā śuddhajālmeśvaraṃ tathā || 15 ||
ekaliṅgaṃ tato muktvā kiṃ vā kokāṃ praśaṃsasi ||
evaṃ pṛṣṭastathā bhaktyā mādhavaśca mahāprabhuḥ || 16 ||
varāharūpī bhagavānpratyuvāca vasundharām ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
evametanmahābhāge yanmāṃ tvaṃ bhīru bhāṣase || 17 ||
kathayiṣyāmi te guhyaṃ kokā yena viśiṣyate ||
ete rudrāśritāḥ kṣetrā ye tvayā parikīrtitāḥ || 18 ||
ete pāśupatāścaiṣāṃ kokā bhāgavatasya ha ||
tatrānyatte pravakṣyāmi mahākhyānaṃ varānane || 19 ||
kṛtaṃ kokāmukhe caiva mama kṣetre hi sundari ||
kaścillubdho miṣāhāraścaranvai kokamaṇḍale || 20 ||
tatrālpenāmbunā yukte hrade matsyastu tiṣṭhati ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ lubdhakastūrṇaṃ baḍiśenājahāra ha ||
tasya hastācca balavānmatsyastūrṇaṃ vinirgataḥ ||
atha śyenastu taṃ harttuṃ mantrayitvā nabhaścaraḥ ||21||
nipatya taṃ gṛhītvaiva proḍḍīnastvarayānvitaḥ ||
aśaktasya tato netuṃ matsyaḥ kokāmukhe'patat ||22||
tatkṣetrasya prabhāveṇa rājaputro'bhavatprabhuḥ ||
rūpavān guṇavāñchuddhaḥ kulena vayasānvitaḥ ||23||
atha kālena tasyaiva mṛgavyādhasya cāṅganā||
gṛhītvā caiva māṃsāni gacchantī yāti tatra vai ||24||
ekā cillī māṃsalubdhā taddhastānmāṃsagarddhinī ||
āgatyāgatya tarasā harttuṃ samupacakrame || 25 ||
mṛgavyādhā balānmāṃsaṃ hartukāmāṃ tu cillikām||
bāṇenaikena saṃhatya pātitā bhuvi tatkṣaṇāt||26||
ākāśātpātitā bhadre kokāyāṃ mama sannidhau||
jātā candrapure ramye rājaputrī yaśasvinī||27 ||
sā vyavarddhata kanyā tu vayorūpaguṇānvitā||
catuḥṣaṣṭikalāyuktā puruṣaṃ sā jugupsati ||28||
rūpavānguṇavāñchūro yuddhakāryārthaniścitaḥ ||
saumyaśca puruṣaścaiva sā ca neti jugupsati || 29 ||
rūpavānguṇavāñchūro yudakāryārthaniṣṭhitaḥ ||
saumyaṃ ca puruṣaṃ caiva sarvānabhijugupsati || 30 ||
atha kenacitkālena śaka ānandapūrake||
sambandho jāyata tayormadhyame vayasi sthayoḥ || 31 ||
tathā tu tau samāsādya parasparamatha kramāt ||
yathānyāyaṃ sa viproktaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||32||
sa vai tathā samaṃ nityaṃ sā ca tena samaṃ śubhā ||
anyonyaṃ ramamāṇau tau muhūrtamapi nojjhataḥ||33||
gacchatyevaṃ bahutare kāle caivāpyaniṃditā ||
samapremṇā ca saṃyuktā sauhradena ca nāyakam||34||
bhajamānā vinītā ca sauhṛdācca viśeṣataḥ ||
evaṃ bahugataḥ kālaḥ kāmabhogeṣu saktayoḥ||39||
rājaputrastasto'pyatra śakānāṃ naṃdavarddhanaḥ||
tasyā jāyata madhyāhne śirorugatipīḍinī||36||
ye kecidbhiṣajastatra gadeṣu kuśalāḥ śubhe||
te tatroṣadhayogaṃ ca cakrustenāpi vedanā ||37||
nanāśa naiva saṃyātaḥ kālo bahutithastataḥ||
na sambudhyati cātmānaṃ viṣṇumāyāvimohitaḥ||38||
pūrṇe hi samaye tattu ubhayośca tadantaram|
tasya kālaḥ saṃvṛtasya yo'sau pūrvapratistavaḥ ||39||
ayane gata eteṣāṃ vṛttaṃ kautūhalaṃ bhuvi ||
anyo'nyaprītiyuktau tu nānyo'nyaṃ jahatuḥ kvacit ||40 ||
tataḥ sarvānavadyāṅgī bharttāramidamabravīt ||
kimidaṃ tava bhadraṃ te vedanā jāyate śire || 41 ||
etadācakṣva tattvena yadyahaṃ ca tava priyā ||
bahavo bhiṣajaścaiva nānāśāstraviśāradāḥ ||42||
kurvanti tava karmāṇi vedanā ca na gacchati ||
evaṃ sa priyayā proktastāṃ priyāṃ punarabravīt ||43||
idaṃ kiṃ vismṛtā bhadre sarvavyādhisamanvitam ||
yallabdhaṃ mānuṣatvaṃ ca sukhaduḥkhasamanvitam || 44||
saṃsārasāgarārūḍhaṃ nātipraṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi ||
tenaivaṃ bhāṣitā bālā śrotukāmā varānanā||45||
tataḥ kadācicchayane suptau tau dampatī kila||
gate bahutithe kāle punaḥ papraccha sā priyam||46||
kathayasva tamevārthaṃ yanmayā pūrvapṛcchitam||
kiṃ māṃ na bhāṣase nātha sābhiprāyaṃ vacastava||47||
gopyaṃ vā kiṃcidastīha kiṃ gopayasi me puraḥ||
avaśyaṃ caiva vaktavyaṃ yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā||48||
iti nirbandhataḥ pṛṣṭaḥ sa śakādhipatirnṛpaḥ||
tāṃ priyāṃ praṇayātprāha bahumānapuraḥsaram ||49||
mucyatāṃ mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ tāṃ jātiṃ smara paurvikīm ||
atha kautūhalaṃ bhadre śravaṇe pūrvajanmanaḥ ||50||
manmātāpitarau gatvā prasādaya śucismite||
mānārhau mānayitvā tau yayāhaṃ jaṭhare dhṛtaḥ||51||
tayorājñāṃ puraskṛtya mānayitvā yathārhataḥ ||
atha kokāmukhe gatvā kathayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 52 ||
svapūrvajanmavṛttaṃ tu devānāmapi dularbham ||
tatra te kathayiṣyāmi sarvavṛttamanindite || 53 ||
tataḥ sā hyanavadyāṅgī śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ puraḥ ||
gatvā gṛhītvā caraṇau tatastāvidamabravīt ||54||
kiṃcidvijñaptukāmāsmi tatra vāmavadhīyatām ||
bhavadājñāṃ puraskṛtya bhavadbhyāmanumānitau || 55 ||
puṇye kokāmukhe gantumicchāvastatra vāṃ gurū ||
kāryagauravabhāvena na niṣedhyau kathañcana || 56 ||
adya yāvatkimapi vāṃ yācitaṃ na mayā kvacit||
purastāddhyāvayostanme yācitaṃ dātumarhataḥ || 57 ||
śirāvedenayā yuktaḥ sadā tava suto hyayam ||
madhyāhne mṛtakalpo vai jāyate hyacikitsakam ||58||
sukhāni sarvaviṣayānvisṛjya paripīḍitaḥ ||
kokāmukhaṃ vinā kaṣṭaṃ na nivṛttaṃ bhaviṣyati || 59 ||
kadācinnoktapūrvaṃ te rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mahat ||
tvaritaṃ gantumicchāmi viṣṇostatparamaṃ padam || 60 ||
dampatibhyāṃ hi mananaṃ rocatāṃ sarvathaiva hi ||
tato vadhūvacaḥ śrutvā śakānāmadhipo nṛpaḥ || 61 ||
kareṇa svayamādāya vadhūṃ putramuvāca ha ||
kimidaṃ cintitaṃ vatsa kokāmukhagamaṃ prati || 62 ||
hastyaśvaratha yānāni striyaścāpsarasopamāḥ ||
sarvametattu saptāṅgaṃ kośakoṣṭhādisaṃyutam ||63||
śaraṇaṃ vittayo rājyaṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
mitraṃ varāsanaṃ caiva gṛhṇīṣva sutasattama ||64||
tvayi pratiṣṭhitāḥ prāṇāḥ santānaṃ ca taduttaram ||
tataḥ piturvacaḥ śrutvā rājaputro yaśasvini || 65 ||
pituḥ pādau gṛhītvā ca provāca vinayānvitaḥ ||
alaṃ rājyena kośena vāhanena balena vā || 66 ||
gantumicchāmi tatrāhaṃ tūrṇaṃ kokāmukhaṃ mahat ||
śirovedanayā yukto yadi jīvāmyahaṃ pitaḥ || 67 ||
tadā rājyaṃ balaṃ kośo mamaivaitanna saśaṃyaḥ ||
tatraiva gamanānmahyaṃ vedanā nāśameṣyati|68||
putroktamavadhāryaiva śakānāmadhipo nṛpaḥ ||
anujajñe tataḥ kokāṃ gaccha putra namo'stu te || 69 ||
vaṇijaścaiva paurāśca vaiśyāścāpi varāṅganāḥ ||
anujagmū rājaputraṃ kokāmukhapathe sthitam || 70 ||
atha dīrgheṇa kālena prāptaḥ kokāmukhaṃ tvidam ||
tatra gatvā varārohā bharttāramidamabravīt 173||
pūrvapṛṣṭaṃ mayā yatte vakṣyāmīti ca māṃ prati ||
kokāmukhe tvayāpyuktaṃ tadetanmama kathyatām || 72 ||
niśamyeti priyāproktaṃ rājaputro yaśasvini ||
prahasyāha bhiyā tāṃ tu samāliṅgya vasundhare || 73 ||
rajanī sampravṛtteyaṃ sukhaṃ svāpo vidhīyatām ||
śvaḥ sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yatte manasi varttate||74||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ snātau kṣaumavibhūṣitau||
praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ haste gṛhya tataḥ priyām ||79||
tataḥ pūrvottare pārśve nityaṃ yo hṛdi tiṣṭhati ||
asthīni darśayāmāsa avaśiṣṭāni yāni tu||7||
etāni mama cāsthāni pūrvadehodbhavāni ca ||
ahaṃ purābhavaṃ matsyaḥ kokeṣu vicaran jale ||7||
vyādhena nigṛhīto'smi baḍiśena jalecaraḥ||
taddhastānnirgatastatra balena patito bhuvi||78||
śyenenāmiṣalubdhena nakhairviddho'smi sundari ||
nīta ākāśamārgeṇa tasmācca patito'tra vai || 79 ||
tena tasya prahāreṇa jātā śirasi vedanā ||
ahameva vijānāmi nānyo jānāti māṃ vinā||80||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre pūrvapṛṣṭaṃ ca yattvayā ||
gaccha sundari bhadraṃ te yatra te varttate manaḥ ||81||
tataḥ sāpyanavadyāṅgī raktapadmaśubhānanā ||
karuṇaṃ svaramādāya bharttāraṃ punarabravīt || 82 ||
etadarthaṃ mayā bhadra guhyaṃ noktaṃ tathā svakam ||
ahaṃ ca yādṛśī pūrvamabhavaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me||83||
kṣutpipāsāpariśrāntā cillī gaganagāminī||
vṛkṣopari samāsīnā bhakṣyaṃ caiva vicinvatī ||84||
atha kaścinmṛgavyādho hatvā vanacarānbahūn||
saṃgṛhya māṃsabhārānvai tena mārgeṇa saṅgataḥ||85||
sthāpayitvā māṃsabhārānpriyāyāḥ savidhe svayam ||
kāṣṭhānyānayituṃ yātaḥ kṣudhito māṃsapācane ||86||
pravṛtto'gnimupādāya tāvaduḍḍīya satvaram||
māṃsapiṇḍo mayā viddho dṛḍhairvajramayairnakhaiḥ ||87||
na ca saktāsmi saṃharttuṃ māṃsabhāraprapīḍitā ||
aśaktā dūragamane savidhe hi vyavasthitā || 88 ||
bhakṣayitvā tato māṃsaṃ vyādhaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||
apaśyanmāṃsapiṇḍaṃ tu mṛgayāmāsa pārśvataḥ ||89||
tāvaddadarśa māṃ tatra khādantīṃ māṃsapiṇḍikām||
tataḥ sa dhanurudyamya saśaraṃ ca vyakarṣata||90||
viddhā bāṇena māṃ tatra bhakṣayantamipātayat ||
tato'haṃ bhramamāṇā vai niśceṣṭā gatajīvitā ||91 ||
patitāsmyavaśā bhadra kālatantre durāsade ||
etatkṣetraprabhāveṇa tvakāmāpi nṛpātmajā||92||
jātāsmi tvatpriyā cāpi smarantī pūrvajanma tat||
etāni paśya cāsthīni śeṣāṇi bahukālataḥ||93||
galitānyalpaśeṣāṇi prāṇanātha samīpataḥ ||
evaṃ sā darśayitvā tu bharttāraṃ punarabravīt ||94 ||
ānīto'si mayā bhadra sthānaṃ kokāmukhaṃ prati||
etatkṣetraprabhāveṇa tiryagyonigatā api||95||
uttame tu kule jātā mānuṣī jātimāśritāḥ ||
yaṃ yaṃ pravakṣyase dharmaṃ viṣṇuproktaṃ yaśodhana||96||
taṃ tameva kariṣyāmi viṣṇuloke sukhāvaham ||
tatastasyā vacaḥ śrutvā labdhapūrvasmṛtirnṛpaḥ || 97 ||
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā sādhu sādhvityapūjayat ||
tasmin kṣetre ca yatkarma karttavyaṃ dharmasaṃhitam||98||
tacchrutvā kāniciddevī svayaṃ cakre pativratā||
anye'pi sarve tacchrutvā yasya yadrocate priyam || 99 ||
tattatsarve'pi kurvaṃti vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
tatra tau dampatī dravyamannaṃ ratnaṃ dvijeṣu ca || 100 ||
dadatuḥ paramaprītau pātrebhyaśca yathārhataḥ ||
ye'nye tatsārthamāsādya yātāste'pi vasundhare || 101 ||
brāhmaṇebhyo daduḥ svāni viṣṇubhaktyā yatavratāḥ ||
tatra sthitvā varārohe mama karmavyavasthitaḥ || 102 ||
tatkṣetrasya prabhāveṇa śvetadvīpamupāgatāḥ ||
evaṃ sa rājaputro'pi mama karmavyavasthitaḥ || 103 ||
muktvā tu mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ śvetadvīpamupāgataḥ ||
sarve ca puruṣāstatra ātmanātmānudarśanāt ||104 ||
śuklāmbaradharā divyabhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitāḥ ||
dīptimanto mahākāyāḥ sarve ca śubhadarśanāḥ || 105 ||
striyo'pi divyā yatratyā divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||

mantraḥ -

mantraḥ -

mantraḥ -

mantraḥ -

bhavecca śītalaṃ grīṣme māyeyaṃ mama tattvataḥ||
paścimāṃ diśamāsthāya yadastaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ||12||
udeti pūrvataḥ prātarmāyeyaṃ mama sundari||
śoṇitaṃ caiva śukraṃ ca ubhe ca prāṇisaṃsthite || 13 ||
garbhe ca jāyate janturmāyeyaṃ mama sundari|
jīvaḥ praviśya garbhaṃ tu sukhaduḥkhe ca vindati||14||
jātaśca vismaretsarvameṣā māyā mamottamā ||
ātmakarmāśrito jīvo naṣṭasaṃjño gataspṛhaḥ||15||
karmaṇā nīyate'nyatra māyaiṣā mama cottamā ||
śukraśoṇitasaṃyogājjāyate mama jantavaḥ||16||
aṅgulyaścaraṇau caiva bhujau śīrṣaṃ kaṭistathā ||
pṛṣṭhaṃ tathodaraṃ caiva dantauṣṭhapuṭanāsikam||17||
karṇau netre kapālau ca lalāṭaṃ jihvayā saha||
etayā māyayā yuktā jāyante yadi jantavaḥ ||18 ||
tasyaiva jīryate bhuktamagninā pītameva ca||
adhaśca sravate jantureṣā māyā mamottamā||19||
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca paṃcama||
annātpravarttate jantureṣā māyā mama priyā||20||
sarvartuṣu nijākāraḥ sthāvare jaṅgame tathā ||
tattvaṃ na jñāyate tasya māyaiṣā mama sundari || 21 ||
āpo divyāstathā bhaumā āpo yeṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
nadyo vṛddhiṃ prayāntyatra māyaiṣā mama sundari || 22 ||
vṛṣṭau bahūdakāḥ sarve palvalāni sarāṃsi ca ||
grīṣme sarvāṇi śuṣyanti etanmāyābalaṃ mama || 23 ||
himavacchikharānmuktā nāmnā mandākinī nadī ||
gāṃ gatā sā bhavedgaṅgā māyaiṣā mama kīrttitā || 24 ||
meghā vahanti salilamuddhṛtya lavaṇārṇavāt ||
varṣanti madhuraṃ loke etanmāyābalaṃ mama || 25 ||
rogārtā jantavaḥ kecidbhakṣayanti mahauṣadham ||
tasya vīryaṃ samāśritya māyāṃ tu visṛjāmyaham ||26||
auṣadhe dīyamāne'pi jantuḥ paṃcatvameti yat ||
nirvīryamauṣadhaṃ kṛtvā kālo bhūtvā harāmyaham || 27 ||
prathamaṃ jāyate garbhaḥ paścātsaṃjāyate pumān ||
jāyate madhyamaṃ rūpaṃ tato'pi jarayā yutaḥ||28||
tata indriyanāśaśca etanmāyābalaṃ mama ||
yadbhūmau vihitaṃ bījaṃ tasmāttajjāyate'ṅkuram || 29 ||
punaśca patrādiyutametanmāyābalaṃ mama ||
ekabījātprakīrṇādvai jāyante tāni bhūriśaḥ || 30 ||
tatrāmṛtaṃ visṛjāmi māyāyogena bhūriśaḥ ||
loka evaṃ vijānāti garuḍo vahate'cyutam || 31 ||
bhūtvā vegena garuḍo vahāmyātmānamātmanā ||
yā etā devatāḥ sarvā yajñabhāgena toṣitāḥ || 32 ||
māyāmetāmahaṃ kṛtvā toṣayāmi divaukasaḥ ||
lokāḥ sarve vijānanti devā nityaṃ makhāśinaḥ || 33||
māyāmetāmahaṃ kṛtvā yakṣyāmi tridivaukasaḥ ||
sarvo'pi bhajate loke yaṣṭāraṃ ca bṛhaspatim || 34 ||
māyāmāṅgirasīṃ kṛtvā yājayāmi divaukasaḥ ||
sarve lokā vijānanti varuṇaḥ pāti sāgaram || 35 ||
māyāṃ tu vāruṇīṃ kṛtvā rakṣāmi ca mahārṇavam ||
sarve lokā vijānanti kubero'yaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ || 36 ||
kuberamāyāmādāya ahaṃ rakṣāmi taddhanam ||
evaṃ lokā vijānanti vṛtraḥ śakreṇa sūditaḥ || 37 ||
śākrīṃ māyāṃ samāsthāya mayā vṛtro niṣūditaḥ ||
evaṃ lokā vijānanti ādityaśca dhruvo mahān || 38 ||
meruṃ māyāmayaṃ kṛtvā vahāmyādityameva ca ||
evamābhāṣate loko jalaṃ vā naśyate'khilam || 39 ||
vaḍavāmukhamāsthāya pibāmi tadahaṃ jalam ||
vāyuṃ māyāmayaṃ kṛtvā megheṣu visṛjāmyaham|| 40 ||
yadīdaṃ bhāṣate lokaḥ kutraitattiṣṭhate jalam ||
devā api na jānanti amṛtaṃ kutra tiṣṭhati || 41 ||
mama māyāniyogena tiṣṭhati hyauṣadhaṃ vane ||
loko hyevaṃ vijānāti rājā pālayate prajāḥ || 42 ||
rājamāyāmahaṃ kṛtvā pālayāmi vasundharām ||
ye tu vai dvādaśādityā udeṣyanti yugakṣaye || 43 ||
praviśya tānahaṃ bhūme māyāṃ loke sṛjāmyaham ||
sūryaśca cāṃśunā bhūme sadā lokeṣu pacyate || 44 ||
māyāmaṃśumayīṃ kṛtvā pūrayāmyakhilaṃ jagat ||
varṣante yatra saṃvarttā dhārairmusalasannibhaiḥ || 45 ||
māyāṃ sāṃvarttakīṃ gṛhya pūrayāmyakhilaṃ jagat ||
yatsvapāmi varārohe śeṣasyopari dhāriṇi ||46||
anantamāyayā cāhaṃ dhārayāmi svapāmi ca ||
varāhamāyāmādāya bhūme jānāsi kiṃ na vai ||47||
devā yatra nilīyante sā māyā mama kīrttitā ||
tvaṃ cāpi vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ kṛtvā jānāsi kiṃ na tat || 48 ||
dhāritāsi ca suśroṇi vārān saptadaśaiva tu ||
māyā tu mama devīyaṃ kṛtvā hyekārṇavāṃ mahīm || 49 ||
mam māyābalaṃ hyetadyena tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ jale ||
prajāpatiṃ ca rudraṃ ca sṛjāmi ca vahāmi ca || 50 ||
te'pi māyāṃ na jānanti mama māyāvimohitāḥ ||
atho pitṛgaṇāścāpi ya ete sūryavarccasaḥ || 51 ||
māyāṃ pitṛmayīṃ hyetāṃ gṛhṇāmīti ca tattvataḥ ||
kintu tvayaiva suśroṇi anyacca śṛṇu sundari || 52 ||
ṛṣirmāyānusāreṇa striyā yoniṃ praveśitaḥ ||
tato viṣṇorvacaḥ śrutvā śrotukāmā vasundharā || 53 ||
karābhyāmañjaliṃ kṛtvā vākyametattadabravīt ||
kiṃ tena ṛṣimukhyena kṛtaṃ karma suduṣkaram ||54 ||
strītvaṃ caiva punaḥ prāptaṃ strīyoniṃ caiva prāpitaḥ ||
etanme sarvamākhyāhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ||55||
tasya brāhmaṇamukhyasya strītve yatkarma pāpakam||
tato mahyā vacaḥ śrutvā hṛṣṭatuṣṭamanā hariḥ||56||
madhuraṃ vākyamādāya pratyuvāca vasundharām ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi dharmākhyāne ca sundari||57||
māyā mama viśālākṣi rohiṇī lomaharṣiṇī ||
māyāyā mama yogena somaśarmā ca karśitaḥ ||58||
gato gatīranekāśca uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ ||
brāhmaṇatvaṃ punaḥ prāpto mama māyāpracoditaḥ ||59||
yathā brāhmaṇamukhyena prāptā strīyonireva ca ||
na tasya vikṛtaṃ karma aparādho na vidyate ||60||
mamaivārādhanaparo mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
nityaṃ cintayate bhūme mama mūrtiṃ manoramām ||61||
ayaṃ dīrgheṇa kālena tasya tuṣṭo'smi sundari ||
tapasā karmaṇā bhaktyā ananyamanasā stutaḥ ||62||
tatastasya mayā devi dattvā darśanamuttamam ||
vareṇa chandito vipra tapastuṣṭo'smi te dvija ||63||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te tava yaddhṛdi varttate ||
ratnāni kāṃcanaṃ gāvastathā rājyamakaṇṭakam ||64||
athavecchasi taṃ svargaṃ yatra saukhyaṃ varāṅganāḥ ||
dhanaratnaṃ samṛddhaṃ hi hemabhāṇḍavibhūṣitam ||65||
yatra sarvā divyarūpā bhavantyapsarasaḥ parāḥ||
dadāmi te varaṃ vipra yāvatte cittacintitam||66||
tato mama vacaḥ śrutvā sa ca brāhmaṇapuṃgavaḥ ||
śirasā patito bhūmau māmuvāca priyaṃ vacaḥ||67||
atha no kupyase deva varaṃ samanuyācate ||
yattvayā bhāṣitaṃ deva mama deyaṃ yadṛcchayā ||68||
na cāhaṃ kāṃcanaṃ gāvo na ca strīrājyameva ca ||
svargaṃ vāpsaraso vāpi aiśvaryaṃ na manoharam ||69||
tathā svargasahasrāṇāmekaṃ cāpi na rocate||
jñātumicchāmi te māyāṃ yayā krīḍasi mādhava ||70||
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā samayā tatra bhāṣitaḥ ||
kiṃ māyayā te viprendra akāryaṃ pṛcchase dvija||71 ||
devā api na jānanti viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ||
tato mama vacaḥ śrutvā sa ca brāhmaṇapuṃgavaḥ||72||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ māyayā ca pracoditaḥ||
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva karmaṇā tapasā'thavā || 73||
tava deva prasādena mamaivaṃ dīyatāṃ varaḥ ||
tatastu sa mayā proktastapasvī brāhmaṇastathā ||74||
gaccha kubjāmrake gaṅgāsnāto māyāṃ tu gacchasi||
mamaiva vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam||75||
kubjāmrake devi vipro mama māyābhilāṣukaḥ ||
tataḥ kuṇḍī tridaṇḍī ca mātrābhāṇḍaṃ ca yatnataḥ ||76||
sthāpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ tīrthamārādhayadyathā||
tato hyavataradgaṅgāṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā||77||
avagāhya tato gaṅgāṃ sarvagātre ca kledite ||
tāvanniṣādasadane tatstrīgarbhe gato'bhavat || 78 ||
hṛdaye'cintayattatra garbhakleśena pīḍitaḥ ||
aho kaṣṭaṃ mayā kiṃsvitkarma vā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 79 ||
yo'haṃ niṣādagarbhe'sminvasāmi narakeṣu ca ||
dhik tapo dhikca me karma dhikphalaṃ dhik ca jīvitam || 80 ||
yo'haṃ niṣādagarbhe'sminpīḍāsti malasaṃkule ||
asthnāṃ triśatasaṅkīrṇe navadvārābhisaṃvṛte || 81 ||
purīṣamūtrasaṅkīrṇe māṃsaśoṇitakarddame||
durgandhe duḥsahe caiva vātikaśleṣmapattike||82||
bahurogasamākīrṇe bahuduḥkhatamākule ||
alaṃ kiṃ tena coktena duḥkhānyanubhavāmi ca || 83 ||
kuto viṣṇuḥ kuto vāhaṃ kuto gaṅgājalāni ca ||
garbhasaṃsāraniṣkrāntaḥ paścādāpyāmi tāṃ kriyām || 84 ||
evaṃ cintayamānastu śīghraṃ garbhādviniḥsṛtaḥ ||
bhūmyāṃ tu patatastasya naṣṭaṃ yatpūrvacintitam || 85 ||
ajāyata tataḥ kanyā niṣādasya gṛhe tadā ||
dhanadhānyasamṛddhasya brāhmaṇo varttate sa ca||86||
na ca saṃjñāyate kiṃcidviṣṇumāyāvimohitā||
atha dīrghasya kālasya kṛtodvāhā yaśasvinī||87||
putrānduhitaraścaiva janayāmāsa māyayā ||
bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca khādeta peyāpeyaṃ ca tatpibet || 88 ||
jīvāni caiva satataṃ ghātitāni tatastataḥ ||
kāryākāryaṃ na jānīte vācyāvācyaṃ tatheti ca || 89 ||
gamyāgamyaṃ na jānāti māyājālena mohitaḥ ||
paṃcāśadvarṣake kāle mayā khyātaḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ || 90 ||
ghaṭaṃ gṛhītvā viḍliptavastrakṣālanakāraṇāt ||
tīre niḥkṣipya vastraṃ sa ghaṭaṃ ca vinidhāya hi ||91||
snātuṃ gaṅgājale sthitvā vigāhayati jāhnavīm ||
prasvedagharmasantaptaḥ sa śiraḥsnānamīhate || 92 ||
jātastapodhanastatra daṇḍī kuṇḍīdharaḥ punaḥ ||
yatra paśyati vipro'sau mātrāṃ kuṇḍīṃ tridaṇḍakam || 93 ||
vastrādi darśitaṃ caiva yatra saṃsthāpitaṃ purā ||
tattena sarvaṃ sandṛṣṭaṃ jāte jñāne tu pūrvavat || 94 ||
vipreṇa jñātukāmena viṣṇumāyāṃ yathā purā ||
tata uttaratastatra gaṅgāyāṃ tu tapodhanaḥ || 95 ||
vāso gṛhṇāti savrīḍo yogaṃ ca paricintayan||
upaviśya ca gaṅgāyāḥ puline samabāluke || 96 ||
tato vindati cātmānaṃ tapasā yattadā kṛtam ||
mayā kiṃ karma pāpena kṛtaṃ nindyaṃ suduṣkaram || 97 ||
evaṃ nindati cātmānaṃ dhikkurvan sādhudūṣitam ||
ācāro vā paribhraṣṭo yenāhaṃ prāpitastvimām || 98 ||
niṣādasya kule jāto bhakṣyābhakṣyāśca bhakṣitāḥ ||
jīvāśca ghātitāḥ sarve jalasthaladivaukasaḥ || 99 ||
peyāpeyaṃ ca me pītaṃ vikrītāścāpyavikreyāḥ ||
agamyāgamanaṃ caiva vācyāvācyaṃ na rakṣitam || 100 ||
veśmanyabhojyabhojyaṃ ca bhuktaṃ caiva na saṃśayaḥ ||
putrā duhitaraścaiva niṣādājjanitā mayā ||101||
tataḥ kiṃcāparādhaṃ vā kena vā tadvicintaye ||
yenāhaṃ prāpito hyenāṃ naiṣādīmīdṛśīṃ daśām || 102 ||
etasminnaṃtare bhūme niṣādaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ||
putraiḥ parivṛtastatra māyātīrthamupāgataḥ || 103 ||
tato mṛgayate bhāryāṃ bhaktiyuktāṃ śubhekṣaṇām ||
paripṛcchati caikaikaṃ tapyamānaṃ tapodhanam || 104 ||
kva gatāsi priye'smākaṃ tyaktvā putrān gṛhe ca mām ||
bālā duhitā roditi kṣudhārttāstanapāyinī || 105 ||
kiṃ nu paśyatha bhāryāṃ me gaṅgātīramupāgatā ||
ghaṭamādāya hastena āgatā jalakāraṇāt || 106 ||
tatraiva ca narāḥ sarve māyātīrthamupāgatāḥ ||
paśyaṃte'tra parivrājaṃ kumbhaṃ caiva yathāsthitam ||107||
tato duḥkhena saṃtaptaḥ apaśyaṃśca svakāṃ priyām ||
dṛṣṭvā paṭaṃ ca kumbhaṃ ca karuṇaṃ paryavedayet||108||
idaṃ vāsaśca kumbhaśca nadīkūle ca tiṣṭhati ||
na cāpi dṛśyate bhāryā mama gaṅgāmupāgatā || 109||
atha kenāpi grāheṇa snāyamānā tapasvinī ||
gṛhītā toyamadhye tu jihvāloḍena cābalā || 110 ||
na cāpriyaṃ mayā'syuktā kadācidapi vācakam ||
svapne'pi noktapūrvāsi kadācidapi cāpriyam || 111 ||
athavāpi piśācena bhakṣitā bhūtarākṣasaiḥ ||
ākṛṣṭā kiṃ nu rogeṇa gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritā ||112 ||
kiṃ kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ mayā karma susaṅkaṭam ||
yena matpurato bhāryāpyadṛṣṭā vigatiṃ gatā || 113 ||
ehi me subhage kānte mama cittānuvarttini ||
paśyaitānbālakān bhītān kliśyamānānitastataḥ || 114 ||
māṃ paśya tvaṃ varārohe trīnputrānatibālakān ||
catasro duhitṝḥ paśya sarvāśca mama mānade|| 115 ||
mama putrā rudantyete bālakāstava lālasā ||
nityaṃ ca dārikā rakṣa mama duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ || 116||
kāmaṃ māṃ kṣudhitaṃ caiva jñāsyase tvaṃ pipāsitam ||
evamuktā ca kalyāṇi mama muktyā vyavasthitā || 117 ||
evaṃ vilapamānasya niṣādasya tvitastataḥ ||
savrīḍaṃ bhāṣate vipro niṣādaṃ gaccha nāsti sā || 118 ||
sukhaṃ yogaṃ ca te nītvā sā gatā hyanivṛttaye ||
taṃ rudantaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā kāruṇyena pariplutaḥ || 119 ||
niṣādaṃ bhāṣate tatra gaccha kiṃ parikliśyase ||
bālāṃstānparirakṣasva āhārairvividhairapi || 120 ||
ete na tyajanīyāste kadācidapi putrakāḥ ||
parivrāja vacaḥ śrutvā niṣādastasya sannidhau || 121 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ duḥkhaśokapariplutaḥ ||
aho munivaraśreṣṭha aho dharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 122 ||
sāntvito'smi tvayā vipra vacanairmadhurākṣaraiḥ || 123 ||
niṣadāsya vacaḥ śrutvā sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ duḥkhaśokapariplutaḥ || 124 ||
mā rodīrvacmi bhadraṃ te tavāhaṃ sā priyā'bhavat ||
gaṅgātīraṃ samāsādya munirjāto'smahaṃ tathā || 125 ||
parivrājavacaḥ śrutvā niṣādo vigatajvaraḥ ||
ślakṣṇaṃ vacanamādāya pratyuvāca dvijottamam || 126 ||
kimidaṃ bhāṣase vipra avyaktaṃ yatkadācana ||
na bhāvaṃ vā yaddhaṭitaṃ striyaḥ puṃstvaṃ sadaiva hi || 127 ||
niṣādasya vacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇo duḥkhamūrcchitaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ gaṅgātīre ca dhīvaram || 128 ||
śīghraṃ gaccha svakaṃ deśametān gṛhya svabālakān ||
sarveṣāṃ ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ snehaḥ karttavya eva ca || 129 ||
sa tena codito hyevaṃ niṣādo nāvagacchati ||
madhuraṃ svaramādāya pratyuvāca dvijottamam || 130 ||
kiṃ tvayā duṣkṛtaṃ karma kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ purātanam ||
mama yadbhāṣase caiva strītvaṃ prāpto'si tatkatham || 131 ||
kena doṣeṇa prāptastvaṃ strītvaṃ bhūtvā pumān punaḥ ||
puṃstvaṃ caiva kathaṃ prāpta etadācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||132||
evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa ṛṣiḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ māyātīrthajalecaram || 133 ||
niṣāda śṛṇu tattvena matkathāṃ ca prajalpataḥ ||
na mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcitkṛtaṃ kutrāpi tattvataḥ || 134 ||
ekabhaktaṃ mayācāre abhakṣyaṃ caiva varjitam ||
sa mayārādhito devo lokanātho janārdanaḥ ||
karmabhirbahubhiścaiva mayā darśanakāṅkṣiṇā || 135 ||
atha dīrgheṇa kālena mayā dṛṣṭo janārddanaḥ ||
vareṇa chandayāmāsa bahudhā māyayā tataḥ || 136 ||
mayā nābhīpsitastasmāddīyamāno varastataḥ||
māyāṃ me darśaya vibho viṣṇo praṇatavatsala || 137||
tato māṃ bhāṣate viṣṇurmāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā hyalaṃ dvija ||
mayā punaḥ punaścokto mama prītyā pradarśaya || 138 ||
tato'haṃ tena cāpyuktastarhi drakṣatyalaṃ bhavān ||
gaccha kubjāmrake gaṅgāṃ snātvetyaṃtarhito'bhavat || 139 ||
ahaṃ māyāpralobhena gaṅgātīramupāgataḥ ||
daṇḍaṃ kuṇḍīṃ ca vastraṃ ca tīre saṃsthāpya yatnanaḥ ||
tataḥ snānavidhānena nimagnastajjale'male || 140 ||
na tatra kiṃcijjānāmi kimidaṃ kiṃ pravarttate ||
niṣādīgarbhasambhūtastava patnyabhavaṃ tataḥ || 141 ||
kenacitkāraṇenātra praviṣṭo jāhnavījale ||
snātvā'paśyaṃ pūrvavacca tāvajjāto ṛṣistvaham || 142 ||
niṣāda paśya kuṇḍīṃ ca mātrāṃ vastraṃ yathā purā ||
paṃcāśadvarṣadeśīyo jāto'smi tvadgṛhe vasan ||
daṇḍavastrādi yatkiṃcinna jīrṇaṃ gaṅgayā hṛtam || 143 ||
evaṃ tena tataścoktā niṣādo'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||
ye ca te bālakāstatra teṣāṃ kaścinna dṛśyate || 144 ||

adya paṃcāśadvarṣāṇi amāvāsyādya caiva hi || 151 ||

etasminnaṃtare devi brāhmaṇāya tato mayā ||
darśayitvā nijaṃ rūpaṃ tamavocamidaṃ dhare||153||
kimidaṃ bhrāṃtarūpo'si kiṃ vā tvaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi ||

pūrvāhṇe sthāpayitvā tvaṃ vastraṃ daṇḍakamaṇḍalū ||
āgato'syaparāhne kiṃ sthalaṃ vismṛtavānasi || 156 ||

snātuṃ kadācidgaṅgāyāṃ gato'haṃ tīrabhūmigaḥ ||
sthāpayitvādya svaṃ vastraṃ magnaḥ snāsyan jale'male||

tapaśca tapyamānena kiṃ mayā vikṛtaṃ kṛtam||160 ||

vyabhicāraśca me tatra ko jātastu tavārccane||161 ||

vikarma na kṛtaṃ kiṃcidapi me vipra pūjane ||
yena duḥkhamanuprāptaṃ tiryagyoniṃ ca vai gataḥ || 165 ||

dadāmi divyabhogānvai bhaumānvāpi tavepsitam ||
tāṃstu necchasi māyāyā darśanaṃ vṛtavānasi || 167 ||

na gato divasaśreṣṭha nāparāhṇe'pi kutracit ||

śuddhā bhāgavatāḥ pūjyā draṣṭavyāḥ sarvadā nṛbhiḥ || 175 ||
viśeṣeṇa kalau brahmandvijarūpo hyavasthitaḥ ||

yo māṃ prāptamiheccheta yasyāvācyaṃ na vidyate ||

gaccha brāhmaṇa siddho'si yadā prāṇānvimokṣyasi ||
tadā''gantā'si matsthānaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ na saśaṃyaḥ || 178 ||
evamuktvā varārohe tatraivāntarhito'bhavam ||

māṃ ca paśyati vai nityaṃ māyābalasusaṃsthitam ||180 ||
māyayā kiṃ tava dhare na māyāṃ jñātumarhasi||
mama māyāṃ na jānanti devadānavarākṣasāḥ ||181 ||

māyācakramiti khyātaṃ sarvapuṇyasukhāvaham || 182||
ākhyānānāṃ mahākhyānaṃ tapasāṃ ca parantapaḥ ||
puṇyānāṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ gatīnāṃ ca parā gatiḥ ||183||
nityaṃ paṭhedyo bhakteṣu abhakteṣu na kīrtayet ||
mā paṭhennīcamadhyeṣu mā paṭhecchāstradūṣake || 184 ||
agrataḥ pṛcchatā śūdramadbhakteṣu tathāgrataḥ ||
paṭhate śobhate vipro na tu ye śāstradūṣakāḥ || 185 ||
kalyamutthāya yo bhūme paṭhate ca dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
tena dvādaśa varṣāṇi mamāgre paṭhitaṃ bhavet || 186 ||
atha pūrṇena kālena pumānpaṃcatvamāgataḥ ||

mucyamānā varārohe kimanyatparipṛcchasi || 189 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre māyācakraṃ nāma paṃcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||125||
atha kubjāmrakamāhātmyārambhaḥ ||
tatra raibhyānugrahaḥ ||
śrutvā māyābalaṃ hyetaddharaṇī saṃśitavratā||
varāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ pratyuvāca vasundharā || 1 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
yattatkubjāmrake deva bhāṣase tadanantakam ||
na tatrāhaṃ vijānāmi pūrvamuktaṃ ca yattvayā || 2 ||
