caturviṃśatirdvādaśyāṃ yena vijñāyate khalu ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi tīrthaṃ kubjāmrake dhare || 84 ||
śakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam ||
tasmiṃstīrthe varārohe śakratīrthe vasuṃdhare ||85||
śakrastu vasate loke vajrahasto na saṃśayaḥ ||
athavā mriyate tatra śakratīrthe mahātape ||86||
upoṣya daśarātrāṇi mama lokāya gacchati ||
tasya cihnaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena vijñāyate tataḥ || 87 ||
ekacittaṃ samādhāya śṛṇu sundari tattvataḥ ||
pañca vṛkṣāstu tiṣṭhanti taddakṣiṇadiśe kṣite || 88 ||
śakratīrthasya cihnaṃ te vasudhe parikīrttitam ||
anyacca tīrthaṃ vakṣyāmi tasmin kubjāmrake param ||89 ||
varuṇena tapastaptaṃ sahasraṃ pañca sapta ca ||
tatra snātasya vakṣyāmi jāyate tatra yatphalam || 90 ||
yatprāpnoti mṛto vāpi puruṣaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ||
aṣṭa varṣa sahasrāṇi gatvā vai varuṇālayam || || 91 ||
svacchandagamano bhūtvā evameva na saṃśayaḥ ||
atha vai mriyate tatra viṃśavarṣoṣito naraḥ || 92 ||
sarvasaṅgaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
tasya cihnaṃ pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 93 ||
tatra dhārā patatyekā ekarūpā sadā bhavet ||
na varddhate ca varṣāsu gharme na hrasate punaḥ || 94 ||
saptasāmudrakaṃ nāma tasminkubjāmrake param ||
tasminkṛtodako bhūme naro dharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 95 ||
trayāṇāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
śīghraṃ gacchati vai svargaṃ sahasraṃ daśa pañca ca || 96 ||
tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭaḥ kulavāñjāyate dvijaḥ ||
vedavedāṅgakuśalaḥ somapaścaiva jāyate || 97 ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānmuktasaṅgo jitendriyaḥ ||
uṣitvā saptarātraṃ vai mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||98||
tasya cihnaṃ pravakṣyāmi tīrthasya śṛṇu sundari ||
vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ vibhūtistatra yā bhavet || 99 ||
vimalā gāṅgatā yatra gaṅgājalavimiśritam ||
tasmin tīrthe tadevaitatkṣīravarṇaṃ punarbhavet || 100 ||
punaśca pītavarṇābhā punā raktaḥ kadā bhavet ||
punarmarakatābhāsaṃ punarmuktāsamaprabham || 1 ||
etaiścihnaistu vijñeyaṃ tattīrthaṃ viditātmabhiḥ ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tīrthaṃ kubjāmrake mahat || 2 ||
tīrthaṃ mānasaro nāma sarvabhāgavatapriyam ||
tasmin snāto varārohe gacchate mānasaṃ saraḥ||3||
devānpaśyati vai sarvānrudreṃdrasamarudgaṇān||
atha tatra mṛto bhūme triṃśadrātroṣito naraḥ || 4 ||
sarvasaṅgavinirmukto mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
tasya cihnaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena tajjñāyate naraiḥ || 5 ||
paṃcāśatkrośavitataṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ durāsadam ||
etattu bhūme vijñeyaṃ yathaitanmānasaṃ saraḥ ||6||
śuddhairbhāgavatairjñeyaṃ mama karmasu niṣṭhitaiḥ ||
etattīrthaṃ mahābhāge tasmin kubjāmrakaṃ smṛtam||7||
siddhikāmasya viprasya raibhyasya parikīrtitam||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasuṃdhare ||8||
tatra kubjāmrake vṛttaṃ purāścaryaṃ mahādbhutam ||
mama nirmālyapārśve vai vyālī tiṣṭhati nirbhayā||9||
gaṃdhamālyopahāryāṇi bhakṣayaṃtī yadṛcchayā||
kasyacittvatha kālasya nakulastatra cāgataḥ || 10 ||
paśyate ca tatastatra ramamāṇaṃ yadṛcchayā||
nakulena saha vyālyā tadā yuddhamabhūcca tat ||1 1 ||
sampūrṇe te tu madhyāhne māghamāse tu dvādaśīm ||
tayā sa daṣṭo nakulo nāśāya mama maṃdire || 12 ||
tenāpi viṣadigdhena vyālī śīghraṃ nipātitā ||
ubhau cānyonya yuddhena tadā paṃcatvamāgatau || 13 ||
vyālī prāgjotiṣe jātā rājaputrī yaśasvinī ||
nakulo'jāyata tadā kosaleṣu janādhipaḥ || 14 ||
rūpavānguṇavāndevi sarvaśāstrakalānvitaḥ ||
tau tu dīrgheṇa kālena saukhyena parirañjitau || 15 ||
avarddhatāṃ yathākālaṃ śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī ||
sā kanyā nakulaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyo hantuṃ tathecchati || 16||
vyālīṃ dṛṣṭvā rājaputraḥ sahasā hantumicchati ||
atha tasyāstu kālena kosalādhipatistathā||17||
pāṇiṃ jagrāha vidhivanmatprasādādvasundhare ||
kosalādhipateścāpi rājñaḥ prāgjotiṣasya ca || 18 ||
mahotsavena saṃvṛttaḥ sambandho matprasādataḥ ||
dṛḍhaprītistayorjātā yathā ca jatukāṣṭhayoḥ || 19 ||
ramato dhūmaketośca vahneścaiva yathā tathā ||
yathā śacī ca śakraśca ramantau nandane vane ||20 ||
evaṃ ca dīrghakālaṃ hi tayoḥ prītirna hīyate ||
evaṃ tau viharantau tu tasminnupavane tataḥ || 21 ||
vasete ca yathānyāyaṃ velāmiva mahodadhiḥ ||
evaṃ tayorgataḥ kālo varṣāṇāṃ saptasaptatiḥ || 22 ||
na budhyatostathātmānaṃ mama māyāvimohitau ||
evaṃ tau viharantau tu tasminnupavane tataḥ || 23 ||
dṛṣṭvā vyālīṃ rājaputrastato hantuṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||
sa tayā vāryamāṇo'pi vyālī hantumihodyataḥ || 24 ||
garuḍo hanti nāgānvai dṛṣṭvaiva vinatātmajaḥ ||
evaṃ sa vāryamāṇo'pi vyālīṃ hanti sma dāruṇam || 25 ||
tadā sā ruṣitā devī na kiñcidapi bhāṣate ||
tatastasyāṃ tu velāyāṃ rājaputryagrato bilāt || 26 ||
nakulastu vinirgatya āhārārthaṃ samudyataḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā tu rājaputrī sā nakulaṃ sarpakāṃkṣiṇam || 27 ||
hṛṣṭaṃ caṃkramamāṇaṃ sā nakulaṃ śubhadarśanam ||
krodhāttaṃ nakulaṃ cāpi vinihantuṃ pracakrame || 28 ||
vāritā rājaputreṇa sutā prājyotiṣasya vai ||
nakulaṃ ghātitaṃ dṛṣṭvā maṅgalyaṃ śubhadarśanam || 29 ||
kupito rājaputro vai rājaputrīmabhāṣata ||
strīṇāṃ bharttā sadā mānyastaṃ māmullaṅghya niṣṭhuram || 30 ||
darśanīyaḥ priyo rājñāṃ maṅgalyaḥ śubhadarśanaḥ ||
ghātito nakulaḥ kasmānmayā vai vāryamāṇayā || 31 ||
iti bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā prāgjyotiṣasutā tadā ||
pratyuvāca tataḥ krodhātkosalādhipateḥ sutam || 32 ||
asakṛdvāryamāṇo'pi vyālī ghātitavānyataḥ ||
tasmānmayāpi nakulo ghātitaḥ sarpaghātakaḥ || 33 ||
rājaputryā vacaḥ śrutvā rājaputrastato'bravīt ||
vāgbhiḥ sa kaṭukābhiśca tarjjayanniva tāṃ dhare || 34 ||
sarpastīvraviṣo bhadre tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro durāsadaḥ ||
daśate mānuṣaṃ duṣṭo yenā'sau mriyate janaḥ || 35 ||
tasmānmayā hato bhadre'hitakārī viṣoddhataḥ ||
prajāpālā vayaṃ bhadre ye'pi caivāpathe sthitāḥ || 36 ||
sarvāṃstāndaṇḍayāmo hi tīvradaṇḍairyathocitam ||
sādhūnye cāpi hiṃsanti hyaparādhavivarjjitān || 37 ||
striyaṃ caivāpi hiṃsanti kāmakārāśca ye narāḥ ||
te daṇḍyāścaiva vadhyāśca rājadharmādyathārhataḥ || 38 ||
mayāpi rājadharmo vai karttavyo rājakarmaṇi ||
nakulenāparāddhaṃ kiṃ tadvada tvaṃ mamāpi hi || 39 ||
darśanīyaḥ surūpaśca rājñāṃ yogyo gṛheṣu ca ||
maṅgalyaśca pavitraśca nakulaḥ kiṃ hatastvayā || 40 ||
vāryamāṇo'pi hi mayā ghātito nakulastataḥ ||
tato mama na bhāryāsi na cāhaṃ te patiḥ sthitaḥ ||41 ||
kiñca tena na hanmi tvāṃ striyo'vadhyāḥ tadaiva yat ||
ityuktvā rājaputrastāṃ nivṛtya nagaraṃ prati || 42 ||
evaṃ krodhaṃ samādāya naṣṭasnehaiḥ parasparam ||
evaṃ gacchati kāle vai kosalāyāṃ janādhipaḥ || 43 ||
śṛṇoti tāṃ kathāṃ sarvāṃ vadhaṃ nakulasarpayoḥ ||
evaṃ śrutvā yathānyāyaṃ sakrodhau tāvubhāvapi || 44 ||
tataḥ kañcukinaścaiva svāmātyānagrataḥ sthitān ||
putraṃ mama vadhūṃ caiva samānayata satvaram || 45 ||
tato vai rājabhṛtyāstu rājño vai priyakāriṇaḥ ||
rājājñāṃ tāṃ puraskṛtya vadhūṃ putraṃ ca sādaram || 46 ||
ānīya darśayāmāsuryatra rājā svayaṃ sthitaḥ ||
vadhūputrau tato dṛṣṭvā rājā vacanamabravīt || 47 ||
putra kutra gataṃ prema yuvayostatsamāhitam ||
snehaśca kva gataḥ pūrvo viruddhācaraṇau katham || 48 ||
āsīdyā yuvayoḥ prītiranyo'nyaṃ jatukāṣṭhavat ||
darpaṇe pratibimbaṃ ca dṛśyate yadvadātmanaḥ || 49||
sanmukhatvena ca sadā tadvadvāṃ yā'bhavatpurā ||
dakṣā suśīlā dharmiṣṭhā naināṃ tyaktuṃ tvamarhasi ||50||
apriyaṃ noktapūrvaṃ tu yayā parijane'pi ca ||
miṣṭānnasādhane dakṣā tvayā tyaktaṃ na yujyate || 51 ||
dhanapūrvastu te dharmaḥ sa ca yoṣitkṛtaḥ khalu ||
aho satyaṃ janānāṃ ca sa tu strībhyaḥ sutaḥ kulam || 52 ||
tataḥ piturvacaḥ śrutvā rājaputro yaśasvini||
ubhau taccaraṇau gṛhya pitaraṃ pratyabhāṣata ||53||
doṣo na vidyate tāta snuṣāyāṃ ko'pi kutracit ||
kiṃ me tu vāryamāṇāpi nakulaṃ me'grato'hanat || 54 ||
tato'bhavanmama krodho dṛṣṭvā pātitamagrataḥ ||
krodhāsaktena tu mayā yatheyaṃ paribhāṣitā || 55 ||
mama bhāryā na bhavatī na cāhaṃ tava vai patiḥ ||
etacca kāraṇaṃ nānyatkiñcidrājanna saṃśayaḥ || 56||
tataḥ pativacaḥ śrutvā prāgjyotiṣakulodbhavā ||
śirasā praṇatiṃ kṛtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 57 ||
aparādhavihīnaśca bhītaśca bhujagastathā ||
śataśo vāryamāṇena śīghrameva nipātitaḥ || 58||
tataḥ sarpavadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kodhasaṃtaptamānasā ||
nābhāṣitaḥ kimapi no mayaitadavadhehi vai || 59 ||
vadhūputravacaḥ śrutvā kosalānāṃ janeśvaraḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyamubhayorjanasaṃsadi || 60 ||
anena nihataḥ sarpastvayā ca nakulo hataḥ ||
kathaṃ vā kriyate krodhastanme vaktumihārhatha || 61 ||
hate tu nakule putra kiṃ te krodhasya kāraṇam ||
rājaputri hate sarpe kiṃ vā te manyukāraṇam || 62 ||
tataḥ piturvacaḥ śrutvā kosaleśvaranaṃdanaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ rājaputro mahayaśāḥ || 63 ||
etena kiṃ vā praśnena naitatpraṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi ||
enāṃ pṛccha mahārāja jñāsyate kāyaceṣṭitam || 64 ||
putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kosalānāṃ janeśvaraḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ dharmasaṃyogasādhanam ||65||
brūhi putra yathānyāyaṃ yatte manasi vartate ||
prītivicchedakaraṇamubhayoriha kathyatām || 66 ||
jātāḥ samvardhitāḥ putrāḥ sarvakāmeṣu niṣṭhitāḥ ||
pitṛpṛṣṭaṃ tu yadguhyaṃ gopayaṃti sutādhamāḥ || 67 ||
satyaṃ vā yadi vā'satyaṃ na bruvaṃti kadācana ||
pataṃti narake ghore raurave taptavāluke || 68 ||
pitrā pṛṣṭaṃ tu ye brūyuḥ śubhaṃ vāśubhameva vā ||
divyāṃ ca te gatiṃ yāṃti yā gatiḥ satyavādinām || 69 ||
avaśyameva tadvākyaṃ vaktavyaṃ mama sannidhau ||
yasya doṣeṇa te putra naṣṭā prītirguṇākarā || 70 ||
tataḥ piturvacaḥ śrutvā kosalānandivarddhanaḥ ||
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā tatraiva janasaṃsadi || 71 ||
gacchatveṣa janaḥ sarvo yathānyāyaṃ gṛhāṇi vai ||
prātastvāṃ kathayiṣyāmi yadvaktavyamavaśyakam ||72||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ duṃdubhīnāṃ vinādanaiḥ ||
nibuddhaḥ kosalaśreṣṭhaḥ sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ || 73 ||
tadā kamalapatrākṣo rājaputro mahāyaśāḥ ||
snātvā ca maṅgalairyukto rājadvāramupāgataḥ || 74 ||
tatastu kaṃcukī gatvā rājñe caiva nyavedayat ||
dvāri tiṣṭhati putraste tava darśanalālasaḥ || 79 ||
kaṃcukestu vacaḥ śrutvā kosalānāṃ janeśvaraḥ ||
śīghraṃ praveśaya sutaṃ kaṃcuke sādhuvādinam || 76 ||
ityukto rājaputraṃ tu prāveśayadanujñayā ||
rājaputraḥ piturveśma praviśya niyataḥ śuciḥ || 77 ||
vavande caraṇau mūrdhnā niṣīdeti sutaṃ tataḥ ||
tamabravītpitā jīva jayetyuktā mudānvitaḥ || 78 ||
pitṛputrau tu vijñeyau janaistvekatra saṃsthitau ||
harṣitastvāntaro bāhyaḥ kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ || 79 ||
tataḥ putraṃ prahasyāha kumāraṃ sa janādhipaḥ || ||
vada putra mahābhāga pūrvaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ mayā hi yat || 80 ||
yuvayoḥ prītivicchede kāraṇaṃ gopitaṃ hi yat ||
tato rājakumārastaṃ pitaraṃ pratyabhāṣata ||81 ||
avaśyameva vaktavyaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭhena niṣphalam ||
tadguhyaṃ hi mahārāja prītivicchedakārakam || 82 ||
yadīcchasi mahārāja śrotuṃ guhyamidaṃ mahat ||
āgaccha tāta kubjāmre mayā saha mahīpate || 83 ||
tatra te kathayiṣyāmi kosalādhipate tvaran ||
yattvayā pṛcchitaṃ hyetadguhyaṃ pūrvamaninditam || 84 ||
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājaputrasya vai nṛpaḥ ||
bāḍhamityeva tatrāha putrapremṇā samanvitaḥ || 85 ||
rājaputre gate subhru amātyānāṃ ca sannidhau ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākya ye vai tatra samāgatāḥ || 86 ||
amātyāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ me vacanaṃ kṛtaniścayam ||
kubjāmrakaṃ prati vayaṃ gacchāmastasya sādhanam || 87 ||
śīghraṃ sampādyatāṃ caiva yujyantāṃ gajavājinaḥ ||
rājño vacaste saṃśrutya tamūcuḥ kṛtameva tat || 88 ||
ityuktvā saptarātreṇa sarvaṃ sampādya sādhanam ||
gajāśvapaśuyānādikārṣāpaṇakadhenukam || 89 ||
suvarṇaratnavastrāṇi annaṃ cānyadapekṣitam ||
rājānaṃ te samāgatya siddhamityūcurīśvaram || 90 ||
tataḥ sa rājaśārdūlaḥ putramāha vasundhare ||
rājyaṃ śūnyaṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ suta || 91 ||
tataḥ piturvacaḥ śrutvā rājaputro mahāyaśāḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ gṛhītvā caraṇau pituḥ || 92 ||
kanīyāneṣa me bhrātā ekodara samudbhavaḥ ||
etasya dīyatāṃ rājyaṃ yathānyāyena cāgatam ||93 ||
putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kosalānāṃ kulodvahaḥ ||
varttamāne'pi ca jyeṣṭhe kanīyān kathamarhati || 94 ||
tataḥ piturvacaḥ śrutvā kosalāyāḥ kulodbhavaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ pitaraṃ dharmakāraṇāt || 95 ||
anujānāmi te tāta dīyamānāṃ vasundharām ||
nāsya dharmavilopastu bhuñjamānasya medinīm ||96 ||
nāhaṃ kubjāmrakaṃ gatvā nivartiṣye kadācana ||
etatsatyaṃ ca dharmaśca tāta te kathitaṃ mayā || 97 ||
putreṇa cābhyanujñātaḥ kanīyānabhiṣecitaḥ ||
sa mukhyenābhyanujñāto bhūme bhūpatisattamaḥ || 98 ||
tato dīrgheṇa kālena sthānaṃ kubjāmrakaṃ gataḥ ||
antaḥpureṇa sahitaḥ sarvadravyasamanvitaḥ || 99 ||
tatastīrthāvadhiṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānāni bhūriśaḥ ||
annavastra suvarṇāni gohastyaśvabhuvastathā || 200 ||
tato bahutithe kāle vyatīte sati dhīmatām ||
tataḥ kadācidbhūpālo rājaputramupasthitam || 1 ||
dampatyoḥ prītivicchedaṃ guhyaṃ tatsamapṛcchata ||
sthānaṃ pāvanakaṃ vatsa viṣṇoḥ pādasamāśrayam ||2||
dattāni dhanaratnāni jātastasya vidhiḥ paraḥ ||
idānīṃ brūhi satyaṃ tadyatkṛte sundarī snuṣā || 3 ||
aduṣṭakāriṇī yuktā kulaśīlaguṇānvitā ||
tvayā mithyaiva kiṃ tyaktā tadguhyaṃ vada putraka ||4||
tataḥ sa pitaraṃ prāha rātrigarcchatu supyatām ||
śvaḥ prabhāte tataḥ sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tatpunaḥ || 5 ||
tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmudite ca divākare ||
kṛtodakastu gaṅgāyāṃ kṣaumavastravibhūṣitaḥ || 6 ||
arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ māṃ caiva guruvatsalaḥ ||
pituḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vākyametadudāharat || 7 ||
ehyehi tāta gacchāmaḥ yastvaṃ guhyāni pṛcchasi ||
śṛṇu tattvena me rājanyattvayā pūrvapṛcchitam ||8||
rājaputraśca vai rājā sā ca paṅkajalocanā ||
gatvā nirmālyakūṭaṃ te yattvṛttaṃ purātanam || 9||
nirmālyaṃ tu samāsādya rājaputro mahātapāḥ ||
ubho tau caraṇau gṛhya pitaraṃ pratyabhāṣata||10||
nakulo'haṃ mahārāja vasāmi kadalītale ||
tato'haṃ kālasaṃyuktaḥ prāpto nirmālyakūṭakam || 11 ||
tatastvāśīviṣā sarpī sarpate'tra janādhipa||
bhakṣayantī sugandhāni puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca ||12||
dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ mahāvyālīṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ ||
acireṇaiva kālena tasyāṅkaṃ sahasā gataḥ||13||
tayā saha mahārāja ghoraṃ yuddhamavarttata ||
māghamāsasya dvādaśyāṃ tatra kaścinna paśyati ||14 ||
yudhyamānasya me tatra gātraṃ caiva nigūhataḥ ||
nāsāvaṃśe tayā daṣṭo bhujaṅgyā ca tadantare ||15||
mayāpi viṣadigdhena nihatā ca bhujaṃgamā ||
ubhau prāṇānparityajya ubhau paṃcatvamāgatau ||16||
mṛtau sva kāle rājendra krodhamohaparicyutau ||
jāto'haṃ tava putrastu kosalādhipateḥ priyaḥ || 17 ||
evaṃ me ghātitaḥ sarpastatkrodhavaśaniścayāt ||
etadguhyaṃ mayā rājanyattvayā pūrvapṛcchitam || 18 ||
rājaputravacaḥ śrutvā vadhūrvacanamabravīt ||
ahaṃ sarpī mahārāja purā nirmālyakūṭake || 19 ||
yudhyamānā tu tenaiva nakulena nipātitā ||
prāgjyotiṣakule jātā jātā tava vadhūstataḥ||20||
tena krodhena nṛpate mūrcchitā maraṇaṃ prati ||
ghātito nakulaścaitadguhyaṃ proktaṃ tava prabho || 21 ||
vadhūputravacaḥ śrutvā sa rājā saṃśitavrataḥ ||
māyātīrthaṃ samāsādya tataḥ paṃcatvamāgataḥ || 22 ||
rājaputro viśālākṣī rājaputrī yaśasvinī || 23 ||
pauṇḍarīke tatastīrthe te'pi paṃcatvamāgatāḥ || 24 ||
gatāste paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo janārddanaḥ ||
rājā vā rājaputraśca rājaputrī yaśasvinī || 25 ||
mama caiva prasādena tapasaśca balena ca ||
kṛtvā suduṣkaraṃ karma śvetadvīpamupāgatāḥ || 26 ||
yo'sau parijano devi kṛtvā tu sukṛtaṃ mahat ||
so'pi siddhiṃ parā prāptaḥ śvetaddvīpamupāgataḥ ||27||
eṣa te kathitā devi puṣṭiḥ kubjāmrakasya ca ||
tasya brāhmaṇamukhyasya raibhyasya kathitā mayā || 28 ||
etatpuṇyaṃ paraṃ japyaṃ cāturvarṇyena sarvadā ||
sarvakarmasu mukhyaṃ ca etadeva viśiṣyate ||29||
tejasāṃ ca mahattejastapasāṃ ca mahattapaḥ ||
etanna mūrkhamadhye tu paṭheccāpi kadācana ||30||
na paṭhedgoghnamadhye tu vedavedāṅganindake ||
na paṭhedguruvidviṣṭe na paṭhecchāstradūṣake || 31 ||
paṭhedbhāgavatānāṃ ca madhye dīkṣāvatāṃ tathā ||
ya etatpaṭhate bhūme kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ || 32 || |
tārayecca svakulajān daśapūrvāndaśāparān ||
etattu paṭhamāno vai yastu prāṇānvimuṃcati || 33 ||
caturbhujaśca jāyeta mallokeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhūme sthānaṃ kubjāmrake tathā ||
mama bhaktasukhārthāya kimanyatparipṛcchasi || 34 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre kubjāmraka māhātmye raibhyānugrahaṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 126||
atha brāhmaṇadīkṣāsūtravarṇanam ||
sūta uvāca ||
evaṃ dharmāṃstataḥ śrutvā bahumokṣārthakāraṇāt ||
pratyuvāca tato bhūmirlokanāthaṃ janārdanam || 1 ||
aho prabhāvaḥ kṣetrasya kathyamāno'tipuṣkalam ||
ahaṃ bhārabharākrāntā laghurjātāsmi dhāvatī || 2 ||
vimohā ca viśuddhā ca śṛṇvānāhaṃ tvimāṃ prabho ||
ahaṃ lokeṣu vikhyātā mukhāttava vinissṛtā || 3 ||
punaḥ pṛcchāmi te deva saṃśayaṃ dharmasaṃhitam ||
yena dharmavidhānena dīkṣā prāpyate puṣkalā ||4||
etanme paramaṃ guhyaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ ca me ||
dharmasaṃgrahaṇārthāya tadbhavānvaktumarhasi || 5 ||
tato mahīvacaḥ śrutvā meghadundubhiniḥsvanaḥ ||
varāharūpī bhagavānpratyuvāca vasundharām || 6 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi mama dharmaṃ sanātanam ||
devā etanna jānanti ye ca yogavrate sthitā| || 7 ||
etaṃ dharmaṃ varārohe maṅgalyaṃ mukhaniḥsṛtam ||
ahameko vijānāmi madbhaktā ye janā bhuvi || 8||
yacca pṛcchasi me bhadre dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ kathām ||
tacchṛṇuṣva varārohe karmasaṃsāramokṣaṇam ||9||
mayoktāṃ labhate kaściddīkṣāṃ caiva sukhāvahām ||
cāturvarṇyavidhānena tāṃ dīkṣāṃ śṛṇu sundari || 10 ||
haranti manujā yena garbhasaṃsārasāgarāt ||
mayi śāntaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā tadutkṛṣṭaṃ ca sundari || 11 ||
abhigacchedguruṃ devi śādhi śiṣyo'smi māṃ guro ||
tadājñāṃ tu puraskṛtya dīkṣādravyānathāharet || 12 ||
lājā madhu kuśāścaiva ghṛtaṃ cāmṛtasannibham ||
gandhaṃ sumanaso dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ prāpaṇakādikam || 13 ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca pālāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ caiva kamaṇḍalum ||
ghaṭaṃ vāsaḥ pāduke ca śuklayajñopavītakam || 14 ||
yantrikāmarghapātraṃ ca carusthālīṃ sadarvikām ||
tilavrīhiyavāṃścaiva vividhaṃ ca phalodakam || 15 ||
bhakṣyabhojyānnapānaṃ ca karmaṇyāṃścaiva saṃcayān ||
dīkṣitā yadi bhuñjanti mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ || 16 ||
yāni kāni ca bījāni ratnāni vividhāni ca ||
kāṃcakādīni suśroṇi tāniṃ śīghramupāharet || 17 ||
etānyevopahāryāṇi gurumūle tataḥ param ||
snātvā maṅgalasaṃyukto dīkṣākāmaśca brāhmaṇaḥ || 18 ||
gurostu caraṇau gṛhya brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ||
tatastu gurvanujñāto vediṃ kuryācca puṣkalām || 19 ||
brāhmaṇo dīkṣamāṇastu caturasrāṃ tu ṣoḍaśahastāṃ kṛtvā tatra ca kalaśopari yuñjet || 20 ||
pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānena dhānyoparidṛḍhaṃ navam ||
jalena pūritaṃ mantraiḥ puṣpapallavaśobhitam || 21 ||
tasyopari tilaiḥ pūrṇapātraṃ sthāpya vidhānataḥ ||
pūjayenmāṃ guruṃ dravyaiḥ śiṣyeṇaivopakalpitaiḥ || 22 ||
tatrārcanavidhiṃ kṛtvā gurudharmaviniścayaḥ ||
pūrvoktāni ca dravyāṇi vedimadhyamupāharet || 23 ||
caturaḥ kalaśāndadyāccatuṣpārśveṣu sundari || 
vāripūrṇāndvijāñchuddhānsahakāravibhūṣitān || 24 ||
sarvataḥ śuklasūtreṇa veṣṭayeta tathānaghe ||
pūrṇa pātrāṇi catvāri catuṣpārśveṣu sthāpayet || 25 ||
evaṃ mantraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyāddīkṣāprayojakaḥ ||
sa ca mantro yathānyāyaṃ yena vā tuṣyate guruḥ || 26 ||
yathānyāyaṃ ca saṃgṛhya gurukarmaviniścitaḥ ||
prapadyāvasathaṃ viṣṇordīkṣāṇāṃ parikāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 27 ||
upaspṛśya yathānyāyaṃ bhūtvā pūrvamukhastataḥ ||
sarvāṃstu śrāvayecchiṣyāndīkṣaṇārthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 28 ||
yastu bhāgavatāndṛṣṭvā svayaṃ bhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ||
abhyutthānaṃ na kurvīta tenāhaṃ tu vihiṃsitaḥ || 29 ||
kanyāṃ dattvā punastāṃstu karmaṇā nopapādayet ||
aṣṭau pitṛgaṇāstena hiṃsitā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 30 ||
bhāryāṃ priyasakhīṃ yastu sādhvīṃ hiṃsati nirghṛṇaḥ ||
na tena tāṃ prāpnuvanti hiṃsakā duṣṭayonijāḥ || 31 ||
brahmaghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca goghnaśca kṛtapātakāḥ ||
etāñchiṣyān vivarjeta uktā ye cānyapātakāḥ || 32 ||
bilvavṛkṣodumbarau ca tathā cānye kadācana ||
karmaṇyāścaiva ye vṛkṣā na cchettavyāḥ kadācana || 33 ||
yadīcchetparamāṃ siddhiṃ mokṣadharmaṃ sanātanam ||
bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca taṃ śiṣyaṃ veditavyaṃ tadantare || 34 ||
karīrasya vadhaḥ śastaḥ phalānyaudumbarasya ca ||
sadyobhakṣā bhavettena abhakṣyā pūtivāsikā || 35 ||
na bhakṣaṇīyaṃ vārāhaṃ māṃsaṃ matsyāśca sarvaśaḥ ||
abhakṣyā brāhmaṇairete dīkṣitaiśca na saṃśayaḥ ||36||
parīvādaṃ na kurvīta na hiṃsāṃ vā kadācana ||
paiśunyaṃ na ca karttavyaṃ stainyaṃ vāpi kadācana || 37 ||
atithiṃ cāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā dūrādhvānaṃ gataṃ kvacit ||
saṃvibhāgastu karttavyo yena kenāpi putraka ||38||
gurupatnī rājapatnī brāhmaṇastrī kadācana ||
manasāpi na gantavyā evaṃ viṣṇuḥ prabhāṣate || 39 ||
kanakādīni ratnāni yauvanasthā ca kāminī ||
tatra cittaṃ na kartavyamevaṃ viṣṇuḥ prabhāṣate || 40 ||
dṛṣṭvā parasya bhāgyāni ātmano vyasanaṃ tathā ||
tatra manyurna karttavyaṃ evaṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 41 ||
evaṃ tataḥ śrāvayīta dīkṣākāmaṃ vasundhare ||
chatraṃ copānahaṃ caiva manasā copakalpayet ||42||
dve dve audumbarasya patre vedimadhye tu sthāpayet ||
kṣuraṃ caiva varārohe jalapūrṇaṃ ca bhājanam || 43 ||
mamāvāhanapūrvaṃ tu mantreṇa vidhinārcayet ||
mantraḥ -
oṃ sapta sāgarāśca saptadvīpāni sapta pavartāśca daśa svargasahasrāśca samastāśca namo'stu sarvāste hṛdaye vasanti||
yaścaitadvarṣati punarunnamati||44||
oṃ bhagavanvāsudeva mamaitatsāraya yuktaṃ varāharūpasṛṣṭena pṛthivyāṃ tu mantrānusmaraṇaṃ ca ājñāpayānubhāvanāsmākamājñaptamanucintayitvā bhagavannāgaccha dīkṣākāmaviprastvatprasādāttu dīkṣati || 45 ||
etanmantramudāhṛtya śirasā jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatena bhavitavyam || 46 ||
oṃ svāgataṃ svāgatavāniti || 47 ||
tata etena mantreṇa ānayitvā vasundhare ||
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ mantreṇa vidhiniścayāt ||48||
mantraḥ -
akṛtaghne devānasurākṛtaghnarudreṇa brāhmaṇāya ca labdhaṃ sarvamimāṃ bhagavate'stu dattaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva ca lokanātha || 49 ||
evaṃ bhūme tato dattvā arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca karmaṇā||
kṣuraṃ gṛhītvā yathānyāyamimaṃ mantra mudīrayet ||50 ||
mantraḥ -
evaṃ varuṇaḥ pātu śiṣya te vapataḥ śiraḥ ||
jalena viṣṇuyuktena dīkṣā saṃsāramokṣaṇam||51||
ekasya kalaśaṃ dadyātkarmakārasya sundari ||
niṣkalaṃ tu śiraḥ kṛtvā śoṇitena vivarjitam ||52||
punaḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śīghrameva na saṃśayaḥ||
etasya vidhivatkṛtvā dīkṣākāmasya sundari||53||
dattvā saṃsāramokṣāya sarvakāmaviniścitaḥ||
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet|| 54||
mantraḥ -
oṃ vedāmyahaṃ bhāgavatāṃśca sarvān sudīkṣitā ye guravaśca sarve ||
viṣṇuprasādena ca labdhadīkṣā mama prasīdantu namāmi sarvān ||55|
natvā tu bhagavadbhaktān prajvālya ca hutāśanam ||
ghṛtena madhumiśreṇa lājākṛṣṇatilaistathā ||56||
saptavārāṃstato dattvā viṃśatiṃ ca tilodanam ||
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā imaṃ mantramudāharet||57|| 
mantraḥ -
aśvinau diśaḥ somasūryau sākṣimātraṃ vayaṃ prasannāḥ śṛṇvantu me satyavākyaṃ vadāmi ||58||
satyena dhāryate bhūmirbhūmiḥ satyena tiṣṭhati ||
satyena gacchate sūryo vāyuḥ satyena vāti ca||59 ||
evaṃ satyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇā vīkṣaṇaṃ punaḥ||
guruṃ prasādeyattatra mantreṇa vidhinārccayan || 60 ||
tisraḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā devaṃ bhāgavataṃ gurum ||
gurupādau tu saṃgṛhya imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 61 ||
mantraḥ -
gurudevaprasādena labdhā dīkṣā yadṛcchayā ||
yaccaivāpakṛtaṃ kiṃcidgururmarṣayatāṃ mama || 62 ||
evaṃ prasādayitvā tu śiṣyo mantreṇa sundari ||
vedimadhye sthāpayitvā bhūtvā pūrvamukhastataḥ || 63 ||
śiṣyameva yato dṛṣṭvā gṛhītvā ca kamaṇḍalum ||
śuklayajñopavītaṃ ca imaṃ mantramudāharet || 64 ||
mantraḥ -
viṣṇuprasādena gato'si siddhiṃ prāptā ca dīkṣā sakamaṇḍaluśca ||
gṛhītvā tu karābhyāṃ yukto'si karmaṇā kriyāyāṃ caiva || 65 ||
tato mukhapadaṃ kṛtvā dīkṣito guruṇā tathā ||
sarvapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā imaṃ mantramudāharet || 66 ||
adho'dho bhūtvā yadyahaṃ bhrāmyallam̐bdho gururviṣṇudīkṣā ca labdhā ||
tava prasādācca guro yathā ca || 67 ||
etena mantreṇa mukhapadaṃ kārayet ||
śaucaseke vai kuryāddevāntantuvāsasam || 68 ||
evaṃ vai vāsa ādatte gṛhṇa vatsa kamaṇḍalum ||
imaṃ lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ śodhanaṃ sarvakarmasu || 69 ||
mantraḥ -
gṛhṇīṣva gandhapātrāṇi sarvagandhaṃ sukhocitam ||
sarvavaiṣṇavakaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam || 70 ||
madhuparkaṃ gṛhītvā ca tvimaṃ mantramudīrayet ||
mantraḥ -
gṛhāṇa madhuparkaṃ ca prārthakāya viśodhanam || 71 ||
tato gṛhītvā caraṇau guroryatnātsutoṣayet ||
śirasā cāñjaliṃ kṛtvā manaścaiva susaṃyatam ||
gurūpadiṣṭaṃ sandhārya imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 72 ||
mantraḥ -
śṛṇvantu me bhāgavatāstu sarve guruśca me sarvakāmakṣayaṃ cakāra ||
ahaṃ śiṣyo dāsabhūtastathaiva devasamo guruśca me tathopapannam || 73 ||
eṣāgame brāhmaṇasya dīkṣā bhūme hyudāhṛtā ||
trayāṇāmatha varṇānāṃ mama dīkṣāvidhīñchṛṇu || 74 ||
etenaiva vidhānena dīkṣayeta vasundhare ||
ubhau ca prāpnutāṃ siddhimācāryaḥ śiṣya eva ca || 79 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe brāhmaṇadīkṣāsūtraṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 127 ||
atha kaṅkatāñjanadarpaṇam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
kṣatriyasya pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
tyaktvā praharaṇānsarvānyatkiṃcitpūrvaśikṣitam || 1 ||
pūrvamantreṇa me bhūme tasya dīkṣāṃ ca kārayet ||
mayā ca pūrvamuktāni yāni saṃsārakāṇi ca || 2 ||
tāni sarvāṇi cānīya ekaṃ varjyaṃ yaśasvini ||
na dadyātkṛṣṇasārasya carma tatra kadācana || 3||
pālāśaṃ daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ ca dīkṣāyāṃ na tu kārayet ||
chāgasya caiva kṛṣṇasya carma tatra pradāpayet || 4 ||
āśvatthaṃ daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ tadanantaram ||
kṛtvā dvādaśahastāṃ tu vediṃ tatropalepayet || 5 ||
sarvaṃ mamoktaṃ karttavyaṃ yacca me pūrvabhāṣitam ||
evaṃ kṣatriyadīkṣāyāṃ sarvaṃ sampādya yatnataḥ || 6 ||
caraṇau mama saṃgṛhya imaṃ mantramudāharet || 7 ||
mantraḥ -
tyaktāni viṣṇo śastrāṇi tyaktaṃ sarvaṃ kṣatriyakarma sarvam ||
tyaktvā devaṃ viṣṇuṃ prapanno'tha saṃsārādvai janmanāṃ tārayasva || 8 ||
evaṃ tato vacaścoktvā kṣatriyo mama pārśvataḥ ||
ubhau ca caraṇau gṛhya imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 9 ||
mantraḥ -
nāhaṃ śastraṃ devadeva smṛśāmi parāpavādaṃ na ca deva bravīmi ||
karma karomi saṃsāramokṣaṇaṃ tvayā coktameva varāhasaṃsthān || 10 ||
tata evaṃ vaco brūte sarvaṃ caivātra pūjayet ||
vividhairgandhapatraiśca dhūpaiścaiva yathoditam || 11 ||
yathoktenaiva tānbhūme bhojayettadanantaram ||
śuddhānbhāgavatāṃścaiva evametanna saṃśayaḥ || 12 ||
eṣā vai kṣatriye dīkṣā devi saṃsāramokṣaṇam ||
matprasādena kartavyaṃ yadīcchetsiddhimuttamām || 13 ||
vaiśyasya caiva vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvena sundari ||
dīkṣā ca yādṛśī tasya yathā bhavati sundari || 14 ||
tyaktvā tu vaiśyakarmāṇi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
yathā ca labhate siddhiṃ tṛtīyā varṇasaṃsthitiḥ || 15 ||
sarvaṃ tatra samānīya yanmayā pūrvabhāṣitam ||
daśahastāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vediṃ vedavicetitaḥ || 16 ||
lepayedgomayenādau pūrvanyāyena tatra vai ||
carmaṇāpi tu chāgasya svagātraṃ pariveṣṭayet|| 17 ||
udumbaraṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare ||
śuddhabhāgavatānāṃ ca kṛtvā triḥ parivarttanam || 18 ||
jānubhyāmavaniṅgatvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 19 ||
mantraḥ -
ahaṃ hi vaiśyo bhavantamupāgataḥ pramucya karmāṇi ca vaiśyayogam ||
dīkṣā ca labdhā bhagavatprasādātprasīdatāṃ me bhavabandhamokṣaṇam || 20 ||
māmevaṃ sopi coktvā vai mama karmaprasādavān ||
gurośca caraṇau gṛhya imaṃ mantramudāharet || 21 ||
tyaktvā vai kṛṣigorakṣāvāṇijyakrayavikrayam ||
labdhā ca tvatprasādena viṣṇudīkṣā mayā'dhunā || 22 ||
devābhivādanaṃ kṛtvā puro bhāgavateṣu ca ||
paścāttu bhojanaṃ dadyādaparādhabahiṣkṛtam || 23 ||
evaṃ dīkṣā tu vaiśyānāṃ mama mārgānusāriṇām ||
yena mucyanti suśroṇi ghorasaṃsārasāgarāt || 24 ||
śūdrasyāpi pravakṣyāmi madbhaktasya varāṅgane ||
yastu dīkṣāṃ samāsādya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||25|||
sarvasaṃskāradravyāṇi mayā pūrvoditāni ca ||
dīkṣākāmasya śūdrasya śīghraṃ tāni prakalpayet || 26 ||
aṣṭahastāṃ tato devi sam̐llipya nīyatāṃ tataḥ ||
carma nīlasya chāgasya kalpayecchūdrayonaye || 27 |
daṇḍaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ dadyānnīlaṃ vastraṃ ca tasya vai ||
evaṃ gṛhītvā śūdro'pi dīkṣāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ param || 28 ||
mamaiva śaraṇaṃ gatvā imaṃ mantramudāharet ||
mantraḥ -
śūdro'haṃ śūdrakarmāṇi muktvā'bhakṣyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 29 ||
bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ tatastyaktvā tyaktvā vai śūdrakarma ca ||
evaṃ vadettato devaṃ śūdro dīkṣābhikāṃkṣiṇam || 30 ||
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo labdhasaṃjño gataspṛhaḥ ||
ubhau tau caraṇau gṛhya gurorvai tadanantaram || 31 ||
guroḥ prasādanārthāya imaṃ mantramudāharet | 32 |
mantraḥ -
viṣṇuprasāde guhyaṃ prasannātpūrvavacca labdhā caiva saṃsāramokṣaṇāya karomi karma prasīda || 33 ||
etanmantraṃ samuccārya kuryāttatra pradakṣiṇam ||
caturaśca yathānyāyaṃ punaścaivābhivādayet || || 34 ||
anantaraṃ tataḥ kuryādgandhamālyena cārcanam ||
bhojayecca yathānyāyamaparādhavivarjjitaḥ || 35 ||
dīkṣā eṣā ca śūdrāṇāmupacāraśca īdṛśaḥ ||
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ duḥkhasaṃsāramokṣaṇam || 36 ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ yathā chatraṃ pradīyate || 37 ||
brāhmaṇe pāṇḍuraṃ chatraṃ kṣatriye raktameva ca ||
vaiśyāya pītaṃ vai dadyānnīlaṃ śūdrāya dāpayet || 38 ||
sūta uvāca ||
cāturvarṇyasya śrutvā vai sā mahī saṃśitavratā ||
varāhaṃ punarapyāha natvā sā dharaṇī tadā || 39 ||
dharovāca ||
śrutā dīkṣā yathānyāyaṃ cāturvarṇyasya keśava ||
dīkṣitaiḥ kiṃ nu karttavyaṃ tava karmaparāyaṇaiḥ || 40 ||
tato mahīvacaḥ śrutvā meghadundubhiniḥsvanaḥ ||
varāharūpī bhagavānuvāca sa mahādyutiḥ || 41 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena kalyāṇi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||
sarvatra cintanīyo'haṃ guhyameva gaṇāntikam || 42 ||
nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā dharaṇī śaṃsitavratā ||
hṛṣṭatuṣṭamanāstatra śrutvā tacca mahaujasam || 43 ||
śucirbhāgavataśreṣṭhā tava karmaṇi nityaśaḥ ||
tataḥ kamalapatrākṣī bhaktā bhakteṣu vatsalā || 44 ||
karābhyāmañjaliṃ kṛtvā nārāyaṇamathābravīt || 45 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
tvadbhaktena mahābhāga vidhinā dīkṣitena ca ||
tava cintāpareṇātra kiṃ karttavyaṃ ca mādhava || 46||
kena cintayitavyastvamacintyo mānuṣaiḥ paraḥ ||
kiṃca bhāgavataiḥ kāryaṃ yathāvittaṃ na śakyate ||47||
tato bhūmyā vacaḥ śrutvā ādiravyaktasambhavaḥ ||
madhuraṃ svaramādāya pratyuvāca vasundharām || 48 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
devi tattvena vakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi||
yena cintayase cintāṃ mama karmaparāyaṇā || 49 ||
eṣā gaṇāntikā nāma dīkṣā'ṅgabījaniḥsṛtā ||
etadguhyāṃ mahābhāge mama cintāṃ vicintayet || 50 ||
dīkṣitena tu śuddhena mama niścitakarmaṇā ||
gṛhītavyaṃ viśālākṣi mantreṇa vidhinātra vai || 51 ||
yastu bhāgavato bhūtvā tadgṛhṇāti gaṇāntikām ||
janasya darśanasparśasaṃyuktāṃ vāmasaṃyutām || 52 ||
tasya dharmo na vidyeta dīkṣā tasya mahāphalā ||
yastu gṛhṇāti suśroṇi mantrapūtāṃ gaṇāntikām || 53 ||
āsurī nāma sā dīkṣā yayā dharmaḥ pravarttate ||
yasmādgaṇāntikāṃ guhyāṃ cintayecchuddhamānasaḥ || 54 ||
guhyāṃ gaṇāntikāṃ yo māṃ cintayetsa budhottamaḥ ||
janmāntarasahasrāṇi cintitā tena tena saḥ || 55 ||
grahaṇasya pravakṣyāmi yathā śiṣyāya dīyate ||
mantraṃ lokasukhārthāya tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 56 ||
kaumudasya tu māsasya mārgaśīrṣasya vāpyatha || |
vaiśākhasyāpi māsasya śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśī || 57 ||
kuryānnirāmiṣaṃ tatra dināni trīṇi niścitaḥ ||
tasmingaṇāntikaṃ grāhyaṃ mama dharmaviniścayāt || 58 ||
mamāgrato varārohe prajvālya ca hutāśanam ||
kuśairāstaraṇaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayitvā gaṇāntikam || 59 ||
tataḥ śiṣyo guruścaiva dīkṣitaḥ śuciruttamaḥ ||
namo nārāyaṇetyuktvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 60 ||
mantraḥ -
yā dhāritā pūrvapitāmahena brahmaṇyadevena bhavodbhavena ||
nārāyaṇāddakṣiṇagātrajātāṃ he śiṣya gṛhṇīṣva sa vai tvameva || 61 ||
tata etena mantreṇa gururgṛhya gaṇāntikam ||
śiṣyāya dattvā snigdhāya imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 62 ||
mantraḥ -
nārāyaṇasya dakṣiṇagātrajātāṃ svaśiṣya gṛhṇīṣva samayena devīm ||
etadvicintyāpara eva bhūtvā bhave punarbhāvanameti naiva || 63 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
snānopakalpanānteṣu kiṃ karttavyaṃ nu mādhava ||
prasādhanavidhiṃ caiva kena mantreṇa kalpayet || 64 ||
akarmaṇyena mucyeta tava karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
tato bhūmyā vacaḥ śrutvā lokanātho janārddanaḥ || 65 ||
dharmasaṃyuktavākyena pratyuvāca vasundharām || 66 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
devi tattvena vakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||
snānasyaivopacārāṇi yāni kurvanti karmmiṇaḥ || 67 ||
vṛtteṣvevopacāreṣu jalaprādhānikeṣu ca ||
kaṅkatīṃ cāñjanaṃ caiva darpaṇaṃ caiva sundari || 68 ||
yathā mantreṇa dātavyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
spṛṣṭvā tu mama gātrāṇi kṣaumavastreṇa saṃvṛtaḥ || 69 ||
añjanaṃ kaṅkatīṃ caiva śīghrameva prasādayet ||
tato jānusthito bhūtvā mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 70 ||
añjalau kaṅkatīṃ gṛhya imaṃ mantramudāharet ||71 ||
mantraḥ -
etāṃ kaṅkatīmañjalisthāṃ pragṛhya prasīda nārāyaṇa śiraḥ prasādhi hi || 72 || 
mahānubhāva viśvanetre svanetre yābhyāṃ paśyase tvaṃ trilokīm ||
lokaprabho sarvalokapradhāna eṣo janamañjanaṃ lokanātha || 73 ||
tataḥ saṃsnāpayeddevaṃ mantreṇānena suvratam || 74 ||
mantraḥ -
devadeva snānīyamidaṃ mama kalpitaṃ suvarṇakalaśaṃ gṛhāṇa prasīda eṣo'ñjalirmayā parikalpitaḥ snāhi snāhīti || 75 ||
namo nārāyaṇetyuktvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 76||
mantraḥ -
eṣā mayā mādhava tvatprasādādguruprasādācca hi mantrapūjā ||
prāptā mamaiṣā vai gaṇāntikā ca bhavedadharmo na ca me kadācita || 77 ||
ya etena vidhānena mama karmaṇi dīkṣitaḥ ||
gurorgṛhītvā mahato mama lokāya gacchati ||
kuśiṣyāya na dātavyā piśunāya śaṭhāya ca || 78 ||
eṣā caiva varārohe gṛhītvā gaṇanāntikā ||
suśiṣyāya ca dātavyā haste caiva gaṇāntikā ||79||
uttamāṣṭādhikaśataṃ paṃcāśatturyamadhyamā ||
tadarddhaṃ syātkaniṣṭhāpi parimāṇena sundari ||80||
rudrākṣairuttamā sā tu madhyamā putrajīvakaiḥ ||
jñeyā kaniṣṭhā padmākṣairdevi te kathitā mayā || 81 ||
etatkaścinna jānāti janmāntaraśatairapi ||
sarvalokahitāṃ śuddhāṃ mokṣakāmāṃ gaṇāntikām || 82 ||
nocchiṣṭaḥ saṃspṛśettāṃ tu strīṇāṃ haste na kārayet ||
ākāśe sthāpanaṃ kuryānna ca vāmena saṃspṛśet || 83 ||
na darśayecca kasyāpi cintayitvā tu pūjayet ||
etatte paramaṃ guhyamākhyātaṃ mokṣadāyakam || 84 ||
evaṃ hi vidhipūrveṇa pālayeta gaṇāntikām ||
viśuddho mama bhaktaśca mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 85 ||
evaṃ viṣṇorvacaḥ śrutvā dharaṇī saṃśitavratā ||
pratyuvāca paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ lokanāthaṃ mahaujasam || 86 ||
darpaṇaṃ te kathaṃ deyaṃ tanmamākhyāhi mādhava ||
yena tuṣṭo nijaṃ rūpaṃ paśyase cintitaḥ prabho || 87 ||
dharaṇyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā varāhaḥ punarabravīt ||
śṛṇu me darpaṇavidhiṃ yathāvaddevi suvrate ||88||
namo nārāyaṇetyuktvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 89 ||
mantraḥ -
śrutirbhāgavatī śreṣṭhā śrutī agnidvijaśca tava mukhaṃ nāse'śvinau nayane candrasūryau mukhaṃ ca candra iva gātrāṇi jagatpradhānānīmaṃ ca darpaṇaṃ paśya paśya rūpam || 90 ||
ya etena vidhānena mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
karoti mama karmāṇi tāritaṃ kulasaptakam || 91 ||
etena mantreṇa vai bhūme upacārastu īdṛśaḥ||
hṛṣṭatuṣṭena karttavyo yadīcchetparamāṃ gatim ||92||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe kaṅkatāñjanadarpaṇanāma aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||128||
atha caturvarṇadīkṣā ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
bhūṣitālaṃkṛtaṃ kṛtvā mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
śuklaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca deyaṃ navaguṇaṃ tathā||1||
śirasā cāñjaliṃ kṛtvā vasudhā punarabravīt ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
etanmāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ tadbhaktāṃ vaktumarhasi ||
sandhyāṃ vai kena mantreṇa tava karmaparāyaṇām ||
vada bhāgavatīṃ śuddhāṃ tava karmaviniścitām ||
tato bhūmivacaḥ śrutvā bhūtānāṃ prabhavo'vyayaḥ ||
varāharūpo bhagavānpratyuvāca vasundharām||
śrīvarāha uvāca||
mādhavi tattvena yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi||
kathayiṣyāmi te bhadre pravaraṃ guhyamuttamam ||
yathāvadviditaṃ bhūpaiḥ puṇyā bhāgavatāḥ śubhāḥ ||
kṛtvā tu mama karmāṇi śucisaṃsāramokṣaṇīm ||
kurvītaiva parāṃ sandhyāṃ yathāvaditi niścitam ||
jalāñjaliṃ tato gṛhya mama bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ ||
muhurtadhyāna māsthāya imaṃ mantramudāharet ||
mantraḥ - bhavodbhavamādivyaktarūpamātraṃ sarve devā brahmā rudrastvādṛksamamāsīddhyānayogasthitā te sandhyāsaṃsthā vāsudevaṃ namati vayaṃ devamādivyaktarūpamātmasaptadivasaṃ tathāpi saṃsārārthaṃ karma tatkaraṇameva sandhyāsaṃsthā vāsudeva namo'stu te||
mantrāṇāṃ paramo mantrastapatāṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ||
ācāraṃ kurute hyevaṃ mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ paramuttamam||
ya evaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ na sa pāpena lipyate||
nādīkṣitāya dātavyaṃ nopavīte kathaṃcana ||
dīkṣitāyaiva dātavyamupapanne tathaiva ca ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi devi tattvena me śṛṇu ||
na dīpamapi gṛhṇāti dattaṃ bhāgavataiḥ śubhaiḥ||
kṛtvā tu mama karmāṇi gṛhya dīpakamuttamam ||
jānusaṃsthāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā imaṃ mantramudīrayeta||
mantraḥ -
oṃ namo bhagavate'nugraha tejase viṣṇo sarvadevāstvāgnisaṃsthāḥ praviṣṭā evaṃ cāgnistava tejasā bhaviṣyati svatejasā māmāśu mantrasya tejasā saṃsārārthaṃ deva gṛhyaṃ dīpakaṃ mantraṃ mūrttimantraṃ śvo bhūtvā imaṃ karma niṣphalam ||
tatkaroti yathānyāyyaṃ dīpakaṃ dadate naraḥ ||
tāritāḥ pitarastena niṣkalāśca pitāmahāḥ ||
gandhena tilakaṃ dadyāllalāṭe mama sundari ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi karma lokasukhāvaham || 2||
yena mantreṇa dātavyaṃ lalāṭe tilakaṃ mama || 3 ||
mantraḥ -
mukhamaṇḍanaṃ cintayā vāsudeva tvayā prayuktaṃ ca mayopanītam ||
etena citraṃ kuru vāsudeva mama caivaṃ kuru saṃsāramokṣam || 4 ||
etena mantreṇa citrakaṃ me dadyāllalāṭe tilakaṃ dharitri ||
tataḥ sumanaso gṛhya imaṃ mantramudāharet || 5 ||
mantraḥ -
imāḥ sumanasaḥ saumanasyāya bhagavan sarvaṃ sumanasaṃ kuru tvayaite saumanasyāya nirmitā gṛhītāḥ svāhā || 6 ||
evaṃ sumanaso dattvā dhūpaṃ caiva nivedayet ||
tato gṛhītvā dhūpaṃ tu sugandhaṃ sumanoharam || 7 ||
namo nārāyaṇetyuktvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet ||
mantraḥ -
sugandhāni tavāṅgāni svabhāvenaiva keśava || 8 ||
amunā caiva dhūpena dhūpitāni tavā'nagha ||
tavāṅgānāṃ sugandhena sarvaṃ saugandhikaṃ kuru || 9 ||
gṛhāṇemaṃ ca me dhūpaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi yathā dīpaṃ nivedayet || 10 ||
yathāvṛttaṃ tu gṛhṇāmi mama bhaktaiḥ sukhāvaham ||
kṛtvā tu mama karmāṇi gṛhya dīpamanuttamam || 11 ||
jānusaṃsthaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 12 ||
mantraḥ -
namo bhagavate tejate viṣṇo sarve devāstvagnisaṃsthāḥ pratiṣṭhā ||
evaṃ cāgnistava tejasā pratiṣṭhito tejaścātmā svayameva || 13 ||
mantraśca -
tejaḥ saṃsārānmocayituṃ deva gṛhṇīṣva dīpaṃ dyutimantaśca ||
mūrtiśca bhūtvā idaṃ karma niṣkalam || 14 ||
māṃ karoti yathānyāyaṃ dīpakaṃ dadate naraḥ ||
tāritāḥ pitarastena niṣkalāśca pitāmahāḥ || 15 ||
nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā vismitā ca vasundharā ||
varāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ pratyuvāca vasundharā || 16 ||
śrutā mayā bhāgavatāstava karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
śeṣasaṃśravaṇārthāya mano dhāvati satpathe || 17 ||
tava prāpaṇakaṃ kṛtyaṃ keṣu pātreṣu kārayet ||
etadācakṣva tattvena yena tuṣyati mādhava || 18 ||
tato bhūmervacaḥ śrutvā lokanātho'bravīdidam ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi yāni pātrāṇi rocate || 19 ||
tāni te kathayiṣyāmi tvayā me pūrvapṛcchitam ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kāṃsyaṃ yeṣu dadyātprapāṇakam || 20 ||
sarvāṇi tāni tyaktveha tāmraṃ ca mama rocate ||
etannārāyaṇācchrutvā dharmakāmā vasundharā || 21 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ lokanāthaṃ janārddanam ||
etanme paramaṃ guhyaṃ tāmraṃ te rocate katham || 22 ||
tato bhūmervacaḥ śrutvā anādiraparājitaḥ ||
lokānāṃ pravaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pratyuvāca vasundharām || 23 ||
śṛṇu tattvena me bhūme kathyamānaṃ mayā'naghe ||
ekāgraṃ cittamādhāya yena tāmraṃ mama priyam || 24 ||
saptayugasahasrāṇi ādikāle'tha mādhavi ||
yathā tāmraṃ samutpannaṃ yathaiva priyadarśanam || 25 ||
pūrvaṃ kamalapatrākṣi guḍākeśo mahāsuraḥ ||
tāmrarūpaṃ samādāya mamaivārādhane rataḥ || 26 ||
tata ārādhitastena varṣāṇāṃ tu caturdaśa ||
sahasrāṇi viśālākṣi dharmakāmena niścalam || 27 ||
ahaṃ tu tapasā tuṣṭastīvreṇa kṛtaniścayāt ||
tatastāmramaye ramye yatra tāmrasamudbhavaḥ ||28||
dṛṣṭvāśramaṃ mahādevi kiñcideva subhāṣitam ||
tato jānusthito bhūtvā mama eṣa vicintayet || 29 ||
caturbāhuṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
praṇataḥ prāñjaliḥ prāha śiro bhūmau nidhāpya saḥ ||
taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā mayā proktaṃ prasannenāntarātmanā || 30 ||
guḍākeśa mahābhāga brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ||
toṣito'smyanayā bhaktyā durārādhyo'pi suvrata || 31 ||
yattvayā cintitaṃ saumya karmaṇā manasā girā ||
varaṃ brūhi mahābhāga tubhyaṃ yadrocate'nagha || 32 ||
evaṃ mama vacaḥ śrutvā guḍakeśo'bravīdidam ||
karābhyāmañjaliṃ kṛtvā viśuddhenāntarātmanā || 33 ||
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva samastenāntarātmanā ||
janmanāṃ tu sahasraṇi tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhā'stu me || 34 ||
cakreṇa vadhamicchāmi tvayā muktena keśava || 35 ||
cakeṇa pātitasyaitadvasāmāṃsāni kiṃ cana ||
tāmraṃ nāma bhavedeva pavitrīkaraṇaṃ śubham || 36 ||
tena pātraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śubhadharmaviniścitaḥ ||
tasminprāpaṇakaṃ kṛtvā śuddhe vai tāmrabhājane || 37 ||
nivedite parā prītirbhavatvetanmanogatam ||
prasanno yadi me deva hyeṣa me dīyatāṃ varaḥ || 38 ||
yaccintito'si deveśa ugre tapati tiṣṭhatā ||
bāḍhamityeva so'pyukto yāvallokasthitirmayā || 39 ||
tāvattāmrasthito bhūtvā mama saṃstho bhaviṣyasi ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tāmrātmā guḍākeśo vyavasthitaḥ || 40 ||
tattāmrabhājane mahyaṃ dīyate yatsupuṣkalam ||
atulā tena me prītirbhūme jānīhi suvrate || 41 ||
maṅgalyaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca tāmraṃ tena priyaṃ mama ||
tvaṃ ca drakṣyasi taccakraṃ madhyasaṃsthe divākare || 42 ||
vaiśākhasya tu māsasya śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśī ||
mama tejomayaṃ cakraṃ tvāṃ vadhiṣyatyasaṃśayam || 43 ||
eṣyase mama lokāya evametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
evamuktvā guḍākeśaṃ tatraivāntarhito'bhavam || 44 ||
cakrādvadhamabhīpsanvai so'pi matkarmaṇi sthitaḥ ||
dine dine viśiṣṭaṃ tu śubhaṃ kurvaṃstapasyati || 46 ||
viṣṇusaṃstho bhaviṣyāmi kadāhamiti cintayan||
evaṃ sthitasya tasyātha vaiśākhasya tu dvādaśī || 46 ||
śuklapakṣasya samprāptā tasyāṃ dharmaviniścitaḥ ||
viṣṇupūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prārthayāmāsa māṃ pratiṃ || 47 ||
muñca muñca prabho cakramapi vahnisamaprabham ||
ātmā me nīyatāṃ śīghraṃ nikṛttyāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ || 48 ||
tadaiva cakreṇa vipāṭito'sau prāpto'pi māṃ bhāgavatapradhānaḥ ||
tāmraṃ tu tanmāṃsamasṛk suvarṇamasthīni rūpyaṃ bahudhātavaśca ||
raṅgaṃ ca sīsaṃ trapudhātusaṃsthaṃ kāṃsyaṃ ca rītiśca malastu teṣām ||49 ||
tāmrapātreṇa vai bhūme prāpaṇaṃ yatpradīyate ||
sikthe sikthe phalaṃ tasya śṛṇuṣva gadato mama || 50 ||
etadbhāgavataiḥ kāryaṃ mama priyakaraiḥ sadā ||
evaṃ tāmraṃ samutpannamiti me rocate hi tat || 51 ||
dīkṣitairvai bhāgavataiḥ pādyārghyādau ca dīyate ||
evaṃ dīkṣāvidhiḥ prokta evaṃ tāmrasamudbhavaḥ || 52 ||
devi tattvena kathitaḥ kimanyat paripṛcchasi ||
bhūmiruvāca ||
devadeva kathaṃ sandhyāṃ dīkṣitaḥ kurute vada || 53 ||
kena mantreṇa vā bhaktastava karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu mādhavi tattvena sandhyāmantramanuttamam || 54 ||
yathā vadanti vai sūryaṃ sandhyāṃ pūrvāṃ parāṃ tathā ||
jalāñjaliṃ gṛhītvā tu mama bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ || 55 ||
muhūrttaṃ dhyānamāsthāya imaṃ mantramudīrayet ||
sikthāni tatra yāvanti tāmraprāpaṇake dhare || 56 ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi mama loke sa modate || 57||
mantraḥ -
bhavodbhavamādivyaktarūpamādityaṃ sarve devā brahmarudrendrāstvāṃ ca ||
kṛṣṇe yathāsīddhyānayogasthitāste sandhyāsaṃsthā vāsudevaṃ namanti || 58 ||
vayaṃ devamādimavyaktarūpaṃ kṛtvā cātmani deva saṃsthāstathāpi ||
saṃsārārthaṃ karma tatkaraṇameva sandhyāsaṃsthā vāsudeva namo namaḥ || 59 ||
anenaiva hi mantreṇa sandhyāṃ kuryāttu dīkṣitaḥ || 60 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe caturvarṇadīkṣātāmravarṇanaṃ nāmonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 129 ||
atha rājānnabhoge prāyaścittam ||
sūta uvāca ||
evaṃ dīkṣāṃ tataḥ śrutvā nārāyaṇamukhānmahī ||
viśuddhamānasā devī nārāyaṇamathābravīt || 1 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
aho te dīkṣāmāhātmyaṃ yasya vai vyuṣṭiruttamā ||
śrutvāhaṃ tu mahābhāga jātāsmi vimalā vibho || 2 ||
aho devasya māhātmyaṃ lokanāthasya tattvataḥ ||
yena sā kāritā dīkṣā cāturvarṇyasukhāvahā || 3 ||
ekaṃ me paramaṃ guhyaṃ yadīśa hṛdi varttate ||
bhava bhaktasukhārthāya tattvaṃ me vaktumarhasi || 4 ||
deva pūrvāparādhāste dvātriṃśadapi kīrtitāḥ ||
evaṃ kṛtvāparādhāni manujā hyalpacetasaḥ || 5 ||
karmaṇā kena śuddhyanti aparādhasya kāriṇaḥ ||
tanmamācakṣva tattvena mama prītyā ca mādhava || 6 ||
tadvai bhūmyā vacaḥ śrutvā hṛṣīkeśo mahāmanāḥ ||
divyaṃ dhyānaṃ samādāya pratyuvāca vasundharām || 7 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śuddhā bhāgavatā bhūtvā mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
ye tu bhuñjanti rājānnaṃ lobhena ca bhayena vā || 8 ||
āpadgatā hi bhuñjanti rājānnaṃ tu vasundhare ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi pacyante narake narāḥ || 9 ||
bhagavadvacanaṃ śrutvā kampitā ca vasundharā ||
dināni sapta daśa ca bhayaṃ tīvramajāyata || 10 ||
tato dīnamanā bhūtvā sā mahī saṃśitavratā ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham ||11||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me deva hṛdaye hi vyavasthitam ||
ko nu doṣo'sti rājñāṃ hi tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi ||12||
tato bhūmyā vacaḥ śrutvā sarvadharmavidāṃ varaḥ ||
prāha nārāyaṇo vākyaṃ dharmakāmāṃ vasundharām || 13 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu sundari tattvena guhyametadanindite ||
rājānnaṃ tu na bhoktavyaṃ śubhaibhārgavataiḥ sadā || 14 ||
yadyapyeṣa samatvena rājā loke pravarttate ||
rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ vāpi kurvankarma sudāruṇam || 15 ||
api vā garhitaṃ tena rājānnaṃ tu vasundhare ||
dharmasandhāraṇārthāya na tu me rocate bhuvi || 16 ||
tato yadyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
yathā rājñāṃ tu bhojyaṃ vai śuddhairbhāgavatairnaraiḥ || 17 ||
sthāpayitvā tu māṃ devi vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
dhanadhānyasamṛddhāni dattvā bhāgavatairapi || 18 ||
siddhaṃ bhāgavataiścānnaṃ mama prāpaṇaśeṣakam ||
bhuñjānastu varārohe na sa pāpena lipyate || 19 ||
evaṃ viṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvā dharaṇī saṃśitavratā ||
varāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ pratyuvāca varānanā || 20 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
rājānnaṃ tu naro bhuktvā śuddho bhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ||
karmaṇā kena śuddhyeta tanme brūhi janārdana || 21 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi yanmāṃ tvaṃ bhīru bhāṣase ||
taranti puruṣā yena rājānnasyopabhuñjakāḥ || 22 ||
ekaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā taptakṛcchraṃ ca puṣkalam ||
kuryātsāntapanaṃ caikaṃ śīghraṃ mucyanti kilbiṣāt || 23 ||
na tasya cāparādho'sti vasudhe vai vaco mama ||
evameva na bhoktavyaṃ rājānnaṃ vai kadācana ||
mamātra pūjākāmena yadīcchetparamāṃ gatim || 24 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre rājānnaprāyaścittaṃ nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 130 ||
atha dantakāṣṭhācarvaṇaprāyaścittam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
dantakāṣṭhamacarvitvā yo hi māmupasarpati ||
pūrvakālakṛtaṃ karma tena caikena naśyati || 1 ||
nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā pṛthivī dharmasaṃśritaḥ ||
viṣṇubhaktasukhārthāya hṛṣīkeśamuvāca ha || 2 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
sarvakālakṛtaṃ karma kleśena mahatā'nagha ||
kathamekāparādhena sarvameva praṇaśyati || 3 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu sundari tattvena kathyamānaṃ mayā'naghe ||
yena caikāparādhena pūrvakarma praṇaśyati || 4 ||
manuṣyaḥ kilbiṣī bhadre kaphapittasamanvitaḥ ||
pūyaśoṇitasampūrṇaṃ durgandhi mukhamasya tat || 5 ||
tatsarvabījaṃ naśyeta dantakāṣṭhasya bhakṣaṇāt ||
śuddhirbhāgavatī caiva ācāreṇa vivarjitā || 6 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
dantakāṣṭhamakhāditvā yaḥ karmāṇi karoti te ||
prāyaścittaṃ ca me brūhi yena dharmo na naśyati || 7 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
evametanmahābhāge yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||
kathayiṣyāmi hīdaṃ te yathā śuddhyanti mānavāḥ || 8||
ākāśaśayanaṃ kṛtvā dināni dve ca paṃca ca ||
abhuktadantakāṣṭhāśca evaṃ śudhyanti mānavāḥ || 9 ||
evaṃ te kathitaṃ bhadre dantakāṣṭhasya bhakṣaṇam ||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 10 ||
kutastasyāparādho'sti evameva na saṃśayaḥ || 11 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe dantakāṣṭhācarvaṇaprāyaścittaṃ nāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 131 ||
atha mṛtakasparśaprāyaścittam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
gatvā tu maithunaṃ bhadre asnāto yaḥ śavaṃ spṛśet ||
retaḥ pibati durbuddhiḥ sahasraṃ nava paṃca ca || 1 ||
varṣaṃ nārāyaṇācchrutvā sā mahī saṃśitavratā ||
tato dīnamanā bhūtvā provāca madhusūdanam || 2 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
kimidaṃ bhāṣase deva dharmaṃ bhīṣaṇasaṅkaṭam ||
kathamevaṃ pumānvai sa retaḥpānaparo bhavet || 3 ||
etanme paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi idaṃ guhyamanuttamam ||4||
cihnamaitadvarārohe ādhicāraviniścayaḥ||
puruṣaḥ strīṣu karmāṇi yo vikurvīta nirghṛṇaḥ ||5||
dṛṣṭaṃ tasyāparādhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
evametadvarārohe yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || 6 ||
aparādhasya doṣeṇa viśuddhiśca na jāyate ||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi rāgadoṣeṇa doṣitam || 7 ||
gṛhasthāḥ puruṣā bhadre mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
yāvakena trayaṃ kṣiptvā piṇyākena dinatrayam || 8 ||
vāyubhakṣaṃ dinaṃ tvekaṃ tato mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
ya evaṃ kurute bhūme vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 9 ||
jñātvā karmāparādhaṃ tu na sa pāpena lipyate ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre mithunaṃ yo'bhigacchati || 10 ||
prāyaścittaṃ mahābhāge mama lokasukhāvaham ||
spṛṣṭvā tu mṛtakaṃ bhadre naraṃ paṃcatvamāgatam || 11 ||
mama śāstraṃ bahiṣkṛtya yaḥ śmaśānaṃ prapadyate ||
pitarastasya suśroṇi ātmanaśca pitāmahāḥ || 12 ||
śmaśāne jambukā bhūtvā bhakṣayanti śavān tathā ||
tato harevarcaḥ śrutvā dharmakāmā vasundharā || 13 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ sarvalokahitāya vai ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
tava nātha prapannānāṃ kva pāpaṃ vidyate prabho || 14||
prāyaścittaṃ ca me brūhi yena mucyanti kilbiṣāt ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu sundari tattvena yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||15||
kathayiṣyāmi te hīdaṃ śobhanaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
ekāhāro dinānsapta trirātraṃ cāpyupoṣitaḥ || 16 ||
paṃcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā tato mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
śave spṛṣṭe'parādhasya eṣa te kathito vidhiḥ || 17 ||
sarvathā varjanīyaṃ vai sarvabhāgavatena tu ||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||18||
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo nāparādho'sti tasya vai ||
nārīṃ rajasvalāṃ spṛṣṭvā yo māṃ spṛśati nirbhayaḥ ||19||
rāgamohena saṃyuktaḥ kāmena ca vaśīkṛtaḥ||
varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasraikaṃ rajaḥ pibati nirghṛṇaḥ ||20 ||
andhaśca jāyate devi daridro jñānamūrkhavān||
na ca vindati cātmānaṃ patito narake yathā ||21||
aparādhamimaṃ kṛtvā tatraivaṃ nāsti saṃśayaḥ ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
tava deva prapannānāṃ mokṣaṃ saṃsārasāgarāt || 22 ||
aparādhasamāyuktastava karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
karmaṇā yena śudhyeta tanme brūhi janārdana || 23 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
spṛṣṭvā rajasvalāṃ nārīṃ naro madbhaktitatparaḥ ||
tapaḥ kṛtvā trirātraṃ tu ākāśaśayane vaset || 24 ||
śuddho bhāgavato bhūtvā mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
evaṃ kṛtvā mahābhāge prāyaścittaṃ mama priyam || 25 || |
mucyate kilbiṣāddevi ācāreṇa bahiṣkṛtaḥ ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre yatspṛṣṭvā tu rajasvalām || 26 ||
spṛṣṭvā tu mṛtakaṃ devi yo matkṣetreṣu tiṣṭhati ||
śatavarṣasahasrāṇi garbheṣu parivarttate || 27 ||
daśavaṣarsahasrāṇi caṇḍālaścaiva jāyate ||
andhaḥ saptasahasrāṇi maṇḍūkaśca śataṃ samāḥ ||28||
makṣikā trīṇi varṣāṇi ṭiṭṭibhaikādaśaṃ samāḥ ||
daṃśo vai sapta cānyāni kṛkalāso bhavetsamāḥ || 29 ||
hastī varṣaśataṃ caiva kharo dvātriṃśakaṃ bhavet ||
mārjāro navavarṣāṇi vānaro daśapañca ca || 30 ||
evaṃ sa cātmadoṣeṇa mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
prāpnoti sumahadduḥkhaṃ devi caivaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||31||
tato harervacaḥ śrutvā duḥkhena paripṛcchati ||
sarvasaṃsāramokṣāya pratyuvāca vasundharā || 32 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
kimidaṃ bhāṣase deva mānuṣāṇāṃ durāsadam ||
vākyaṃ bhīṣaṇamatyantaṃ mama marmaprabhedakam || 33 ||
ācārācca paribhraṣṭastavakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
yathā tarati durgāṇi prāyaścittaṃ tathā vada || 34 ||
śrutvā pṛthvyāstathā vākyaṃ lokanātho janārddanaḥ ||
dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya pratyuvāca vasundharām || 35 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
spṛṣṭvā tu mṛtakaṃ bhūme mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
ekāhāraṃ tatastiṣṭheddināni daśa pañca ca || 36 ||
tata evaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā pañcagavyaṃ tu prāśayet ||
śuddhabhāvaṃ viśuddhātmā karmaṇā ca na lipyate || 37 ||
etatte kathitaṃ devi spṛṣṭvā mṛtakameva ca ||
doṣaṃ caiva viśuddhyarthaṃ yattvayā pūrvapṛcchitam || 38 ||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||
aparādhavimukto vai mama lokaṃ sa gacchati|| 39 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe mṛtakasparśanaprāyaścittaṃ nāma dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 132 ||
atha pūjāsāmayikagudaravapurīṣotsarjanayoḥ prāyaścittam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
spṛśamānena māṃ bhūme vātakarma pramucyate ||
evañca puruṣo yukto vāyupīḍitamānasaḥ || 1 ||
makṣikā pañca varṣāṇi trīṇi varṣāṇi mūṣakaḥ ||
śvā caiva trīṇi varṣāṇi kūrmo vai jāyate nava || 2 ||
eṣa vai tāpanaṃ devi mohanaṃ mama sāṃpratam ||
yo vai śāstraṃ vijānāti mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 3 ||
śrutvā vākyaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ pratyuvāca vasundharā ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
atulaṃ labhate pāpaṃ tava karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 4 ||
tasya deva sukhārthāya viśuddhiṃ vaktumarhasi ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu kārtsnyena me devi kathyamānaṃ mayā'naghe || 5 ||
aparādhamimaṃ kṛtvā santaredyena karmaṇā ||
pāvakena dinaṃ trīṇi naktāni ca punastrayaḥ || 6 ||
karma caivaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sa ca me nāparādhyati ||
sarvasaṅgaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 7 ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre mahākarmāparādhinaḥ ||
doṣaṃ caiva guṇaṃ caiva yattvayā paripṛcchitam || 8 ||
śṛṇu tattvena me bhūme kathyamānaṃ mayā'naghe ||
purīṣaṃ mucyate yastu mama karma samācaran || 9 ||
divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu raurave narake vaset ||
purīṣaṃ bhakṣayettatra mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 10 ||
prāyaścittaṃ vadāmyatra yena mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
mama karmaparibhraṣṭo vihvalenāntarātmanā || 11 ||
ekāṃ jalamayīṃ śayyāmekāmākāśaśāyinīm ||
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ tu so'parādhātpramucyate || 12 ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre purīṣaṃ yaḥ samutsṛjet ||
madbhakteṣu viśālākṣi aparādhaviniścayaḥ || 13 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe pūjāsamaye gudaravapurīṣotsargayoḥ prāyaścittaṃ nāma trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||133||
atha pūjādisāmayikāparādheṣu prāyaścittāni ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
muktvā tu mama karmāṇi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
prāyaścittavidhiṃ devi yastu vākyaṃ prabhāṣate || 1 ||
mūrkho bhavati suśroṇi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
prāyaścittavidhiṃ devi yena mucyeta kilbiṣāt || 2 ||
ākāśaśayanaṃ kṛtvā dināni daśa pañca ca ||
mucyate kilbiṣāttatra devi caiva na saṃśayaḥ || 3 ||
iti maunatyāgaprāyaścittam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
bhūṣito nīlavastreṇa yo hi māmupapadyate ||
varṣāṇāṃ hi śataṃ pañca kṛmirbhūtvā sa tiṣṭhati || 4 ||
tasya vakṣyāmi suśroṇi aparādhaviśodhanam ||
prāyaścittaṃ viśālākṣi yena mucyeta kilbiṣāt || 5 ||
vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
mucyate kilbiṣādbhūme evametanna saṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
avidhānena saṃspṛśya yo hi māmupasarpati ||
sa mūrkhaḥ pāpakarmā ca mama vipriyakārakaḥ || 7 ||
tena dattaṃ varārohe gandhamālyasugandhitam ||
prāpaṇaṃ ca na gṛhṇāmi mṛṣṭaṃ cāpi kadācana || 8 ||
tato nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā sā saṃśitavratā ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ dharmakāmā vasundharā || 9 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
yanmāṃ tvaṃ bhāṣase nātha ācārasya vyatikramam ||
upaspṛśya samācāraṃ rahasyaṃ vaktumarhasi || 10 ||
kena karmavidhānena bhūtvā bhāgavatā bhuvi ||
upaspṛśyopasarpanti tava karmaparāyaṇāḥ || 11 ||
etanme saṃśayaṃ deva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||
tava bhaktasukhārthāya niṣkalaṃ vaktumarhasi || 12 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi yanmāṃ tvaṃ bhīru bhāṣase ||
kathitaṃ mama tattvena guhyametatparaṃ mahat || 13 ||
vimucya sarvakarmāṇi yo hi māmupasarpati ||
tasya vai śṛṇu suśroṇi upaspṛśya ca yā kriyā || 14 ||
bhūtvā pūrvamukhastatra pādau prakṣālya cāmbubhiḥ ||
upaspṛśya yathānyāyaṃ tisro vai gṛhya mṛttikāḥ || 15 ||
tataḥ prakṣālitaṃ hastaṃ jalena tadanantaram ||
saptakośaṃ tato gṛhya jalena kṣālayettataḥ || 16 ||
pādamekaikaśastadvatpaṃca pañca vadettataḥ ||
kośau saṃmṛjyatāṃ tatra yadīcchettu mama priyam || 17 ||
trīṇi kośānpibettatra sarvapāpaviśodhanam ||
mukhaṃ karābhyāṃ mārjeta sarvamindriyanigraham || 18 ||
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mama cintāparāyaṇaḥ ||
karmaṇā vidhidṛṣṭena kuryātsaṃsāramokṣaṇam ||19||
trīṇi vārānspṛśettatra śiro brahmaṇi saṃsthitaḥ ||
trīṇi vārānpunastatra ubhe te karṇanāsike || 20 ||
spṛśettu niṣkalastatra yo hi yatra pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
vikṣipettrīṇi vārāṇi salilaṃ pravaraṃ trayam || 21 ||
evamuktasya karttavyaṃ mamābhigamaneṣu ca ||
upaspṛśya tanuṃ vāme yadīkṣeta priyaṃ mama || 22 ||
evaṃ ca kurvatastasya mama karmavyavasthitaḥ ||
aparādhaṃ na vindeta evaṃ devi na saṃśayaḥ || 23 ||
tato nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā devī vasundharā ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ sarvabhāgavatapriyam ||24||
dharaṇyuvāca||
upaspṛśya vidhānena yastu karmāṇi cāpnuyāt ||
tāpanaṃ śodhanaṃ caiva tadbhavānvaktumarhati||25||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me bhūme imaṃ guhyamanindite ||
yāṃ gatiṃ ca prapadyante mama karmabahiṣkṛtāḥ || 26 ||
vyabhicāraṃ ca me kṛtvā yaśca māmupasarpati ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca || 27 ||
kṛmirbhūtvā yathānyāyyaṃ tiṣṭhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi tasya mūrkhasya mādhavi || 28 ||
yacca kṛtvā mahābhāge kṛtakṛtyaḥ punarbhavet ||
mahāsāntapanaṃ kṛtvā taptakṛcchraṃ ca niṣkalam || 29 ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo mama ye ca mate sthitāḥ ||
anena vidhinā kṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ yaśasvini || 30 ||
kilbiṣāttu pramuktāste gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ||
yastu krodhasamāviṣṭo mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 31 ||
spṛśeta mama gātrāṇi cittaṃ kṛtvā calācalam ||
na cāhaṃ rāgamicchāmi kruddhameva yaśasvini || 32 ||
icchāmi ca sadā dāntaṃ śubhaṃ bhāgavataṃ śucim ||
paṃcendriyasamāyuktaṃ lābhālābhavivarjitam || 33 ||
ahaṅkāravinirmuktaṃ kamarṇyabhirataṃ mama ||

dharaṇyuvāca ||

śrutvā sudustaraṃ sāraṃ bhītāsmi paridevitā ||

sanatkumāro yogajñaḥ pratyuvāca vasundharām || 45 ||

tato māṃ bhāṣate brahmanviṣṇurmāyākaraṇḍakaḥ ||

ya etena vidhānena brahmakarmāṇi kārayet || 52 ||

śīghramārādhayedviṣṇuṃ dvijamukhyo na saṃśayaḥ ||

dharaṇyuvāca ||
tataḥ sa puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ || 56 ||
varāharūpī bhagavām̐llokanātho janārdanaḥ |
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ meghadundubhiniḥsvanaḥ || 57 ||

anenaiva vidhānena ācāreṇa samanvitaḥ || 58||

kruddhena na ca karttavyaṃ lobhena tvarayā na ca || 59 ||

śrīvarāha uvāca ||

etatte kathitaṃ bhadre puṣpaṃ yanme na rocate || 66 ||

dharaṇyuvāca ||

atha jālapādabhakṣaṇāparādhaprāyaścittam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
raktavastreṇa saṃyukto yo hi māmupasarpati ||
tasyāpi śṛṇu suśroṇi karma saṃsāramokṣaṇam || 1 ||
rajasvalāsu nārīṣu rajo yattatpravarttate ||

rajo bhūtvā mahābhāge raktavastraparāyaṇaḥ || 3 ||

yena śudhyanti te bhūme puruṣāḥ śāstraniścitāḥ || 4 ||

vāyubhakṣastrīṇyahāni dinamekaṃ jalāśanaḥ || 5 ||

etatte kathitaṃ bhūme raktavastravibhūṣite ||

andho bhūtvā mahābhāge ekaṃ janma tamomayaḥ ||

prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi andhakāre tu yaḥ purā || 11 ||
saṃspṛśetso'pi dharmātmā yena lokaṃ mama vrajet ||
akṣṇorācchādanaṃ kṛtvā dināni daśa pañca ca || 12 ||
ekāhāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dinaviṃśaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
yasya kasyāpi māsasya ekāmeva ca dvādaśīm ||13 ||

yaḥ punaḥ kṛṣṇavastreṇa mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 15 ||

śucirbhāgavato bhūtvā mama mārgānusārakaḥ || 23 ||
tasya doṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi aparādhaṃ vasundhare ||
patanti yena saṃsāraṃ vāsasocchiṣṭakāriṇaḥ || 24 ||

dharaṇyuvāca ||
śrutametanmayā deva yattvayā samudāhṛtam || 28 ||

prāyaścittaṃ ca me brūhi sarvakarmasukhāvaham || 29 ||
kilbiṣādyena mucyante tava karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi kathyamānaṃ mayā'naghe || 30 ||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
yāvakena trīṇyahāni piṇyākena dinatrayam || 31 ||
parṇabhakṣastrīṇyahāni payobhakṣo dinatrayam ||
pāyasena trirātraṃ tu vāyubhakṣo dinatrayam || 32 ||

evaṃ dinānyekaviṃśatkṛtvā vai śubhalakṣaṇam ||

akṣāralavaṇaṃ sapta saktubhiśca tathā trayaḥ ||49||

payo bhuktvā dinaṃ sapta kārayedbuddhimānmanaḥ||50||

kimidaṃ tiṣṭhase rudra kaśmalena samāvṛtaḥ ||
tvaṃ karttā ca vikarttā ca vikārākāra eva ca || 24 ||

tvamugradevadevādistvaṃ sāma tvaṃ tathā diśaḥ || 25 ||

śrṛṇu tattvena me deva ko'nyo'pyevaṃ kariṣyati ||29||
