tvatprasādena jāto'smi pūrṇāmburiva sāgaraḥ || 31 ||
ahaṃ tvāṃ tu vijānāmi māṃ tvaṃ jānāsi mādhava ||
āvayorantaraṃ ko'pi na paśyati janārdana || 32 ||
brahmāṇaṃ tu vijānāti nāvayorantareṇa hi ||
sādhu viṣṇo mahābhāga sarvamāyākaraṇḍaka || 33 ||
evaṃ mahyaṃ haro vākyamuktvā bhūtamaheśvaraḥ ||
muhūrttaṃ dhyānamāsthāya punaḥ provāca mādhavi || 34 ||
tava viṣṇo prasādena mayā tattripuraṃ hatam ||
nihatā dānavāstatra garbhiṇyaśca nipātitāḥ || 35 ||
bālavṛddhā hatāstatra visphuranto diśo daśa ||
tasya pāpasya doṣeṇa na śaknomi viceṣṭitum || 36 ||
praṇaṣṭayogamāyaśca naṣṭaiśvaryaśca mādhava ||
ki karttavyaṃ mayā viṣṇo pāpāvasthena samprati ||37||
viṣṇo tattvena me brūhi śodhanaṃ pāpa nāśanam ||
yena vai kṛtamātreṇa śuddho mucyeta kilbiṣāt || 38 ||
evaṃ cintātmanastasya mayā rudrasya bhāṣitam ||
kapālamālāṃ gṛhītvā samalaṃ gaccha śaṅkara || 39 ||
mamaivaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavānparameśvaraḥ ||
uvāca māṃ punarvyaktaṃ māṃ bodhaya jagatpate || 40 ||
kīdṛśaḥ samalo viṣṇo yatra gacchāmahe vayam ||
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā śaṅkarasya maheśvari || 41 ||
tatpāpaśodhanārthāya mayā vākyaṃ prabhāṣitam ||
śmaśānaṃ samalaṃ rudra pūtiko vraṇagandhikaḥ || 42 ||
svayaṃ tiṣṭhanti vai tatra manujā vigataspṛhaḥ ||
tatra gṛhya kapālāni rama tatraiva śaṅkara || 43 ||
tatra varṣasahasrāṇi divyānyeva dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
tato bhakṣaya māṃsāni pāpakṣayacikīrṣukaḥ || 44 ||
hatānāṃ caiva māṃsāni ye ca bhojyāstava priyāḥ ||
evaṃ sarvairgaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ vasa tatra suniścitaḥ || 45 ||
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu sthitvā tvaṃ samale punaḥ ||
gacchāśramapadaṃ paścādgautamasya mahāmuneḥ || 46 ||
tatra jñāsyasi cātmānaṃ gautamāśramasaṃsthitaḥ ||
prasādādgautamamunerbhavatā gatakilbiṣaḥ || 47 ||
satataṃ pāpasampannaṃ kapālaṃ śirasi sthitam ||
ṛṣiḥ pātayituṃ śaktastvatprasādānna saśaṃyaḥ || 48 ||
evaṃ rudraṃ varaṃ dattvā tatraivāntarhito'bhavam ||
rudro'pi bhramate tatra śmaśāne pāpasaṃvṛte ||49||
ato na rocate bhūme śmaśānaṃ me kadācana ||
yatra rudrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sthitaṃ kila bhayāvaham || 50 ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre śmaśānaṃ me jugupsitam ||
vinā tu kṛtasaṃskāro mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 51 ||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena śudhyati kilbiṣāt ||
kṛtvā caturthabhakṣaṃ tu dināni daśa paṃca ca || 52 ||
ākāśaśayanaṃ kuryādekavastraḥ kuśāsane ||
prabhāte paṃcagavyaṃ ca pātavyaṃ karmaśodhanam || 53 ||
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
piṇyākaṃ bhakṣayitvā tu yo devamupasarpati || 54 ||
tasya vai śṛṇu suśroṇi prāyaścittaṃ suśodhanam ||
ulūko daśa varṣāṇi kacchapastu samāstrayaḥ || 55 ||
jāyate mānavastatra mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
yāṃstu doṣānprapaśyante saṃsāre'sminvasundhare || 56 ||
tasya vakṣyāmi suśroṇi prāyaścittaṃ mahaujasam ||
kilbiṣādyena mucyeta saṃsārāntaṃ ca gacchati || 57 ||
yāvakena dinaikaṃ tu gomūtreṇa ca kārayet||
rātrau vīrāsanaṃ kuryādākāśaśayane vaset || 58 ||
na sa gacchati saṃsāraṃ mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
varāhamāṃsena tu yo mama kurvīta prāpaṇam || 59 ||
mūrkhaḥ sa pāpakarmā ca mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
yāṃstu doṣānprapadyeta saṃsāraṃ ca vasundhare || 60 ||
yāvadroma varāhasya mama gātreṣu saṃsthitam ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi narake pacyate bhuvi || 61 ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
vārāheṇa tu māṃsena yastu kurvīta prāpaṇam || 62 ||
yāvat tattanusaṃsthaṃ tu bhajate tu pratiṣṭhitam ||
tāvatsa patate devi saukarīṃ yonimāsthitaḥ ||63||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
yāṃ gatiṃ samprapadyeta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||64||
andho bhūtvā tato devi janma caivaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
evaṃ gatvā tu saṃsāraṃ varāhamāṃsaprāpaṇāt ||65||
jāyate vipule siddhe kule bhāgavate śuciḥ ||
vinītaḥ kṛtasaṃskāro mama kamarparāyaṇaḥ ||66||
dravyavānguṇavāṃścaiva rūpavāñchīlavāñchuciḥ ||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi tasya kāyaviśodhanam || 67 ||
kilbiṣādyena mucyeta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
phalāhāro dinānsapta sapta mūlāśanastathā || 68 ||
dināni sapta tiṣṭheta sapta vai pāyasena ca ||
takreṇa sapta divasānsapta pāvakabhojanaḥ || 69 ||
prāyaścittānmahābhāge mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
madyaṃ pītvā varārohe yastu māmupasarpati || 70 ||
tatra doṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu sundari tattvataḥ ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daridro jāyate punaḥ ||71||
tato bhavetsupūtātmā madbhaktaḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ ||
yastu bhāgavato bhūtvā kāmarāgeṇa mohitaḥ || 72 ||
dīkṣitaḥ pibate madyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 73 ||
agnivarṇāṃ surāṃ pītvā tena mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 74 ||
na sa lipyati pāpena saṃsāraṃ ca na gacchati ||
kausumbhaṃ caiva yaḥ śākaṃ bhakṣayenmama pūjakaḥ ||75||
narake pacyate ghore daśa paṃca ca sūkaraḥ ||
tato gacchecchvayonau ca trīṇi varṣāṇi jambukaḥ ||76||
varṣamekaṃ tataḥ śudhyenmatkarmaṇi rataḥ śuciḥ ||
mama lokamavāpnoti śuddho bhūtvā vasundhare ||77||
tato bhūmirvacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca punarharim ||
kusumbhaśākanaivedyaprāpaṇena ca kilbiṣāt||78||
kathaṃ mucyeta deveśa prāyaścittaṃ vada prabho ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
yo me kusumbhaśākena prāpaṇaṃ kurute naraḥ || 79 ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi narake paripacyate ||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi tacca me vadataḥ śṛṇu || 80 ||
bhakṣaṇe tu kṛte kuryāccāndrāyaṇamatandritaḥ ||
prāpaṇe tu kṛte kuryāddvādaśāhaṃ payovratam || 81 ||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||
na sa lipyeta pāpena mama lokaṃ ca gacchati || 82 ||
yaḥ pārakyeṇa vastreṇa na dhūtena ca mādhavi ||
prāyaścittī bhavenmūrkho mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 83 ||
karoti mama karmāṇi spṛśate māṃ tadā sthitaḥ ||
mṛgo vai jāyate devi varṣāṇi trīṇi sapta ca ||84||
hīnapādena jāyeta caikaṃ janma vasundhare ||
mūrkhaśca krodhanaścaiva madbhaktaścaiva jāyate || 85 ||
tasya vakṣyāmi suśroṇi prāyaścittaṃ mahaujasam ||
yena gacchati saṃsāraṃ mama bhakto vyavasthitaḥ || 86 ||
aṣṭabhaktaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||
māghasyaiva tu māsasya śuklapakṣasya dvādaśīm || 87 ||
tiṣṭhejjalāśaye gatvā śānto dānto yatavrataḥ ||
ananyamānaso bhūtvā mama cintāparāyaṇaḥ || 88 ||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmudite tu divākare ||
pacagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā mama karmāṇi kārayet ||89||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret||
sarvapāpavinirmukto mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||90||
( akṛtvā yo navānnāni mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||)
tato bhāgavato bhūtvā navānnaṃ yo na kārayet || 91 ||
pitarastasya nāśnanti varṣāṇi daśa paṃca ca ||
adattvā yastu bhuñjīta navānnāni kadācana || 92 ||
na tasya dharmo vidyeta evametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi yena tasmātpramucyate || 93 ||
prāyaścittaṃ mahābhāge mama bhaktasukhāvaham ||
upavāsaṃ trirātraṃ tu tata ekena vā punaḥ || 94 ||
ākāśaśayanaṃ kṛtvā caturthe'hani śudhyati ||
evaṃ tatra vidhiṃ kṛtvā udite ca divākare || 95 ||
paṃcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā śīghraṃ mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 96 ||
sarvasaṅgaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
adattvā gandhamālyāni yo me dhūpaṃ prayacchati || 97 ||
kuṇapo jāyate bhūme yātudhāno na saṃśayaḥ ||
varṣāṇi caikaviṃśāni ayaskāranivāsakaḥ || 98 ||
tiṣṭhatyatra mahābhāge evametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 99 ||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
yasya kasyacinmāsasya śuklapakṣasya dvādaśīm || 100 ||
upoṣya cāṣṭabhaktaṃ tu daśaikādaśameva ca ||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmudite ravimaṇḍale || 101 ||
paṃcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā śīghraṃ mucyati kilbiṣāt ||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 102 ||
tāni tāni tarantyeva sarva eva pitāmahāḥ ||
vahannupānahau padbhyāṃ yastu māmupacakramet || 103 ||
carmakārastu jāyeta varṣāṇāṃ tu trayodaśa ||
tajjanmanaḥ paribhraṣṭaḥ sūkaro jāyate punaḥ || 104||
sūkaratvātparibhraṣṭaḥ śvā bhavecca jugupsitaḥ ||
tataḥ śvattvātparibhraṣṭo mānuṣeṣūpajāyate || 105 ||
madbhaktaśca vinītaśca aparādhavivarjitaḥ ||
muktastu sarvasaṃsārānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 106 ||
ya etena vidhānena vasudhe karma kārayet ||
na sa lipyeta pāpena evametanna saṃśayaḥ || 107 ||
bherīśabdamakṛtvā tu yastu māṃ pratibodhayet ||
badhiro jāyate bhūme ekaṃ janma na saṃśayaḥ || 108 ||
tasya vakṣyāmi suśroṇi prāyaścittaṃ mama priyam ||
kilbiṣādyena mucyeta bherītāḍanamohitaḥ || 109 ||
yasya kasyacinmāsasya śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśī ||
ākāśaśayanaṃ kṛtvā śīghraṃ mucyeta kilbiṣāt || 110 ||
ya etena vidhānena vasudhe karma kārayet ||
aparādhaṃ na gacchettu mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 111 ||
annaṃ bhuktvā bahutaramajīrṇena pariplutaḥ ||
udgāreṇa samāyuktaḥ asnāta upasarpati || 112 ||
ekajanmani śvā caiva vānaraścaiva jāyate ||
ekasmiñjanmani cchāgaḥ sṛgālaścaikajanmani || 113 ||
ekajanma bhavedandho mūṣako jāyate punaḥ ||
tārito hyeṣa saṃsārājjāyate vipule kule ||114||
śuddho bhāgavataḥ śreṣṭhastvaparādhavivarjjita||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi mama bhaktasukhāvaham||115||
kilbiṣādyena mucyeta mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||
tridinaṃ pāvakāhāro mūlāhāro dinatrayam || 116 ||
pāyasena dinatrayyāṃ tridinaṃ saktunā tathā ||
tridinaṃ vāyubhakṣo'pi ākāśaśayanastrikam ||117||
utthāyāpararātre tu kṛtvā vai dantadhāvanam||
paṃcagavyaṃ pibeccaiva śarīrapariśodhanam ||118||
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||
na sa lipyeta pāpena mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 119 ||
ākhyānānāṃ mahākhyānaṃ tapasāṃ ca paraṃ tapaḥ ||
atrāhaṃ kīrttayiṣyāmi brāhmaṇebhyo maheśvari || 120 ||
eṣa dharmaśca kīrttiśca ācārāṇāṃ mahaujasām ||
guṇānāṃ ca paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ṛtīnāṃ ca mahā ṛtiḥ || 121 ||
ya etatpaṭhate nityaṃ kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ ||
sa pitṝm̐stārayejjanturdaśa pūrvāndaśāparān || 122 ||
ārogyāṇāṃ mahārogyaṃ maṅgalānāṃ tu maṅgalam ||
ratnānāṃ paramaṃ ratnaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 123 ||
yastu bhāgavato nityaṃ paṭhate ca dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
kṛtvā sarvāparādhāni na sa pāpena lipyate || 124 ||
eṣa japyaḥ pramāṇaṃ ca sandhyopāsanameva ca ||
kalyamutthāya paṭhate mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 125 ||
na paṭhenmūrkhamadhye tu kuśiṣyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ||
dadyādbhāgavate śreṣṭhe mama karmaparāyaṇe || 126 ||
etatte kathito devi ācārasya viniścayaḥ ||
pūrvaṃ tvayā yatpṛṣṭaṃ tu kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 127 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre prāyaścittakarmasūtraṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 136 ||
atha gṛdhrajambukākhyānam |
tatrādityavarapradānam ||
sūta uvāca ||
śrutvā tu vipulaṃ hyetadaparādhaviśodhanam ||
karma bhāgavataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvabhāgavata priyam || 1 ||
aho karma mahāśreṣṭhaṃ bhagavaṃstava bhāṣitam ||
mama caiva priyārthāya tava bhaktasukhāvaham || 2 ||
śrutaṃ hyeva mahābāho sarvadharmārthasādhakam||
tava bhaktasukhārthāya tadbhavānvaktumarhati||3||
kimucyate vrataṃ caiva śubhaṃ kubjāmrake mahat ||
kataraccāpi tacchreṣṭhaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaktasukhāvaham ||4||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu me paramaṃ guhyaṃ yattvayā pṛcchitaṃ mama ||
mama kṣetraṃ paraṃ caiva śuddhaṃ bhāgavatapriyam ||5||
paraṃ kokāmukhaṃ sthānaṃ tathā kubjāmrakaṃ param ||
paraṃ saukaravaṃ sthānaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam || 6 ||
yatra saṃsthā ca me devi hyuddhṛtāsi rasātalāt ||
yatra bhāgīrathī gaṅgā mama saukarave sthitā || 7 ||
dharovāca ||
keṣu lokeṣu yāntīśa saukare ye mṛtāḥ prabho ||
kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ bhavettatra snātasya pibatastathā || 8 ||
kati tīrthāni padmākṣa kṣetre saukarave tava ||
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya tadviṣṇo vaktumarhasi || 9 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi yattvaṃ māṃ paripṛcchasi ||
yāṃ gatiṃ te prapadyante narāḥ saukarave mṛtāḥ||10||
yatra snātasya yatpuṇyaṃ gatasya ca mṛtasya ca||
yatra yāni ca tīrthāni mama saṃsthānasaṃsthitāḥ||11||
śṛṇu puṇyaṃ mahābhāge mama kṣetreṣu sundari ||
prāpnuvanti mahābhāge gatvā saukaravaṃ prati || 12 ||
daśa pūrvāparāścāpi apare sapta paṃca ca ||
svargaṃ gacchanti puruṣāsteṣāṃ ye tatra vai mṛtāḥ || 13 ||
gamanādeva suśroṇi mukhasya mama darśanāt ||
saptajanmāntare bhadre jāyate vipule kule || 14 |||
dhanadhānyasamṛddheṣu rūpavānguṇavān śuciḥ ||
madbhaktaścaiva jāyeta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 15 ||
evaṃ vai mānuṣo bhūtvā aparādhavivarjitaḥ ||
gamanaṃ tasya kṣetrasya maraṇaṃ tatra kāraṇam ||16||
ye mṛtāstasya kṣetrasya saukarasya prabhāvataḥ ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhanurhastāścaturbhujāḥ ||17||
tyaktvā kalevaraṃ tūrṇaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ prayānti te ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 18 ||
tīrtheṣu teṣu snātaśca yāṃ prapnoti parāṃ gatim ||
cakratīrthaṃ mahābhāge yatra cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 19 ||
śṛṇu puṇyaṃ tatra bhadre prāpnoti paramaṃ naraḥ ||
cakratīrthe naro gatvā niyato niyatāśanaḥ || 20 ||
vaiśākha dvādaśīṃ prāpya snāyādyo vidhipūrvakam ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca || 21 ||
dhanadhānyasamṛddho hi jāyate vipule kule ||
madbhaktaścāpi jāyeta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 22 ||
aparādhaṃ varjayati dīkṣitaścaiva jāyate ||
bhūtvā vai mānuṣastatra tīrthe saṃsārasāgaram || 23 ||
tīrtvā cakra gadāśaṃkhapadmapāṇiścaturbhujaḥ ||
mama rūpadharaḥ śrīmānmama loke mahīyate || 24 ||
cakratīrthe viśālākṣi maraṇe kṛtakṛtyataḥ ||
etacchrutvā vacastasya śrotukāmā vasundharā || 25 ||
śirasyañjalimādhāya ślakṣṇametaduvāca ha ||
tatra saukarave tīrthe candramāstvāmatoṣayat || 26 ||
etadācakṣva tattvena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||
vasudhāyā vacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇurmāyākaraṇḍakaḥ || 27 ||
uvāca vākyaṃ medinyāḥ meghadundubhiniḥsvanaḥ ||
śṛṇu bhūme prayatnena kathyamānaṃ mayānaghe || 28 ||
tasya vai kāraṇaṃ yena tena cārādhitosmyaham ||
tasya prīto'smyahaṃ devi viśuddhenāntarātmanā ||29||
darśitaśca mayā hyātmā yo hi deveṣu durlabhaḥ ||
rūpaṃ somena taddṛṣṭvā visaṃjñastadanantaram ||30||
māṃ sa draṣṭuṃ na śaknoti mama tejaḥpramohitaḥ ||
tato nimīlitākṣeṇa kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim || 31 ||
na śaknoti tathā vaktuṃ bhīruḥ santrastalocanaḥ ||
evametadviceṣṭantaṃ brāhmaṇānāmapīśvaram||32||
vāṇīṃ sūkṣmāṃ samādāya sa somo codito mayā ||
kiṃ vā phalaṃ samuddiśya tapyase sumahattapaḥ ||33||
brūhi tatvena me soma yatte manasi varttate ||
sarvaṃ sampādayiṣyāmi tvatprasādānna saṃśayaḥ || 34||
mama vākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā grahāṇāṃ pravareśvaraḥ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ somatīrthamavasthitaḥ ||35||
bhagavan yadi tuṣṭo'si mama cātra gataḥ prabho||
yoganātho jagacchreṣṭhaḥ sarvayogīśvareśvaraḥ ||36||
yāvallokā dhariṣyanti tāvattvayi janārdana ||
atulā tvayi me bhaktirbhavennityaṃ suniścalā|| 37||
yaccāpi mama tadrūpaṃ tvayā saṃsthāpitaṃ prabho ||
saptadvīpeṣu dṛśyeta tatra tatraiva saṃsthitam || 38||
soma ityeva yajñeṣu pibantu mama brāhmaṇāḥ||
gatiḥ pāramikā teṣāṃ divyā viṣṇo bhavedyathā|| 39||
kṣīṇastatra tvamāvasyāṃ tatra piṇḍapitṛkriyāḥ||
pravarttante yathānyāyaṃ bhaveyaṃ saumyadarśanaḥ||40 ||
adharme ca na me buddhirbhavedviṣṇo kadācana||
patitvaṃ cātha gaccheyamoṣadhīnāṃ tathā kuru ||41 ||
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva ādimadhyānta varjitaḥ ||
mama caiva priyārthāya etanme dīyatāṃ varaḥ || 42 ||
tataḥ somavacaḥ śrutvā tatraivāntarhito'bhavam ||
evaṃ taptaṃ mahābhāge tapaḥ somena niścayāt ||43||
prāptā ca paramā siddhiḥ somatīrthe'nyadurllabhā ||
snāyādyaḥ somatīrthe tu mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||44||
aṣṭamena tu bhaktena mama karmavidhau sthitaḥ ||
phalaṃ tasya pravakṣyāmi somatīrthe narasya yat||45||
yatra taptaṃ tapastena somena sumahātmanā||
pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi ekapādena tiṣṭhatā ||46||
pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi tathaivorddhvamukhaḥ sthitaḥ ||
evamugraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā kāntimānabhavacca saḥ ||47||
mamāparādhānmuktaśca brāhmaṇānāṃ patistathā ||
evameva mahābhāge somatīrthe kṛtodakaḥ ||48||
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi triṃśadvarṣaśatāni ca ||
jāyate brāhmaṇaḥ subhru vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ||49 ||
dravyavānguṇavāṃścaiva saṃvibhāgī yaśasvini ||
madbhaktaścaiva jāyeta aparādhavivarjitaḥ ||50 ||
sa eṣa brāhmaṇo bhūtvā saṃsārādvipramucyate ||
tasya cihnaṃ pravakṣyāmi somatīrthasya sundari || 51 ||
tattīrthaṃ yena vijñeyaṃ mama mārgānusāriṇā ||
vaiśākhasya tu māsasya śuklapakṣasya dvādaśī || 52 ||
pravṛtte cāndhakāre tu yatra kaścinna dṛśyate||
somena ca vinā bhūmirdṛśyate candrasaprabhā || 53||
ālokaścaiva dṛśyeta somastatra na dṛśyate ||
evaṃ tvāṃ vacmi he bhadre eṣa vai vismayaḥ paraḥ || 54 ||
etaccihnaṃ mahābhāge puṇye saukarave mama ||
saumatīrthe viśālākṣi yena mucyanti jantavaḥ || 55 ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
prabhāvamasya kṣetrasya vismayaṃ paramaṃ mahat || 56 ||
akāmā tu mṛtā tīrthe ātmanaḥ karmaniścayāt ||
mama kṣetraprabhāveṇa sṛgālī mānuṣī bhavet || 57 ||
rājaputrī viśālākṣī śyāmā sarvāṅgasundarī ||
guṇavadrūpasampannā catuḥṣaṣṭikalānvitā ||58||
tasya pūrveṇa pārśvena tīrthaṃ gṛdhravaṭaṃ smṛtam ||
yatrākāmo mṛto gṛdhro mānuṣatvamupāgataḥ || 56 ||
vākyaṃ nārāyaṇācchrutvā dharaṇī śubhalakṣaṇā ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ viṣṇubhaktasukhāvaham || 60 ||
aho tīrthaprabhāvo vai tvayā prokto mahānmama ||
yasya deva prabhāveṇa tiryagyonitvamāgatau ||
gṛdhraścaiva sṛgālī ca prāptau vai mānuṣīṃ tanum ||61 ||
snānena tatra tīrthe ca maraṇādvā janārdana ||
kāṃ gatiṃ vai prapadyante tanmamācakṣva keśava ||62||
cihnaṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ teṣāṃ jāyante yena te tathā ||
akāmāvapi tau kṣetre prāptau nu paramāṃ gatim || 63 ||
tato mahīvacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇurdharmavidāṃ varaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ dharmakāmo vasundharām ||64||
śṛṇu tattvena me bhūme yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||
ubhau tau kāraṇādyasmātprāptau vai mānuṣīṃ gatima||65||
tasminkāle hyatikrānte mama karmaviniścayāt ||
tretāyuge hyupakrānte jñāte ca yugasaṃsthitau || 66||
tatra rājā mahābhāgaḥ svadharmakṛtaniścayaḥ ||
brahmadatteti vikhyātaḥ puraṃ kāmpillamāsthitaḥ || 67 ||
tasya putro mahābhāgaḥ sarvadharmeṣu niṣṭhitaḥ ||
somadatteti vikhyātaḥ kumāraḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ || 68 ||
pitrarthe mṛgayāṃ yāto mṛgalipsurvane tadā ||
araṇye sa tadā gatvā vyāghrasiṃhaniṣevite ||69 ||
na tatra labhate kiñcitpitṛkārye narādhipaḥ ||
evaṃ hi bhramatastasya sṛgālī dakṣiṇe tathā || 70 ||
aṅgamadhye tu viddhā sā sphurantī sarvamaṅgalā ||
tathā sā bāṇasantaptā vyathayā ca pariplutā ||71 ||
pītvā sā salilaṃ tatra vṛkṣaṃ śākoṭakaṅgatā ||
ātapena pariklāntā bāṇaviddhāturā bhṛśam ||72||
akāmā muñcatī prāṇān tīrthaṃ somātmakaṃ prati ||
etasminnaṃtare bhadre rājaputraḥ kṣudhārditaḥ || 73 ||
prāpto gṛdhravaṭaṃ tīrthaṃ viśrāmaṃ tatra cākarot ||
atha paśyati gṛdhraṃ sa vaṭaśākhāṃ samāśritam || 74 ||
ekena sa tu bāṇena tayā gṛdhro nipātitaḥ ||
sa tatra patito gṛdhro vaṭamūle yaśasvini || 75 ||
gatāsurnaṣṭasaṃjño vai bāṇabhinnastathā hṛdi ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ gṛdhraṃ rājaputrastutoṣa ha || 76 ||
tasya cchitvā tataḥ pakṣau gṛhītvā rājanandanaḥ ||
bāṇapakṣānvidhātuṃ ca somadatto gṛhaṃ yayau ||77||
so'pi dīrgheṇa kālena akāmo'pi mṛtaḥ khagaḥ ||
jātaḥ kaliṅgarājasya suto guṇavibhūṣitaḥ ||78||
rūpavān paṇḍitaścaiva prajānaṃdakaraḥ sadā ||
tasminrājani nāyāsaṃ ko'pi kutrāpi viṃdati ||79||
yā sā sṛgālī sañjajñe kāṃcīrājasya vai sutā||
rūpayuktā guṇavatī dakṣā sarvāṃgasuṃdarī || 80 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭikalāyuktā kokileva sukhasvarā ||81 ||
evaṃ pravarttite tatra kāṃcīrājye kaliṅgake || 
hārdikyātsauhṛdātprītiranyo'nyakulaniścayāt || 82 ||
bhūme mama prasādena sambadho'jāyata svataḥ ||
atha dīrgheṇa kālena kāṃcīrājasutā tathā || 83 ||
kaliṅgarājaputreṇa vidhinā tu vivāhitā ||
kāṃcīrājastayoḥ prītyā nānāratnāni cādadat ||84||
bhūṣaṇāni ca divyāni gajāśvamahiṣīḥ striyaḥ ||
tataḥ kaliṅgarājo'pi savadhūkaṃ nijaṃ sutam || 85 ||
ādāya svagṛhaṃ yātastena rājñātimānitaḥ ||
evaṃ gacchati kāle vai dampatyostuṣyamāṇayoḥ ||86||
avyucchinnā'bhavatprītī rohiṇīcaṃdrayoriva ||
rematustau vihāreṣu devatāyataneṣu ca ||87||
vane copavane caiva ye kecinnandanopamāḥ ||
bharttāraṃ sā na paśyeccetkadācidapi pārśvataḥ || 88||
naṣṭaṃ manyeta cātmānaṃ rājaputrī yaśasvini ||
na cetpaśyati bhāryāṃ svāṃ so'pi rājanyanandanaḥ||89||
ātmānaṃ manyate prītyā naṣṭaprāyaṃ vasundhare ||
dine dine tayorevaṃ varddhate prītiruttamā||90 ||
nāntaraṃ paśyate kaścit puruṣaḥ puṇyakarmaṇoḥ ||
so'pi buddhyā suśīlena kṛtena ca vasundhare ||91 ||
kaliṃgastoṣayāmāsa paurānjānapadāṃstathā ||
antaḥpure tu yā nāryaḥ kaliṃgeṣu dhare tayoḥ ||92 ||
tābhyāṃ santoṣitāḥ sarvāḥ śīlena svaguṇaistathā||
evaṃ pravarddhitā tābhyāṃ prītiḥ pūrvaṃ yaśasvini ||93||
ramate tatra cānyonyaṃ śacīvāsavayoriva ||
atha praṇayapūrvaṃ sā kāṃtaṃ sarvāṃgasundarī||94||
vyajijñapadrājasutaṃ sauhṛdena yaśasvinī ||
kiṃcidicchāmi te vaktuṃ rājaputra yaśodhana || 95 ||
mama snehātpriyaṃ caiva tadbhavānvaktumarhati ||
tato bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā kaliṃgasya sutaḥ prabhuḥ || 96 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ padmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ ||
yadvadiṣyasi bhadre tvaṃ yacca te'sti manīṣitam ||97 ||
sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi śape satyena sundari ||
satyaṃ mūlaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viṣṇuḥ satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||98||
tasya mūlaṃ tapo rājñi rājyaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ||
nāhaṃ mithyā pravakṣyāmi kadācidapi sundari ||99||
na mithyā pūrvamuktaṃ me brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ||
hastyaśvaratharatnāni yānāni ca dhanāni ca || 100 ||
athavā paramagryaṃ tu paṭṭabandhaṃ karomi te ||
sā bhartṛvacanaṃ śrutvā kāṃcīrājasya cātmajā || 101 ||
saṃgṛhya cobhau caraṇau bharttāramidamabravīt ||
na caiva ratnānīcchāmi hastyaśvarathameva ca || 102 ||
paṭṭabandhena kāryaṃ ca yāvaddhriyati me guruḥ ||
ekā svapitumicchāmi madhyāhne tu tathāvidhe || 103 ||
na ciraṃ vālpakālaṃ tu yathā kaścinna paśyati ||
śvaśuro yadi vā śvaśrūryathaivānyo narādhipa || 104 ||
suptā naiva ca draṣṭavyā vratametanmuhūrttakam ||
ātmano vai gṛhajanā ye kecitsvajane janāḥ || 105 ||
te māṃ prasuptāṃ paśyeyuḥ kadācidapi saṃsthitām ||
tato bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā kaliṅgaiśvaryavarddhanaḥ || 106 ||
bāḍhamityeva tāṃ vākyaṃ pratyuvāca vasundhare ||
visrabdhā bhava suśroṇi kalyāṇena yaśasvini || 107 ||
na tvāṃ vai drakṣyate kaścicchayanīye mahāvratām ||
evaṃ gacchati kāle tu tayostu tadanantare || 108 ||
kaliṅgo jarayā yukto putraṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat ||
rājyaṃ dattvā varārohe yathānyāyaṃ kulodbhavam || 109 ||
kṛtvā niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ dattvā paṃcatvamāgataḥ ||
evaṃ prabhustato rājyaṃ piturdattaṃ yathocitam || 110 ||
ekākī svapate tatra yatra kaścinna paśyati ||
sa tu dīrgheṇa kālena kaliṅgakulavarddhanaḥ || 111 ||
sutānajanayatpaṃca ādityasamatejasaḥ ||
evaṃ tu mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ mama māyāpramohitam || 112 ||
ātmakarmasu saṃyuktaṃ cakravatparivarttate ||
jāto janturbhavedbālo bālastu taruṇo bhavet ||113||
taruṇo madhyamaṃ yāti paścādyāti jarāṃ tataḥ ||
bālo vai yāni karmāṇi karotyajñānataḥ svayam || 114 ||
na sa lipyati pāpena evametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
tataḥ kariṣyato rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakamanāmayam || 115||
saptasaptativarṣāṇi hyatītāni yaśasvini ||
aṣṭasaptatike varṣe ekānte tu narādhipaḥ || 116 ||
tameva cintayannarthaṃ madhyasaṃsthe divākare ||
mādhavasya tu māsasya śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśī || 117 ||
buddhiḥ sampadyate tasya priyādarśanalālasā ||
ko'rcyastatkiṃ vrataṃ cāsyā eṣā svapiti nirjane ||118||
na suptāyā vrataṃ kiṃciddṛśyate dharmasaṃcayaḥ ||
na ca viṣṇukṛtaṃ karma na caiveśvaracoditam ||119||
manunā vai kṛto dharma eṣa naiva na dṛśyate ||
na kvāpyapakṛto dharmo mahānapi na yoginām || 120 ||
na tatra eṣa vidyeta yaścaredvratamīdṛśam ||
bārhaspatyeṣu dharmeṣu yāmyeṣu ca na vidyate || 121 ||
na eṣa vidyate tatra suptā carati yadvratam ||
bhuktvā tu kāmabhogāni bhuktvā tu piśitodanam ||122||
tāmbūlaṃ raktavastraṃ tu susūkṣme paṭṭavāsasī ||
sugandhairbhūṣitā gātre sarvaratnasamāyutā || 123 ||
mama kāntā viśālākṣī kimatra carate vratam ||
kupyetāpi tu santuṣṭā priyā me kamalekṣaṇā || 124 ||
avaśyameva draṣṭavyā kīdṛśaṃ carati vratam ||
kinnaraiḥ supralakṣyeta vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || 125 ||
atha yogīśvarī bhūtvā yatra gacchati rocate ||
athavā cānyasaṃsṛṣṭā kāmarogeṇa cāvṛtā || 126 ||
evaṃ cintayatastasya astaṃ prāpto divākaraḥ ||
saṃvṛttā rajanī subhrūḥ sarvasārthasukhāvahā || 127 ||
tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ prabhātasamaye śubhe ||
paṭhanti māgadhā bandisūtā vaitālikāstathā || 128 ||
śaṅkhadundubhinādaiśca bodhito vasudhādhipaḥ ||
sarvalokahitārthāya udite ca divākare ||129||
yattadā cintitaṃ pūrvaṃ draṣṭukāmena tāṃ priyām ||
sarvacintāṃ parityajya sā cintā hṛdi varttate || 130||
snātastu vidhinā so'tha kṣaumābhyāmupasaṃvṛtaḥ ||
bhūtvā cotsārayāmāsa ājñāṃ dattvā yathocitam || 131 ||
vratasthaṃ yaḥ spṛśenmāṃ tu nārī puruṣa eva ca ||
dharmayuktena daṇḍena mama vadhyo bhavettu saḥ || 132 ||
evamājñāpayitvā tu kāliṅgo nṛpatiḥ kila ||
gataśca tvarayā dhīmānpraviṣṭastatra suvrate || 133 ||
paryaṅkasya tale tatra rājā darśanalālasaḥ ||
vilokya tāṃ varārohāṃ tataścintāparāyaṇām ||134||
tataḥ kamalapatrākṣī vedanāyāsapīḍitā ||
rujārttā rurude tatra śirovedanatāḍitā || 135 ||
kiṃ mayā tu kṛtaṃ karma pūrvameva suduṣkaram ||
yenāhamīdṛśīṃ prāptā daśāṃ puṇyaparikṣayāt || 136 ||
bharttā ca māṃ na jānāti kliśyamānāmanāthavat ||
atha māṃ kiṃ kathaṃ bharttā manyate svajano'pi vā ||137||
kathaye kiṃ śayānā tu sakhīnāṃ śayane sthitā||
evamatra na yujyeta yanmayā paricintitam || 138 ||
kiṃca vātmani duḥkhasya sarvametacca yujyate ||
kiṃca māṃ vakṣyate bharttā kiṃ ca māmitare janāḥ || 139 ||
anyāyena vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ sarvato vikṛtaṃ bhavet ||
kadācidapi kāle tu gacchetsaukaravaṃ prati || 140 ||
tato brūyāmidaṃ vākyaṃ yanme hṛdyavatiṣṭhate ||
tataḥ priyāvacaḥ śrutvā samutthāya tato nṛpaḥ || 141 ||
dorbhyāmāliṅgya vai bhāryāṃ vākyametaduvāca ha ||
kimidaṃ bhāṣase bhadre ātmānaṃ na praśaṃsasi ||142 ||
aśocyā śocitā yā tu yacca nindasi cātmani ||
bhiṣajaḥ kiṃ na vidyante aṣṭakarmasamāhitāḥ ||143||
ye tu saṃsthāpayeyuste śiraso vedanāṃ parām ||
tvayā pūrvaṃ vratamiṣādvedanā yadi gopitā ||144||
yena vai kliśyase bhadre śirasya sukhapīḍitā ||
vāyunā kaphapittena śoṇitena kaphena vā || 145 ||
sannipātasya doṣeṇa yenedaṃ pīḍyate śiraḥ ||
kāle vikāle kṛtvā vai pittodrekaṃ yaśasviti || 146 ||
aśnāsi piśitaṃ cānnaṃ tenedaṃ dūṣyate śiraḥ ||
kriyate'tra śirāvedho rudhirasrāva eva ca || 147 ||
dīyate cecchiro'bhyaṅgaḥ kathaṃ tiṣṭhati vedanā ||
kimetadgopitaṃ bhadre mayi tanna niveditam || 148 ||
tvayā vratamiṣeṇāyamātmā saṃkliśyate vṛthā ||
yā tvaṃ vai bhāṣase vākyaṃ saukare gamanaṃ prati || 149 ||
tatra gopyaṃ kimastīti yena te parivedanā ||
tataḥ kamalapatrākṣī savrīḍā duḥkhapīḍitā || 150 ||
bharturgṛhītvā caraṇau sā patiṃ pratyabhāṣata ||
prasīda me mahārāja nedaṃ praṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi || 151 ||
mama pūrvakathāṃ vīra duṣṭakarmānusāriṇīm ||
tato bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā kaliṅgānāṃ janādhipaḥ || 152 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ suhitenāntarātmanā ||
kimidaṃ gopyate devi mamāgre varavarṇini || 153 ||
tathyameva mahābhāge pṛcchyamānā yaśasvini ||
tato bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā vismayotphullalocanā || 154 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ kaliṅgānāṃ mahādhipam ||
bharttā dharmo yaśo bharttā bharttaiva priyamātmanaḥ || 155 ||
avaśyameva tadvācyaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchati ||
tathāpi notsahe vaktuṃ hṛdi yatparivarttate || 156 ||
tava pīḍākaramiti tanmāṃ na praṣṭumarhasi ||
etadduḥkhaṃ mahābhāga hṛdi me parivarttate ||157||
sukhe hi varttase nityaṃ mahārājo'si sundaraḥ ||
bahvyo matsadṛśā bhāryāstiṣṭhantyantaḥpure tava||158||
prāśnāsi piśitānnaṃ ca prāvārānbhūṣaṇāni ca ||
ācchādayasi yānaiśca hastyaśvarathapṛṣṭhagaḥ || 159 ||
gacchasyanārataṃ rājan kiṃ sthitaṃ ca mayā vinā ||
ājñā ca te'pratihatā gandhānbhogāṃśca sarvaśaḥ || 160 ||
bibharṣi svecchayā rājanna māṃ saṃpraṣṭumarhasi ||
tvaṃ me devo guruḥ sākṣādbharttā yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ || 161 ||
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca yaśaḥ svargaśca mānada ||
pṛṣṭayā me sadā vācyaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ priyaṃ tava || 165 ||
pativratānāṃ sarvāsāmeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
na saṃśaye niyoktavyaḥ sukhastho hi patiḥ striyā ||163||
etanniścitya me pīḍāṃ na praṣṭuṃ tvamihārhasi ||
tato bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā kaliṅgānāṃ janādhipaḥ || 164 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ bhāryāpīḍābhipīḍitaḥ ||
śṛṇu tattvena me bhadre śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ||165||
avaśyameva vaktavyaṃ pṛṣṭayā patinā dhruvam ||
yāni guhyānyaguhyāni striyo dharmapathe sthitāḥ || 165 ||
bharttāraṃ ca samāsādya rahastāṃ gopayanti na ||
kṛtvā suduṣkaraṃ karma rāgalobhapramohitā || 167 ||
yā sugopāyate guhyaṃ satī sā nocyate budhaiḥ ||
evaṃ cintya mahābhāge brūhi satyaṃ yaśasvini ||168||
adharmaste na bhavitā guhyārthakathane mama ||
tato bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā sā devī paramapriyā || 169 ||
pratyuvāca priyaṃ vākyaṃ rājānaṃ dharmavādinam ||
devo rājā gurū rājā somo rājeti paṭhyate ||170||
avaśyameva vaktavyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
yadi guhyaṃ na me kāryaṃ śrūyatāṃ rājasattama ||171||
abhiṣiṃcasva rājye sve jyeṣṭhaṃ putraṃ kulocitam||
ehi nātha mayā sārddhaṃ kṣetraṃ saukaravaṃ prati||172||
tato bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā kaliṃgānāṃ janādhipaḥ || |
bāḍhamityeva vākyena chandayāmāsa tāṃ priyām||173||
dāsyāmi rājyaṃ putrāya vacanāttava sundari||
yathā pūrvaṃ mayā labdhaṃ svapituryadyathākramam ||174||
ityuktvā tau mahābhāgau yuktaṃ caiva parasparam ||
rājā ca rājaputrī ca niṣkrāntau tadgṛhāttataḥ || 175 ||
tataḥ kañcukinaṃ dṛṣṭvā provācoccasvareṇa ca ||
apasāraya sarvaṃ vai janamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati||176||
jñānakautūhalo yo'tra śīghraṃ gacchatvito bahiḥ||
tato halahalāśabdaḥ pravṛtto'ntaḥpure mahān||177 ||
kimidaṃ kāraṇaṃ vṛttaṃ yena cotsāritā vayam ||
nājñāsti cintālolānāmāgatānāṃ svakāryataḥ || 178 ||
aśrotavyaṃ bhavennūnaṃ yena cotsāritā vayam ||
tato bhojyānnapānāni bhuktvā rucyā nṛpaḥ priyān ||179||
samaṃ mahiṣyā cācamya kṣaṇaṃ viśramya pārthivaḥ ||
amātyānānayāmāsa hyabhiṣektuṃ nijaṃ sutam || 180 ||
samprāptānsacivāṃstatra rājā vacanamabravīt ||
rājadhānī saṃskriyatāṃ maṅgalācārapūrvakam || 181 ||
vṛddhāmātyamupāsyātha kaliṅgo dharmasaṃhitam ||
nītiśāstrārthatattvajñamuvācāviklavaṃ vacaḥ || 182 ||
kālyamicchāmyahaṃ tāta putraṃ rājye'bhiṣecitum ||
śīghraṃ sajjaṃ prakurvantu ābhiṣecanikaṃ vidhim ||183||
bhūtamityeva taṃ prāhuḥ sacivāstaṃ narādhipam ||
asmākamapi taccaiva rocate yatprabhāṣase ||184||
putraste rājaśārdūla sarvalokahite rataḥ ||
prajānurāgavāñchūro nītijñastu vicārakaḥ ||185||
manīṣitaṃ tava vibho samyaṅ no manasaḥ priyam ||
evamuktvā gatāmātyāḥ sūryaścāstamupāgataḥ ||186||
sukhena sā gatā rātrirgītagāndharvavāditaiḥ ||
bodhitaḥ sa ca rājā tu sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ ||187||
vetālikaiśca suśroṇi sarvamaṃgalapāṭhakaiḥ ||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmudite ca divākare || 188 ||
muhūrttaṃ śubhamāsādya hyabhiṣiktaḥ sutaḥ śuciḥ ||
evaṃ datvā tadā rājyaṃ mūrdhni cāghrāya dharmavit || 189 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ putraṃ putravatāṃ varaḥ ||
rājyasthenāpi te putra karttavyaṃ śṛṇu tanmama || 190 ||
yadīccheḥ paramaṃ dharmaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇaṃ tathā ||
dātavyaṃ na ca haṃtavyaṃ haṃtavyāḥ pāradārikāḥ || 191 ||
bālaghātāśca haṃtavyā haṃtavyāḥ strīvighātakāḥ|||
na lobhaḥ parabhāryāsu brāhmaṇīṣu viśeṣataḥ ||192||
surūpāṃ paranārīṃ tu dṛṣṭvā cakṣurnimīlayeḥ ||
paradravyeṣu mā lobhaḥ anyāyopārjjiteṣu ca ||193||
na ciraṃ tiṣṭhasi kvāpi kathaṃcana na paśyasi ||
rakṣaṇīyaśca te deśaḥ kuśalanyāyasajjitaḥ || 194 ||
nityodyuktena sthātavyamamātyavacanaṃ kuru ||
amātyo yadvaco brūyāttasya kāryaṃ vimarśayan || 195 ||
avaśyameva karttavyaṃ śarīraparirakṣaṇam ||
prajā yena pramodaṃti yena tuṣyaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ || 195 ||
evaṃ te putra karttavyaṃ mama priyahitaiṣiṇā ||
saptavyasanavargo'tra doṣo rājñāṃ mahānbhavet || 197 ||
arthadūṣaṇakaṃ caiva na karttavyaṃ kadācana ||
amātyaṃ nāpriyaṃ brūyā yamicche rājakarmaṇi || 198 ||
nāhaṃ nivāraṇīyaste gamanāya pathe sthitaḥ ||
etanme kriyatāṃ śīghraṃ yadīcchasi mama priyam || 199 ||
tataḥ piturvacaḥ śrutvā rājaputro yaśasvini ||
pituḥ pādau tu saṃgṛhya karuṇaṃ pratyuvāca tam || 200 ||
mama kiṃ tāta rājyena kośena ca balena ca ||
yastvayā rahitastāta na śaknomi viceṣṭitum || 201 ||
abhiṣekaṃ rājaśabdaṃ mama saṃjñāpitaṃ tvayā ||
etanna bahumanye'haṃ vinā tāta tvayā hyaham || 202 ||
krīḍāmevā'tra jānāmi yena krīḍanti bālakāḥ ||
rājyacintāṃ na jānāmi rājāno yāṃ tu kurvate ||203||
tataḥ putravacaḥ śrutvā kaliṅgānāṃ mahīpatiḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ sāmapūrvaṃ yaśasvini || 204 ||
yaccedaṃ bhāṣase putra nāhaṃ jānāmi tadvacaḥ ||
putra śikṣāpayiṣyanti paurajānapadāstava || 205 ||
evaṃ saṃdiśya taṃ tatra sa rājā dharmaśāstrataḥ ||
gamanāya matiṃ cakre kṣetraṃ saukaravaṃ prati || 206 ||
taṃ prayāntaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā paurajānapadāstava || 205||
sakalatrasutāḥ sarve'pyanuyānti narādhipam || 207 ||
hastyaśvarathayānāni striyaścāntaḥpurasthitāḥ ||
saṃhṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve anuyānti narādhipam ||208||
atha dīrgheṇa kālena prāpya saukaravaṃ tadā ||
dhanadhānyasamṛddhyādi pradadau tatra mādhavi ||209||
evaṃ gacchati kāle tu tayostatra vasundhare ||
pravarttamānayornityaṃ dharme karmaṇi śuddhayoḥ || 210 ||
tataḥ sa padmapatrākṣaḥ kaliṅgānāṃ janādhipaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ kāṃcīrājasutāṃ tadā ||211 ||
pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai jīvitaṃ mama sundari ||
brūhi tatparamaṃ guhyaṃ yanmayā pūrvapṛcchitam || 212 ||
tato bhartturvacaḥ śrutvā prahasya rucirekṣaṇā ||
ubhau tau caraṇau gṛhya rājānaṃ vākyamabravīt || 213 ||
evametanmahābhāga yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||
upoṣya tu trirātraṃ tvaṃ paścācchroṣyasi mānada||214||
bāḍhamityeva tāṃ rājā pratyuvāca yaśasvini ||
padmapatraviśālākṣi pūrṇacandranibhānane||215||
yathā vadasi suśroṇi tathaiva mama rocate ||
dantakāṣṭhaṃ samādāya dvādaśāṃgulamāyatam || 216 ||
snātvā saṅkalpayāmāsa trirātraṃ niyamānvitau ||
upoṣya tau trirātraṃ tu vidhinā niyamānvitau ||217||
tataḥ snātau śucī kṣaume paridhāya tu vāsasī ||
praṇamya bhūṣitau viṣṇuṃ dampatī tadanantaram ||218||
tataḥ sā sundarī bhūṣāṃ samuttārya śubhekṣaṇā||
mahyaṃ nivedayāmāsa provāca ca janeśvaram||219||
ehyehi nātha gacchāvaḥ paśya gopyaṃ manīṣitam||
tato haste patiṃ gṛhya udvāha iva sundarī||220||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ kaliṃgādhipatiṃ tathā||
sṛgālī pūrvamevāhaṃ tiryyagyonivyavasthitā||221||
viddhāsmi somadattena bāṇena mṛgalipsunā||
etaṃ śirasi me rājanpaśya bāṇaṃ susaṃskṛtam||222||
yasya doṣeṇa me'pyeṣa rujā śirasi saṃsthitā||
kāṃcīrājakule janma pitrā dattā tava priyā||223||
kṣetraprabhāvānme saiṣā jātā siddhirnamo'stu te||
sa tataḥ padmapatrākṣaḥ kaliṅgānāṃ janādhipaḥ||224||
śrutvā rājā priyāṃ vākyaṃ pratyuvāca smṛtiṅgataḥ||
ahaṃ gṛdhro mahābhāge tenaiva vanacāriṇā||225||
somadattena bāṇena ekenaiva nipātitaḥ||
tato jāto'smyahaṃ bhadre kaliṃgānāṃ janādhipaḥ||226||
jāto'smi paramā vyuṣṭiḥ prāptaṃ rājyaṃ mayā mahat||
siddhirlabdhā varārohe mayā sarvāṃgasundari||227||
akāmapatitenāpi paśya kṣetrasya vai phalam||
ye ca bhāgavataśreṣṭhā ye ca nārāyaṇapriyāḥ||228||
paurajānapadāḥ sarve śrutvā tu tadanantaram||
lābhālābhau parityajya sarvakarmāṇyakārayan||229||
tatraiva maraṇaṃ prāpuḥ sarvasaṃgavivarjitāḥ||
śvetadvīpaṃ tataḥ prāptāḥ sarva eva caturbhujāḥ||2230||
sarve śaṅkhadharāścaiva sarve cāyudhasaṃyutāḥ|
tāḥ striyaśca varārohe stutimānyā mahaujasaḥ||231||
śvetadvīpe pramodante sarvabhogasamanvitāḥ||
evaṃ te kathitaṃ bhūme vyuṣṭiḥ saukarave mahat||232||
akāmapatitāścaiva śvetadvīpamupāgatāḥ||
ya etena vidhānena vāsaṃ tīrthe tu kārayet||233||
maraṇaṃ ca viśālākṣi śvetadvīpaṃ ca gacchati||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare||234||
snānādākhoṭake tīrthe yatphalaṃ samupāśnute||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca ||235||
nandanaṃ samavāśritya modante caiva sarvadā||
tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭo jāyate vipule kule||236||
madbhaktaścaiva jāyeta evametanna saṃśayaḥ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi snāto gṛdhravaṭe naraḥ||237||
yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti snānamātrakṛtodakaḥ||
navavarṣasahasrāṇi navavarṣaśatāni ca||238||
indralokaṃ samāsādya modate nirjaraiḥ saha||
indralokātparibhraṣṭo mama tīrthaprabhāvataḥ||239||
sarvasaṅgaṃ parityajya madbhaktaścaiva jāyate||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre snānamātrasya yatphalam||240||
yattvayā pṛcchitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam||
tato nārāyaṇācchrutvā pṛthivī saṃśitavratā||241||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ lokanāthaṃ janārdanam||
kena karmavipākena tīrthaṃ punaravāpyate||242||
snānaṃ vā maraṇaṃ deva yathāvadvaktumarhasi||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge pūrvadharmakṛto narāḥ ||243||
kenacitkarmadoṣeṇa tiryagyonimavāpya hi ||
janmāntarārjitaiḥ puṇyaistīrthasnāna japādibhiḥ ||244||
mahādānaiśca labhyeta tīrthe pañcatvamarccakaiḥ ||
janmāntarakṛtaṃ karma yatsvalpamapi vā bahu || 245 ||
tatkadācitphalatyeva na tasya parisaṃkṣayaḥ ||
kadācidvāsahāyo vai puṇyatīrthādidarśanāt || 246 ||
durbalaṃ prabalambhūtvā prabalaṃ durbalambhavet ||
pāpāntaraṃ samāsādya gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ || 247 ||
yadalpamiva dṛśyeta tanmahattvāya kalpate ||
ata eva manuṣyatvaṃ prāptaṃ rājatvameva ca || 248 ||
sṛgālī caiva gṛdhraśca tīrthasyaiva prabhāvataḥ ||
maraṇādeva samprāpya kṣīṇapāpau smṛtiṃ punaḥ || 249 ||
śvetadvīpaṃ tataḥ prāptau jānīhi tvaṃ vasundhare ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||250 ||
tīrthaṃ vaivasvataṃ nāma yatrārkastaptavāṃstapaḥ ||
kadācitputrakāmena mārttaṇḍena mahattapaḥ ||251 ||
kṛtaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ tatra daśavarṣasahasrakam ||
tataḥ saptasahasrāṇi vāyubhakṣastu saṃsthitaḥ || 252 ||
tatastuṣṭo'smyahaṃ bhadre sūryasya sumahaujasaḥ ||
vareṇa chandayāmāsa ādityaṃ tadanantaram || 253 ||
vivasvantaṃ mahābhāgaṃ mama karmaparāyaṇam ||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yaste manasi varttate ||254 ||
tato mamavacaḥ śrutvā kaśyapasya suto balī ||
madhuraṃ svaramādāya pratyuvāca mahadvacaḥ ||255||
yadi deva prasanno'si ayaṃ me dīyatāṃ varaḥ ||
putramicchāmyahaṃ deva prasādātte sureśvara ||256|||
vivasvadvacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭo'haṃ tasya sundari ||
tasya śuddhena manasā proktavānasmi sundari || 257 ||
yamaśca yamunā caiva mithunaṃ janayiṣyataḥ ||
evaṃ tasya varaṃ dattvā ādityasya vasundhare || 258 ||
ātmayogaprabhāveṇa tatraivāntarhito'bhavam ||
ādityo'pi gato bhadre veśma svaṃ ca mahādhanam ||259||
puṇyaṃ saukarave kṛtvā suduṣkarataraṃ mahat ||
aṣṭamena tu bhaktena yastu snāti vasundhare ||260 ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
athavā tatra suśroṇi mriyate puṇyavānnaraḥ ||261 ||
yamalokaṃ na gacchettu tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre snānasya maraṇasya ca ||262||
phalaṃ caiva yathāvṛttaṃ tīrthe saukarave mama ||
ākhyānānāṃ mahākhyānaṃ kriyāṇāṃ ca mahākriyā || 263 ||
eṣa japyaḥ pramāṇaṃ ca sandhyopāsanameva ca ||
eṣa tejaśca mantraśca sarvabhāgavatapriyam||264||
piśunāya na dātavyaṃ mūrkhe bhāgavate na tu ||
na ca vaiśyāya śūdrāya yena jānanti māṃ param ||265||
paṇḍitānāṃ sabhāmadhye ye ca bhāgavatā bhuvi ||
maṭhe brāhmaṇamadhye tu ye ca vedavidāṃ varāḥ || 266 ||
dīkṣitāya ca dātavyaṃ ye ca śāstrāṇi jānate ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre puṇyaṃ saukarave mahat ||267||
ya etatpaṭhate subhru kalya utthāya mānavaḥ ||
tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi cintito'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||268||
na sa jāyeta garbheṣu muktimāpnoti śāśvatīm ||
yaḥ paṭhedakemadhyāyaṃ tārayetsa kulāndaśa || 269 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre tīrthamāhātmye saukarave gṛdhrajambūkākhyāne ādityavarapradānādikaṃ nāma saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 137||
iti gṛdhrajambūkopākhyānaṃ samāptam||
atha khaṃjarīṭopākhyānam ||
sūta uvāca ||
etatpuṇyatamaṃ śrutvā ramye saukarave tadā ||
guṇastavaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ jātyānāṃ parivartanam || 1 ||
tataḥ kamalapatrākṣī sarvadharmavidāṃ varā ||
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā nirvṛtenāntarātmanā || 2 ||
punaḥ papraccha taṃ devaṃ vismayāviṣṭamānasā||
aho tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ kṣetre saukarave tava || 3 ||
akāmānmriyamāṇasya mānuṣatvamajāyata ||
kiṃ vānyadvṛttamākhyāhi kṣetre saukarave'male || 4 ||
śṛṇvantyā me mahajjātaṃ citte kautūhalaṃ param ||
gāyamānasya kiṃ puṇyaṃ vādyamānasya kiṃ phalam || 5||
nṛtyataḥ ki bhavetpuṇyaṃ jāgrato vā phalaṃ nu kim ||
godāturannadāturvā jaladātustu kiṃ phalam || 6 ||
saṃmārjane lepane vā gandhapuṣpādidānataḥ ||
dhūpadīpādinaivedyaiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ samudīritam || 7 ||
anyena karmaṇā caiva japayajñādinā'thavā ||
kāṃ gatiṃ pratipadyante ye śuddhamanaso janāḥ ||8 ||
tava bhaktasukhāryāya tadbhavānvaktumarhati ||
tato mahyā vacaḥ śrutvā sarvadevamayo hariḥ || 9 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ dharmakāmāṃ vasundharām ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu sundari tattvena yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || 10 ||
sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi puṇyakarma sukhāvaham ||
tasminsaukarave pakṣī khañjarīṭastu kīṭakān || 11 ||
bahūn bhuktvā hi vasudhe ajīrṇabhṛśapīḍitaḥ ||
maraṇaṃ samanuprāptaḥ patitaḥ svena karmaṇā || 12 ||
samprāptāstatra vai bālāḥ krīḍantastaṃ mṛtaṃ khagam ||
grahīṣyāma iti procya dhāvantastatra tatra ha || 13 ||
mamāyaṃ vai mamāyaṃ vai jighṛkṣantaḥ parasparama ||
saṅgharṣātkalahaṃ cakrurbhṛśaṃ krīḍanakotsukāḥ || 14 ||
tata eko gṛhītvainaṃ gaṅgāmbhasi samākṣipat ||
yuṣmākameva bhavatu nānenāsmatprayojanam || 15 ||
evaṃ sa khañjarīṭo hi gaṅgātoyāttatastadā ||
ādityatīrthasaṃklinnaśarīraḥ sa vasundhare || 16 ||
vaiśyasya tu gṛhe jāto hyanekakratuyājinaḥ ||
dhanaratnasamṛddhe tu rūpavān guṇavān śuciḥ || 17 ||
vibuddhaśca pavitraśca madbhaktaśca vasundhare ||
jātasya tasya varṣāṇi jagmurdvādaśa suvrate || 18 ||
kadācidupaviṣṭau tau dṛṣṭvā bālo guṇānvitaḥ ||
mātaraṃpitaraṃ cobhau harṣeṇa mahatānvitau || 19 ||
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau baddhāñjalirayācata ||
matpriyaṃ yadi karttavyameko me dīyatāṃ varaḥ || 20 ||
na cāhaṃ vāraṇīyo vai pitrā mātrā kathaṃcana ||
satyaṃ śapāmi guruṇā yathā nanu kṛtaṃ bhavet || 21 ||
putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dampatī tau mudānvitau ||
ūcatustaṃ priyaṃ vākyaṃ bālaṃ kamalalocanam || 22 ||
yadyattvaṃ vakṣyase vatsa yadyatte hṛdi varttate ||
sarvaṃ tattatkariṣyāvo visrabdhaṃ vada sāmpratam || 23 ||
triṃśatsahasraṃ gāvo hi sarvāśca śubhadohanāḥ ||
yadyatra rocate putra dehi tvamavicāritam || 24 ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi āvayoḥ putra kāraṇāt ||
vāṇijyaṃ naḥ smṛtaṃ karma tatte putre yadīpsitam || 25 ||
tatkuruṣva yathānyāyaṃ mitrebhyo dīyatāṃ dhanam ||
dhanadhānyāni ratnāni dehi putra avāritaḥ || 26 ||
kanyā vai ramaṇīyāśca sajātīyāḥ kulodbhavāḥ ||
ānayiṣyāva bhadraṃ te udvāhena krameṇa te || 27 ||
yadīcchasi punaścānyadyajñairyaṣṭuṃ suputraka ||
vidhinā pūvardṛṣṭena vaiśyā yena yajanti ca || 28 ||
aṣṭau sampūrṇadhuryāṇāṃ halānāṃ tāvatāṃ śatam ||
vaiśyakarma samādāya kiṃ punaḥ prāptumicchasi || 29 ||
yāvadbhojanatṛptānvā dvijānicchasi tarpitum ||
sarvaṃ nijecchayā putra karttumarhasi sāmpratam || 30 ||
pitṛmātṛ vacaḥ śrutvā sa bālo dharmasaṃyutaḥ ||
caraṇāvupasaṃgṛhya pitarau punarabravīt || 31 ||
gopradāne na me kāryaṃ mitraṃ vāpi na cintitam ||
kanyālābhe na cecchāsti na ca yajñaphale tathā || 32 ||
nāhaṃ vāṇijyamicchāmi kṛṣigorakṣameva ca ||
na ca sarvātithitvaṃ vā mama citte prasajjati || 33 ||
ekaṃ me paramaṃ cintyaṃ yanmamecchā tapodhṛtau ||
cintā nārāyaṇakṣetraṃ gāḍhaṃ saukaravaṃ prati||34||
tataḥ putravacaḥ śrutvā mama karmaparāyaṇau ||
karuṇaṃ paridevantau rudantau tāvubhau tathā || 35 ||
atha dvādaśa varṣāṇi tava jātasya putraka ||
kimidaṃ cintitaṃ vatsa tvayā nārāyaṇāśrayam || 36 ||
cintayiṣyati bhadraṃ te yadā tatprāpnuyā vayaḥ ||
adyāpi bhojanaṃ gṛhya dhāvamānāsmi pṛṣṭhataḥ || 37 ||
kimidaṃ cintitaṃ vatsa gamane saukaraṃ prati ||
adyāpi matstanau dhanyau prasrutau hi divāniśam || 38 ||
putra tvatsparśanāśāyāḥ kimetaccintitaṃ tvayā ||
rātrau supto'si vatsa tvaṃ śayyāsu parivarttitaḥ || 39 ||
ambeti bhāṣase'dyāpi kathametadvicintitam ||
spṛśaṃti tava nāryo'pi krīḍamānasya putraka || 40 || |
aparādho na vidyeta putra kṣetragṛheṣvapi ||
na vā svajanabhṛtyādyaiḥ paruṣaṃ te prabhāṣitam || 41 ||
ruṣṭena vāpi bhīṣāyai gṛhyate caiva yaṣṭikā||
putrahartuṃ na paśyehaṃ tava nirvedakāraṇam || 42 ||
iti māturvacaḥ śrutvā sa vaiśyakulanandanaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ jananīṃ saṃśitavrataḥ || 43 ||
uṣito'smi tadaṃgeṣu garbhasthaḥ kukṣisaṃbhavaḥ ||
krīḍatosmi yathānyāyaṃ tavotsaṃge yaśasvini || 44 ||
stanau hyetau mayā pītau lalitena vijṛmbhitau ||
aṅgaṃ tava samāruhya pāṃsubhirguṇṭhitā tanuḥ || 45 ||
amba tvaṃ mayi kāruṇyaṃ kuruṣva khalu cocitam ||
muṃca putrakṛtaṃ śokaṃ tyaja mātaranindite || 46 ||
āyānti ca punaryānti gatā gacchanti cāpare||
dṛśyate ca punarnaṣṭo na dṛśyeta punaḥ kvacit||47||
kuto jātaḥ kva saṃbaddhaḥ kasya mātā pitāthavā ||
imāṃ yonimanuprāpto ghore saṃsārasāgare || 48 ||
mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca||
janmajanmani varttante kasya te kasya vā vayam || 49 ||
evaṃ cintāṃ samāsādya mā śuco janani kvacit ||
evaṃ tau pitarau śrutvā vismayātpunarūcatuḥ || 50 ||
aho bata mahadguhyaṃ kimetattāta kathyatām ||
etadvacanamākarṇya sa vaiśyakulabālakaḥ || 51 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ jananīṃ pitaraṃ tathā||
yadi śrutena vaḥ kāryaṃ guhyasya pariniścayāt || 52 ||
tatpṛcchyatāṃ bhavadbhyāṃ hi guhyaṃ saukaravaṃ prati ||
tatrāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi svasya guhyaṃ mahaujasam ||53 ||
sūryatīrthaṃ samāsādya yattāta paripṛcchasi ||
bāḍhamityeva putraṃ tau dampatī procatuśca tam || 54 ||
gamane kṛtasaṃkalpau tataḥ saukaravaṃ prati ||
sarvadravyasamāyuktau gatau saukaravaṃ prati || 55 ||
gataḥ sa padmapatrākṣa ābhīrāṇāṃ janeśvaraḥ ||
gāvo viṃśasahasrāṇi preṣayatyagrato drutam || 56 ||
agre sarvāstāḥ prayayurdravyeṇa ca samāyutāḥ ||
yacca kiṃcidgṛhe vāsti kṛtaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati || 57 ||
tataḥ pūrvārddhayāmena māghamāse trayodaśī ||
sarvaṃ svajanamāmantrya sambaddhaṃ ca yathāvidhi || 58 ||
muhūrttena ca tenaiva gamanaṃ kurute tataḥ ||
snātvā ca kṛtaśaucāste nārāyaṇamudāvahāḥ || 59 ||
atha dīrgheṇa kālena nārāyaṇamudāvahāḥ ||
vaiśākhasya tu dvādaśyāṃ mama kṣetramupāgatāḥ || 60 ||
snātāḥ santarpya ca pitṝnmama vastravibhūṣitāḥ ||
gāvo viṃśatisāhasrā yāḥ pūrvamupakalpitāḥ || 61 ||
tatra bhaṅguraso nāma mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
tenaiva tā gṛhītā vai vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 62 ||
tataḥ sa pradadau tasya viṃśā gāvo mahādhanāḥ ||
maṅgalyāśca pavitrāśca sarvāśca varadohanāḥ || 63 ||
pradadau dhanaratnāni nityameva dine dine ||
modate saha putreṇa bhāryayā svajanena ca || 64 ||
evaṃ tu vasatastasya varṣākāla upāgataḥ ||
prāvṛḍupasthitā tatra sarvasasyapravarddhinī||65||
puṣpitāni kadambāni kuṭajārjjunakāni ca||
evaṃ duḥkhamanuprāptā striyo yā rahitāḥ priyaiḥ||66||
garjjatāṃ guñjatāṃ caiva dhārāpātanipātitāḥ||
meghāḥ savidyutaścaiva balākāṅgadabhūṣitāḥ||67||
nadīnāṃ caiva nirghoṣo mayūrāṇāṃ ca niḥsvanaḥ||
kuṭajārjjunagandhāśca kadambārjjunapādapāḥ||68||
vātāḥ pravānti te tatra śikhīnāṃ ca sukhāvahāḥ||
śokena kāminīnāṃ ca bhartrā ca rahitāśca yāḥ||69||
gacchatyevaṃ sa kālo hi meghadundubhināditaḥ||
tataḥ śaradanuprāptā agastirudito mahān||70||
taḍāgāni prasannāni kumudotpalavanti ca||
padmaṣaṇḍaiḥ suramyāṇi puṣpitāni samantataḥ||71||
pravānti susukhā vātāḥ sugandhāśca suśītalāḥ||
saptaparṇasugandhāśca śītalāḥ kāmivallabhāḥ||72||
evaṃ śaradi nirvṛtte kaumude samupāgate||
sā tasminmāsi suśroṇi śuklapakṣāntare tadā||73||
ekādaśyāṃ tataḥ subhru snātau kṣaumavibhūṣitau||
ubhau tau dampatī tatra putramūcaturātmanaḥ||74||
uṣitāstvatra ṣaṇmāsānsukhaṃ ca dvādaśī bhavet||
kinno na vakṣyase guhyaṃ yena vai vāritā vayam||75||
pitrostu vacanaṃ śrutvā sa putro dharmaniṣṭhitaḥ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ tayostu kṛtaniścayaḥ||76||
evametanmahābhāga yattvayā paribhāṣitam||
kalyaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi idaṃ guhyaṃ mahaujasam||77||
eṣā vai dvādaśī tāta prabhunārāyaṇapriyā||
maṃgalā ca vicitrā ca viṣṇubhaktasukhāvahā||78||
dadate'syāṃ prahṛṣṭāśca dvādaśyāṃ kaumude site||
dīkṣitāste yogikule viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ||79||
tena dānaprabhāveṇa viṣṇutoṣakareṇa ca||
taranti dustaraṃ tāta ghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram||80||
evaṃ kathayatāṃ teṣāṃ prabhātā rajanī śubhā||
tataḥ sandhyāmupāsyātha udite sūryamaṇḍale||81||
śucirbhūtvā yathānyāyaṃ kṣaumavastravibhūṣitaḥ||
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam||82||
ubhau taccaraṇau gṛhya pitarau samabhāṣata||
śṛṇu tāta mahābhāga yadarthaṃ samupāgataḥ||83||
yadbhavānpṛcchate tāta guhyaṃ saukaravaṃ prati||
khañjarīṭo hyahaṃ tāta pakṣiyonisamudbhavaḥ||84||
bhakṣitāśca pataṃgā me ajīrṇenātipīḍitaḥ||
ahaṃ tenaiva doṣeṇa na śaknomi viceṣṭitum||85||
dṛṣṭvā māṃ vihvalaṃ bālā gṛhītvā krīḍituṃ gatāḥ||
hastāddhastena krīḍantaścānyonyaparihāsayā||86||
tvayā dṛṣṭo mayā dṛṣṭo hyaṃ ceti kaliḥ kṛtaḥ||
tata ekena bālena bhrāmayitvā'kṣayembhasi||87||
na mameti tavetyuktvā hyādityaṃ tīrthamuttamam||
krodhenādāya tīvreṇa kṣipto gaṅgāmbhasi tvarā|| 88||
tatra muktā mayā prāṇāḥ sūryatīrthe mahaujasi||
akāmena viśālākṣi tatprabhāvādahaṃ tataḥ || 89 ||
jātastava suto mātastadetaddinamuttamam ||
akāmānmriyamāṇasya varṣāṇyadya trayodaśa || 90 ||
vyatītāni ca guhyaṃ te kathanaṃ mama caiva yat ||
etatte kathitaṃ tāta guhyamāgamanaṃ prati || 91 ||
ahaṃ karma kariṣyāmi gaccha tāta namo'stu te ||
tato mātā pitā caiva putraṃ punaruvāca ha || 92 ||
viṣṇuproktāni karmāṇi yaṃ yaṃ kārayitā bhavān ||
tānvayaṃ ca kariṣyāmo vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 93 ||
vaṭamālā yathānyāyaṃ karmasaṃsāramokṣaṇam ||
te'pi dīrgheṇa kālena mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ || 94 ||
kṛtvā tu vipulaṃ karma tataḥ paṃcatvamāgatāḥ ||
mama kṣetraprabhāveṇa cātmanaḥ karmaniścayāt || 95 ||
vimuktāḥ sarvasaṃsārācchvetadvīpamupāgatāḥ ||
yo'sau parijanaḥ kaścidgṛhebhyaśca samāgataḥ || 96 ||
sarvaḥ śriyā yutastatra rogavyādhivivarjitaḥ ||
sarve ca yoginastatra sarve cotpalagaṃdhayaḥ || || 97 ||
modante tu yathānyāyaṃ prasādātkṣetrajānmama ||
etatte kathitaṃ devi mahākhyānaṃ mahaujasam || 98 ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi yadvṛttaṃ saukare mama ||
eṣā vyuṣṭirmahābhāge kṣetre yatkriyate mahat || 99 ||
tiryagyonivinirmuktāḥ śvetadvīpamupāgatāḥ ||
ya etatpaṭhate nityaṃ kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ || 100 ||
sa kulaṃ tārayettūrṇaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāvarān ||
na paṭhenmūrkhamadhye tu pāpiṣṭhe śāstradūṣake || 101 ||
na paṭhetpiśunānāṃ ca ekākī tu paṭhedgṛhe ||
paṭhedbrāhmaṇamadhye ca ye ca vedavidāṃ varāḥ || 102 ||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca purato yai va śāstraguṇānvitāḥ ||
viśuddhānāṃ vinītānāṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam || 103 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe khañjarīṭopākhyānaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 138 || 
iti khañjarīṭopākhyānaṃ samāptam ||
atha saukaramāhātmyam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi lipyamānasya yatphalam ||
sarvaṃ te kathayaṣyāmi yathā prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 1 ||
gṛhītvā gomayaṃ bhūme mama veśmopalepayet ||
nyastāni tatra yāvanti padāni ca vilimpataḥ || 2 ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni divi modate ||
yadi dvādaśavarṣāṇi lipyate mama karmasu ||3||
jāyate vipule śuddhe dhanadhānyasamākule ||
divyairnamaskṛto devi kuśadvīpaṃ ca gacchati || 4 ||
kuśadvīpamanuprāpya sahasrāṇi ca jīvati ||
daśa caiva tu varṣāṇāṃ mama bhakto mahāñchuciḥ || 5 ||
kuśadvīpātparibhraṣṭo mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ||
rājā vai jāyate subhru sarvadharmeṣu niṣṭhitaḥ || 6 ||
tena tasya prabhāveṇa mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
bhaktau vyavasthitaścāpi sarvaśāstrāṇi pṛcchati ||7||
devi kārayate sarvaṃ mama cāyatanāni ca||
kārayitvā yathānyāyaṃ mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||8||
gomayasya tu vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare||
gomayantu samāsādya yāvalloko'nugacchati ||9||
samīpe yadi vā dūre gatvā nayati gomayam||
yāvanti tatpadānyasya tāvadvarṣa sahasrakam||10 ||
gomayānāṃ ca netā vai svargaloke mahīyate||
tataḥ sa śālmale dvīpe ramate ca mudā yutaḥ||11||
ekādaśasahasrāṇi ekādaśaśatāni ca ||
śālmalāttu paribhraṣṭo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ||12||
madbhaktaścaiva jāyeta sarvadharmavidāṃ varaḥ ||
atha dvādaśavarṣāṇi macchritaḥ sudṛḍhavrataḥ||13||
vahate gomayaṃ suṣṭhu mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
snānopalepane bhūme salilaṃ yo dadāti ca || 14 ||
tasya puṇyaṃ mahābhāge śṛṇu tatvena niṣkalam ||
yāvanto bindavastatra pānīyasya vasundhare || 15 ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
svargalokātparibhraṣṭaḥ kraucadvīpaṃ ca gacchati || 16 ||
krauṃcadvīpātparibhraṣṭo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
tenaiva guṇayogena śvetadvīpaṃ ca gacchati || 17 ||
saṃmārjjanaṃ pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
yāṃ gatiṃ puruṣā yānti striyo vā karmasu sthitāḥ || 18 ||
śucirbhāgavataḥ śuddho aparādhavivarjitaḥ ||
yāvantaḥ pāṃsavo bhūmeruḍḍīyante tu cālitāḥ || 19 ||
tāvadvarṣaśatānyāśu svargaloke mahīyate ||
svargalokātparibhraṣṭaḥ śākadvīpaṃ sa gacchati || 20 ||
tatra sthitvā ciraṅkālaṃ rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
tato bhuktvā sarvabhogānsthitvā saṃsārasāgare || 21 ||
śvetadvīpaṃ tato gacchenmatkarmanirataḥ śuciḥ ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama || 22 ||
gāyanaṃ ye prakurvanti mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
teṣāṃ yadyatphalaṃ bhūme śṛṇuṣva gadato mama || 23 ||
gīyamānasya gītasya yāvadakṣarapaṅktayaḥ ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi indraloke mahīyate || 24 ||
rūpavānguṇavān siddhaḥ sarvavedavidāṃ varaḥ ||
nityaṃ paśyati tatrastho devarājaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
madbhaktaścaiva jāyeta indralokapathe sthitaḥ ||
sarvakarmaguṇaśreṣṭhastatrāpi mama pūjakaḥ || 26 ||
indralokātparibhraṣṭo mama gītaparāyaṇaḥ ||
nandanopavane ramye ramandevagaṇaiḥ saha || 27||
tataḥ sa bhūmau jāyeta vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha saṃsthitaḥ ||
gāyanmama yaśo nityaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 28 ||
matprasādātsa śuddhātmā mama lokaṃ hi gacchati || 29 ||
sūta uvāca ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mādhavasya yaśasvinī ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūyaḥ pratyuvāca vasundharā || 30 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
aho gītaprabhāvo vai yastvayā kīrttito mahān ||
ke ca gītaprabhāveṇa siddhiṃ prāptā mahaujasaḥ || 31 ||
varāha uvāca ||
tatraiva cāśrame bhadre cāṇḍālaḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ ||
dūrājjāgaraṇe yāti mama bhaktau vyavasthitaḥ || 32 ||
gāyamānaśca gītāni saṃvatsaragaṇānbahūn ||
śvapākaḥ sa guṇajñaśca madbhaktaścaiva sundari || 33 ||
kaumudasya tu māsasya śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśī ||
supte gate yena jāte vīṇāmādāya caṃkramat ||34||
jāgraṃstatra sa cāṇḍālo gṛhīto brahmarakṣasā ||
alpaprāṇaḥ śvapāko vai balavānbrahmarākṣasaḥ || 35 ||
duḥkhaśokena santapto na śaknoti viceṣṭitum ||
tena proktaḥ śvapākena balavānbrahmarākṣasaḥ ||36||
kiṃ tvayā ceṣṭitaṃ mahyaṃ yastvevaṃ paridhāvasi ||
śvapākavacanaṃ śrutvā tena vai brahmarakṣasā ||37 ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ śvādaṃ mānuṣāhāralolupaḥ ||
atheha daśarātraṃ me nirāhārasya tiṣṭhataḥ ||38||
vidhātrā vihitastvaṃ va āhāraḥ pāraṇāvidhau ||
adya tāṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi savasāmāṃsaśoṇitaiḥ ||39||
tṛptiṃ yāsyāmi paramāṃ vidhātrā vihitāṃ mama ||
brahmarakṣovacaḥ śrutvā śvapāko gītalālasaḥ || 40 ||
rākṣasaṃ chandayāmāsa mama bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ ||
evametanmahābhāga bhakṣyo'haṃ samupāgataḥ || 41 ||
avaśyametatkartavyaṃ dhātrā dattaṃ yathā tava ||
kiṃ tvahaṃ devadevasya bhaktyā gātuṃ ca jāgare ||42||
udyaṃstatra gatvāhamupāsya vidhinā harim ||
paścātkhādasva māṃ rakṣo jāgarādvinivartitam || 43 ||
viṣṇoḥ santoṣaṇārthāya yato me vratamāsthitam ||
jāgare vinivṛtte māṃ bhakṣaya tvaṃ yadīcchati || 44 ||
śvapākasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmarakṣaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ ||
uvāca puruṣaṃ vākyaṃ śvapākaṃ tadanantaram || 46 ||
mithyā kiṃ bhāṣase mūḍha punareṣyāmi te'ntikam ||
mṛtyormukhamanuprāpya punarjīvati mānavaḥ || 46 ||
rakṣaso mukhavibhraṣṭaḥ punarāgantumicchasi ||
rākṣasasya vacaḥ śrutvā cāṇḍālastamathābravīt || 47 ||
yadyapyahaṃ hi cāṇḍālaḥ pūrvakarmavidūṣitaḥ ||
samprāpto mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ vihitenāntarātmanā ||48||
śṛṇu matsamayaṃ rakṣo yenāhaṃ punarāgamam ||
dūrājjāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā lokasya dvijarākṣasa||49||
satyena punareṣyāmi manyase yadi muṃca mām ||
satyamūlaṃ jagatsarvaṃ lokāḥ satye pratiṣṭhitāḥ||50||
satyena siddhiṃ prāptā hi ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ||
satyena dīyate kanyā satyaṃ jalpanti brāhmaṇāḥ || 51 ||
satyaṃ jayanti rājānastrīṇyetānyabruvannṛtam ||
satyena gamyate svargo mokṣaḥ satyena cāpyate || 52 ||
satyena tapate sūryaḥ somaḥ satyena rajyate ||
ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīmamāvāsyāmubhe pakṣe caturdaśī || 53 ||
asnātānāṃ gatiṃ yāsye yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ ||
gurupatnīṃ rājapatnīṃ yo'bhigacchati mohitaḥ|| 54||
tāṃ gatiṃ samprapadye'haṃ yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ||
yājakānāṃ ca ye lokā ye ca mithyābhibhāṣiṇām||55||
tāṃ gatiṃ samprapadye'haṃ yadyaṃ nāgame punaḥ||
brahmaghne ca surāpe vā stene bhagnavrate tathā||56||
teṣāṃ gatiṃ prapadye'haṃ yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ||
śvapākavacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭo brāhmaṇarākṣasaḥ||57||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ namo'stu te||
brahmarākṣasamuktvā tu śvapākaḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ||58||
punargāyati mahyaṃ vai mama bhaktau vyavasthitaḥ||
atha prabhāte vimale gīte nṛtye ca jāgare||59||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti śvapākaḥ parivarttate||
tatastvaritamāgatya pumāṃstasyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ||60||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ cāṇḍālaṃ kṛtaniścayam||
kva yāsi tvaritaḥ sādho na ca tvaṃ gantumarhasi||61||
jānankauṇapapaṃ taṃ ca na tvaṃ marttumihārhasi||
puruṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā cāṇḍālaḥ punarabravīt||62||
samayo me kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ rākṣasena hi bhakṣatā||
tena tatra gamiṣyāmi satyaṃ ca paripālayan||63||
tataḥ sa padmapatrākṣaḥ śvapākaṃ pratyuvāca ha||
madhurāṃ giramādāya vihitenāntarātmanā||64||
mā gaccha tatra cāṇḍāla yatrāsau pāparākṣasaḥ||
jīvitārthāya satyasya na doṣaḥ parihāpanāt||65||
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā śvapākaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ||66||
nāhamevaṃ kariṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paribhāṣase||
na cāhaṃ nāśaye satyametanme niścitaṃ vratam||67||
satyamūlaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kulaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam||
satyameva paro dharma ātmā satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ||68||
na caivāhaṃ tadutsṛjya asatyaḥ syāṃ kadācana||
nāhaṃ mithyā cariṣyāmi gaccha tāta namo'stu te||69||
evamuktvā śvapākopi nityaṃ satyavrate sthitaḥ||
rākṣasaṃ samanuprāptastamuvācātha pūjayan||70||
āgato'smi mahābhāga mā vilambaya bhakṣaya||
tvatprasādādahaṃ gantā vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānamuttamam||71||
etāni mama gātrāṇi bhakṣayasva yatheṣṭataḥ||
piboṣṇaṃ rudhiraṃ mahyaṃ pīḍito'si kṣudhā bhṛśam||72||
tarpayasva svamātmānaṃ kuruṣva mama vai hitam||
śvapākasya vacaḥ śrutvā tataḥ sa brahmarākṣasaḥ||73||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śvapākaṃ tadanantaram||
sādhu tuṣṭo'smyahaṃ vatsa satyaṃ dharmaṃ ca pālitam||74||
caṇḍālasyāvidhijñasya yasya te matirīdṛśī||
brahmarakṣovacaḥ śrutvā śvapākaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ||75||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ brahmarākṣasameva tu||
yadyapyahaṃ vai cāṇḍālaḥ sarvakarmavivarjitaḥ||76||
tathāpi satyaṃ vaktavyaṃ brahmarākṣasa nityaśaḥ||
śvapākavacanaṃ śrutvā brahmarakṣo bhayānakam || 77 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śvapākaṃ saṃśitavratam ||
yattvayā gīyate rātrau viṣṇorjāgaraṇaṃ prati || 78 ||
phalaṃ gītasya me dehi yadīccherjīvitaṃ svakam ||
tato mokṣyāmi kalyāṇa bhakṣyāmi na ca bhīṣaṇaḥ ||79||
brahmarakṣovacaḥ śrutvā śvapākaḥ pratyuvāca ha||
mano'jñātamidaṃ vākyaṃ brahmarakṣo nibhāṣase || 80 ||
bhakṣayāmīti coktvā māṃ gītapuṇyaṃ kimicchasi ||
śvapākavacanaṃ śrutvā brahmarakṣo'bravītpunaḥ || 81 ||
dehi me tvekayāmīyaṃ puṇyaṃ gītasya vai param ||
tato mokṣyasi bhakṣyeṇa saṃgataḥ putradārakaiḥ|| 82 ||
śrutvā rākṣasavākyāni cāṇḍālo gītalobhitaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ rākṣasaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ || 83 ||
na gāyanaphalaṃ dadmi brahmarakṣastavepsitam ||
bhakṣayasva yathānyāyaṃ rudhiraṃ piba cepsitam || 84 ||
śvapākavacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasaḥ punarabravīt ||
ekagītasya me dehi yattvayā viṣṇusaṃsadi || 85 ||
etena tārito'smīti tava gītaphalena vai ||
śrutvā vākyāni cāṇḍālo rākṣasasya nivārayan || 86 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ cāṇḍālo vismayānvitaḥ ||
kiṃ tvayā vikṛtaṃ karma tadbrūhi mama rākṣasa || 87 ||
karmaṇo yasya doṣeṇa rākṣasatvaṃ samāgataḥ ||
śvapākavacanaṃ śrutvā brahmarakṣo mahāyaśāḥ || 88 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ duḥkhasantaptamānasaḥ ||
nāmnā vai somaśarmāhaṃ carako brahmayonijaḥ || 89 ||
sūtramantraparibhraṣṭo yajñakarmasu niṣṭhitaḥ ||
tato'haṃ yājayāmyajñān lobhamohaprapīḍitaḥ || 90 ||
pravartamāne yajñe tu kadāciddaivayogataḥ ||
udare jātaśūlo'haṃ tena paṃcatvamāgataḥ || 91 ||
atha pañcamahārātre hyasamāpte kratau tathā ||
asya yajñasya doṣeṇa mātaṃga śṛṇu me vacaḥ ||92||
rākṣasatvamanuprāptastena duṣṭena karmaṇā ||
maṃtrahīnaṃ mayā tatra svarahīnaṃ ca tatkṛtam || 93 ||
sūtrahīnaṃ tathā tatra prāgvaṃśādi kṛtaṃ mayā ||
parimāṇaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca mayā tatropalakṣitam ||94||
kṛtasya tasya doṣeṇa yoniṃ prāpto'smi rākṣasīm ||
svagītaphaladānena nistārayitumarhasi ||95||
mocayasvādhamaṃ pāpādviṣṇugītena satvaram ||
brahmarakṣovacaḥ śrutvā śvapākaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ||93||
bāḍhamityeva tadvākyaṃ rākṣasaṃ prābravīttadā ||

evaṃ tasmātphalaṃ prāpya śvapākādrākṣasastadā||99||
jātaḥ suvimalo bhadre śaradīva yathā śaśī||
śvapakaścāpi suśroṇi mama caivopagāyakaḥ||100||
kṛtvā suvipulaṃ karma sa brahmatvamupāgataḥ||
etadgītaphalaṃ devi prāpnoti manujo bhuvi||101||
mahyaṃ jāgarato bhadre gīyamānaṃ manasvini||
yastu gāyati suśroṇi kaumudīṃ dvādaśīṃ prati||102||
sarvasaṃgaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||
yastu gāyati gītāni mama jāgaraṇe sadā||103||
sarvasaṃgātpramukto vai mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||
etatte kathitaṃ devi gāyanasya phalaṃ mahat||104||
yasya gītasya śabdena taretsaṃsārasāgaram||
vāditrasya pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare||105||
prāptavānmānuṣo yena devebhyaḥ sabalāṃ svayam||
śampātālaprayogeṇa sannipātena vā punaḥ||106||
navavarṣasahasrāṇi navavarṣaśatāni ca ||
kuberabhavanaṃ gatvā modate vai yadṛcchayā||107||
kuberabhavanādbhraṣṭaḥ svacchandagamanālayaḥ||
śamyāditālasampātairmama lokaṃ sa gacchati||108||
nṛtyamānasya vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare|
mānavo yena gacchettu cchittvā saṃsārabandhanam||109||
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi triṃśadvarṣaśatāni ca||
puṣkaradvīpamāsādya svacchandagamanālayaḥ||110||
phalaṃ prāpnoti suśroṇi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ||
rūpavān guṇavāñchūraḥ śīlavānsatpathe sthitaḥ||111||
madbhaktaścaiva jāyeta saṃsāraparimocitaḥ||
yastu jāgarito nityaṃ gītavādyena narttakaḥ||112||
jambūdvīpaṃ samāsādya rājarājastu jāyate||
sarvakarmasamāyukto rakṣitā vai mahīpatiḥ||113||
madbhaktaścaiva jāyeta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ||
upahāryāṇi puṣpāṇi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ||114||
yo māmupanayedbhūme mama karmapathe sthitaḥ||
puṣpāṇi tatra yāvanti mama mūrddhani dhārayet||115||
sa kṛtvā puṣkalaṃ karma mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||
etatte kathitaṃ devi bhaktānāṃ tu mahaujasām||116||
mama bhaktasukhārthāya sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam||
ya etatpaṭhate bhūme kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ||117||
sa tu tārayate janturdaśa pūrvāndaśāparān||
na paṭhenmūrkhamadhye tu piśunānāṃ puro na ca||118||
paṭhedbhāgavatānāṃ ca madhye muktiratātmanām||
aśraddadhāne krūre vā na paṭheddevale tathā||119||
yadīcchetsiddhikalyāṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ ca mama priyam||
dharmāṇāṃ paramo dharmaḥ kriyāṇāṃ paramā kriyā||120||
mā paṭhecchāstradūṣāya adhyāyaṃ vā kadācana||
yadīcchetparamāṃ siddhiṃ mama loke mahīyate||121||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saukare cāṇḍālabrahmarākṣasasaṃvāde saukaramāhātmyaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||139||
atha kokāmukha(badarī) māhātmyam||
dharaṇyuvāca||
śrutāni devasthānāni tvayā proktāni yānyuta||
kasmiṃstiṣṭhasi nityaṃ tvaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati||1||
kiṃca te paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra mūrttyākṛtirbhavān||
kasminsthāne kṛtaṃ karma yena yātyuttamāṃ gatim||2||
śrīvarāha uvāca||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsale ||
yeṣu sthāneṣu tiṣṭhāmi kathyamānānimāñchṛṇu||3||
tava kokāmukhaṃ nāma yanmayā pūrvabhāṣitam||
badarīti ca vikhyātaṃ girirājaśilātalam||4||
sthānaṃ lohārgalaṃ nāma mleccharājasamāśritam||
kṣaṇaṃ cāpi na muṃcāmi evametanna saṃśayaḥ||5||
sacaityaṃ paśya me sthānaṃ jagadetaccarācaram||
sarvatrāhaṃ varārohe na mannyūnaṃ hi jānate||6||
ye tu jānanti māṃ devi guhyāṃ kāmagatiṃ mama||
śīghraṃ kokāmukhaṃ yāntu mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ||7||
tato devavacaḥ śrutvā pṛthivī vākyamabravīt||
śirasyañjalimādhāya nirvṛtenāntarātmanā||8||
dharaṇyuvāca||
sarvato lokanātheśa paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me||
kathaṃ kokāmukhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhasi||9||
śrīvarāha uvāca||
nāsti kokāmukhātkṣetraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kokāmukhācchuci||
nāsti kokāmukhātsthānaṃ nāsti kokāmukhātpriyam||10||
yastu kokāmukhaṃ gatvā bhūyo vinivarttate||
karmāṇi tatra kurvīta ceṣṭaṃ bhavati cātmani||11||
yāni yāni ca kṣetrāṇi tvayā pṛṣṭāni vai dhare|
kokāmukhasamaṃ sthānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati||12||
mama sā paramā mūrttiryāṃ na jānanti gopitām||
sthitaṃ kokāmukhaṃ nāma etatte kathitaṃ mayā||13||
śrīvarāha uvāca||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi||
tasmin kokāmukhaṃ ramyaṃ kathyamānaṃ mayā'naghe||15||
jalabinduriti khyātātparvatātpattanādbhuvi||
tattu guhyatamaṃ devi kṛtvā karma mahaujasam||16||
sarvasaṅgānparityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||
viṣṇudhāreti vikhyātā kokāyāṃ mama maṇḍale||17||
parvatātpatitā bhūmau dhārā musalasannibhā||
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā snāyāttatra prayatnataḥ||18||
agniṣṭomasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ|
na muhyati sa karttavye phalaṃ prāpnoti cottamam||19||
jāyate vipule śuddhe mama mārgānusāriṇi||
tatrātha muṃcati prāṇānviṣṇudhārāṃ samāśritaḥ||20||
paśyate paramāṃ mūrttimetāṃ mama na saṃśayaḥ||
tatra viṣṇupadaṃ nāma sthānaṃ kokāmukāśritam||21||
etatkaścinna jānāti dhare vārāhasaṃśritam||
tasminkṛtodako devi naro rātrāvupoṣitaḥ|| 22||
krauṃcadvīpe prajāyeta mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ||
tatrātha muṃcati prāṇānguhyasthāne pare mama||23||
sarvasaṅgānparityajya mama loke sa gacchati||
asti viṣṇusaro nāma krīḍitaṃ yattvayā saha||24||

tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta prātaḥkāle vasundhare||25||

somatīrthamiti khyātaṃ kokāyāṃ mama maṇḍale ||26||

gomede jāyate dvīpe mama mārgānusārakaḥ ||
tatrātha muñcate prāṇanguhyakṣetre pare mama || 28 ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śuddhātmā māṃ sa paśyati ||
tuṃgakūṭetivikhyātaṃ kokāyāṃ mama maṇḍale || 29 ||
caturdhārāḥ patantyatra parvatāducchrayaṃ śritāḥ ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ pañcarātroṣito naraḥ||30||
kuśadvīpaṃ samāsādya mama lokeṣu tiṣṭhati ||
anityamāśramaṃ nāma kṣetrakarmasukhāvaham ||31||
devāśca yaṃ na jānanti kimpunarmanujādayaḥ ||
tatra snātvā varārohe ahorātroṣito naraḥ || 32 ||
jāyate puṣkaradvīpe mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
atha tatra mṛto bhūme puṇyakṣetre mahāśuciḥ || 33 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
astyatrāgnisaro nāma paraṃ guhyaṃ mama sthitam ||34||
paṃca dhārāḥ patantyatra girikuñjasamāśritāḥ ||
tatra cāpi kṛtasnānaḥ pañcarātroṣito naraḥ || 35 ||
kuśadvīpe ca jāyeta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
tatrātha muñcate prāṇān kṛtvā karma mahaujasam||36||
kuśadvīpātparibhraṣṭo brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati||
asti brahmasaro nāma guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama ||37|||
yatra dhārā patatyekā puṇyā bhūmiśilātale||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta pañcarātroṣito naraḥ ||38||

athā'tra muṃcate prāṇānsūryadhārāṃ samāśritaḥ || 39 ||
sūryalokamatikramya mama lokaṃ tu gacchati ||
asti dhenuvaṭaṃ nāma guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama||40||

tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta ekamekaṃ dinaṃ tathā || 41 ||
saptarātroṣito bhūtvā mama karma samāśritaḥ ||

tatrātha muṃcate prāṇānmama bhaktisamanvitaḥ ||43 ||
saptadvīpamatikramya mama lokaṃ tu gacchati ||

agnivarṇastato bhūtvā mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||

tatrā'tha muṃcate prāṇānmama karmaṇyavasthitaḥ ||
sarvasaṃgaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||80|||
asti matsyaśilā nāma guhyaṃ kokāmukhe varam ||

meruśṛṃgaṃ samullaṅghya gama lokaṃ ca gacchati || 85||
paṃcayojanavistāraṃ kṣetraṃ kokāmukhaṃ mama ||
yastvetattu vijānāti na sa pāpena lipyate || 86 ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
tasminkokāmukhe ramye tiṣṭhāmi dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||87||
śilācandanasaṃkāśaṃ devānāmapi durlabham ||
varāharūpamādāya tiṣṭhāmi puruṣākṛtiḥ || 88 ||
vāmonnatamukhaṃ kṛtvā vāmadaṃṣṭrāsamunnatam ||
paśyāmi ca jagatsarvaṃ ye ca bhaktā mama priyāḥ ||89||
ye māṃ smaranti vai bhūme puruṣā muktakilbiṣāḥ ||
tatra kurvanti karmāṇi śuddhāḥ saṃsāramokṣaṇe ||90||
yadi kokāmukhaṃ gacchet kadācitkālaparyaye ||
mā tato vinivartteta yadīcchenmama tulyatām || 91 ||
guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyametatsthānaṃ paraṃ mahat ||
siddhānāṃ paramā siddhirguhyaṃ kokāmukhaṃ param || 92 ||
na ca sāṃkhyena yogena siddhiṃ yānti mahāparām ||
yāti kokāmukhaṃ gatvā rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā ||93||
evaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mahābhāge yattvayā paripṛcchim ||
paramaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchase ||94||
ya etatkathitaṃ bhūme kokāmukhamanuttamam ||
tāritāḥ pitarastena daśa pūrvāstathā parāḥ || 95 ||
mṛto vā tatra jāyeta śuddhe bhāgavate kule ||
ananyamānaso bhūtvā mama mārgapradarśakaḥ ||96||
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ kalya utthāya mānavaḥ ||
tyaktvā paṃcaśataṃ janma mama bhaktaśca jāyate || 97 ||
ya etatpaṭhate nityaṃ kokākhyānaṃ tathoṣasi ||
gacchate paramaṃ sthānamevametanna saṃśayaḥ ||98||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre kokāmukhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||140 ||
atha badarikāśramamāhātmyam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
tasminhimavataḥ pṛṣṭhe paraṃ guhyamataḥ śṛṇu ||
badarīti ca vikhyātā devānāmapi durllabhā ||1 ||
na tatprāpnoti manujaḥ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||
prāpnuvanti ca bhaktā ye badarīṃ viśvatāriṇīm || 2 ||
durllabhaṃ tanmama kṣetraṃ himakūṭaśilātale ||
yastatprāpnoti hi kṣetraṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || 3 ||
brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātamāste tatra śiloccaye ||
himasaṃsthaṃ tathātmānaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhāmi mādhavi || 4 ||
snānaṃ karoti yastatra trirātropoṣito naraḥ ||
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 5 ||
muñcetprāṇāṃstatra yadi vrataniṣṭho jitendriyaḥ ||
satyalokamatikramya mama lokaṃ ca gacchati || 6 ||
agnisatyapadaṃ nāma tasminkṣetre paraṃ mama ||
śṛṅgatrayātpatantyatra dhārā musalasannibhāḥ || 7 ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ trirātropoṣito naraḥ ||
satyavādī bhaveddakṣo mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 ||
yastatra muñcate prāṇānyadi kṛtvā jalāśayam ||
satyalokamatikramya mama loke sa modate || 9 ||
indralokamiti khyāto badaryāṃ ca mamāśramaḥ ||
tatrāhaṃ devi śakreṇa niṣkalaṃ paritoṣitaḥ ||10 ||
tatra caiva tu śṛṅgebhyaḥ sthūladhārā patetpunaḥ ||
sthūle śilātale tatra mama dharmo vyavasthitaḥ ||11 ||
snānaṃ karoti yastatra ekarātroṣito naraḥ||
satyavādī śucirbhūtvā satyaloke mahīyate||12||
athātra muñcate prāṇānkṛtvā cānāśakaṃ vratam||
satyalokamatikramya mama lokeṣu tiṣṭhati ||13||
asti pañcaśikhaṃ nāma badaryāśramatīrthakam ||
yatra dhārāḥ patantyatra paṃcaśṛṅgasamāśritāḥ ||14||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ paṃcasrotasi mānavaḥ ||
aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya devaiśca saha modate || 15 ||
yadyatra muñcate prāṇān kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||
svargalokamatikramya mama loke mahīyate ||16||
catuḥsrota iti khyātaṃ tasminkṣetre pare mama ||
caturdhārāḥ patantyatra catasro diśa āśritāḥ ||17||
yastatra kurute snānamekarātroṣito naraḥ ||
modate nākapṛṣṭhe tu mama bhaktaśca jāyate||18||
atha prāṇānparityajya kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram||
nākapṛṣṭhamatikramya mama lokaṃ prapadyate||19||
vedadhāramiti khyātaṃ tasminkṣetre pare mama ||
yatra brahmamukhādbhraṣṭā vedāścatvāra eva ca || 20 ||
tatraiva himavatpṛṣṭhe catuḥśṛṅgādbṛhattarāḥ ||
caturdhārāḥ patantyatra viṣamāśca śiloccaye ||21||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ catūrātroṣito naraḥ ||
caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ grahaṇe kāraṇaṃ bhavet||22||
athātra muñcate prāṇānmama karmapathe sthitaḥ|
devalokamatikramya mama lokaṃ pratiṣṭhate || 23 ||
dvādaśādityakuṇḍeti tasminkṣetre pare mama ||
yatra te dvādaśādityā devi saṃsthāpitā mayā ||24||
tatra parvataśṛṃge tu sthūlamūle śilātale ||
dvādaśa patanti dhārā mama karmasukhāvahāḥ || 25||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ yāṃ kāñciddvādaśīṃ yadi||
yatra te dvādaśādityāstatra gacchenna saṃśayaḥ||26||
athātra muñcate prāṇānmama karmaṇi saṃsthitaḥ ||
samatikramya cādityān mama loke mahīyate||27||
lokapālamiti khyātaṃ tasminkṣetre pare mama||
tatra te lokapālāstu mayā saṃsthāpitāḥ purā||28||
tatra parvatamadhye tu sthalakuṇḍaṃ bṛhanmama ||
bhitvā parvatamudgīrṇaṃ yatra somasamudbhavaḥ || 29 ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta jyeṣṭhamāsasya dvādaśīm ||
modate lokapāleṣu mama bhaktaśca jāyate||30 ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānmama karmasu tatparaḥ ||
lokapālānatikramya mama lokaṃ prapadyate||31 ||
asti merorvaraṃ nāma tasmin guhyaṃ paraṃ mama ||
tatra sthitena vai bhūme meruḥ saṃsthāpitaḥ svayam || 32 ||
dhārāstisraḥ patantyatra suvarṇasadṛśaprabhāḥ ||
patettu tajjalaṃ bhūmau vyaktiṃ naivopalabhyate ||33||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ trirātropoṣito naraḥ ||
modate meruśṛṃgeṣu mama bhaktaśca jāyate ||34||
atha tatra mṛto devi tasmin guhye pare mama ||
merupṛṣṭhamatikramya mama lokaṃ tu gacchati || 35 ||
mānasodbhedamiti ca tatrānyattīrthamuttamam ||
pṛthvīmudbhidya madhye tu jalaṃ gacchati satvaram ||36||
devā api na jānanti taṃ deśaṃ tatra saṃsthitam ||
mānuṣā hi vijānanti bhūmyāṃ patati tajjalam ||37||
yastatra kurute snānamahorātroṣito naraḥ ||
modate mānase divye mama bhaktaśca jāyate ||38||
asti pañcaśiraṃ nāma tasminguhyaṃ paraṃ mama ||
brahmaṇā cchidyate yatra śiraścaiva mahādyuti || 39||
tatra vai paṃca kuṇḍāni sthūlaśīrṣaśiloccaye ||
pañcātra śirasaḥ sthāne bahudhārāsamanvitāḥ || 40 ||
yatra tanmadhyamaṃ kuṇḍaṃ chinnameva svayambhuvā ||
tatra raktajalā bhūmirdṛśyate dhārasaṃkulā ||41||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ paṃcarātroṣito naraḥ ||
modate brahmalokastho mama bhaktaśca jāyate ||42||
tathātra muñcate prāṇān guhye pañcaśire mama ||
jalacāṃdrāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā mama karmasu niṣṭhitaḥ ||43||
buddhimānmatimāṃścaiva rāgamohavivarjitaḥ ||
brahmalokamatikramya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||44||
asti somābhiṣeketi tīrthamanyatparaṃ mama|
rājatve brāhmaṇānāṃ tu mayā somo'bhiṣecitaḥ ||45 ||
tatrāhaṃ toṣitastena atriputreṇa mādhavi ||
navapañcakakoṭyastu kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||46||
prāptaśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ matprasādādvasundhare ||
tadāyattaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vrīhayaḥ paramauṣadhīḥ ||47||
jāyate'sminpralīyaṃte skandendrāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ ||
bhūme somamayaṃ sarvaṃ mama saṃsthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||48||
tatra somagirirnāma yatra dhārā patedbhuvi ||
kuṇḍe'raṇye viśāle tu etatte kathitaṃ mayā || 49 ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ trirātropoṣito naraḥ ||
modate somalokeṣu evametanna saṃśayaḥ ||50 ||
athātra mriyate devi kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||
somalokamatikramya mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||51||
asti corvaśikuṇḍeti guhyaṃ kṣetre paraṃ mama ||
yatra caivorvaśī bhittvā dakṣiṇorumajāyata ||52||
tatra tapyāmyahaṃ devi devānāmapi kāraṇāt ||
na māṃ kaścidvijānāti svātmāno hi vijānate ||53||
tato me tapyamānasya bahuvarṣavyatikramāt ||
devā api na jānanti vajribrahmamaheśvarāḥ ||54||
ekaikena phalenā'tra badaryāṃ tu suniścitam ||
bahuvarṣasahasraṃ tu tapaścīrṇaṃ mayā bhuvi ||55||
tatrāhaṃ daśa koṭyastu daśavarṣaṃ daśārbudam ||
daśa bhūme tathānyāni padmāni tapasi sthitaḥ ||56||
tataste māṃ na paśyanti devā guhyapathe sthitam ||
vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmurdevā duḥkhaparāyaṇāḥ || 57||
ahaṃ paśyāmi sarvaṃ vai tapaḥsaṃstho vasundhare ||
na māṃ sarve prapaśyanti yogamāyāsamāvṛtāḥ || 58 ||
tatastā devatāḥ sarvāḥ pratyūcuśca pitāmaham ||
viṣṇunā ca vinā loke śāntiṃ naiva labhāmahe || 59 ||
devānāṃ tu vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā lokāpitāmahaḥ ||
yogamāyāpaṭacchannaṃ kathayāmāsa māṃ tadā || 60 ||
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ||
tatra jagmurmahābhāge tuṣyantaḥ paramaṃ mudā || 61 ||
vibhāvayanti māṃ tatra devā indrapurogamāḥ ||
tvayā nātha parityaktā duḥkhitāḥ śramavarjitāḥ || 62 ||
trāyasva no hṛṣīkeśa paramānugraheṇa vai ||
etatkṛtvā viśālākṣi devān praṇatipūrvakam || 63 ||
mayā vilokitāḥ sarve parāṃ nirvṛtimāgatāḥ ||
etasminnurvaśīkuṇḍe ekarātroṣito naraḥ || 64 ||
yaḥ snāti sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
urvaśīlokamāsādya krīḍate kālamakṣayam || 65 ||
yastatrotsṛjate prāṇānmama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
puṇyapāpavinirmukto yāti mallīnatāṃ priye || 66 ||
śrībadaryāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ yatra yatra sthitaḥ smaret ||
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ || 67 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ madbhaktaḥ satataṃ paṭhet ||
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ || 68 ||
dhyānayogarato nityaṃ sa muktiphalabhāgbhavet ||
yasyaitadviditaṃ sarvaṃ dhyānayogaṃ vasundhare || 69 ||
yo'vagacchati cātmānaṃ sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ||70 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre badarikāśramamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||141 ||
atha guhyakarmamāhātmyam ||
sūta uvāca ||
tato devavacaḥ śrutvā dharmakāmā vasundharā ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā prasādayati mādhavam || 1 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
dāsyāṃ me praṇayaṃ kṛtvā vijñāpyaṃ śṛṇu mādhava ||
mṛdunā ca svabhāvena vakṣyāmi tvāṃ janārdana || 2 ||
alpaprāṇabalā nāryo yattvayā paribhāṣitam ||
aśaktāḥ sahituṃ hyetāḥ kṣudhātvanaśane'balāḥ || 3 ||
bhuñjamānā narā hyatra rajasā yāṃti śaṃ param ||
annaṃ hyanugrahaṃ deva yena te karma saṃśritāḥ || 4 ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā mādhavyāḥ sa tu mādhavaḥ ||
prahasya bhāvaśuddhātmā tata evamabhāṣata || 5 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
sādhu devi varārohe mama karmavyavasthite ||
pṛṣṭo'haṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ mama bhaktasukhāvaham || 6 ||
spṛṣṭā yā rajasā devi mama karmaparāyaṇā ||
māṃ saṃspṛśantu tatrasthaṃ yatra tiṣṭhāmi sundari || 7 ||
yadi bhāvastadā kaścidbhojane kāyasādhane ||
cittaṃ nyasya mayi kṣoṇi bhoktavyaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ || 8 ||
na sā lipyati doṣeṇa bhuñjamānā rajasvalā||
añjaliṃ śirasā kṛtvā mayoktaṃ mantramuttamam ||9 ||
( anādimadhyāntamajaṃ purāṇaṃ rajasvalā devavaraṃ namāmi ||)
tata etena mantreṇa bhuktvā devi rajasvalā ||
karoti yāni karmāṇi na tairduṣyeta karhicit || 10 ||
snātvā sā tu mahābhāge paṃcamāttu dinātpunaḥ ||11 ||
yathārhaṃ kurute karma maccittā matparāyaṇā ||
prāpnuyātpuruṣatvaṃ ca nyastasaṃsāracintanāt || 12 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
puruṣā vā striyo vāpi na pumāṃso na vā striyaḥ ||
kathaṃ doṣeṇa mucyante janmasaṃsārabandhanāt ||13 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
indriyāṇi nigṛhyātha cittamapyanuveśya ca ||
mayi saṃnyāsayogena mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 14 ||
mama yogeṣu saṃnyāsamekacitto dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
evaṃ kurvanmahābhāge striyo vā punnapuṃsakam || 15 ||
jñānasaṃnyāsayogaṃ vā yadīcchetparamāṃ gatim ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 16 ||
mano buddhiśca cittaṃ ca te hyanīśāḥ śarīriṇām ||
ekacittaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā jñānena pṛdhulocane || 17 ||
samacittaṃ prapadyante na te lipyanti mānavāḥ ||
sarvabhakṣyāṇi bhakṣantaḥ peyāpeyāṃstathaiva ca || 18||
samaṃ cittaṃ mayi yadi tadā tasya na ca kriyā ||
cittaṃ manaśca buddhiśca matsaṃsthaṃ ca samaṃ yadi ||19||
yatkiṃcitkurvataḥ karma padmapatramivāṃbhasi ||
saṃyogānna ca lipyeta samatvādeva nānyathā ||20||
rātrindivaṃ muhūrtaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ vā yadi vā kalā||
nimeṣaṃ vā truṭiṃ vātha devi cittaṃ samaṃ kuru||21||
sadā divāniśoścaiva kurvantaḥ karmasaṅkaram ||
te'pi yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ yadi cittaṃ vyavasthitam||22||
jāgrataḥ svapato vāpi śṛṇvataḥ paśyato'pi vā ||
yo māṃ citte ciṃtayati maccintasya ca kiṃ bhayam ||23||
durvṛttamapi cāṇḍālaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cā'pathi sthitam ||
taṃ tu devi praśaṃsāmi nānyacittaṃ kadācana || 24 ||
yajantaḥ sarvadharmajñā jñānasaṃskārasaṃskṛtāḥ ||
mayi cittaṃ samādhāya mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||25||
ye matkarmāṇi kurvanti mayā hṛdi samāśritāḥ ||
sukhaṃ nidrāṃ samādhāya svapantaḥ karmasaṃsthitāḥ || 26 ||
yeṣāṃ praśāṃtaṃ cittaṃ vai te'pi devi mama priyāḥ ||
sarvamātmani karma svaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham ||27||
prāpnuvanti ca duḥkhāni bhramaccittā narādhamāḥ ||
cittaṃ nāśo hi lokasya cittaṃ mokṣasya kāraṇam ||28|||
tasmāccittaṃ samādāya māṃ prapadyasva medini ||
nyasya jñānaṃ ca yogaṃ ca ekacittā bhajasva mām || 29 ||
maccittaḥ satataṃ yo māṃ bhajeta niyatavrataḥ ||
matpārśvaṃ prāpya paramaṃ madbhāvāyopapadyate || 30 ||
mayā caiva purā sṛṣṭaṃ prajārthena vasundhare ||
māse māse tu gantavyamṛtukāle vyavasthitam || 31 ||
ekacittaṃ samādāya yadīcchettu mama priyam ||
na gacchedyadi māse tu ṛtukālavyavasthitam || 32 ||
pitarastasya hanyante daśa pūrvā daśāparāḥ ||
na tatra kāmalobhena mohena ca vasundhare || 33 ||
tyaktvānaṅgaṃ ca mohaṃ ca pitrarthāya striyaṃ vrajet ||
dvitīyāṃ na spṛśennārīṃ lobhamohātkathaṃcana || 34 ||
na saṃspṛśettṛtīyāṃ tu caturthī na kadācana ||
kṛte saṃbhogadharme tu kṛtakautukasaṃsthitaḥ || 35 ||
śayane na striyaṃ paśyedyadīcchecchuddhimuttamām ||
kautuke kṛtakṛtye tu mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 33 ||
jalasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryādanyavastraparigraham ||
apūrṇe ṛtukāle tu yo'bhigacchedrajasvalām ||37 ||
retaḥpāḥ pitarastasya evametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
ekāṃ tu puruṣo yāti dvitīyāṃ kāmamohitaḥ ||38 ||
tṛtīyāṃ vā caturthīṃ vā tadā sa puruṣo'dhamaḥ ||
sarvasyaiva tu lokasya samayo'yaṃ hi matkṛtaḥ || 39 ||
ṛtukāle tu sarvāsāṃ pitrarthaṃ bhoga iṣyate ||
ṛtukālābhigāmī yo brahmacāryeva saṃmataḥ || 40 ||
na gacchati ca yaḥ krodhānmohādvā puruṣādhamaḥ ||
ṛtau ṛtau bhrūṇahatyāṃ prāpnoti puruṣaścaran || 41 ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare||
jñānaṃ tu cittayogasya karmayogasya yatkriyā||42||
karmaṇā yānti matsthānaṃ yānti madgānaniṣṭhitāḥ ||
yānti yogavidaḥ sthānaṃ nāsti cānyā parā gatiḥ || 43 ||
jñānaṃ yogaṃ ca sāṃkhyaṃ ca nāsti cittavyapāśritam ||
labhante puṣkalāṃ siddhiṃ mama mārgānusāriṇaḥ || 44 ||
yastu bhāgavato bhūtvā ṛtukāle vyavasthitaḥ ||
vāyubhakṣastatastiṣṭhedbhūme trīṇi dināni ca ||49 ||
atha tatra caturthe tu dine prāpte vasundhare ||
kṛtvā vai siddhikarmmāṇi na gacchatyaparāṇi ca || 46 ||
tataḥ snānena kurvīta śiraso malaśodhanam ||
śuklāṃbaradharo bhūtvā cittaṃ kṛtvā samāhitam || 47 ||
tato buddhiṃ manaścaiva samaṃ kṛtvā vasundhare ||
paścātkurvanti karmāṇi sadā te me hṛdi sthitāḥ || 48 ||
mama prāpaṇakaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kurvanti bhojanam ||
añjaliṃ śirasā kṛtvā mayoktaṃ karma sasmitam || 49 ||
tatra mantraḥ -
ādirbhavānguptamanantamadhyo rajasvalā deva vayaṃ namāmaḥ ||
upoṣitāstrīṇi dināni caivaṃ muktau rataṃ vāsudevaṃ namāmaḥ || 50 ||
tata etena mantreṇa śuddhā bhūme rajasvalāḥ ||
ye tu kurvanti karmāṇi snātāsnātāni bhāgaśaḥ || 51 ||
evaṃ duṣyati no devi nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā ||
kurvanti mama karmāṇi te yathāvanmama priyāḥ || 52 ||
sarvāṇyanudinaṃ bhadre mama cittānusāriṇaḥ ||
prāpnuyātpuruṣaḥ strī vā rajasā dūṣitā api || 53 ||

iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre guhyakarmamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvācatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 142 ||
atha mandāramahimanirūpaṇam ||

tasya dakṣiṇapūrveṇa samasroto varāṃgaṇe ||

tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta ekabhaktoṣito naraḥ ||

athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama cittavyavasthitaḥ ||
chitvā vai sarvasaṃsāraṃ mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 26 ||

modate pūrvapārśve ca merau tasmiñchiloccaye || 28 ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇān kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||
