tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta ahorātroṣito naraḥ ||
modate dakṣiṇe śṛṅge mahāmerau śiloccaye || 31 ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānkṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||
meruśṛṅgaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ prapadyate || 32 ||
dakṣiṇe paścime bhāge mandārasya yaśasvini ||
atra dhārā patatyekā ādityasamatejasā || 33 ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta ahorātroṣito naraḥ ||
modate paścime bhāge dhruvo yatra pravartate || 34 ||

sarvapāpavinirmukto mama loke ca modate || 35 ||

sarvasaṃgaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ prapadyate || 47 ||

|| sūta uvāca ||

śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu tattvena me devi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||

īśvareṇa samaṃ pūrvamahamāsaṃ vasundhare ||

yatra sthitvā trirātreṇa tapasaḥ phalamaśrute || 72 ||

tena rāvaṇanṛtyena prakhyāto narttanācalaḥ ||73 ||
snātvā tu bāṇagaṃgāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇeśvaraṃ prabhum ||
gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ prāpya modate devavaddivi || 74 ||
sālaṅkāyanako'pyāśu kṣetre tasminparaṃ mama ||
śālagrāme mahātīvramāsthitaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 75 ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi paraṃ guhyaṃ vasundhare ||
tapyatastasya tu mune rīśvareṇa samaṃ sutam ||76||
prāpyāmīti paraṃ bhāvaṃ jñātvā devo maheśvaraḥ ||
sundaraṃ tvaparaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā dṛṣṭisukhāvaham || 77 ||
sālaṅkāyanaputratvaṃ yogamāyāmupāśritaḥ ||
prāpto'pi taṃ na jānāti dakṣiṇaṃ pāśvarmāsthitaḥ ||78||
māyāyogabalopetastryakṣo vai śūlapāṇidhṛk ||
rūpavān guṇavāṃścaiva vapuṣādityasannibhaḥ || 79 ||
sa taṃ na jñāyate jātaṃ mamaivārādhane sthita ||
atha nandī prahasyāha mahādevājñayā munim || 80 ||
uttiṣṭha muni śārdūla saphalaste manorathaḥ ||
tvaddakṣiṇāṅgājjāto'smi putraste śādhi māṃ prabho ||81 ||
tvayā tapaḥ samārabdhamīśvareṇa samaṃ sutam ||
prāpsyāmīti tato mahyaṃ sadṛśo'nyo na kaścana ||82||
vicāryeti tavāhaṃ vai jāto'smi svayameva ca ||
tapasārādhayandevaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam ||83||
prāpto'si paramāṃ siddhiṃ tvatputro'haṃ yataḥ sthitaḥ ||
śrutvā tannandino vākyaṃ prahṛṣṭavadano muniḥ || 84 ||
vismitastu tadovāca kathaṃ nādyāpi me hariḥ||
dṛggocaratvamāyāti jātaṃ cettapasaḥ phalam || 85 ||
yāvattaṃ na samīkṣiṣye tāvanna virataṃ tapaḥ ||
ahamatraiva vatsyāmi yāvadacyutadarśanam ||86||
tvamapi yogena mathurāṃ vraja satvaram ||
madāśrame tatra puṇye dhanaṃ govrajasaṃkulam || 87 ||
āmuṣyāyaṇamādāya śīghramatra samānaya || 88 ||
tatastvājñāṃ samādāya nandī satvaramāvrajat ||
gatvā ca mathurāṃ tasya ṛṣerāśramamīkṣya ca|| 89 ||
dṛṣṭvāmuṣyāyaṇaṃ tatra pṛṣṭvā nāma tamapyuta ||
gṛhe vitte ca kuśalamapṛcchadgodhaneṣu ca || 90 ||
sālaṃkāyanaśiṣyo'pi āmuṣyāyaṇasaṃjñitaḥ ||
sarvatra kuśalaṃ sādho prabhāvāttu gurormama ||91 ||
gurośca kuśalaṃ brūhi kutrāste sa tapodhanaḥ ||
bhavān kutaḥ samāyātaḥ kimatrāgamakāraṇam ||92 ||
tanme vistarato brūhi arghyaścaivopagṛhyatām ||
ityuktaḥ so'rghyamādāya viśramya ca tato guroḥ || 93 ||
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa tvāgamasya ca kāraṇam ||
tatastenaiva sahito godhanaṃ tatpragṛhya ca || 94 ||
dinaiḥ katipayaiścaiva gaṇḍakītīramāśritaḥ ||
śanairuttīrya ca tatastriveṇīṃ prāpya harṣitaḥ || 95 ||
devikā nāma devānāṃ prabhāvācca tapasyatām ||
niyamārthaṃ samudbhūtā gaṃḍakyā militā śubhā || 96 ||
āśramādaparā cāsītpulastyapulahāśramāt ||
gaṃḍakyā militā sāpi triveṇī gaṇḍakītyabhūt || 97||
kāmikaṃ tanmahātīrthaṃ pitṝṇāmativallabham ||
tatra sthitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ trijaleśvarasaṃjñitam ||98||
muktibhuktipradaṃ devi darśanādaghanāśanam || 99 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
prayāge yā triveṇīti yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ||
śūlaṭaṅka iti khyātaḥ someśa iti cāparaḥ || 100 ||
veṇīmādhavanāmnā'pi yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ||
gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva sarasvatyaparā nadī || 101 ||
sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ sarasāmapi||
sarveṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ samājastatra me śrutaḥ ||102||
yatrāplutā divaṃ yānti mṛtā muktiṃ prayānti ca ||
tīrtharāja iti khyātaṃ tattīrthaṃ keśavapriyam || 103||
saiva triveṇī vikhyātā kimapūrvāṃ praśaṃsasi ||
etadguhyatamaṃ proktaṃ tvayā viṣṇo na saṃśayaḥ ||104 ||
tatkathyatāṃ mahābhāga lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||
mayyanukrośubuddhyā ca kṛpāṃ kuru dayānidhe || 105 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇuṣva devi bhadraṃ te yadguhyaṃ pari pṛcchasi ||
atra te kīrttayiṣyāmi setihāsāṃ kathāṃ śubhām || 106 ||
purā viṣṇustapastepe lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||
himālaye girau ramye devatāgaṇasevite || 107 ||
tato bahutithe kāle yāte sati tapasyataḥ||
tīvraṃ tejaḥ prādurāsīdyena lokāścarācarāḥ ||108 ||
tasyoṣmaṇā samudbhūtaḥ svedapūrastu gaṇḍayoḥ ||
tena jātā dhunī divyā lokānāmaghahāriṇī || 109 ||
maharlokādayaḥ sarve vismitāḥ sarvato diśam ||
tasya prabhavamicchanto jñātuṃ neśuḥ kathaṃcana||110||
devāḥ sarve tato jagmurbrahmāṇaṃ prati cotsukāḥ||
papracchuḥ prabhavaṃ tasya praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ||111||
brahmāpi hi na jānāti mohitastasya māyayā ||
tato devaiḥ samaṃ brahmā śaṅkaraṃ pratyupasthitaḥ || 112 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā devaiḥ sametaṃ pratyupasthi tam||
papraccha taṃ mahādevastadāmanakāraṇam||113||
brahmā taṃ ca mahādevaṃ papraccha praṇataḥ sthitāḥ||
atyadbhutaṃ mahattejaścādbhutaṃ kiṃ maheśvara ||114 ||
yena pratyāhatā kṣmā'sau jagadvyatikarāvahā ||
kinnu syātkathamatetsyātkaścāsya prabhavo vibho || 115 ||
śivaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tato dhyātvā brahmādyān pratyuvāca ha ||
mahaso'sya samutpattiṃ mahato darśayāmi vaḥ || 116 ||
jagāma devasahitaḥ somaḥ sahagaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||
yatrāste bhagavānviṣṇurmahatā tapasānvitaḥ || 117 ||
uvāca paramaprītastadā śambhuḥ smayanniva ||
tapasyasi kimicchantastvaṃ karttā jagatāṃ prabhuḥ || 118 ||
sarvādhāro' khilādhyakṣastatkiṃ yattava durllabham ||
evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca praṇamya jagatāṃ prabhuḥ || 119 ||
ahaṃ lokahitārthāya tapastaptuṃ samudyataḥ ||
tvatto varānabhīpsanvai tvaddarśanasamutsukaḥ || 120 ||
tvaddarśanamamanuprāpya kṛtārtho'smi jagatpate || 121 ||
śiva uvāca ||
muktikṣetramidaṃ deva darśanādeva muktidam ||
gaṇḍasvedodbhavā yatra gaṇḍakī saritāṃ varā || 122 ||
bhaviṣyati na sandeho yasyā garbhe bhaviṣyati ||
tvayi sthite jaga nnāthe tava sānnidhyakāraṇāt || 123 ||
ahaṃ brahmā ca devāśca ṛṣibhiḥ saha keśava ||
sarve vedāśca yajñāśca sarvatīrthāni cāpyuta || 124 ||
vasiṣyāmaḥ sadaivātra gaṇḍakyāṃ jagatāṃ pate ||
kārttikaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ yaḥ snāsyati naraḥ prabho || 125 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto muktibhāgī na saṃśayaḥ ||
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam ||126 ||
yatra snānena labhyeta gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ naraiḥ ||
smaraṇāddarśanātsparśānniṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ || 127 ||
yasyāstatsamatāṃ kānyā labhedgaṃgāṃ vinā nadīm ||
yatra sā paramā puṇyā gaṇḍakī bhuktimuktidā || 128 ||
aparā devikā nāmnā gaṇḍakyā saha saṃgatā ||
pulastyapulahau pūrvaṃ tepāte paramaṃ tapaḥ || 129 ||
yatra sṛṣṭividhānārthaṃ kṛtvāśramapadaṃ pṛthak ||
sṛṣṭervidhānasāmarthyaṃ yatra labdhaṃ tataḥ param || 130 ||
tato'bhūdbrahmatanayā puṇyā sā saritāṃ varā ||
gaṇḍakyā yatra militā brahmaputrī yaśasvinī || 131 ||
triveṇī sā mahāpuṇyā devānāmapi durllabhā ||
dhare jānīhi tatkṣetraṃ yojanaṃ paramārccitam||132||
purā vedanidheḥ putrau jayo vijaya eva ca ||
yajanāya gatau rājñā vṛtau tau kardamātmajau ||133||
tṛṇabindoḥ sutau pāpau jātau dṛṣṭyaiva suvratau ||
yajñavidyāsunipuṇau vedavedāṃgapāragau ||134||
pūjayantau hariṃ bhaktyā tanniṣṭhendriyamānasau ||
yayoḥ pūjayatornityaṃ sānnidhyaṃ kila keśavaḥ || 135 ||
dadāti pūjāvasare bhaktyā kila vaśīkṛtaḥ ||
maruttena kadācittāvāhūtau kuśalau dvijau || 136 ||
rājñā samāptayajñena pūjayitvā puraskṛtau ||
dakṣiṇābhistoṣayitvā visṛṣṭau gṛha māgatau || 137 ||
vibhāgaṃ karttumārabdhau pasparddhāte parasparam ||
samo vibhāgaḥ karttavya iti jyeṣṭho'bhyabhāṣata ||138 ||
vijayaścābravīccainaṃ yena labdhaṃ hi tasya tat ||

vijayo'pyabravīnnūnamandhībhūto'ti kiṃ dhanaiḥ || 140 ||

triveṇīkṣetramadhye tu jayo'bhūdvai mahāngaja||142||
kariśāvairgajībhiśca krīḍamāno vane vasan ||
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi vyatītāni tayostadā||143||
vane viharatorbhūme śāpamohitayoḥ satoḥ ||
kadācitsa gajaḥ snātuṃ kareṇu gaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ || 144 ||
triveṇīmabhito yāto'vagāhanaparāyaṇaḥ ||
siṃcankareṇūstābhiśca sicyamāno jalaṃ piban || 145 ||
svayaṃ ca pāyayaṃstāśca cikrīḍa prītamānasaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃkrīḍatastatra daivayogena tasya hi || 146 ||
grāhaḥ sampreritaḥ pūrvaṃ vairayogamanusmaran ||
jagrāha sudṛḍhaṃ pādaṃ gajo'pi ca viṣāṇataḥ || 147 ||
grāhaṃ vivyādha so'pyenamākarṣayata tajjale ||
tayoryuddhaṃ samabhavadanekābdaṃ vikarṣaṇaiḥ || 148 ||
ākarṣaṇaiśca bahubhirddantabhedaiḥ parasparam||

sudarśanena cakreṇa grāhāsyaṃ samapāṭayat || 151 ||

saṅghaṭṭanāttu cakrasya śilāścakreṇa lācchitāḥ || 152 ||
bāhulyena babhūvurhi tasminkṣetre pare mama ||

na sandehastvayā kāryastriveṇīṃ prati sundari ||
triveṇīkṣetramahimā evaṃ te parikīrttitaḥ || 154 ||
yadā ca bharato rājā pulastyasyāśramāntike ||
sthitvā paryacaradviṣṇuṃ trijaleśamapūjayat || 155 ||
tataḥprabhṛti tasyāsīdbharatenāratiḥ sphuṭam ||
punaśca mṛgadehānte jaḍaḥ sa bharato'bhavat || 156 ||
tainaiva pūjito yasmājjaleśvara iti smṛtaḥ ||
yasya saṃpūjanādbhaktyā yogasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 157 ||
śālagrāme pare kṣetre yadāhaṃ subhage sthitaḥ ||
tatra jñātvā jaleśena stuto'haṃ vasudhe mahi || 158 |||
tato bhaktakṛpāveśātkṣiptavāṃstatsudarśanam ||

tatra snānena tejasvī sūryaloke mahīyate ||
yadi prāṇairviyujyeta mama loke mahīyate ||160||
bhaktasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya mayājñaptaṃ sudarśanam ||
yatra yatra bhramati tattatra tatrāṃkitāḥ śilāḥ || 161||
evaṃ tadvai bhramākṣiptaṃ sarvaṃ cakamayaṃ tvabhūt ||

godhanānyagrataḥ kṛtvā harikṣetraṃ jagāma ha ||
hariṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ kṣetraṃ pūjanīyaṃ tataḥ smṛtam || 163 ||
yadā nandī śūlapāṇirgodhanena puraskṛtaḥ ||
sthitavāṃstaddinādetatkhyātaṃ hariharaprabham||164||
devānāmaṭanāccaiva devāṭa iti saṃjñitam ||
tasya devasya mahimā kena vaktuṃ hi śakyate ||165||
sa śūlapāṇirdeveśo bhaktābhayavidhāyakaḥ ||
munibhirddevagandharvaiḥ sevyate'cintyaśaktimān || 166 ||
tasminsthāne mahādevaḥ sālaṅkāyanakasya hi ||
putratvaṃ nandirūpeṇa prāptaḥ sākṣācchivaḥ prabhuḥ || 167 ||
svayaṃ caiva mahāyogī yogasiddhividhāyakaḥ ||
āsthitaḥ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ tīrthe caiva tridhārake || 168 ||
trijaṭābhyo'bhavandhārā stisro vai paramādbhutāḥ ||
gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva puṇyā caiva sarasvatī || 169 ||
etattraidhārikaṃ tīrthaṃ trijaṭābhyaḥ samutthitam ||
yatra śambhuḥ sthitaḥ sākṣānmahāyogī maheśvaraḥ || 170 ||
śālagrāmābhidhe kṣetre hariśīlanatatparaḥ ||
diśañjñānaṃ svabhaktānāṃ saṃsārādyena mucyate || 171 ||
tīrthe tridhāre yaḥ srātvā santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||
mahāyoginamabhyarcya na bhūyo janmabhāgbhavet || 172 ||
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge haṃsatīrthamiti smṛtam ||
tatraikaṃ kautukaṃ vṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahattaram || 173 ||
kadācicchivarātryāṃ tu bhaktaiḥ pūjāmahotsave ||

tatra kākāḥ samutpeturanne tasminbubhukṣitāḥ ||
gṛhītvānnaṃ tu tatkākastena coḍḍīya nirgataḥ ||175|||
tadgṛhītuṃ paraḥ kāka stenāyudhyata cāṃbare ||

yakṣalokamatikramya mama lokaṃ prapadyate || 180 ||

etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ guhyaṃ vasundhare ||

atha sālagrāmakṣetramāhātmyam ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
bhagavandevadeveśa sālaṃkāyanako muniḥ ||
kiṃ cakāra tapaḥ kurvaṃstava kṣetre vimuktide || 1 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca||

tapyamāno yathānyāyaṃ paśyanvai sālamuttamam || 2 ||
abhinnamatulacchāyaṃ viśālaṃ puṣpitaṃ tathā ||

vaiśākhamāsadvādaśyāṃ maddarśanamupāgataḥ || 7 ||

sālavṛkṣaṃ samāśritya nibhṛtenāntarātmanā || 17 ||

tavaivārādhanārthāya tapastaptaṃ mayā hare || 18 ||
paryaṭāmi mahīṃ sarvāṃ saśailavanakānanām ||
idānīṃ khalu dṛṣṭo'si cakrapāṇe mahāprabho || 19 ||
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva sarvaśāntikaraḥ paraḥ ||

tadā dehi jagannātha mameśvara samaṃ sutam ||
eṣa eva varo mahyaṃ dīyatāṃ madhusūdana || 21 ||
evaṃ varaṃ yācito'smi muninā bhīmakarmaṇā ||
putrakāmena vipreṇa dīrgha kālaṃ tapasyatā || 22 ||
evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇasya tapasvinaḥ ||
madhurāṃ giramādāya pratyavocamṛṣiṃ prati || 23 ||
cirakālaṃ vratasthena yattvayā cintitaṃ mune ||
sa kāmastava sañjātaḥ siddho'si tapasā bhavān || 24 ||
īśvarasya parā mūrttirnāmnā vai nandikeśvaraḥ ||
tvaddakṣiṇāṃgādudbhūtaḥ putrastava munīśvara || 25 ||
saṃharasva tapo brahmañśāntiṃ gaccha mahāmune ||
atha caitasya jātasya kalpā vai sapta sapta ca || 26 ||
tvaṃ na jānāsi viprarṣe sa jāto nandikeśvaraḥ ||
māyāyogabalopeto govrajaṃ sa mayā sthitaḥ ||27||
mathurāyāḥ samānīya āmuṣyāyaṇasaṃjñitam ||
tava śiṣyaṃ puraskṛtya śūlapāṇiravasthitaḥ ||28||
tatrāśrame mahābhāga sthitvā tvaṃ tapasāṃ nidhe ||
putreṇa paramaprīto matkṣetre'smatsamo bhava||29||
anyacca guhyaṃ vakṣyāmi sālaṅkāyana tacchṛṇu ||
tava prītyā pravakṣyāmi yenaitatkṣetramuttamam || 30 ||
śālagrāmamiti khyātaṃ tannibodha mune śubham ||
yo'yaṃ vṛkṣastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ so'hameva na saṃśayaḥ || 31 ||
etatko'pi na jānāti vinā devaṃ maheśvaram ||
māyayā'haṃ nigūḍho'smi tvatprasādātprakāśitaḥ || 32 ||
evaṃ tasmai varaṃ dattvā sālaṃkāyanakāya vai || 33 ||
paśyatastasya vasudhe tatraivāntarhito'bhavam ||
vṛkṣaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvā jagāma svāśramaṃ muniḥ || 34 ||
mama tadrocate sthānaṃ girikūṭaśiloccaye ||
śālagrāma iti khyātaṃ bhaktasaṃsāramokṣaṇam || 35 ||
tatra guhyāni me bhūme vakṣyamāṇāni me śṛṇu ||
taranti manujā yebhyo ghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram || 36 ||
guhyāni tatra vasudhe tīrthāni daśa paṃca ca ||
nādyāpi kiṃcijjānanti mucyante yairiha sthitāḥ || 37 ||
tatra bilvaprabhaṃ nāma guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ mama priyam ||
kuñjāni tatra catvāri krośamātre yaśasvini || 38 ||
hṛdyaṃ tatparamaṃ guhyaṃ bhaktakarmasukhāvaham ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta ahorātroṣito naraḥ || 39 ||
caturṇāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karmasu niṣṭhitaḥ || 40 ||
aśvamedhaphalaṃ bhuktvā mama loke sa modate ||
cakrasvāmīti vikhyātaṃ tasminkṣetre paraṃ mama || 41 ||
cakrāṅkitaśilāstatra dṛśyante ca itastataḥ ||
cakrāṅkitaśilā yatra varavarṇini tiṣṭhati || 42 ||
tadetadviddhi vasudhe samantā dyojanatrayam ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta trirātropoṣito naraḥ ||43||
trayāṇāmapi yajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti niścitam ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karma parāyaṇaḥ || 44 ||
vājapeyaphalaṃ bhuktvā mam lokaṃ ca gacchati||
tatra viṣṇupadaṃ nāma kṣetraṃ guhyaṃ paraṃ mama ||45||
tisro dhārāḥ patantyatra himakūṭaṃ samāśritāḥ ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta trirātropoṣito naraḥ||46||
trayāṇāmapi rātrīṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti niṣkalam ||
tathaiva muṃcate prāṇānmuktasaṃgo gata klamaḥ || 47 ||
atirātraphalaṃ bhuktvā mama loke mahīyate ||
tatra kālīhradaṃ nāma guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama || 48 ||
atra caiva hradasroto badarīvṛkṣaniḥsṛtaḥ ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta ṣaṣṭikāloṣito naraḥ || 49 ||
naramedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmuktarāgo gata klamaḥ || 50 ||
naramedhaphalaṃ bhuktvā mama loke ca modate ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi mahāścaryaṃ vasundhare || 51 ||
tatra śaṅkhaprabhaṃ nāma guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama||
śrūyate śaṃkhaśabdaśca dvādaśyāmarddharātrake || 52 ||
gadākuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ tasminkṣetre paraṃ mama ||
yatra vai kampate sroto dakṣiṇāṃ diśāmāśri tam || 53 ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta trirātropoṣito naraḥ ||
vedāntagānāṃ viprāṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 54 ||
atha vai muṃcate prāṇānkṛtakṛtyo guṇānvitaḥ ||
gadāpāṇirmahākāyo mama lokaṃ prapadyate || 55 ||
punaścāgniprabhaṃ nāma guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama ||
dhārā patati tatraikā pūrvottarasamāśritā ||56||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ catūrātroṣito naraḥ ||
agniṣṭomātpaṃcaguṇaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||57||
athātra muṃcate prāṇān mama karmasu niṣṭhitaḥ ||
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ bhuktvā mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||58||
tatrāścaryaṃ mahābhāge kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu ||
hemante coṣṇakaṃ tīrthaṃ grīṣme bhavati śītalam || 59 ||
guhyaṃ sarvāyudhaṃ nāma tatra kṣetre paraṃ mama ||
patanti sapta srotāṃsi himavanniḥsṛtāni vai || 60 ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta saptarātroṣito naraḥ ||
rājā bhavati suśroṇi savāryudhakalānvitaḥ || 61 ||
atha vai muṃcate prāṇānmama karmāviniścitaḥ ||
sa bhuktvā rājya bhojyāni mama lokaṃ ca gacchati || 62 ||
tatra devaprabhaṃ nāma guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama ||
dhārāḥ paṃcamukhāstatra pataṃti girisaṃśritā || 62||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta tvaṣṭakāloṣito naraḥ ||
caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ yāti pāraṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 64 ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇām̐llobhamohavivarjjitaḥ ||
vedakarma samutsṛjya mama loke mahīyate || 65 ||
guhyaṃ vidyādharaṃ nāma tatra kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama ||
paṃca dhārāḥ patantyatra himakūṭaviniḥsṛtāḥ || 66 ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ mekarātroṣito naraḥ ||
yāti vaidyādharaṃ lokaṃ kṛtakṛtyo na saṃśayaḥ ||67||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānvītarāgo gataklamaḥ ||
bhuktvā vaidyādharānbhogānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||68||
tatra puṇyanadī nāma guhyakṣetre pare mama ||
śilākuñjalatākīrṇā gandharvāpsarasevitā ||69||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta aṣṭa rātroṣito naraḥ ||
saptadvīpeṣu bhramati svacchaṃdagamanālayaḥ || 70 ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānmama kamārnusārakaḥ ||
saptadvīpān samutsṛjya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||71||
gandharveti ca vikhyātaṃ tasmin kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama ||
ekadhārā patatyatra paścimāṃ diśamāśritā ||72||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta catūrātro ṣito naraḥ ||
modate lokapāleṣu svacchaṃdagamanālayaḥ || 73 ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānmamakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
lokapālānparityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||74||
tatra devahradaṃ nāma mama kṣetraṃ vasundhare ||
yatra kāṃtāsi me bhūme baleryajñavināśanāt||75||
sa hrado varadaḥ śreṣṭho manojñaḥ sukhaśītalaḥ ||
agādhaḥ saukhyadaścāpi devānāmapi durllabhaḥ ||76||
tasmin hrade mahābhāge mama vai niyamodake ||
matsyāścakrāṃkitāścaiva paryaṭante itastataḥ ||77||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasuṃdhare ||
mahāścaryaṃ viśālākṣi yatra tatparivarttate ||78||
paśyeti śraddadhānastu na paśyatpāpapūruṣaḥ||
tasmindevahrade puṇyaṃ caturviṃśatirdvādaśa ||79||
sauvarṇāni ca padmāni dṛśyante bhāskarodaye ||
tāvatpaśyanti bhūtāni yāvanmadhyandinaṃ bhavet || 80 ||
yatra snātā divaṃ yāṃti śuddhā vākkāyajairmalaiḥ ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta daśarātroṣito naraḥ ||81||
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ prāpnotyavikalaṃ phalam ||
athā'tra muñcate prāṇānmama ciṃtāvyavasthitaḥ ||82||
aśvamedhaphalaṃ bhuktvā bhūme matsamatāṃ vrajet ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi kṣetraṃ guhyaṃ paraṃ mama||83||
saṃbhedo devanadyostu samastasukhavallabhaḥ ||
divo'vatīrya tiṣṭhanti devā yatra sahapriyāḥ ||84||
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva nāgakanyāḥ sahoragaiḥ ||
devarṣayaśca munayaḥ samastasuranāyakāḥ || 85 ||
siddhāśca kinnarāścaiva svargādavataranti hi ||
nepāle yacchivasthānaṃ samastasukhavallabham || 86 ||
tebhyastebhyaśca sthānebhyastīrthebhyaśca viśeṣataḥ ||
mahādevajaṭājūṭānnīlakaṇṭhācchivālayaḥ || 87 ||
śvategaṃgeti yā proktā tayā saṃbhūya sādaram ||
nānā nadyaḥ samāyātā dṛśyādṛśyatayā sthitāḥ || 88||
gaṇḍakyā kṛṣṇayā caiva yā kṛṣṇasya tanūdbhavā ||
tayā saṃbhedamāpannā yā sā śivatanūdbhavā ||89||
triśūlagaṃgetyākhyātā sāpi tatra mahānadī ||
evaṃ nadīsamudbhedaḥ sarvatīrthakadaṃbakam || 90 ||
mama kṣetre samākhyātaṃ puṇyaṃ paramapāvanam ||
vasudhe tvaṃ vijānīhi devānāmapi durllabham || 91 ||
yacca siddhāśrama iti vikhyātaḥ puṇyavarddhanaḥ ||
śaṃbhostapovanaṃ tatra sarvāśramavaraṃ prati || 92 ||
nānāpuṣpaphalopetaṃ kadalīṣaṇḍamaṇḍitam ||
niculaiścaiva punnāgaiḥ kesaraiśca virājitam || 93 ||
kharjjūrāśokabakulaiścūtaiścaiva priyālakaiḥ ||
nārikelaiśca pūgaiśca caṃpakairjaṃbubhirdhavaiḥ || 94 ||
nāraṃgairbadarībhiśca jaṃbīrairmātuluṃgakaiḥ ||
ketakīmallikājātīyūthikārājirājitam || 95 ||
kundaiḥ kuravakairnāgaiḥ kuṭajairdāḍimairapi ||
āgatya yatra krīḍanti devānāṃ mithunāni ca || 96 ||
tasminhrade mahāpuṇye puṇyanadyostu saṃgame ||
snānācchatāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 97 ||
snātvā tatra tu vaiśākhe gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet ||
māghamāse punaḥ snātvā prayāgasnānajaṃ phalam ||98||
kārttike māsi yaḥ snāti tulāsaṃsthe divākare ||
vidhinā niyataḥ so'pi muktibhāgī na saṃśayaḥ || 99 ||
yastrirātramuṣitvā tu niyate niyatā śanaḥ ||
rājasūyaphalaṃ prāpya modate devavaddivi || 100 ||
yajñastapo'thavā dānaṃ śrāddhamiṣṭasya pūjanam ||
yatkiṃcitkriyate karma tadanantaphalaṃ bhavet || 101 ||
bhūme tasyāparādhāṃśca sarvāneva kṣamāmyaham ||
gaṃgāyamunayoryadvatsaṃgamo marttyadurllabhaḥ || 102 ||
tathaivāyaṃ devanadyo saṃgamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ||
etadguhyaṃ paraṃ devi mama kṣetre vasundhare || 103 ||
ahamasminmahākṣetre dhare pūrvamukhaḥ sthitaḥ ||
śālagrāme mahākṣetre bhūme bhāgavata priyaḥ || 104 ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
antarguhyaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yanna jānanti mohitāḥ || 105 ||
śivo me dakṣiṇasthāne tiṣṭhanvai vigatajvaraḥ ||
lokānāṃ pravaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvalokavaro haraḥ ||106||
taṃ ye vindanti te devi nūnaṃ māmeva vindati ||
ye māṃ vidanti deveśi te vidanti śivaṃ param ||107||
ahaṃ yatra śivastatra śivo yatra vasundhare ||
tatrāhamapi tiṣṭhāmi āvayornāntaraṃ kvacit ||1 08||
śivaṃ yo vandate bhūme sa hi māmeva vandate ||
labhate puṣkalāṃ siddhimevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ || 109 ||
evametanmahābhāge kṣetraṃ hariharātmakam ||
mṛtā ye'tra gatiṃ yānti mama karmānusāriṇaḥ ||110||
muktikṣetraṃ prathamato rurukhaṇḍaṃ tataḥ param ||
saṃbhedo devanadyośca triveṇī ca tataḥ param ||111||
kṣetraṃ pramāṇaṃ vijñeyaṃ gaṇḍakī saṅgataṃ param ||
evaṃ sā gaṇḍakī devi nadīnāmuttamā nadī ||112||
gaṅgayā militā yatra bhāgīrathyā mahāphalā ||
aparaṃ tanmahatkṣetraṃ harikṣetramiti smṛtam ||113||
ādau sā gaṇḍakī puṇyā bhāgīrathyā ca saṅgatā ||
tasya tīrthasya mahimā jñāyate na surairapi ||114||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre śālagrāmasya sundari ||
gaṇḍakyāścaiva māhātmyaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ||115||
pūrvapṛṣṭaṃ tayā yacca puṇyaṃ bhāgavatapriyam ||
ākhyānānāṃ mahākhyānaṃ dyutīnāṃ paramā dyutiḥ ||116||
puṇyānāṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ tapasāṃ ca mahattapaḥ ||
guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ gatīnāṃ paramā gatiḥ ||117 ||
mahālābhastu lābhānāṃ nāstyasmādaparaṃ mahat ||
piśunāya na dātavyaṃ na śaṭhāya gurudruhe ||118||
ye ca pāpāḥ kṛtaghnāśca dvijadevāparādhinaḥ ||
kuśiṣyāya na dātavyaṃ na dadyācchāstradūṣake ||1 19||
nīcāya na ca dātavyaṃ ye na jānanti sevitum ||
suśiṣyāya ca dātavyaṃ dhīrāya śubha buddhaye ||120||
lobhamohamadādyairye varjitāḥ puṇyabuddhayaḥ ||
ya etatpaṭhate nityaṃ kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ ||121||
kulāni tāritānyevaṃ sapta sapta ca sapta ca ||
evaṃ maraṇakāle tu na kadācidvimuhyate ||122||
yadīcchetparamāṃ siddhiṃ mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
kṣetrasya śālagrāmasya māhātmyaṃ paramaṃ mayā ||123||
kathitaṃ te mahādevi kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||124||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre śālagrāmakṣetramāhātmyaṃ nāma paṃcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 145||
atha rurukṣetrasthahṛṣīkeśamāhātmyam ||
sūta uvāca ||
śālagrāmasya māhātmyaṃ śrutvā guhyaṃ mahaujasam ||
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā hṛṣṭā vacanamabravīt || 1 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ yattvayā bhāṣitaṃ hare ||
etacchrutvā mahābhāga jātāsmi vigatajvarā || 2 ||
ruruṣaṇḍamiti proktaṃ yattvayā paramārccitam ||
rururnāma kathaṃ ko vā āsītpūrvaṃ janārdana || 3 ||
yannāmnā paramaṃ kṣetraṃ hṛṣīkeśa tvayāśritam ||
kathayasva jagannātha yadyanugrāhyatā mayi || 4 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
āsītpurā mahābhāgo devadatta iti dvijaḥ ||
bhṛguvaṃśe samutpanno vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ||5||
yajñavidyāsu kuśalo vrataniṣṭho'tithipriyaḥ ||
tatrāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyadrumalatānvitam||6||
śāntairmṛgagaṇaiḥ kīrṇaṃ kandamūlaphalānvitam ||
tatra tīvraṃ tapo'tapyaddevadatto munīśvaraḥ ||7||
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ tata indro vyacintayat ||
kāmaṃ vasantasahitaṃ gandharvān sa sakhīnpunaḥ || 8 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ kṣubdhendriyamanāḥ prabhuḥ ||
aho sakhāyaḥ kiṃcinme mahatkāryamupasthitam || 9 ||
tasya me cintayānasya yūyameva parā gatiḥ ||
bhavatprasādātsvastho'haṃ nirbhayastadvicintyatām || 10 ||
tadindrasya vacaḥ śrutvā te kāmamalayānilāḥ ||
pratyūcurdevarājānamājñāpaya nijaṃ priyam || 11 ||
jitendriyasyāpi manaḥ kasya saṃkṣobhayāmahe ||
kaṃ vā sutīvrāttapaso bhraṃśayāmaḥ supeśalam || 12 ||
ājñāprasādaṃ te labdhvā vada śīghraṃ sukhī bhava ||
ityuktaḥ śatamanyurvai pratyuvācā'tha mānayan || 13 ||
tadaiva me gatā cintā bhavatāṃ darśanaṃ yadā ||
jātamevā'khilaṃ kāryaṃ mama tacchṛṇutākhilāḥ || 14 ||
himaśaile mahāramye hṛṣīkeśāśrito muniḥ ||
devadatta iti khyātastapasyati mahattapaḥ ||15||
jighṛkṣurme padaṃ nūnaṃ tattapo vinivartyatām ||
ityuktāste tadājñāṃ vai gṛhītvā śirasā drutam || 16 ||
prasthānāya matiṃ cakruḥ kāmadevapuraḥsarāḥ ||
prasthāpyāgre vasantaṃ ca malayānilameva ca || 17 ||
tataḥ surapatiḥ śakraḥ pramlocāṃ nāma nāmataḥ ||
praśasya praṇayātpūrvaṃ mānayannidamabravīt || 18||
gaccha svastimatī devi vijayāya munerbhuvi ||
yatrāśramapadaṃ tasya devadattasya vai muneḥ || 19 ||
lalitaiḥ svairvilāsaistaṃ mohayitvā vaśaṃ kuru ||
yathā matprītiratulā tvaṃ me kāryakarī sadā ||20||
tathā kuruṣva bhadraṃ te hṛṣīkeśasamīpataḥ ||
indrasyājñāṃ samādāya yayau tasyāśramaṃ prati || 21 ||
samīpopavane ramye nānādrumalatākule ||
madhurālāpabahule kokilānāṃ kalākule || 22 ||
rasālamañjarīvyāptarasāmodālisaṃkule ||
guṃjanmattālisannādaśrutiśrutidharānvite || 23 ||
gandharvagītasaṃmiśre malayānilaśītale ||
samphullapaṅkajavane sunirmalajalāśaye || 24 || 
muniprabhāvasantyaktakrauryasthalajalāśaye ||
madhurāmodamadhure cittakṣobhavidhāyini ||25||
praviśya sā varārohā gītaṃ sumadhuraṃ jagau ||
yadā dhyānāduparataḥ samādherviratāścirāt ||26||
gāndharvaṃ prārabhaṃste tu gandharvāḥ surasammatāḥ ||
tasminneva kṣaṇe labdhvā'vasaraṃ paṃca sāyakaḥ || 27 ||
vicakarṣa dhanuḥ pauṣpaṃ sāyakān samayūyujat ||
saṃlakṣya taṃ muniṃ śāntaṃ bhāvidaivabalātkṛtam ||28||
śrutvā tanmadhuraṃ gītaṃ pañcamālāpasundaram ||
kṣubdhacittaḥ samabhavatsa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ||29||
cakarṣa ca dhanuḥ kāmaḥ punaḥpunaratandritaḥ ||
devavrato'pi sa muniḥ kṣubdhātmā niyato'pi san||30||
vicacārāśramapadaṃ paśyansantuṣṭamānasaḥ||
dūrāddadarśa tanvaṅgīṃ krīḍantīṃ kandukena tām||31||
dṛṣṭvaiva tāṃ tu cārvaṃgīṃ viddhaḥ kāmena patriṇā ||
tasyāḥ samīpamagamatsmayamāno mahāmuniḥ ||32||
sāpi dṛṣṭvā devadattaṃ sajjantī hariṇekṣaṇā ||
kaṭākṣayantī sahasā lajjamānā vigūhati || 33 ||
kareṇa kandukaṃ ghnantī cañcalākṣī supeśalā ||
sraṃsatā keśapāsena galatpuṣpeṇa rājatā || 34 ||
mano harantī tasyarṣeḥ lalitairvibhramodbhavaiḥ ||
etasminnantare tasyā dakṣiṇaḥ pavano'harat||35||
vāsaḥ sūkṣmaṃgalannīvi kāṃcīdāmaguṇānvitam ||
puṣpabāṇo'pyavidhyattaṃ dṛṣṭvā 'vasaramantike ||36||
sammohitaḥ sa tu munirgatvāntikamathābravīt ||
kā tvaṃ kasyāsi subhage vane'sminkiñcikīrṣasi || 37 ||
mādṛśānkiṃ mṛgayase bāhupāśena vā mṛgān ||
baddhvā gṛhītvā vāmoru kiṃ vā'smānkarttumicchasi||38||
sarvathā'smāṃstavādhīnān yadyadvā kārayiṣyati ||
tattatkurmo vayaṃ nityaṃ tadadhīnāḥ sma sarvathā ||39||
atha tāṃ hasamānāṃ ca gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare||
samāliṅgya viṣajjaṃtīṃ ramayāmāsa mohitaḥ ||40||'
ramamāṇastayā sārddhaṃ bhuñjanbhogān manoramān ||
tapaḥprabhāvopanatāndivārātramataṃdritaḥ ||41 ||
bahūnahargaṇānevaṃ ramamāṇo yadṛcchayā ||
suptotthita ivākasmādvivakena samanvitaḥ ||42||
nirvedaṃ prāptavānsadyastadovāca bhṛśāturaḥ ||
aho bhāgavatī māyā yayāhaṃ bhṛśamohitaḥ || 43 ||
jānannapi tapobhraṃśaṃ prāpto daivabalātkṛtaḥ ||
agnikuṇḍasamā nārī ghṛtakumbhasamaḥ pumān ||44||
iti pravādo mūrkhāṇāṃ vicārānmahadantaram ||
ghṛtakumbho'gni yogena dravate na tu darśanāt ||45||
pumāṃstrīdarśanādeva dravate yadvimohitaḥ ||
nāparādhastvato nāryāḥ svayaṃ yadajitendriyaḥ ||46||
ityuktvā'sau nivṛttātmā visasarja surāṅganām ||
pramlocā daivavaśago manasyetadacintayat || 47 ||
upasargo mahānatra tapaso bhraṃśakārakaḥ ||
tyaktvāśramamimaṃ cānyatsthānaṃ gatvā samāhitaḥ || 48 ||
tapastīvraṃ samāsthāya śoṣayiṣye kalevaram ||
iti niścitya manasā gatvā bhṛgvāśramaṃ prati ||49||
gaṇḍakīsaṃgame snātvā santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ ca sampūjya tapaḥsthānaṃ viciṃtayan ||50 ||
paśyanbhṛgvāśramaṃ ramyamuttaraṃ gatavān śanaiḥ ||
gaṇḍakyāḥ pūrvabhāge tu viviktaṃ vijanaṃ śubham || 51 ||
dṛṣṭvā tīreṣu viśrāṃtastapobhūmimaciṃtayat ||
bhṛgutuṃgaṃ samāsādya śaṅkarārādhane rataḥ ||52||
atapyata tapo ghoraṃ śivadarśanalālasaḥ ||
atha dīrgheṇa kālena santuṣṭaḥ sa maheśvaraḥ || 53 ||
liṃgarūpadharaḥ sākṣāduparyapi tathā hyadhaḥ ||
tiryak ca jaladhārābhiryuktastattāpaśāṃtikṛt || 54 ||
uvāca ca prasannātmā mune paśya ca māṃ śivam ||
māmevāvehi viṣṇuṃ tvaṃ mā paśyasvāṃtaraṃ mama || 55 ||
pūrvamantarabhāvena dṛṣṭavānasi yanmama ||
tena vighno'bhavadyena galitaṃ tvattapo mahat || 56 ||
āvāmekena bhāvena paśyaṃstvaṃ siddhimāpsyasi ||
tapaḥprabhāvālliṃgāni prādurbhūtāni yatra vai ||57||
samaṃgamiti vikhyātametatsthānaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
snātvā'tra gaṇḍakītīrthe mama liṃgāni yo'rccayet ||58||
tasya yogaphalaṃ samyagbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti dattvā varaṃ śambhustatraivāntaradhīyata ||59||
devadatto'pi sa muniḥ samprāpya jñānamuttamam ||
śivopadiṣṭamārgeṇa sāyujyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 60 ||
pramlocāpi munergarbhaṃ samprāpyāśramamantikāt ||
prasūtāṃ kanyakāṃ tyaktvā svargameva jagāma ha || 61 ||
punarjātamivātmānaṃ manyamānā śucismitā ||
sāpi kanyā mṛgaistatra rurubhirvarddhitā satī || 62 ||
rururitveva vikhyātā piturevāśrame sthitā ||
yuvabhiḥ prārthyamānāpi citte kañcana nādhyagāt ||53||
tataḥ suniścayaṃ kṛtvā tapase dhṛtamānasā ||
cintayantī jagannāthaṃ bhagavantaṃ ramāpatim ||64||
māse sā prathame bālā phalāhāraparāyaṇā ||
ekāṃtaraṃ dinaṃ prāpya dvitīye tridināntare || 65||
tṛtīye paṃcama dine caturthe saptamāṃtare ||
pañcame navarātreṇa ṣaṣṭhe pañcadaśāhake || 66 ||
māsena saptame caiva śīrṇaparṇāśanāṣṭame ||
tyaktvā tānyapi sā bālā vāyvāhārā babhūva ha || 67 ||
saivaṃ varṣaśataṃ sthitvā harāvekāgramānasā ||
samādhinā samā bhūtvā sthāṇuvanniślā'bhavat || 68 ||
dvandvāni nāvidaccāpi ātmabhūtāntaraṃ vinā ||
parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ samāpannā prakāśamayakāṃtidhṛk || 69 ||
tattejasā vṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā vasundhare ||
ahaṃ vismayamāpannastasyāḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || 70 ||
sanniruddhendriyagrāmā nācakṣata bahiḥsthitam ||
tadā hṛṣīkāṇyāviśya saṃhṛtya svaṃ hṛdo bahiḥ || 71 ||
sthito'haṃ vasudhe devi akṣṇoḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||
hṛṣīkāṇi niyamyāhaṃ yataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || 72 ||
hṛṣīkeśa iti khyāto nāmnā tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ ||
sā māṃ yadaiva nāpaśyadunmīlya nayane tataḥ || 73 ||
bahiḥ sthitaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
gadgadasvarasaṃyuktā aśruklinnavilocanā || 74 || 
romāṃcitatanuścāsītkadambamukulākṛtiḥ ||
tathā bhūtāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā prāvocamahamaṅganām || 79 ||
ayi bāle viśālākṣi tuṣṭo'haṃ tapasastava ||
varaṃ yācaya mattastvaṃ yatte manasi varttate || 76 ||
adeyamapi te dadmi yadanyeṣāṃ sudurllabham ||
iti śrutvā prabhorvākyaṃ praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 77 ||
stutvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭā ||
dadāsi cedvaraṃ mahyaṃ devadeva jagatpate || 78 ||
anenaiva svarūpeṇa bhagavansthātumarhasi ||
sthito'smyatraiva bhadraṃ te aparaṃ varayāśu me || 79 ||
durlabhaṃ te varaṃ dadmi tapasāhaṃ pratoṣitaḥ ||
ityuktvā māṃ praṇamyāha ruruḥ sā saṃśitavratā || 80 ||
yadi prasanno deveśa tadā māṃ kuru pāvanīm ||
mannāmnā kṣetrametacca khyātaṃ bhavatu nānyathā || 81 ||
tāmahaṃ devi subhage prāvocaṃ punareva hi||
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tava deho bhavatvayam || 82 ||
tava nāmnāṃ ca vikhyātametatkṣetraṃ bhaviṣyati ||
tava tīrthe kṛtasnānastrirātropoṣito naraḥ||83||
vilokya māṃ bhavetpūto mama vākyānna saṃśayaḥ ||
brahmahatyādi pāpāni jñātvā'jñātvā kṛtānyapi || 84 ||
yāsyanti vilayaṃ kṣipramevametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
iti dattvā varāṃstasyai tatraivāntarhitaḥ sthitaḥ || 89 ||
sāpi kālena sañjātā tīrthabhūtā tathā'bhavat ||
etatte kathitaṃ devi rurumāhātmyamuttamam || 86 ||
rurukṣetrasya prabhavametadguhyaṃ paraṃ mama ||87||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre rurukṣetraṛṣīkeśayormāhātmyaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||146||
atha goniṣkramaṇamāhātmyam||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
atyāścaryaṃ śrutaṃ hyetadrurukṣetrasamudbhavam ||
hṛṣīkeśasya mahimā tvayā ya upavarṇitaḥ || 1 ||
anyacca yatparaṃ guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam ||
vaktumarhasi deveśa paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama || 2 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu bhūme prayatnena kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ mama ||
guhyamastyaparaṃ caiva himaśṛṅga śiloccaye || 3 ||
goniṣkramaṇakaṃ nāma gāvo yatra pratāritāḥ ||
yathā niṣkramaṇaṃ prāpya surabhīṇāṃ vasundhare ||4||
saptatiryatra kalpāni aurvo yatra prajāpatiḥ ||
tapaścacāra paramaṃ mama māyābalānvitaḥ || 5 ||
tasyaivaṃ varttamānasya yāti kāle mahattare ||
evaṃ hi tapyamānasya sarvalokasya saṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
na varaṃ prārthayatyeṣa lābhālābhasamanvitaḥ ||
sūcako'pi na vidyeta balikarmasu saṃyataḥ || 7 ||
atha dīrghasya kālasya kaścidbrahmayatistadā ||
tapastapasyati munau tasminśailoccaye dhare ||8||
īśvaro'pi mahābhāge tatpārśvaṃ samupāgataḥ ||
goniṣkrameti vikhyāte tasmiṃstīrthe mahaujasi || 9 ||
tatra tvaurvo mahābhāge tapyate samadarśanaḥ ||
padmānāṃ kāraṇādaurvo gaṃgādvāramupāgataḥ || 10 ||
tannirgataṃ tato jñātvā aurvaṃ sarve tapasvinaḥ ||
maheśvaro mahātejāḥ sambhramātsamupāgataḥ || 11 ||
phalapuṣpasamākīrṇā lakṣmīścaivopajāyate ||
āśramaṃ rūpasampannaṃ phalapuṣpopaśobhitam||12||
tacca vai bhasmasādbhūtaṃ mahārudrasya tejasā||
dagdhvā taṃ cāśramaṃ puṇyamauravasya sumahatpriyam||13||
īśvaro'pi tataḥ prāptaḥ śīghrameva himālayam ||
etasminnantare devi gṛhya puṣpakaraṇḍakam ||14||
āśramaṃ samanuprāpta aurvo'pi munipuṃgavaḥ ||
śānto dāntaḥ kṣamāśīlaḥ satyavrataparāyaṇaḥ || 15 ||
dṛṣṭvā svamāśramaṃ dagdhaṃ bahupuṣpaphalodakam ||
manyunā paramāviṣṭo duḥkhanetrapariplutaḥ || 16 ||
uvāca krodharaktākṣo vacanaṃ nirdahanniva ||
yenaiṣa cāśramo dagdho bahupuṣpaphalodakaḥ || 17 ||
so'pi duḥkhena santaptaḥ sarvalokānbhramiṣyati ||
evamaurveṇa datte tu śāpe tasminmahaujasi || 18 ||
mahābhayāttu lokānāṃ na kaścitparyavārayat ||
tatkṣaṇādeva deveśi īśo'pi jagato vibhuḥ || 19 ||
mahādāhena santaptaḥ śambhurdevīmuvāca ha ||
aurvasya tu tapo dṛṣṭvā bhītairdevairudāhṛtam || 20 ||
dahyate sma jagatsarvaṃ sa tu kiñcinna cecchati ||
ko vā prati vidhistatra yathā sarvasya sambhavet || 21 ||
evamukte mayā krodhādīkṣitastasya cāśramaḥ ||
dagdho'bhavatkṣaṇenaiva vayaṃ tasmādvinirgatāḥ || 22 ||
etadduḥkhena santapto manyunā ca pariplutaḥ ||
aurvaḥ śaśāpa roṣeṇa tena taptā vayaṃ śive ||23||
tato'bhramadvirūpākṣaḥ śaṃ na prāpnoti karhicit ||
ahaṃ ca paritapto'smi ātmatvādīśvarasya ca || 24 ||
tena dāhena santapto na śaknomi viceṣṭitum ||
pārvatyā ca tataḥ proktaḥ āvāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati || 25 ||
gacchāvastasya vākyena sukhaṃ yatra bhaviṣyati ||
tato nārāyaṇaṃ gatvā saha tena tamaurvakam || 26 ||
vijñāpayāmo rudrasya śāpo'yaṃ vinivarttatām ||
santaptāḥ sma vayaṃ sarve tasmācchāpaṃ nivarttaya || 27 ||
aurvo'pyuvāca noktaṃ me anṛtaṃ tu kadācana ||
surabhīgaṇamānīya gatvaitaṃ snāpayantu vai || 28 ||
rudraśāpo nivṛttaḥ syāttenaiva kila nānyathā ||
etasminnantare devi mayā gāvo'vatāritāḥ || 29 ||
saptasaptatiḥ kalyāṇi saurabheyā mahaujasaḥ ||
tenāplāvitadehāśca parāṃ nirvṛtimāgatāḥ || 30 ||
tacca goniṣkramaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta ekarātroṣito naraḥ ||31||
golokaṃ ca samāsādya modate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānkṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||32||
śaṃkhacakragadāyukto mama loke mahīyate ||
paṃca dhārāḥ patantyatra mūle mūlavaṭasya hi || 33 ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta paṃcarātroṣito naraḥ ||
paṃcānāmapi yajñānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 34 ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānkṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||
paṃcayajñaphalaṃ bhuktvā mama lokaṃ prapadyate||35||
asti paṃcapadaṃ nāma tasminkṣetre paraṃ mama||
mama pūrveṇa pārśveṇa dṛḍhāḥ paṃca mahāśilāḥ||36||
matpūrvāṃ diśamāśritya tatra brahmapadadvayam ||
madhye tu tasya kuṇḍasya śilā vistīrṇasaṃśritā || 37 ||
ūrddhvaṃ nālaparīṇāhaṃ tatra viṣṇupadaṃ mama ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta paṃcarātroṣito naraḥ || 38 ||
yāṃti śuddhāṃstu lokāṃste ye ca bhāgavatapriyāḥ ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānyuktaḥ pañcapade naraḥ || 39 ||
vimuktaḥ sarvasaṃsārānmama lokaṃ ca gacchati ||
tato brahmapadaṃ nāma kṣetraṃ guhyaṃ paraṃ mama || 40 ||
yatra dhārā patatyekā paścimāṃ diśamāśritā ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta ekarātroṣito naraḥ || 41 ||
brahmalokamavāpnoti brahmaṇā saha modate ||
kaumudasya tu māsasya śuklapakṣasya dvādaśī || 42 ||
yajñānāṃ vājapeyānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karmasu niṣṭhitaḥ || 43 ||
vājapeyaphalaṃ bhuktvā mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||
asti koṭivaṭaṃ nāma tasmin kṣetre paraṃ mama || 44 ||
paṃcakrośaṃ tato gatvā vāyavyāṃ diśi saṃsthitaḥ ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta ṣaṣṭhakāloṣito naraḥ || 45 ||
bahuyajñasya koṭīnāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti niṣkalam ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānbhūme koṭivaṭe śubhe ||46||
yajñakoṭiphalaṃ bhuktvā mama koṭiṃ prapadyate ||
asti viṣṇusaro nāma tasmin kṣetre paraṃ mama || 47 ||
pūrvottareṇa pārśvena paṃcakrośaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
matsaraḥ padmapatrākṣi āgādhaṃ parisaṃsthitam || 48 ||
paṃcakrośaśca vistāraḥ parvataḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ ||
tatra bhramati yo bhadre kuryāccaiva pradakṣiṇam || 49 ||
upavāsaṃ trirātraṃ tu kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||
yāvanti bhramamāṇasya padāni nanu sundari || 50 ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi brahmaloke mahīyate ||
athā'tra muṃcate prāṇānsvakarmapariniṣṭhitaḥ || 51 ||
brahmalokaṃ samutsṛjya mama loke mahīyate ||
tasmin kṣetre mahābhāge āścaryaṃ śṛṇu sundari || 52 ||
gavāṃ vai śrūyate śabdo mama karmasukhāvahaḥ ||
athātra jyeṣṭhamāsasya śuklapakṣasya dvādaśī || 53 ||
śrūyate sumahāñchabdaḥ svayametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
evaṃ gosthalake puṇye mahābhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ||54||
karoti śubhakarmāṇi śīghraṃ mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
evaṃ tena mahābhāge īśvareṇa yaśasvini ||55||
śāpadāho vinirmuktaḥ sarvaiḥ saha marudgaṇaiḥ||
etadgosthalakaṃ nāma sarvaśāntikaraṃ param ||56||
kathitaṃ devi kārtsnyena tavānugrahakāmyayā||
eṣo'dhyāyo mahābhāge sarvamaṅgalakārakaḥ || 57 ||
mama mārgānusārāṇāṃ mama ca prītivarddhanaḥ ||
śreṣṭhānāṃ paramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam || 58 ||
lābhānāṃ paramo lābho dharmāṇāṃ dharma uttamaḥ ||
labhante paṭhamānā vai mama mārgānusāriṇaḥ || 59||
tejaḥ śriyaṃ ca lakṣmīṃ ca sarvakāmānyaśasvini ||
yāvanti cākṣarāṇi syuratrādhyāye manasvini || 60 ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi mama loke mahīyate ||
patanaṃ ca na vidyeta paṭhamāno dine dine || 61 ||
tāritāni kulānyebhiḥ sapta sapta ca sapta ca ||
piśunāya na dātavyaṃ na mūrkhāya śaṭhāya ca || 62 ||
deyaṃ putrāya śiṣyāya yaśca jānāti sevitum ||
etanmaraṇakāle tu na kadācittu vismaret || 63 ||
ślokaṃ vā yadi vā pādaṃ yadīcchetparamāṃ gatim ||
tatkṣetraṃ tu mahābhāge paṃcayojanamaṇḍalam ||64 ||
tiṣṭhāmi parayā prītyā diśaṃ pūrvāmupāśritaḥ ||
paścimena vahedgaṅgāṃ niṣkāmena vasundhare || 65 ||
evaṃ rahasyaṃ guhyaṃ ca sarvakarmasukhāvaham ||
etatte paramaṃ bhadre guhyaṃ dharmasamanvitam || 66 ||
mama kṣetraṃ mahābhāge yattvayā paripṛcchitam || 67 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre goniṣkramaṇa māhātmyaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 147 ||
atha stutasvāmimāhātmyam ||
sūta uvāca ||
goniṣkramaṇamāhātmyaṃ śrutvā guhyamanuttamam ||
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā sarvaratnavibhūṣitā ||1||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
aho gavāṃ hi māhātmyaṃ tava caivaṃ śrutaṃ mayā ||
yacchrutvā'haṃ jagannātha jātāsmi parinirvṛtā || 2 ||
evameva paraṃ guhyaṃ brūhi nārāyaṇa prabho ||
asmātkṣetrātparaṃ deva yadi kṣetraṃ viśiṣyate || 3 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ sarvadharmavyapāśrayaḥ ||
mātsaryaṃ caiva me nāsti tenāhaṃ paramaḥ prabhuḥ ||4||
etacchāstraṃ mahābhāge prayuktaṃ līlayā mayā ||
varāharūpamādāya sarvabhāgavatapriyam || 5 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
yathā yathā bhāṣasi dharmakāraṇamidaṃ vaco dharmaviniścayaṃ mahat ||
tathā tathā deva varā'prameyaṃ hṛdyaṃ mano bhāvayase janārdana || 6 ||
tato mahīvacaḥ śrutvā dharmaśreṣṭhī mahāmanāḥ ||
varāharūpī bhagavānpratyuvāca vasundharām || 7 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
sādhu bhūme mahābhāge mama karmavyavasthite ||
kathayiṣyāmyahaṃ hyevaṃ guhyaṃ lokasukhāvaham || 8 ||
stutasvāmīti vikhyātaṃ guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama ||
hyaparaṃ yugamāsādya tatra sthāsyāmi sundari ||9||
putro'haṃ vasudevasya devakyā garbhasambhavaḥ||
vāsudeva iti khyātaḥ sarvadānavasūdanaḥ ||10||
pañca tasya suśiṣyāśca bhaviṣyanti vicakṣaṇāḥ ||
ṛṣayo dharmasaṃyuktā matprasādādbalāśritāḥ || 11 ||
te māṃ saṃsthāpayiṣpanti dharmamūrttiṃ mahīṃ gatam ||
śāṇḍilyo jājaliścaiva kapilaścopasāyakaḥ || 12 ||
bhṛguścaiva mahābhāge mama māgārnusāriṇaḥ ||
te ca prasannamanasa ātmadṛṣṭāntadarśinaḥ||13||
svayaṃ jñānaprabhāveṇa bhāsayiṣyanti māṃ sadā||
saṅkarṣaṇo vāsudevo pradyumno hyaniruddhakaḥ||14||
gacchatā bahukālena mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
tato dīrgheṇa kālena ijyāpūrvasthitena ca || 15 ||
varaṃ teṣāṃ pradāsyāmi yo yasya hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ ||
te pravakṣyanti māṃ devi ātmaśāstravyavasthitāḥ || 16 ||
ātmaśāstraṃ pratiṣṭheta yatra dharmaḥ suniṣṭhitaḥ ||
bhavatvetanniścayena na tu mithyā kadācana || 17 ||
tava deva prasādena ihalokaḥ pravartatām ||
tānapyevaṃ vadiṣyāmi śiṣyāya bhavatāṃ priyam || 18 ||
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho yato yūyaṃ mama priyāḥ ||
suśiṣyā bāḍhamityevaṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 19 ||
tadete pravadiṣyanti sarvabhāgavatapriyam ||
yathā ca mathyamānādvai dadhnaścoddhriyate ghṛtam || 20 ||
evaṃ sarveṣu śāstreṣu vārāhaṃ ghṛtasammitam ||
vārāhaṃ jñānamutsṛjya mahābhāgaṃ mahaujasam || 21 ||
evaṃ samaṃ mayā caiva hyātmanā paribhāṣitam ||
te praṇāmaṃ kariṣyanti siddhiṃ prāpsyanti vai parām || 22 ||
mahājñānamidaṃ sūkṣmaṃ bhūme bhakteṣu dṛśyate ||
śāstrāṇāṃ paramaṃ śāstraṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam || 23 ||
kiñcidanyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
śāstrametanmahābhāge sdhūlakarma mahaujasam || 24 ||
kecittaranti jñānena kecitkarmaṇi niṣṭhitāḥ ||
kecidyatheṣṭaṃ suśroṇi keciddānena karmaṇā || 25 ||
kecidyogabalaṃ bhuktā paśyanti mama saṃsthitam ||
vidhipūrvaṃ tu me kiñcinnarāḥ paśyanti niṣṭhitāḥ || 26 ||
sarvadharmakarāḥ kecitsarvāśāḥ sarvavikrayāḥ ||
te māṃ paśyanti vai bhūme ekacitta vyavasthitāḥ || 27 ||
evametanmahāśāstraṃ devi saṃsāramokṣaṇam ||
mama bhaktavyavasthāyai prayuktaṃ paramaṃ priyam || 28 ||
te tathā ca pravakṣyanti yacca yasyābhirocate ||
anyathānyasya dṛṣṭānāmṛṣibhiryatprayojitam || 29 ||
tadyugasya prabhāveṇa bhūme kurvanti mānavāḥ ||
taiḥ svaśiṣyaiḥ samaṃ devi ye śāstraviniyojitāḥ ||30||
matprasādena te sarve siddhiṃ yāsyanti matparām ||
mama śiṣyeṣu yeṣāṃ ca mātsaryopahatātmanām ||31||
macchāstre ca bhaveddoṣasteṣāmatra punarbhavaḥ ||
mātsaryaṃ ye ca kurvanti maddharmaparame jane ||32||
teṣāṃ nāyaṃ paro loko mātsaryopahatātmanām ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 33 ||
mama mārgānusāreṇa paraṃ guhyaṃ mama priye ||
śāstravanto vinītāśca bahudoṣavivarvitāḥ || 34 ||
te tu mātsaryardoṣeṇa naṣṭācārāḥ patantyadhaḥ ||
mātsaryaṃ sarvanāśāya mātsaryaṃ dharmanāśakam || 35 ||
yastu mātsaryasaṃyukto na sa paśyati māṃ kvacit ||
bahukarmasamāyuktā dānādhyayananiṣṭhitāḥ ||36||
tapasā jñānayuktā vā nityaṃ karmasu codyatāḥ ||
anena hi svabhāvena mātsaryaṃ caiva kurvate ||37||
na te paśyanti māṃ bhūme māyayā paridūṣitāḥ ||
na karttavyaṃ tataḥ sarvairmātsaryaṃ dharmaghātakam ||
mama śāstrapareṇeha yadīcchetparamāṃ gatim || 38 ||
etadguhyaṃ mahābhāge na jānanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
mātsaryasya tu doṣeṇa bahavo nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 39 ||
etacchāstraṃ mahābhāge prayuktaṃ vidhinā mayā ||
varāharūpamādāya sarvabhāgavatapriyam ||40||
tatrāścaryaṃ mahābhāge śṛṇu bhūtagirau mama ||
āyasī pratimā tatra hyabhedyā caiva dṛśyate||41||
bruvanti kecitkāṃsyeti āyasītyapare'bruvan ||
pāṣāṇītyapare kecidanye vajramayīti ca || 42 ||
ūrddhvaṃ vā yadi vā'dho vā ye kurvanti mamārcanam ||
tathāpi māṃ saṃspṛśanti śiromadhye tu sundari || 43 ||
ye tu paśyanti māṃ bhūme maṇipūragirau sthitam ||
stuvantyācāryavantaśca matprasādatsu saṃyatāḥ ||44||
ācāryāṇāṃ guṇānbhuktvā mama karmapathe sthitāḥ ||
sarvakilbiṣamuktāśca yānti te paramāṃ gatim || 45 ||
tasminkṣetre mahābhāge asti guhyaṃ paraṃ mama ||
paṃcārumeti vikhyātamuttarāṃ diśamāśritam ||46||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta paṃcakāloṣito naraḥ ||
modate nandane divye hyapsarobhiḥ samākule || 47 ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānkṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ ||
nandanaṃ vanamutsṛtya mama lokaṃ ca gacchati ||48||
bhṛgukuṇḍeti vikhyātamatra guhyaṃ paraṃ mama ||
mama dakṣiṇapārśve tu adūrādardhayojanāt || 49 ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta mama mārgānusārakaḥ ||
bhūpṛṣṭhe na tu jāyeta kālena vijitendriyaḥ || 50 ||
dhruvo yatra tu tiṣṭheta meruśṛṃge śiloccaye ||
tatra modati suśroṇi apsarobhiryathāsukham ||51||
athātra muṃcate prāṇān mama karmapathe sthitaḥ ||
dhruvalokaṃ parityajya mama loke mahīyate || 52 ||
maṇikuṇḍeti vikhyātaṃ tatra guhyaṃ paraṃ mama ||
maṇayo yatra dṛśyante anekālayasaṃsthitāḥ || 53 ||
agādhaṃ taṃ hṛdaṃ bhadre devānāmapi durlabham ||
vismayaṃ kiṃ punastatra malayaścaṃcalaḥ sthitaḥ || 54 ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta paṃcakāloṣito naraḥ ||
ratnabhāgī bhavedvīro rājalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 55 ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karmapathe sthitaḥ ||
chittvā vai sarvasaṃsāraṃ mama lokaṃ prapadyate || 56 ||
suguhyaṃ pūrvapārśvena mama kṣetrasya sundari ||
adūratastrikośena parimāṇaṃ vidhīyate ||57||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
dhūtapāpeti vikhyātaṃ tatra guhyaṃ paraṃ mama || 58 ||
paṃcakrośādadūrādvai mama kṣetrasya paścime ||
tatra kuṇḍaṃ mahābhāge mama tadrocate jalam || 59 ||
suvarṇābhaṃ mārakatamagādhaṃ nirmitaṃ mayā ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta paṃcabhaktoṣito naraḥ ||60||
dhunvāno duṣkaraṃ karma paṃcabhūtātmaniṣṭhitam ||
kṛtodakastatra bhadre dhūtapāpo yaśasvini ||61||
gatvendralokaṃ suśroṇi devaiḥ saha sa modate ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 62 ||
indralokaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||
tatrāścaryaṃ mahābhāge dhūtapāpe śṛṇuṣva me || 63 ||
varttate ca viśālākṣi maṇipūre girau mama ||
tāvanna patate dhārā yāvatpāpaṃ na dhūyate || 64 ||
dhūte pāpe ca suśroṇi dhārā ca patati kṣitau ||
evaṃ tatra viśālākṣi vṛkṣamaśvatthamiśritam || 65 ||
dhūtapāpaṃ na praviśetpraviśatyamale nare ||
tasminkṣetre varārohe samantātpaṃcayojane || 66||
yatra tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ devi paścimāṃ diśamāśritaḥ ||
tatra cāmalakaṃ bhadre adūrādarddhayojanāt || 67 ||
mama caiva prabhāveṇa sarvakālaphalodayam ||
tatra kaścinna jānāti pāpakarmā narādhamaḥ || 68||
bhaktaṃ bhāgavataṃ śuddhaṃ mama karmavyavasthitam ||
upoṣya ca trirātrāṇi śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ ||69||
tatra gatvā varārohe udite ca divākare ||
atha madhyāhnavelāyāṃ yadi vā'staṃgate'pi vā || 70 ||
ekacittena gantavyaṃ dhṛtiṃ kṛtvā supuṣkalām ||
yattatra labhate bhadre phalamāmalakaṃ śubham || 71 ||
paṃcarātreṇa labhate tasminbhūtagirau mama ||
tato harivacaḥ śrutvā sā mahī saṃśitavratā || 72 ||
punarnārāyaṇaṃ tatra provāca vinayānvitā ||
stutasvāmī śruto'si tvaṃ tattra sthānāni yāni ca || 73 ||
etannāmaniruktiṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi sāmpratam || 74 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
bhūme hitvā tu saṃsārānye cānye devakaṇṭakāḥ ||
dvāpare yugamāsādya yatra sthāsyāmi sundari || 75 ||
tato'maraiśca brahmādyairbahubhirmantravādibhiḥ ||
stutiṃ karttuṃ samārabdhaṃ maṇipūrāśritasya me ||76 ||
tato māṃ nārado devi asito devalastathā ||
parvataśca mahābhāge mama bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ || 77 ||
nāma kurvanti me tatra maṇipūragirau tataḥ ||
stutasvāmīti vikhyātaṃ mama karmavyapāśritam || 78 ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre niruktikaraṇaṃ mayā ||
tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ hi yadbhadre sarvabhāgavatapriyam || 79 ||
etatstutagirerdevi māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā ||
dvāparaṃ yugamāsādya yatra sthāsyāmi sundari ||80||
etāni bhūme guhyāni tatra bhūtagirau mama ||
śraddhadhānena marttyena śrotavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||81||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre sarvadharmavyapāśrayam ||
śrīstutasvāmimāhātmyaṃ kimanyatparipṛcchasi||82||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre stutasvāmimāhātmyaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 148 ||
atha dvārakāmāhātmyam ||
sūta uvāca ||
śrīstutasvāmimāhātmyaṃ śrutvā dharmaparāyaṇā ||
parituṣṭamanā devī vākyametaduvāca ha||1 ||
dharaṇyuvāca||
etacchrutvā tu māhātmyaṃ deva devavara prabho ||
mama cittasya paramā jātā śāntiranuttamā ||2||
nārācadhārāvaraṇāsidhārī suraripuvadhakārī dharaṇīdharaḥ ||
dhṛtaśaṅkhagadābjacakrapāṇiḥ svayamiha śāstramudāvahatpradhānam||3||
evaṃ hi guṇamāhātmyaṃ stutasvāmini macchrutam ||
asmāccedaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tanme vada kṛpānidhe ||4 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
evaṃ bhūme varaṃ śreṣṭhe phullapaṃkajamālini ||
kathayiṣyāmi cānyatte guhyaṃ pāpabhayāpaham ||5 ||
dvāparaṃ yugamāsādya yādavānāṃ kulodvahaḥ ||
śaurīti tatra vikhyāto bhaviṣyati pitā mama || 6 ||
dvāraketi ca vikhyātā purī tatra sthitā'bhavat ||
yā ca devapurī ramyā viśvakarmavinirmitā || 7 ||
paṃcayojanavistārā daśayojanamāyatā ||
vasāmyatra varārohe śatapañcasamāstathā || 8 ||
bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā devānāṃ sumahatpriyam ||
punarapyāgamiṣyāmi svarlokaṃ prati sundari || 9 ||
bhaviṣyati varārohe īśvaraḥ sadṛśo mama||
durvāsā iti vikhyātaḥ śapiṣyati kulaṃ mama || 10 ||
tasya śāpābhisantāpāddvārakāvāsino dhare ||
vṛṣṇyandhakāśca bhojāśca gamiṣyanti yamakṣayam || 11 ||
candrapāṇḍurasaṃkāśo vanamālī halāyudhaḥ ||
halenākṛṣya nagaraṃ samudraṃ gamayiṣyati || 12||
nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā dharmakāmā vasundharā ||
ubhau tau caraṇau gṛhya punaḥ papraccha mādhavī ||13||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
lokanātho'si sarveṣāṃ deva māyākaraṇḍaka ||
śapiṣyati kathaṃ tatra durvāsāstadvadasva me || 14 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
tatra jāmbavatī nāma mama patnī bhaviṣyati ||
rūpayauvanasampannā mama bhogasamanvitā || 15 ||
tasyāḥ putro mahābhāgo rūpayauvanadarpitaḥ ||
sāṃba ityabhivikhyāto mamaiva satataṃ priyaḥ || 16 ||
tenaiva krīḍamānena kṛtvā garbhamatathyataḥ ||
sa pṛṣṭaḥ paramaśreṣṭha ṛṣireṣā prasoṣyati || 17||
putrakāmā tviyaṃ bālā mune tatprabravīhi me ||
sāmbo'yamiti ca jñātvā sa muniḥ kopamūrcchitaḥ || 18 ||
uvāca tarhi te garbhānmusalaṃ kulanāśanam ||
yena vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ sarve gamiṣyanti yamakṣayam || 19 ||
śrutvā durvāsasaḥ śāpaṃ te ca sarve kumārakāḥ ||
śāpena santaptadhiyo māmūcurbhayasaṃyutāḥ ||20 ||
tatastānāgatāndṛṣṭvā kumārān pṛṣṭavānaham ||
te ca māmabruvansarve yathāvṛttaṃ samutsukāḥ || 21 ||
tacca teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā proktavānasmi tacchṛṇu ||
bhaviṣyati na sandeho durvāsā yaduvāca ha ||22||
evaṃ te kathitaṃ bhūme vṛṣṇyādeḥ śāpakāraṇam ||
tatra sthānāni me bhūme kathyamānāni me śṛṇu || 23 ||
dvārakāyāṃ mahābhāge vaiṣṇavānāṃ sukhāvahe ||
asti paṃcasaro nāma guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama || 24 ||
samudratīramutsṛjya mama karmasukhāvaham ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta ṣaṣṭhakāloṣito naraḥ || 25 ||
modate nākapṛṣṭhe tu apsarogaṇasaṃkule ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānkṣetre paṃcasare mama ||26||
devalokaṃ samutsṛjya mama loke mahīyate ||
plakṣo vai tatra suśroṇi śataśākho mahādrumaḥ || 27 ||
suphalaiḥ śobhanaiḥ kumbhākṛtibhirbahubhiḥ phalaiḥ ||
bahavastatra gacchanti lābhalaulyena mānavāḥ||28||
phalaṃ na labhate kaścinmuktvā bhāgavataṃ naram ||
labhante ye phalaṃ tatra muktāḥ pāpena karmaṇā || 29 ||
te labhante parāṃ siddhiṃ mama karmaṇi saṃsthitāḥ ||
prabhāsamiti vikhyātaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe pare mama || 30 ||
manujā yaṃ na paśyanti rāgalobhasamanvitāḥ ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta paṃcabhaktoṣito naraḥ || 31 ||
modate saptadvīpeṣu guhyāni ca sa gacchati ||
atha cenmuṃcate prāṇānprabhāte gatakilbiṣaḥ ||32 ||
sarvasaṃgaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
tatrāścaryaṃ mahābhāge kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu ||33||
prabhāse yatra śṛṇvanti sāgare na ma(ga)raṃ prati ||
makarāstatra dṛśyaṃte bhramamāṇā itastataḥ ||34|| ||
na kiṃcidaparādhyanti snāyamānā jale tataḥ ||
athātra prakṣipetpiṇḍānprasanne salile naraḥ || 35 ||

pāpakarmaratasyāpi na gṛhṇanti jalaṃ prati ||36||

śakralokaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
tatrāścaryaṃ mahābhāge kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu ||40 ||

tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta paṃcakāloṣito naraḥ || 60 ||

sarvānsvargānsamutsṛjya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||
tatrāścaryaṃ pravakṣyāmi kathyamānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 62 ||

caturviṃśatidvādaśyāmarddharātre yaśasvini || 63 ||

te labhante parāṃ siddhiṃ evaṃ bhūme na saṃśayaḥ ||
asti raivatakaṃ nāma tasmin kṣetre paraṃ mama ||67||

gacchettu somalokaṃ tu kṛtakṛtyo na saṃśayaḥ ||70||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karmasu niṣṭhitaḥ ||
somalokaṃ samutsṛjya mama lokaṃ prapadyate || 71 ||
tatrāścaryaṃ mahābhāge kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu ||
paśyanti manujāḥ sarve dharmakāmā na saṃśayaḥ || 72 ||
patanti sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ patrāṇi subahūnyapi ||
ekaṃ cāpi na dṛśyeta prasannaṃ yāti tajjalam ||73 ||

aparo mama pārśvena devānāmapi durllabhaḥ || 74 ||
paṃcakrośasuvistāraḥ śobhate vai mahādrumaḥ ||
padmaiścaivotpalaiśchannaṃ sugandhikusumaiḥ saha ||75||

śilātalāguhācchannaṃ sugandhikusumaiḥ saha|| 76 ||

modate nandane divye apsarobhiḥ samanvite || 77 ||
atrāścaryaṃ mahābhāge kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu ||
paśyanti manujāḥ sarve dharmakāmā na saṃśayaḥ || 78||

caturviṃśatidvādaśyāṃ sa puṣyati ca niṣkalam || 80 ||

dṛśyate ca mahābhāge astamete divākare || 81 ||

etanmaraṇakāle'pi mā kadācittu vismaret || 99 ||

sakulyāstāritāstena sapta sapta ca sapta ca||

ucitenopacāreṇa kimanyatparipṛcchati || 98 ||

atha sānandūramāhātmyam ||
sūta uvāca ||

hṛṣṭāvocattadā devaṃ dharmakāmā vasundharā || 1 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
aho deva prasādaśca yattvayā parikīrttitam ||
śrutvaitatparamaṃ puṇyaṃ prāptāsmi paramāṃ śriyam || 2 ||

varāharūpī bhagavānpratyuvāca vasundharām ||4||

tato vasiṣṭhakuṇḍaṃ tu tasminkṣetraṃ paraṃ mama || 41 ||
dhārāḥ patanti tisrastu na sthūlā nāti vai kṛśāḥ ||
tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta paṃca kāloṣito naraḥ || 42 ||
vāsiṣṭhaṃ lokamāsādya modate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karmasu niṣṭhitaḥ||43||
vāsiṣṭhaṃ lokamutsṛjya mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||
paṃcakuṇḍeti vikhyātaṃ tasminkṣetre paraṃ mama || 44 ||
paṃca dhārāḥ patantyatra himakūṭaviniḥsṛtāḥ ||
tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta paṃcakāloṣito naraḥ || 45 ||
sa tatra gacchedvai bhūme yatra paṃcaśikho muniḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama bhakto jitendriyaḥ || 46 ||
paṃcacūḍaṃ samutsṛjya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
saptarṣikuṇḍaṃ vikhyātamasminkṣetre paraṃ mama ||47 ||
sapta dhārāḥ patantyatra himavatparvatasthitāḥ ||
tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta saptabhaktoṣito naraḥ || 48 ||
modate ṛṣilokeṣu ṛṣikanyābhisaṃvṛtaḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānrāgalobhavivarjitaḥ || 49 ||
saptarṣīnsa samutsṛjya modate mama saṃsthitaḥ ||
śarabhaṅgasya kuṇḍaṃ vai kṣetre guhyaṃ pare mama || 50 ||
tatra dhārā patatyekā śarabhaṅgaśritā nadī ||
snānaṃ yastatra kurvīta ṣaṣṭhabhaktoṣito naraḥ || 51 ||
modate tasya lokeṣu ṛṣikanyāpramoditaḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānsarvasaṅgavivajjitaḥ || 52 ||
śarabhaṅgaṃ samutsṛjya mama loke mahīyate ||
kuṇḍamagnisaro nāma sarvamāyābhisaṃvṛtam || 53 ||
bhūmiṃ nītvā jalaṃ tatra tiṣṭhatyeva varānane ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta cāṣṭakāloṣito naraḥ || 54 ||
gacchatyaṅgiraso lokaṃ sukhabhāgī na saṃśayaḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 55 ||
agnilokaṃ samutsṛjya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
kuṇḍaṃ bṛhaspaterbhūme sarvavedodakāśritam || 56 ||
dhārā caikā patatyatra himakūṭasamāśritā ||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta ṣaṣṭhakāloṣito naraḥ ||57||
gatvā bṛhaspaterlokaṃ munikanyābhimoditaḥ ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ samāśritaḥ ||58||
so'pi yāti parāṃ siddhiṃ samutsṛjya bṛhaspatim ||
vaiśvānarasya kuṇḍaṃ tu guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mam ||59||
dhārā caikā patatyatra dṛśyate himasaṃśrayāt ||
tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta ṣaṣṭhabhaktoṣito naraḥ ||60 ||
gatvā bṛhaspaterlokaṃ munikanyābhimohitaḥ ||
vaiśvānareṣu lokeṣu modate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ||61||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
vaiśvānaraṃ samutsṛjya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 62 ||
kārttikeyasya kuṇḍaṃ tu guhyaṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ mama ||
yatra paṃcadaśā dhārāḥ patanti himaparvatāt || 63||
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta ṣaṣṭhakāloṣito naraḥ ||
kumāraṃ paśyati vyaktaṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ śubhadarśanam || 64 ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānkṛtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ śuciḥ ||
kārttikeyaṃ samutsṛjya modate mama maṇḍale || 65 ||
umākuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ tasminkṣetre paraṃ mama ||
sā gaurī yatra cotpannā mahādevavarāṅganā || 66 ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta daśarātroṣito naraḥ ||
gaurīṃ devīṃ sa paśyettu tasyā loke ca modate || 67 ||
atha prāṇānpramuṃceta daśarātroṣito naraḥ ||
umālokaṃ samutsṛjya mama lokaṃ prapadyate || 68 ||
maheśvarasya vai kuṇḍaṃ yatra codvāhitā umā ||
kādambaiścakravākaiśca haṃsasārasasevitam || 69 ||
tisro dhārāḥ patantyatra himavatparvatāśritāḥ ||
sthūlāśca ramaṇīyāśca na hrasvāścātinirmalāḥ || 70 ||
tatra snānaṃ tu kurvīta dvādaśāhoṣito naraḥ ||
modate rudralokeṣu rudrakanyābhirāvṛtaḥ || 71 ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānkṛtvā karma suduṣkaram ||
rudralokaṃ samutsṛjya mama lokaṃ ca gacchati ||72 ||
prakhyātaṃ brahmakuṇḍaṃ tu vedā yatra samutthitāḥ ||
catasro veda dhārāstu patanti ca himālayāt || 73 ||
tataḥ pūrveṇa pārśvena samā dhārā patecchubhā ||
uccā ca ramaṇīyā ca pāṇḍarodakaśobhitā || 74||
punarasyottare pārśve suvarṇasadṛśopamā ||
ṛgvedaḥ patate dhārā prasannā vimalodakā || 79||
atha paścimapārśvena yajurvedena saṃyutā ||
atha dakṣiṇapārśvena cātharvaṇasamanvitā || 76 ||
ekā dhārā patatyatra indragopakasannibhā ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ saptarātroṣito naraḥ || 77 ||
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya brahmaṇā saha modate ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānahaṅkāravivarjitaḥ ||78||
brahmalokaṃ parityajya mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||
guhyākhyāne mahābhāge kṣetre lohārgale mama || 79 ||
siddhikāmena martyena gantavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
samantātpañcaviṃśati yojanāni varānane || 80 ||
na tasya karma vidyeta sa evamapi saṃsthitaḥ ||
ākhyānānāṃ mahākhyānaṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharma uttamaḥ ||81||
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ tu na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit ||
ye paṭhaṃti mahābhāge sthitāḥ śṛṇvanti matpathe ||82||
tāritāni kulāni syurubhayatra daśāpi ca ||
etanmaraṇakāle tu na kadācittu vismaret ||83||
yadīcchetparamāṃ siddhiṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇīm ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre lohārgalamanuttamam ||84 ||
māhātmyaṃ padmapatrākṣi guhyaṃ yacca mahaujasam ||
maṅgalyaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca mama bhakta sukhāvaham || 85 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre lohārgalamāhātmyaṃ nāmaikapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 151 ||
atha mathurātīrtha praśaṃsā ||
sūta uvāca ||
śrutvā devasya māhātmyaṃ lohārgalanivāsinaḥ ||
trailokyanāthādhipatervismayaṃ paramaṃ gatā || 1 ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
padmapatra viśālākṣa lokanātha jagatpate ||
tvatprasādācca deveśa śrutaṃ śāstraṃ mahaujasam || 2 ||
tava śiṣyā ca dāsī ca tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṅgatā ||
jagaddhātā jagajjyotirjagatprabhuratandritaḥ || 3 ||
tava sambhāvanāddeva jātāsmi kanakojjvalā ||
alaṃkṛtā ca śastā ca sarvaśāstreṇa mānada ||4 ||
jagaddhāturjagacchāstrakṛte na hi pariśramaḥ ||
tvayyāyattaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yacca kiṃcitpravarttate || 5 ||
iti kṛtvā ca me deva tvāhlādo hṛdi varttate ||
lohārgalāt paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ guhyaṃ paramadurlabham || 6 ||
tīrthaṃ tadvada kalyāṇaṃ tīrthānāmuttamottamam ||
yadasti durlabhaṃ tīrthaṃ tattvaṃ kathaya me prabho || 7 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
na vidyate ca pātāle nāntarikṣe na mānuṣe ||
samānaṃ mathurāyā hi priyaṃ mama vasundhare || 8 ||
sūta uvāca ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya priyaṃ ca vasudhā tadā ||
praṇamya śirasā devī varāhaṃ punarabravīt ||9 ||
pṛthivyuvāca||
puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ caiva purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ tathā ||
etānhitvā mahābhāga mathurāṃ kiṃ praśaṃsati || 10 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śṛṇu kārtsnyena vasudhe kathyamānaṃ mayānaghe ||
mathureti ca vikhyātaṃ tasmānnāsti paraṃ mama || 11 ||
sā ramyā ca suśastā ca janmabhūmistathā mama ||
śṛṇu devi yathā staumi mathurāṃ pāpahāriṇīm || 12 ||
tatra vāsī naro yāti mokṣaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||
mahāmāghyāṃ prayāge tu yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || 13 ||
tatphalaṃ labhate devi mathurāyāṃ dine dine ||
pūrṇe varṣa sahasraṃ tu vārāṇasyāṃ tu yatphalam || 14 ||
tatphalaṃ labhate devi mathurāyāṃ kṣaṇena hi ||
kārttikyāṃ caiva yatpuṇyaṃ puṣkare tu vasundhare ||15 ||
tatphalaṃ labhate devi mathurāyāṃ jitendriyaḥ ||
mathurāṃ tu parityajya yo'nyatra kurute ratim || 16 ||
mūḍho bhramati saṃsāre mohito mama māyayā ||
yaḥ śṛṇoti varārohe māthuraṃ mama maṇḍalam || 17 ||
anyenoccāritaṃ śaśvatso'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni āsamudraṃ sarāṃsi ca || 18 ||
mathurāyāṃ prayāntyatra supte caiva janārdane ||
mathurāmaṇḍalaṃ prāpya śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 19 ||
tṛptiṃ prayānti pitaro yāvatsthityagrajanmanaḥ ||
ye vasaṃti mahābhāge mathurāmitare janāḥ || 20 ||
te'pi yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ ||
kubjāmrake saukarave mathurāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 21 ||
vinā sāṃkhyena yogena matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ ||
mathurāyāṃ mahāpuryāṃ ye vasaṃti śucivratāḥ ||22 ||
balibhikṣāpradātāro devāste naravigrahāḥ ||
bhaviṣyāmi varārohe dvāpare yugasaṃsthite || 23 ||
yayātibhūpavaṃśācca kṣatriyaḥ kulavarddhanaḥ ||
bhaviṣyāmi varārohe mathurāyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 24 ||
mūrtiṃ caturvidhāṃ kṛtvā sthāsyāmi ṛṣibhiḥ stutaḥ ||
vatsarāṇāṃ śataṃ tatra yuddheṣu kṛtaniścayaḥ || 25 ||
ekā candanasaṅkāśā dvitīyā kanakaprabhā ||
aśokasadṛśā cānyā anyā cotpalasannibhā || 26 ||
tatra guhyāni nāmāni bhaviṣyanti mama priye ||
puṇyāni ca pavitrāṇi saṃsāracchedanāni ca || 27 ||
yatrāhaṃ pātayiṣyāmi dvātriṃśattu vasundhare ||
daityānghorānmahābhāge kaṃsādīndharmadūṣakān || 28 ||
yamunā yatra suvahā nityaṃ sannihitā dhruvam ||
vaivasvatasutā ramyā yamunā yatra viśrutā || 29||
gaṅgāṃ prāpya prayāge yā veṇīti prathitā bhuvi ||
gaṅgāśataguṇā puṇyā māthure mama maṇḍale || 30 ||
yamunā viśrutā devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
tatra tīrthāni guhyāni bhaviṣyanti mamānaghe || 31 ||
yeṣu snāne naro devi mama loke mahīyate ||
athātra muñcate prāṇānmama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 32 ||
na jāyata sa marttyeṣu jāyate ca caturbhujaḥ ||
avimukte naraḥ snāto muktiṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 33 ||
tathātra muñcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
viśrāntisaṃjñakaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 34 ||
yasminsnāto naro devi mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yatsnānaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam || 35 ||
tatphalaṃ labhate devi dṛṣṭvā devaṃ gataśramaḥ ||
na ca yajñairna tapasā na dhyānairna ca saṃyamaiḥ || 36 ||
tatphalaṃ labhate snāto yathā viśrāntisaṃjñake ||
kālatrayaṃ tu vasudhe yaḥ paśyati gataśramaḥ || 37 ||
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇe dve tu viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
asti cānyatparaṃ guhyaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam ||38||
yasminsnāto naro devi mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||
prayāgaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tu devānāmapi durllabham||39||
yasminsnāto naro devi agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||
indralokaṃ samāsādya naro'sau devi modate||40||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama loke sa gacchati ||
tathā kanakhalaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ guhyaṃ paraṃ mama || 41 ||
snānamātreṇa tatrāpi nākapṛṣṭhe sa modate ||
asti kṣetraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ tiṃdukaṃ nāma nāmataḥ||42||
tasminsnāto naro devi mama loke mahīyate ||
asmiṃstīrthe purā vṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||43||
pāṃcālaviṣaye devi kāmpilyaṃ ca purottamam||
dhanadhānyasamāyuktaṃ brahmadattena pālitam || 44 ||
tasmiṃstu vasate devi tiṃduko nāma nāpitaḥ||
tasmiṃstu vasatastasya nāpitasya purottame||45||
kālena mahatā tasya kuṭumbaṃ ca kṣayaṃ gatam ||
kṣīṇe kuṭumbe tu tadā subhṛśaṃ duḥkhapīḍitaḥ || 46 ||
sarvasaṃgaṃ parityajya so'gacchanmathurāṃ tadā ||
brāhmaṇāvasathe so'pi vasamāno vasundhare ||47||
tasya karmaśataṃ kṛtvā snātvaiva yamunāṃ nadīm ||
nityaṃ sa yamunāṃ snāti cirakālaṃ dṛḍhavrataḥ||48||
tataḥ kālena mahatā paṃcatvaṃ samupāgataḥ ||
sa ca tīrthaprabhāveṇa jāto'sau brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||49||
tasmin varagṛhe devi brāhmaṇo yogināṃ varaḥ||
jātismaro mahāprājño viṣṇubhakto vasundhare || 50 ||
tattīrthasya prabhāveṇa jātā muktiḥ sudurllabhā ||
tataḥ paraṃ sūryatīrthaṃ sarvapāpapramocanam || 51 ||
vairocanena balinā sūryastvārādhitaḥ purā ||
bhraṣṭarājyena hi tathā dhanakāmena sundari ||52 ||
ūrddhvabāhurnirāhārastatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ ||
sāgraṃ saṃvatsaraṃ devi tataḥ kāmamavāptavān ||53||
tasya prasanno bhagavān dyumaṇiḥ pratyabhāṣata||
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bale brūhi tapasyasi mahattapaḥ||54||
baliruvāca||
bhraṣṭarājyo'smi deveśa pātāle nivasāmyaham ||
vittenāpi vihīnasya kuṭumbabharaṇaṃ kṛtaḥ ||55||
mukuṭāttasya vai sūryo dadau cintāmaṇiṃ tataḥ ||
cintāmaṇiṃ samāsādya pātālamagamadbaliḥ || 56 ||
tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
tatrātha muñcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 57 ||
ādityāhani saṃkrāntau grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||
tasminsnāto naro devi rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||58 ||
dhruveṇa yatra santaptaṃ svecchayā paramaṃ tapaḥ ||
tatra vai snānamātreṇa dhruvaloke mahīyate || 59 ||
tatrātha muñcate prāṇānmama loke mahīyate ||
dhruvatīrthe tu vasudhe yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ||60 ||
pitṝṃstārayate sarvaṃ pitṛpakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
dakṣiṇe dhruvatīrthasya tīrtharājaṃ prakīrtitam || 61 ||
tasmin snāte naro devi mama lokaṃ prapadyate ||
taddakṣiṇe mahādevi ṛṣitīrthaṃ paraṃ mama || 62 ||

athātra muñcate prāṇānmama loke mahīyate ||63||
dakṣiṇe ṛṣitīrthasya mokṣatīrthaṃ paraṃ mama ||
tatra vai snānamātreṇa mokṣameva prapadyate ||64 ||
tatra vai koṭitīrthaṃ hi devānāmapi durllabham||
tatra snānena dānena mama loke mahīyate ||65 ||
koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||
tāritāḥ pitarastena tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ ||66||
koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā brahmaloke mahīyate ||
tatraiva vāyutīrthaṃ tu pitṝṇāmapi durllabham || 67 ||

gayā piṇḍapradānena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ||
tatphalaṃ labhate devi jyeṣṭhe dānānna saṃśayaḥ || 68 ||
dvādaśaitāni tīrthāni devānāṃ durllabhāni ca ||

iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe mathurāmāhātmye mathurātīrthapraśaṃsā nāma dvāpaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 152||
atha mathurātīrthamāhātmyam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
uttare śivakuṇḍācca tīrthānāṃ navakaṃ smṛtam ||
navatīrthātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati||1 ||

rūpavantaḥ prajāyaṃte svargaloke na saśaṃyaḥ || 2 ||
tasmin snāto naro devi mama loke prapadyate ||
tatra saṃyamanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 3 ||
tatra snāto mṛto vāpi mama lokaṃ sa gacchati||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||4||

kaścitpāpasamācāro niṣādo duṣṭamānasaḥ || 5||
vasate naimiṣāraṇye supratīte'tipāpakṛt||
kenacittvatha kālena so'gacchanmathurāṃ prati ||6 ||
tatra prāpya ca kālindīṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm ||

tatāra yamunāṃ so'tha prāpya saṃyamanaṃ śubhe ||
mamajjāsau tataḥ pāpastasmiṃstīrthe vare śubhe||8||
magnamātrastataḥ pāpaḥ sadyaḥ prāṇairvyayujyata ||
tattīrthasya prabhāveṇa jāto'sau pṛthavīpatiḥ||9||
saurāṣṭraviṣaye devi kṣatriyo'bhūddhanurddharaḥ ||
nāmnā yakṣmadhanurnāma so'bhavatpriyadarśanaḥ ||10 ||
pālayāmāsa vasudhāṃ kṣatradharmaṃ samāśritaḥ ||
tenoḍhā kāśirājasya pīvarī nāmataḥ śubhā||11|
patnī śatānāṃ mukhyānāṃ pravarā sā vasunghare||
tāṃ caiva ramayāmāsa udyāneṣu vaneṣu ca||12||
prāsādeṣu ca ramyeṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca||
prajāḥ pālayatastasya dānāni dadatastathā ||13||
kālo gacchati rājā tu bhogāsaktiṃ ca viṃdati||
bhogāsaktasya vasudhe varṣāṇi saptasaptatiḥ||14||
putrāḥ sapta tathā jātāḥ kanyāḥ paṃca suśobhanāḥ ||
rājñāṃ paṃcasutā dattāḥ kanyāḥ kamalalocanāḥ ||15||
putrānsaṃsthāpayāmāsa sthāneṣu vasudhādhipān ||
pīvaryā saha suptaḥ sa rātrau ca vasudhādhipaḥ || 16 ||
tatra prabuddho nṛpatirhāheti vadate muhuḥ ||
smṛttvā tu mathurāṃ devi smṛtvā saṃyamanaṃ param ||17||
tata sā pīvarī prāha kimevaṃ bhāṣase nṛpa ||
priyāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā vacanamabravīt ||18||
mattaḥ suptaḥ pramattaśca asambaddhaṃ prabhāṣate ||
nidrāvaśasya vacanaṃ na sampraṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi || 19 ||
pīvaryuvāca ||
kathayasva mamādya tvaṃ yadyahaṃ vallabhā tava ||
prāṇāṃstyakṣyāmyahaṃ deva gopayiṣyasi me yadi || 20 ||
priyāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca narādhipaḥ ||
avaśyaṃ yadi vaktavyaṃ gacchāvo mathurāṃ purīm || 21 ||
tatra gatvā yathātattvaṃ vadiṣyāmi śubhānane ||
dadasva vipulaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sulocane || 22||
putrānsaṃsthāpya dauhitrānsve sthāne śubhānpriye ||
grāmāṃśca kośaṃ ratnāni putrānvīkṣya punaḥ punaḥ || 23 ||
tataḥ sammānayāmāsa janaṃ puranivāsinam ||
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ pālanīyaṃ yathākramam || 24 ||
rājye putrānniyokṣyāmi yadi vo rocate'naghāḥ ||
rājyaputrakalatrāṇi bandhuvargaṃ tathaiva ca || 25 ||
nityamicchanti vai loko yamasyecchanti nānyathā ||
evaṃ jñātvā prasannena karttavyaṃ cātmano hitam ||26||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena gacchāvo mathurāṃ purīm ||
aho kaṣṭaṃ yadasmābhiḥ purā rājyamanuṣṭhitam ||27||
idānīṃ tu mayā jñātaṃ tyāgānnāsti paraṃ sukham ||
nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣurnāsti cakṣussamaṃ balam || 28 ||
nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgātparaṃ sukham ||
yaḥ kāmānkurute sarvānyaścaitānkevalāṃstyajet ||29||
prāyeṇa sarvakāmānāṃ parityāgo viśiṣyate ||
abhiṣicya sutaṃ jyeṣṭhamanuyojya parānbahūn || 30 ||
tataḥ paurajanaṃ dṛṣṭvā caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā samprāpto mathurāṃ purīm || 31 ||
tena dṛṣṭā purī ramyā vāsavasya purī yathā ||
tīrthairdvādaśabhiryuktā puṇyā pāpaharā śubhā ||32||
ramyaṃ madhuvanaṃ nāma viṣṇusthānamanuttamam ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā manujo devi kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate || 33 ||
ekādaśī śuklapakṣe māsi bhādrapade tathā ||
tasyāṃ snāto naro devi kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate || 34 ||
vanaṃ kundavanaṃ nāma tṛtīyaṃ caivamuttamam ||
tatra gatvā naro devi kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate || 35 ||
ekādaśī kṛṣṇapakṣe māsi bhādrapade hi vā ||
tatra snāto naro devi rudraloke mahīyate ||36||
caturthaṃ kāmyakavanaṃ vanānāṃ vanamuttamam||
tatra gatvā naro devi mama loke mahīyate || 37 ||
vimalasya ca kuṇḍe tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
yastatra muṃcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||38 ||
paṃcamaṃ bakulaṃ nāma vanānāmuttamaṃ vanam ||
tatra gatvā naro devi agnisthānaṃ sa gacchati || 39 ||
yamunāyāḥ pare pāre devānāmapi durllabham ||
asti bhadravanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaṃ vanamanuttamam || 40 ||
tatra gatvā tu vasudhe madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ ||
tadvanasya prabhāveṇa nāgalokaṃ sa gacchati || 41 ||
saptamaṃ tu vanaṃ bhūme khādiraṃ lokaviśrutam ||
tatra gatvā naro bhadre mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 42 ||
mahāvanaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ tu sadaiva tu mama priyam ||
yatra gatvā tu manuja indraloke mahīyate || 43 ||
lohajaṅghavanaṃ nāma lohajaṅghena rakṣitam ||
navamaṃ tu vanaṃ nāma sarvapātakanāśanam || 44 ||
vanaṃ bilvavanaṃ nāma daśamaṃ devapūjitam ||
tatra gatvā tu manujo brahmaloke mahīyate || 45 ||
ekādaśaṃ tu bhāṇḍīraṃ yoginaḥ priyamuttamam ||
tasya darśanamātreṇa naro garbhaṃ na gacchati ||46||
bhāṇḍīraṃ tamanuprāpya vanānāṃ vanamuttamam ||
vāsudevaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā punarjanma na vidyate || 47 ||
vṛndāvanaṃ dvādaśakaṃ vṛndayā parirakṣitam ||
mama caiva priyaṃ bhūme mahāpātakanāśanam || 48||
vṛndāvanaṃ ca govindaṃ ye paśyanti vasundhare ||
na te yamapuraṃ yānti yānti puṇyakṛtāṃ gatim || 49 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre mathurāmāhātmye mathurātīrthamāhātmyaṃ nāma tripaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 153 ||
atha yamunātīrthaprabhāvaḥ ||
varāha uvāca ||
evaṃvidhāṃ ca mathurāṃ dṛṣṭvā tau mudamāpatuḥ ||
evaṃ tu vasatastasya rājñastatra vasundhare || 1 ||
papraccha ca tadā bhāryā yadguhyaṃ pūrvabhāṣitam ||
purasthena tadā rājñā vakṣyāmi mathurāṃ prati||2|| ||
tanme vada mahārāja yadgopyaṃ pūrvabhāṣitam ||
rājāpyuvāca tāṃ rājñīṃ tvayāpyuktaṃ purā mama || 3 ||
tadvadasva svakaṃ guhyaṃ paścādvakṣyāmyahaṃ tava ||
ityuktvā pīvarī jñātvā prahasya tu guṇālayā || 4 ||
provāca caiva rājānaṃ manasaḥ prītikāraṇam ||
ahaṃ tu pīvarī nāma gaṃgātīranivāsinī || 5 ||
āgatemāṃ purīṃ draṣṭuṃ kumudasya tu dvādaśīm ||
nāvamāruhya yāntīha patitā yamunājale || 6 ||
sadyaḥ prāṇairviyuktā ca tattīrthasya prabhāvataḥ ||
kāśīrājapateḥ kanyā yātāsmi vasudhādhipa || 7 ||
tvayā vivāhitā rājanna ca māṃ vijahātsmṛtiḥ ||
etattīrthaprabhāveṇa dharmayuktā tathā'nagha||8||
dhārāpatanake tīrthe tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ||
etacchrutvā tato rājā kathāṃ prāgjanmasambhavām || 9 ||
svāṃ cāpyakathayattasyai yathā saṃyamane mṛtaḥ ||
evaṃ tau mathurāṃ prāpya snātvā yāmunatīrthake || 10 ||
māṃ paśyantau niyamatastatraiva nidhanaṃ gatau ||
mṛtau sarvaparityaktau gatau mama salokatām || 11 ||
etatte kathitaṃ devi āścaryaṃ yadabhūnmahat ||
tyaktvā cātmatanuṃ tīrthe dhārāpatanasaṃjñake || 12 ||
nākalokamavāpnoti tyaktapāpo na saṃśayaḥ ||
yamuneśvaramāsādya tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ ||13||
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti divyamūrtiścaturbhujaḥ ||
dhārāpatanake snātvā nākaloke sa modate ||14||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
ataḥ paraṃ nāgatīrthaṃ tīrthānāmuttamottamam||15||
yatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ ||
ghaṇṭābharaṇakaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapramocanam || 16|||
yasminsnāto naro yāti sūryalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
athā'tra muṃcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 17 ||
punaranyat pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmalokeṣu viśrutam || 18 ||
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca niyato niyatāśanaḥ ||
brahmaṇā samanujñāto mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 19 ||
somatīrthe tu vasudhe pavitre yamunāmbhasi ||
yatra paśyati māṃ somo dvāpare yugasaṃsthite || 20 ||
tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta svakarmapariniṣṭhitaḥ ||
modate somaloke tu evameva na saṃśayaḥ || 21 ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
sarasvatyāśca patanaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham || 22 ||
tatra snāto naro devi avarṇo'pi yatirbhavet ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi māthure mama maṇḍale || 23 ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ trirātropoṣito naraḥ||
snānamātreṇa manujo mucyate brahmahatyayā || 24 ||
athātra muṃcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati ||
daśāśvamedhamṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ sarvadā mudā || 25 ||
tatra ye snānti niyatāsteṣāṃ svargo na durlabhaḥ ||
mathurāpaścime pārśve satataṃ tvṛṣipūjitam || 26 ||
brahmaṇā sṛṣṭikāle tu manasā nirmitaṃ purā ||
mānasaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tu ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ purā || 27 ||
tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ ||
tīrthaṃ tu vighnarājasya puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham || 28 ||
yatra snātānmanuṣyāṃśca vighnarājo na pīḍayet ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ || 29 ||
tasmiṃstīrthavare snātaṃ na pīḍayati vighnarāṭ ||
vidyārambheṣu sarveṣu yajñadānakriyāsu ca || 30 ||
avighnaṃ kurute tasya satataṃ pārvatīsutaḥ ||
tatrātha muñcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 31 ||
tataḥ pare koṭitīrthe pavitraṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ||
tatra vai snānamātreṇa gavāṃ koṭiphalaṃ labhet || 32 ||
tathātra muñcate prāṇām̐llobhamohavivarjitaḥ ||
somalokamatikramya mama lokaṃ ca gacchati || 33 ||
ataḥ paraṃ śivakṣetramarddhakrośaṃ tu duṣkaram ||
tatra sthito haro devo mathurāṃ rakṣate sadā ||34||
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca māthuraṃ labhate phalam ||
athā'tra muñcate prāṇānmama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 35 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe mathurāmāhātmye yamunātīrthaprabhāvo nāma catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśa tatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 154 ||
athā'krūratīrthaprabhāvaḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi marttyaloke sudurlabham ||
anantaṃ viditaṃ tīrthamacalaṃ dhruvamavyayam || 1 ||
tatra nityaṃ sthito devi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||
māṃ dṛṣṭvā manujā devi muktibhājo bhavanti te || 2 ||
ayane viṣuve caiva tathā viṣṇupadīṣu ca ||
anantaṃ taṃ samāsādya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 3 ||
akrūreti ca vikhyātaṃ mama kṣetraṃ vasundhare ||
tatra snātvā mahābhāge rāhugraste divākare || 4 ||
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
tīrtharājaṃ hi cākrūraṃ guhyānāṃ guhyamuttamam || 5 ||
tatsnānātphalamāpnoti prayāgasnānajaṃ phalam ||
asmiṃstīrthe purāvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare || 6 ||
nāmnā tu sudhano nāma mama bhaktaḥ sadaiva hi ||
dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ sutayuktaḥ sadaiva hi || 7 ||
bandhuputrakalatraiśca gṛhe prītiranuttamā ||
putradārasametasya mayi bhaktirvasundhare || 8||
gacchanti divasāstasya māsāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā ||
karoti gṛhakṛtyāni dhanopāyena nityaśaḥ || 9 ||
mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ na karoti sa karhicit ||
evaṃ ca vasatastasya bahavo vatsarā gatāḥ || 10 ||
nityaṃ kālaṃ ca kurute haripūjanamuttamam ||
puṣpadīpapradānena candanena sugandhinā || 11 ||
upahāreṇa divyena dhūpena ca sugandhinā ||
ekādaśyāṃ tu kurute pakṣayorubhayorapi || 12 ||
upavāsaṃ tu kurute rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā ||
sa gacchati yathākālamakrūraṃ tīrthamuttamam || 13 ||
tatrāgatya mamāgre'sau nṛtyate śubhadarśanaḥ ||
sudhanastu vaṇikśreṣṭhaḥ kadācidrātrijāgare || 14 ||
calamāno gṛhītastu caraṇe brahmarakṣasā ||
kṛṣṇavarṇī mahākāya ūrdhvakeśo bhayaṃkaraḥ || 15 ||
pāde gṛhītvā vasudhe idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 16 ||
rākṣaso'haṃ vaṇikśreṣṭha vasāmi vanamāśritaḥ ||
tvāmadya bhakṣayiṣyāmi tṛptiṃ yāsyāmi śāśvatīm || 17 ||
sudhana uvāca ||
pratīkṣasva kṣaṇaṃ me'dya dāsyāmi tava puṣkalam ||
bhakṣayiṣyasi me gātraṃ miṣṭānnaparipoṣitam || 18 ||
jāgaraṃ devadevasya kartumicchāmi rākṣasa ||
mama vrataṃ sārvakālaṃ yajjāgarmi hareḥ puraḥ || 19 ||
tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte tava sannidhau ||
āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ śīghramādityodayanaṃ prati ||20 ||
tataḥ khādiṣyase gātraṃ vinivṛttasya jāgarāt ||
viṣṇutuṣṭyai vratamidamārabdhaṃ sarvakāmadam || 21 ||
mā kuru vratabhaṅgaṃ me rakṣo nārāyaṇasya hi ||
jāgare vinivṛtte tu māṃ bhakṣaya yathepsitam || 22 ||
sudhanasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmarakṣaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vaṇijaṃ prati sādaram || 23 ||
mithyā prabhāṣase sādho tvaṃ punaḥ kathameṣyasi ||
ko hi rakṣomukhādbhraṣṭo mānuṣo yo nivarttate||24||
rākṣasasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa vaṇigvākyamabravīt||
satyamūlaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ||25||
siddhiṃ labhante satyena ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ ||
yadyahaṃ ca vaṇik pūrvaṃ karmaṇā na hi dūṣitaḥ ||26||
prāptaśca mānuṣo bhāvo vihitenāntarātmanā ||
śṛṇu matsamayaṃ rakṣo yenāhaṃ punarāgamam||27||
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ tatra nṛtyaṃ kṛtvā yathāsukham ||
punareṣyāmyahaṃ rakṣo nāsatyaṃ vidyate mayi ||28||
satyena dīyate kanyā satyaṃ jalpanti brāhmaṇāḥ ||
satyottīrṇā hi rājānaḥ satyena vasudhā dhṛtā || 29||
svargamicchanti satyena mokṣaḥ satyena labhyate||
satyena sūryastapati somaḥ satyena rājate ||30||
yamaḥ satyena harati satyādindro virājate||
tatsatyaṃ mama naśyeta yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 31 ||
paradārāṃstu yo gacchetkāmamohaprapīḍitaḥ || 32 ||
tasya pāpena lipye'haṃ yadi nāyāmi te puraḥ || 33 ||
dattvā ca bhūmidānaṃ yo hyapakāraṃ karoti ca ||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 34 ||
pūrvaṃ bhuktvā striyaṃ yastu sukhamāpya vihṛtya ca ||
dveṣāttāṃ yadi cejjahyāttasyāyaṃ me bhavatvalam || 35 ||
paṅktibhedaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādekapaṃktyāśināṃ dhuvam ||
tasya pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgantā yadi te puraḥ || 36 ||
amāvasyāṃ mahārakṣaḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā striyaṃ vrajet ||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 37 ||
aṣṭāṣṭamī tvamāvāsyā ubhe pakṣe caturdaśī ||
asnātānāṃ gatiṃ yāsyāmyahaṃ vai nāgame punaḥ || 38 ||
gurorbhrātuḥ sutasyāpi sakhyurvai mātulasya ca ||
vyavasyati ca yannārī yo mohena vimohitaḥ || 39 ||
abhigacchati mandātmā tatpāpaṃ me bhavettadā ||
rājapatnīṃ brahmapatnīṃ vidhavāṃ yo'bhigacchati || 40 ||
tasya pāpena lipye'haṃ yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ ||
yastu kanyāṃ sakṛddattvā anyasmai cetpunardadet || 41 ||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ ||
rājayājakayājyāśca ye ca vai grāmayājakāḥ ||42 ||
teṣāṃ pāpena lipye'haṃ yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ ||
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate śaṭhe ||43||
yā gatistāṃ prapadye'haṃ yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca||
sudhanasya vacaḥ śrutvā santuṣṭo brahmarākṣasaḥ ||44||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ namo'stu te||
brahmarākṣasamukto'sau vaṇik tu dṛḍhaniścayaḥ||45||
punarnṛtyati caivāgre mama bhakto vyavasthitaḥ ||
atha prabhātasamaye nṛtyacitto'ti kovidaḥ||46||
punaḥ punarvai uccārya namo nārāyaṇāya ca||
nivṛtte jāgare so'tha kālindīsalilāplutaḥ ||47||
dṛṣṭvā māṃ divyarūpaṃ tu gato'sau mathurāṃ purīm||
dṛṣṭaścāgre tvahaṃ tena puruṣo divyarūpavān ||48||
sa ca pṛṣṭo mayā devi kva bhavānprasthito drutam ||
puruṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā sudhano vākyamabravīt ||49||
ahaṃ gacchāmi tvarito brahmarākṣasasannidhau ||
nivārayāmāsa tadā na gaṃtavyaṃ tvayānagha||50||
jīvato dharmamāhātmyaṃ mṛte dharmaḥ kuto yaśaḥ ||
puruṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa vaṇigvākyamabravīt || 51 ||
tatra satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi yāsye rākṣasasannidhau ||
āgato'haṃ mahābhāga narttayitvā yathāsukham || 52 ||
viṣṇave lokanāthāya cāgato harijāgarāt ||
idaṃ śarīraṃ me rakṣo bhakṣayasva yathepsitam || 53 ||
yathānyāyaṃ vidhānena yathā vā tava rocate ||
noktapūrvaṃ mayā'satyaṃ kadācidapi rākṣasa || 54 ||
tena satyena māṃ bhuṅkṣva brahmarākṣasa dāruṇa ||
vaṇijastu vacaḥ śrutvā tato'sau brahmarākṣasaḥ || 55 ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ sudhanaṃ tadanantaram ||
sādhu tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te satyaṃ dharmaśca pālitaḥ ||56||
vaṇik tvaṃ cātivijñastu yasya te gatirīdṛśī ||
jāgarasya samastasya mama puṇyaṃ prayaccha vai || 57 ||
satyapuṇyaprabhāveṇa yathāhaṃ muktimāpnuyām ||
sudhana uvāca||
nāhaṃ dāsyāmi te puṇyaṃ nṛtyasya narabhojana || 58 ||
arddhaṃ vātha samastaṃ vā praharaṃ cārddhameva vā ||
sudhanasya vacaḥ śrutvā abravīdbrahmarākṣasaḥ || 59 ||
ekanṛtyasya me puṇyaṃ dada tvaṃ vaṇiguttama ||
sudhana uvāca ||
nā'haṃ dāsyāmi te puṇyaṃ yathoktaṃ ca samācara || 60 ||
kena tvaṃ karmadoṣeṇa rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ ||
yatte guhyaṃ mahābhāga sarvaṃ tatkathayasva me || 61 ||
sudhanasya vacaḥ śrutvā vihasitvāha rākṣasaḥ ||
kiṃ tvaṃ māṃ ca vijānāsi prativāsi hyahaṃ tava || 62 ||
agnidattastu vai nāma chāndaso brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||
iṣṭakāṃstu harannityaṃ parakīyāṃśca sarvadā || 63 ||
mṛtassugṛhakāmena rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ ||
mayā tvaṃ hi yathā prāpta upakāraṃ kuruṣva me || 64 ||
ekaviśrāmapuṇyaṃ me dehi tvaṃ vaṇiguttama ||
kṛpayā tu samāyukto vaṇigvacanamabravīt || 65 ||
sādhu rākṣasa dattaṃ te ekanṛtyaṃ mayā tava ||
ekanṛtyaprabhāveṇa rākṣaso muktimāgataḥ || 66 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
sudhanastu tato devi viśvarūpaṃ janārdanam ||
agratastu sthitaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā'sau dharaṇīṃ gataḥ ||67||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ devadevo janārdanaḥ||
caturbhujo divyatanuḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 68 ||
vimānavaramāruhya mama lokaṃ vrajasva ca ||
