pradakṣiṇāphalaṃ samyaganukramavidhiṃ vada||16||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
purā saptarṣibhiḥ pṛṣṭo brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||
idameva purā proktaṃ yathā pṛṣṭā tvayā hyaham ||17||
śrutvā sarvapurāṇoktaṃ tīrthānukramaṇaṃ param ||
pṛthivyāścaturantāyāstathā tadvaktumudyataḥ ||18||
sarvadeveṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam ||
sarvadāneṣu yatproktamiṣṭāpūrtteṣu caiva hi || 19 ||
yatphalaṃ labhyate viprāstasmācchataguṇottaram ||
prakramānmathurāyāstu satyametadvadāmi vaḥ || 20 ||
ityuktvā ṛṣayo jagmurabhivādya svayambhuvam ||
āgatya mathurāṃ devīmāśramāṃścakrire dvijāḥ || 21 ||
dhruveṇa sahitāścāsankāmayānāstu taddinam ||
kumudasya tu māsasya navamyāṃ śuklapakṣake || 22 ||
mathuropakramaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 23 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe mathurāmāhātmye mathurāpradakṣiṇādikaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 159 ||
atha mathurāparikramaprādurbhāvaḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
aṣṭamyāṃ mathurāṃ prāpya kārttikasyāsite naraḥ ||
snātvā viśrāṃtitīrthe tu pitṛdevārccane rataḥ || 1 ||
viśrāṃtidarśanaṃ kṛtvā dīrghaviṣṇuṃ ca keśavam ||
pradakṣiṇāyāḥ samyagvai phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 2 ||
upavāsarataḥ samyagalpamedhyāśano'thavā ||
dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca sāyāhne kṛtvā śuddhyarthamātmanaḥ || 3 ||
brahmacaryeṇa tāṃ rātriṃ kṛtvā saṅkalpya mānase ||
dhautavastreṇa susnāto maunavrataparāyaṇaḥ || 4 ||
tilākṣatakuśān gṛhya pitṛdevārthamudyataḥ ||
dīpahasto vanaṃ gatvā śrānto viśrāntijāgare || 5 ||
yathānukramaṇaṃ taiśca dhruvādyairṛṣibhiḥ kṛtam ||
evaṃ paraṃparāyātaṃ kramaṇīyaṃ narottamaiḥ || 6 ||
pradakṣiṇā varttamānā bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 7 ||
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā navamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
brāhme muhurtte saṃprāpte tato yātrāmupakramet || 8 ||
tathā prārabhayedyātrāṃ yāvannodayate raviḥ ||
prātaḥ snānaṃ tathā kuryāttīrthe dakṣiṇakoṭike || 9 ||
prakṣālya pādāvācamya hanumantaṃ prasādayet ||
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ kumāraṃ brahmacāriṇam || 10 ||
vijñāpya siddhikarttāraṃ yātrāsiddhipradāyakam ||
yasya saṃsmaraṇādeva sarve naśyantyupadravāḥ || 11 ||
yathā rāmasya yātrāyāṃ siddhiste supratiṣṭhitā ||
tathā paribhramante'dya bhavānsiddhiprado bhava || 12 ||
iti vijñāpya vidhivaddhanūmantaṃ gaṇeśvaram ||
dīpapuṣpopahāraistu pūjayitvā visarjjayet || 13 ||
tathaiva padmanābhaṃ tu dīrghaviṣṇuṃ bhayāpaham ||
vijñāpya siddhikarttāraṃ devyaśca tadanantaram || 14 ||
dṛṣṭvā vasumatīṃ devīṃ tathaiva hyaparājitām ||
āyudhāgārasaṃsthāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ sarvabhayāpahām || 15 ||
kaṃsavāsanikāṃ tadvadaugrasenāṃ ca carccikām ||
vadhūṭīṃ ca tathā devi dānavakṣayakāriṇīm || 16 ||
jayadāṃ devatānāṃ ca mātaro devapūjitāḥ ||
gṛhadevyo vāstudevyo dṛṣṭvānujñāpya nirgamet || 17 ||
maunavratadharo gacchedyāvaddakṣiṇakoṭike ||
prāpya snātvā pitṛm̐starpya dṛṣṭvā devaṃ praṇamya ca || 18 ||
natvā gacchedikṣuvāsāṃ devi kṛṣṇasupūjitām ||
bālakrīḍanarūpāṇi kṛtāni saha gopakaiḥ ||
yāni tīrthāni tānyeva sthāpitāni maharṣibhiḥ ||19||
khyātiṃ gatāni sarvāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ||
vatsaputraṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpaharaṃ param ||
arkasthalaṃ vīrasthalaṃ kuśasthalamanantaram || 20 ||
puṇyasthala mahāsthala mahāpāpavināśanam ||
paṃcasthalāni tatraiva sarvapāpaharāṇi ca || 21 ||
yeṣāṃ tu darśanādeva brahmaṇā saha modate ||
śivaṃ siddhamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthalānāṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 22 ||
hayamuktiṃ tato gacchetsiṃdūraṃ sasahāyakam ||
śrūyate cātra ṛṣibhirgāthā gītā purātanī || 23 ||
aśvārūḍhena tenaiva yatreyaṃ samanuṣṭhitā ||
aśvo muktiṃ gatastatra sahāyasahitaḥ sukham ||24||
rājaputraḥ sthitastatra yānayātrā na muktidā ||
tasmādyānaiśca yātrā tu na karttavyā phalecchayā||25||
tasmiṃstīrthe tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
kuṇḍaṃ śivasya vikhyātaṃ tatra snānaphalaṃ mahat ||26||
mallikādarśanaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya jayadaṃ śubham ||
tataḥ kadaṃbakhaṇḍasya gamanātsiddhimāpnuyāt || 27 ||
carcikā yoginī tatra yoginīparivāritā ||
kṛṣṇasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi sthitā sā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || 28 ||
aspṛśyā cāspṛśā caiva mātarau lokapūjitau ||
bālānāṃ darśanaṃ tābhyāṃ mahārakṣāṃ kariṣyati || 29 ||
varṣakhātaṃ tato gatvā kuṇḍaṃ pāpaharaṃ param ||
gatvā snātvā pitṝm̐starpya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 30 ||
kṣetrapālaṃ tato gatvā śivaṃ bhūteśvaraṃ haram ||
mathurākramaṇaṃ tasya jāyate saphalaṃ tathā || 31 ||
kṛṣṇakrīḍāsetubandhaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
bālānāṃ krīḍanārthaṃ ca kṛtvā devo gadādharaḥ || 32||
gopakaiḥ sahitastatra kṣaṇamekaṃ dinedine ||
tatraiva ramaṇārthaṃ hi nityakālaṃ sa gacchati || 33 ||
balihradaṃ ca tatraiva jalakrīḍākṛtaṃ śubham ||
yasya sandarśanādeva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 34 ||
tataḥ paraṃ ca kṛṣṇena kukkuṭaiḥ krīḍanaṃ kṛtam ||
yasya darśanamātreṇa caṇḍo'pi gatimāpnuyāt || 35 ||
stambhoccayaṃ suśikharaṃ saurabhaiḥ susugandhibhiḥ ||
bhūṣitaṃ pūjitaṃ tatra kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā || 36 ||
tasya pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā paripūjya prayatnataḥ ||
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ vrajettu saḥ ||37||
vasudevena devakyā garbhasya rakṣaṇāya ca ||
kṛtamekāntaśayanaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 38 ||
tato nārāyaṇasthānaṃ praviśenmuktihetave ||
parikramya tato devānnārāyaṇapurogamān || 39 ||
dṛṣṭvā tataḥ suvijñāpya gaṇaṃ vidhivināyakam ||
kubjikāṃ vāmanāṃ caiva brāhmaṇyau kṛṣṇapālite || 40 ||
anujñāya tataḥ sthānaṃ draṣṭuṃ gartteśvaraṃ śivam ||
dṛṣṭamātreṇa tatraiva yātrāphalamavāpyate || 41 ||
mahāvidyeśvarī devī ārakṣaṃ pāpakaṃ haret ||
kṣetrasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi yātrāyāḥ siddhidāṃ nṛṇām || 42 ||
prabhā mallī ca tatraiva dṛṣṭvā kāmānavāpnuyāt ||
mahāvidyeśvarī devī kṛṣṇarakṣārthamudyatā || 43 ||
nityaṃ sannihitā tatra siddhidā pāpanāśinī ||
kṛṣṇena balabhadreṇa gopaiḥ kaṃsaṃ jighāṃsubhiḥ || 44 ||
saṅketakaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra mantraniścayakārakam ||
tadā saṃketakaiḥ sā ca siddhā devī pratiṣṭhitā || 45 ||
siddhipradā bhogadā ca tena siddheśvarī smṛtā ||
saṃketakeśvarīṃ caiva dṛṣṭvā siddhimavāpnuyāt || 46 ||
tatra kuṇḍaṃ svacchajalaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
tato dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ gokarṇeśvaranāmataḥ || 47 ||
yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
sarasvatīṃ nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā tato bhadrāṇi paśyati || 48 ||
vighnarājaṃ tato gacchedgaṇeśaṃ vighnanāyakam ||
sarvasiddhipradaṃ ramyaṃ darśanācca phalaṃ labhet || 49 ||
gaṃgā sādhvī ca tatraiva mahāpātakanāśinī ||
dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā tathā dhyātvā sarvakāmānsamaśnute ||50||
mahādevamukhākāraṃ nāmnā rudramahālayam ||
kṣetrapaṃ taṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣetravāsaphalaṃ labhet || 51||
tasmāduttarakoṭiṃ ca dṛṣṭvā devaṃ gaṇeśvaram ||
dyūtakrīḍā bhagavatā kṛtā gopajanaiḥ saha || 52 ||
nānāpahāsarūpeṇa jitā gopyo dhanāni ca ||
gopairānīya tāścaiva kṛṣṇāya ca niveditāḥ ||53 ||
gopālakṛṣṇagamanaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
samastaṃ bālacaritaṃ bhramaṇaṃ ca yathāsukham ||54||
kṛtaṃ tatra yathārūpaṃ yadrūpaṃ ca yathā tathā ||
ṛṣibhiḥ sevitaṃ dhyātaṃ viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam ||55||
tato gacchenmahātīrthaṃ vimalaṃ yamunāmbhasi ||
snātvā pītvā pitṝṃstarpya nāmnā rudramahālayam || 56 ||
gārgyatīrthe mahāpuṇye narastatra tathā kramet ||
bhadreśvare mahātīrthe somatīrthe tathaiva ca || 57 ||
snātvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā yātrāphalaṃ labhet ||
sarasvatyāḥ saṅgame ca devarṣipitṛmānavān || 58 ||
santarpya vidhivaddattvā viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt ||
ghaṇṭābharaṇake tadvattathā garuḍakeśave || 59 ||
dhārālopanake tadvadvaikuṇṭhe khaṇḍavelake ||
mandākinyāḥ saṃyamane asikuṇḍe tathaiva ca || 60 ||
gopānāṃ tīrthake caiva tathā vai muktikeśvare ||
vailakṣagaruḍe caiva mahāpātakanāśane || 61 ||
tīrthānyetāni puṇyāni yathā viśrāntisaṃjñakam ||
eṣu tīrtheṣu kramito bhaktimāṃśca jitendriyaḥ || 62 ||
devānpitṝn samabhyarcya tato devaṃ prasādayet ||
avimukteśa deveśa saptarṣibhirabhiṣṭuta || 63 ||
mathurākramaṇīyaṃ me saphalaṃ syāttavājñayā ||
ityevaṃ devadeveśaṃ vijñāpya kṣetrapaṃ śivam || 64 ||
viśrāntisaṃjñake snānaṃ kṛtvā ca pitṛtarpaṇam ||
gataśramaṃ parikramya stutvā dṛṣṭvā praṇamya ca || 65 ||
sumaṅgalāṃ tato gacchedyātrāsiddhiṃ prasādayet ||
sarvamaṅgalamāṃgalye śive sarvārthasādhike || 66 ||
yātreyaṃ tvatprasādena saphalā me bhavatviti ||
pippalādeśvaraṃ devaṃ pippalādena pūjitam || 67 ||
viśrāntastu parikramya trātastatra mahātapāḥ ||
upalipya tatastasya śīrṣopari mahacchivam|| 68 ||
svanāmnā cihnitaṃ sthāpya tadā yātrāphalaṃ labhet ||
karkoṭakaṃ tathā nāgaṃ mahāduṣṭanivāraṇam || 69 ||
dṛṣṭvā gacchettato devīṃ yā kṛṣṇena vinirmitā ||
kaṃsabhedaṃ prathamataḥ śrutaṃ yatra kumantritam || 70 ||
sukhavāsaṃ ca varadaṃ kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ||
sukhāsīnaṃ ca tatraiva sthāpitaṃ śakunāya vai || 71 ||
svānukūlaḥ svaro yatra praveśe dakṣiṇaḥ svanaḥ ||
dhyātā svabhāve kṛṣṇena svasā sātisukhapradā || 72 ||
bhayārtena ca kṛṣṇena dhyātā devī ca caṇḍikā ||
sthāpitā siddhidā tatra nāmnā cārttiharā tataḥ ||73||
dṛṣṭvā sarvārttiharaṇaṃ yasyā devyāḥ sukhī naraḥ ||
agrottaraṃ śubhavaraṃ śakunārthaṃ ca yācataḥ || 74 ||
kṛṣṇasya kaṃsaghātārthaṃ saṃbhūtā sā tathottare ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manujaḥ kāmānsarvāniṣṭānavāpnuyāt || 75 ||
vajrānanaṃ tato dhyātvā kṛṣṇo mallajighāṃsayā||
nihatya mallānpaścāddhi vajrānanamakalpayat|| 76 ||
vāñchitārthaphalaṃ cakre kṛṣṇenāsya manorathān||
yasyai yasyai devatāyai tasyai tasyai dadau makham||77||
upayācitaṃ tu māṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham||
kṛṣṇasya bālacaritaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 78 ||
sūryaṃ taṃ varadaṃ devaṃ māthurāṇāṃ kuleśvaram ||
dṛṣṭvā tatraiva dānaṃ ca dattvā yātrāṃ samāpayet || 79 ||
evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā navamyāṃ śuklakaumude ||
sarvaṃ kulaṃ samādāya viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 80 ||
kramataḥ padavinyāsādyāvantaḥ sarvato diśaḥ ||
tāvantaḥ kulasaṃbhūtāḥ sūrye tiṣṭhanti śāśvate || 81 ||
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca caurā bhagnavratāśca ye ||
agamyāgamane śīlāḥ kṣetradārāpahārakāḥ || 82 ||
mathurākramaṇaṃ kṛtvā vipāpmāno bhavanti te ||
anyadeśāgato dūrātparibhramati yo naraḥ || 83 ||
tasya sandarśanādanye pūtāḥ syurvigatāmayāḥ ||
śrutaṃ yaiśca vidūrasthaiḥ kṛtayātraṃ naraṃ naraiḥ ||84||
sarvapāpavinirmuktāste yānti paramaṃ padam ||85||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe mathurā parikramaprādurbhāvo nāma ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 160 ||
atha devavanaprabhāvaḥ ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
ye dharmavimukhā mūḍhāḥ sarvajñānavivarjitāḥ ||
kā gatiḥ kṛṣṇa teṣāṃ hi vihitā narake suraiḥ ||1 ||
abhuktvā nārakaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukṛtaiḥ puṇyadairnṛṇām ||
prayānti karmaṇā yena tamupāyaṃ bravīhi me || 2 ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
sarvadharmavihīnānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ durātmanām ||
narakārttiharā devī mathurā pāpaghātinī || 3 ||
mathurāvāsino ye ca tīrthānāṃ copasevakāḥ ||
vanānāṃ darśako vātha mathurākramako'pi vā ||4 ||
eṣāṃ madhye kṛtaṃ yaiśca ekaṃ ca śatamojasā ||
na te naraka bhoktāraḥ svargabhājo bhavanti te ||5||
ādau madhuvanaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ tālameva ca ||
vanaṃ kundavanaṃ caiva tṛtīyaṃ vanamuttamam ||6||
caturthaṃ kāmyakavanaṃ vanānāṃ vanamuttamam ||
paṃcamaṃ vai bahuvanaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ bhadravanaṃ smṛtam || 7 ||
saptamaṃ tu vanaṃ bhūme khādiraṃ lokaviśrutam ||
mahāvanaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ tu sadaiva ca mama priyam || 8 ||
lohārgalavanaṃ nāma navamaṃ pātakāpaham ||
vanaṃ bilvavanaṃ nāma daśamaṃ devapūjitam || 9 ||
ekādaśaṃ tu bhāṇḍīraṃ dvādaśaṃ vṛndakā vanam ||
etāni ye prapaśyanti na te narakabhoginaḥ ||10||
yathākrameṇa ye yātrāṃ vanānāṃ ca jitendriyāḥ ||
kariṣyanti varārohe indralokaṃ vrajanti te || 11 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe mathurāmāhātmye devavanaprabhāvo nāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 161 ||
atha cakratīrthaprabhāvaḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
cakratīrthe purāvṛttaṃ mathurāyāstathottare ||1||
mahāgṛhodayaṃ nāma jambūdvīpasya bhūṣaṇam ||
tasmin puravare divye brāhmaṇo vasate śubhe ||2||
sa kanyāṃ putramādāya brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ ||
śāligrāmaṃ mahāpuṇyamagacchadbrāhmaṇottamaḥ || 3 ||
tatrāsau vāsamakarotpuṇyasevī jitendriyaḥ ||
tīrthasevī tathā snāyī devatādarśane rataḥ || 4 ||
tatra siddhena saṃvāso brāhmaṇasyābhavattadā||
sa siddho vasate nityaṃ kalpagrāme ca sarvadā ||5||
gacchetsa sarvakālaṃ tu śāligrāme vasundhare ||
sa tena saha saṅgatya kānyakubjanivāsinā ||6||
kalpagrāma vibhūtiṃ ca nityakālamavarṇayat ||
kalpagrāmavibhūtiṃ ca śrutvā sa munisattamaḥ || 7 ||
gamane buddhirutpannā tataḥ siddhamayācata ||
mitratvaṃ varttate siddha nayasvātmaniveśane || 8 ||
brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā siddho vacanamabravīt ||
tatra siddhā hi gacchanti tena tatra gatirbhavet || 9 ||
prārthanā duḥkhalābhaṃ tu śṛṇu vai brāhmaṇottama ||
ātmayogabalenaiva caliṣyāmi saputrakaḥ || 10 ||
dakṣiṇe tu kare gṛhya brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam ||
vāme caiva kare gṛhya tasya putraṃ mahāmatim || 11 ||
utpapāta tadā siddho gṛhītvā brāhmaṇottamau ||
kalpagrāme tu tau muktau pitāputrau vasundhare || 12 ||
tatra tau vasato nityaṃ kalpagrāme dvijottamau ||
tatra kālena mahatā rugdehe cābhavattadā || 13 ||
rujā tu pīḍyamānaḥ sa daśamīṃ ca daśāṃ gataḥ ||
martukāmo dvijavaro nirīkṣya sutamuttamam || 14 ||
uvāca putraṃ dharmātmā maraṇe samupasthite ||
gaṃgātīre ca māṃ putra naya tvaṃ mā vilambaya || 15 ||
tena putreṇa nīto'sau gaṃgātīre mahāmuniḥ ||
ruroda putrastu tadā pitṛsnehasamanvitaḥ || 16 ||
vedādhyayanaśīlaḥ sa pitṛbhaktyā niyantritaḥ ||
vasatastasya vai tatra kālo jāto mahāmateḥ ||17||
kalpagrāme tadā siddhastasya kanyā sumadhyamā ||
varamanveṣayantī sā na prāptastu tayā mataḥ || 18 ||
kadāciddevayogena kānyakubjanivāsinaḥ ||
gṛhe praviṣṭo vipraḥ sa bhojanārthaṃ mahāmatiḥ || 19 ||
pṛṣṭo'sau brāhmaṇo bhadre kva bhavāṃstvamihāgataḥ||
sa sarvaṃ kathayāmāsa yathāvṛttaṃ dṛḍhavrataḥ||20||
divyajñānena taṃ jñātvā pūjayāmāsa taṃ dvijaḥ||
pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ kanyāṃ tasmai dadau tadā||21||
śvaśurasya gṛhe nityaṃ bhojanaṃ kurute dvijaḥ ||
vasate pitṛsānnidhye praticārī sa putrakaḥ ||22||
kāle bhagavatastasya atikṣīṇaḥ pitā tadā ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣīṇatāṃ prāptaṃ śvaśuraṃ paryapṛcchata ||23||
svāminpiturme maraṇaṃ bhaviṣyati vadasva mām ||
jāmātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya śvaśuro'bravīt ||24||
śūdrānnaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tena nityakālaṃ dvijottama ||

śrīvarāha uvāca ||

śabarastu sabhāryo vai krīḍate sa mayā saha ||76||

ityuktamātre vacane śabaro vākyamabravīt ||

śabara uvāca ||

śrīvarāha uvāca ||
śukaṃ gṛhya tataḥ sthānātprasthito mathurāṃ purīm ||
praviśya gṛhya tatpuṇyaṃ mātāpitrostadarpitam || 1 ||

pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ ||

gokarṇastu tathā cakre tasminnāyatane śubhe ||
prathame'hni yathā kṛtyamevameva trayodaśa || 1 ||

śrīvarāha uvāca ||

śatrughnena purā ghoro lavaṇaḥ sūdito yathā ||

śrīvarāha uvāca ||

tarpaṇaṃ dhruvatīrthe te pitṝṇāṃ ṣoḍaśāntare || 123 ||

eṣa eva prabhāvo'tra dhruvasya kathito mayā || 124 ||
dṛṣṭo bhavadbhiḥ sarvaṃ yadasmākaṃ suduratyayam ||
dustaraṃ tāritaṃ pāpaṃ tvatprasādānmahāmune || 125 ||
iti viśrāvya vacanaṃ rājānaṃ sa ṛṣiṃ janān ||
rājaputrīṃ tathā dāsīṃ svāṃ sutāṃ śivamastu vaḥ ||126||
āruhya varayānaṃ te gatāḥ svargaṃ vṛtā suraiḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
tataḥ sa rājaśārdūlaḥ sagaṇaḥ parivārakaiḥ || 127 ||
dṛṣṭvā tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ praṇamya ṛṣisattamam ||
praviṣṭo nagarīṃ ramyāṃ saṃsmarannityamacyutam || 128 ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre māhātmyaṃ mathurābhavam ||
smaraṇādyasya pāpāni naśyante pūrvajanmani || 129 ||
paṭhati śraddhayā yukto brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau ||
sa pitṝṃstarpayetsarvānabhigamya gayāśire || 130 ||
etattvayānāvratine na cāśuśrūṣaye tathā ||
kathanīyaṃ mahābhāge yaśca nārccayate harim || 131 ||
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmamuttamam ||
jñānānāṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ lābhānāṃ lābha uttamaḥ || 132 ||
kathanīyaṃ mahābhāge puṇyānbhāgavatānsadā ||
sūta uvāca ||
etacchrutvā prabhorvākyaṃ dharaṇī vismayānvitā || 133 ||
papraccha muditā devī pratimāsthāpanaṃ prati || 134 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre mathurāvarṇanaṃ nāmāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 180 ||
atha madhukāṣṭhāpratimāyāmarcāsthāpanam ||
sūta uvāca ||
evaṃ śrutvā paraṃ sthānaṃ sā mahī saṃśitavratā||
sarvakṣetravibhāgeṣu yaśca vai paramo vidhiḥ || 1 ||
saṃśrutya vismayāviṣṭā pratyuvāca vasundharā ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
aho kṣetraprabhāvo vai yastvayā samudāhṛtaḥ || 2 ||
yaṃ śrutvā devatattvena jātāsmi vigatajvarā ||
ekaṃ me paramaṃ guhyaṃ yannityaṃ hṛdi varttate || 3 ||
mama prītyarthamakhilaṃ tadviṣṇo vaktumarhasi ||
kathaṃ tiṣṭhasi kāṣṭheṣu śailamṛnmayajeṣu ca || 4 ||
tāmre kāṃsye ca raupye ca tiṣṭhasi sthāpitaḥ katham ||
sauvarṇeṣu ca sarveṣu tiṣṭhasi sthāpitaḥ katham || 5 ||
brahmacārī samāsādya kathaṃ tiṣṭhasi mādhava ||
dantaratne samāsādya kathaṃ santiṣṭhate bhavān || 6 ||
kathaṃ tiṣṭhasi vā savye bhittisaṃstho janārdanaḥ ||
bhūmisaṃstho mahābhāga vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 7 ||
evaṃ dharāvacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvācādisūkaraḥ ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
pratimā yasya karttavyā tadānīya vasundhare || 8 ||
pratimāṃ kārayeccaiva lakṣaṇoktāṃ vasundhare ||
arcāśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānataḥ ||9||
tataḥ sampūjayeddevi saṃsārabhavamuktaye ||
tatra kāṣṭheṣu madhukamānīya ca vasundhare || 10 ||
kṛtvā tatpratimāṃ caiva pratiṣṭhāvidhinārccayet ||
tāṃstu dadyāttu gandhāṃśca ye mayā samudāhṛtāḥ || 11 ||
karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva tvacaṃ cāgurumeva ca ||
rasaṃ ca candanaṃ caiva silhakośīrakaṃ tathā || 12 ||
etairvilepanaṃ dadyādarcitastu vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
svastikaṃ varddhamānaṃ ca śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathā ||13 ||
vidhānapūrvakaṃ caiva maṃgalyaṃ caiva pāyasam ||
varttistilaphalaṃ caiva karmaṇyāni na saṃśayaḥ || 14 ||
evaṃ sarvaṃ tato dadyātpūjāyāṃ vihitaṃ śubham ||
karmaṇā vidhidṛṣṭena śuddho bhāgavataḥ śuciḥ||15||
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā imaṃ mantramudīrayet ||
yo'sau bhavāṃstiṣṭhate ca sarvayogapradhānataḥ || 16 ||
sasambhramaṃ loke supratītastiṣṭha kāṣṭhe sa tvaṃ bhuvi ||
evaṃ saṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā kāṣṭhasya pratimāsu ca ||17 ||
punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śuddhairbhāgavataiḥ saha ||
prajvālya dīpaṃ tatraiva cārccāyāḥ sammukhaṃ sthitaḥ || 18 ||
norddhvaṃ na tiryagīkṣeta kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ ||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 19 ||
kuryātsaṃskaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 20 ||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavānsarvajanapravīra gatiḥ prabhustvaṃ vasasi hyamogha ||
anena mantreṇa ca lokanātha saṃsthāpitastiṣṭha ca vāsudeva || 21 ||
sarvāmevaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mama saṃsthāpanakriyām ||
pūjyā bhāgavatāḥ sarve ye tatra samupāgatāḥ || 22 ||
gandhamālyairarcayitvā upalepaiśca bhojanaiḥ ||
kuryātsaṃskaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 23 ||
etatkarmavidhānena madhukāṣṭhasya sundari ||
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya etatte kathitaṃ mayā || 24 ||
yastvanena vidhānena arccāṃ kāṣṭhasya sthāpayet ||
sa na gacchati saṃsāraṃ mama lokaṃ ca gacchati || 25 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre madhukāṣṭhāyāṃ pratimārccāsthāpanaṃ nāma ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 181 ||
atha śailārccāsthāpanam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
yathā tiṣṭhāmi śaileṣu pratimāyāmitastataḥ || 1 ||
surūpāṃ ca śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā niḥśalyāṃ suparīkṣitām ||
tatra dakṣaṃ rūpakāraṃ śīghraṃ ca viniyojayet || 2 ||
śīghramālikhya taṃ tatra śvetavartikayā naraḥ ||
pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjayedakṣatādibhiḥ || 3 ||
dīpakaṃ ca tato dadyādbaliṃ dadhyodanena ca ||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti uktvā mantramudīrayet || 4 ||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavānsarvajanapravīraḥ somāgnitejāḥ sumatipradhānaḥ ||
etena mantreṇa tu vāsudeva pratiṣṭhito varddhaya kīrttirāśim || 5 ||
pravara ayutavarāha jaya jaya varddhasva ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa karttavyaṃ yasya yādṛśam ||
evaṃrūpaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 6 ||
tato vai sthāpayettatra pūrvābhimukhameva tu ||
ahorātramuṣitvaivaṃ śuklavastreṇa bhūṣitaḥ || 7 ||
śuklayajñopavītī ca kṛtvā vai dantadhāvanam ||
sarvagandhodakaṃ gṛhya imaṃ mantramudāharet||8||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavāṃstiṣṭhati sarvarūpaṃ māyābalaṃ sarvajagatsvarūpam ||
etena mantreṇa jagatsvarūpa sampūjitastiṣṭhasi lokanātha||9|| karaṇadhāraṇapravadhyamudāharaṇamaparājitamajarāmara ||
sampūjya snāpayātmānamanena mantreṇa oṃ namo vāsudevāya ||
evaṃ tu sthāpanaṃ kṛtvā śilāyāṃ mama sundari ||
tato 'dhivāsanaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvaproṣṭhapadāsu ca || 10 ||
yo māṃ saṃsthāpayedbhūme mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 11 ||
yāvakaṃ pāyasaṃ bhuktvā ahorātraṃ samāpayet ||
tataḥ paścimasandhyāyāṃ dadyāccatvāri dīpakān||12||
paṃcagavyaṃ ca gandhaṃ ca vāriṇā saha miśrayet ||
caturaḥ kalaśāṃścaiva sthāpayetpādamūlataḥ || 13 ||
gītavāditraghoṣeṇa utsavaṃ tatra kārayet ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ sāmagaistatra vedaghoṣaṃ tu kārayet || 14 ||
brahmākṣarasahasrāṇi paṭhatāṃ brahmavādinām ||
yeṣāṃ paṭhitaśabdena śubhagītasvareṇa ca || 15 ||
āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ devi mantrapāṭho mama priyaḥ ||
niḥśabdaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā sthāpyo bhāgavataiḥ saha ||16||
punarāvāhanaṃ kuryānmantreṇānena suvrataḥ ||
āgaccha he deva sumantrayuktaḥ paṃcendriyaiḥ ṣaṭsu tathā pradhānaḥ ||17||
eteṣu bhūteṣu ca saṃvidhātā āvāsitastiṣṭhati lokanātha || 18 ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa samittilaghṛtena ca ||
madhunā caiva hotavyamaṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ || 19 ||
evaṃ kṛte vidhāne bhavāmi sannihitaḥ svayam ||
vyatītāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ prabhāte vimale tataḥ||20 ||
paṃcagavyaṃ tata prāśya mantreṇa vidhipūrvakam ||
sarvagandhaiśca lājaiśca paṃcagavyajalaṃ tathā || 21 ||
tataḥ prāsāde sthāpyo'haṃ gītavāditramaṅgalaiḥ ||
sarvagandhāṃstato gṛhya imaṃ mantramudāharet || 22 ||
mantraśca -
yo'sau bhavām̐llakṣaṇalakṣitaśca lakṣmyā ca yuktaḥ satataṃ purāṇaḥ ||
atra prāsāde susamiddhatejāḥ praveśamāyāhi namo namaste ||23||
tata etena mantreṇa prāsādaṃ saṃpraveśayet ||
pratimā sthāpitavyā me madhye na tu vipārśvataḥ || 24 ||
evaṃ saṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā dadyādudvarttanaṃ vibhoḥ ||
candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva miśraṃ kāleyakena ca ||25||
evaṃ codvarttanaṃ kṛtvā imaṃ mantramudāharet ||
yo'sau bhavānsarvajagatpradhānaḥ sampūjito brahmabṛhaspatibhyām ||
pravanditaḥ kāraṇaṃ mantrayuktaḥ susvāgataṃ tiṣṭha sulokanātha || 26 ||
evaṃ saṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā gandhamālyaiśca pūjayet ||
śuklavastrāṇi me dadyādimaṃ mantramudāharet || 27 ||
mantraḥ -
vastrāṇi deveśa gṛhāṇa tāni mayā subhaktyā racitāni yāni ||
imāni sandhāraya viśvamūrtte prasīda mahyaṃ ca namo namaste ||28||
evaṃ vastrāṇi me dadyādvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
dhūpanaṃ me tato dadyātkuṅkumāgurumiśritam ||
evaṃ ca dhūpanaṃ dadyādimaṃ mantramudīrayet || 29 ||
mantraḥ -
asāvanādiḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇo nārāyaṇaḥ sarvajagat pradhānaḥ ||
gandhaṃ ca mālyāni ca dhūpa dīpau gṛhāṇa deveśa namo namaste || 30 ||
evaṃ pūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prāpaṇaṃ ca nivedayet ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena prāpaṇaṃ copakalpya ca || 31 ||
pūrvoktenaiva mantreṇa dadyātprāpaṇakaṃ budhaḥ ||
prāpaṇānte cācamanaṃ dadyāddehaviśuddhaye || 32||
śāntijāpastataḥ kāryaḥ sarvakāryārthasiddhidaḥ ||
mantraḥ -
tvaṃ vai suśāntiṃ kuru lokanātha rājñaḥ sarāṣṭrasya ca brāhmaṇānām ||
bāleṣu vṛddheṣu gavāṅgaṇeṣu kanyāsu śāntiṃ ca pativratāsu || 33 ||
rogā vinaśyantu ca sarvataśca kṛṣīvalānāṃ ca kṛṣiḥ sadā syāt||
subhikṣayuktāśca sadā hi lokāḥ kāle suvṛṣṭirbhavitā ca śāntiḥ ||34||
evaṃ vidhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
saṃpūjya tatra deveśaṃ brāhmaṇānbhojayedvratī || 35 ||
dīnānāthānpratarpyātha yathāvibhavaśaktitaḥ ||
ya etena vidhānena kuryātsaṃsthāpanaṃ mama || 36 ||
yāvanto mama gātreṣu jāyante jalabindavaḥ ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi mama lokeṣu tiṣṭhati || 37 ||
yo māṃ saṃsthāpayedbhūme sarvāhaṅkāravarjitaḥ ||
tāritaṃ ca kulaṃ tena sapta sapta ca saptatiḥ || 38 ||
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre śailikāsthāpanaṃ mama ||
dharmasandhāraṇārthāya mama bhakta sukhāya ca || 39 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe śailārcāsthāpanaṃ nāma dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 182 ||
atha mṛnmayārcāsthāpanam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
tiṣṭhāmi mṛnmayīṃ cāpi pratimāṃ pūjanecchayā ||1||
ārccāṃ ca mṛnmayīṃ kṛtvā asphuṭāṃ cāpyakhaṇḍitām ||
nādhikāṃ vāmanāṃ cāpi na vakrāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ||2||
īdṛśīṃ pratimāṃ kṛtvā mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
bhūme sarvāṇi karmāṇi yathā vā rocate tathā || 3 ||
kāṣṭhānāmapyalābhe tu mṛnmayīṃ tatra kārayet ||
śailajāṃ vā tato bhūme mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 4 ||
tāmreṇa kāṃsyaraupyeṇa sauvarṇatrapu rītibhiḥ ||
kurvanti śubhakarmāṇaḥ kovidaḥ pratimāṃ śubhām || 5 ||
arcanaṃ tvaparaṃ vedyāṃ mama kamarparigrahāt||
kecillokāpavādena khyātyai kurvanti kecana ||6||
gṛhaṃ cālocya kaścinmāṃ pūjayetkāmanāparaḥ ||
pūjayedyadi vā cakraṃ mama tejoṃśasambhavam || 7||
bhūme evaṃ vijānīhi sthāpito'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
sampadastu prayacchāmi pūjito'haṃ dharādhare || 8 ||
mantrairvā vidhipūrveṇa yo me karmāṇi kārayet ||
yaṃ yaṃ phalaṃ samuddiśya māṃ pūjayati mānavaḥ || 9 ||
tattatphalaṃ prayacchāmi prasannenāntarātmanā ||
mama caiva prasādena prāpnoti gatimuttamām || 10 ||
madbhaktaḥ satataṃ nityaṃ karmaṇā pariveṣṭitaḥ ||
sa vai matparitoṣārthaṃ manasyeva prapūjayet || 11 ||
dadyājjalāñjaliṃ mahyaṃ tena me prītiruttamā ||
tasya kiṃ sumanobhiśca jāpyena niyamena kim ||12||
mahyaṃ cintayato nityaṃ nibhṛtenāntarātmanā ||
tasya kāmānprayacchāmi divyānbhogānmanoramān || 13 ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ sugopyaṃ ca prayatnataḥ ||
mṛnmayīṃ pratimāṃ kṛtvā mama karmasu niṣṭhitaḥ ||14||
śravaṇe caiva nakṣatre kuryāttasyādhivāsanam ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena sthāpayenmantrapūrvakam || 15 ||
paṃcagavyaṃ ca gandhaṃ ca vāriṇā saha miśrayet ||
tato me snapanaṃ kāryamimaṃ mantramudāharet || 16 ||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavānsarvajagatprakarttā yasya prasādena bhavanti lokāḥ ||
sa tvaṃ kuruṣvācyuta matprasādaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭha cārccāsu ca mṛnmayīṣu || 17 || 
kāraṇakāraṇaṃ hyugratejasaṃ dyutimantaṃ mahāpuruṣaṃ namo namaḥ ||
anena mantreṇa veśmani praviśya sthāpanāṃ kuryāt ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa sthāpayenmāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
pūrvavatsthāpayettatra caturaḥ kalaśānpurā ||
caturastāngṛhītvā ca imaṃ mantramudāharet || 18 ||
mantraḥ -
oṃ varuṇaṃ samudro labdhvā saṃpūjito hyātmamatiprasannaḥ ||
etena mantreṇa mamābhiṣekaṃ prāptaṃ variṣṭhaṃ hi sa ūrdhvabāhuḥ ||
agniśca bhūmiśca rasāśca sarve bhavanti yasmātsatataṃ namasye || 19 ||
evamāsnāpya vidhivanmama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
pūrvoktavidhinā caiva gandhamālyaiśca pūjayet || 20 ||
aguruṃ caiva dhūpaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ sakuṅkumam ||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti uktvā dhūpaṃ prakalpayet || 21 ||
dhūpaṃ dattvā yathānyāyaṃ pītaṃ vastraṃ tu dāpayet ||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti uktvā mantramudāharet || 22 ||
mantraḥ -
vastreṇa pītena sadā prasanno yasminprasanne tu jagatprasannam ||
gṛhṇātu vastraṃ sumukhaḥ prasanno devaḥ sadā pātu bhavasya bandhāt ||23||
tata etena maṃtreṇa vastraṃ dadyādyathocitam ||
dhūpadīpādibhiḥ pūjya prāpaṇaṃ parikalpayet || 24 ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena dadyātprāpaṇakaṃ naraḥ ||
paścādācamanaṃ dadyānmantrapūrvaṃ prayatnataḥ || 25 ||
mantraḥ -
śāntirbhavatu devānāṃ brahma kṣatraviśāṃ tathā ||
śāntirbhavatu vṛddhānāṃ bālānāṃ śāntiruttamā ||26||
devo varṣatu parjanyaḥ pṛthivī sasyapūritā ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa śāntiṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || 27 ||
paścādbhāgavatānpūjya tato brāhmaṇapūjanam ||
śirasā vacanaṃ kāryaṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ prapūjya ca || 28 ||
acchidraṃ vācya paścācca kuryādevaṃ visarjanam ||
evaṃ visarjanaṃ kṛtvā ye ca tatra samāgatāḥ || 29 ||
pūjayettāṃśca vidhivadvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
pūjayīta guruṃ tatra yadīcchenmama sātmyatām || 30 ||
yo guruṃ pūjayedbhaktyā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
tenāhaṃ pūjito nityaṃ devi satyaṃ bravīmi te || 31 ||
tuṣṭo dadāti kṛcchreṇa grāmamātraṃ narādhipaḥ ||
ābrahmapadaparyantaṃ helayā yacchate guruḥ || 32 ||
tathaiva mama śāstreṣu mamaiva vacanācchubhe ||
sarvaśāstreṣu kalyāṇi gurupūjā vyavasthitā || 33 ||
ya etena vidhānena kuryātsaṃsthāpanaṃ mama ||
tāritāni kulānyeva trīṇi triṃśacca saptatiḥ || 34 ||
pūjāyāṃ mama mārgeṣu patanti jalabindavaḥ ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi mama lokeṣu modate || 35 ||
evaṃ te kathitaṃ bhūme sthāpanaṃ mṛnmayasya tu ||
kathayiṣyāmi te hyanyat sarvabhāgavatapriyam || 36 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe mṛnmayārccāsthāpanaṃ nāma tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 183 ||
atha tāmrārcāsthāpanam ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
tāmreṇa pratimāṃ kṛtvā surūpāṃ caiva bhāsvarām ||
ucitenopacāreṇa veśmamadhyamupānayet || 1 ||
tato veśmanyupāgamya sthāpayitvā udaṅmukhaḥ ||
citrāyāṃ caiva nakṣatre kuryāccaivādhivāsanam ||2||
jalaṃ ca sarvagandhena paṃcagavyena miśritam ||
snāpayecca tato māṃ vai imaṃ mantramudāharet || 3 ||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavāṃstiṣṭhati sārabhūtaḥ tvaṃ tāmrake tiṣṭhasi netrabhūtaḥ ||
āgaccha mūrttau saha paṃcabhūtairmayā ca pātraiḥ saha viśvadhāman || 4 ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa sthāpayitvā yaśasvini ||
pūrvanyāyena karttavyamadhivāsanapūjanam || 5 ||
vyatītāyāṃ ca śarvaryāmudite ca divākare ||
ṛcā śuddhiṃ vidhāyā'tha snāpayenmantrapūrvakam || 6 ||

mantraḥ -

mantraḥ -
oṃ gṛhṇīṣva me suvimalaṃ madhuparkamādyaṃ saṃsāranāśanakaraṃ tvamṛtena tulyam || nārāyaṇena racitaṃ bhagavatpriyāṇāṃ dāhe ca śāntikaraṇaṃ suralokapūjyam || 109 ||

śmaśrukarma prakarttavyaṃ viprasya tu yathāvidhi||18||
snāpanābhyañjanaṃ kāryaṃ pretasantoṣadāyakam||
gṛhītvā bhūmibhāgaṃ ca sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kārayet||19||
nipātadeśaṃ saṃgṛhya śucideśe samāhitaḥ||
nadīkūle nikhāte vā pretabhūmiṃ vinirdeśet||20||
catuḥṣaṣṭikṛtaṃ bhāgaṃ yathāvatsukṛtaṃ bhavet||
tato dakṣiṇapūrveṣu digvibhāgeṣu sundari||21 ||
chāyāyāṃ kuṃjarasyāpi nadīkūladrume tathā ||
cāṇḍālādiprahīṇe tu pretakāryaṃ samācaret ||22||
yaṃ deśaṃ ca na paśyanti kukkuṭaśvānaśūkarāḥ ||
śvā cāpohati rāveṇa garjitena ca śūkaraḥ||23||
kukkuṭaḥ pakṣavātena cāṇḍālaśca yathā dhare||
tatra kurvanti ye śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ bandhanapradam||24||
varjanīyā budhairete pretakāryeṣu sundari ||
devatāsuragandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ|| 25 ||
nāgā bhūtāni yajñāśca ye ca sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā yathā devi tava pṛṣṭhe pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 26 |||
dhārayiṣyāmi suśroṇi viṣṇumāyātataṃ jagat ||
caṇḍālamāditaḥ kṛtvā narāṇāṃ tu śubhāśubham|| 27||
snānaṃ kurvantu te bhūme sthaṇḍile tadanantare ||
akṛtvā pṛthivībhāgaṃ nivāpaṃ ye tu kurvate || 28||
tvadadhīnaṃ jagadbhadre tavocchiṣṭaṃ hataṃ bhavet ||
na devāḥ pitarastasya gṛhṇantīha kadācana || 29 ||
patanti narake ghore tenocchiṣṭena sundari ||
sthaṇḍile pretabhāgaṃ tu dadyātpūrvāhṇikaṃ tu tam || 30 ||
kṛtvā tu piṇḍasaṅkalpaṃ nāmagotreṇa mādhavi ||
paścādaśnanti gotrāṇi kulajāścaikabhojanāḥ || 31 ||
na dadyādanyagotrebhyo ye na bhuñjanti tatra vai ||
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ pretakāryeṣu sundarī || 32 ||
evaṃ dattena prīyante pretalokagatā narāḥ ||
adatvā pretabhāgaṃ tu bhuṅkte yastatra mānavaḥ || 33 ||
gatvā mahānadīṃ so'pi sacailaṃ snānamācaret ||
tīrthāni manasā gatvā tribhirabhyukṣayedbhuvam || 34 ||
evaṃ śuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇān śīghramānayet ||
āgatāṃśca dvijān dṛṣṭvā karttavyā svāgatakriyā ||35||
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tato dadyāddhṛṣṭapuṣṭena mādhavi ||
āsanaṃ copakalpeta mantreṇa vidhipūrvakam ||36||
mantraḥ -
idaṃ te āsanaṃ dattaṃ viśrāmaṃ kriyatāṃ dvija||
kuruṣva me prasādaṃ ca suprasīd dvijottama || 37||
upaveśyāsane vipraṃ chatraṃ saṅkalpayetpunaḥ ||
nivāraṇārthamākāśe bhūtā gaganacāriṇaḥ ||38||
devagandharva yakṣāśca siddhasaṃghā mahāsurāḥ ||
dhāraṇārthaṃ tathākāśe chatraṃ tejasvināṃ kṛtam || 39 |||
pretasya ca hitārthāya dhārayeta vasundhare ||
pūrvaṃ saṃhṛṣṭatuṣṭena pretabhāgaṃ ca dāpayet || 40 ||
chatramāvaraṇārthaṃ tu dadyāñcaiva dvijātaye ||
ākāśe tatra paśyanti devāḥ siddhapurogamāḥ||41||
gandharvā hyasurāḥ siddhā rākṣasāḥ piśitāśinaḥ ||
dṛśyamāneṣu sarveṣu pretaḥ saṃvrīḍito bhavet ||42||
vrīḍamānaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā hasaṃtyasurarākṣasāḥ ||
evaṃ nivāraṇaṃ chatramādityena kṛtaṃ purā||43||
pretalokagatānāṃ ca sarvadevarṣiṇāṃ purā ||
agnivarṣaṃ śilāvarṣaṃ taptaṃ tatra jalodakam||44||
bhasmavarṣaṃ tato ghoramahorātreṇa mādhavi ||
pādau ca te na dahyetāṃ yamasya viṣayaṃ gate ||
tamo'ndhakāraviṣamaṃ durgamaṃ ghoradarśanam ||47||
ekākī duḥsahaṃ loke pathā yena sa gacchati ||
kālo mṛtyuśca dūtaśca yaṣṭimudyamya pṛṣṭhataḥ || 48||
ahorātreṇa ghoreṇa pretaṃ nayati mādhavi ||
dadyāttadarthaṃ viprāya padatre ca sukhāvahe || 49||
taptavālumayī bhūmiḥ kaṇṭakairupasaṃstṛtā||
tena durgāṇi tarati dattayopānahātra vai||50||
paścāddhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca dadyādvai mantrapūrvakam||
yāti yena vijānīyātpṛthakpretena yojayet || 51 ||
nāmagotramudāhṛtya pretāya tadanantaram ||
śīghramāvāhayedbhūme darbhapātre ca bhūtale||52||
mantraḥ -
iha lokaṃ parityajya gato'si paramāṃ gatim ||
gṛhṇa gandhaṃ mudā yukto bhaktyā pretopapāditam || 53||
gandhamantraḥ -
sarvagandhaṃ sarvapuṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathaiva ca ||
pratigṛhṇīṣva viprendra pretamokṣaprado bhava || 54 ||
evaṃ vastrāṇi viprāya sarvāṇyābharaṇāni ca ||
punaḥ punaśca pakvānnaṃ prayacchettu vasundhare || 55 ||
evamādīni dravyāṇi pretabhogyāni sarvaśaḥ ||
pādaśaucādi triḥ kṛtvā cāturvarṇyasya mādhavi ||56||
evaṃvidhaḥ prayoktavyaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ mantravarjitam ||
amantrasya ca śūdrasya vipro gṛhṇāti mantrataḥ ||57||
etatsarvaṃ vinirvartya pakvānnaṃ bhojayeddvijam||
bhokṣyamāṇena vipreṇa jñānaśuddhena sundari ||58||
pretāya prathamaṃ dadyānna spṛśeta parātparam ||
sarvaṃ vyañjanasaṃyuktaṃ pretabhāgaṃ prakalpayet ||59||
devatvaṃ brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca pretapiṇḍe pradīyate ||
mānuṣatvaṃ nivāpeṣu jñātavyaṃ satataṃ budhaiḥ ||60||
pitṛsthāne pradātavyaṃ vidhānānmantrasaṃyutam ||
evaṃ preteṣu vipreṣu eva kālo na vidyate || 61||
hastaśaucaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā hyupaspṛśya yathāvidhi ||
samantraṃ pratigṛhṇāti pakvānnaṃ bhakṣyabhojanam || 62 ||
bhujyamānasya viprasya pretabhāgaṃ ca nityaśaḥ ||
jñātivargeṣu gotreṣu sambandhisvajaneṣu ca || 63 ||
bhāgastatra pradātavyastasyārthe yasya vidyate ||
viprāya dīyamāne tu vāraṇīyaṃ na kenacit || 64 ||
nivārayati yo dattaṃ guruhatyāphalaṃ labhet ||
na devā pratigṛhṇanti nāgnaya pitarastathā ||65 ||
evaṃ vilupyate dharmaḥ pretastatra na tuṣyati ||
evaṃ vicintyamānasya yathā dharmo na lupyate || 66 ||
jñātisambandhimadhye tu yo dadyātpretabhojanam ||
hṛṣṭena manasā vipre pretabhāgaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 67 ||
kūṭavatpratitiṣṭheta dṛṣṭvā tṛptiṃ na gacchati ||
evaṃ tu pretabhāvena śīghraṃ muñcati kilbiṣāt || 68 ||
tṛptiṃ jñātvā tu viprasya pakvānnena tu mādhavi ||
dātavyamudake tasya pāṇāvabhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 69 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu proṣitaṃ tena ucchiṣṭaṃ na visarjjayet ||
brāhmaṇe nāpyanujñātaḥ śīghraṃ saṃraṃbhayettataḥ || 70 ||
dātavyaṃ tatra cocchiṣṭaṃ yena hetumagarhitam ||
upaspṛśya vidhānena mama tīrthagatena ca || 71 ||
śucirbhūtvā tu vidhivatkṛtvā śāntyudakāni tu ||
praṇamya śirasā devi nivāpasthānamāgataḥ ||
mantraiḥ stutistu karttavyā tava bhaktyā'vatiṣṭhatā || 72 ||
namo namo medini lokamātarurvyai mahāśailaśilādharāyai ||
namonamo dhāriṇi lokadhātri jagatpratiṣṭhe vasudhe namo'stu te ||73 ||
evaṃ nivāpadānena tava bhaktena sundari ||
dadyāttilodakaṃ tasya nāmagotramudāharet || 74 ||
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā namaskṛtya dvijottamān ||
pāṇiṃ saṃgṛhya hastena mantreṇotthāpayeddvijān||75||
dadyācchayyānaṃ devi tathaivāñjanakaṅkaṇam ||
aṃjanaṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ gṛhya śayyāmākramya sa dvijaḥ ||76||
muhurtaṃ tatra viśramya nivāpasthānamāgataḥ||
gavāṃ lāṃgūlamuddhṛtya dadyādbrāhmaṇahastake||77||
pātreṇodumbarasthena kṛtvā kṛṣṇatilodakam ||
udāharettu mantrānvai saurabheyān dvijātayaḥ || 78 ||
mantrapūtaṃ tadā toyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
uddhṛtya tacca lāṃgūlaṃ toyenābhyukṣya vai tataḥ || 79 ||
paścātpretaṃ visarjyaivaṃ dadyāddānaṃ dvijātaye ||
nivāpamannamaśuciṃ dadyādvāyasatarpaṇama||80||
gatvā tu brāhmaṇebhyo'pi svagṛhaṃ yatra tiṣṭhati ||
pakvānnaṃ bhojayetsarvaṃ na tiṣṭhet prativāsikam || 81 ||
pipīlikādibhūtāni pretabhāgaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
kṛtvā tu tarpaṇaṃ devi yasyārthe tasya kalpayet || 82 ||
bhukteṣu teṣu sarveṣu dīnānāthān pratarpya ca||
pretarājapuraṃ gatvā prayacchati sa mādhavi||83||
sarvānnamakṣayaṃ tasya dattaṃ bhavati sundari||
karttavya evaṃ saṃskāraḥ pretabhāvaviśodhanaḥ||84||
nemiprabhṛtibhiḥ śaucaṃ cāturvarṇyasya sarvataḥ||
bhaviṣyati na sandeho dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ svayambhuvā||85||
kṛtvā tu dharmasaṃkalpaṃ pretakāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ||
na bhetavyaṃ tvayā putra pretakārye kṛte sati ||86||
vistareṇa mayā proktaṃ pratyakṣaṃ nāradasya ca||
tvayā vatsa sutasyārthe kraturekaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||87||
tasmātprabhṛti lokeṣu pitṛyajño bhaviṣyati ||
evaṃ yāsyati vatsa tvaṃ na śokaṃ karttumarhasi || 88 ||
śivalokaṃ brahmalokaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ na saśaṃyaḥ||
evamuktvā tadātreyaḥ pitṛkarma yathāvidhi ||89||
dātavyaṃ tu tṛtīye ca māse saptanaveṣu ca ||
ekādaśe tathā māse dadyātsāṃvatsarīṃ kriyām||90||
pretasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ ||
pakvānnaṃ bhojayettatra pretabhāgaṃ yathāvidhi ||91 ||
mantrayuktopacāreṇa cāturvarṇyasya sarvataḥ ||
vṛṣalānāmamantrāṇāṃ prayoktavyaṃ yathāvidhi || 92 ||
pretakārye nivṛtte tu pūrṇe saṃvatsare tathā ||
prayānti jantavaḥ kecidgatvā gacchanti cāpare || 93 ||
pitāmahaḥ snuṣā bhāryā jñātisambandhibāndhavāḥ ||
yadyete bahavaḥ santi svapnopamamidaṃ jagat || 94 ||
svayaṃ muhūrttaṃ roditvā tato yāti parāṅmukhaḥ ||
snehapāśena baddho vai kṣaṇārddhānmucyate tataḥ ||95 ||
kasya mātā pitā kasya kasya bhāryā sutāstathā ||
yuge yuge tu varttante mohapāśena badhyate ||96||
snehabhāvena karttavyaḥ saṃskāro hi mṛtasya ca ||
mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca || 97||
saṃsāreṣvanubhūtāni kasya te kasya vā vayam ||
svayambhuvā vidhiḥ proktaḥ pretasaṃskāralakṣaṇaḥ || 98 ||
pretakārye nivṛtte tu pitṛtvamupajāyate ||
māsi māsi hyamāyāṃ vai karttavyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ||99||
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ||
juhuyādbrāhmaṇamukhe tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī || 100 ||
evamuktvā sa ātreyaḥ pitṛyajña viniścayam ||
muhūrte dhyānamāsthāya tatraivāntaradhīyata || 101 ||
nārada uvāca ||
śrutvā tu mṛtasaṃskāramātreyoktaṃ yathāvidhi ||
cātuvarṇyasya sarvasya tvayā dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 102 ||
pitṛyajñamupaśrāddhe māsi māsi dine tathā ||
varttayanti yathānyāyamṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 103 ||
nirdiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vai śūdrāṇāṃ mantravarjitam ||
neminā ca kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti vai dvijāḥ || 104 ||
kurvanti satataṃ śrāddhaṃ naimiśrāddhaṃ taducyate ||
svastyastu te mahābhāga yāsyāmi munisattama || 105 ||
evamuktvā muniśreṣṭho nārado dvijatattamaḥ ||
tejasā dyotayansarvaṃ gataḥ śakrapuraṃ prati || 106 ||
evaṃ ca piṇḍasaṃkalpaṃ śrāddhotpattiśca mādhavi ||
ātreyeṇaiva muninā sthāpitaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu ca || 107 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre piṇḍakalpa śrāddhotpattirnāmāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāya || 188 ||
atha piṇḍakalpotpattiprakaraṇam ||
dharaṇyuvāca ||
śrutaṃ śrāddhaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ śaucāśaucāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ||
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ pretabhojyaṃ yathāvidhi || 1 ||
utpannaṃ saṃśayaṃ me'dya bhagavanvaktumarhasi ||
cāturvarṇyeṣu sarveṣu dadyāddānaṃ dvijottame || 2 ||
pratigṛhṇanti ye tatra pretabhāgaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
aniṣṭaṃ garhitaṃ tatra pretena saha bhojanam || 3 ||
bhuktvā teṣāṃ dvijo deva mucyate kena karmaṇā ||
kathaṃ te tārayiṣyanti dātāraṃ puruṣotama || 4 ||
praṇayātstrīsvabhāvena pṛcchāmi tvāṃ janārdana ||
evamukto'pi bhūmyā 'sau śaṃkhadundubhiniḥsvanaḥ || 5 ||
varāharūpī bhagavānpratyuvāca vasundharām ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
sādhu bhūme varārohe yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||6||
kathayiṣyāmi te devi tārayanti yathā dvijāḥ||
bhuktvā tu pretabhojyāni brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ || 7 ||
viśodhanārthaṃ dehasya upavāsaṃ tu kārayet ||
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā vipro jñānena saṃyutaḥ || 8 ||
pūrvasaṃdhyāṃ vinirvartya kṛtvā caivāgnitarpaṇam ||
tilahomaṃ prakurvīta śāntimaṅgalapāṭhakaḥ||9||
prāksrotasaṃ nadīṃ gatvā snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ||
paṃcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā madhuparkeṇa saṃyutam || 10 ||
audumbare ca pātre ca kṛtvā śāntyudakāni ca||
prokṣayecca gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ yatrātiṣṭhatsvayaṃ dvijaḥ || 11 ||
devāścāgnimukhāḥ sarve tarpayitvā vibhāgaśaḥ ||
bhūtānāṃ ca baliṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaśca bhojanam || 12 ||
ekā gaustu pradātavyā pāpakṣayakarī tadā ||
evaṃ tu kurute yaśca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 13 ||
pretānne codarasthe tu kāladharmamupāgataḥ ||
ākalpaṃ narake ghoraṃ vasamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ || 14 ||
prāpnoti rākṣasatvaṃ vai tato mucyeta kilbiṣāt ||
prāyaścittaṃ tu karttavyaṃ dātṛbhoktṛsukhāvaham || 15 ||
gohastyaśvadhanādīni sāgarāntāni mādhavi ||
pratigṛhṇanti ye viprā mantreṇa vidhipūvarkam || 16 ||
prāyaścittaṃ caredyastu sa tārayati niścitam |
dvijo jñānena sampanno vedābhyāsarataḥ sadā || 17 ||
sa tārayati cātmānaṃ dātāraṃ naiva saṃśayaḥ ||
brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyastribhirvarṇairdharādhare || 18 ||
daive ca janmanakṣatre śrāddhakāle ca parvasu ||
pretakāryeṣu sarveṣu parīkṣya nipuṇaṃ dvijam || 19 ||
vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ bahudharmanirantaram ||
śīlayuktaṃ susantuṣṭaṃ dharmajñaṃ satyavādinam || 20 ||
kṣamāyuktaṃ ca śāstrajñamahiṃsāyāṃ rataṃ tathā ||
ebhirguṇaistu saṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prāpya satvaraḥ || 21 ||
dadyāddānāni viprāya sa vai tārayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||
kuṇḍagoleṣu yaddattaṃ niṣphalaṃ tattu jāyate || 22 ||
kuṇḍagolaṃ pratigrāhi dātāraṃ cāpyadho nayet ||
pitrye karmaṇi caikaṃ tu kuṇḍaṃ vā golakaṃ tathā || 23 ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ pitaro yānti nirāśā nirayaṃ drutam ||
daive karmaṇi caivaṃ tu teṣāṃ dattaṃ suniṣphalam || 24 ||
tasmāddānaṃ na dātavyamapātrāya yaśasvini ||
atrārthe yatpurā vṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||25||
avantīviṣaye kaścidrājā hyatyantadhārmikaḥ ||
nāmnā medhātithiścaiva manuvaṃśavivarddhanaḥ || 26 ||
rājñaḥ purohitaścāsīccandraśarmmā dvijottamaḥ ||
ātreyagotre cotpanno vedavādarataḥ sadā || 27 ||
sa rājā brāhmaṇebhyaśca gā dadāti dine dine ||
śataṃ dattvā vidhānena pṛścādbhuṅkte narādhipaḥ || 28 ||
gate bahutithe kāle rājño medhātitheḥ pituḥ ||
śrāddhasya divasaḥ prāpto vaiśākhe varavarṇini ||
viprānāhvāpayāmāsa piturvai śrāddhakāraṇāt || 29 ||
āgatānbrāhmaṇāndṛṣṭvā medhātithirakalmaṣaḥ ||
viprānnatvā guruṃ caiva śrāddhārambhamathākarot || 30 ||
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tu vidhivatpiṇḍānnirvāpya yatnataḥ ||
śrāddhasaṃkalpitaṃ cānnaṃ viprebhyaḥ pradadau bahu || 31 ||
tanmadhye brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidgolako'vasthitastadā ||
śrāddhe saṃkalpitaṃ cānnaṃ tasmai dattaṃ vidhānataḥ || 32 ||
tenaiva śrāddhadoṣeṇa rājñastu pitarastadā ||
svargādbhraṣṭāvalambante vane kaṇṭakasaṃyute ||33||
kṣutpipāsārditā nityaṃ krandante ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
kadāciddaivayogena rājā medhātithiḥ svayam||34||
mṛgayārthaṃ gatastatra dvitraiḥ parijanairvṛtaḥ ||
tatrāvalambato dṛṣṭvā tānapṛcchaddvijapriyaḥ || 35 ||
ke bhavanto'tra saṃprāptā daśāmetāṃ suduḥkhitāḥ ||
kena karmavipākena bhavantaḥ kathayantu me || 36 ||
pitara ūcuḥ ||
asmadvaṃśakaro nityaṃ nāmnā medhātithiḥ prabhuḥ ||
vayaṃ tasyaiva pitaro narakaṃ gantumudyatāḥ ||37||
teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā duḥkhasamanvitaḥ ||
uvāca tānpitṝnsarvānsāntvapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ ||38 ||
medhātithiruvāca||
medhātithirahaṃ nāmnā bhavantaḥ pitaro mama ||
kena vai karmadoṣeṇa nirayaṃ gantumudyatāḥ || 39 ||
pitara ūcuḥ ||
śrāddhaṃ saṃkalpitaṃ cānnaṃ dattaṃ tadgolakāya vai ||
tenaiva karmadoṣeṇa narakaṃ gantumudyatāḥ || 40 ||
tatra duḥkhaṃ mahadbhuktvā punargacchāmahe divam ||
putra tvaṃ caiva dātā ca sarvalokahite rataḥ || 41 ||
asaṃkhyātāstvayā dattā gāvaḥ subahudakṣiṇā||
tena puṇyena gacchāmaḥ svargaṃ hyatisukhapradam||42||
tatra cānnaṃ na vidyeta yena tṛptirbhaviṣyati ||

yatnena mithunaṃ śrāddhe bhojayitvā visarjjayet ||
amāyāṃ ca viśālākṣi dantakāṣṭhaṃ na khādayet || 115 ||
amāyāṃ tu ca yo mūrkho dantakāṣṭhaṃ hi khādati ||
hiṃsito hi bhavetsomo devatāḥ pitarastathā || 116 ||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmudite ca divākare ||
divākṛtyaṃ tato gṛhya viprasya vidhipūrvaṃkam || 117 ||
śmaśrukarma ca karttavyaṃ nakhānāṃ chedanāni ca ||
snāpanā'bhyañjane dadyātpitṛbhaktena sundari || 118 ||
pakvānnaṃ tatra vai kāryaṃ suvimṛṣṭaṃ ca śuddhitaḥ ||
vṛtte tu tatra madhyāhne śrāddhārambhaṃ tu kārayet || 119 ||
svāgataṃ ca tathā kṛtvā pādyārthaṃ salilaṃ śuci ||
pādyaṃ dattvā tu viprāya gṛhasyābhyantaraṃ nayet || 120||
āsanaṃ kalpayitvā tu āvāhya tadanantaram||
arghyaṃ dattvā vidhānena gandhamālyaiḥ prapūjya ca || 121 ||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā vastraṃ tilodakamathāpi vā ||
pātraṃ ca bhojanasyārthe viprāgre dhārayettathā ||122 ||
bhasmanā maṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ paṅkti doṣanivārakam ||
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā annaṃ ca pariveṣayet || 123 ||
tatra kāryo na saṃkalpaḥ pitṝnuddiśya sundari ||
yathāsukhena bhoktavyamiti brūyāddvijaṃ prati || 124 ||
rakṣoghnamantrapāṭhāṃśca śrāvayīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
tṛptaṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ dattvā dadyādvai vikiraṃ tataḥ ||125 ||
uttarīyāsanaṃ dattvā piṇḍapraśnaṃ tu kārayet ||
dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā darbhānāstīrya bhūtale || 126 ||
piṇḍadānaṃ prakurvīta pitrāditritaye tathā ||
piṇḍānāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ tantuvṛddhyai yathāvidhi || 127 ||
brāhmaṇasya ca haste tu dadyādakṣayyamātmavān ||
dakṣiṇābhiḥ pratoṣyāpi svasti vācyaṃ visarjayet || 128 ||
piṇḍāstrayastu vasudhe yāvattiṣṭhanti bhūtale ||
apyāyamānāḥ pitarastāvattiṣṭhanti vai gṛhe || 129 ||
upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā dadyācchāntyudakāni ca ||
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau nivāpasya ca dhāriṇīḥ ||130 ||
vaiṣṇavī kāśyapī ceti akṣayā ceti nāmataḥ ||
bhakṣayetprathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ patnyai deyaṃ tu madhyamam ||131 ||
tṛtīyamudake dadyācchrāddhe evaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
pitṛdevāṃśca visṛjettataśca praṇamettu tān || 132 ||
evaṃ dattena tuṣyanti pitṛdevā na saṃśayaḥ||
dīrghāyuṣyaṃ prayacchanti putrapautradhanāni ca ||133||
jñānottameṣu vipreṣu dadyācchrāddhaṃ vidhānataḥ||
anyathā tattu vai śrāddhaṃ niṣphalaṃ nāsti saṃśayaḥ ||134||
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute dvijaḥ ||
madbhaktasyāsurendrasya phalaṃ bhavati bhāgataḥ ||135 ||

atha madhuparkotpattidānasaṃkaraṇaprakaraṇam ||
sūta uvāca ||
evaṃ śrutvā bahūndharmān dharmaśāstraviniścayāt||
varāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ punaḥ papraccha medinī || 1 ||
dharaṇyuvāca||
evaṃ śāstraṃ mayā deva tava vaktrādviniḥsṛtam ||
śrutaṃ subahuśaścaiva tṛptirmama na vidyate||2||
mamaivānugrahārthāya rahasyaṃ vaktumarhasi ||

rūpavāndyutimāṃścaiva śrīmānhrīkīrtimānnaraḥ || 8 ||

ya eva tiṣṭhate viṣṇo trayāṇāṃ ca caturthakaḥ || 9 ||
sarahaśca laghurdeva etattava na yujyate ||
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā mayāpyevaṃ prabhāṣitam || 10 ||
evaṃ ca me samutpannaḥ sarvakarmasu niṣṭhitaḥ ||
madhuparkketi vikhyāto bhaktānāṃ bhavamokṣaṇaḥ || 11 ||
mayātra saṃśitaṃ brahman rudre cāpi samāsataḥ ||
sādhu viṣṇo bhāgataste eṣa cāpi viniḥsṛtaḥ || 12 ||

madhuparkeṇa kiṃ kāryametadācakṣva niṣkalam ||
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā mayā'sau pratibhāṣitaḥ || 14 ||
kāraṇaṃ madhuparkasya dānaṃ saṅkaraṇaṃ tathā ||
mamārcanavidhiṃ kṛtvā madhuparkaṃ prayacchati ||15||
brahman yātyuttaraṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati||

yasya dānavidhiṃ prāpya yānti divyāṃ gatiṃ mama ||
vṛtteṣvevopacāreṣu ye ca brahmanmama priyāḥ || 17 ||
saṃgṛhya madhuparkaṃ vai imaṃ mantramudāharet || 18 ||
mantraḥ -
oṃ eṣa hi deva bhagavaṃstava gātrasūtiḥ saṃsāramokṣaṇakaro madhuparkanāmā ||
bhaktyā mayā'yaṃ pratipādito'dya gṛhāṇa deveśa namo namaste || 19 || 
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
yādṛśo madhuparkko vai yā ca tasya mahān kriyā ||20||
madhvevaṃ dadhi sarpiśca kuryāccaiva samaṃ tathā ||
vidhinā mantrapūtena yadīcchetsiddhimuttamām || 21 ||
sāmāsādya tataḥ kṛtvā mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
ucitenopacāreṇa yattvayā paripṛcchitam || 22 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe madhuparkkotpattidānasaṃkaraṇaṃ nāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 191 ||
atha sarvaśāntivarṇanam ||
sūta uvāca ||
śrutvā tu madhuparkkasya hyutpattiṃ dānameva ca ||
puṇyaṃ caiva phalaṃ caiva kāraṇaṃ grahaṇaṃ tathā || 1 ||
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā sā mahī saṃśitavratā ||
pādau gṛhya yathānyāyaṃ pratyuvāca janārdanam || 2 ||
deva vṛttopacāreṇa tava yanmanasi priyam ||
kiṃ ca tatraiva dātavyaṃ tava karmaparāyaṇaiḥ || 3 ||
etadācakṣva tattvena tatra yatparamaṃ mahat ||
śrīvarāha uvāca ||
sādhu bhūme mahābhāge yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || 4 ||
kathayiṣyāmi tatsarvaṃ duḥkhasaṃsāramokṣaṇam ||
kṛtvā tu mama karmāṇi yattvayā pūrvabhāṣitam || 5 ||
paścācchāntiṃ ca me kuryādbhūme rāṣṭrasukhāvaham ||
sarvakarma tataḥ kṛtvā bhūmyāṃ jānu nipātya ca || 6 ||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti uktvā mantramudāharet ||
mantraḥ -
oṃ namo namo vāsudeva tvaṃ gatistvaṃ parāyaṇam || 7 ||
śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ gato nātha saṃsārārṇavatāraka ||
āgatastvaṃ ca sumukha punaḥ samucitena vai || 8 ||

prasīda svasya rāṣṭrasya rājñaḥ sarvabalasya ca ||9 ||
garbhiṇīnāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ ca gavāṃ tathā ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca satataṃ śāntiṃ kuru śubhaṃ kuru || 10 ||
annaṃ kuru suvṛṣṭiṃ ca subhikṣamabhayaṃ tathā ||
rāṣṭraṃ pravarddhatu vibho śāntirbhavatu nityaśaḥ || 11 ||
devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ kanyakāsu ca ||
paśūnāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śāntirbhavatu nityaśaḥ || 12 ||
evaṃ śāntiṃ paṭhitvā tu mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ||
punarjalāñjaliṃ dattvā tvimaṃ mantramudāharet||13||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavānsarvajagatprasūto yajñeṣu deveṣu ca karmasākṣī ||
śāntiṃ kuru tvaṃ mama vāsudeva saṃsāramokṣaṃ ca kuruṣva deva ||14||
eṣā siddhiśca kīrtiśca ojasā tu mahaujasam ||
lābhānāṃ paramo lābho gatīnāṃ paramā gatiḥ || 15 ||
evaṃ paṭhati tattvena mama śāntiṃ sukhāvahām ||
te tu mallayatāṃ yānti punarāvṛttivarjitāḥ || 16 ||
evaṃ śāntiṃ paṭhitvā tu madhuparkaṃ prayojayet ||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti coktvā mantramudāharet ||17||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavāndevavaraprasūto yo vai samarcyo madhuparkkanāmā ||
āgaccha santiṣṭha ime ca pātre mamāpi saṃsāravimokṣaṇāya||18||
sarpirdadhimadhūnyeva samaṃ pātre hyudumbare ||
alābhe madhunaścāpi guḍena saha miśrayet ||19 ||
ghṛtālābhe tu suśroṇi lājaiḥ saha vimiśrayet ||
alābhe vāpi dadhnaśca kṣīreṇa saha miśrayet||20||
dadhi kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva kārayeta samaṃ tathā ||
samarpayāmi deveśa rudra sarpirghṛtaṃ madhu ||21||
sarveṣāmapyalābhe tu mama karmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
apa eva tato gṛhya imaṃ mantramudāhāret || 22 ||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavānnābhimātraprasūto yajñaiśca mantraiḥ sarahasyajapyaiḥ ||
so'yaṃ mayā te parikalpitaśca gṛhāṇa divyo madhuparkkanāmā || 23 ||
yo dadāti mahābhāge mayoktaṃ vidhipūrvakam ||
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya mama lokaṃ prapadyate || 24 ||
anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva vasundhare ||
yo vai prāṇānpramuṃceta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ || 25 ||
tasya caiveha dātavyaṃ mantreṇa vidhipūrvakam ||
yāvatprāṇānpramuṃceta kṛtvā karma supuṣkalam ||26||
madbhaktena tu dātavyaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam ||
dṛṣṭvā tu vihvalaṃ hyenaṃ mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||27||
madhuparkkaṃ paraṃ gṛhya cemaṃ mantramudāharet ||28 ||
mantraḥ -
yo'sau bhavāṃstiṣṭhati sarvadehe nārāyaṇaḥ sarvajagatpradhānaḥ ||
gṛhāṇa caivaṃ suralokanātha bhaktopanītaṃ madhuparkkasaṃjñam || 29 ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa dadyācca madhuparkkakam ||
narasya mṛtyukāle tu dadyātsaṃsāra mokṣaṇam || 30 ||
eṣā gatirmahābhāge madhuparkkasya kīrttitā ||
evaṃ kaścinna jānāti madhuparkaṃ vasundhare||31 ||
evaṃ hi madhuparkkaśca deyaḥ siddhimabhīpsubhiḥ ||
arcitvā devadeveśaṃ sarvasaṃsāranāśanam || 32 ||
dadāti madhuparkaṃ yaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
ayaṃ pavitro vimalaḥ sarvakāma viśodhanaḥ || 33 ||
dīkṣitāya ca dātavyo yaśca śiṣyo gurupriyaḥ ||
na mūrkhāya pradātavyamavinītāya karhicit ||34||

etatte kathitaṃ bhadre madhuparkkavibhāvanam ||
sarvasaṃsāramokṣārthaṃ yadīcchetsiddhimuttamām || 36 ||

yastvanena vidhānena kuryācchāntimanuttamām||

iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre sarvaśāntikaraṇaṃ nāma dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 192 ||
atha naciketaḥ prayāṇavarṇanam ||
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca ||
vyāsaśiṣyaṃ mahāprājñaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam ||
dvāradeśe samāsīnaṃ kṛtapūrvāhṇikakriyam || 1 ||

anirvartyaṃ yathā karma śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
nirviśaṅkā nirākṣepā dharmajñā dharmapāṭhakāḥ || 14 ||
cintayanti ca kāryāṇi sarvalokahitāya te ||
yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśāstraṃ yathākālanivedakāḥ ||15 ||
tataḥ sarve ca tatsarvaṃ cintayanti suyantritāḥ ||
manuḥ prajāpatiścaiva pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ || 16 ||
atrirauddālakiścaiva āpastambaśca vīryavān ||
bṛhaspatiśca śukraśca gautamaśca mahātapāḥ || 17 ||
śaṅkhaśca likhitaścaiva hyaṅgirā bhṛgureva ca ||
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva ye cānye dharmapāṭhakāḥ || 18 ||
yamena sahitāḥ sarve cintayanti pratikriyām ||
sarve ca kāmapracurā ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ||19||
kuṇḍalābhyāṃ pinaddhābhyāmaṅgadābhyāṃ mahātapāḥ ||
bhrājate mukuṭastasya brahmadatto mahādyutiḥ ||20||
tejasā vacasā caiva durnirīkṣyo mahābalaḥ ||
ekasthamiva sarveṣāṃ tejastejasvināṃ tadā || 21 ||
tasya pārśve mahādivyā ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ||
dīpyamānāḥ svavapuṣā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ || 22 ||
vedārthānāṃ vicārajñāḥ satyadharmapuraskṛtāḥ ||
chandaḥśikṣāvikalpajñāḥ sarvaśāstravikalpakāḥ || 23 ||
niruktamativādāśca sāmagāndharvaśobhitāḥ ||
dhātuvādāśca vividhā niruktāścaiva naigamāḥ || 24 ||
tatra caiva mayā dṛṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā ||
bhavane dharmarājasya pragāyantaḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ || 25 ||
tasya pārśve mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo mahāhanuḥ ||
uttamaḥ prakṛtākāra urddhvaromā nirākṛtiḥ || 26 ||
vāmabāhuśca daṇḍena pravareṇa samanvitaḥ ||
vikṛtāsyo mahādaṃṣṭro nityakruddho bhayānakaḥ || 27 ||
śikṣārthe dharmarājena sandiṣṭaḥ sa punaḥ punaḥ ||
śṛṇoti caiva kālo'sau nityayuktaḥ sanātanaḥ || 28 ||
tathānye cāpare tatra śāsaneṣu samāhitāḥ ||
dṛṣṭāstatra mayā tāta sarvatejomayī śubhā || 29 ||
yamena pūjyamānā sā divyagandhānulepanaiḥ ||
saṃhāraḥ sarvalokānāṃ gatīnāṃ ca mahāgatiḥ ||30||
ataḥ paraṃ na karttavyaṃ sādhanaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ ||
bibhyaṃti hyasurāstatra ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ||31||
asurāśca surāścaiva yoginaśca mahaujasaḥ ||
namaskāryā ca pūjyā ca mohinī sarvasādhanī || 32 ||
tasyāṅgebhyaḥ samudbhūtā vyādhayaḥ kleśasambhavāḥ ||
aparāśca mahāghorāḥ vyādhayaḥ kālanirmitāḥ || 33 ||
pauruṣeṇa samāyuktāḥ sarvalokanayāyatāḥ ||
prakṛtyā durvinītaśca mahākrodhaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || 34 ||
mahāsattvo mahātejāḥ jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ ||
mṛtyurdṛṣṭā durādharṣo divyagandhānulepanaḥ || 35 ||
gāyakā hāsakāścaiva sarvajīvaprabodhakāḥ ||
mṛtyunā sahitā nityaṃ kālajñā kālasammatāḥ || 36 ||
divyābharaṇaśobhābhiḥ śobhamānāḥ sutejasaḥ ||
savālavyajanacchannaiḥ kecittatra mahaujasaḥ || 37 ||
paryāstaraṇasaṃchanneṣvāsaneṣu tathā pare ||
pūjyamānā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ kecittatra mahaujasaḥ || 38 ||
anekāśca narāstatra vedanāśca sudāruṇāḥ ||
nārīnarasvarūpāśca mayā dṛṣṭāstvanekaśaḥ || 39 ||
kāmakrodhavicāriṇyo nānārūpadharāḥ striyaḥ ||
jīvabhakṣakarā ghorāstīvraroṣā bhayānakāḥ ||40||
tāsāṃ halahalāśabdaḥ sarvāsāṃ ca samantataḥ ||
dharmarājasamīpe tu dārayanti dharāmimām ||41||
kūṣmāṇḍā yātudhānāśca rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ ||
ekapādā dvipādāśca tripādā bahupādakāḥ || 42 ||
ekabāhurdvibāhuśca tribāhurbahubāhukaḥ ||
śaṅkukarṇā mahākarṇā hastikarṇāstathā'pare || 43 ||
kecittu tatra puruṣāḥ sarvaśobhāviśobhitāḥ ||
keyūrairmukuṭaiścānye citrairaṅgaistathā'pare || 44 ||
sragviṇo baddhapādāśca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||
sakuṭhārāḥ sakuddālāḥ sacakrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ || 45 ||
saśaktitomarāḥ kecitsadhanuṣkā durāsadāḥ ||
asihastāstathā cānye tathā mudgarapāṇayaḥ || 46 ||
sajjitā dadhihastāśca gandhahastā hyanekaśaḥ ||
vicitrabhakṣahastāśca vastrahastāstathaiva ca || 47 ||
dhūpānpragṛhya vividhānvāsāṃsi śubhadarśanāḥ ||
śibikāśca mahāśobhā yānāni vividhāni ca || 48 ||
vājikuñjarayuktāni haṃsayuktāni cāpare ||
śarabhai ṛṣabhaiścāpi hastibhiśca sudarśanaiḥ || 49 ||
mayūraiḥ sārasaiścaiva cakravākaiśca vājibhiḥ ||
evaṃrūpā mayā dṛṣṭāstatra cānye bhayānakāḥ || 50 ||
ujjvalā malināścaiva jīrṇavastrā navāṃśukāḥ ||
sumanābhimanā mūkā mārakāḥ śatamārakā || 51 ||
samārjārī kācavarṇā kṛṣṇā caiva kalistathā ||
dharmahastā yaśohastāḥ kīrttihastāstathāpare || 52||
ete purogamāstatra kṛtāntasya mahātmanaḥ ||
yadyetāni yajedvipro nāsti tasya parābhavaḥ ||53||
namaskāryāśca pūjyāśca āpannena hi nityaśaḥ ||
parituṣya kṛtā nityaṃ vihitāḥ sārvalaukikāḥ ||54||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe saṃsāracakre kṛtāntakālamṛtyukiṅkaravarṇanaṃ nāma saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 197 ||
atha saṃsāracakrayātanāsvarūpavarṇanam ||
varttamānaḥ sabhāmadhye rājā pretapurādhipaḥ ||
māmekamṛṣabhaṃ tatra darśanaṃ ca dadau yamaḥ || 1 ||
yāthātathyena me pūjā kāryeṇa vidhinā'karot ||
āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca vedadṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 2 ||
abravīcca punarhṛṣṭo hyāsyatāṃ ca varāsane ||
kāṃcane kuśasaṃcchanne divyapuṣpopaśobhite || 3 ||
tasya vaktraṃ mahāraudraṃ nityameva bhayānakam ||
paśyatastasya māṃ viprāstataḥ saumyataraṃ babhau || 4 ||
lohite tasya vai netre jalpataśca punaḥpunaḥ ||
padmapatranibhe caiva jajñāte mama sauhṛdāt || 5 ||
tato'haṃ tasya bhāvena bhāvitaśca punaḥpunaḥ ||
prahṛṣṭamānaso jāto viśvāsaṃ ca paraṃ gataḥ ||6 ||
tasya prītikaraṃ sadyaḥ sarvadoṣavināśanam ||
kāmadaṃ ca yaśodaṃ ca daivataiścāpi pūjitam || 7 ||
kālavṛddhikaraṃ stotraṃ kṣipraṃ tatra udīrayan ||
yena prīto mahātejā yamaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || 8||
ṛṣiputra uvāca ||
tvaṃ dhātā ca vidhātā ca śrāddhe caiva hi dṛśyase ||
pitṝṇāṃ paramo devaścatuṣpāda namo'stu te ||9||
kālajñaśca kṛtajñaśca satyavādī dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
pretanātha mahābhāga dharmarāja namo'stu te || 10 ||
karma kārayitā caiva bhūtabhavya bhavatprabho ||
pāvako mohanaścaiva saṃkṣepo vistarastathā || 11 ||
daṇḍapāṇe virūpākṣa pāśahasta namo'stu te ||
ādityasadṛśākāra sarvajīvahara prabho ||12||
kṛṣṇavarṇa durādharṣa tailarūpa namo'stu te ||
mārtaṇḍasadṛśa śrīmanmārtaṇḍasadṛśadyutiḥ ||13||
havyakavyavahastvaṃ hi prabhaviṣṇo namo'stu te ||
pāpahantā vratī śrāddhā nityayukto mahātapāḥ ||14||
ekadṛgbahudṛgbhūtvā kāla mṛtyo namo'stu te||
kvaciddaṇḍī kvacinmuṇḍī kvacit kālo durāsadaḥ ||15||
kvacidbālaḥ kvacidvṛddhaḥ kvacidraudro namo'stu te ||
tvayā virājito lokaḥ śāsito dharmahetunā ||16||
pratyakṣyaṃ dṛśyate deva tvāṃ vinā na ca sidhyati ||
devānāṃ paramo devastapasāṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ||17||
japānāṃ paramaṃ japyaṃ tvattaścānyo na dṛśyate ||
ṛṣayo vā tathā kruddhā hatabandhusuhṛjjanāḥ ||18||
pativratāstu yā nāryo duḥkhitāstapasi sthitāḥ ||
na tvaṃ śakta iha sthānātpātanāya kadācana || 19 ||
tasmāttvaṃ sarvadeveṣu caiko dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ||
kṛtajñaḥ satyavādī ca sarvabhūtahite rataḥ || 20 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca ||
evaṃ śrutvā stavaṃ divyamṛṣiputreṇa bhāṣitam ||
parituṣṭastadā dharmo hyauddālakasutaṃ prati || 21 ||
yama uvāca ||
parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te mādhuryeṇa tavānagha ||
yāthātathyena vākyena brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || 22||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yaṃ varaṃ kāṅkṣase dvija ||
śubhaṃ vā śreyasā yuktaṃ jīvitaṃ vāpyanāmayam || 23 ||
ṛṣiputra uvāca||
necchāmyahaṃ mahābhāga mṛtyuṃ vā jīvitaṃ prabho ||
yadi tvaṃ varado rājansarvabhūtahite rataḥ || 24 ||
draṣṭumicchāmyahaṃ deva tava deśaṃ yathātatham ||
pāpānāṃ ca śubhānāṃ ca yā gatistviha dṛśyate || 25 ||
sarvaṃ darśaya me rājanyadi tvaṃ varado mama ||
citraguptaṃ ca taṃ rājankāryārthaṃ tava cintakam || 26 ||
darśayasva mahābhāga sarvalokasya cintaka ||
yathā karmaviśeṣāṇāṃ darśanārthaṃ karoti saḥ ||27 ||
evamukto mahātejā dvārasthaṃ saṃdideśa ha ||
citraguptasakāśaṃ tu naya vipraṃ suyantritam || 28 ||
vaktavyaśca mahābāhurasminvipre yathātatham ||
prāptakālaṃ ca yuktaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 29 ||
tato'haṃ tvaritaṃ nītastena dūtena darśitaḥ ||
prāptaśca parayā prītyā citraguptaniveśanam || 30 ||
pratyutthitaśca māṃ dṛṣṭvā cintayitvā tu tattvataḥ ||
svāgataṃ muniśārdūla yatheṣṭaṃ parigamyatām || 31 ||
evaṃ sambhāṣya māṃ vīraḥ svānbhṛtyānsandideśa ha ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭānsarvānghorarūpānbhayānakān || 32 ||
citragupta uvāca ||
bho bho śṛṇuta me dūtā mama cittānuvarttakāḥ ||
bhaktimanto durādharṣā nityaṃ vrataparāyaṇāḥ || 33 ||
ayaṃ vipro mayādiṣṭaḥ pretāvāsaṃ gamiṣyati ||
asya rakṣā ca guptiśca bhavadbhiḥ kriyatāmiti || 34 ||
naiva duḥkhena khedaḥ syānna coṣṇena ca śītataḥ ||
bhukṣāpi tṛṣā vāpi eṣa ājñāpayāmi vaḥ || 35 ||
evaṃ dattavaro vipro gurucittānucintakaḥ ||
sarvabhūtadayāvāṃśca dravyavāṃśca sa vai dvijaḥ || 36 ||
yathākāmamayaṃ paśyeddharmmarājapurottamam ||
evamuktvā mahātejā gaccha gaccheti cābravīt || 37 ||
ṛṣiputra uvāca ||
sandiṣṭāśca tato dūtāścitraguptena dhīmatā ||
dhāvantastvaramāṇāstu gṛhṇanto ghnanta eva ca || 38 ||
bandhayanti mahākāyā nirdahanti mahābalāḥ ||
pāṭayanti prahāraiśca tāḍayanti punaḥ punaḥ || 39 ||
veṇuyaṣṭiprahāraiśca praharanti tato'dhikaiḥ ||
bhagnā bhinnā vibhinnāśca tathā bhagnaśirodharāḥ || 40 ||
rudanti karuṇaṃ ghoraṃ trātāraṃ nāpnuvanti te ||
narake'pi tathā pūrṇe hyagādhe tamasāvṛte || 41 ||
kecicca teṣu pacyante dahyante pāvakendhanam ||
tailapāke tathā kecitkecitkṣāreṇa sarpiṣā || 42 ||
patanti te durātmānastatra tatra ca karmabhiḥ ||
yātanābhirdahyamānā ghorābhiśca tatastataḥ || 43 ||
kecidyantramupāropya saṃpīḍyante tilā iva ||
teṣāṃ saṃpīḍyamānānāṃ śoṇitaṃ sravate bahu || 44 ||
tato vaitaraṇī ghorā saṃbhūtā nimnagā tathā ||
saphenasalilāvarttā dustarā pāpakarmiṇām || 45 ||
athānye śūla āropya dūtāḥ pādeṣu gṛhya vai ||
vaitaraṇyāṃ sughorāyāṃ prakṣipanti sahasraśaḥ || 46 ||
nānuṣṇe rudhire tatra phenamālāsamākulāḥ ||
daśanti sarpāstāṃstatra prāṇinastu sahasraśaḥ ||47 ||
anuttārya tadā tasyā ucchritā vikṛtāvaśāḥ ||
āvarttādūrmayaścaiva hyuttiṣṭhanti sahasraśaḥ || 48 ||
tatra śuṣyanti te pāpāḥ sarvadoṣasamanvitāḥ ||
majjantaśca vamantaśca trātāraṃ nāpnuvanti te ||49||
athānye bahavastatra bahubhiścāpi dūtakaiḥ ||
kūṭaśālmalimāropya lohakaṇṭakasaṃvṛtām ||50 ||
asiśaktiprahāraiśca tāḍayanti punaḥpunaḥ ||
tatra śākhāsu ghorāsu mayā dṛṣṭāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||51 ||
kūṣmāṇḍā yātudhānāśca laṃbamānā bhayānakāḥ ||
atikramya ca te skandhāstīkṣṇakaṇṭakasaṅkulāḥ || 52 ||
vedanārttāstu vegena śīghraṃ śākhā upāruhan ||
tatra te nihatā ghorā rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ| 53 ||
ghnanti cārūḍhagātrāṇi niḥśaṅkaṃ tamasā vṛtam ||
saṃkramāccaiva khādanti śālāyāṃ kapivadbhṛśam || 54 ||
yathā ca kukkuṭaṃ khādet kaścinmleccho nirākṛtaḥ ||
tathā kaṭakaṭāśabdastasminvṛkṣe mayā śrutaḥ || 55||
pakvamāmraphalaṃ yadvannaraḥ khādedyathā vane ||
evaṃ te mukhataḥ kṛtvā mahāvaktrā durāsadāḥ || 56 ||
cūṣayitvā tu tānsarvāṃste ca tasminnagottame ||
visṛjanti kṣitiṃ yāvadāsthibhūtānnarāṃstathā || 97 ||
tato javena saṃyuktā vanasthāścūṣitāḥ punaḥ ||
āviṣṭāni ca karmāṇi punaḥ śīghramakāmayan || 58 ||
adhastāttu punastatra paśyantaḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ ||
bahusaṃkhyeṣu pāpeṣu dāruṇeṣu suduḥkhitāḥ || 59 ||
bho deva pāhi muñceti vadantaḥ puruṣaṃ vacaḥ ||
yamadūtā nirāmarṣāḥ sūdayanti punaḥ punaḥ ||60 ||
pāṣāṇavarṣaiḥ kecittu pāṃsuvarṣaiśca vidrutāḥ ||
praviśanti nagacchāyāṃ tataste prajvalanti tu || 61 ||
dravanti ca punastatra dūtaiścāpi dṛḍhaṃ hatāḥ ||
bhuvaneṣu ca ghoreṣu pacyante te dṛḍhāgninā || 62||
vāripūrṇaṃ tataḥ kumbhaṃ śītalaṃ ca jalaṃ punaḥ ||
dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ ceti bruvate naḥ prasīdatha ||63||
tataḥ pānīyarūpeṇa jalaṃ taptaṃ tu dīyate ||
tena dagdhāśca ārttāśca krośantaśca parasparam || 64 ||
āliṅgyāliṅgya duḥkhārttāḥ kecittatra patanti vai ||
tathānye kṣudhitāstatra hāhābhūtamacetasaḥ || 65 ||
annānāṃ ca sumiṣṭānāṃ bhakṣyāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
paśyanti rāśiṃ tatrasthāṃ sugandhāṃ parvatopamām || 66 ||
dadhikṣīrarasāṃścaiva kṛsarānpāyasaṃ tathā ||
madhumādhavapūrṇāni surāmaireyakasya ca || 67 ||
mādhvīkasya ca pānasya sīdhorjātīrasasya ca ||
pānāni divyāni sugandhīni vai śītalānica || 68 ||
gorasasya ca pānāni bhājanāni ca nityaśaḥ ||
tapo'rjitāni divyāni tiṣṭhanti sukṛtātmanām || 69 ||
mālyāni dhūpaṃ gandhāśca nānārasasamāyutāḥ ||
manoharāśca kāntāśca bhūyiṣṭhāśca sahasraśaḥ || 70 ||
bhojaneṣu ca sarveṣu striyaḥ kāntā manoharāḥ ||
gṛhītakumbhamaṇikāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 71 ||
phalāni kuṇḍahastāśca pātrahastāstathāparāḥ ||
sumanaḥpādya hastāśca adīnā paramāṅganāḥ ||72||
annadānaratāścaiva bhojayanti sahasraśaḥ ||
nūpurojvalapādāśca tiṣṭhanti ca manoharāḥ ||73||
upasthāpya mahāyogyamatra kāle ca yoṣitaḥ ||
bruvanti sarvāstāścaiva tasyāṃ tasya ca dakṣiṇāḥ || 74 ||
nighnantaśca hasantaśca dūtā niṣṭhuravādinaḥ ||
bhobho kṛtaghnā lubdhāśca paradārābhimarśakāḥ || 79 ||
pāpāśayā niṣkṛtikāḥ sarvadānavivarjitāḥ ||
parāpavādaniratāḥ pāpairbaddhakathānakāḥ || 75 ||
nirlajjā gṛhakā deyā yācituṃ manasā hitāḥ ||
sulabhāni na dattāni vibhave sati laukike || 77 ||
pānīyamatha kāṣṭhāni yadyannaṃ sukhamāgatam ||
tena vadhyā bhavanto vai yātanābhiranekaśaḥ ||78||
karmaṇāṃ ca kṣayo jātaḥ saṃsāre yadi pacyate ||
vimuktāśceha lokāttu janiṣyatha sudurgatāḥ ||79||
kuleṣu sudaridreṣu sañjātāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ||
pāpairanugatā ghorairmānuṣaṃ lokamāśritāḥ||80 ||
vṛttasthā bhuñjate hemāṃścāturvarṇyānviśeṣataḥ ||
tataḥ satyaratā śāntā dayāvantaḥ sudhārmikāḥ ||81 ||
iha viśrāmya te dhīrāḥ kiṃcitkālaṃ sahānugāḥ ||
gacchanti paramaṃ sthānaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vā mahatkule || 82 ||
bahusundaranārīke samṛddhe susamāhitāḥ ||
ajāyanta tathā kṣāntāḥ prāpsyanti paramāṃ gatim || 83 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saṃsāracakra yātanānāṃ svarūpavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 198 ||
punaḥ saṃsāracakrayātanāsvarūpavarṇanam ||
ṛṣiputra uvāca ||
tasmin kṣititalaṃ sarvamāyasaiḥ kaṇṭakaiścitam ||
prabhavanti punaḥ kecidviṣamaṃ tamasāśritam ||1 ||
athānye chinnapādāstu chinnapāṇiśirodharāḥ ||
pāpācārāstathā deśādupasarpata mā ciram || 2 ||
ye tu dharmaratā dātā vapuṣmanto yathā gṛhe ||
paripānti kṣitiṃ sarve pātyante pāpakāriṇaḥ || 3 ||
yācamānāḥ sthitā nityaṃ suśītaistoyabhojanaiḥ ||
striyaḥ śrīrūpasaṃkāśāḥ sukumārāḥ subhojanāḥ || 4 ||
kṛtvā pūjāṃ parāṃ tatra pratīkṣante paraṃ janam||
agnitapte sughore ca nikṣipyante śilātale ||5||
āloke ca pradarśyante vṛkṣāśca bhuvanāni ca||
āyānti dahyamāneṣu pṛṣṭhapādodareṣu ca||6||
tatra gatvā tu te dūtāḥ praviśanti sudāruṇāḥ||

evamuktvā tato ghorā vyādhayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ||
sannaddhāstvaritaṃ śūrā bhīmarūpā bhayānakāḥ || 21 ||
gajairanye tathā cāśvai rathaiścāpi mahābalāḥ ||
kaṇṭakaisturagairhaṃsairanye siṃhaistathāpare ||22||
mṛgaiḥ sṛgālairmahiṣairvyāghrairmeṣaistathāpare ||
gṛdhraiḥ śyenairmayūraiśca sarpagarddabhakukkuṭaiḥ || 23 ||
evaṃ vāhanasaṃyuktā nānāpraharaṇodyatāḥ ||
samāgatā mahāsattvā anyonyamabhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 24 || 
tūryakṣveḍitasaṃghuṣṭairbalitāsphoṭitairapi ||
jayārthino drutaṃ vīrāścālayantaśca medinīm || 25 ||
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ tasmiṃstamasi santate ||
mukuṭairaṃgadaiścitraiḥ keyūraiḥ paṭṭiśāsikaiḥ || 26 ||
sakuṇḍalaiḥ śirobhiśca bhrājate vasudhātalam ||
bahubhiśca sakeyūraiśchatraiśca maṇibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 27||
śūla śaktiprahāraiśca yaṣṭitomarapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||
asikhaḍgaprahāraiśca balaprāṇasamīritaiḥ || 28 ||
abhavaddāruṇaṃ yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam ||
nakhairdantaiśca pādaiśca te'nyo'nyamabhijaghnire || 29 ||
bāhubhiḥ samanuprāptaḥ keśākeśi tataḥ param ||
ayuktamatulaṃ yuddhaṃ teṣāṃ vai samajāyata || 30 ||
tataste rākṣasā bhagnā dūtairghoraparākramaiḥ ||
dehi dehi vadantyeva bhindhi gṛhṇīṣva tiṣṭha ca || 31 ||
vadhyamānāḥ piśācāste ye nivṛttā raṇārditāḥ ||
āhūyanta pratibhayātkrodhasaṃraktalocanāḥ || 32 ||
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha kva yāsīti na gacchāmi dṛḍho bhava ||
mayā muktamidaṃ śastraṃ tava dehavināśanam || 33 ||
kintu mūḍha tvayā śastraṃ na muktaṃ me rujākaram ||
mayā kṣiptāstu iṣavaḥ pratīccha kva palāyase ||34||
kiṃ tvaṃ vadasi durbuddhe eṣo'haṃ pārago raṇe ||
mama bāhu vimuktastu yadi jīvasyato vada || 35||
tatra te sahasā ghorā rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ ||
mandehā nāma nāmnā te vadhyamānāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 36 ||
tato bhagnā yadā te tu rākṣasāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ||
pratyapadyanta te māyāṃ tāmasīṃ tamasāvṛtāḥ ||37 ||
adṛśyāścaiva dṛśyāśca tadbalaṃ tamasāvṛtāḥ ||
tataste śaraṇaṃ jagmurjvaraṃ paramabhīṣaṇam || 38 ||
śūlapāṇiṃ virūpākṣaṃ sarvaprāṇipraṇāśanam ||
mandehā nāma nāmnā vai rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ || 39 ||
khādanti caiva ghnanti sma citraguptena coditāḥ ||
vyādhīnāṃ ca sahasrāṇi dūtānāṃ ca mahābalāḥ ||40||
vayamadya mahābhāga trāyasva jagataḥ pate ||
tatasteṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā dūtānāṃ kāmarūpiṇām || 41 ||
jvaraḥ kruddho mahātejā yodhānāṃ tu sahasraśaḥ ||
kālo muṇḍaḥ kekarākṣo lohayaṣṭiparigrahaḥ ||42||
vividhānsandideśā'tra puruṣānagnivarcasaḥ ||
baddhāñjalipuṭānsarvānidamāha sureśvaraḥ||43||
paca śīghramimānpāpānyogena ca balena ca ||
tataste tvaritaṃ gatvā yatra te piśitāśanāḥ ||44||
jvarājñayā ca te sarve jīmūtaghananiḥsvanāḥ ||
bahūṃste rākṣasānghorāndarpotsiktān sahasraśaḥ || 45 ||
bahuśastraprahāraiśca śastraiśca vividhojjvalaiḥ ||
tarasā rākṣasā vignā rudhireṇa pariplutāḥ || 46 ||
mocayāmāsa saṃgrāmaṃ svayameva yamastataḥ ||
rākṣasānmocayitvā'tha hanyamānānsamantataḥ || 47 ||
gatvā jvaraṃ mahābhāgaṃ vinayātsāntvayanmuhuḥ ||
pūjayanvai jvaraṃ divyaṃ gṛhya haste mahāyaśāḥ || 48 ||
praviveśa gṛhaṃ svaṃ tu sambhrameṇedṛśena tu ||
ānanaṃ tu samutprośchya saṃgrāme svedabinduvat || 49 ||
dharmarājo'tha viśrāntaṃ kālabhūtaṃ mahājvaram ||
kiṃkiṃ vṛttamidaṃ deva vyāpinastvaṃ mahātapāḥ || 50 ||
roṣāyāsakaraṃ caiva sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ ||
ahaṃ tvaṃ caiva deveśa imaṃ lokaṃ carācaram || 51 ||
śāsemahi yathākāmaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam ||
tvayā grāhyo hyahaṃ deva mṛtyunā ca susaṃvṛtaḥ || 52 ||
lokānsarvānahaṃ hanmi sarvaghātī na saṃśayaḥ ||
gaccha gaccha yathāsthānaṃ yuddhaṃ ca tyajatu svayam ||53 ||
rākṣasānāṃ hatāstatra ṣaṣṭikoṭyo raṇājire||
amarāścākṣayāścaiva na hi tvāṃ prāpayanti vai || 54 ||
tato hyuparataṃ yuddhaṃ dharmarājo yamaḥ svayam ||
dūtānāṃ citraguptena sakhyamekamakārayat || 55 ||
sambhāṣante tato dūtāścitraguptaṃ tathaiva ca ||
niyuñjasva mayā pūrvaṃ sarvakarmāṇi jantuṣu||56||
svakarmaguṇabhūtāni hyaśubhāni śubhāni ca||
rudraṃ dūtāḥ samāgamya citraguptasya pārśvataḥ|||57||
upasthānaṃ ca kurvanti kālaciṃtakamabruvan ||
yathā lokā yathā rājā yathā mṛtyuḥ sanātanaḥ||58||
tadaivottiṣṭha tiṣṭheti kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāṃ prabho || 59 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre saṃsāracakre rākṣasakiṃkarayuddhaṃ nāmaikādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 201 ||
atha nārakidaṇḍanakarmavipākavarṇanam ||
ṛṣiruvāca ||
vismayastu mayā dṛṣṭastasminnadbhutadarśanaḥ ||
citraguptasya sandeśo dharmarājena dhīmataḥ||1||
prāpnuvanti phalaṃ te vai ye ca kṣiptāḥ purā janāḥ ||
agninā vai prataptāste baddhā bandhaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ || 2 ||
santaptā bahavo ye te taistaiḥ karmabhirulbaṇaiḥ ||
śyāmāśca daśanābhirye tvimaṃ śīghraṃ pramāpaya || 3 ||
durācāraṃ pāparataṃ nirghṛṇaṃ pāpacetasam ||
śvānastu hiṃsakā ye ca bhakṣayantu durātmakam || 4 ||
pitṛghno mātṛgoghnastu sarvadoṣasamanvitaḥ ||
āropya śālmalīṃ ghorāṃ kaṇṭakaistairvipāṭaya || 5 ||
enaṃ pācaya tailasya ghṛtakṣaudrasya vā punaḥ ||
taptadroṇyāṃ tato muṃca tāmrataptakhale punaḥ || 6 ||
narādhamamimaṃ kṣiptvā pradīpte havyavāhane ||
tato manuṣyatāṃ prāpya ṛṇaistatra pradīpyate || 7 ||
śayanāsanaharttāramagnidāyī ca yo naraḥ ||
vaitaraṇyāmayaṃ caiva kṣipyatāmaciraṃ punaḥ || 8 ||
pāpakarmāyamatyarthaṃ sarva tīrthavināśakaḥ ||
tasya pradīptaḥ kīlo'yaṃ vahnitapto'tiduḥspṛśaḥ ||9||
ādeśya cobhayorasya karṇayoḥ kūṭasākṣikaḥ ||
yo naraḥ piśunaḥ kūṭasākṣī cālīkajalpakaḥ||10||
grāmayājanakaṃ vipramadhruvaṃ dāṃbhikaṃ śaṭham||
baddhvā tu bandhane ghore dīyatāṃ tu na kiṃcana||11||
jihvā'sya chidyatāṃ śīghraṃ vācā duṣṭasya pāpinaḥ ||
gamyāgamyaṃ purā yena vijñātaṃ na durātmanā || 12 ||
kṛtaṃ lobhābhibhūtena kāmasammohitena ca ||
tasya cchitvā tato liṃgaṃ kṣāramagniṃ ca dīpaya || 13 ||
imaṃ tu khalakaṃ kṛtvā durātmā pāpakāriṇam ||
dāyādā bahavo yena svārthahetorvināśitāḥ || 14 ||
imaṃ vārdhuṣikaṃ vipraṃ sarvatrāṃgeṣu bhedaya ||
tathāyaṃ yātanāṃ yātu pāpaṃ bahu samācaran || 15 ||
suvarṇasteyinaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ ca tathā naram ||
krūraṃ pitṛhaṇaṃ cainaṃ brahmaghneṣu samīkuru || 16 ||
asthi cchitvā tataḥ kṣipraṃ kṣāramagniṃ ca dāpaya ||
imaṃ tu vipraṃ khādantu tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāḥ sudāruṇāḥ || 17 ||
piśunaṃ hi mahāvyāghrāḥ paṃca ghorāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ||
imaṃ pacata pākeṣu bahudhā marmabhedinam || 18 ||
yenāgnirujjhitaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhītvā ca na pūjitaḥ ||
imaṃ pāpasamācāraṃ vīraghnamatipāpinam || 19 ||
karkaṭasya tu ghorasya nityakruddhasya mocaya ||
imaṃ ghore hrade kṣiptaṃ sarvayājanayājakam || 20 ||
sarveṣāṃ tu paśūnāṃ yo nityaṃ dhārayate jalam ||
na trātā na ca dātā ca pāpasyāsya durātmanaḥ || 21 ||
adānavratino viprā vedavikrayiṇastathā ||
sarvakarmāṇi kuryurye dīyate na ca kiṃcana || 22 ||
toyabhājanaharttāraṃ bhojanaṃ yo'nivārayan ||
hanyatāṃ sudṛḍhairdaṇḍairyamadūtairmahābalaiḥ || 23 ||
veṇudaṇḍakaśābhiśca lohadaṇḍaistathaiva ca ||
jalamasmai na dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca kathaṃcana || 24||
tasmā annaṃ ca pānaṃ ca na dātavyaṃ kadācana ||
hata viśvāsya hantāraṃ vahnau śīghraṃ prapācaya || 25 ||
brahmadeyaṃ hṛtaṃ yena taṃ vai śīghraṃ vipācaya ||
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi pātaye karma vistare || 26 ||
samuttīrṇaṃ tataḥ paścāttiryagyonau prapātaye ||
sūkṣmadehavipākeṣu kīṭapakṣivijātiṣu || 27 ||
kliṣṭo jātisahasraistu jāyate mānuṣastataḥ ||
tatra jāto durātmā ca kuleṣu vividheṣu ca ||28||
hiṃsārūpeṇa ghoreṇa brahmavadhyāṃ pradāpayet ||
rājñastu mārakaṃ ghoraṃ brahmaghnaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ tathā||29||
suvarṇasteyinaṃ caiva surāpaṃ caiva kārayet ||
anubhūya tataḥ kāle tato yakṣma prayojayet ||30||
goghātako hyayaṃ pāpaḥ kūṭaśālmalimāruhet ||
kṛṣyate vividhairghorai rākṣasairghoradarśanaiḥ || 31 ||
pūtipākeṣu pacyeta jantubhiḥ saṃprayojitaḥ ||
brahmavadhyāccaturbhāgairmṛgatvaṃ paśutāṃ gataḥ || 32 ||
udvignavāsaṃ patitaṃ yatra yatropapadyate ||
pāpakarmasamudvigno jāto jātaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 33 ||
ayaṃ tiṣṭhati kiṃ pāpaḥ pitṛghātī durātmavān ||
te tu varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ bhakṣayantu vicetasaḥ || 34 ||
tataḥ pākeṣu ghoreṣu pacyatāṃ ca narādhamaḥ ||
tato mānuṣatāṃ prāpya garbhastho priyatāṃ punaḥ || 35 ||
vyāpanno daśagarbheṣu tataḥ paścādvimucyatām ||
tatrāpi labdhvā mānuṣyaṃ kleśabhāgī ca jāyatām || 36 ||
bubhukṣārugvikāraiśca satataṃ tatra pīḍyatām ||
pāpācāramimaṃ ghoraṃ mitraviśvāsaghātakam || 37 ||
yantreṇa pīḍyatāṃ kṣipraṃ tataḥ paścādvimucyatām ||

jāyatāṃ ca tataḥ paścācchūnāṃ yonau durātmavān ||
bhraṣṭo'pi jāyatāṃ tasmānmānuṣaḥ kleśa bhājanaḥ || 39 || 
prāptavānvividhānrogānsaṃsāre caiva dāruṇān ||
brahmasvahārī pāpo'yaṃ naro lavaṇataskaraḥ || 40 ||
varṣāṇāṃ tu śataṃ paṃca tatra kliṣṭo durātmavān ||
kṛmiko jāyate paścādviṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmiko'paraḥ || 41||
śakunto jāyate ghorastatra paścādvṛko bhavet ||
imamagnipradaṃ ghoraṃ kāṣṭhāgnau sampratāpaya || 42 ||
svakarmasu vihīneṣu paścāllabdhagatistathā ||
tataścātha mṛgo vāpi tato mānuṣatāṃ vrajet || 43 ||
tatrāpi dāruṇaṃ duḥkhamupabhuṃkte durātmavān ||
sarvaduṣkṛtakāryeṣu saha saṃghātacintakaiḥ || 44 ||
evaṃ karmasamāyuktāste bhavantu sahasraśaḥ ||
paradravyāpahārāśca raurave patitāstathā || 45 ||
kumbhīpākeṣu nirdagdhaḥ paścādgardabhatāṃ gataḥ ||
tato jātastvasau pāpaḥ śūkaro malabhuktathā || 46 ||
prāpnotu vividhāṃstāpānyathā hṛtadhanaśca san ||
kṣudhātṛṣṇāparākrānto gardabho daśajanmasu || 47 ||
mānuṣyaṃ samanuprāpya cauro bhavati pāpakṛt ||
paropaghātī nirlajjaḥ sarvedoṣasamanvitaḥ || 48 ||
vṛkṣaśākhāvalambo'tra hyadhaḥśīrṣaḥ prajāyate ||
agninā pacyatāṃ paścāllubdho vai puruṣādhamaḥ || 49 ||
tato varṣaśate pūrṇe mucyate sa punaḥ punaḥ ||
ajitātmā tathā pāpaḥ piśunaśca durātmavān || 50 ||
pūrvaiśca sūkaro bhūtvā nakulo jāyate punaḥ ||
vimuktaśca tataḥ paścānmānuṣyaṃ labhate cirāt || 51 ||
dhikkṛtaḥ sarvalokena kūṭasākṣyanṛtavrataḥ ||
na śarma labhate kvāpi karmaṇā svena garhitaḥ || 52 ||
imaṃ hyānṛtikaṃ duṣṭaṃ kṣetrahārakameva ca ||
svakarma duṣkṛtaṃ yāvattāvaduḥkhaṃ bhunaktvasau || 53 ||
karmaṇyekaikaśaścāyaṃ sa tu tiṣṭhatvayaṃ punaḥ ||
varṣalakṣaṃ na sandehastatastiṣṭhatvayaṃ punaḥ || 54 ||
tato jātīḥ smaretsarvāstiryagyoniṃ samāśritaḥ ||
jāyatāṃ mānuṣaḥ paścātkṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ || 55 ||
sarvakāmavimuktastu sarvadoṣasamanvitaḥ ||
kvacijjātyāṃ bhavedandhaḥ kvacidbadhira eva ca || 56 ||
kvacinmūkaśca kāṇaśca kvacidvyādhisamanvitaḥ ||
evaṃ hi prāpnuyādduḥkhaṃ na ca saukhyamavāpnuyāt || 57 ||
jātyantarasahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca ||
śāntiṃ na labhate caiva bhūme kṣetraharo naraḥ || 98 ||
tīvrairantargatairduḥkhairbhūmiharttā narādhamaḥ ||
imaṃ bandhairdṛḍhairbaddhvā vipācaya tathāciram || 59 ||
prabaddhaḥ suciraṃ kālaṃ mama lokaṃ gato naraḥ ||
jāyatāṃ sa ciraṃ pāpo mārjārastena karmaṇā || 60 ||
tīvrakṣudhāparikliṣṭo baddho bandhanayantritaḥ ||
duḥkhānyanubhavaṃstatra pāpakarmā narādhamaḥ || 61 ||
saptadhā sapta caikāṃ ca jātiṃ gatvā sa pacyate ||

jātikarma sahasraṃ tu tato mānuṣatāṃ vrajet ||
imaṃ saukarikaṃ pāpaṃ mahiṣā ghātayantu tam ||64 ||

vibhinnaṃ ca prabhinnaṃ ca śṛṃgābhyāṃ padbhireva ca || 65 ||

yāṃ yāṃ yāti punarjātiṃ tatra bhakṣyo bhavettu saḥ ||
karmakṣayo'nyathā nāsti mayā pūrvaṃ vinirmitam || 67 ||
prāpya mānuṣatāṃ paścātpunarvyādho bhaviṣyati ||
anyathā niṣkṛtirnāsti jātijanmaśatairapi || 68 ||
ucchiṣṭānnapradātāraṃ pāpācāramadhārmikam ||
aṅgāraiḥ pacatāṃ cainaṃ trīṇi varṣaśatāni ca || 69 ||
bhinnacāritraduḥśīlā bhartturvyalīkakāriṇī ||
āyasānpuruṣānsapta hyāliṅgatu samantataḥ || 70 ||
tataḥ śunī bhavetpaścātsūkarī ca tataḥ param ||

na ca saukhyamavāpnoti tena duḥkhena dukhitā ||
anena bhṛtyā bahavaḥ śrāṃtāḥ śāṃtāḥ pravāhitāḥ || 72 ||
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca pānaṃ ca na teṣāmupapāditam ||

evaṃ kuruta bhadraṃ vo mama pārśve tu durmatiḥ ||
raurave narake ghore sarvadoṣasamanvite || 74 ||
sarvakarmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ kṣapayadhvaṃ durāsadam ||

prakṣipyatāmayaṃ paścāddasyujātau durātmavān ||
jāyatāmuragaḥ paścāttataḥ karma samāśrayet || 76 ||
tataḥ paścādbhavetpāpaścetaraḥ sarvapāpakṛt ||

varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ tato mānuṣatāṃ vrajet ||

apaugaṇḍo mriyetpaṃca karmaśeṣakṣaye tu saḥ ||
tato mānuṣatāṃ yāti caiṣa karmāvinirṇayaḥ || 80||
pāpasya sukṛtasyātha prajānāṃ vinipātane ||

iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe saṃsāracakre nārakidaṇḍakarmavipāka varṇanaṃ nāma dvyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 202 ||
atha pāpasamūhānukramavarṇanam ||
ṛṣiputra uvāca ||
anyānyapi ca pāpāni citragupto dideśa ha ||
vyāmiśrānkathyamānāṃśca śṛṇudhvaṃ tānmahaujasaḥ || 1 ||
śīlasaṃyamahīnānāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣānugāminām ||
mahāpāpairupetānāṃ kathyatāṃ tatparābhavam || 2 ||
rājadviṣṭā gurudviṣṭāḥ sarve te vai vigarhitāḥ ||
aviśvāsyā hyasambhāṣyāḥ kukṣimātraparāyaṇāḥ || 3 ||
hiṃsāvihāriṇaḥ krūrāḥ sūcakāḥ kāryadūṣakāḥ ||
gaveḍakasya vadhakāḥ mahiṣājādikasya ca || 4 ||
dāvāgniṃ ye ca muṃcanti ye ca saukarikāstathā ||
tatra kālamasaṃkhyeyaṃ pacyante pāpakāriṇaḥ || 5 ||
karmakṣayādyadā bhūyo mānuṣyaṃ prāpnuvanti te ||
alpāyuṣo bhavantīha vyādhigrastāśca nityaśaḥ || 6||
garbha eva vipadyante mriyante bālakāstathā ||
paririṃgaratāḥ kecinmriyante puruṣādhamāḥ || 7 ||
kāṣṭhavaṃśe ca śastre ca vāyunā jvalanena ca ||
toyena vā pāśabandhaiḥ patanena viṣeṇa vā ||8||
mātāpitṛvadhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ mitrasambandhibandhujam ||

prāṇātipātanaṃ te vai prāpnuvanti yathā tathā ||
lohakāḥ kārukāścaiva garbhāṇāṃ vinihiṃsakāḥ || 10 ||

śravaṇacchedanaṃ caiva nāsācchedanameva ca ||

jaḍāndha badhirā mūkāḥ paṃgavaḥ pādasarpiṇaḥ || 17 ||
ekapakṣahatāḥ kāṇāḥ kunakhāścāmayāvinaḥ ||
kubjāḥ khañjāstathā hīnā vikalāśca ghaṭodarāḥ || 18 ||

bahubhirdāruṇairghorairvyādhibhiḥ samanudgatāḥ ||

eṣāṃ caturvidhā bhāṣā yā mithyāpyabhidhīyate ||
hāsyarūpeṇa yā bhāṣā citrarūpeṇa vā punaḥ || 23 ||
arahasyaṃ rahasyaṃ vā paiśunyena tu nindanāt ||

kadalīgarbhanissārāṃ marmaspṛkkaṭukākṣarām || 25 ||

ayaṃtritamukhā ye ca ye nibaddhāḥ pralāpinaḥ || 26 ||

tatastiryakprajāyante bahudhā kīṭa pakṣiṇaḥ ||
loke doṣakarāścaiva lokadviṣṭāstathā pare|| || 29 ||

tatra kālaṃ tu suciraṃ pacyantāṃ pāpakāriṇaḥ||40||
karmakṣayo yadā teṣāṃ mānuṣyaṃ prāpnuvanti te ||
tatra tatropapadyante yatra yatra mahadbhayam || 41 ||
yasmiṃścaurabhayaṃ deśe kṣudbhayaṃ rājato bhayam ||

ītayo yatra deśeṣu lubdheṣu nagareṣu ca ||
kṣayāḥ kālopasargā vā jāyante tatra te narāḥ||43||
bahuduḥkhaparikliṣṭā garbhavāsena pīḍitāḥ ||
ekahastā dvihastā vā kūṭāśca vikṛtodarāḥ || 44 ||
śirāvivṛtagātrāśca hīnāṅgā vātarogiṇaḥ ||
aśrupātitanetrāśca bhāryā na prāpnuvanti te ||49||
teṣāmapatyaṃ na bhavettadrūpaṃ ca sulakṣaṇam ||
atihrasvaṃ vivarṇaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ bhrāntalocanam || 46 ||
saṃsāre ca yathā pakvaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ bhairavasvanam ||
mahataḥ parivārasya tuṣṭaścocchiṣṭabhojakaḥ || 47 ||
rūpato guṇato hīno balataḥ śīlatastathā ||
rājabhṛtyā bhavantyete pṛthivīparicārakāḥ || 48 ||
anālayā nirāmarṣā veda nābhiḥ susaṃvṛtāḥ ||
samakāryasajātyānāṃ mitrasambandhināṃ tathā || 49 ||
karmāntakārakā hyete tṛṇībhūtā bhavanti te ||
anartho rājadaṇḍo vā nityamutpādyate vadhaḥ || 50 ||

karṣakāḥ paśupālāśca vāṇijyasyopajīvakāḥ ||51||
yadyatkurvanti te karma sarvatra kṣayabhāginaḥ ||
satyamanviṣyamāṇāśca naiva te kīrttibhāginaḥ || 52 ||
yatkiñcidaśubhaṃ karma tasmindeśe samucchritam ||
tasya deśasya naivāsti varjayitvāturānnarān || 53 ||
suvṛṣṭyāmapi teṣāṃ vai kṣetraṃ taṃ tu vivarjayet ||
aśanirvā patettatra kṣetraṃ vāpi vinaśyati ||54 ||
na sukhaṃ nāpi nirvāṇaṃ teṣāṃ mānuṣatā bhavet ||
utpadyate nṛśaṃsānāṃ tīvraḥ kleśaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||55||
steyakarmaprayuktānāṃ muktvā kleśaparamparām ||
paradāraprasaktānāmimāṃ śṛṇuta yātanām || 56 ||
tiryaṅmānuṣadeheṣu yānti vikṣiptamānasāḥ ||
viharanti hyadharmeṣu dharmacāritradūṣakāḥ || 57 ||
tāṃstenaiva pradānena saṃgrahettu graheṇa vā ||
mūlakarmaprayogeṇa rāṣṭrasyātikrameṇa vā || 58 ||
prasahya vā prakṛtyā vai ye caranti kulāṅganāḥ ||
varṇasaṅkarakarttāraḥ kuladharmādidūṣakāḥ || 59 ||

dharṣayanti ca ye pāpāḥ śrūyatāṃ tatparābhavaḥ || 60 ||
nirayaṃ pāpabhūyiṣṭhā anubhūya mahābhayam ||
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi kamarṇā tena duṣkṛtāḥ || 61 ||
karmakṣaye yadā bhūyo mānuṣyaṃ yānti dāruṇam ||
saṅkīrṇayonijāḥ kṣudrā bhavanti puruṣādhamāḥ || 62 ||
veśyālaṅghakakūṭānāṃ śauṇḍikānāṃ tathaiva ca ||
duṣṭapāṣaṇḍanārīṇāṃ naikamaithunagāminām || 63 ||
nirllajjapuṇḍrakāḥ kecidbaddhapauruṣagaṇḍakāḥ ||
strībandhakāḥ strīvināśāḥ strīveṣāḥ strīvihāriṇaḥ || 64 ||
strīṇāṃ cānupravṛddhā ye strībhogaparibhoginaḥ ||
