tadbhāvāstatkathālāpāstadbhogāḥ paribhoginaḥ ||
vipralobhaṃ ca dāneṣu prāpnuvanti narādhamāḥ || 66 ||
saubhāgyaparamāsaktā narā bībhatsadarśanāḥ ||
abuddhaiḥ saha saṃvāsaṃ priyaṃ cāvipriyaṃ tathā || 67 ||
śārīraṃ mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāpnuvanti narādhamāḥ ||
kṛmibhirbhakṣaṇaṃ caiva taptatailopasecanam || 68 ||
agnikṣāranadībhyāṃ tu prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
paradāraprasaktānāṃ bhayaṃ bhavati nigrahaḥ || 69 ||
sarvaṃ ca nikhilaṃ kāryaṃ yanmayā samudāhṛtam || 70 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe pāpasamūhānukramo nāma tryadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāya || 203 ||
atha dūtapreṣaṇavarṇanam ||
ṛṣiruvāca ||
idaṃ caivāparaṃ tasya vadato hi mayā śrutam ||
citraguptasya viprendrā vacanaṃ lokaśāsinaḥ ||1||
dūre'sāviti kiṃ kāryaṃ na kṣayo'styasya karmaṇaḥ ||
kiṃ kṛpāṃ kurute tasmingṛhāṇa jahi mā vyathaḥ ||2||
vrīḍitaḥ kimbhavāñjñātaṃ kiṃ tiṣṭhati parāṅmukhaḥ ||
kiṃ na gacchasi vegena kiṃ tvayā suciraṃ kṛtam || 3 ||
gaccha gaccha punastatra śīghraṃ cainamihānaya ||
aśakto'smīti kiṃ roṣamarhante darpamīdṛśam || 4 ||
kiṃ tvaṃ vadasi durbuddhe vivāhastasya varttate ||
ūrdhvaretāstapasvīti tvaṃ māṃ bhāṣayase katham || 5 ||
kiṃ tvaṃ vadasi garhyaṃ ca muhūrttaṃ paripālaya ||
ramate kāntayā sārddhamiti kiṃ tvaṃ prabhāṣase || 6 ||
pativrateti sādhvīti rahasyaṃ bhāṣase punaḥ||
kiṃ kiṃ vadasi bālo hi niśi caivāgato gṛham || 7 ||
ānīyate kathaṃ jñātvā bhoktukāmaṃ kathaṃ hare ||
jalaśāyinaṃ kathaṃ caiva dātukāmaṃ kathaṃ hare ||8||
dhārmikā yūyamevātra ahameko nṛśaṃsavat ||
yāta yāta tathā dṛṣṭvā yathākālo'natikramet || 9 ||
śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhava sarpo hi vyāghrastvaṃ ca sarīsṛpaḥ ||
jale grāho bhava tvaṃ hi tvaṃ kṛmistvaṃ sarīsṛpaḥ||10||
narakānugatastvaṃ hi vyādhibhūtaḥ samāśrayaḥ ||
atīsāro bhava tvaṃ hi tvaṃ chardistvaṃ punarbhavaḥ||||
karṇarogo viṣūcī ca nityarogaśca sambhavaḥ ||
jvaro bhava mahāghoro jale grāho durāsadaḥ||12||
vātavyādhistathā ghorastathaiva tvaṃ jalodaraḥ||
apasmārastvamunmādo vātarogastathaiva ca ||13||
vibhramastvaṃ bhavecchīghraṃ viṣṭambhaśca punarbhava ||
vyādhirbhava mahāghoro hyayaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tu vindatu||14||
yathākālaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ tāvatkālo'tra tiṣṭhatu ||
kālasaṃharaṇe vāpi śubhasyāgamane'pi vā || 15 ||
yūyaṃ ca kṛtakarmāṇastato mokṣamavāpsyatha ||
drutaṃ dravata vegena sarve gacchata mā ciram || 16 ||
varājñā dharmarājasya yā mayā samudāhṛtā ||
ekāhaṃ kṣapayestatra dvirātraṃ tatra mā ciram || 17 ||
trirātraṃ vai catūrātraṃ ṣaḍrātraṃ daśarātrakam ||
pakṣaṃ vā māsamekaṃ vā bahūnmāsāṃstathāpi vā || 18 ||
kṣapayitvā yathākālaṃ tato mokṣamavāpsyatha ||
bhūtātmā mohavāṃstatra karuṇaḥ kaṣṭameva ca || 19 ||
yasminyasmiṃstu kāle'haṃ yāvataśca śrayāmyaham ||
tasmiṃstasminmahākālaṃ yūyaṃ tatkarttumarhatha ||20||
viniyogā mayā sūktā yathāpūrvaṃ yathāśrutam ||
jāgrataṃ vā pramattaṃ vā yathā kālo na sampatet || 21 ||
yatnāttathā tu karttavyaṃ bhavadbhirmama śāsanāt ||
abhayaṃ cātra yacchāmi brāhmaṇebhyo na saṃśayaḥ || 22 ||
tasmādyāta ṛṣibhyaśca strībhyaścaiva mahābalāḥ ||
yātanāyā na bhetavyamahamājñāpayāmi vaḥ || 23 ||
yathāvācyaṃ ca kuruta yathā kālo na gacchati ||
yathākāmaṃ prakuruta yacca dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tathā || 24 ||
mayājñaptā viśeṣeṇa mṛtyunā saha saṅgataḥ ||
yathā vīro mahātejāścitragupto mahāyaśāḥ ||25 ||
yathābravītsvayaṃ rudro yathā śakraḥ śacīpatiḥ ||
yathājñāpayate brahmā citraguptastathā prabhuḥ || 26 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe saṃsāracakre dūtapreṣaṇaṃ nāma caturadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 204 ||
atha śubhāśubha phalānukīrtanavarṇanam ||
ṛṣiputra uvāca ||
idamanyatpurā viprāḥ śrūyatāṃ tasya bhāṣitam ||
yamasya citraguptasya yacca tatra mayā śrutam || 1 ||
ayaṃ tu bhavatāṃ yātu yātu svargaṃ mahīkṣitām ||
ayaṃ vṛkṣastvayaṃ tiryagayaṃ mokṣaṃ vrajennaraḥ || 2 ||

kliśyato rudataścaiva vadataśca punaḥpunaḥ ||

atha śubhakarmaphalodaya prakaraṇam ||
ṛṣiruvāca ||

śrūyatāṃ vai mahābhāgāstapaḥsiddhā dvijottamāḥ || 1 ||

akriyāṇi tu dānāni pūrvaṃ dattāni dhīmatā || 6 ||

yāvatsvargādvimānāni samāgacchanti kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
tataḥ sa pravarairyānaiḥ sānugaḥ saparicchadaḥ || 8 ||
devānāṃ bhavanaṃ yātu daivatairabhipūjitaḥ ||
tatraiva ramatāṃ vīro yāvalloko hi dhāryate || 9 ||
sa kṛtārthaḥ sadā loke yatraiṣo'bhiprayāsyati ||
tatra medhyaṃ pavitraṃ ca yatra sthāsyatyayaṃ śuciḥ || 10 ||
naikakanyāpradātāraṃ naikayajñakṛtaṃ tathā ||
pūjyatāṃ sarvakāmaistu padaṃ gacchatu vaiṣṇavam || 11 ||
tatraiṣa ramatāṃ dhīraḥ sahasramayutaṃ samāḥ ||
tato vai mānuṣe loke ādye vai jāyatāṃ kule || 12 ||
bhūtānukampako hyeṣa kriyatāmasya cārccanam ||

upānahau ca chatraṃ ca jalabhājanameva ca || 14 ||

hastena saṃspṛśatyeṣa mṛdunā śītalena ca ||
vidyādharastathā hyeṣa nityaṃ muditamānasaḥ || 16 ||

nīyatāṃ nīyatāṃ śīghraṃ yatrayatra na cālayet || 19 ||

amarākhyo bhavettatra golokeṣu samāhitaḥ || 22 ||
idamevāparaṃ caiva citraguptasya bhāṣitam ||
sarvadevamayā devyaḥ sarvavedamayāstathā || 23 ||
amṛtaṃ dhārayantyaśca pracaranti mahītale ||

pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ puṣṭīnāṃ puṣṭireva ca ||
tasmātpurastu dātavyaṃ gavāṃ vai medhyakāraṇāt || 25 ||
daghnā hi tridaśāḥ sarve kṣīreṇa ca maheśvaraḥ ||
ghṛtena pāvako nityaṃ pāyasena pitāmahaḥ || 26 ||

paṃcagavyena pītena vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
gavyaṃ tu paramaṃ medhyaṃ gavyādanyanna vidyate || 28 ||
danteṣu maruto devā jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī ||
khuramadhye tu gandharvāḥ khurāgreṣu tu pannagāḥ || 29 ||
sarvasandhiṣu sādhyāśca candrādityau tu locane ||
kakude sarvakṣatrāṇi lāṃgūle dharma āśritaḥ || 30 ||
apāne sarvatīrthāni prasrāve jāhnavī nadī ||
nānādvīpasamākīrṇāścatvāraḥ sāgarāstathā || 31 ||
ṛṣayo romakūpeṣu gomaye padmadhāriṇī ||
rome vasanti vidyāśca tvakkeśeṣvayanadvayam || 32 ||

smṛtirmedhā tathā lajjā vapuḥ kīrttistathaiva ca || 33 ||
vidyā śāntirmatiścaiva santatiḥ paramā tathā ||
gacchantamanugacchanti hyetā gāvo na saṃśayaḥ || 34||
yatra gāvo jagattatra devadevapurogamāḥ ||
yatra gāvastatra lakṣmīḥ sāṃkhyadharmaśca śāśvataḥ || 35 ||
sarvarūpeṣu tā gāvastiṣṭhantyabhimatāstathā ||
bhavaneṣu viśāleṣu sarvaprāsādapaṅktiṣu || 36 ||
striyaśca puruṣāścaiva rakṣantaśca suyantritāḥ ||
śayanāsanapāneṣu hyupaviṣṭāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 37 ||
krīḍanti vividhairbhogairbhogeṣu ca sahasraśaḥ ||
tatra pānagṛheṣvanye puṣpamālāvibhūṣitāḥ || 38 ||
bhakṣyāṇāṃ vividhānāṃ ca bhojanānāṃ ca saṃcayāt ||

apaśyanvividhāstatra striyaśca śubhalocanā ||

udyāneṣu tathā cānyā bhavaneṣu ca puṇyataḥ ||
anena sadṛśaṃ nāsti hyasmādanyanna vidyate || 41 ||
aho sūtrakṛtaṃ śilpamahoratnairalaṃkṛtam ||
evaṃ gṛhādgṛhaṃ gacchannahaṃ tatra tatastamaḥ || 42 ||
tatastu nikhilaṃ samyagdṛṣṭvā karma mahodayam ||
punarevāgataḥ pārśvaṃ yamasya dvijasattamāḥ || 43 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe saṃsāracakre śubhakarmaphalodayo nāma ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 206 ||
atha saṃsāracakrapuruṣa vilobhanaprakaraṇam ||
ṛṣiputra uvāca ||
idamanyanmahābhāgānnāradātkalahapriyāt ||
śrutaṃ viprā yathā tatra yamasya sadasi svayam || 1 ||

ākhyānaṃ kathayāmāsa yaduktaṃ citrabhānunā || 2 ||

dharmarājasabhāṃ prāptastapasā dyotitaprabhaḥ ||4 ||

arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam || 5 ||

ayaṃ deśaḥ punaḥ pūtaḥ sarvato munisattama || 8 ||
yatkāryaṃ yena vā kāryaṃ yadvai manasi varttate ||
prabrūhi bhagavannāśu yaccānyatkiṃciduttamam || 9 ||
durllabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu yacca priyataraṃ tava ||

ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi yatpṛṣṭaṃ saṃśayāspadam || 11 ||
nārada uvāca||
bhavān pātā ca goptā ca netā dharmasya nityaśaḥ ||
satyena tapasā kṣāntyā dhairyeṇa ca na saṃśayaḥ || 12 ||

amaratvaṃ kathaṃ yāti vratena niyamena ca ||
kena vā dānadharmeṇa tapasā vā surottama || 14 ||
atulāṃ ca śriyaṃ loke kīrttiṃ ca sumahatphalam ||

yama uvāca ||
gacchanti hi narā ghorā bahavo'dharmanirmitam ||

śrūyatāṃ tanmahābhāga śrutvā caivopadhāraya || 18 ||
nāgnicinnarakaṃ yāti na putrī na ca bhūmidaḥ ||
śūraśca śatavarṣī ca vedānāṃ caiva pāragaḥ || 19 ||

ajitāścāśaṭhāścaiva svāmibhaktāśca ye narāḥ || 20 ||
ahiṃsakā na gacchanti brahmacaryavyavasthitāḥ ||
pativratā dānavanto dvijabhaktāśca ye narāḥ || 21 ||
svadāraniratā dāntāḥ paradāravivarjakāḥ ||
sarvabhūtātmabhūtāśca sarvabhūtānukampakāḥ || 22 ||

yātanāsthānasaṃpūrṇaṃ hāhākārabhayākulam || 23 ||
jñānavanto dvijā ye ca ye ca vidyāṃ parāṅgatāḥ ||
udāsīnā na gacchanti svāmyarthe ca hatā narāḥ || 24 ||
na gacchantyatra dātāraḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
śuśrūṣakā mātṛpitrorna gacchanti ca ye narāḥ || 25 ||

yathoktaṃ yajamānāśca satrayājina eva ca||
cāturmāsyakarā ye ca ye dvijāḥ āhitāgnayaḥ ||27||

nityasvādhyāyino dāntāḥ sadā sabhyāśca ye narāḥ ||28||
māṃ na paśyanti te caiva svātmabhāvena bhāvitāḥ||
aparvamaithunā ye ca na gacchanti jitendriyāḥ ||29||
brāhmaṇā amaratvaṃ ca prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
nivṛttāḥ sarvakāmebhyo nirāśāḥ sujitendriyāḥ || 30 ||

nārada uvāca ||
kiṃ dānaṃ śreya āhosvitpātreṇa phalamucyate ||

yama uvāca ||

rahasyamidamākhyānaṃ śrūyatāṃ munisattama ||

āyuḥprakarṣo bhogāśca bhavati tapasaiva tu || 37 ||

annadānena ca naraḥ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati||45||

pānīyasya pradānena tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī ||
annapānapradānena kāmabhogaistu tṛpyate ||47||
puṣpopagandhaṃ ca phalopagaṃdhaṃ yaḥ pādapaṃ sparśayate dvijāya ||

sragdhūpagandhānyanulepanāni puṣpāṇi gṛhyāṇi manoramāṇi || 49 ||

kṣaudreṇa nānārasatṛptatāṃ ca dīpapradānāddyutimāpnuvanti || 53 ||

ṛṣiputra uvāca ||
muhūrttasya tu kālasya divyābharaṇabhūṣitān ||
prayātāndivi saṃprekṣya vimānaiḥ sūryasannibhaiḥ || 1 ||

haviṣye varttamānānāmidaṃ varṣaśataṃ gatam || 41 ||
kuddālena hi kāṣṭhena kṣetraṃ vai kurmahe priye ||
tato dharmavidhiṃ tattvātprāpnuyāṃ me na saṃśayaḥ ||42|||
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca ye ye ca tatastvaṃ sukhamāpsyasi ||
evamuktā tato rājñī rājānamidamabravīt || 43 ||
devyuvāca ||
bhṛtyānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi tava rājanniveśane ||
aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca sairibhānāṃ tathaiva ca || 44 ||
uṣṭrāṇāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ ca kharāṇāṃ ca mahāyaśāḥ ||
ete sarve kathaṃ rājanna kurvanti tavepsitam || 45 ||
rājovāca ||
niyuktāni hi karmāṇi vārṣikāṇītarāṇi ca ||
sarvakarmāṇi kurvanti ye bhṛtyā me varānane || 46 ||
balīvardāḥ kharā aśvā gajā uṣṭrā hyanekaśaḥ ||
sarve niyuktā me devi sarvakarmasu śobhane || 47 ||
āyasaṃ trāpuṣaṃ tāmraṃ rājataṃ kāṃcanaṃ tathā ||
niyuktāni tu sarvāṇi sarva karmasvanindite || 48 ||
nanu paśyāmyahaṃ devi kiṃciddhaimaṃ na cāyasam ||
yena kuryāmahaṃ devi kuddālaṃ susamāhitaḥ ||49||
evamuktā mahādevī tena rājñā suśobhanā ||
hṛṣṭapuṣṭamanā devī rājānamidamabravīt || 50 ||
gaccha rājanyathākāmamanuyāsyāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ ||
evamuktaḥ suniṣkrāntaḥ sabhāryaḥ sa nareśvaraḥ || 51 ||
tato rājā ca devī ca kṣetraṃ mṛgayatastadā ||
gatau ca paramādhvānaṃ tato rājābravīdidam || 52 ||
idaṃ bhadraṃ mama kṣetramāssvātra varavarṇini ||
yāvadgulmānimān bhadre kaṇṭakāṃśca varānane || 53 ||
ahaṃ chinadmi vai devi tvametāñchodhaya priye ||
eṣa te karma yogastu tataḥ prāpsyāmi cepsitam || 54 ||
evamuktā mahādevī tena rājñā tapodhana ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ prahasantī nṛpāṅganā || 55 ||
vṛkṣo'tra dṛśyate pārśve sauvarṇo gulma eva ca ||
pānīyasya tu sānnidhyaṃ na kiṃcidiha dṛśyate || 56 ||
kathaṃ kṣetraṃ kariṣyāvo hṛdrogasya tu kārakam ||
iyaṃ nadī hyayaṃ vṛkṣa iyaṃ bhūmiḥ samāṃsalā || 57 ||
asminvāpi kṛtaṃ karma kathaṃ guṇakaraṃ bhavet ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā vacanamabravīt || 58 ||
śubhaṃ sānunayaṃ vākyaṃ bhūtānāṃ guṇavatsalaḥ ||
pūrvagṛhe bhavetpūrvaṃ viniyuktaṃ tathā priye || 59 ||
pānīyasya tu pārśvena sannikṛṣṭena sundari ||
caturthaṃ janaparyantaṃ na kiṃcidiha dṛśyate || 60 ||
ayaṃ gṛho mahādevi na ca bādhā'tra kasyacit ||
tatastacchodhayāmāsa tatkṣetraṃ bhāryayā saha || 61 ||
viyanmadhye tathograśca savitā tapate sadā ||
samṛddhaśca tadā tatra nidāghaḥ kāla āgataḥ || 62 ||
pravṛddho dāruṇo gharmaḥ kālaścaivātidāruṇaḥ ||
tataḥ sā tṛṣitā devī kṣudhitā ca tapasvinī || 63 ||
snigdhau tāmratalau pādau tasyāṃ santāpamāgatau ||
guṇapravāharaktau tu tasyāḥ pādau ca suvrata || 64 ||
sūryasya pādā madhyāhne tāpayantyagnisannibhāḥ ||
tataḥ sā vyathitā devī bharttāramidamabravīt || 65 ||
tṛṣitāsmi mahārāja bhṛśamuṣṇena pīḍitā ||
pānīyaṃ dīyatāṃ rājanmama śīghraṃ prasādataḥ || 66 ||
ityuktvā patitā devī vihvalā duḥkhapīḍitā ||
patantyā ca tayā sūryo dṛṣṭo vihvalayā tathā || 67 ||
yadṛcchayā patantyā tu sūryaḥ kopena vīkṣitaḥ ||
tato vivasvān bhagavān santrasto gagane tadā || 68||
divaṃ muktvā mahātejāḥ patito dharaṇītale ||
tato dṛṣṭvā tu rājā'sau svabhāvena ca varjitam || 69 ||
kimarthamiha tejasviṃstyaktvā maṇḍalamāgataḥ ||
kiṃ karomi mahātejāḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 70 ||
evaṃ bruvantaṃ rājānaṃ sūryaḥ sānunayo'bravīt ||
pativratā śubhākṣī ca mamaiṣā ruṣitā bhṛśam || 71 ||
tato'haṃ patito rājaṃstava kāryānuśāsanaḥ ||
anayā sadṛśī nārī trailokye naiva vidyate || 72 ||
pṛthivyāṃ svargaloke vā na kācidiha dṛśyate ||
aho'syāḥ paramaṃ sattvamaho'syāḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 73||
aho dhairyaṃ ca śaktiśca tavaivaṃ śaṃsitā guṇāḥ||
tatheyaṃ te mahābhāga tava cittānusāriṇī||74||
anurūpā viśuddhā ca tapasā ca varāṅganā||
pativratā ca sādhvī ca nityaṃ tava hite ratā||79||
sadṛśī te mahābhāga śakrasyeva yathā śacī ||
pātraṃ pātravatā prāptaṃ sukṛtasya mahatphalam ||76||
anurūpaḥ surūpo vā yato jātaḥ suyantritaḥ ||
mā ca te vitathaḥ kāmo bhaveccaiva narādhipaḥ ||77 ||
kuruṣva dayitaṃ kṣetraṃ yathā manasi varttate ||
bhojanārthaṃ mahārāja tvadanyo na hi vidyate||78||
phaladaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati hi kāmadam||
evamuktvā tataḥ sūryaḥ sasarja jalabhājanam||79||
upānahau ca chatraṃ ca divyālaṃkāra bhūṣitam ||
dadau ca rājñe savitā prītyā paramayā yutaḥ ||80 ||
upabhoktuṃ sukhasyārthaṃ supuṇyasya viśeṣataḥ ||
dattvā tatpuṇyakarmāṇaṃ tataḥ prāha divākaraḥ || 81 ||
evamuktvā tu bhagavāṃstathā tatkṛtavān kvacit ||
rājñā ca janakenaiva priyāyā hitakāmyayā || 82 ||
tataḥ sāpyāyitā devī toyena śubhalakṣaṇā ||
labdhasaṃjñā gatabhayā rājānamidamabravīt || 83 ||
devī dṛṣṭvā tadāścaryaṃ vismayotphullalocanā ||
kena dattaṃ śubhaṃ toyaṃ divyaṃ chatramupānahau || 84 ||
etanme saṃśayaṃ rājankathayasva tapodhana ||
rājovāca ||
eṣa devo mahādevi vivasvānnāma nāmataḥ || 85 ||
tavānukampayā devi muktvākāśamihāgataḥ ||
evamuktā tu sā devī bharttāramidamabravīt || 86 ||
karavāṇyasya kāṃ prītiṃ jñāyatāmasya vācchitam ||
tato rājā mahātejāḥ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ || 87 ||
vijñāpayāmāsa tadā bhagavan kiṃ karomi te ||
evamukto narendreṇa sūryo vacanamabravīt || 88 ||
abhayaṃ me mahārāja strībhyo bhavatu mānada ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya bhāskarasya tu mānadaḥ || 89 ||
tāṃ priyāṃ prītahṛdayāṃ śrāvayaṃstasya bhāṣitam ||
rājñastu vacanaṃ śrutvā devī vacanamabravīt || 90 ||
prītyā paramayā yuktā tasya rājño manaḥpriyā ||
raśmīnāṃ tāraṇārthāya chatraṃ dattvā tu kuṇḍikām || 91 ||
imau copānahau dattvā caubhau pādasya śaṅkarau ||
abhayaṃ te mahābhāga yathā tvaṃ vṛtavānasi || 92 ||
evaṃ pativratāṃ vipra pūjayāmi namāmi ca || 93 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe saṃsāracakre pativratopākhyānaṃ nāma aṣṭādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 208 ||
atha pativratāmāhātmya varṇanam ||
nārada uvāca ||
karmaṇā kena rājendra tapasā vā tapodhanāḥ ||
uttamāṃ ca gatiṃ yāṃti kṛṣṇavāsaḥ praśaṃsa me ||1||
evamuktastu dharmātmā nāradenābravīttadā ||
yama uvāca ||
na tasya niyamo vipra tapo naiva ca suvrata || 2 ||
upavāso na dānaṃ vā na devo vā mahāmune ||
yādṛśī tu bhavedvipra śṛṇu tattvaṃ samāsataḥ || 3 ||
prasupte yā prasvapiti jāgarti vibudhe svayam ||
bhuṅkte tu bhojite vipra sā mṛtyuṃ jayati dhuvam ||4 ||
maune maunā bhavedyā tu sthite tiṣṭhati yā svayam ||
sā mṛtyuṃ jāyate vipra nānyatpaśyāmi kiṃcana ||5 ||
ekadṛṣṭirekamanā bhartturvacanakāriṇī ||
tasyā bibhīmahe sarve ye tathānye tapodhana || 6 ||
devānāmapi sā sādhvī pūjyā paramaśobhanā ||
bhartrā cābhihitā yāpi na pratyākhyāyinī bhavet ||7||
varttamānāpi viprendra pratyākhyātāpi vā sadā ||
na daivataṃ samprayāti patyuranyaṃ kadācana || 8 ||
sā na mṛtyumukhaṃ yāti evaṃ yā strī pativratā ||
evaṃ yā tu bhavennityaṃ bharttuḥ priyahite ratā || 9 ||
anuveṣṭanabhāvena bharttāramanugacchati ||
sā tu mṛtyumukhadvāraṃ na gacchedbrahmasambhava || 10 ||
eṣa mātā pitā bandhureṣa me daivataṃ param ||
evaṃ śuśrūṣate yā tu sā māṃ vijayate sadā ||11||
pativratā tu yā sādhvī tasyāṃ cāhaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
bhartāramanudhyāyantī bharttāramanugacchatī || 12 ||
bharttāramanuśocantī mṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ||
gītavāditranṛtyāni prekṣaṇīyānyanekaśaḥ || 13 ||
na śṛṇoti na paśyedyā mṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ||
snāntī ca tiṣṭhatī vāpi kurvantī vā prasādhanam || 14 ||
nānyaṃ yā manasā paśyenmṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ||
devatā arcayantaṃ vā bhujyamānamapi dvija || 15 ||
patiṃ na tyajate cittānmṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ||
bhānau cānudite vāpi utthāya ca tapodhana || 16 ||
gṛhaṃ mārjayate nityaṃ mṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ||
cakṣurdehaśca bhāvaśca yasyā nityaṃ susaṃvṛtam || 17 ||
śaucācārasamāyuktā sāpi mṛtyuṃ na paśyati||
bhartturmukhaṃ prapaśyedyā bharttuścittānusāriṇī || 18 ||
varttate ca hite bhartturmṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ||
evaṃ kīrttimatāṃ loke dṛśyante divi devatāḥ || 19 ||
mānuṣāṇāṃ ca bhāryā vai tatra deśe tu dṛśyate ||
kathitaiva purā vipra ādityena pativratā || 20 ||
mayā tasmāttu viprarṣe yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam ||
guhyametattato dṛṣṭvā pūjayāmi pativratāḥ || 21 ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe saṃsāracakre pativratāmāhātmyaṃnāma navādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 209 ||
punaḥ pativratāmāhātmyavarṇanam ||
nārada uvāca ||
rahasyaṃ dharmamākhyānaṃ tvayoktaṃ tu mahāyaśaḥ ||
strīṇāṃ māhātmyamuddiśya bhāskarasya mataṃ yathā || 1 ||
idaṃ hi sarvabhūteṣu paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ||
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mahātapāḥ || 2 ||
ye narā duḥkhasantaptāstapastīvraṃ samāśritāḥ ||
nānāvrataśatopāyaiḥ sukhahetormahāprabha || 3 ||
manasā niścitātmānastyaktvā sarvapriyāpriyam |||
kāṃkṣante bahavaḥ kecitkenacidvinihanyate||4||
śrutā loke śrutistāta śreyodharmā hi nityaśaḥ||
samyakkṛcchrāśritasyātha kathaṃ pāpe matirbhavet||5||
kasyaitacceṣṭitaṃ tāta karttā kārayitāpi vā ||
kaḥ karṣati jagaccaiko bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham || 6 ||
kaṃ vā dveṣaṃ puraskṛtya matistasya pravarttate ||
sukhaduḥkhādi loke'sminprakaroti sudāruṇam || 7 ||
yadyevaṃ tu mayā guhyaṃ durvijñeyaṃ surairapi ||
śakyaṃ śrotuṃ mahārāja tadākhyāhi tapodhana || 8 ||
nāradenaivamuktastu dharmarājo mahāmanāḥ ||
vinayātpraśritaṃ vākyamidamāha mahāmunim || 9 ||
yama uvāca ||
devarṣe śrūyatāṃ puṇyaṃ yadbravīṣi mahāmune ||
tvaduktyā me kathayataḥ śṛṇuṣvāvahito'nagha || 10 ||
na kaściddṛśyate loke karttā kārayitāpi vā ||
yadvai paramadharmātman yasminkarma pratiṣṭhitam || 11 ||
yasya vai kīrttyate nāma yena cājñāpyate jagat ||
vyavaharāmi vacaścāhaṃ yaḥ karoti svayaṃ kṛtam || 12 ||
divye'smin sadasi brahman brahmarṣigaṇasaṃvṛte ||
yathāśrutaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ kathayiṣyāmyahaṃ vibho ||13||
svakarma bhujyate tāta sambhūtairyatkṛtaṃ svayam ||
ātmānaṃ pātayatyātmā kiñcitkarma ca kārayet || 14||
vāyunā bhāvitā saṃjñā saṃsāre sā dṛḍhīkṛtā ||
tāmeva bhajate jantuḥ sukṛtaṃ vātha duṣkṛtam || 15 ||
abhighātābhibhūtastu ātmanātmānamuddharet ||
ātmā śatruśca bandhuśca na kaścidbandhurātmanaḥ || 16 ||
bandhuṃ bandhuparikleśaṃ nirmitaṃ pūrvakarmabhiḥ ||
jagatyāmupabhuṅkte vai jīvā yoniśatairapi||17||
mithyāpravṛttaḥ śabdo'yaṃ jagadbhramati sarvaśaḥ ||
yāvattatkurute karma tāvatkarma svayaṃkṛtam || 18 ||
yathā yathā kṣayaṃ yāti hyaśubhaṃ puruṣasya vai ||
tathā tathā śubhā buddhirmanujasya pravarttate || 19 ||
saṃsāre prāptadoṣasya jāyamānasya dehinaḥ ||
patatāṃ ca gato bhāvaḥ pāpakarmakṣayena tu || 20 ||
śubhāśubhakarīṃ buddhiṃ labhate paurvadaihikīm ||
duṣkṛtaiḥ karmabhirdehī śubhairvā svayamarjitaiḥ||
kleśakṣayaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubhaṃ karma karotyatha ||21||
śubhāśubhaṃ naraḥ prāpya karmākarma tathaiva ca||
vivṛte vimale karmaṇyamareṣu mahīyate||22||
svargaḥ śubhaphalaprāptirnirayaḥ pāpasaṃbhavaḥ ||
naiva kaścitpradātā ca nāpahartā pradṛśyate || 23 ||
nārada uvāca ||
yadyevaṃ svakṛtaṃ karma samanveti śubhāśubham ||
śubhasyeha bhavedavṛddhiraśubhasya kṣayo'pi vā || 24 ||
manasā karmaṇā vāpi tapasā caritena vā ||
yathā na rohate jantustathā tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 25 ||
yama uvāca ||
idaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca hyaśubhānāṃ śubhapradam ||
kīrttayiṣyāmi te samyakpāpadoṣakṣayaṃ sadā || 26 ||
praṇamya śirasā samyakpāpapuṇyakarāya ca ||

yena sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ||
anādimadhyanidhanaṃ durvijñeyaṃ surāsuraiḥ || 28 ||

śubhanyāyaḥ sadā yaśca sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate || 33 ||

anasūyaśca yo martyaḥ sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate || 36 ||

akṣudraśīlastu naraḥ sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ||37||

nārada uvāca ||

mahāpātakanāśastu tadā tasya vidhīyate || 53 ||

kaṇṭhasthaṃ pātakaiḥ sarvairhradisthaṃ ca kṛtākṛtaiḥ || 54||
manasā karmaṇā vācā yatkiṃcitkaluṣaṃ kṛtam ||
udarasthaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 55 ||

yadā lāṃgalakaṇṭhe tu sthitaṃ paśyeddivākaram || 56 ||
tadā sa duṣkṛtānsarvānvināśayati mānavaḥ ||
yadā somaṃ guruṃ sarvaṃ yaḥ kuryāttu pradakṣiṇam ||57||
dhyāyeta hyakṣayaṃ yastu sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ||
bhṛgurbudhaḥ śanaiścāro lohitāṅgaśca vīryavān ||58||
saumyarūpo yadā candraḥ kurute ca pradakṣiṇām ||
hṛdi kṛtvā tu tatpāpaṃ yo dhyāyedakṣaraṃ śuciḥ ||59||
tadā nirmalatāṃ yāti candramāḥ śārado yathā ||

punaḥ pāpanāśopāyavarṇanam ||
ṛṣiputra uvāca||

upāyo'taḥparo nānyo vidyate hi vasundhare ||

nandinā varadānaṃ ca jalaśaileśayostathā || 48 ||
śṛṃgeśvarasya mahimā caivaṃ vṛttāntasaṃgrahaḥ ||
etacchrutvāpnuyānmarttyo vārāhaśrutijaṃ phalam || 49 ||
ityanukramaṇikā nāma aṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 218 ||
samāptaṃ vārāhaṃ mahāpurāṇaṃ śubham ||
yādṛśaṃ pustake dṛṣṭaṃ tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā ||
yadi śuddhamaśuddhaṃ vā mama doṣo na vidyate || 1 ||
